docs.text: ​过程​ \(X = \{X_t\}_{t \in T}\) adapted ​指对​每个​ \(t \in T\)，\(X_t\) ​是​ \(\mathcal{F}_t\)-​可测​的​（​取值​通常​在​ \((\mathbb{R}^d, \mathcal{B}(\mathbb{R}^d))\)）。

docs.title: Definition 1.2 (predictable, continuous-time)
docs.text: predictable \(\sigma\)-​代数​ \(\mathcal{P}\) ​是​使​所有​左​连续​ adapted ​过程​ \(H: [0, T] \times \Omega \to \mathbb{R}\) ​可测​的​最小​ \(\sigma\)-​代数​；​等价​地​，\(\mathcal{P}\) ​由​ \(\{(s, t] \times A: 0 \leq s < t, A \in \mathcal{F}_s\}\) ​生成​（Protter 2004 (R22) Ch. III）。\(X\) predictable ​即​ \(X: ([0, T] \times \Omega, \mathcal{P}) \to (\mathbb{R}^d, \mathcal{B}(\mathbb{R}^d))\) ​可测​。​离散​时间​下​退化​为​ \(X_n \in \mathcal{F}_{n-1}\)（​约定​ \(\mathcal{F}_{-1} = \mathcal{F}_0\) ​或​ trivial）。

docs.title: Definition 1.3 (progressively measurable)
docs.text:
\(X\) progressively measurable ​指对​每个​ \(t\)，restrictions \(X|_{[0, t] \times \Omega}\) ​关于​ \(\mathcal{B}([0, t]) \otimes \mathcal{F}_t\) ​可测​。

Inclusion ​严格​：predictable \(\subsetneq\) progressively measurable \(\subsetneq\) adapted。​连续​时间​下​ adapted + ​右​连续​轨道​ \(\Rightarrow\) progressively measurable（​标准​事实​，Karatzas-Shreve 1991 (R20) ​命题​ 1.1.13）；​离散​时间​ hierarchy ​由​ measurability shift ​一目了然​。

docs.title: Definition 1.4 (conditional expectation)
docs.text:
​对​ \(X \in L^1(\Omega, \mathcal{F}, \mathbb{P})\) ​与子​ \(\sigma\)-​代数​ \(\mathcal{G} \subseteq \mathcal{F}\)，\(\mathbb{E}[X \mid \mathcal{G}]\) ​是​几乎​处处​唯一​的​ \(\mathcal{G}\)-​可测​随机变量​，​满足​ \(\int_A \mathbb{E}[X \mid \mathcal{G}]\,d\mathbb{P} = \int_A X\,d\mathbb{P}\) ​对​所有​ \(A \in \mathcal{G}\)。

​它​是​ linear operator；​在​ \(L^2(\mathcal{F})\) ​上​是​到​ \(L^2(\mathcal{G})\) ​子​空间​的​ orthogonal projection，​并​通过​稠密​延拓​得到​ \(L^p\) ​上​的​ \(\|\cdot\|_p\)-contraction \(\|\mathbb{E}[X \mid \mathcal{G}]\|_p \leq \|X\|_p\)（\(p \geq 1\)）；tower property \(\mathbb{E}[\mathbb{E}[X \mid \mathcal{G}] \mid \mathcal{H}] = \mathbb{E}[X \mid \mathcal{H}]\)（\(\mathcal{H} \subseteq \mathcal{G}\)）​是​后续​几乎​所有​ martingale ​论证​的​基础​。

docs.title: Definition 1.5 (stopping time)
docs.text:
\(\tau: \Omega \to T \cup \{+\infty\}\) ​是​ stopping time ​指​ \(\{\tau \leq t\} \in \mathcal{F}_t\) ​对​所有​ \(t \in T\)（​离散​版​替换​ \(\leq t\) ​为​ \(\leq n\)）。stopped \(\sigma\)-​代数​ \(\mathcal{F}_\tau = \{A \in \mathcal{F}: A \cap \{\tau \leq t\} \in \mathcal{F}_t\;\forall t\}\)。​三种​ closing ​条件​绝不​混用​：(i) bounded \(\tau \leq T_0\)；(ii) finite a.s. \(\tau < \infty\) a.s.；(iii) UI（uniform integrability）closing。​这​三种​条件​在​ §2 OST ​四​版本​与​ §3 ​收敛​三​版本​中​精确​匹配​。

​类比​仅供​直觉​：filtration ​编码​"​截止​ \(t\) ​时​可​观测​信息​"，stopping time ​是​"​决策​时刻​只​看​可​观测​信息​"。formal ​上​ hierarchy ​与​ closing ​条件​的​严格​性​在​后续​章节​是​核心​，​不可​由​直觉​替代​。

docs.title: §1.1 ​三类​可测性​的​分立​动机​与​下游​用法
docs.text:
predictable / progressively measurable / adapted ​三层​可测性​的​分立​并非​纯​技术​游戏​。​下游​章节​里​这三类​各自​承担​不同​ role：

​第一​，predictable ​用于​ integrand——§2 Theorem 2.2 mart transform \((H \cdot M)_n\) ​要求​ \(H_n \in \mathcal{F}_{n-1}\)，§6 Definition 6.1 stochastic integral \(\int H\,dX\) ​要求​ \(H\) predictable；​这​是因为​ mart ​的​"​决策​当前​积累​"​语义​要求​ integrand ​在​事件​发生​之前​就​被​锁定​。​如果​允许​ \(H\) ​仅​ adapted，\((H \cdot M)\) ​不再​保留​ mart ​性质​（Williams 1991 (R8) §10.6 ​给出​反例​）。

​第二​，progressively measurable ​用于​ path-integral——continuous time ​下要​让​ \(\int_0^t f(s, \omega)\,ds\) ​作为​ \(\mathcal{F}_t\)-​可测​ random variable，​仅​ \(f\) adapted ​不够​；progressively measurable ​是​最弱​的​可​保证​此​ Fubini-style ​结论​成立​的​可测性​条件​。§8 BSDE driver \(f(t, \omega, y, z)\) ​标的​ progressively measurable ​正​出于​此​。

​第三​，adapted ​用于​ state process——semimart ​分解​ \(X = M + A\)、value process \(Y_t\)、Snell envelope \(U_t\) ​等​都​是​ adapted；​其​反映​ "​当前​状态​信息​已知​" ​但​不​要求​"​信息​已​锁定​"。

​三层​ inclusion ​是​ strict：​在​ \([0, T] \times \Omega\) ​上​选​ deterministic ​时间​ \(t_0\) + Bernoulli ​随机变量​ \(\eta \perp \mathcal{F}_{t_0}\)，​定义​ \(X_t = \eta \cdot \mathbf{1}_{t \geq t_0}\) ​给​ adapted ​但​非​ progressively measurable ​例​；​类似​ construction ​区分​ predictable ​与​ progressively measurable（Protter 2004 (R22) Ch. I §3 ​详例​）。

docs.title: §1.2 ​离散​ vs ​连续​ setup ​的​关键​差异
docs.text:
​本文​ §2-§4 ​走​ discrete、§5-§9 ​走​ continuous，​两轨​在​ setup ​层面​差异​已经​显著​：

  • usual conditions: discrete ​不​需要​；continuous ​必须​（​右​连续​ + ​完备化​），​否则​ \(\mathcal{F}_\tau\) ​的​良性​、stopping time ​限制​操作​（​如​ \(\tau_n \downarrow \tau\)）​失去​ measurability ​保证​；
  • predictable σ-​代数​: discrete ​简化​为​ \(\mathcal{F}_{n-1}\)-meas，​连续​上升​为​ \(\mathcal{P}\) ​由​左​连续​ adapted ​过程​生成​的​ \(\sigma\)-​代数​；
  • class (D): discrete ​不​需要​——\(L^1\)-bounded mart ​自动​ UI ​在​ closing ​处​可​成立​；continuous ​不可​省​，§6 Doob-Meyer ​唯一性​严​依赖​（F-9 ​即​指此​ differential）；
  • quadratic variation: discrete \([S]_n = \sum d_k^2\) ​直接​定义​；continuous \([X]_t\) ​需​ mesh-shrinking limit in probability ​才​存在​，​且​ \([X] = \langle X\rangle\) ​在​跳​出现​时​破坏​（§5 Definition 5.3）。

​下游​章节​里​这些​差异​点​逐一​显化​；F-7/F-8/F-9/F-10 forbidden ​列表​正是​用来​防止​读者​把​ discrete intuition ​直​推​ continuous ​的​常见​误区​。

docs.title: §1.3 mode of convergence ​的​五分​谱​与​误用​代价
docs.text:
​本文​ ANTIPATTERN #13 ​写作​约束​第​ 6 ​条​要求​：​任何​"​收敛​"​陈述​均​需​显标​ a.s. / \(L^p\) / in prob / in dist / ucp ​五种​之一​。​这五种​ mode ​在​ martingale ​理论​中​的​精确​含义​：

  • a.s.（almost surely）: \(\mathbb{P}(\lim_n X_n = X) = 1\)；​这是​ §3 Theorem 3.1 ​离散​ mart ​收敛​三​版本​的​主体​结论​；
  • \(L^p\) (\(p \geq 1\)): \(\mathbb{E}|X_n - X|^p \to 0\)；​在​ §3 A2b UI / A2c \(L^p\)-bounded ​与​ §9 LSM Theorem 9.6 ​出现​；
  • in probability: \(\mathbb{P}(|X_n - X| > \varepsilon) \to 0\) ​对​任意​ \(\varepsilon > 0\)；​在​ §5 Definition 5.3 quadratic variation \([X]_t\) ​定义​中​使用​（pathwise limit in probability）；
  • in distribution: \(\mathbb{E}[f(X_n)] \to \mathbb{E}[f(X)]\) ​对​所有​ bounded continuous \(f\)；​在​ §3 Corollary 3.3 mart CLT ​中​使用​；
  • ucp（uniformly on compacts, in probability）: continuous-time ​下​ \(\sup_{t \leq T}|X_n(t) - X(t)| \to 0\) in probability ​对​任意​ \(T\)；§6 stochastic integral ​延拓​的​拓扑​基础​。

​五种​ mode ​不可​笼统​替换​。​最​常见​误用​：​把​ §3 A2a "a.s." ​强行​说成​ "\(L^1\)"；​把​ §5 \([X]_t\) "limit in probability" ​强行​说成​ "a.s."；​把​ §3 Corollary 3.3 "in distribution" ​强行​说成​ "in probability"。​每种​误用​导致​下游​论证​ hypothesis ​失配​，​本文​严格​禁止​。

docs.title: §1.3a ​离散​化​与​连续​化​的​工程化​考虑
docs.text:
​实际​计算​中​的​ martingale ​几乎​全在​离散​网格​上​实现​（​即使​理论​ setup ​是​ continuous）。​连续​ → ​离散​的​工程化​考虑​涉及​：

  • Euler-Maruyama ​离散​化​: ​把​ SDE \(dX_t = b\,dt + \sigma\,dW\) ​离散​为​ \(X_{t_{n+1}} = X_{t_n} + b\,\Delta t + \sigma\,\Delta W_n\)；​离散​ mart ​性质​在​ Euler ​离散​下​保持​（​条件期望​仍​正确​），​但​ quadratic variation ​可能​有​ \(O(\Delta t)\) ​误差​；
  • higher-order schemes: Milstein / Runge-Kutta ​等​给​更​高阶​离散​收敛​，​但​保持​ mart ​性质​需谨慎​设计​；
  • strong vs weak convergence: strong convergence ​控制​ path-wise ​误差​，​适合​ hedging；weak convergence ​控制​ expectation ​误差​，​适合​ option pricing。​两者​收敛​率​不同​（typically strong rate < weak rate）；
  • time-step adaptive: ​在​ stress region（​如​ close to barrier / strike）​用​更​细​ time step；§10.1 deep BSDE ​在​实际​实现​中​常用​ adaptive grid。

​离散​化​的​精确​控制​对​ §10.1 deep BSDE / §10.2 deep OS ​的​收敛​分析​至关重要​——Han-Long 2020 a posteriori bound ​显式​ dependence on \(\Delta t\) ​即此​体现​。

docs.title: §1.4 ​本文​与​经典​文献​的​ setup ​取舍
docs.text:
v3 ​标准​教科书​（​如​ K-S 1991 (R20) / Protter 2004 (R22) / Williams 1991 (R8)）​的​ setup ​在​本文​ v4 ​综述​中​作为​ baseline。​本文​ v4 setup ​取舍​：

  • ​保留​ measure-theoretic ​严格​性​: ​所有​定义​ / ​定理​ hypothesis ​严格​ spell out，​不​省略​ σ-​代数​ / measurability / integrability ​细节​；
  • ​强化​ mode of convergence ​显写​: ​比​经典​文献​更​显式标​ a.s. / \(L^p\) / in prob / in dist / ucp；
  • ​强化​ OST ​四​版本​分立​: ​经典​文献​偶有​笼统​ "by optional sampling"，​本文​ F-7 ​严禁​；
  • ​强化​ discrete vs continuous Doob ​区分​: ​经典​文献​偶有​跳​过​ "discrete ​不需​ class (D)" ​的​强调​，​本文​ F-9 ​显式​区分​；
  • ​新增​ §4 self-norm ​系列​与​ §10 ​高维​数值​章节​: v3 ​不​覆盖​ 2024-2026 ​前沿​，v4 ​重心​加入​。

§13 taxonomy ​矩阵​的​ 6 ​轴​正交​划分​（​时间​域​ / integrator class / ​应用​域​ / ML ​算法​栈​ / concentration / filtration ​假设​）​是​ v4 ​综述​定位​的​精确​编码​。

docs.title: §1.5 Notation ​补遗​（​下游​高频​符号​）
docs.text: ​补​ 5 ​项​（​其余​ 16 ​项见​ phase0d §3 Final Notation Table）： - \(S^2\): \(\{Y \text{ adapted cádlàg}: \mathbb{E}\sup_t|Y_t|^2 < \infty\}\) — BSDE ​解​ \(Y\) ​所在​空间​（§8）； - \(H^2\): \(L^2(\Omega \times [0, T], \mathcal{P}, d\mathbb{P} \otimes ds; \mathbb{R}^d)\) — BSDE ​解​ \(Z\) / MRT representer ​空间​（§7-§8）； - class (D): \(\{X_\tau: \tau \text{ finite stopping}\}\) UI — Doob-Meyer ​全局​唯一性​ hypothesis（§5 Def 5.2 / §6 Thm 6.3）； - strict local mart: local mart ​但​非​ mart — bubble ​数学​对应​（§5 Ex 5.4 / §11.1）； - Esscher ​变换​: \(d\mathbb{Q}/d\mathbb{P} = \exp(\lambda X - \log \mathbb{E}[\exp(\lambda X)])\) — single-period ​指数​ tilting（§11.2）。

docs.title: §1.6 Bridge to Thread A — ​离散​ mart ​的​最小​工作​ setup
docs.text:
§1 ​已​建立​ filtered probability space、measurability hierarchy、stopping time、​五种​ mode of convergence ​的​完整​ vocabulary。​从​这​一​通用​ setup ​进入​ Thread A（§2-§4），motivation ​是​：​在​ closing ​条件​（bounded \(\tau\)、UI、\(L^p\)-bounded \(p > 1\)）​确定​之前​，​离散​ mart ​已能​在​最弱​ hypothesis（adapted + \(\mathbb{E}|X_n| < \infty\)）​下​展开​不等式​ / ​收敛​ / concentration ​三件套​——​这是​ §2 Doob ​不等式​ + §3 ​收敛​ + §4 concentration ​的​总线​。

​具体​地​，Thread A ​主体​ hypothesis ​不​需要​ §5 ​的​ semimart ​阶梯​、\([X]\) vs \(\langle X\rangle\) ​分离​、class (D)；​这些​ measure-theoretic ​重型​工具​被​推迟​到​ Thread B ​引入​。​这一​ hypothesis ​分层​使​读者​能先​掌握​离散​ mart ​的​代数​ + ​不等式​ + ​收敛​骨架​（"adapted process + ​条件期望​ + stopping"​三件套​），​再​在​ §5-§8 ​把​ setup ​升级​到​连续​时间​的​ semimart-central ​阶梯​。

docs.title: §2 ​离散​时间​ martingale ​与​ Doob ​不等式​系列​ (thread: A)
docs.text: Model basis. filtered \((\Omega, \mathcal{F}, \{\mathcal{F}_n\}_{n \in \mathbb{N}}, \mathbb{P})\)；adapted \(X = \{X_n\}\)，\(\mathbb{E}|X_n| < \infty\)。​不​需要​：semimart ​结构​ / \([X]\) vs \(\langle X\rangle\) ​分离​ / class (D)。

docs.title: Definition 2.1 (mart / sub / supermart, discrete)
docs.text: \(X\) ​是​ \((\mathcal{F}_n)\)-martingale ​指​ \(\mathbb{E}[X_{n+1} \mid \mathcal{F}_n] = X_n\) a.s. ​对​所有​ \(n\)；​将​等​号​换​为​ \(\geq\)（resp. \(\leq\)）​得到​ submartingale（resp. supermartingale）。​约定​不可​双向​松弛​：​方向​严格​区分​。

docs.title: Definition 2.2 (predictable process & martingale transform)
docs.text: \(H = \{H_n\}_{n \geq 1}\) predictable ​指​ \(H_n \in \mathcal{F}_{n-1}\)。​给定​ mart \(M\) ​与​ predictable bounded \(H\)，martingale transform \((H \cdot M)_n := \sum_{k=1}^n H_k (M_k - M_{k-1})\) ​是​ mart（Williams 1991 (R8) §10.6）。​这是​ §6 stochastic integral \(\int H\,dM\) ​的​离散​原型​。

docs.title: Theorem 2.1 (Doob's maximal inequality, \(L^p\) version)
docs.text: ​设​ \(X = \{X_n\}_{0 \leq n \leq N}\) ​是非​负​ submartingale，\(p > 1\)。​记​ \(X_N^* := \max_{0 \leq n \leq N} X_n\)。​则​ $\(\|X_N^*\|_p \leq \frac{p}{p-1}\|X_N\|_p.\)$ \(p = 1\) ​时​退化​为​ weak-type ​不等式​ \(\lambda \cdot \mathbb{P}(X_N^* \geq \lambda) \leq \mathbb{E}[X_N \mathbf{1}_{\{X_N^* \geq \lambda\}}]\)（Doob 1953 (R1) Ch. VII）。

docs.title: Theorem 2.2 (Doob's upcrossing inequality)
docs.text: ​设​ \(X\) submart，\(a < b\)；\(U_N([a, b])\) = ​截止​时间​ \(N\) ​时​ \(X\) ​穿越​ \([a, b]\) ​自下而上​的​次数​。​则​ $\((b - a)\,\mathbb{E}[U_N([a, b])] \leq \mathbb{E}[(X_N - a)^+] - \mathbb{E}[(X_0 - a)^+].\)$ ​此​不等式​直接​推出​离散​ mart ​收敛​定理​（§3 Theorem 3.1）：\(L^1\)-bounded sup-mart ​的​ upcrossing ​期望​ finite ​给出​ \(\{X_n\}\) a.s. ​收敛​。

docs.title: Theorem 2.3 (Optional Sampling Theorem, ​四版​分立​, F-7)
docs.text:
​设​ \(X\) submartingale，\(\sigma \leq \tau\) ​是​两个​ stopping times。 - OST-1 (bounded): ​若​ \(\tau \leq T_0\) a.s. ​对​某​常数​ \(T_0\)，​则​ \(\mathbb{E}[X_\tau \mid \mathcal{F}_\sigma] \geq X_\sigma\) a.s.； - OST-2 (DCT): ​若​ \(\tau < \infty\) a.s. ​且​存在​可积​ \(Y\) ​使​ \(|X_{\tau \wedge n}| \leq Y\) ​对​所有​ \(n\)，​则​ \(\mathbb{E}[X_\tau] \geq \mathbb{E}[X_\sigma]\)； - OST-3 (UI): ​若​ \(X\) uniformly integrable，​且​ \(\sigma \leq \tau\) ​任意​ stopping times（​含​ \(\tau = +\infty\) ​时​定义​ \(X_\infty := \lim_n X_n\)），​结论​同​ OST-1； - OST-4 (\(L^p\)-bounded, \(p > 1\)): ​若​ \(\sup_n \mathbb{E}|X_n|^p < \infty\)，UI ​自动​成立​，​落入​ OST-3。

​引用​ OST ​必须​ specify ​用​的​是​哪​一​版本​——​笼统​ "by optional sampling" ​在​本文​ forbidden（F-7）。

docs.title: Theorem 2.4 (Burkholder-Davis-Gundy, discrete)
docs.text:
​设​ \(S_n = \sum_{k=1}^n d_k\) ​为​ mart, \([S]_n := \sum_{k=1}^n d_k^2\) ​离散​ quadratic variation。​则​对​ \(p \geq 1\) ​存在​通用​常数​ \(c_p, C_p > 0\)（​仅​依赖​ \(p\)）​使得​ $\(c_p\,\mathbb{E}\big[[S]_n^{p/2}\big] \leq \mathbb{E}\big[\max_{k \leq n}|S_k|^p\big] \leq C_p\,\mathbb{E}\big[[S]_n^{p/2}\big].\)$ ​此即​ Burkholder 1973 (R5)；Hall-Heyde 1980 (R7) Ch. 2 ​给出​最优​常数​比较​与​ \(p = 1\) ​端点​（​涉及​ Davis ​不等式​）。

​注​ 2.A (F-8 / FC-8). discrete ​上​ \([S]_n = \sum d_k^2\) ​与​ conditional \(\langle S\rangle_n = \sum_{k=1}^n \mathbb{E}[d_k^2 \mid \mathcal{F}_{k-1}]\) ​是​不同​对象​；​二者​通过​ \([S] - \langle S\rangle\) ​是​ mart ​联系​（​即​ \(\{[S]_n - \langle S\rangle_n\}\) ​是​ mart）。​一般​ (​跳​) semimart ​上​ \([X] \neq \langle X\rangle\)（​详​ §5 ​与​ F-8）。

​类比​仅供​直觉​：\([S]_n\) ​类似​"​轨道​能量​"，\(\langle S\rangle_n\) ​类似​"​可​预测​能量​预算​"；​二者​差额​是​ mart ​噪声​。

docs.title: §2.1 ​离散​ mart ​的​可视化​与​ fair-game ​解释
docs.text: mart ​等式​ \(\mathbb{E}[X_{n+1} \mid \mathcal{F}_n] = X_n\) ​是​"​在​ \(\mathcal{F}_n\) ​已知​条件​下​，​下​一步​期望​增量​为​零​"​的​形式​陈述​；submart \(\mathbb{E}[X_{n+1} \mid \mathcal{F}_n] \geq X_n\) ​是​"​期望​增量​非负​"（​趋势​向上​），supermart ​反向​。​本文​章节​中​的​ fair-game / ​趋势​分解​ / ​漂移​ / ​偏向​交互​均​在​此基础​上​展开​；mart ​的​"​无​信息​漂移​"​性质​是​ §3 ​收敛​、§4 concentration、§6-§7 stochastic integral、§9 FTAP ​全部​ downstream ​内容​的​核心​驱动力​。

docs.title: §2.2 Doob ​不等式​系列​的​工具​谱​比较
docs.text:
§2 ​罗列​的​四件套​——maximal、\(L^p\) Doob、upcrossing、OST——​服务​不同​目的​：

  • maximal ​不等式​ (Theorem 2.1) ​用于​控制​ path supremum \(\max_{n} X_n\) ​的​尾​概率​，​是​ deviation analysis ​的​入门​工具​；
  • \(L^p\) Doob inequality ​给出​ \(\|X_N^*\|_p\) ​与​ \(\|X_N\|_p\) ​的​同阶​等价​（\(p > 1\) ​时​常数​ \(p/(p-1)\)）——​这是​ BDG ​不等式​ \(L^p\) ​等价​的​基础设施​；
  • upcrossing (Theorem 2.2) ​是​ §3 ​收敛​定理​的​几何​核心​：a.s. ​收敛​ ⇔ ​任意​有理​ \((a, b)\) ​上​的​ upcrossing ​次数​ \(U_\infty([a, b])\) a.s. ​有限​；
  • OST (Theorem 2.3) ​把​"​任意​ stopping time \(\tau\) ​的​ mart sampled value"​控制​在​ mart ​等式​之内​，​是​ stopping problem / Snell envelope (§9) / BSDE comparison (§8) ​的​基础​桥梁​。

​四件套​的​关系​并非​孤立​：upcrossing ​与​ maximal ​不等式​之间​存在​ Birkhoff-type ​等价​表达​，​而​ OST ​在​ UI ​假设​下​退化​为​ mart ​在​ \(L^1\) ​闭合​的​紧致性​陈述​。​本文​ §3 ​收敛​定理​证明​同时​调用​ maximal + upcrossing；§9 Snell envelope ​性质​同时​调用​ OST + Doob-Meyer。

docs.title: §2.2a Doob upcrossing ​不等式​的​现代​视角
docs.text:
Theorem 2.2 upcrossing ​不等式​是​ mart a.s. ​收敛​证明​的​几何​核心​。​其​现代​视角​解读​：

  • ​几何​: \(U_N([a, b])\) ​计数​ \(X\) ​在​ \([a, b]\) ​上​"​自下而上​穿越​"​次数​；​如果​ a.s. ​收敛​失败​，​则​存在​ \(a < b\) ​使​ \(U_\infty([a, b]) = +\infty\) with positive probability；
  • probabilistic content: \(\mathbb{E}[U_N([a, b])] \leq \mathbb{E}[(X_N - a)^+]/(b - a)\) ——​即​ expected upcrossing ​受​ \(X\) ​的​ \(L^1\)-bound ​控制​；
  • a.s. ​收敛​ ⇔ ​任意​有理​ \((a, b)\) ​上​ \(U_\infty([a, b]) < \infty\) a.s.: ​这一​等价​ follows from Cauchy criterion + \(\mathbb{Q}\) ​稠密​；
  • ​现代​推广​: \(L^p\) upcrossing inequality (Burkholder), oscillation inequality, \(\rho\)-variation ​等​是​ upcrossing ​的​精细​ quantification。

upcrossing ​框架​在​现代​ stochastic analysis ​中​仍​是​核心​工具​，​特别​在​ ergodic theory / ​大偏差​ / ​高维​ stochastic optimization ​等​领域​的​ path-property ​证明​。​本文​ §3 Theorem 3.1 ​三版​收敛​均​经由​ upcrossing ​推出​。

docs.title: §2.3 OST ​四​版本​误用​的​常见​模式
docs.text:
F-7 ​严禁​笼统​ "by optional sampling"。​下游​章节​里​ OST ​引用​的​四种​典型​场景​：

  • OST-1 bounded \(\tau\): ​在​ finite-horizon ​设定​（​如​ §9 Bermudan ​网格​）​下​最易​满足​；​只要​ \(\tau \leq T_0\)，​无须​额外​ integrability；
  • OST-2 DCT: ​在​ \(X\) unbounded ​但​ \(|X_{\tau \wedge n}|\) ​被​可积​ dominating ​函数​ ​控制​时​使用​——​常见于​ §7 Girsanov ​密度​过程​ \(\mathcal{E}(N)\) ​局部​ mart ​转​ mart ​的​ truncation ​证明​；
  • OST-3 UI: ​在​ closed mart \(\{X_n\}_{n \in \mathbb{N} \cup \{\infty\}}\) ​设置​下​使用​——§3 Theorem 3.1 A2b、§9 FTAP ​复制​策略​对应​；
  • OST-4 \(L^p\)-bounded \(p > 1\): ​由​ Hölder + \(L^p\)-Doob ​自动​归约​到​ OST-3——§4 self-norm Bernstein ​的​部分​推论​使用​。

​每次​引用​时​必须​落入​四类​之一​并​写明​；​任何​ "OST gives ..." ​而​无​版本​说明​的​语句​在​本文​均​不予​接受​（F-7）。

docs.title: §3 ​离散​ martingale ​收敛​与​ Doob ​分解​ (thread: A)
docs.text: Model basis. §2 setup ​加上​ closing ​条件​：\(L^1\)-bounded ​或​ UI ​或​ \(L^p\)-bounded（\(p > 1\)）。discrete Doob ​分解​不​需要​ class (D)（F-9）。

docs.title: Theorem 3.1 (Doob's martingale convergence, ​三版​分立​)
docs.text:
• A2a (\(L^1\)-bounded supermart): ​若​ \(X\) supermart ​且​ \(\sup_n \mathbb{E}|X_n| < \infty\)，​则​存在​ \(X_\infty \in L^1\) ​使​ \(X_n \to X_\infty\) a.s.（​仅​ a.s.，​未必​ \(L^1\) ​收敛​）；
  • A2b (UI mart): ​若​ \(X\) UI mart，​则​ \(X_n \to X_\infty\) a.s. ​且​ \(L^1\)；​且​ \(X_n = \mathbb{E}[X_\infty \mid \mathcal{F}_n]\)（Lévy upward）；
  • A2c (\(L^p\)-bounded, \(p > 1\)): ​若​ mart ​且​ \(\sup_n \|X_n\|_p < \infty\)，​则​ a.s. ​且​ \(L^p\) ​收敛​。

​证明​骨架​：A2a ​由​ Theorem 2.2 upcrossing ​限制​ \(\mathbb{E}[U_\infty([a, b])] < \infty\) ​给​所有​有理​ \((a, b)\) a.s. ​收敛​；A2b/A2c ​加​ \(L^p\)-Doob maximal ​给​ dominated convergence (Williams 1991 (R8) Ch. 11)。

docs.title: Theorem 3.2 (Doob decomposition, discrete, F-9)
docs.text:
​任一​ adapted ​过程​ \(X\) ​与​ \(\mathbb{E}|X_n| < \infty\)，​存在​唯一​分解​ $\(X_n = X_0 + M_n + A_n,\quad M_0 = A_0 = 0,\)$ ​其中​ \(M\) ​是​ mart with ​显式​公式​ \(M_n = X_n - X_0 - A_n = \sum_{k=1}^n (X_k - \mathbb{E}[X_k \mid \mathcal{F}_{k-1}])\)，\(A\) predictable ​且​ \(A_n = \sum_{k=1}^n \mathbb{E}[X_k - X_{k-1} \mid \mathcal{F}_{k-1}]\)。​当​ \(X\) submart ​时​ \(A\) nondecreasing。​此处​不需​ class (D)——​它​的​ continuous ​类比​ Doob-Meyer ​才​依赖​ class (D)（§6 Theorem 6.3 ​与​ F-9）。

Mini-example (biased random walk). ​设​ \(\{\varepsilon_i\}_{i \geq 1}\) i.i.d.，\(\mathbb{E}[\varepsilon_i] = \mu\), \(\mathrm{Var}(\varepsilon_i) = \sigma^2 < \infty\)；\(X_n = \sum_{i=1}^n \varepsilon_i\)，\(\mathcal{F}_n = \sigma(\varepsilon_1, \ldots, \varepsilon_n)\)。​则​ \(\mathbb{E}[X_k - X_{k-1} \mid \mathcal{F}_{k-1}] = \mathbb{E}[\varepsilon_k] = \mu\)，​故​ \(A_n = n\mu\) (deterministic linear drift, predictable trivially), \(M_n = X_n - n\mu = \sum_{i=1}^n (\varepsilon_i - \mu)\) ​是​ zero-mean i.i.d. ​和​ (mart)。

​无​ drift ​极限​ \(\mu = 0\) ​退化​为​纯​ mart \(X_n = M_n\), \(A_n \equiv 0\)；​正​ drift ​极限​ \(\mu > 0\) ​给​ submart ​与​ \(A\) nondecreasing。​这一​最​简单​例​直接​展示​ Doob decomp ​的​"​零​均值​噪声​ + ​可​预测​漂移​"​语义​——​下游​ §8 BSDE ​的​ \(-dY = f\,dt - Z\,dB\) ​把​ driver \(f\) ​视作​连续​时间​下​ predictable drift ​部分​，​正是​此​ mini-example ​的​连续​化​对应​。

docs.title: Corollary 3.3 (Discrete BDG → mart CLT ​桥接​)
docs.text:
​结合​ Theorem 2.4 (BDG) ​与​ Lindeberg ​条件​下​的​ mart difference array CLT（Hall-Heyde 1980 (R7) Ch. 3，​详尽​常用​版​）：​若​ mart diff ​阵​ \(\{d_{n,k}\}\) ​满足​ \(\sum_k \mathbb{E}[d_{n,k}^2 \mid \mathcal{F}_{n,k-1}] \to \sigma^2\) in prob ​且​ conditional Lindeberg \(\sum_k \mathbb{E}[d_{n,k}^2 \mathbf{1}_{|d_{n,k}| > \varepsilon} \mid \mathcal{F}_{n,k-1}] \to 0\) in prob，​则​ \(\sum_k d_{n,k} \Rightarrow \mathcal{N}(0, \sigma^2)\)（in distribution）。

​此​ CLT ​是​ §4 self-norm ​不等式​ non-asymptotic ​化​的​目标​比​对​项​；​具体​ non-asymptotic ​速率​仍为​ open seam（​参​ Phase 0c-A open seam OS3/OS4）。

A↔B lift cue. §3 Theorem 3.2 ​是​ §6 Theorem 6.3 (Doob-Meyer continuous) ​的​离散​原型​；​升级​代价​：(i) class (D) ​取代​离散​自动​ UI ​性​；(ii) predictable \(\sigma\)-​代数​ \(\mathcal{P}\) ​由​ \(\mathcal{F}_{n-1}\)-meas ​精​化为​左​连续​ adapted ​生成​；(iii) strict local mart ​例子​（§5 Example 5.4，3D Bessel ​倒数​）​证​ class (D) ​不可​省​。​详​ §6 / cross-thread §12。

​类比​仅供​直觉​：Theorem 3.2 ​把​ adapted ​过程​拆成​"​零​均值​噪声​ + ​可​预测​漂移​"——​后续​ stochastic control / BSDE / ​资产​定价​里​所有​"Drift adjustment" ​的​雏形​。

docs.title: §3.1 ​三版​收敛​的​可用性​ trade-off
docs.text:
Theorem 3.1 ​三版​收敛​ A2a / A2b / A2c ​反映​ closing ​条件​从弱到强​的​ trade-off：

  • A2a ​仅​ \(L^1\)-bounded, ​给​ a.s. ​收敛​但​未必​ \(L^1\) ​收敛​，​原因​是​ mass escape——​典型​例​ simple symmetric random walk ​在​原点​反射​后​ stopped at \(\{0\}\) ​的​反复​样本​给​ \(L^1\)-bounded ​但​极限​不​在​ \(L^1\)；
  • A2b UI ​是​兼有​ a.s. ​与​ \(L^1\) ​收敛​的​标准​ closing ​条件​，​且​ ​给出​ Lévy upward \(X_n = \mathbb{E}[X_\infty \mid \mathcal{F}_n]\)——​即​ mart ​由​其​极限​唯一​决定​；
  • A2c \(L^p\)-bounded \(p > 1\) ​自动​ UI（Hölder），​并​升级​到​ \(L^p\) ​收敛​，​速率​可借​ Doob \(L^p\) inequality (Theorem 2.1) ​精化​。

​实践​中​ A2b / A2c ​是​ §9 Snell envelope、§10 deep BSDE、§11 RLHF reward modeling ​反复​用到​的​工具​；A2a ​更​多​作为​ boundary case，​在​ strict local mart / bubble ​上下文​（§5 + §11）​作为​反例​提供​器​出现​。

docs.title: §3.1a Lévy upward ​与​ Lévy downward ​在​金融​建模​中​的​作用
docs.text:
Theorem 3.1 A2b UI mart ​收敛​同时​给出​ Lévy upward ​公式​ \(X_n = \mathbb{E}[X_\infty \mid \mathcal{F}_n]\) ——​即​ mart ​由​其​极限​唯一​决定​。​这一​公式​在​金融​建模​中​至关重要​：

  • claim ​复制​: §9 ​中​可​对冲​ European claim \(\xi\) ​对应​的​ mart \(V_t = \mathbb{E}^\mathbb{Q}[\xi \mid \mathcal{F}_t]\) ​由​ \(\xi\) ​在​ \(\mathbb{Q}\) ​下​唯一​决定​；MRT (Theorem 7.1) ​给​具体​ \(\phi\) representation；
  • filtration shrinkage / projection: ​在​不​完备​市场​或​部分​信息​设置​下​，\(\mathbb{Q}\)-mart ​在​ sub-filtration ​上​的​ projection ​仍​是​ mart；Lévy upward ​保证​这一​ projection ​在​ closing ​处​仍​可​恢复​ \(\xi\)；
  • conditional expectation chain: \(\mathbb{E}[\mathbb{E}[\xi \mid \mathcal{F}_t] \mid \mathcal{F}_s] = \mathbb{E}[\xi \mid \mathcal{F}_s]\) (tower property + Lévy upward) ​是​ dynamic programming / Snell envelope (§9) ​的​代数​基础​。

Lévy downward ​是​对偶​版​：reverse mart \(X_n = \mathbb{E}[X_0 \mid \mathcal{F}^{(n)}]\)，\(\mathcal{F}^{(n)} \downarrow \mathcal{F}^{(\infty)}\) shrinking filtration；A2b downward ​给​ \(X_n \to \mathbb{E}[X_0 \mid \mathcal{F}^{(\infty)}]\) a.s. + \(L^1\)。​在​ ergodic theory ​与​某些​信用风险​模型​中​使用​，​本文​ v4 ​综述​只​在​此处​一并​ mention。

docs.title: §3.2 ​离散​ vs ​连续​ Doob ​分解​的​ hypothesis ​差异
docs.text:
Theorem 3.2 ​在​离散​情形​不​需要​ class (D)，​本质​原因​是​离散​ \(\sigma\)-​代数​ stack \(\{\mathcal{F}_n\}\) ​自带​ \(\mathbb{E}[\cdot \mid \mathcal{F}_{n-1}]\) ​的​有限​步​迭代​ well-defined ​性​。​连续​上​对应​ conditional expectation ​的​迭代​须​借​ cádlàg ​化​与​ right-continuity，​而​ unique ​分解​要求​ \(\{X_\tau: \tau \text{ stopping}\}\) ​的​ UI ——​即​ class (D)（§6 Theorem 6.3 ​与​ Definition 5.2）。

F-9 ​严禁​不​区分​版本​的​根源​即此​：​离散​假设​比​连续​弱​，​混用​会​产生​两种​错误​——(i) ​把​连续​ statement ​误​强加​ hypothesis（​如说​"​离散​也​需​ class (D)"），(ii) ​把​离散​结论​误​推到​连续​而​忽略​ class (D)（​如​把​ §3 ​直接​ lift ​而​不​附​ class (D)）。​本文​每次​引用​ Doob ​分解​必显标​ discrete / continuous，​并​显写​ hypothesis。

docs.title: §4 ​离散​ concentration: Azuma / BDG / Freedman / self-normalized Bernstein (thread: A; 2024-2026 ​重点​)
docs.text: Model basis. filtered \((\Omega, \mathcal{F}, \{\mathcal{F}_n\}, \mathbb{P})\)；mart diff \(d_k = M_k - M_{k-1}\) ​满足​按​家族​特异​ hypothesis；conditional variance \(\langle M\rangle_n = \sum_{k=1}^n \mathbb{E}[d_k^2 \mid \mathcal{F}_{k-1}]\)。​本​节​假设​清单​按​ family ​严格​分立​——bounded differences / bounded conditional moments / predictable QV bound / self-norm ​随机​分母​。

docs.title: Theorem 4.1 (Azuma-Hoeffding, F-6 / FC-6)
docs.text: Hypothesis. mart \(M\) with \(M_0 = 0\), bounded differences \(|d_k| \leq c_k\) a.s.（​不是​ bounded \(X_n\)；F-6 ​严禁​该​误用​）。Conclusion. $\(\mathbb{P}(|M_n| \geq t) \leq 2\exp\left(-\frac{t^2}{2 \sum_{k=1}^n c_k^2}\right),\quad t > 0.\)$ Azuma 1967 (R4) ​原始​ statement；Hoeffding 1963 (R3) ​给​独立​有​界​ i.i.d. ​版本​，Azuma ​推广​至​ mart ​差分​。

docs.title: Theorem 4.2 (Freedman 1975)
docs.text: Hypothesis. mart \(M\), \(|d_k| \leq c\) a.s.（uniform diff bound），predictable QV \(\langle M\rangle_n \leq v\) a.s.。Conclusion. $\(\mathbb{P}(M_n \geq t,\,\langle M\rangle_n \leq v) \leq \exp\left(-\frac{t^2}{2(v + ct/3)}\right).\)$ Freedman 1975 (R6) ​的​关键​差异​：​用​ predictable QV bound \(v\) ​替代​ sum-of-squared-bounds，​对​ heavy-tail-but-low-conditional-variance ​场景​更​紧​。

docs.title: Theorem 4.3 (Burkholder-Davis-Gundy revisited)
docs.text: ​即​ §2 Theorem 2.4，​关键​是​ \(L^p\) norm equivalence \(\|S_n\|_p \asymp \|[S]_n^{1/2}\|_p\) holds for all \(p \geq 1\)。BDG ​是​ §6 continuous BDG ​的​离散​原型​；continuous ​版本​对​所有​ \(p > 0\) ​均​成立​（​详​ §6 Theorem 6.4）。

docs.title: Theorem 4.4 (self-normalized mart Bernstein ​系列​, 2024-12 / 2025-07)
docs.text:
Hypothesis (​公共​). mart \(M\) with diff \(d_k\)；​可能​ unbounded，​但​ conditional moment ​控制​ \(|d_k| \leq R\) ​或​更弱​形式​（​按​ paper ​异​）。Conclusion ​形式​：​对​ \(\delta \in (0, 1)\), w.p. \(\geq 1 - \delta\), $\(|M_n| \leq C\sqrt{(1 + \langle M\rangle_n) \log(1/\delta)} + (\mathrm{lower\text{-}order\;term}),\)$ ​关键​在​分母​为​随机​ \(\sqrt{1 + \langle M\rangle_n}\)（self-normalized），​从而​ confidence radius ​与​ sample-dependent variance ​同步​收紧​。​三作​并列​： - R11 Kuchibhotla 2024-12 (arXiv:2412.20542) — "On the Missing Factor in Some Concentration Inequalities for Martingales"，​精化​ self-norm Bernstein ​在​ missing-factor regime ​的​常数​； - R12 Ziemann 2024-12 (arXiv:2412.20949) — "A Vector Bernstein Inequality for Self-Normalized Martingales"，PAC-Bayes prior ​给​ vector-valued self-norm Bernstein； - R13 Akhavan-Shidani-Ayoub-Janz 2025-07 (arXiv:2507.20982) — Hilbert / RKHS dim-free self-norm Bernstein，​作者​归属​ Oxford / Oxford / Alberta / Oxford。

FC-2 hedge. R10 Hsu-Kakade-Zhang 2012 ECP 17 (doi:10.1214/ECP.v17-1869) ​是​ random-matrix Bernstein / Chernoff（PCA / approximate matrix multiplication ​应用​），​不是​ SVM tail bounds（F-2 ​严禁​该​误用​）。​其​ "intrinsic dimension" ​形式​ \(\mathrm{Tr}(\Sigma)/\|\Sigma\|\) ​替代​ ambient dimension \(d\)，​是​ §4 self-norm ​系列​ dim-free trail ​的​开端​。

FC-7 hedge. Mussi et al. 2024（​被​ R13 Akhavan et al. ​摘要​引​"resolves open problems by Mussi et al."）primary source ​在​上游​ phase ​未​独立​ verify；​本文​如需​引用​仅作​ R13 secondary cite，​不​独立​断言​ Mussi et al. ​内容​。

A↔C bridge cue. R6 Freedman → R9 de la Peña-Lai-Shao 2009 → R11/R12/R13 2024-2025 ​三作​链​是​ LinUCB / kernelized UCB / RLHF reward modeling ​的​ confidence-set engine。​具体​应用​见​ §11 ​与​ cross-thread §12.3。FC-5：mart concentration ​作为​统计​工具​用于​ RL/bandit ​是​ mathematical bridge；​与​ §11 ​末段​ RLHF-DPO closed form ​与​ Girsanov ​之间​的​形式​同构​（concept-level）​论点​强度​不同​，​二者​不可​混​。

​类比​仅供​直觉​：Azuma ​给​"​差分​变化​幅度​"​控尾​；Freedman ​给​"​可​预测​累积​方差​"​控尾​；self-norm Bernstein ​给​"​实际​累积​方差​"​控尾​，​自适应性​最强​。

docs.title: §4.1 ​从​ Azuma ​到​ self-normalized Bernstein ​的​演进​逻辑
docs.text:
§4 ​罗列​的​ Azuma → Freedman → ​现代​ self-norm Bernstein ​一系列​不等式​呈现​的​不是​"​互相​替代​"，​而是​"​在​ hypothesis-​放宽​ / bound-​收紧​"​两个​轴上​的​逐步推进​：

  • Azuma（Theorem 4.1）​使用​最强​ hypothesis（bounded mart differences \(|d_k| \leq c_k\)），bound ​形式​最​ conservative，​但​其​常数​代价​是​ \(\sum c_k^2\) ——​对​ heavy-tail-but-low-conditional-variance ​的​过程​过​紧​；
  • Freedman（Theorem 4.2）​放宽​ conditional variance ​控制​为​ predictable QV bound \(v\)，bound ​形式​包含​ Bernstein-type ​二阶​项​与​ Cramér-type ​三阶​项​，​在​ small-deviation regime ​紧于​ Azuma；
  • de la Peña-Lai-Shao 2009 (R9) ​把​ Bernstein ​进一步​ self-normalize——​分母​换​为​ \(\sqrt{1 + \langle M\rangle_n}\)，​让​ confidence ​半径​直接​随​数据​ adapt，​这是​ LinUCB / ​线性​ bandit / kernelized regression confidence-set ​构造​的​关键​ enabler；
  • 2024-2025 ​三作​ R11 / R12 / R13 ​在​三​方向​同时​推进​：R11 Kuchibhotla ​精化​ missing constant、R12 Ziemann ​给​ vector-valued via PAC-Bayes prior、R13 Akhavan-Shidani-Ayoub-Janz ​推​到​ Hilbert / RKHS ​的​ dim-free ​形式​。​三作​相互​独立​但​ thread ​一致​：​把​ self-norm Bernstein ​在​ dimension-free / vector / Hilbert ​三个​轴​上推​到​ sharp。

docs.title: §4.2 dim-free ​的​两种​含义​辨析
docs.text:
"dim-free" ​在​ §4 / R10 / R13 ​的​语境​下​有​两种​相关​但​不同​的​含义​：

  • intrinsic-dim Bernstein (R10 Hsu-Kakade-Zhang 2012 ECP) ——bound ​显式​依赖​ \(\mathrm{Tr}(\Sigma)/\|\Sigma\|\) ​而​非​ ambient \(d\)；​当​ \(\Sigma\) ​有​ effective rank \(\ll d\) ​时​ bound sharp，​这是​ random-matrix Bernstein ​应用​于​ PCA / approximate matrix multiplication ​的​关键​（FC-2 ​严禁​误读​为​ SVM tail bounds）；
  • ​真正​ dim-free (R13) ——bound ​完全​不​含​ \(d\)，​仅​依赖​ RKHS norm ​与​ trace；2025-07 Akhavan-Shidani-Ayoub-Janz ​三作​ + Janz ​的​工作​把​ R10 ​的​ effective-rank ​思路​推​到​ RKHS / kernelized bandit ​的​完整​ dim-free ​形式​。

​二者​关系​是​ successive refinement：R10 → R13 ​把​"​显式​但​ implicit-dim"​的​ effective-rank bound ​推​到​"​完全​ implicit-dim"​的​ RKHS trace bound。R13 ​摘要​中​所述​"resolves open problems by Mussi et al."​的​ Mussi et al. 2024 primary ​未​独立​ verify（FC-7），​仅作​ R13 secondary cite。

docs.title: §4.3 self-norm Bernstein ​在​ LinUCB / kernelized UCB ​上​的​具体​角色
docs.text:
§4 self-norm ​系列​在​ linear bandit / kernelized bandit ​上​的​具体​使用​：

LinUCB (Abbasi-Yadkori-Pál-Szepesvári 2011, FC-8 secondary) ​假设​ reward \(r_t = \langle x_t, \theta^*\rangle + \eta_t\)，\(\eta_t\) conditionally sub-Gaussian。confidence set ​构造​为​ $\(C_t = \{\theta: \|\theta - \hat{\theta}_t\|_{V_t} \leq \beta_t\},\)$ ​其中​ \(V_t = \lambda I + \sum_{s \leq t} x_s x_s^\top\) ​是​ regularized covariance，\(\hat{\theta}_t = V_t^{-1}\sum_s x_s r_s\) ​是​ ridge estimator，\(\beta_t\) confidence radius ​由​ self-norm Bernstein ​控制​：

\[\beta_t = O\left(\sqrt{d\log(t/\delta)} + \sqrt{\lambda}\|\theta^*\|\right).\]

​确定性​ part \(\sqrt{d\log(t/\delta)}\) ​来自​ self-norm mart \(\sum_s \eta_s x_s\) ​的​ self-normalized concentration——​具体​地​ \(\|\sum_s \eta_s x_s\|_{V_t^{-1}}^2\) ​是​ self-norm mart ​形式​，​可用​ R9 de la Peña-Lai-Shao 2009 ​章​ 6 ​直接​ bound。

Kernelized UCB (Valko-Korda-Munos-Cristianini-2013, FC-8 secondary) ​把​ LinUCB ​推广​到​ RKHS ​设置​，confidence radius ​通过​ information gain \(\gamma_t = O(d_{eff} \log t)\) ​控制​，\(d_{eff}\) ​是​ effective dimension。R10 Hsu-Kakade-Zhang 2012 ECP (intrinsic-dim random-matrix Bernstein) ​是​ \(d_{eff}\) ​概念​的​形式化​起点​；R13 Akhavan-Shidani-Ayoub-Janz 2025-07 ​把​该​ framework ​推​到​完全​ dim-free RKHS Bernstein。

​这一​ trail (R6 → R9 → R10 → R13) ​是​ §4 self-norm ​系列​在​ §11 RLHF reward modeling confidence-set ​构造​上​的​实际​工程化​路径​。

docs.title: §4.4 ​矩​等价​ vs ​尾​估计​的​ cascading ​模式
docs.text:
§4 / §6 BDG ​给矩​等价​；Bernstein-type concentration ​给​尾​估计​。​两者​在​分析​中常​按​以下​ cascading ​模式​联合​使用​：

Step 1: ​通过​ BDG ​把​ \(\mathbb{E}\sup |M|^p\) ​转换​为​ \(\mathbb{E}[\langle M\rangle_T^{p/2}]\)（continuous）​或​ \(\mathbb{E}[[S]_n^{p/2}]\)（discrete）。 Step 2: ​通过​ Chebyshev / Markov ​把矩​ bound ​转换​为​尾​估计​ \(\mathbb{P}(\sup |M| > t) \leq \mathbb{E}\sup|M|^p / t^p\)。 Step 3: ​优化​ \(p\)（​即​ Cramér-Chernoff ​方法​）​使​ bound ​在​指定​ \(t\) ​处​ sharp。 Step 4: ​若​ \(\langle M\rangle\) ​自身​随机​，​用​ self-norm ​形式​（§4 Theorem 4.4）​直接​控制​ \(\sup|M|/\sqrt{\langle M\rangle}\) ​的​尾​，​绕开​ Step 1-3 ​的​ worst-case ​分析​。

​这一​ cascading ​在​ §8 BSDE Picard contraction ​与​ §10.1 deep BSDE ​收敛​分析​中​反复​出现​。​例如​ Han-Long 2020（FC-8 secondary）​证​ a posteriori bound ​时​，​先​用​ BDG ​控制​ \(\hat{Y} - Y\) ​的​ \(L^2\) ​矩​，​再用​ Markov ​给​ a.s. ​误差​控制​。

self-norm ​形式​（Step 4）​的​优势​是​绕开​ Step 1-3 ​中​ worst-case \(\langle M\rangle\) ​的​ upper bound——​这一​ worst-case ​在​ data-dependent ​设置​（​如​ RL / bandit）​下​可能​远大于​实际​值​，​造成​ confidence radius ​过大​；self-norm ​直接​随​实际​ \(\langle M\rangle\) adapt，​给​紧得​多​的​ confidence。

docs.title: §4.5 self-norm Bernstein ​在​ online RL ​的​统一​框架
docs.text:
§4 self-norm Bernstein ​系列​在​ online RL / contextual bandit ​设置​下​统一​为​如下​框架​：

​算法​（generic self-norm UCB）: 1. ​初始化​ \(V_0 = \lambda I\), \(\hat{\theta}_0 = 0\)； 2. ​每步​ \(t = 1, 2, \ldots\): - ​观察​ context \(x_t\)，​选​ action ​使​ \(a_t = \arg\max_a \langle x_t(a), \hat{\theta}_{t-1}\rangle + \beta_t \|x_t(a)\|_{V_{t-1}^{-1}}\)； - ​观察​ reward \(r_t = \langle x_t(a_t), \theta^*\rangle + \eta_t\)； - ​更新​ \(V_t = V_{t-1} + x_t(a_t) x_t(a_t)^\top\), \(\hat{\theta}_t = V_t^{-1}\sum_s x_s(a_s) r_s\)； 3. confidence radius \(\beta_t\) ​由​ self-norm Bernstein ​控制​。

regret ​分析​依次​使用​：(i) confidence radius bound \(\|\sum_s \eta_s x_s(a_s)\|_{V_t^{-1}}^2 \leq \beta_t^2\) (self-norm Bernstein); (ii) elliptical potential lemma \(\sum_t \|x_t(a_t)\|_{V_{t-1}^{-1}}^2 \leq O(d\log T)\) (linear algebra)；(iii) regret decomposition + Cauchy-Schwarz ​给​ \(\tilde{O}(d\sqrt{T})\) regret。

R11 / R12 / R13 ​三作​在​ self-norm Bernstein ​这一​关键​ building block ​上​推进​；​其​影响​经此​框架​传导​到​ RL / RLHF ​的​ regret bound。​这一​传导​是​ §12.3 A↔C bridge ​的​"mathematical bridge, ​论点​强度​高​"​具体​兑现​。

docs.title: §4.6 empirical Bernstein ​与​ mart Bernstein ​的​区分
docs.text:
statistical learning theory ​中​常见​的​ "empirical Bernstein"（Maurer-Pontil 2009, FC-8 secondary）​与​ §4 mart Bernstein ​在结构上​相关​但​ distinct：

  • empirical Bernstein (i.i.d. ​主体​): ​用​ empirical variance \(\hat{\sigma}_n^2\) ​替代​ true variance；​适用​ i.i.d. ​序列​；
  • mart Bernstein (§4 ​主体​): ​用​ predictable QV \(\langle M\rangle_n\) ​或​ self-norm ​分母​；​适用​ mart ​差分​序列​，​不需​ i.i.d.；
  • self-norm Bernstein (R9, R11-R13): ​在​ mart Bernstein ​基础​上​把​分母​换​为​随机​ \(\sqrt{1 + \langle M\rangle_n}\)；​最自​适应​。

empirical Bernstein ​在​ i.i.d. ​主体​下​足够​强​；​现代​ RL / bandit / online learning ​几乎​不能​假设​ i.i.d.（​数据​收集​ sequentially adapts to algorithm decisions），​故​必须​用​ mart / self-norm Bernstein。​这一​区分​在​文献​使用​中常​被​忽略​——​一些​ RL ​论文​误用​ empirical Bernstein ​在​ mart ​主体​上​，​本文​ §4 ​严格​区分​。

docs.title: §4.7 BDG ​在​ §4 ​与​ §6 ​的​角色​对照
docs.text: §2 Theorem 2.4 (discrete BDG) ​与​ §6 Theorem 6.4 (continuous BDG) ​是​ §4 ​系列​不等式​的​ \(L^p\)-moment ​对应​——BDG ​给出​矩​等价​，concentration inequalities ​给出​尾​估计​。​二者​在​数学​上​互推​不​闭合​，​但​在​ deep BSDE / RKHS regression / RL non-asymptotic analysis ​中​常常​ sequential ​使用​：​先​ BDG ​控​ \(L^p\) ​矩​，​再​ Chebyshev / Markov ​化为​尾​估计​。​本文​ §8 BSDE Picard ​与​ §10.1 deep BSDE ​收敛​分析​就是​此​ sequential ​模式​的​实例​。

docs.title: §4.8 Bridge to Thread B — ​从​离散​ mart ​到​连续​ semimart ​阶梯​的​ lift
docs.text:
Thread A (§2-§4) ​工具​谱​已经​穷尽​离散​ mart ​的​不等式​ (Doob \(L^p\) / upcrossing / OST / BDG / Azuma-Hoeffding / Freedman / self-norm Bernstein) ​与​收敛​ (a.s. / \(L^p\) / mart CLT)；​下​一步​ lift ​到​ Thread B ​是​把​ "adapted + integrable + filtration ​通用​" ​升级​为​ "usual conditions + Brownian motion + semimart ​阶梯​ + \([X]\) vs \(\langle X\rangle\) ​分离​ + class (D)"。

​具体​ lift ​对应​关系​：(i) §2 Theorem 2.2 mart transform \((H \cdot M)_n = \sum H_k \Delta M_k\) → §6 Definition 6.1 stochastic integral \(\int H\,dM\)；(ii) §2 Theorem 2.4 discrete BDG \(\|S_n\|_p \asymp \|[S]_n^{1/2}\|_p\) → §6 Theorem 6.4 continuous BDG \(\mathbb{E}\sup|M|^p \asymp \mathbb{E}\langle M\rangle_T^{p/2}\) (​对​所有​ \(p > 0\))；(iii) §3 Theorem 3.2 discrete Doob decomp（​无需​ class (D)） → §6 Theorem 6.3 continuous Doob-Meyer（​严​依赖​ class (D)，F-9）。

lift ​的​"​代价​"​集中​在​ (a) usual conditions ​的​右​连续​ + ​完备化​要求​；(b) predictable \(\sigma\)-​代数​从​ \(\mathcal{F}_{n-1}\)-meas ​精​化为​左​连续​ adapted ​生成​的​ \(\mathcal{P}\)；(c) \([X]\) ​需​ mesh-shrinking limit in probability、\(\langle X\rangle\) ​需​ quasi-left-continuous ​局部​ square-integrable ​假设​。​详尽​ lift ​论证​留​ §6 / §12.1 A↔B cross-thread。

docs.title: §5 ​连续​时间​随机​分析​: BM, semimart ​阶梯​, \([X]\) vs \(\langle X\rangle\) (thread: B)
docs.text: Model basis. \((\Omega, \mathcal{F}, \{\mathcal{F}_t\}, \mathbb{P})\) ​满足​ usual conditions（§1）；Brownian motion \(B = \{B_t\}_{t \geq 0}\) ​是​ continuous a.s.、\(B_0 = 0\)、​独立​增量​、\(B_t - B_s \sim \mathcal{N}(0, t - s)\) ​的​ process；augmented filtration \(\mathcal{F}_t^B = \sigma(\{B_s: s \leq t\}, \mathcal{N})\)（\(\mathcal{N}\) ​为​ \(\mathbb{P}\)-null ​集类​）。Karatzas-Shreve 1991 (R20) Ch. 1-2、Protter 2004 (R22) Ch. I-II ​是​本节​标准​参考​。

docs.title: Definition 5.1 (continuous-time mart, local mart, semimart ​阶梯​)
docs.text:
• martingale: \(X\) adapted、cádlàg、\(\mathbb{E}|X_t| < \infty\)，​且​ \(\mathbb{E}[X_t \mid \mathcal{F}_s] = X_s\) (\(s \leq t\))；
  • local martingale: ​存在​ stopping times \(\tau_n \uparrow \infty\) a.s. ​使​ \(\{X_{t \wedge \tau_n}\}\) ​是​ mart for each \(n\)；
  • semimartingale: \(X = X_0 + M + A\)，\(M\) local mart，\(A\) adapted cádlàg locally bounded variation；
  • strict local mart: local mart ​但​ ​不是​ mart（​典型​例​ Example 5.4）。

​阶梯​ mart \(\subsetneq\) local mart \(\subsetneq\) semimart ​严格​真​包含​；F-8 / F-9 / F-10 ​禁​混用​。

docs.title: Definition 5.2 (class (D))
docs.text: adapted ​过程​ \(X\) ​属​ class (D) ​指​ \(\{X_\tau: \tau\;\text{finite stopping time}\}\) ​是​ uniformly integrable family。class (D) ​是​ Doob-Meyer ​连续​版​（§6 Theorem 6.3）​的​必需​ hypothesis；F-9 ​严禁​连续​ Doob-Meyer ​省略​此​条件​。

docs.title: Definition 5.3 (quadratic variation \([X]\) vs predictable bracket \(\langle X\rangle\), F-8)
docs.text:
​对​ semimart \(X\): - \([X]_t\) = pathwise quadratic variation, ​定义​为​分割​ \(0 = t_0^n < \cdots < t_{k_n}^n = t\) mesh \(\to 0\) ​时​ \(\sum_i (X_{t_{i+1}^n} - X_{t_i^n})^2\) ​的​ limit in probability。Semimart ​上​ \([X]\) ​总​存在​，​且​对​ cádlàg semimart $\([X]_t = [X^c]_t + \sum_{0 < s \leq t} (\Delta X_s)^2,\)$ ​其中​ \(X^c\) ​是​ continuous mart part； - \(\langle X\rangle_t\) = predictable compensator of \([X]\)（\(X\) locally square-integrable local martingale ​时​存在​且​唯一​；class (D) ​不是​此处​所​需​ hypothesis，​它​属于​ §6 Doob-Meyer ​唯一性​），​即​ \(\langle X\rangle\) predictable ​且​ \(X^2 - \langle X\rangle\) ​是​ local mart。

​严格​等式​（F-8）：\([X] = \langle X\rangle\) ​仅​ when \(X\) ​是​ continuous local mart（​更​一般​ quasi-left-continuous）；​存在​跳时​ \([X] = \langle X^c\rangle + \sum (\Delta X)^2 \neq \langle X\rangle = \langle X^c\rangle + \langle X^d\rangle\)，​二者​通过​跳​部分​相关​但​不​相等​。

docs.title: Theorem 5.1 (Brownian QV)
docs.text: \([B]_t = \langle B\rangle_t = t\) a.s. for all \(t \geq 0\)；​这是​ continuous local mart ​上​ \([X] = \langle X\rangle\) ​的​最​经典​实例​（Karatzas-Shreve 1991 (R20) Theorem 1.5.8）。

docs.title: Example 5.4 (strict local mart: 3D Bessel ​倒数​)
docs.text: ​设​ \(B = (B^1, B^2, B^3)\) ​三维​ BM, \(R_t = \|B_t\|\) ​是​ 3D Bessel process；\(M_t := 1/R_t\) (\(t \geq \varepsilon > 0\)，​需​远离​原点​) ​是​ strict local mart——​满足​ local mart ​定义​但​ \(\mathbb{E}[M_t]\) ​随​ \(t\) ​严格​ ​递减​（​不保​ mart property）。​此例​在​ §9 bubble theory ​重​出现​：strict local mart ​与​ \(\mathbb{E}^\mathbb{Q}[\tilde{S}_T] < \tilde{S}_0\) ​的​资产​泡沫​一一对应​（Phase 0c-C bubble lens；§11 ​与​ R45 Biagini-Gonon-Mazzon-Meyer-Brandis 2025）。

docs.title: Theorem 5.2 (Föllmer 1981 pathwise QV)
docs.text:
Hypothesis. ​单一​ cádlàg ​轨道​ \(x: [0, T] \to \mathbb{R}\)；​分割​ \(\pi_n\) mesh \(\to 0\)；​假设​ \([x]^{(n)}_t := \sum_{i: t_i^n \leq t} (x_{t_{i+1}^n} - x_{t_i^n})^2 \to [x]_t\) pointwise ​对​某​连续​ nondecreasing \([x]\)。

Conclusion. ​可定义​ pathwise Itô integral \(\int_0^t f'(x_s)\,dx_s\) ​且​ pathwise Itô formula \(f(x_t) - f(x_0) = \int_0^t f'(x_s)\,dx_s + \tfrac{1}{2}\int_0^t f''(x_s)\,d[x]_s + \text{jumps}\) ​成立​。

Föllmer 1981 (R17) ​此​结果​是​ model-free finance / rough path / pathwise hedging ​的​方法论​起点​；​它​绕开​ \(\mathbb{P}\) ​与​ filtration，​仅​依赖​单​轨道​ QV ​假设​，​与​ §6 measure-theoretic stochastic integral ​互补​而​非​替代​。

​类比​仅供​直觉​：\([X]\) ​是​"​实际​累计​平方​涨幅​"，\(\langle X\rangle\) ​是​"​按​ history ​期望​应有​的​平方​涨幅​"；continuous ​时​二者​相等​，​跳​出现​时​实际​超出​（​或​低于​）​期望​。

docs.title: §5.1 ​三层​阶梯​的​物理​动机
docs.text:
mart / local mart / semimart ​三层​阶梯​在​数学​上​是​ strict ​真​包含​，​在​应用​上​对应​不同​的​金融​ / ​物理​建模​需求​：

  • mart: ​严格​无​漂移​过程​，​是​"​无​套利​价格​"​在​ risk-neutral measure ​下​的​标准​形式​；§9 FTAP I ​给出​ NFLVR ⇔ ELMM ​等价​正是​ mart ​阶梯​最低​层​的​应用​；
  • local mart: ​允许​过程​在​尾部​"​局部​ mart ​化​"，​处理​ unbounded payoff ​与​ strict-local ​现象​（​如​ §5 Example 5.4 3D Bessel ​倒数​、§11.1 bubble price）；Delbaen-Schachermayer 1998 (R29) ​把​ FTAP ​扩展​到​ unbounded semimart ​时​引入​ Eσ-MM ​概念​，​正是​ local mart / semimart ​区分​必要​的​体现​；
  • semimart: ​最广​ integrator class，​是​ Itô integral ​在​ Bichteler-Dellacherie ​理论​下​良性​ stochastic integration ​的​最大​ class，​包含​ finite-variation drift + local mart ​组合​。

​阶梯​严格​性​的​反例​（strict local mart ​但​非​ mart）​由​ §5 Example 5.4 ​提供​：3D Bessel ​倒数​ \(1/\|B\|\) ​在​ \(\{\|B\| \geq \varepsilon\}\) ​上​是​ local mart，​但​ $\mathbb{E}[M_t] = M_0 - $（​正​项​严格​递减​），​故非​ mart。​这​一例​在​ §11.1 R45 Biagini-Gonon-Mazzon-Meyer-Brandis 2025 Math. Finance 35 (arXiv:2210.01726) bubble ​检测​中重​出现​：strict local mart ​与​资产​泡沫​一一对应​。

docs.title: §5.2 \([X]\) vs \(\langle X\rangle\) ​在​跳​情形​下​的​修正
docs.text:
F-8 ​严禁​在​一般​ semimart ​上下文​写​ "\([X] = \langle X\rangle\)"。​本​节​再次​显化​跳​出现​时​的​正确​关系​：

\[[X]_t = [X^c]_t + \sum_{0 < s \leq t}(\Delta X_s)^2 = \langle X^c\rangle_t + \sum_{0 < s \leq t}(\Delta X_s)^2,\] \[\langle X\rangle_t = \langle X^c\rangle_t + \langle X^d\rangle_t,\]

​其中​ \(X^d\) ​是​ purely-discontinuous part；\(\langle X^d\rangle_t\) ​是​ jumps ​的​ predictable compensator \(\sum_{0 < s \leq t}\mathbb{E}[(\Delta X_s)^2 \mid \mathcal{F}_{s-}]\)（quasi-left-continuous ​假设​下定义​）。​一般​ cádlàg semimart ​上​跳​的​实际​平方和​与​预测​平方和​不​等​，​故​ \([X] \neq \langle X\rangle\)。​仅当​ \(X^d = 0\)（​即​ \(X\) continuous）​才​有​ \([X] = \langle X\rangle\)。

​这一​区分​对​ §6 Itô formula（jump correction ​项​）、§7 Doléans-Dade（continuous local mart ​才​用​ \(\langle N\rangle\)）、§9 FTAP（Eσ-MM ​处理​ unbounded jumps）​均​至关重要​；​本文​每次​涉及​ quadratic variation ​的​章节​均​在​ Model basis ​中显​写​ \(X\) ​的​ jump ​假设​。

docs.title: §5.3 Föllmer 1981 pathwise ​路线​与​ measure-theoretic ​路线​的​互补
docs.text:
Theorem 5.2 Föllmer 1981 (R17) pathwise QV ​是​ measure-theoretic ​随机​分析​的​互补​而​非​替代​——​它​放弃​ \(\mathbb{P}\) ​与​ filtration，​仅​在​单​轨道​ + QV ​假设​下推​ pathwise Itô formula。​其​在​以下​场景​特别​有​价值​：

  • model-free finance: ​不​假定​ \(\mathbb{P}\) ​时​ hedging duality（Burzoni / Riedel ​等​ model-free FTAP ​系列​, FC-8 secondary）；
  • rough path lifts: Lyons 1998 rough path theory ​把​ Föllmer ​路线​推​到​ \(p\)-variation \(p > 2\) ​的​非​ semimart ​路径​，​是​ §10.3 rough volatility / signature ​路线​的​数学​基础​（Hambly-Lyons 2010, FC-8 secondary）。

Föllmer ​路线​给​"​对​单条​样本​路径​而言​的​ Itô"，measure-theoretic ​路线​给​"​全空间​ \(L^2\) ​收敛​而言​的​ Itô"；​二者​在​ continuous semimart ​主体​下结论​一致​，​但​ Föllmer ​路线​更广​——​不​限定​ \(\mathbb{P}\)，​不​限定​ filtration。​这是​ v4 ​综述​ §10.3 signature kernel MMD generative finance (R43 arXiv:2407.19848) ​与​ neural RDE portfolio (R44 arXiv:2510.10728) ​等​ model-free / pathwise ​方向​的​理论​祖系​。

Mini-example (cádlàg single path with finite \(p\)-variation). ​固定​一条​具体​ cádlàg ​轨道​ \(x: [0, T] \to \mathbb{R}\) ​满足​ \(\sum_{i: t_i^n \leq t} (x_{t_{i+1}^n} - x_{t_i^n})^2 \to [x]_t\) pointwise (mesh \(\to 0\)) for some continuous nondecreasing \([x]\)。​最​经典​实例​：​固定​一条​ typical Brownian path \(\omega \mapsto B_t(\omega)\) —— ​由​ Lévy ​定理​ \(\mathbb{P}\)-a.s. ​满足​ \([B]_t(\omega) = t\)，​故​ Föllmer ​假设​对​每条​ typical \(\omega\) ​单独​成立​。​对此​ fix ​的​ \(\omega\) ​与​ \(f \in C^2(\mathbb{R})\)，Föllmer pathwise Itô formula $\(f(B_T(\omega)) - f(B_0(\omega)) = \int_0^T f'(B_s(\omega))\,dB_s(\omega) + \tfrac{1}{2}\int_0^T f''(B_s(\omega))\,ds\)$ ​对​这条​具体​轨道​成立​——​无需​谈论​ \(\mathbb{P}\) ​全空间​收敛​，​纯​ pathwise ​语言​。

"\(p\)-variation"​作​ Föllmer ​假设​的​精化​：\(|x|_{p\text{-var}} := \sup_\pi (\sum_i |x_{t_{i+1}} - x_{t_i}|^p)^{1/p}\)；Brownian path a.s. ​有​有限​ \(p\)-variation \(\forall p > 2\) ​但​无限​ \(p\)-variation for \(p \leq 2\)，​故​ BM ​是​ Föllmer-friendly (\([x]\) ​在​ \(p = 2\) ​边界​上​良性​) ​但​不能​直接​ Riemann-Stieltjes ​化​（\(p\)-variation \(= \infty\) for \(p \leq 2\)）。

​具体​地​，fractional BM with Hurst \(H \in (0, 1/2)\) ​进一步​把​ \(p\)-variation ​临界值​推​到​ \(p > 1/H > 2\)，​故落​出​ semimart class——​这是​ §10.3 rough volatility ​必须​走​ rough path / signature lift ​而​非​ Itô ​路径​的​根本原因​（​与​ §5.5 Bichteler-Dellacherie semimart characterization ​一致​）。

docs.title: §5.4 quasi-left-continuous semimart ​与​ jumps ​的​处理
docs.text:
§5 Definition 5.3 ​提到​ \([X] = \langle X\rangle\) ​在​ quasi-left-continuous local mart ​下​成立​。quasi-left-continuous ​含义​是​：​若​ \(\tau_n \uparrow \tau\) predictable stopping times，​则​ \(X_{\tau_n} \to X_\tau\) a.s.（​即​跳​不​发生​在​ predictable ​时刻​）。

quasi-left-continuous ​的​典型​例​：

  • ​任何​ continuous semimart: trivially quasi-left-continuous；
  • Poisson process / ​任何​ Lévy process（under natural/augmented filtration）: jumps ​发生​在​ Poisson ​时刻​（totally inaccessible），​不是​ predictable，​故​ quasi-left-continuous；
  • Markov processes with continuous semigroup: ​在​合适​ regularity ​假设​下​ quasi-left-continuous。

quasi-left-continuous ​失败​ ​的​例​：dividend-paying stock with deterministic dividend times（dividend ​在​ predictable ​时刻​发生​）；​不​连续​ deterministic component ​加​ mart ​也​可能​违反​。

quasi-left-continuous ​在​ §6 Itô formula ​与​ §7 Doléans-Dade（Theorem 7.3）​的​统一​推导​中是​关键技术​ hypothesis；​本文​ §6 / §7 ​默认​ quasi-left-continuous，§13 taxonomy ​矩阵​ "Integrator class" ​列对​ jump ​情形​显式​标注​。

docs.title: §5.4a strict local mart ​的​判别​准则​与​金融​实务
docs.text:
§5 Definition 5.1 ​引入​ strict local mart ​概念​，​与​ §11.1 bubble detection ​直接​相关​。strict local mart ​的​常用​判别​准则​：

  • Mijatović-Urusov 2012 ​准则​: ​对​一维​ time-homogeneous diffusion \(dS_t = \sigma(S_t)\,dW_t\)（risk-neutral ​下​ drift = 0 ​简化​），\(S\) ​是​ strict local mart \(\iff\) \(\int_\varepsilon^\infty x/\sigma^2(x)\,dx < \infty\) ​对​某​ \(\varepsilon > 0\)（FC-8 secondary，​未​独立​ primary verify）；
  • Cox-Hobson 2005 ​准则​: ​给​ CEV / Heston ​等​模型​下​ \(S\) ​是​ strict local mart ​还是​ true mart ​的​具体​参数​边界​；
  • Sin 1998 ​准则​: ​对​ Heston with CIR variance, ​在​ some parameter range \(S\) ​是​ strict local mart（FC-8 secondary）。

​实务​含义​：​在​ Heston / CEV ​等​经典​ stochastic vol ​模型​的​某些​参数​ regime ​下​，risk-neutral ​价格​已经​是​ strict local mart——​即​"​内生​ bubble"。R45 (Biagini-Gonon-Mazzon-Meyer-Brandis 2025) NN classifier ​训练​在​这些​参数​ regime ​的​ simulated paths ​上​，​学习​区分​ true mart vs strict local mart ​的​ path features。​这一​应用​使​ strict local mart ​不再​仅​是​ §5 mathematical curiosity，​而​成为​ v4 ​综述​ §11.1 bubble detection ​的​核心​数学​对象​。

docs.title: §5.5 semimart ​的​ Bichteler-Dellacherie ​良性​ characterization
docs.text:
semimart ​作为​最大​良性​ integrator class ​由​ Bichteler-Dellacherie ​定理​ (Bichteler 1981, Dellacherie 1980, FC-8 secondary) ​给出​ measure-theoretic characterization：

\(X\) adapted cádlàg ​是​ semimart \(\iff\) \(X\) ​对​所有​ simple predictable \(H\) ​在​ ucp ​下​良性​ integrable，​即​映射​ \(H \mapsto \int H\,dX\) ​是​ ucp-continuous。​这一​ characterization ​把​ semimart ​等同于​"​良性​ stochastic integration ​的​最大​ input class"。

​实际意义​：​任何​"​想​做​ stochastic integration"​的​ process ​必须​是​ semimart；​非​ semimart（​如​ fractional BM with \(H \in (0, 1/2)\)）​需要​ rough path ​等​额外​工具​。R17 Föllmer 1981 ​与​ Lyons rough path ​路线​正是​处理​非​ semimart ​路径​的​两种​方法论​。

§10.3 rough volatility ​主体​（rough Bergomi ​等​）​的​ driver \(W^H\) ​是非​ semimart，​故​ §10.3 ​算法​（signature / neural CDE / RDE）​必须​绕开​ §6 measure-theoretic stochastic integral ​直接​构造​；​这​与​ §5.3 Föllmer ​路线​一致​。

docs.title: §6 ​随机​积分​、Itô formula、Doob-Meyer (continuous) (thread: B)
docs.text: Model basis. §5 setup；integrand \(H\) predictable locally bounded；integrator \(X\) semimart。Itô isometry ​与​ BDG ​是​本节​核心​ workhorse。

docs.title: Definition 6.1 (stochastic integral against semimart)
docs.text: ​对​ simple predictable \(H = \sum_{i} h_i \mathbf{1}_{(\tau_i, \tau_{i+1}]}\)（\(\tau_i\) stopping times，\(h_i \in \mathcal{F}_{\tau_i}\) bounded），​定义​ $\((H \cdot X)_t := \sum_i h_i (X_{t \wedge \tau_{i+1}} - X_{t \wedge \tau_i}).\)$ ​通过​ BMO / \(\mathcal{H}^p\) ​拓扑​或​ Bichteler-Dellacherie ​路径​将​定义​延拓​至​ \(H\) predictable locally bounded、\(X\) semimart（Protter 2004 (R22) Ch. II §3-5；K-S 1991 (R20) Ch. 3）。

docs.title: Theorem 6.1 (Itô isometry, continuous mart)
docs.text: ​设​ \(M\) continuous local mart, \(H\) predictable ​且​ \(\mathbb{E}\int_0^T H_s^2\,d\langle M\rangle_s < \infty\)。​则​ \(\int_0^t H_s\,dM_s\) well-defined as \(L^2\) mart ​且​ $\(\mathbb{E}\left[\left(\int_0^T H_s\,dM_s\right)^2\right] = \mathbb{E}\int_0^T H_s^2\,d\langle M\rangle_s.\)$ （K-S 1991 (R20) Proposition 3.2.10。）​此​等式​对​ continuous local mart ​中​ \([M] = \langle M\rangle\)（§5 F-8）​严格​依赖​；​对​带​跳​ semimart ​须​替换​为​ \(\mathbb{E}\int H^2\,d[M]\) ​形式​。

docs.title: Theorem 6.2 (Itô formula, \(C^{1,2}\), semimart version)
docs.text: ​设​ \(X\) cádlàg semimart with continuous mart part \(X^c\), \(f \in C^{1,2}([0, T] \times \mathbb{R})\)。​则​ $\(f(t, X_t) = f(0, X_0) + \int_0^t \partial_t f\,ds + \int_0^t \partial_x f(s, X_{s-})\,dX_s + \frac{1}{2}\int_0^t \partial_{xx} f\,d\langle X^c\rangle_s + \sum_{0 < s \leq t}[f(s, X_s) - f(s, X_{s-}) - \partial_x f(s, X_{s-})\Delta X_s].\)$ ​连续​ BM ​主体​下​退化​为​经典​ Itô：\(df(t, B_t) = \partial_t f\,dt + \partial_x f\,dB_t + \tfrac{1}{2}\partial_{xx}f\,dt\)。Itô 1944 (R14) / 1951 (R15) ​是​源​；K-S 1991 (R20) Theorem 3.3.3 / Protter 2004 (R22) Ch. II §7 ​给出​ cádlàg semimart ​完整版​。

docs.title: Theorem 6.3 (Doob-Meyer decomposition, continuous, F-9)
docs.text:
​两版​分立​（F-9 ​严禁​省略​ class ​条件​ / ​混用​结论​）： - Class (DL) ​版​ (horizon \([0, T]\)). Hypothesis. \(X\) right-continuous submart of class (DL)（​即​ \(\{X_\tau: \tau \leq T \text{ stopping}\}\) UI ​对​每个​ finite \(T\)）。Conclusion. ​唯一​分解​ \(X_t = X_0 + M_t + A_t\), \(M\) local martingale, \(A\) predictable cádlàg nondecreasing, \(A_0 = 0\)。§8 BSDE / §9 Snell envelope ​主体​的​ finite-horizon ​应用​落此​版​。 - Class (D) ​全局​版​ (corollary). Hypothesis. \(X\) submart of class (D)（§5 Definition 5.2；​全局​ finite stopping times \(\{X_\tau\}\) UI）。Conclusion. ​同​上​分解​但​ \(M\) ​强化​为​ UI martingale, \(A\) predictable BV cádlàg integrable。

Meyer 1962-66 (R16) ​原​系列​论文​；K-S 1991 (R20) Theorem 1.4.10 / Protter 2004 (R22) Ch. III §3-4 standard ​现代​写法​。

​离散​ vs ​连续​ contrast (F-9): §3 Theorem 3.2 discrete Doob decomp ​无需​ class (D)；Theorem 6.3 continuous Doob-Meyer ​严​依赖​ class (D)。F-9 ​严禁​不​区分​版本​。

docs.title: Theorem 6.4 (BDG, continuous, all \(p > 0\))
docs.text:
​设​ \(M\) continuous local mart, \(M_0 = 0\). ​则​对​每个​ \(p > 0\) ​存在​常数​ \(0 < c_p \leq C_p < \infty\) ​使​ $\(c_p\,\mathbb{E}[\langle M\rangle_T^{p/2}] \leq \mathbb{E}[\sup_{0 \leq t \leq T}|M_t|^p] \leq C_p\,\mathbb{E}[\langle M\rangle_T^{p/2}].\)$ （K-S 1991 (R20) Theorem 3.3.28；Protter 2004 (R22) Ch. IV §4。）​注意​ continuous ​版​对​所有​ \(p > 0\) ​成立​（​含​ \(p < 1\)），​而​ §2 Theorem 2.4 discrete BDG ​仅​ \(p \geq 1\)；​这是​ continuous local mart \([M] = \langle M\rangle\) ​整合性​的​红利​。

A↔B lift workhorse. §2 Theorem 2.4 (discrete BDG) → §6 Theorem 6.4 (continuous BDG) → §8 BSDE Picard contraction：BSDE ​解​ \((Y, Z) \in S^2 \times H^2\) ​的​唯一性​证明​里​要​把​ \(\|Y\|_{S^2}^2 := \mathbb{E}\sup_t |Y_t|^2\) ​与​ \(\|Z\|_{H^2}^2 := \mathbb{E}\int_0^T |Z_s|^2\,d s\) ​通过​ BDG ​桥接​。​此​ lift ​在​ §8 / §10 deep BSDE ​收敛​分析​中是​核心​工具​。

​类比​仅供​直觉​：Theorem 6.2 ​是​"random analog of Taylor expansion"——\(f(X_t)\) ​的​展开​多出​一项​ \(\tfrac{1}{2}f''d\langle X^c\rangle\) ​来​吃掉​ \((dX^c)^2 = d\langle X^c\rangle\)。

docs.title: §6.1 stochastic integral ​的​存在​性​ vs ​良性
docs.text:
Definition 6.1 ​给出​ stochastic integral ​在​ simple predictable ​上​的​定义​；​从​ simple ​延拓​至​ predictable locally bounded ​涉及​ BMO / \(\mathcal{H}^p\) ​拓扑​下​的​ Cauchy completion ​论证​。​三种​延拓​路径​在​文献​中​并存​：

  • K-S 1991 (R20) Ch. 3 ​路径​: ​以​ continuous local mart ​为​ integrator，​用​ Doob \(L^2\) inequality + Itô isometry ​在​ \(L^2(d\mathbb{P} \otimes d\langle M\rangle)\) ​上​做​ \(L^2\)-Cauchy completion；
  • Protter 2004 (R22) Ch. II ​路径​: ​以​ semimart ​为​ integrator，​用​ Bichteler-Dellacherie ​良性​ integrator characterization + UCP ​拓扑​；​这是​最广​的​ path——​不​要求​ \(M\) ​是​ mart ​或​ local mart，​只要​ semimart；
  • Föllmer 1981 (R17) pathwise ​路径​: ​不需​ \(\mathbb{P}\)，​仅​需单​轨道​ + QV ​假设​；​详​ §5 Theorem 5.2。

​本文​ §6-§10 ​全​章节​默认​ K-S / Protter ​路径​；§5.3 Föllmer ​路径​仅​在​ §10.3 rough path / signature ​节点​出现​作​补充​。

docs.title: §6.2 Itô formula ​的​ jump correction ​与​高频​应用
docs.text:
Theorem 6.2 cádlàg semimart ​版​ Itô formula ​的​ jump correction ​项​ \(f(s, X_s) - f(s, X_{s-}) - \partial_x f(s, X_{s-})\Delta X_s\) ​与​连续​部分​ \(\tfrac{1}{2}\partial_{xx} f\,d\langle X^c\rangle_s\) ​严格​分立​——​前者​吃​ jump-induced ​二阶​展开​（​一阶​展开​已​被​ \(\partial_x f \cdot \Delta X\) ​吃掉​），​后者​吃​ continuous-part QV ​二阶​展开​。

​应用​层面​，​跳​ Itô ​在​以下​场景​关键​：

  • jump-diffusion option pricing: Merton 1976 jump-diffusion ​模型​ / Bates / Kou ​等​ — jump correction ​直接​影响​ option Greeks ​的​ jump-induced ​修正​；
  • Lévy-driven SDE: § 5 quasi-left-continuous ​假设​下​ Lévy semimart ​的​ Itô formula ​是​ §10.3 ​部分​ neural SDE ​文献​（​如​ R44 arXiv:2509.20599 / arXiv:2511.09112 / arXiv:2512.14967 ​等​ Phase 0c-B anchors）​的​基础​；
  • structural credit models / first-passage: stopping time / barrier-hitting payoff ​的​ Itô ​表示​常需​ jump correction。

​连续​ BM ​主体​下​退化​为​ \(df(t, B_t) = \partial_t f\,dt + \partial_x f\,dB_t + \tfrac{1}{2}\partial_{xx}f\,dt\) ​是​ §9 Black-Scholes ​推导​的​标准​入门​ — ​但​ v4 ​综述​强调​：​任何​ Itô ​引用​须​显示​ cádlàg semimart ​版本​能否​ reduce ​至此​特例​。

​具体​地​，Black-Scholes ​推导​走​如下​路径​：(i) ​假设​ \(dS_t/S_t = \mu\,dt + \sigma\,dB_t\)（GBM）；(ii) ​应用​ Itô formula ​给​ \(d(\log S_t) = (\mu - \tfrac{1}{2}\sigma^2)\,dt + \sigma\,dB_t\)；(iii) ​构造​ delta-hedge portfolio \(\Pi = V - \Delta S\)，\(\Delta = \partial_S V\)；(iv) ​通过​ self-financing + Itô ​给​ \(d\Pi\) ​不​含​ \(dB\) ​项​；(v) ​等于​ risk-free portfolio \(\Pi r\,dt\) ​给​ Black-Scholes PDE。

​整个​推导​依赖​ Itô formula ​的​精确​形式​——​任何​ hypothesis ​失配​（​如​ \(V\) ​不​在​ \(C^{1, 2}\) ​或​ \(S\) ​不​在​ continuous semimart）​都​会​破坏​推导​。R20 K-S 1991 Ch. 5 ​给出​完整版​。

docs.title: §6.3 Doob-Meyer continuous ​与​ class (D) ​的​不可​省
docs.text:
Theorem 6.3 Doob-Meyer continuous ​版本​的​ class (D) hypothesis ​不可​省​，​反例​由​ §5 Example 5.4 strict local mart ​给出​：3D Bessel ​倒数​ \(1/\|B\|\) ​是​ supermart（\(\mathbb{E}\) ​递减​）​但​非​ class (D)；​它​对应​的​ "\(X_0 + M + A\)" ​分解​ \(M\) ​部分​仅​ local mart ​而​非​ UI mart，​唯一性​失败​。

​这是​ F-9 ​严禁​不​区分​ discrete / continuous Doob ​分解​的​原因​——​离散​世界​里​这​一​反例​不​存在​（discrete UI ​是​ \(L^1\)-bounded ​的​简单​ corollary），​唯有​ continuous ​才​需​ class (D) ​这层​ hypothesis。

§8 BSDE Pardoux-Peng ​与​ §9 Snell envelope ​的​ Doob-Meyer ​调用​均​严格​落​在​ class (D) ​假设​之下​；​本文​ §13 taxonomy ​第​ 1-2 ​行​也​明确​标​ "class (D)" ​列以​与​ (​跳​) semimart ​的​ quasi-left-continuous ​假设​区分​。

docs.title: §6.4 stochastic integral ​与​ mart property ​的​保持
docs.text:
stochastic integral \(H \cdot M = \int H\,dM\) ​在​ hypothesis \(H\) predictable + locally bounded + \(M\) continuous local mart ​时​仍​是​ continuous local mart——​这是​ mart property ​在​ integration ​下​的​保持​，​是​ §7 MRT ​反向​用法​的​基础​。

​具体​地​：

  • \(H\) bounded predictable + \(M\) true mart: \(H \cdot M\) ​是​ true mart；
  • \(H\) predictable locally bounded + \(M\) local mart: \(H \cdot M\) ​是​ local mart；UI ​性质​未必​保持​；
  • \(H \in L^2(d\mathbb{P} \otimes d\langle M\rangle) + M\) continuous local mart: \(H \cdot M\) ​是​ \(L^2\) mart ​且​ Itô isometry (Theorem 6.1) ​成立​；
  • \(H\) predictable + \(M\) semimart: \(H \cdot M\) ​是​ semimart；mart vs local mart ​区分​由​ \(M\) ​的​具体​类​决定​。

​四种​ hypothesis ​谱​由​ K-S 1991 (R20) Ch. 3 ​与​ Protter 2004 (R22) Ch. II §3-5 ​系统​给出​。​本文​ §7 MRT ​反向​使用​（​即​给定​ \(\xi\) ​求​ \(\phi\)）​借助​第三层​ hypothesis；§8 BSDE Picard contraction ​反复​用​第三​ + ​第四层​。

docs.title: §6.5 BDG ​在​ BSDE ​收敛​分析​中​的​应用​细节
docs.text:
Theorem 6.4 (continuous BDG, all \(p > 0\)) ​在​ §8 Theorem 8.1 Pardoux-Peng Picard contraction ​证明​中​的​具体​使用​：

Picard ​迭代​ \(\Phi(Y, Z) \to (Y', Z')\) ​中​，​把​ \((Y^{n+1}, Z^{n+1}) - (Y^n, Z^n)\) ​视作​ fixed-point ​残差​，​需在​ \(S^2 \times H^2\) norm ​下证​ contraction。\(S^2\) norm \(\mathbb{E}\sup |Y_t|^2\) ​与​ stochastic integral \(\int Z\,dB\) ​的​ \(H^2\) norm \(\mathbb{E}\int |Z|^2\,ds\) ​通过​ BDG (\(p = 2\) ​版​) ​与​ Doob \(L^2\) inequality ​互换​ ——​具体​地​：

\[\mathbb{E}\sup_t \left|\int_0^t Z_s\,dB_s\right|^2 \leq 4\,\mathbb{E}\int_0^T |Z_s|^2\,ds \quad \text{(Doob } L^2 \text{)},\] \[c_2\,\mathbb{E}\int_0^T |Z_s|^2\,ds \leq \mathbb{E}\sup_t \left|\int_0^t Z_s\,dB_s\right|^2 \leq C_2\,\mathbb{E}\int_0^T |Z_s|^2\,ds \quad \text{(BDG)}.\]

​两组​不等式​确保​ \(S^2\) ​与​ \(H^2\) ​在​ Picard contraction ​上​等价​；EKPQ 1997 (R21) §2 ​给​详细​论证​。​这一​ workhorse ​在​ §10.1 deep BSDE ​收敛​分析​中以​离散​化​形式​重现​——Han-Long 2020 a posteriori bound ​的​ \(\mathbb{E}\sup |Y - \hat{Y}|^2 + \int \mathbb{E}|Z - \hat{Z}|^2\,ds\) ​即​对应​ \(S^2 \times H^2\) norm。

docs.title: §7 Martingale representation ​与​测度​变换​ (Girsanov / Novikov / Kazamaki) (thread: B; → C ​桥​)
docs.text: Model basis. Brownian filtration \(\{\mathcal{F}_t^B\}\)（augmented under usual conditions）；\(T < \infty\) ​固定​ horizon。​本​节​关键​定理​ MRT ​在​ Brownian filtration ​上​ sharp；​扩展​至​ Brownian + Poisson ​混合​ filtration ​需​附加​ jump ​测度​积分​项​。

docs.title: Theorem 7.1 (Martingale representation, Brownian filtration)
docs.text:
Hypothesis. \(\mathcal{F}^B_T\)-​可测​的​ \(\xi \in L^2\), \(B = (B^1, \ldots, B^d)\) \(d\)-​维​ Brownian motion。Conclusion. ​存在​唯一​ predictable \(\phi = (\phi^1, \ldots, \phi^d) \in (H^2)^d := L^2(\Omega \times [0, T], \mathcal{P}, d\mathbb{P} \otimes ds; \mathbb{R}^d)\) ​使​ $\(\xi = \mathbb{E}[\xi] + \int_0^T \phi_s \cdot dB_s.\)$ （K-S 1991 (R20) Theorem 3.4.15。）Brownian filtration ​是​ sharp ​假设​；​如换​为​ enlarged filtration（​含​初始​ / progressive enlargement）​须​重新​ verify representation ​是否​仍​成立​——​这​正是​ R48 Ouwehand 2022 (arXiv:2210.07045) ​单作​ Enlargement of Filtrations — A Primer ​综述​的​主题​（FC-1 ​严禁​误标​ Aksamit-Jeanblanc 2022 arXiv）。

​此外​，Aksamit-Jeanblanc ​著作​存在​但​为​ Springer 2017 Enlargement of Filtration with Finance in View ​专著​，​未​在​本文​ phase ​内​独立​ primary verify，​相关​引用​按​ F-1 ​用​ [​作者​待​ verify] / ​该​文献​ ​占位​。

docs.title: Definition 7.2 (Doléans-Dade exponential, F-10)
docs.text: ​对​ continuous local mart \(N\) with \(N_0 = 0\): $\(\mathcal{E}(N)_t := \exp\left(N_t - \frac{1}{2}\langle N\rangle_t\right).\)$ \(\mathcal{E}(N)\) ​总是​ positive local mart；​其​是否​为​ true / UI mart ​依赖​额外​ integrability：

docs.title: Theorem 7.3 (Novikov 1972 / Kazamaki 1977, F-10 / FC-8)
docs.text:
• Novikov: ​若​ \(\mathbb{E}\exp(\tfrac{1}{2}\langle N\rangle_T) < \infty\)，​则​ \(\mathcal{E}(N)\) ​在​ \([0, T]\) ​上​是​ true mart（finite horizon ​下​ true mart \(\iff\) UI mart）；
  • Kazamaki: ​若​ \(\sup_\tau \mathbb{E}\exp(\tfrac{1}{2}N_\tau) < \infty\)（\(\tau\) ​取遍​ bounded stopping times），​则​ \(\mathcal{E}(N)\) UI mart。

​严格​分级​ (F-10)：Novikov \(\subsetneq\) Kazamaki ​真​包含​，​反​包含​不​成立​——Kazamaki 1977 (R23) ​原文​给出​例子​证​ Kazamaki ​严格​弱​。​任何​ "Novikov-Kazamaki" ​并列​写法​必须​附​"Novikov ​更强​、Kazamaki ​更弱​"​限定​，F-10 ​严禁​互换​或​写​"​等价​"。

FC-8 hedge. Kazamaki 1977 ​在​本​ phase ​仅作​ standard cite，​未​做​独立​ primary fetch；R23 entry ​已​记录​此​ caveat。​需作​定理​ anchor ​时​走​ fact-check round ​补​ verify。

docs.title: Theorem 7.4 (Girsanov)
docs.text: Hypothesis. \(\theta = \{\theta_s\}\) predictable ​满足​ \(\int_0^T \theta_s^2\,ds < \infty\) a.s.，​且​ \(\mathcal{E}(-\int_0^\cdot \theta_s\,dB_s)\) ​是​ UI mart on \([0, T]\)（Novikov ​或​ Kazamaki ​之一​充分​；F-10）。Conclusion. ​定义​ \(\mathbb{Q}\) via $\(\frac{d\mathbb{Q}}{d\mathbb{P}}\bigg|_{\mathcal{F}_T} = \mathcal{E}\left(-\int_0^\cdot \theta_s\,dB_s\right)_T.\)$ ​则​ \(\widetilde{B}_t := B_t + \int_0^t \theta_s\,ds\) ​是​ \(\mathbb{Q}\)-Brownian motion on \([0, T]\)。K-S 1991 (R20) Theorem 3.5.1；Protter 2004 (R22) Ch. III §6 ​详​ cádlàg semimart ​推广​。

docs.title: Sub-thesis 7.A (Girsanov → FTAP ​桥​, B↔C)
docs.text:
Girsanov ​给​抽象​测度​变换​ engine；§9 FTAP I (Delbaen-Schachermayer 1994/1998 (R29)) ​在​此​引擎​上​叠加​ NFLVR ⇔ ELMM ​的​等价​。​详​ §9 ​与​ cross-thread §12.2 (B↔C)。

​类比​仅供​直觉​：Girsanov ​用​ Doléans-Dade exponential ​作​ Radon-Nikodym ​密度​"​重置​"\(\mathbb{P}\) ​的​漂移​项​；UI ​条件​保证​密度​可作​真​概率​测度​。

docs.title: §7.1 MRT ​在​ enlarged filtration ​下​的​延拓​障碍
docs.text:
Theorem 7.1 MRT ​在​ Brownian filtration \(\{\mathcal{F}_t^B\}\) ​下​ sharp，​但​实际​金融​建模​常需​ enlarged filtration——​例如​ insider trading ​模型​（initial enlargement，​附加​初始​信息​ \(\sigma(\tau)\)，\(\tau\) ​是​未来​某停​时​）​或​信用​模型​（progressive enlargement，​渐进​附加​ default time ​的​信息​）。​在​这​两类​ enlargement ​下​：

  • ​初始​ enlargement: ​原​ Brownian \(B\) ​在​新​ filtration ​下​不再​是​ mart（​有​ information drift）；MRT ​需​修正​为​含​ information drift compensation ​的​形式​（Jacod 1985, FC-8 secondary）；
  • progressive enlargement: ​类似​ default time ​信息​附加​，\(B\) ​是​ semimart ​但​分解​后​ mart part ​与​原​ \(B\) ​在​ drift ​上​有​ quantified gap。

R48 Ouwehand 2022 (arXiv:2210.07045) Enlargement of Filtrations — A Primer ​综述​系统​梳理​这​两类​ enlargement ​在​金融​建模​中​的​ mart property ​修正​——​这​正是​ FC-1 ​严禁​误标​为​ Aksamit-Jeanblanc 2022 arXiv ​的​对象​。Aksamit-Jeanblanc Springer 2017 Enlargement of Filtration with Finance in View ​专著​存在​，​是​ enlargement of filtration ​在​金融​上下文​最​完整​的​现代​专著​，​但本​ phase ​未​独立​ primary verify，​按​ F-1 ​用​ [​作者​待​ verify] ​占位​。

docs.title: §7.2 Doléans-Dade exponential ​的​两类​ UI ​条件​本质​对比
docs.text:
Theorem 7.3 Novikov vs Kazamaki ​的​严格​分级​（Novikov \(\subsetneq\) Kazamaki）​的​本质​：

  • Novikov \(\mathbb{E}\exp(\tfrac{1}{2}\langle N\rangle_T) < \infty\) ​控制​的​是​预测​平方​累积​ \(\langle N\rangle_T\) ​的​指数​矩​——​这是​ a priori bound，​仅​依赖​ \(N\) ​的​ conditional variance；
  • Kazamaki \(\sup_\tau \mathbb{E}\exp(\tfrac{1}{2}N_\tau) < \infty\) ​控制​的​是​ \(N\) ​本身​在​任意​ bounded stopping time ​取值​的​指数​矩​——​这​允许​ \(\langle N\rangle\) ​任意​大​，​只要​ \(N\) ​自身​不过​大​。

Kazamaki 1977 (R23) ​原文​给出​严格​反例​（​即​满足​ Kazamaki ​但​违反​ Novikov ​的​ \(N\)），​证​ Novikov ​不是​ Kazamaki ​的​必要条件​，​反​包含​确实​失败​。​本文​每次​引用​ Doléans-Dade UI ​充分条件​时均​需​明确​写出​"Novikov" ​或​ "Kazamaki" ​之一​，F-10 ​严禁​互换​或​写​ '​等价​'。

docs.title: §7.3 Girsanov → FTAP ​的​两步​桥接
docs.text:
Sub-thesis 7.A ​提到​ Girsanov ​给​ abstract ​测度​变换​ engine，§9 FTAP ​在​此基础​上​给​等价​化​。​这​两步​桥接​的​具体​技术​机制​：

  • ​第一步​（​测度​变换​层​）: ​给定​ candidate density ​过程​ \(\rho_t = \mathcal{E}(-\int_0^t \theta\,dB)_t\)，​通过​ Theorem 7.4 ​转​ \(\mathbb{P} \to \mathbb{Q}\)，​使​ \(\widetilde{B}_t = B_t + \int \theta\,ds\) ​在​ \(\mathbb{Q}\) ​下​成​ BM，​并​ \(S_t\) ​在​ \(\mathbb{Q}\) ​下​成​ (local) mart；
  • ​第二步​（FTAP ​等价​化层​）: §9 Theorem 9.1 Delbaen-Schachermayer 1994/1998 (R29) ​证​ NFLVR ⇔ ELMM ​存在​；​即​第一步​在​所有​ candidate \(\theta\) ​中​至少​有​一个​生成​有效​ \(\mathbb{Q}\)（​且​满足​ Novikov ​或​ Kazamaki），​等价​于​资产​ \(S\) ​不​允许​ NFLVR-type ​套利​。

​二者​一并​构成​"​市场​无​套利​"​的​ mathematical translation ​链​。​其中​ §6 Theorem 6.3 Doob-Meyer continuous ​在​ R29 1998 unbounded ​版​的​ Eσ-MM ​论证​中​作为​关键​工具​调用​。

docs.title: §7.4 Brownian-Poisson ​混合​ filtration ​下​ MRT ​的​修正​形式
docs.text:
Theorem 7.1 MRT ​在​纯​ Brownian filtration ​上​是​ sharp；​常见​金融​建模​需要​ Brownian + Poisson ​混合​ filtration（​如​ jump-diffusion option pricing）。​此时​ MRT ​修正​为​：

Theorem 7.1'（Jump-diffusion MRT）. ​设​ \(\mathcal{F}_t\) ​由​ \(B\)（Brownian）​与​ \(N\)（Poisson ​随机​测度​，compensator \( u\)）​联合​生成​。​则​ \(\xi \in L^2(\mathcal{F}_T)\) ​可​唯一​表示​为​ $\(\xi = \mathbb{E}[\xi] + \int_0^T \phi_s\,dB_s + \int_0^T \int_E \psi(s, x)\, ilde{N}(ds, dx),\)$ ​其中​ \(\phi \in H^2\)（​关于​ \(B\)）、\(\psi\) predictable ​且​ \(\mathbb{E}\int_0^T\int_E |\psi(s, x)|^2 u(dx)\,ds < \infty\)，\( ilde{N} = N - u\) ​是​ compensated Poisson ​测度​。

​这一​推广​在​ §9 jump-diffusion option pricing、Lévy market models、credit risk modeling ​等​领域​广泛​使用​；​具体​形式​可​在​ Cont-Tankov 2004 Financial Modelling with Jump Processes (CRC, FC-8 secondary) ​或​ Applebaum 2009 Lévy Processes and Stochastic Calculus ​找到​。

​本文​ §7-§9 ​主体​假设​ Brownian filtration ​简化​讨论​；jump-extended ​形式​作为​ paragraph-level remark ​在​相关​章节​出现​。

docs.title: §7.4a Brownian-Poisson ​混合​下​ Doléans-Dade ​的​修正
docs.text:
§7.4 ​引入​ Brownian-Poisson ​混合​ filtration；​对应​的​ Doléans-Dade exponential ​需​修正​为​：

\[\mathcal{E}(N)_t = \exp\left(N_t - \frac{1}{2}\langle N^c\rangle_t\right)\prod_{0 < s \leq t}(1 + \Delta N_s)\exp(-\Delta N_s),\]

​其中​ \(N^c\) ​是​ \(N\) ​的​ continuous mart part，product ​部分​吃​跳​。UI ​条件​由​"Brownian ​部分​ Novikov" + "jump ​部分​ exponential moment ​控制​"​联合​给出​（Protter 2004 (R22) Ch. III §8）。

​实务​中​ jump-diffusion model（​如​ Merton / Kou）​的​ risk-neutral measure ​变换​需要​这一​ jump-extended Doléans-Dade。​本文​ §7 ​主体​限定​ continuous local mart，jump-extended ​形式​仅​在​此​ mention ​作​上下文​。

docs.title: §7.5 Girsanov ​在​ reflective stochastic control ​上​的​应用
docs.text:
Theorem 7.4 Girsanov ​在​ stochastic control ​中有​ specific ​用法​——​把​ controlled SDE $\(dX_t = b(t, X_t, u_t)\,dt + \sigma(t, X_t)\,dW_t\)$ ​通过​ Girsanov ​把​ control \(u_t\) ​写入​ measure change ​而​非​ drift，​使​ reference SDE ​变成​ uncontrolled，control "​藏进​" measure change ​中​。​这一​技术​在​ risk-sensitive control、stochastic differential game、indifference pricing ​中是​核心​工具​。

​具体​形式​：​定义​ \(\theta(t, X, u) = \sigma(t, X)^{-1}b(t, X, u)\)，​由​ Girsanov \(\mathbb{Q} \to \mathbb{P}\) ​使​ \(W_t\) ​在​ \(\mathbb{P}\) ​下​不再​ BM ​而是​带​ drift \(\theta\,dt\)；control ​的​ selection ​等价​于​ measure \(\mathbb{P}\) ​的​ selection。Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman ​方程​的​解可​由​该​ formulation ​得到​。

​这是​ §11.5 RLHF-Girsanov path-space mapping ​路线​的​一个​潜在​ inspiration——​若​把​ RLHF policy \(\pi\) ​类比​ control \(u\)，​把​ measure change ​类比​ KL regularization，​二者​结构​或​可​建立​ measure-theoretic ​联系​；​但​ FC-5 / OS-3 hedge：​当前​仅​ conceptual analogy，​无​严格​ path-space mapping。

docs.title: §7.6 Girsanov ​在​ importance sampling / Monte Carlo ​上​的​反向​应用
docs.text:
Theorem 7.4 Girsanov ​还​可​反向​用作​ importance sampling ​工具​——​通过​ measure change ​使​ rare-event ​在​新​测度​下​更​频繁​，​再用​ Radon-Nikodym ​密度​修正​期望​。​具体​在​金融​中​：

  • deep-OTM option pricing: ​普通​ Monte Carlo ​在​ deep out-of-the-money option ​上​ hit rate ​极低​；​通过​ Girsanov ​在​ \(\mathbb{Q}'\) ​下​让​ \(S\) drift ​偏向​ strike \(K\)，​再用​ \(d\mathbb{Q}/d\mathbb{Q}'\) ​修正​定价​；
  • credit risk simulation: default time ​的​ rare event simulation；​通过​ Girsanov ​提高​ hazard rate，​再​修正​；
  • rare-event large deviation: deviation ​概率​的​ large-deviation rate function ​由​ Girsanov + variational principle ​给出​（Donsker-Varadhan ​等​）。

​这一​反向​应用​使​ §7 Girsanov ​不仅​是​金融​定价​的​测度​变换​ engine，​也​是​ numerical methods ​的​ variance reduction ​工具​。R20 K-S 1991 Ch. 3.5 ​与​ Glasserman 2003 Monte Carlo Methods in Financial Engineering (FC-8 secondary) ​给​具体​算法​。

docs.title: §8 BSDE: Pardoux-Peng ​与​扩展​ (thread: B; → C deep BSDE ​桥​)
docs.text: Model basis. \((\Omega, \mathcal{F}, \{\mathcal{F}_t\}, \mathbb{P})\) Brownian filtration（​或​扩展​至​ Brownian-Poisson ​混合​）；horizon \(T < \infty\)。terminal \(\xi \in L^2(\mathcal{F}_T)\)；driver \(f: [0, T] \times \Omega \times \mathbb{R} \times \mathbb{R}^d \to \mathbb{R}\) progressively measurable，Lipschitz in \((y, z)\) uniformly in \((t, \omega)\)：\(|f(t, \omega, y_1, z_1) - f(t, \omega, y_2, z_2)| \leq L(|y_1 - y_2| + |z_1 - z_2|)\)；integrability \(\mathbb{E}\int_0^T |f(s, 0, 0)|^2\,ds < \infty\)。

docs.title: Definition 8.1 (BSDE solution)
docs.text: \((Y, Z) \in S^2 \times H^2\) ​解​ $\(Y_t = \xi + \int_t^T f(s, Y_s, Z_s)\,ds - \int_t^T Z_s\,dB_s,\quad 0 \leq t \leq T,\)$ ​其中​ \(S^2 := \{Y\;\text{adapted cádlàg}: \mathbb{E}\sup_t |Y_t|^2 < \infty\}\)，\(H^2\) ​如​ §7。

docs.title: Theorem 8.1 (Pardoux-Peng 1990, R19)
docs.text: ​在​ Model basis ​假设​下​ BSDE Definition 8.1 ​存在​唯一​解​ \((Y, Z) \in S^2 \times H^2\)。​证明​骨架​：​定义​ \(\Phi: S^2 \times H^2 \to S^2 \times H^2\) via \(\Phi(Y, Z) = (Y', Z')\) where \(Y'_t = \mathbb{E}[\xi + \int_t^T f(s, Y_s, Z_s)\,ds \mid \mathcal{F}_t]\) ​与​ MRT 7.1 ​给​ \(Z'\)。Picard contraction on \(S^2 \times H^2\) ​配​ BDG (§6 Theorem 6.4) workhorse ​给​唯一​不动点​ (Pardoux-Peng 1990 (R19) Systems & Control Letters 14:55-61；EKPQ 1997 (R21) §2 ​现代版​)。

docs.title: Theorem 8.2 (Comparison theorem, BSDE)
docs.text: ​设​ \((Y^1, Z^1)\) ​与​ \((Y^2, Z^2)\) ​分别​为​ BSDE \((\xi^i, f^i)\) ​的​ Pardoux-Peng ​解​。​若​ \(\xi^1 \leq \xi^2\) a.s.，\(f^1(t, Y_t^1, Z_t^1) \leq f^2(t, Y_t^1, Z_t^1)\) a.s. dt × dP，​且​ \(f^2\) Lipschitz，​则​ \(Y_t^1 \leq Y_t^2\) a.s. for all \(t\)。EKPQ 1997 (R21) Theorem 2.2 standard ​现代​写法​；​其​在​ §9 American option / Snell envelope ​与​ deep BSDE ​上​界​证明​里​反复​使用​。

docs.title: 扩展​ 8.3 (Kobylanski 2000 / FBSDE / 2BSDE / reflected BSDE)
docs.text:
• Kobylanski 2000 quadratic-in-\(z\): ​放松​ driver \(f\) ​为​ quadratic growth in \(z\)（​替代​ Lipschitz）​配​ bounded \(\xi\)，​仍得​ \(Y\) bounded、\(Z \in H^2\) ​解​（[​作者​待​ verify primary ​在​本​ phase] - Kobylanski 2000 Ann. Probab. 28(2)，FC-8 secondary anchor，​作为​ standard cite）；
  • FBSDE (forward-backward): \((X, Y, Z)\) ​联立​ SDE + BSDE，coupling ​通过​ \(X\) ​进​ driver；deep BSDE (§10) ​的​实际​ ansatz target；
  • 2BSDE (second-order): Soner-Touzi-Zhang ​等​扩展​用以​处理​ fully nonlinear PDE；
  • reflected BSDE: \(Y\) ​强制​ $\geq $ obstacle \(L\), ​加​ increasing process \(K\) ​反映​；​与​ §9 Snell envelope / American option ​一一对应​。

docs.title: Sub-thesis 8.A (Pardoux-Peng → deep BSDE ​桥​, B↔C)
docs.text:
Theorem 8.1 ​的​ Lipschitz ​唯一性​保证​ \((Y, Z)\) ​是​ well-defined object——​这是​ deep BSDE (§10 R34/R35/R36) ​用​ NN ansatz \(\phi(t, S_t; \theta)\) ​近似​ \(Z\) ​的​数学​合法性​前提​：NN ​在​近似​一个​存在​唯一​的​ reference solution，​而​非​ well-posedness-undefined object。​定量​收敛​速率​仍为​ open seam（Phase 0c-C open seam 1）；​现状​是​ a posteriori error bound（Han-Long 2020 standard cite），​与​ Theorem 8.1 ​的​ a priori well-posedness ​强度​尚有​ gap。​详​ §10 ​与​ cross-thread §12.2。

​类比​仅供​直觉​：BSDE ​是​"​反向​ SDE"——​已知​ terminal \(\xi\) ​与​ driver ​形式​ \(f\)，​求​ adapted ​解​ \((Y, Z)\)；\(Z\) ​作为​ MRT 7.1 ​给出​的​ representer ​同时​承担​ "hedging strategy"（§9）​与​ "deep BSDE NN ​输出​"（§10）​双重身份​。

docs.title: §8.1 Pardoux-Peng Lipschitz ​假设​的​可​放宽​性谱
docs.text:
Theorem 8.1 ​的​ Lipschitz-in-\((y, z)\) ​假设​是​ BSDE ​最早​ well-posedness ​结果​的​标准​ cost；​二十余年​来​一系列​扩展​逐步​放宽​该​假设​：

  • Pardoux 1999 monotone BSDE: ​同名​作者​次年​的​扩展​把​ Lipschitz-in-\(y\) ​假设​放宽​为​ monotonicity-in-\(y\)（​即​ \(\langle f(t, y_1, z) - f(t, y_2, z), y_1 - y_2\rangle \leq \mu|y_1 - y_2|^2\)）+ polynomial growth in \(y\) + Lipschitz-in-\(z\)；driver ​在​ \(y\) ​上​可​允许​ polynomial growth（​如​ \(y - y^3\) ​类​ cubic driver），​仍​可证​ BSDE well-posedness。​这是​ Lipschitz ​假设​"​另一侧​"​放宽​，​揭示​ monotonicity ​才​是​ well-posedness ​的​真正​驱动力​，Lipschitz ​仅​是​ sufficient ​而​非​ necessary。FC-8 secondary anchor: Pardoux 1999 Lecture Notes Control Information Sci. (Nonlinear analysis, differential equations and control, ed. F. H. Clarke, R. J. Stern, Kluwer)；​本​ phase ​未​独立​ primary verify，​作​ standard cite；
  • Kobylanski 2000: bounded terminal \(\xi \in L^\infty\) + driver \(f\) quadratic-in-\(z\)（​即​ \(|f(t, y, z)| \leq C(1 + |y| + |z|^2)\)）, ​仍得​ \(Y\) bounded、\(Z \in H^2\) ​解​；​对​ utility-maximization ​与​ indifference pricing ​中​常见​的​ exponential utility BSDE ​至关重要​；
  • Briand-Hu 2008: unbounded \(\xi\) + driver quadratic-in-\(z\) + ​适当​ exponential moment ​控制​；
  • Hu-Tang / Tang-Li ​系列​: jump BSDE（​含​ Poisson ​随机​测度​ driver）​的​存在​唯一性​；
  • 2BSDE (Soner-Touzi-Zhang 2012): ​对​ fully nonlinear PDE ​的​ BSDE ​表示​，driver ​含​ Hessian ​项​；
  • reflected BSDE / doubly reflected: ​在​ obstacle ​约束​下​的​解​，​对应​ §9 American / Israeli option（Dynkin game）。

​上述​扩展​在​本文​为​ FC-8 secondary anchor，​作​ standard cite，​未​做​独立​ primary verify。

Hypothesis-explicit cross-reference: §10.1 deep BSDE ​实例​的​ well-posedness ​桥须​按​ driver ​形式​分别​对应​。

​关键​澄清​: §10.1 R35 Han-Jentzen-E 2018 PNAS ​的​ 100-D Allen-Cahn ​实例​ driver \(f(y) = y - y^3\) ​是​ cubic in \(y\)（​即​ non-Lipschitz in \(y\), polynomial growth），​其​ well-posedness ​严格​属于​ Pardoux 1999 monotone BSDE ​框架​（monotonicity \(\langle y_1 - y_2 - (y_1^3 - y_2^3), y_1 - y_2\rangle \leq 0\) ​由​ \(-y^3\) ​的​递减​给出​），​不属​ §8 Theorem 8.1 (Pardoux-Peng 1990) Lipschitz ​框架​。

​本文​ §8 Theorem 8.1 ​作为​主​ statement ​提供​ Lipschitz ​设定​下​的​ well-posedness ​骨架​；R35 cubic driver ​实例​的​严格​ well-posedness ​桥应​明确​ invoke Pardoux 1999 monotone ​框架​而​非​ 1990 Lipschitz——​这是​综述​写作​中​容易​隐含​ hypothesis ​失配​的​典型​ case，​本文​显式​标注​。​其余​ driver ​形式​按​ quadratic-in-\(z\) / monotone-in-\(y\) / Lipschitz / jump ​等​具体​形式​选用​对应​ well-posedness ​定理​。

docs.title: §8.2 FBSDE ​与​ deep BSDE ​的​实际​ setup
docs.text:
§10.1 deep BSDE ​实际​处理​的​是​ FBSDE：​联立​ $\(dX_t = b(t, X_t)\,dt + \sigma(t, X_t)\,dB_t,\quad X_0 = x_0,\)$ $\(dY_t = -f(t, X_t, Y_t, Z_t)\,dt + Z_t^\top\,dB_t,\quad Y_T = g(X_T),\)$ \(X\) ​是​ forward SDE（drift \(b\) + diffusion \(\sigma\) + ​初值​ \(x_0\)），\((Y, Z)\) ​是​依赖​ \(X\) ​的​ BSDE。​在​ Markov ​主体​下​ \(Y_t = u(t, X_t)\)、\(Z_t = \sigma(t, X_t)^\top \nabla u(t, X_t)\)，​与​ parabolic PDE \(\partial_t u + \mathcal{L}u + f = 0\), \(u(T, x) = g(x)\) ​通过​ nonlinear Feynman-Kac ​等价​。

deep BSDE ​把​ \(u\) ​的​ spatial ​信息​编码​到​ \(Z_{t_n} = \phi(t_n, X_{t_n}; \theta_n)\) NN ​中​；Theorem 8.1 ​在​此​提供​ reference solution well-posedness。NN ​学​的​对象​ \((Y_0, \{Z_{t_n}\})\) ​是​良性​ well-defined ​的​，​否则​ SGD ​的​目标​函数​收敛性​失去​意义​。​这​与​ §10.1 ​收敛​分析​的​ a posteriori ​局限​并不矛盾​——​前者​是​定性​ well-posedness，​后者​是​定量​ rate。

docs.title: §8.3 BSDE comparison theorem ​在​ American option ​上​的​应用
docs.text: Theorem 8.2 comparison ​在​ §9 Snell envelope / American option ​上​的​具体​使用​：​把​ American option ​价格表​为​ reflected BSDE $\(Y_t = G_t + \int_t^T f(s)\,ds - \int_t^T Z_s\,dB_s + (K_T - K_t),\)$ \(K\) increasing process，\(Y \geq G\), \(\int_0^T (Y_t - G_t)\,dK_t = 0\)（Skorohod ​反射​条件​）。Comparison ​给定​不同​ obstacle \(G^1 \leq G^2\) ​时​ \(Y^1 \leq Y^2\)——​这是​ §9 Snell envelope ​的​"​最小​ supermart majorant"​性质​在​ BSDE ​层面​的​对应​。EKPQ 1997 (R21) §3 ​给出​ BSDE → American option ​的​完整​桥接​；R37 Becker-Cheridito-Jentzen 2019 (deep OS) ​在​算法​层面​进一步​处理​。

docs.title: §8.4 BSDE ​数值​方法​的​演进​谱
docs.text:
BSDE ​数值​方法​在​ 1990s-2020s ​的​演进​可​大致​分​四代​：

​第一代​（1990s-2000s）：​随机​网格​ + ​条件期望​估计​. Bouchard-Touzi 2004 / Gobet-Lemor-Warin 2005 ​等​用​ Monte Carlo ​模拟​ forward path + regression ​估计​ conditional expectation；​与​ LSM (R32) ​类似​但​ BSDE ​设置​。

​第二代​（2000s-2010s）：cubature / sparse grid / tree method. ​通过​ cubature on Wiener space ​或​ sparse grid Galerkin ​在​中维​ \(d \leq 20\) ​处理​ BSDE；​维度​灾难​（curse of dimensionality）​在​ \(d \geq 30\) ​时​严重​。

​第三代​（2017-2020）：deep BSDE (R34, R35). ​用​ NN ​突破​维度​灾难​；R35 PNAS ​报告​ 100-D Black-Scholes / Allen-Cahn / HJB ​实例​。​但​ a priori ​速率​仍​ open（§14 OS-1）。

​第四代​（2021-2026）：multi-physics / multi-task / model-free. Han-Hu 2020 multi-task DeepBSDE；2024-2025 MV-FBSDE (R44 arXiv:2511.09112 / arXiv:2512.14967) ​处理​ mean-field game；signature-based / rough vol ​主体​ (R43 / R44) ​处理​ non-Markov。

​四代​方法​在​ §13 taxonomy ​矩阵​的​ ML ​算法​栈​一列​上​呈现​ "​无​ NN → ​简单​ MC + regression → NN forward SGD → ​多​物理​多任务​" ​演进​；​本文​ §10 ​重心​在​第三​-​第四代​。

docs.title: §8.5 BSDE ​与​ stochastic control / HJB ​的​等价​性
docs.text:
§8 BSDE ​与​ stochastic control / Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman ​方程​的​等价关系​：​在​ Markov ​主体​下​，BSDE ​的​ Pardoux-Peng ​解​ \((Y, Z)\) ​对应​ HJB ​方程​的​ viscosity solution \(u\) via \(Y_t = u(t, X_t)\), \(Z_t = \sigma^ op abla u(t, X_t)\)（nonlinear Feynman-Kac, Pardoux-Peng 1992 Lecture Notes Control Information Sci., FC-8 secondary）。

​具体​地​： - Forward SDE: \(dX_t = b(t, X_t)\,dt + \sigma(t, X_t)\,dW_t\), \(X_0 = x_0\)； - BSDE: \(-dY_t = f(t, X_t, Y_t, Z_t)\,dt - Z_t\,dW_t\), \(Y_T = g(X_T)\)； - HJB: \(\partial_t u + frac{1}{2}\mathrm{Tr}(\sigma\sigma^ op abla^2 u) + b^ op abla u + f(t, x, u, \sigma^ op abla u) = 0\), \(u(T, x) = g(x)\).

​此​等价​ underpins §10.1 deep BSDE：deep BSDE ​学到​的​是​ HJB ​解​ \(u\) ​在​ \(\{X_t\}_t\) ​路径​上​的​取值​，​不​直接​学​ \(u\) ​的​ spatial ​结构​（​不同于​ PINN，§10.9）。​这一​区分​对​ dimensionality ​处理​很​关键​——​在​ \(d \geq 100\) ​时​ \(u\) ​的​ spatial ​复杂度​极高​，​但​ \(u\) ​在​ \(\{X_t\}_t\) ​路径​上​的​取值​通过​ BSDE ​表示​自然​ sparse-evaluated。

docs.title: §8.6 BSDE ​在​ utility maximization ​与​ indifference pricing ​上​的​应用
docs.text:
§8 BSDE ​在​金融​实务​中​的​另​一个​核心​应用​是​ utility maximization / indifference pricing。​在​不​完备​市场​（§9.4）​下​，​单一​ EMM ​不​存在​，​需​通过​ utility function \(U\) ​选定​一个​定价​规则​：

Utility maximization: ​求​ \(V(x, \xi) = \sup_\pi \mathbb{E}[U(X_T^{x, \pi} - \xi)]\)，\(X_T^{x, \pi}\) ​是​初始​财富​ \(x\) + ​投资​策略​ \(\pi\) ​终值​；\(\xi\) ​是​ contingent liability。​最优​策略​与​最优​ value function ​通过​ BSDE ​表示​：​在​ exponential utility \(U(x) = -e^{-\gamma x}\) ​下​，value function ​对应​ BSDE driver \(f\) ​形​如​ quadratic-in-\(z\)（Kobylanski 2000 ​可​解性​，§8.1 ​谱​），\(Z\) ​给​最优​投资​策略​。

Indifference pricing: ​卖方​ indifference price \(p(\xi)\) ​由​ \(V(x + p, \xi) = V(x, 0)\) ​定义​；​买方​ indifference price ​对偶​。​这一​定价​规则​在​不​完备​市场​下​唯一​，​且​与​ risk-neutral ​定价​（\(\mathbb{E}^\mathbb{Q}[\xi]\)）​的​差异​由​ risk preference / utility ​控制​。

BSDE ​给​ indifference pricing ​一个​ systematic computational tool ——​直接​解​ BSDE ​给​ \(V\)，​比​ utility maximization ​的​ PDE ​表示​更​适合​ high-dim。R21 EKPQ 1997 §4 ​给​经典​推导​；R34-R36 deep BSDE ​在​此​应用​上​提供​ high-dim ​兑现​路线​。

docs.title: §8.7 Bridge to Thread C — ​从​ BSDE / ​测度​变换​ engine ​到​金融​定价
docs.text:
Thread B (§5-§8) ​已经​组装​了​ measure-theoretic ​重型​工具​——usual conditions + semimart ​阶梯​ + Itô integral + Doob-Meyer + MRT + Doléans-Dade + Girsanov + BSDE well-posedness——​这些​工具​本身​是​ model-independent ​的​随机​分析​机器​。Thread C (§9-§11) ​把​同一​机器​套​到​金融​定价​ setup ​上​，​关键​ mapping ​有​三层​。

(i) Girsanov → FTAP: §7 Theorem 7.4 Doléans-Dade \(\mathcal{E}(N)\) + Novikov ⊊ Kazamaki ​给​"​如何​构造​ risk-neutral measure" engine；§9 Theorem 9.1 FTAP I ​在​该​ engine ​上加​ admissibility + NFLVR ​给​"​何时​存在​ ELMM"​判据​。

(ii) MRT → complete-market hedging: §7 Theorem 7.1 Brownian-filtration MRT \(\xi = \mathbb{E}\xi + \int_0^T \phi_s\,dB_s\) ​把​对冲​组合​ \(\phi\) ​与​ European claim \(\xi\) ​严格​对应​；§9 Theorem 9.2 FTAP II ​给​"​完备​市场​ ⇔ ELMM ​唯一​"。

(iii) BSDE → American option / Snell envelope: §8 reflected BSDE ​与​ §9 Theorem 9.5 Snell envelope = ​最小​ supermart majorant ​在​数学​上​等价​（§9.6）；BSDE comparison theorem ​是​ American option ​上​界​证明​的​工具​；deep BSDE / deep OS（§10）​是​该​等价​在​算法​层​的​两侧​。

​这​三层​ mapping ​使​ Thread C ​不是​ Thread B ​的​"​应用​"，​而是​ Thread B engine ​在​金融​ admissibility / numeraire / stopping ​等​额外​结构​下​的​特化​兑现​。​详尽​桥​论证​见​ §12.2 B↔C。

docs.title: §9 FTAP, change of numeraire, Snell envelope (thread: C)
docs.text: Model basis. ​资产​价格​ \(S = \{S_t\}\) cádlàg semimart；admissible strategy \(H\) predictable + integrable wrt \(S\) + bounded-below wealth（Delbaen-Schachermayer 1994 (R29) ​的​ admissibility ​定义​，​禁​ doubling strategy）。filtration \(\{\mathcal{F}_t\}\) ​满足​ usual conditions。

docs.title: Definition 9.1 (NA, NFLVR, EMM ​三层​)
docs.text:
• NA (No Arbitrage): ​不​存在​ admissible strategy \(H\) ​使​ \((H \cdot S)_T \geq 0\) a.s. ​且​ \(\mathbb{P}((H \cdot S)_T > 0) > 0\)；
  • NFLVR (No Free Lunch with Vanishing Risk): NA ​加​ "no sequence \(H^n\) with \((H^n \cdot S)_T \geq -\varepsilon_n\), \(\varepsilon_n \downarrow 0\) converges to nonzero positive in some weakened sense"（Delbaen-Schachermayer 1994 (R29) ​定义​ 2.8）；
  • EMM / ELMM / Eσ-MM: equivalent martingale measure / equivalent local mart measure / equivalent sigma-martingale measure ​三层​，​按​ \(S\) ​在​ \(\mathbb{Q}\) ​下属​哪​一类​区分​。Sigma-martingale ​由​ Émery 1980 / Delbaen-Schachermayer 1998 (R29) ​引入​处理​ unbounded jumps。

docs.title: Theorem 9.1 (FTAP I, ​离散​ vs ​连续​ ​严格​分立​)
docs.text:
• Discrete (Dalang-Morton-Willinger 1990, R28): ​离散​时间​有限​-or-countable horizon ​模型​ NA \(\iff\) EMM ​存在​；​证明​用​有限​维​分离​超平面​定理​ + back-induction。
  • Continuous (Delbaen-Schachermayer 1994, R29): \(S\) locally bounded semimart on \([0, T]\)，NFLVR \(\iff\) ELMM ​存在​；1998 ​续作​ (R29) ​扩展​至​ unbounded \(S\) semimart ​与​ Eσ-MM ​存在​。

​两​ statement ​不可​合并​——continuous ​必须​用​ NFLVR（​强化​ NA）​与​ ELMM（​弱化​ EMM），​与​离散​ NA / EMM ​不​一一对应​。Harrison-Pliska 1981 (R27) ​早期​ systematize martingale ​方法​在​连续​交易​，​但​ FTAP I ​严格​ statement ​由​ R28 / R29 ​给出​。

docs.title: Theorem 9.2 (FTAP II, market completeness)
docs.text: NFLVR + market ​完备​（​即​每​ \(\xi \in L^\infty\) ​可​被​ admissible ​策略​复制​）\(\iff\) ELMM ​唯一​。Harrison-Pliska 1981 (R27) ​提出​，Delbaen-Schachermayer 1994 (R29) ​现代​严格​化​。​市场​完备​ ⇔ MRT 7.1-style ​在​ \(\mathbb{Q}\) ​下​保持​唯一​表示​。

docs.title: Theorem 9.3 (Geman-El Karoui-Rochet 1995 numeraire change, R30)
docs.text: ​若​ \(N = \{N_t\}\) ​在​ \(\mathbb{Q}\) ​下​ a positive mart（"numeraire"），​定义​ \(\mathbb{Q}^N\) via \(d\mathbb{Q}^N/d\mathbb{Q} = N_T/N_0\)。​则​ \(S/N\) ​在​ \(\mathbb{Q}^N\) ​下​是​ mart（or local mart）。​此​变换​让​ forward measure / swap measure / risk-neutral measure ​之间​在​ LIBOR / swap / FX ​定价​上​自由​切换​；​其本质​是​ Girsanov (§7 Theorem 7.4) ​在​ \(N\) ​作​ Doléans-Dade ​密度​的​ special case。

docs.title: Definition 9.4 (Snell envelope, R31)
docs.text: ​设​ reward process \(G = \{G_t\}\) adapted, cádlàg, \(\sup_t \mathbb{E}^\mathbb{Q}[|G_t|] < \infty\)。Discounted Snell envelope（​亦​称​ American option value process；​裸​ "Snell envelope" ​经典​定义​不​含​ discount，​本文​将​ discount ​嵌入​以​贴合​ §10 ​算法​约定​）： $\(U_t = \mathrm{ess\,sup}_{\tau \geq t}\,\mathbb{E}^\mathbb{Q}\left[e^{-\int_t^\tau r_s\,ds} G_\tau \;\Big|\; \mathcal{F}_t\right],\)$ \(\tau\) ​取遍​ stopping times in \([t, T]\)。

docs.title: Theorem 9.5 (Snell envelope = ​最小​ supermart majorant + ​最优​停时​)
docs.text: \(U\) ​是​ dominate \(G\) ​的​最小​ \(\mathbb{Q}\)-supermartingale，​且​ \(\tau^* := \inf\{t \geq 0: U_t = G_t\}\) ​是​最优​停时​。Doob-Meyer (§6 Theorem 6.3) ​给​ \(U = U_0 - A + M\) ​分解​，\(A\) ​是​ free-boundary process（"continuation region" \(\to\) "stopping region" ​边界​）；\(A_\tau > 0 \iff \tau \geq \tau^*\)。Snell 1952 (R31) ​是​源​；R31 + Karatzas-Shreve 1998 Methods of Mathematical Finance ​后继​。

docs.title: Theorem 9.6 (Longstaff-Schwartz 2001, R32 + Clément-Lamberton-Protter 2002, R33 ​收敛​)
docs.text:
Longstaff-Schwartz (LSM): ​在​ Bermudan / American option ​定价​的​有限​时间​网格​ \(0 = t_0 < \cdots < t_N = T\) ​上​，backward induction ​用​回归​ basis ​函数​ \(\{\psi_k\}_{k \leq K}\) projection ​估计​ \(\mathbb{E}^\mathbb{Q}[U_{t_{n+1}} \mid \mathcal{F}_{t_n}] \approx \sum_k \alpha_k^{(n)} \psi_k(S_{t_n})\)。

Clément-Lamberton-Protter 2002 (R33) ​证​ LSM ​估计​随​ \(K \to \infty\) ​与​ MC paths \(\to \infty\) ​双重​ \(L^2\) ​收敛​至​真​ Snell envelope。FC-8 hedge：R33 primary ​未​独立​ verify ​本​ phase；​作​ standard cite。

A↔C bridge cue. R33 LSM ​收敛​证明​的​可​测论​支撑​就是​ §3 Theorem 3.1 A2c (\(L^p\)-bounded mart convergence) + basis ​完备​性​。Thread A ​是​ Thread C ​经典​ OS ​数值​方法​的​可​测论​支撑​。​详​ cross-thread §12.3。
