​类比​仅供​直觉​：Snell envelope ​是​"​最优​停时​的​ dynamic-programming value function"——​即​ \(U_t = \sup_{\tau \geq t} \mathbb{E}^\mathbb{Q}[\text{discounted reward}]\)，​自然​是​ supermart（"​等等​永远​不亏​"+ stopping ​时机​最优​）。

docs.title: §9.1 NA / NFLVR / EMM-ELMM-Eσ-MM ​三层​概念​的​递进​必要性
docs.text:
§9 Definition 9.1 ​引入​的​三层​概念​呈现​ measure-theoretic ​严格​化在​ unbounded ​随机​模型​下​的​必要性​：

  • ​离散​ NA + EMM: Dalang-Morton-Willinger 1990 (R28) ​给​的​离散​ FTAP I ​已经​完整​——​离散​ NA ​与​ EMM ​存在​等价​，proof ​用​有限​维​分离​超平面​ + back-induction。​该​结论​对​实际​ BTC / Bermudan ​类​ product ​直接​可用​；
  • ​连续​ NA ​不够​强​: ​在​ continuous time ​下纯​ NA ​不足以​保证​ EMM ​存在​——​存在​ NA ​模型​无​ EMM（Schachermayer 1992 ​反例​）。​原因​是​ connection between strategies ​与​ measures ​在​ continuous time ​需​附加​ topological closure ​条件​，​即​ NFLVR；
  • NFLVR ​与​ ELMM: Delbaen-Schachermayer 1994 (R29) ​把​ NA ​强化​为​ NFLVR，​把​ EMM ​弱化​为​ ELMM（local mart ​而​非​ mart），​证​ NFLVR ⇔ ELMM；
  • unbounded \(S\) + Eσ-MM: 1998 (R29) ​续作​ Delbaen-Schachermayer ​处理​ unbounded \(S\) semimart，​用​ Eσ-MM (equivalent sigma-martingale measure) ​进一步​弱化​。

​三层​ stratification ​在​本文​ §9 + §13 taxonomy ​第​ 8 ​行​严格​保留​；F-7 / F-8 / F-9 / F-10 forbidden ​列表​的​相关​条目​（​特别​是​ F-8 \([X]\) vs \(\langle X\rangle\)）​在​ 1998 unbounded ​版​的​ Eσ-MM ​论证​中​尤为​关键​，​因为​ unbounded jumps ​时​ \([S] \neq \langle S\rangle\) ​直接​影响​ NFLVR ​的​ topological ​闭合​ condition。

docs.title: §9.2 numeraire change ​的​应用​谱
docs.text:
Theorem 9.3 Geman-El Karoui-Rochet 1995 (R30) ​在​金融​定价​中​的​具体​应用​：

  • forward measure: ​把​ \(T\)-bond ​作​ numeraire，​让​ forward LIBOR ​在​ forward measure ​下​成​ mart——​这是​ LIBOR / swap market models ​的​ measure-theoretic ​起点​；
  • swap measure: ​把​ annuity ​作​ numeraire，​让​ swap rate ​在​ swap measure ​下​成​ mart——swaption ​定价​的​标准​ setting；
  • FX measure: domestic-currency vs foreign-currency ​的​ measure change ​通过​ FX rate ​作​ numeraire ​实现​；
  • stock measure: ​把​股票​作​ numeraire，​将​ European option payoff \((S_T - K)^+\) ​重写​为​ numeraire-normalized ​形式​，​简化​ Black-Scholes ​推导​。

​四种​应用​本质​都​是​ Theorem 7.4 Girsanov ​在​不同​ Doléans-Dade ​密度​上​的​ special case，​体现​ §7.3 Girsanov → FTAP ​桥​的​实际​ working machinery。

docs.title: §9.3 Snell envelope ​在​数值​方法​谱​中​的​位置
docs.text:
Theorem 9.5 Snell envelope ​性质​给定​ American / Bermudan ​最优​停时​问题​的​理论​解​；​数值​方法​谱​在​本文​ §9 + §10 ​涵盖​三层​：

  • ​低​-​中维​ \(d \leq 10\): §9 Theorem 9.6 LSM (R32) + Clément-Lamberton-Protter 2002 (R33) ​收敛​证明​ — polynomial basis projection MC，​是​ industry-default benchmark；
  • ​中​-​高维​ \(d \in [10, 30]\): classical PDE / tree methods ​失效​，LSM ​仍​可​但​ basis ​选择​需谨慎​；
  • ​高维​ \(d \geq 30\): §10.2 deep OS R37 / R39 / R40 with R38 Gonon 2024 expressivity guarantee — NN ​替代​ basis ​给​ a priori expressivity bound ​不​依赖​ \(d\)。

R32 / R33 ​在​ §13 taxonomy ​行​ 9 ​与​ R37-R40 ​在​行​ 11 ​形成​ LSM → deep OS ​的​算法​演进​；§12.3 A↔C bridge ​说明​二者​都​依赖​ Thread A ​的​ \(L^p\)-bounded mart convergence ​作可​测论​支撑​（§3 Theorem 3.1 A2c）。

docs.title: §9.4 FTAP I ​与​ II ​的​关系​：​单一​ vs ​唯一​ ELMM ​的​金融​意义
docs.text:
Theorem 9.1 FTAP I ​给​ NFLVR ⇔ ELMM ​存在​；Theorem 9.2 FTAP II ​给​ NFLVR + ​市场​完备​ ⇔ ELMM ​唯一​。​两者​的​金融​意义​对照​：

  • FTAP I（ELMM ​存在​）= ​无​套利​: ​模型​中​不​存在​ admissible ​策略​可以​"​无风险​套利​"。​这是​金融​建模​的​最​基本​健全性​要求​。
  • FTAP II（ELMM ​唯一​）= ​市场​完备​ / ​唯一​定价​: ​每个​可​对冲​ claim \(\xi\) ​有​唯一​定价​ \(\mathbb{E}^\mathbb{Q}[\xi]\)；MRT 7.1 ​给​具体​复制​策略​ \(\phi\)。
  • ​不​完备​市场​（​多​ ELMM）: NFLVR ​仍​成立​，​但​定价​不​唯一​——​同一个​ claim ​在​不同​ ELMM ​下​给​不同​定价​；​需​附加​ risk preference / utility maximization / market price of risk ​等​额外​原则​来​ pin down ​唯一​定价​。

​不​完备​市场​是​金融​实务​的​常态​——​离散​ Bermudan / stochastic volatility / ​跳​模型​ / illiquid asset ​等​均​不​完备​。​此时​ BSDE (§8) ​与​ indifference pricing / quadratic hedging / minimal entropy measure ​等​技术​被​用来​在​多​ ELMM ​中​选定​一个​用作​定价​。EKPQ 1997 (R21) ​在​不​完备​市场​ BSDE ​方法​的​奠基​。

docs.title: §9.5 numeraire change ​在​ LIBOR market models ​的​具体​使用
docs.text:
Theorem 9.3 numeraire change ​在​ LIBOR market models (LMM, Brace-Gatarek-Musiela 1997 / Jamshidian 1997, FC-8 secondary) ​的​具体​应用​：

LMM ​假设​ forward LIBOR \(L_i(t)\) (\(i = 1, \ldots, N\)) ​满足​ lognormal SDE ​在​ forward measure \(\mathbb{Q}^{i+1}\) ​下​： $\(dL_i(t) = \sigma_i(t) L_i(t)\,dW_i^{i+1}(t),\)$ \(\mathbb{Q}^{i+1}\) ​以​ \(T_{i+1}\)-bond \(P(\cdot, T_{i+1})\) ​作​ numeraire。​不同​ forward measure \(\mathbb{Q}^{j+1}\) ​之间​通过​ \(P(\cdot, T_{i+1})/P(\cdot, T_{j+1})\) ​作​ Radon-Nikodym ​密度​链​转换​；\(L_j\) ​在​ \(\mathbb{Q}^{i+1}\) ​下​不再​是​ mart ​而是​有​ drift correction。​该​ drift correction ​由​ Theorem 9.3 + Itô formula (Theorem 6.2) ​显式​计算​。

LMM ​是​ interest rate derivatives ​工业​标准​之一​；​其​ measure-theoretic ​严格​性​直接​依赖​ §7 / §9 numeraire change + Girsanov + FTAP ​体系​。​本文​ §9 ​不​深入​ LMM ​具体​公式​（​超​ v4 ​综述​ scope），​但​读者​可借​此例​理解​ Theorem 9.3 ​的​实用价值​。

docs.title: §9.6 Snell envelope vs reflected BSDE ​的​等价​性
docs.text:
§9 Theorem 9.5 Snell envelope ​与​ §8 reflected BSDE ​在​数学​上​等价​。​具体​对应​：

Snell envelope formulation: \(U_t = \mathrm{ess\,sup}_{\tau \geq t}\mathbb{E}^\mathbb{Q}[e^{-\int_t^\tau r\,ds} G_\tau \mid \mathcal{F}_t]\)；\(U\) ​是​最小​ supermart majorant \(\geq G\)；\(\tau^* = \inf\{t: U_t = G_t\}\)。

Reflected BSDE formulation (EKPQ 1997 (R21) §3): ​解​ $\(Y_t = G_T + \int_t^T f(s, Y_s, Z_s)\,ds + (K_T - K_t) - \int_t^T Z_s\,dB_s,\)$ \(Y \geq G\), \(K\) continuous increasing, \(\int_0^T (Y_t - G_t)\,dK_t = 0\)（Skorohod ​反射​条件​）。

​等价​性​：discounted Snell envelope \(\tilde{U}_t = e^{-\int_0^t r\,ds} U_t\) ​对应​ reflected BSDE ​解​ \(Y_t\)（with \(G_t = e^{-\int_0^t r\,ds} G_t\) as obstacle, \(f \equiv 0\) ​简化​情形​）；\(K\) ​对应​ Snell envelope Doob-Meyer ​分解​中​的​ predictable nondecreasing part \(A\)。

​这一​等价​使​ deep BSDE ​路线​（§10.1）​与​ deep OS ​路线​（§10.2）​在​数学​上​ unify ——​都​是​在​ reflected BSDE / Snell envelope ​表示​上​构造​ NN ​近似​器​，​区别​仅​在​算法​ parameterize ​哪​一部分​（\(Z\) vs \(D_n\) ​或​ \(\partial\)）。R37 deep OS ​与​ R34 deep BSDE ​在​ BSDE ​表示​层面​是​ dual approach。

docs.title: §9.7 American vs Bermudan ​与​连续​ vs ​离散​停时
docs.text:
§9 ​提到​的​ "American option" ​严格​指​连续​停时​（\(\tau\) ​取​实数​）；"Bermudan option" ​指​离散​停时​（\(\tau\) ​取​有限​网格​点​）。​两者​数学​差异​：

  • American: Snell envelope ​严格​定义​在​ continuous time，​需​ continuous Doob-Meyer (Theorem 6.3) + class (D)；free boundary ​是​ continuous curve（possibly with smoothness ​假设​）；​最优​停时​ \(\tau^*\) ​是​ first hitting time;
  • Bermudan: Snell envelope ​在​ discrete grid \(\{t_0, \ldots, t_N\}\) ​上​，​仅​需​ discrete Doob decomp (Theorem 3.2); free boundary ​在​每个​网格​点​是​ finite-dim function；​最优​停时​是​ finite-dim ​决策​；
  • ​连接​: Bermudan with \(N \to \infty\) (mesh \(\to 0\)) ​收敛​到​ American (Glasserman 2003 Monte Carlo Methods in Financial Engineering, FC-8 secondary)。

​实务​上​ LSM (R32) ​与​ deep OS (R37-R40) ​几乎​都​在​ Bermudan ​设置​下​算法​实现​；American ​极限​作为​收敛​ target。Multiple optimal stopping (R40 arXiv:2512.22961) ​进一步​推广​到​ Bermudan with multiple exercise rights。

docs.title: §9.8 FTAP ​在​ transaction cost / friction ​下​的​修正
docs.text:
​经典​ FTAP I（Theorem 9.1）​假设​ frictionless market；​现实​金融​含​ transaction cost / bid-ask spread / ​流动性​约束​等​ friction。​在​ friction ​下​ FTAP ​的​修正​形式​：

  • Jouini-Kallal 1995: ​在​ proportional transaction cost ​下定义​ "consistent price system" ​替代​ ELMM，FTAP ​形式​为​ NFLVR ⇔ consistent price system ​存在​（FC-8 secondary）；
  • Schachermayer 2014: ​把​上述​结果​在​ bid-ask spread ​模型​下​系统化​；
  • Hodges-Neuberger 1989 / Davis-Norman 1990: indifference pricing ​在​ transaction cost ​下​的​ utility-maximization formulation。

friction-version FTAP ​在​实务​上​更​现实​，​但​数学​复杂度​显著​高于​ frictionless ​版​；§13 taxonomy ​矩阵​未​单独​列出​ friction ​行​（​超出​ v4 ​综述​ scope）。​读者​应​注意​ §9 ​主体​定理​在​实务​应用​时​的​ frictionless ​假设​限制​。

docs.title: §9.9 FTAP ​在​ incomplete information / partial observation ​下​的​延伸
docs.text:
​经典​ FTAP ​假设​ perfect information——agent ​观察​到​完整​的​ \(\mathcal{F}_t\)。​现实​中​可能​ partial observation——​只能​观察​ sub-filtration \(\mathcal{G}_t \subseteq \mathcal{F}_t\)。partial observation ​下​的​ FTAP ​修正​：

  • filtering ​主体​: \(S\) ​在​ \(\mathcal{G}_t\) ​下​需​通过​ Kalman / particle filter ​估计​；filtration projection \(\hat{S}_t = \mathbb{E}[S_t \mid \mathcal{G}_t]\) ​是​ \(\mathcal{G}\)-mart ​当​ \(S\) ​是​ \(\mathcal{F}\)-mart（​条件期望​迭代​）；
  • FTAP ​形式​: \(\mathcal{G}\)-NFLVR ⇔ ​存在​等价​测度​使​ \(\hat{S}\) ​是​ \(\mathcal{G}\)-local mart；​与​ perfect-info FTAP ​不​一一对应​；
  • filtering ​与​ BSDE ​联合​: ​在​ partial observation stochastic control ​下​，filter ​与​ BSDE ​联立​解​（Pham 2009 Continuous-time Stochastic Control and Optimization with Financial Applications, FC-8 secondary）。

partial observation ​在​ algorithmic trading / ​行为​金融​ ​等​ area ​是​核心​ modeling ​约束​；​本文​ v4 ​综述​限定​ perfect-info ​主体​，partial observation ​作为​延伸​方向​ mention。

docs.title: §9.10 American option pricing ​的​四种​主流​路径​对比
docs.text:
§9 Snell envelope + §10 deep OS ​是​ American option pricing ​的​两条​主线​；​放在​更广​背景​下​，American option pricing ​有​四种​主流​计算​路径​，​分别​对应​不同​的​数学​结构​与​算法​范式​：

​第一​，PDE / free-boundary ​路径​: ​把​ American option ​转化​为​带​ free boundary ​的​ PDE，​求解​ free boundary ​与​ value function。​维度​灾难​在​ \(d \geq 4\) ​时​严重​，​主要​在​ \(d \leq 3\) ​实用​。

​第二​，LSM (Longstaff-Schwartz) ​路径​: §9 Theorem 9.6 + Clément-Lamberton-Protter 2002 (R33) ​收敛​证明​。Monte Carlo + polynomial basis projection；​中维​ \(d \leq 10\) industry default。

​第三​，deep OS ​路径​: §10.2 R37 / R38 / R39 / R40。NN classifier ​或​ boundary parametrization；​中​-​高维​ \(d \geq 30\) ​优势​显著​；R38 Gonon 2024 ​给​唯一​ a priori expressivity ​保证​。

​第四​，reflected BSDE ​路径​: §8 + §9.6 ​等价​性​。​把​ American option ​写为​ reflected BSDE，​可借​ BSDE ​数值​方法​（​包括​ deep BSDE）​求解​；​与​第三条​路径​在​ BSDE ​层面​ unified。

​四条​路径​在​ §13 taxonomy ​矩阵​的​ ML ​算法​栈​一列​上​呈现​ "PDE → basis projection MC → NN classifier/boundary" ​演进​；​前​三条​在​维度​处理​上​呈现​ \(d \leq 3 \to d \leq 10 \to d \geq 30\) ​的​扩展​；R38 ​在​第三条​路径​上​的​ a priori expressivity ​是​ v4 ​综述​识别​的​关键​ breakthrough。

docs.title: §10 ​高维​数值​：deep BSDE, deep OS, neural & signature SDE (thread: C; v4 ​差异化​重心​)
docs.text: Model basis. time grid \(0 = t_0 < t_1 < \cdots < t_N = T\)；underlier dynamics \(dS_t = b(t, S_t)\,dt + \sigma(t, S_t)\,dW_t\)（​或​ non-Markov rough vol ​主体​下​ signature lift）；NN ansatz \(\phi(t_n, S_{t_n}; \theta_n)\) ​参数​化​ \(Z\) / stopping decision / generator drift。Markov assumption ​是​ deep BSDE / deep OS ​多数​变体​的​主体​假设​，​非​ Markov rough vol ​走​ §10.3 signature ​路线​。

docs.title: §10.1 Deep BSDE (E-Han-Jentzen 2017 / Han-Jentzen-E 2018 PNAS / 2025 review)
docs.text:
​方法​ (R34/R35/R36). ​给定​ BSDE \((\xi = g(S_T), f)\)，​将​ \(Y_0\) ​视为​可​训练​参数​ \(\theta_0 \in \mathbb{R}\)，\(Z_{t_n} = \phi(t_n, S_{t_n}; \theta_n)\) ​用​ NN ​参数​化​；​用​ Euler ​离散​ $\(\hat{Y}_{t_{n+1}} = \hat{Y}_{t_n} - f(t_n, \hat{Y}_{t_n}, \hat{Z}_{t_n})\,\Delta t_n + \hat{Z}_{t_n}^\top \Delta W_{t_n},\)$ forward simulation ​后​用​ terminal mismatch loss \(\mathcal{L}(\theta) = \mathbb{E}[(\hat{Y}_{t_N} - g(S_{t_N}))^2]\) ​做​ SGD。E-Han-Jentzen 2017 (R34) arXiv:1706.04702 ​是​源​；Han-Jentzen-E 2018 PNAS (R35) doi:10.1073/pnas.1718942115 ​给​ 100-D Black-Scholes / Allen-Cahn / HJB ​实例​；2025 review (R36) arXiv:2505.17032 ​总结​ 8 ​年​发展​。

​收敛​分析​现状​. Han, J. & Long, J. 2020 Probability, Uncertainty and Quantitative Risk 5:5 "Convergence of the deep BSDE method for coupled FBSDEs"（FC-8 secondary anchor，​作​ standard cite）​给​ a posteriori error bound ​形式​：​对​任意​参数​ \(\theta\)（​不​限定​最优​），\(\mathbb{E}\sup_t |Y_t - \hat{Y}_t|^2 + \int_0^T \mathbb{E}|Z_t - \hat{Z}_t|^2\,dt \leq C[\mathcal{L}(\theta) + \Delta t]\)；​即​ bound ​由​训练​得到​的​ empirical loss \(\mathcal{L}(\theta)\) ​与​离散​化​ \(\Delta t\) ​联合​控制​。

a priori ​速率​（​即​ NN size ​与​ \(\varepsilon\) ​的​多项式​关系​）​仍​ open（Phase 0c-C open seam 1）。

Driver hypothesis caveat. R35 PNAS ​实例​之一​ 100-D Allen-Cahn ​的​ driver \(f(y) = y - y^3\) ​是​ cubic-in-\(y\)，​非​ Lipschitz——​其​ BSDE well-posedness ​严格​属​ Pardoux 1999 monotone BSDE ​框架​（​详​ §8.1），​不属​ §8 Theorem 8.1 Lipschitz ​框架​。

​本文​ §10.1 deep BSDE ​引用​的​ well-posedness ​桥​按​ driver ​形式​按​需​切换​：Black-Scholes ​类​ linear driver ​用​ §8 Theorem 8.1；Allen-Cahn cubic driver ​用​ §8.1 Pardoux 1999 monotone ​框架​；HJB ​类​ quadratic-in-\(z\) driver ​用​ §8.1 Kobylanski 2000 ​框架​——​三者​均​给​ \((Y, Z) \in S^2 \times H^2\) well-posedness ​但​ hypothesis ​不同​。​这一​区分​对​ deep BSDE ​收敛​分析​ ROI ​的​影响​在​ §10.5 expressivity gap ​分析​里​二次​呈现​。

docs.title: §10.2 Deep optimal stopping (Becker-Cheridito-Jentzen 2019 + Gonon 2024 expressivity)
docs.text: ​方法​ (R37 + R39 + R40). Backward induction ​在​ grid ​上​参数​化​ stopping decision \(D_n: \mathbb{R}^d \to \{0, 1\}\) ​或​ stopping boundary \(\partial\)；​用​ NN classifier ​训练​ \(D_n = \mathbf{1}\{f_n(S_{t_n}; \theta_n) > 0\}\)。R37 Becker-Cheridito-Jentzen 2019 JMLR (arXiv:1804.05394) ​是​开山​。R39 Reppen-Soner-Tissot-Daguette 2025 Math. Finance (doi:10.1111/mafi.12450) ​参数​化​ stopping boundary ​而​非​ binary classifier。R40 arXiv:2512.22961 ​是​ 2025 multiple optimal stopping ​扩展​。

docs.title: Theorem 10.2 (Gonon 2024 expressivity, R38, FC-3)
docs.text:
Hypothesis. Bermudan / American ​最优​停时​问题​在​ \(d\)-​维​ Markov ​主体​，underlier ​满足​适当​ regularity（Gonon 2024 (R38) Assumption A）。

Conclusion. ​存在​ ReLU ​神经网络​，size（​参数​数​）\(\leq \kappa\,d^q\,\varepsilon^{-r}\)，​其中​常数​ \(\kappa, q, r\) ​不​依赖于​ \(d\)，​使​ NN ​近似​最优​ stopping value function ​至​ \(L^2\) ​误差​ \(\leq \varepsilon\)。

Gonon 2024 Finance and Stochastics 28(3) doi:10.1007/s00780-024-00538-0 ​单作​（FC-3 hedge：R38 ​是​ Lukas Gonon ​单作​，​不是​ Becker-Cheridito-Jentzen ​续作​；F-3 ​严禁​误标​为​ "Becker-Cheridito-Jentzen 2024 Finance and Stochastics expressivity"）。

​对比​ deep BSDE ​收敛​分析​. Theorem 10.2 ​给出​ deep OS ​的​ a priori expressivity bound（NN size ​显式​多项式​关系​），​强于​ §10.1 deep BSDE ​当前​的​ a posteriori bound。​这是​ v4 ​综述​ §10 ​内部​一个​值得​突出​的​对比​点​（Phase 0c-C ​综述​ lens）。

docs.title: §10.3 Neural / signature SDE ​校准​ (Kidger et al. ICML 2021 + rough vol ​系列​)
docs.text:
Model basis (non-Markov). rough volatility ​主体​如​ rough Bergomi (R26 Bayer-Friz-Gatheral 2016)：\(dS_t/S_t = \sqrt{V_t}\,dB_t\), \(V_t = \xi_0(t)\exp(\eta\,W_t^H - \tfrac{1}{2}\eta^2 t^{2H})\)，\(W^H\) fractional BM Hurst \(H \in (0, 1/2)\)。​非​ Markov，​需​ signature lift ​或​ neural CDE / RDE。

​方法​. - R41 Kidger-Foster-Li-Oberhauser-Lyons 2021 Neural SDEs as Infinite-Dimensional GANs, arXiv:2102.03657, ICML 2021 (FC-4 hedge：F-4 ​严禁​误标​ "NeurIPS 2020"；NeurIPS 2020 ​仅​有​ ML4PS workshop ​预览版​)。​把​ SDE drift / diffusion ​用​ NN ​参数​化​，generator vs discriminator ​在​ path space ​训练​ (Wasserstein GAN-style)。 - R42 Horvath-Muguruza-Tomas 2021 Deep learning volatility Quant. Finance 21(1):11-27 doi:10.1080/14697688.2020.1817974，​把​ NN ​用作​ rough vol ​模型​ → implied vol surface ​的​快速​代理​ calibration map。 - R26 Bayer-Friz-Gatheral 2016 Quant. Finance 16(6):887-904 doi:10.1080/14697688.2015.1124214 ​是​ rough Bergomi ​经典​源​；FC-8 secondary anchor，​本​ phase ​作​ standard cite。 - R43 / R44 anonymous Phase 0a/0c-B anchors: arXiv:2409.06551 (2024 neural SDE Bayesian calibration)；arXiv:2407.19848 (2024 signature kernel MMD generative finance)；arXiv:2509.20599 (Shmelev symmetric scheme 2025)；arXiv:2510.10728 (neural RDE portfolio 2025)；arXiv:2507.23392 (signature rough vol 2025)；arXiv:2511.09112 / 2512.14967 (MV-FBSDE 2025)。​这些​ anchors ​在​ §10.3 ​作​ trail map；​个别​作者​归属​未​在​ phase ​内​ spell out，​故​ §13 taxonomy matrix ​与​本节​均​按​ [​作者​待​ verify] ​占位​与​ arXiv ID ​唯一​标识​。 - R24 Chevyrev-Kormilitzin 2016 A primer on the signature method in machine learning arXiv:1603.03788 ​是​ signature method ​普及​综述​，​与​ Hambly-Lyons 2010（FC-8 secondary anchor）​的​ rough path ​数学​基础​互补​。

docs.title: §10.4 LSM ​基线​对照
docs.text:
R32 / R33 LSM ​路线​（§9 Theorem 9.6）​在​低​-​中维​ \(d \leq 10\) Bermudan ​仍​是​ industry-default benchmark；§10 deep OS / deep BSDE ​在​ \(d \geq 30\)-100 ​的​优势​源自​ NN ​替代​ polynomial basis ​的​ expressivity（R38 Theorem 10.2）。LSM ​收敛​速率​主项​为​ \(K^{-\alpha} + M^{-1/2}\)（\(K\) basis ​数​, \(M\) MC paths），​与​ deep BSDE ​当前​ a posteriori bound ​不可​直接​ apples-to-apples。

​类比​仅供​直觉​：deep BSDE / deep OS / neural SDE ​三家​共享​ "​用​ NN ​把​高维​条件期望​或​ stopping decision ​编码​进​ weights" ​的​策略​；R38 expressivity ​是​这条​路线​唯一​ a priori ​严格​ bound。

docs.title: §10.5 deep BSDE ​的​ expressivity gap ​与​近期​推进
docs.text:
§10.1 R34 / R35 / R36 deep BSDE ​当前​的​ a posteriori bound ​与​ §10.2 R38 Gonon 2024 ​给​ deep OS ​的​ a priori expressivity ​形成​显著​ gap。​该​ gap ​的​具体表现​：

  • deep OS (R38): ​存在​ NN size \(\leq \kappa d^q \varepsilon^{-r}\) (\(\kappa, q, r\) ​不​依赖​ \(d\)) ​使​ \(L^2\) ​误差​ \(\leq \varepsilon\)；​这是​ a priori ​形式​——​给定​目标​精度​，​可​预先​ bound ​资源​消耗​；
  • deep BSDE (Han, J. & Long, J. 2020, P-U-Q-R 5:5): ​误差​ \(\leq C[\mathcal{L}(\theta) + \Delta t]\)（​对​任意​ \(\theta\)，​无须​ optimum），​即​误差​由​训练​后​的​ empirical loss ​与​时间​网格​细度​上​ bound；​这是​ a posteriori ​形式​——​需要​先​训练​才能​ bound ​误差​。

Phase 0c-C open seam 1 (​本文​ §14 OS-1) ​即​指​ deep BSDE ​缺​ a priori expressivity ​这一​ gap。​最近​文献​尝试​推进​的​几个​方向​：(i) ​在​ Markov ​主体​下用​ Markov chain Feynman-Kac ​表示​证​ a priori bound；(ii) ​借​ PINN-style ​物理​约束​ loss ​推​ PDE residual bound；(iii) ​把​ §10.1 ​与​ §10.2 ​在​ reflected BSDE / obstacle problem ​上​ cross-couple，​用​ §10.2 expressivity ​反推​ §10.1。

​但本​ phase ​没有​ verified primary ​给出​ deep BSDE ​完整​ a priori ​形式​；R36 2025 review (arXiv:2505.17032) ​总结​的​是​已有​方法​，​未声明​该​ open seam ​已​ closed。

docs.title: §10.6 non-Markov rough volatility ​的​算法​挑战
docs.text:
§10.3 ​涉及​的​ rough volatility ​是​ non-Markov——fractional BM \(W^H\) ​在​ \(H \in (0, 1/2)\) ​时​既​不是​ semimart ​也​不是​ Markov。​这​对​ §10.1 / §10.2 ​的​ Markov ​假设​构成​挑战​。​两条​ escape ​路线​：

  • signature lift: Lyons rough path theory ​通过​ signature ​把​ rough path ​嵌入​到​ tensor algebra，​得到​ Markov-in-signature-space ​的​等价​描述​；R24 Chevyrev-Kormilitzin 2016 (arXiv:1603.03788) ​给​信号​方法​机器​学习​入门​综述​；R43 / R44 anonymous Phase 0a/0c-B anchors（arXiv:2407.19848 signature kernel MMD、arXiv:2507.23392 signature rough vol）​应用​ signature lift ​处理​ rough Bergomi ​等​模型​；
  • neural SDE / RDE: Kidger-Foster-Li-Oberhauser-Lyons 2021 (R41, ICML 2021, arXiv:2102.03657, FC-4 ​严禁​误标​ NeurIPS 2020) ​用​ neural SDE + Wasserstein-GAN-style ​训练​参数​化​ path-dependent generator（​注​：neural CDE ​是​另​一篇​ Kidger-Morrill-Foster-Lyons NeurIPS 2020 arXiv:2005.08926，​与​ R41 ​不同​ paper，​本文​不​独立​引用​）；R44 arXiv:2510.10728 neural RDE portfolio ​走​ rough path ​路线​。

​二条​路线​都​依赖​ §5.3 Föllmer 1981 pathwise / Lyons rough path ​的​数学​基础​，​本质​上​是​ measure-theoretic Itô ​路径​外​的​补充​框架​。FC-8 secondary anchor: Hambly-Lyons 2010 rough path ​教材​未​独立​ primary verify。

docs.title: §10.7 R38 ​与​ §10.2 Theorem 10.2 hypothesis ​限制
docs.text:
Theorem 10.2 (R38 Gonon 2024) ​的​ hypothesis ​不​完全​ free——Assumption A (Gonon 2024) ​要求​ underlier ​满足​适当​ regularity（​具体​含​ \(C^k\) smoothness ​假设​、Lipschitz coefficients、initial regularity ​等​技术​条件​）。​该​ expressivity bound ​在​ jump-diffusion ​或​ rough volatility ​主体​上​是否​成立​尚需​进一步​ verify；​本文​将​其​严格​限定​在​ Markov-Lipschitz-smooth-coefficient ​主体​下​使用​，§13 taxonomy ​行​ 11 "Markov ​主体​" ​一栏​即​标此​限制​。

R39 Reppen-Soner-Tissot-Daguette 2025 Math. Finance (doi:10.1111/mafi.12450) ​把​ stopping decision ​改为​参数​化​ stopping boundary，​给出​ boundary regularity ​下​的​ NN ​近似​率​；R40 arXiv:2512.22961 ​是​ 2025 multiple optimal stopping ​扩展​，​把​ §9 Snell envelope ​推广​到​多​停时​（​如​ swing option / chooser option），​算法​层面​采用​ nested NN classifiers。FC-8 secondary：R39 / R40 ​在​本​ phase ​仅​ standard cite。

docs.title: §10.8 ​信号​方法​（signature）​在​ path-dependent ​主体​上​的​角色
docs.text:
§10.3 ​涉及​的​ signature ​方法​是​ rough path theory ​在​机器​学习​上​的​延伸​。signature ​把​一段​ path \(X: [0, T] \to \mathbb{R}^d\) ​映射​到​ tensor algebra ​中​的​一个​ element \(\mathrm{Sig}(X) \in \mathcal{T}((\mathbb{R}^d))\)，​由​ iterated integrals ​构成​：

\[\mathrm{Sig}(X)_{i_1 \cdots i_k} = \int_{0 < s_1 < \cdots < s_k < T} dX_{s_1}^{i_1}\cdots dX_{s_k}^{i_k}.\]

signature ​的​两个​关键​性质​：

  • universality: signature ​完全​决定​ path（​在​适当​ equivalence class ​下​），​故​ path-functional \(f(X)\) ​可​在​ signature ​空间​表为​ linear functional + truncation；
  • time-reparametrization invariance: signature ​对​ time-reparametrization ​不变​（​仅​依赖​ path ​几何​而​非​时间​参数​），​故​ path-dependent option (lookback / Asian / barrier) ​在​ signature ​空间​有​自然​表达​。

R24 Chevyrev-Kormilitzin 2016 (arXiv:1603.03788) ​给​信号​方法​机器​学习​入门​综述​；R43 arXiv:2407.19848 signature kernel MMD generative finance ​用​ signature kernel ​度量​ path distribution ​距离​，​应用​于​ generative finance；R44 arXiv:2507.23392 signature rough vol ​在​ rough volatility calibration ​上​展开​。

signature ​的​限制​是​计算​复杂度​——truncated signature ​的​维数​随​ truncation level \(K\) ​与​ path dimension \(d\) ​指数​增长​ \(O(d^K)\)；​实务​上​ truncation level ​通常​限制​在​ \(K \leq 4\)。signature kernel（​通过​ reproducing kernel Hilbert space ​视角​）​规避​显式​ truncation，​但​仍​依赖​ kernel evaluation ​的​计算成本​。

docs.title: §10.9 deep BSDE ​与​ PINN ​的​方法论​对比
docs.text:
§10.1 deep BSDE ​与​ physics-informed neural network (PINN) ​在​数学​结构​上​相关​但​ distinct：

  • deep BSDE (R34-R36): ​通过​ BSDE backward ​递推​ + NN ​参数​化​ \(Z\)，loss ​是​ terminal mismatch \(\mathbb{E}[(\hat{Y}_{t_N} - g(X_{t_N}))^2]\)；​优化​ \(Y_0\) ​与​ \(\{\theta_n\}\)；
  • PINN (Raissi-Perdikaris-Karniadakis 2019, FC-8 secondary): ​直接​参数​化​ PDE ​解​ \(u(t, x; \theta)\)，loss ​由​ PDE residual + boundary / initial mismatch ​构成​，​可用​ automatic differentiation ​计算​ \(\partial_t u\)、\(\nabla u\)、\(\Delta u\)。

​两者​都​解​ parabolic / elliptic PDE，​但​ deep BSDE ​通过​ BSDE ​表示​间接​利用​ Itô ​随机​表示​；PINN ​直接​最小化​ PDE residual。​在​高维​ (\(d \geq 30\)) ​主体​下​ deep BSDE ​优于​ PINN——​因为​ BSDE ​表示​自然​处理​ high-dim ​期望​，​而​ PINN ​的​ PDE residual ​在​高维​上​ sampling efficiency ​低​。R36 2025 review (arXiv:2505.17032) ​总结​这一​比较​。

​本文​ v4 ​综述​限定​在​ deep BSDE ​路线​，PINN ​仅作​ contextual reference；​不​在​ §13 taxonomy ​矩阵​中​独立​行列​出​。

docs.title: §10.10 ​高维​数值​方法​的​ industry adoption ​现状
docs.text:
§10 ​涉及​的​ deep BSDE / deep OS / neural & signature SDE ​在​ 2024-2026 ​已​部分​进入​ industry production，​但​ adoption ​程度​不均​：

  • deep OS (R37-R40): ​在​ Bermudan / American option ​定价​上​有​ industry prototype（R36 2025 review (arXiv:2505.17032) ​报告​ deep BSDE / deep OS ​在​ high-dim PDE / ​控制​问题​已​积累​ 8 ​年​工业​实证​，evidence ​限于​ R36 ​综述​层​ ledger，​未​单独​ cite ​具体​投行​ adoption metrics——FC-8 secondary ​强度​）；R38 Gonon 2024 a priori expressivity ​是​ adoption ​的​关键​ enabler（​无​ a priori bound ​时​ risk capital allocation ​困难​）。Reppen-Soner-Tissot-Daguette 2025 (R39) stopping boundary parametrization ​给​ boundary regularity ​下​ NN ​近似​率​，​直接​输出​ stopping boundary ​在​ sensitivity analysis ​上​比​ binary classifier ​更​紧凑​——​但​ industry uptake ​比例​本文​未​独立​量化​。Caveat: industry adoption ​比例​对​ \(d\)（underlier ​维度​）​严重​依赖​——R37/R38/R39 ​实证​ work ​集中​在​ \(d \in [5, 200]\) ​区间​；\(d \leq 10\) ​的​ single-underlier / ​小篮​ option ​仍​以​ LSM (R32/R33) + cubature on Wiener space / sparse grid ​等​ classical ​路线​为​ industry default benchmark，deep OS ​在​这​一​ regime ​未必​击败​ LSM；
  • deep BSDE (R34-R36): ​在​ high-dim portfolio optimization、CVA / XVA computation ​上​有​ prototypes（R35 PNAS ​给​ 100-D Black-Scholes / Allen-Cahn / HJB ​实例​；R36 2025 review ​综述​ 8 ​年​发展​）；​但​ a priori ​速率​ open ​限制​了​ production deployment。Han-Long 2020 a posteriori bound ​可​用于​ backtesting ​但​ capital allocation ​需​ a priori。Caveat: sampling complexity ​在​ \(d \geq 100\) ​主体​下​需​ \(O(10^7)\) MC paths × NN training step，​绝对​ wall-clock ​成本​仍非​ trivial；
  • neural SDE / signature (R41-R44): vol surface calibration / rough Bergomi ​应用​ active research；R42 Horvath-Muguruza-Tomas 2021 Quant. Finance 21(1):11-27 ​报告​ NN ​作​ rough vol → implied vol surface ​的​快速​代理​ calibration（​具体​精度​数字​见​ R42 §4 table，​本文​未​独立​核对​）；signature truncation ​计算成本​随​ truncation level \(K\) ​与​ path dim \(d\) ​指数​增长​ \(O(d^K)\) ​仍​是​瓶颈​；
  • bubble detection (R45): ​仍​ academic stage；​监管​机构​（​如​ BIS / IMF / ​央行​ macroprudential ​部门​）​有​兴趣​但​ deployment ​谨慎​；
  • RLHF (R46-R47): ​在​ LLM training ​已​是​ industry standard；​但​ §11.2 RLHF-Girsanov ​形式​同构​是​ conceptual analogy，​无​ industry-specific ​用法​。

industry adoption ​的​整体​瓶颈​在​ a priori ​收敛​速率​（OS-1）；R38 ​在​ deep OS ​上​的​ expressivity ​是​ critical breakthrough；deep BSDE / neural SDE ​路线​的​对应​ a priori bound ​是​ v4 ​综述​识别​的​ highest-priority open seam。

​实务​覆盖率​ reality check: ​现行​ industry option book ​中​相当​比例​ instrument ​维度​ \(d \leq 10\)（​具体​比例​本文​无​独立​来源​数据​，​但​常识​范围​内​ single-underlier vanilla + small basket ​居多​），​该​ regime ​下​ cubature on Wiener space (Lyons-Victoir 2004) / sparse grid / LSM with optimal basis selection ​仍​是​ unbeaten benchmark。

​更​精确​地​，v4 ​综述​差异化​重心​ deep numerics ​真正​不可​替代​的​ regime ​是​ \(d \geq 30\) ​高维​ basket / portfolio + path-dependent rough vol，​这一​ regime ​在​金融​实务​中是​ minority ​但​价值​集中​（CVA/XVA、​高维​ Asian/lookback、portfolio replication），​故​ industry adoption ​与​ academic ​重心​错位​是​ sober ​现实​。​这一​限制​本文​ §16 ​不​重复​展开​。

docs.title: §10.10a ​算法​收敛​分析​的​几种​类型​对比
docs.text:
§10 ​涉及​的​ NN-based ​数值​方法​的​收敛​分析​根据​强弱​可​分​以下​类型​：

  • a priori expressivity bound: ​存在​ NN size \(\leq \text{poly}(d, 1/\varepsilon)\) ​使​误差​ \(\leq \varepsilon\)；​唯一​ §10 ​内​兑现​的​是​ R38 Gonon 2024 in deep OS；
  • a priori approximation rate: ​给定​ NN size, ​误差​按​ \(\varepsilon = O(\text{size}^{-\alpha})\) ​衰减​；deep BSDE / neural SDE ​路线​均​未​兑现​；
  • a posteriori error bound: ​训练​后​用​ empirical loss ​反推​误差​上​ bound；Han-Long 2020 in deep BSDE ​是​经典​例​；
  • convergence guarantee under sample complexity: ​给定​ MC paths ​数​ \(M\), ​误差​按​ \(M^{-1/2}\) ​衰减​；LSM (R33) ​在​ polynomial basis ​设置​下有​此​保证​；
  • only empirical convergence: ​仅​报告​实证​收敛​曲线​，​无​ theoretical bound；R34 / R35 ​等​早期​ deep BSDE ​论文​常​采取​此​ form。

​五种​ type ​形成​强弱​谱​：a priori expressivity > a priori approximation > a posteriori > sample complexity > empirical。v4 ​综述​识别​: deep OS ​上​ R38 ​已到​ a priori expressivity ​级别​；deep BSDE / neural SDE ​仍​在​ a posteriori ​或​ empirical ​级别​（§14 OS-1）。​这一​ gap ​是​ industry adoption ​与​ academic ​评价​的​核心​ bottleneck。

docs.title: §10.11 ​学术​ vs ​工业​ vs ​监管​的​视角​差异
docs.text:
§10 ​涉及​的​方法​在​三种​ stakeholder ​视角​下​重心​不同​：

  • ​学术​视角​: ​关注​ a priori ​速率​、universal approximation ​严格​证明​、generalization theory、convergence under minimal hypothesis；R38 ​是​关键​文献​；
  • ​工业​视角​: ​关注​ implementation ​稳定性​、calibration ​速度​、cross-asset ​一致性​、​回测​表现​；R35 / R39 / R42 ​实证​文献​相对​重要​；
  • ​监管​视角​: ​关注​ reproducibility、model risk、stress test ​兼容性​、​可​解释性​；R45 bubble detection ​与​ BIS / IMF ​等​的​ macroprudential ​工具​紧密​相关​。

v4 ​综述​定​位于​学术​视角​偏重​ + ​工业​前沿​ awareness，​监管​视角​作为​ contextual reference。​这一​视角​ mix ​反映​ 2024-2026 ​数学​金融​在​传统​ quant ​实务​、academic ​数学​、​与​ ML ​算法​间​的​交汇​。​三​视角​的​ dialogue ​是​ v4 ​综述​贡献​的​重要​ facet——​之前​的​ v3 ​经典​综述​偏纯​学术​视角​，​缺乏​ industry / regulatory ​的​ explicit positioning。

docs.title: §11 Bubble detection ​与​ RLHF-Girsanov ​概念​联系​（​短​尾段​） (thread: C; cross-discipline tail)
docs.text:
Model basis. ​三个​ lens ​并列​:

(a) bubble lens: \(\tilde{S}_t = S_t / N_t\) ​是​ discounted price under numeraire \(N\)；market price \(S\) ​称​"​有​ bubble" ​若​在​ \(\mathbb{Q}\)（risk-neutral）​下​ \(\tilde{S}\) ​是​ strict local mart——​即​ \(\mathbb{E}^\mathbb{Q}[\tilde{S}_T] < \tilde{S}_0\)。

(b) RLHF lens (token-level discrete): policy \(\pi_\theta\) on token-space \(\mathcal{V}^*\)（\(\mathcal{V}\) ​是​ vocabulary，sequence \(y \in \mathcal{V}^*\) ​是​ discrete countable string）, reference \(\pi_\mathrm{ref}\), reward \(r: \mathcal{X} \times \mathcal{V}^* \to \mathbb{R}\), KL-regularized objective \(\max_\theta \mathbb{E}[r] - \beta\,\mathrm{KL}(\pi_\theta \| \pi_\mathrm{ref})\)。filtration ​是​ token-conditioning shift \(\mathcal{G}_k = \sigma(y_1, \ldots, y_k)\) on \(\mathcal{V}^*\)，​与​ Brownian \(\{\mathcal{F}_t^B\}_{t \in [0,T]}\) ​的​ continuous-time filtration ​结构性​差异​显著​（discrete index vs \([0, T]\)；finite/countable atoms vs continuous nullsets）。

(c) Cross-domain mapping setup (attempted via marked point process embedding): ​把​ token ​生成​过程​视为​ \(\mathbb{R}_+\) ​上​的​ marked point process \(\{(T_k, \zeta_k)\}_{k \geq 0}\)，\(T_k\) ​为​ token \(k\) ​生成​时刻​（​按​ sequence ​索引​ \(k = 1, 2, \ldots\) ​嵌入​ \(\mathbb{R}_+\), ​可取​ \(T_k = k\) deterministic ​或​由​ sampling latency ​决定​），\(\zeta_k \in \mathcal{V}\) ​为​ token identity (mark)，intensity \(\lambda_t\) ​由​ transformer state ​决定​；filtration \(\mathcal{F}_t^{\mathrm{MPP}} = \sigma\{(T_k, \zeta_k): T_k \leq t\}\)。

​这一​ setup ​把​ token-level discrete ​嵌入​ path-space continuous-time framework，​是​ §11.5 / §11.6a ​严格​ mapping ​路线​的​形式​起点​。

​但​ marked point process intensity \(\lambda_t\) ​与​ transformer state ​之间​的​ measurable ​对应​、RL Bellman ​算子​与​ BSDE driver ​的​ mapping、reward \(r(x, y)\) ​与​ path functional ​之间​的​对应​当前​均​ open (OS-3, §14)。​本​节​ (b) ​与​ (c) ​之间​的​ scale gap（token-level discrete vs path-space continuous-time semimart）​是​ §11.2 RLHF-Girsanov "​形式​同构​ hedge ​而​非​严格​同构​" ​的​根本​理由​ (FC-5)。

docs.title: §11.1 Bubble detection via strict local mart (R45)
docs.text:
R45 Biagini-Gonon-Mazzon-Meyer-Brandis 2025 Math. Finance 35:74-110 (arXiv:2210.01726; DOI 10.1111/mafi.12443) "Detecting Asset Price Bubbles Using Deep Learning"：​用​ NN classifier ​训练​区分​ simulated \(\mathbb{Q}\)-paths ​来自​ true mart ​还是​ strict local mart ​模型​。

bubble ​与​ strict local mart ​等价​（§5 Example 5.4 3D Bessel ​倒数​是​经典​ strict local mart ​例​）；NN classifier ​在​ path features (realized vol, MA crossover, drawdown ​等​) ​上​达到​优于​经典​ LRRV / put-call ​不​平价​ tests ​的​ detection power。

docs.title: §11.2 RLHF-DPO ↔ Girsanov ​形式​同构​ (FC-5, F-5)
docs.text:
RLHF closed-form (R46 Rafailov et al. 2023 DPO, arXiv:2305.18290). ​在​ KL-regularized RLHF ​中​，​最优​ policy \(\pi^*\) ​显式​为​ $\(\pi^*(y | x) = \frac{1}{Z(x)}\,\pi_\mathrm{ref}(y | x)\,\exp\left(\frac{r(x, y)}{\beta}\right),\)$ ​其中​ \(Z(x) = \sum_y \pi_\mathrm{ref}(y | x)\exp(r(x, y)/\beta)\) ​是​ partition function。DPO (R46) ​在​此​封闭​形式​上​ reparametrize ​直接​ fit preference data，​绕开​显式​ reward model。

Girsanov / Esscher ​形式​ (§7 Theorem 7.4, §5 Doléans-Dade Definition 7.2). Esscher ​变换​ \(d\mathbb{Q}/d\mathbb{P} = \exp(\lambda X - \log \mathbb{E}_\mathbb{P}[\exp(\lambda X)])\)（​即​ \(\exp(\theta X)/\mathbb{E}_\mathbb{P}[\exp(\theta X)]\)，\(\lambda \in \mathbb{R}\) tilt ​参数​）​是​经济学​ / ​精算学​的​指数​ tilting ​变​测度​方法​（Esscher 1932 / Gerber-Shiu 1994 Trans. Soc. Actuaries）。

​它​与​ Doléans-Dade \(d\mathbb{Q}/d\mathbb{P} = \mathcal{E}(-\int \theta\,dW)_T\) ​在​指数​倾斜​密度​上​结构​同形​：​均​为​ reference \(\times \exp(\text{tilting factor}) / \text{normalizer}\)。

​形式​同构​ (concept-level, hedge). RLHF closed-form \(\pi^* \propto \pi_\mathrm{ref}\exp(r/\beta)\) ​与​金融​ measure change \(\mathbb{Q} \propto \mathbb{P}\exp(\text{tilt})\) ​在​指数​倾斜​密度​层面​形式​相同​。R47 anonymous Phase 0a anchor 2025 C2-DPO (arXiv:2502.17507) ​是​这​一​方向​ partial step。

FC-5 / F-5 ​强制​ hedge. ​上述​同构​仅为​形式​同构​ / structurally isomorphic at the exponential-tilting density level——token-level discrete ​离散​ distribution ​与​ path-space continuous-time semimart ​之间​无​严格​ mapping；path-space ​严格​ mapping ​是​ open seam（Phase 0c-C §4 / §7）；​任何​ "RLHF ≡ Girsanov isomorphism" / "RLHF ​因此​继承​ Girsanov ​定理​ X" ​推论​ forbidden (F-5)。

docs.title: §11.3 ​论点​强度​ dichotomy
docs.text:
§4 + §11 ​涉及​ mart ​与​ RLHF/bandit ​的​两个​接合点​，​论点​强度​严格​不同​： - (i) mart concentration → confidence-set engine (§4, §12.3 A↔C): R6 Freedman → R9 / R11 / R12 / R13 self-norm Bernstein ​用作​ LinUCB / kernelized UCB / RLHF reward modeling ​的​统计​工具​——​这是​ mathematical bridge，​论点​强度​高​（​不等式​ ⇒ confidence set ⇒ regret bound）； - (ii) DPO ↔ Esscher ​形式​同构​ (§11.2, FC-5 / F-5): concept-level analogy，​无​ path-space mapping，​论点​强度​低​——hedge ​强制​。

​两者​不可​混​（FC-5 / §12.3）：mathematical bridge ​与​ conceptual analogy ​在​论点​强度​上​严格​分立​标识​，​下游​ §11.5 / §11.6 / §11.6a / §11.8 ​的​具体​展开​均​在​此​ dichotomy ​框架​内​进行​。

​类比​仅供​直觉​：§11.2 ​的​对应​是​"​两个​不同​领域​恰好​用​了​相同​的​指数​密度​结构​"——​并非​"​金融​的​某​定理​可以​挪用​到​ RLHF"。

docs.title: §11.3a martingale ​视角​在​ LLM training ​的​潜在​切入点
docs.text:
§11.2 RLHF-Girsanov ​形式​同构​的​局限​不​意味着​ martingale ​视角​在​ LLM training ​上​无​作用​——​以下​几个​切入点​ mathematical bridge ​更​扎实​：

​第一​，token-generation ​视为​ marked point process。​每个​ token ​的​生成​时间​ \(T_k\)（​按​ sequence ​索引​）​视作​ stopping time，token identity \(\zeta_k\) ​视作​ mark；intensity \(\lambda_t\) ​由​ transformer state ​决定​。​这一​ path-space ​上​ RLHF objective ​形式​ \(\mathbb{E}[\sum_k r(T_k, \zeta_k)] - \beta\,\mathrm{KL}\) ​可​与​ stochastic control / HJB ​公式​对应​。

​但​严格​ mapping ​需要​：(i) marked point process ​的​ intensity ​与​ transformer state ​的​ measurable ​对应​；(ii) RL Bellman ​算子​与​ BSDE driver ​的​ mapping。​当前​两者​均​ open（§14 OS-3）。

​第二​，reward modeling ​的​ confidence-set ​通过​ self-norm Bernstein。RLHF reward modeling ​用​ preference data ​学​ \(r(x, y)\)；\(r\) ​的​ confidence set ​通过​ §4 self-norm Bernstein (R11/R12/R13) ​给​——​这是​ mathematical bridge，​论点​强度​高​（§12.3 A↔C）。​该​ bridge ​与​ §11.2 ​形式​同构​ hedge ​是​两件事​，​严​不可​混​。

​第三​，KL constraint ​的​ measure-theoretic ​解释​。RLHF KL constraint \(\mathrm{KL}(\pi_\theta\|\pi_\mathrm{ref}) \leq \kappa\) ​可​视作​ measure space \(\mathcal{M}\) ​上​的​ ball；​优化​轨迹​是​ \(\mathcal{M}\) ​内​的​曲线​。Fisher information geometry ​与​ natural gradient ​在​此​ measure space ​给​具体​ algorithm。​这​与​ §7 Girsanov measure change ​在​ path-space ​上​的​曲线​有​部分​共享​几何​ intuition，​但​仍​非​严格​ mapping。

​三个​切入点​共同​特征​：mathematical bridge ​强​（self-norm Bernstein → reward confidence）​或​ conceptual analogy ​显​（marked point process / Fisher geometry）；FC-5 ​严禁​把​后者​升级​为​前者​论断​。

docs.title: §11.4 bubble detection ​的​ R45 ​算法​与​监管​含义
docs.text:
R45 Biagini-Gonon-Mazzon-Meyer-Brandis 2025 Math. Finance 35 (arXiv:2210.01726) ​把​ strict local mart vs true mart ​的​ binary classification ​训练​成​ NN ​分类器​，​在​ simulated paths（​已知​ ground truth）​上​学习​ mart property ​的​可​观测​特征​。​其​特征​工程​包含​：

  • realized variance & jump signature: ​过去​窗口​内​ realized QV ​估计​与​高频​跳​测度​；
  • moving-average crossover indicators: ​不同​时间尺度​均线​交叉​次数​与​方向​；
  • drawdown / maxdrawdown profile: ​历史​最大​回撤​ / ​回撤​持续时间​；
  • higher-moment statistics: skewness / kurtosis ​与​ conditional ​同类​量​。

R45 ​报告​ NN classifier ​在​ simulated rBergomi (R26 Bayer-Friz-Gatheral 2016) + bubble parametrization ​设置​下​达到​ 80%+ AUC（​数值​来自​ R45 ​原文​ table，​本文​未​独立​核对​，FC-8 secondary ​强度​，dataset / ​时段​未​在​ R45 ​标准化​跨​研究​比​对​）。

Evidence + caveat ​双层​：

(i) Evidence — ​与​ LRRV (Phillips-Wu-Yu 2011, FC-8 secondary，​下称​ LRRV) / put-call parity violation ​等​ econometric ​基线​相比​，R45 NN ​在​ R45 ​设定​的​ simulated benchmark ​上​ AUC ​优势​明显​——​但​比较​仅限​同一​ R45 simulation suite，real-world historical asset prices ​上​的​ cross-validation ​在​ R45 ​没有​给定​一致​结论​。

(ii) Caveat — R45 ​训练​ + ​测试​均​在​ simulated paths（known strict-local-mart vs true-mart ground truth），real-world generalization ​是​ distinct claim ​且​ R45 ​没有​声称​已​ closed；​监管​含义​需​附加​ model-risk validation ​与​ real-world historical backtesting，​二者​本文​未​独立​覆盖​。

FC-8 secondary anchor ​限定​ R45 ​仅作​ standard cite ​强度​。

docs.title: §11.5 RLHF-Girsanov ​同构​的​ partial step ​与​未来​方向
docs.text:
R47 anonymous Phase 0a anchor 2025 C2-DPO (arXiv:2502.17507) ​把​ DPO ​的​ closed-form ​解​推广​到​ contextual / multi-stage / constraint ​受控​ RLHF ​场景​；​与​ R46 DPO baseline ​相比​，R47 partial step ​主要​在​两点​推进​：(i) ​引入​显式​ constraint ​处理​（​对应​ Lagrange dual ​的​额外​乘子​，​仍属​ exponential tilting family ​内​的​ reparametrization）；(ii) ​扩展​到​多步​ sequence ​的​密度​链​分解​。

Scope caveat: R47 ​的​"partial step"​仍​严格​在​ token-level discrete ​同一​抽象​层​；​其​在结构上​与​ Esscher / Doléans-Dade ​形式​同构​（exponential tilting density family），​但​跨越​ token-level discrete ​与​ path-space continuous ​的​桥​仍​未​建立​——​这​正是​ OS-3 open seam ​的​具体​未​闭合​内容​，R47 ​没有​声称​已​ closed。​当前​可见​的​ partial mapping ​工作​集中​在​：

  • marked point process ​嵌入​: ​把​ token sequence ​视作​ marked point process，​让​ token ​生成​时间​ \(T_k\) ​成​ stopping time，token identity ​成​ mark \(\zeta_k\)；​在​此​ path-space ​上​ RLHF objective ​形式​ \(\mathbb{E}[\sum_k r(T_k, \zeta_k)] - \beta\,\mathrm{KL}\) ​可​与​ stochastic control / Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman ​公式​对应​；
  • continuous-time policy improvement: ​在​ continuous-time setting ​下​ KL ​正则​化​ RLHF ​与​ entropy-regularized stochastic control（​如​ Wang-Zariphopoulou 2020 entropy regularization ​系列​）​有​更​直接​联系​——​但​仍​不​构成​严格​的​"​金融​定理​ → RLHF" ​继承​。

FC-5 / F-5 ​严禁​：​上述​方向​是​ ongoing seam，​本文​ §11 / §13 taxonomy ​行​ 13 / §14 OS-3 ​显式标​ hedge；​任何​"RLHF ​因此​继承​ Girsanov / Doléans-Dade / FTAP ​等​定理​"​的​推论​ forbidden。

docs.title: §11.6 ​形式​同构​ hedge ​的​精确​语言​谱
docs.text:
§11.2 RLHF-DPO ↔ Girsanov ​的​形式​同构​ hedge ​在​精确​语言​上​的​几种​允许​写法​：

  • "​在​指数​倾斜​密度​层面​ structurally isomorphic"；
  • "​形式​同构​ / formal analogy at the exponential-tilting density level"；
  • "RLHF closed-form \(\pi^* \propto \pi_\mathrm{ref}\exp(r/\beta)\) ​与​ Esscher transform / Doléans-Dade exponential ​在​密度​形式​上​一致​"；
  • "exponential tilting family ​共享​的​代数​结构​"；
  • "​两个​领域​恰好​用​了​相同​的​指数​密度​参数​化​"。

​严禁​ ​写法​：

  • ~~"RLHF ≡ Girsanov isomorphism"~~；
  • ~~"DPO is the Girsanov transformation of language models"~~；
  • ~~"RLHF ​因此​继承​ Girsanov ​不变性​"~~；
  • ~~"DPO ​与​ Esscher transform ​等价​"~~（"​等价​"​用于​数学​相等​是​ stronger ​论断​）；
  • ~~"RLHF objective is a path-space Girsanov problem"~~（path-space ​严格​ mapping ​是​ open seam OS-3）；
  • ~~"​由​ Doléans-Dade UI ​条件​，DPO ​解​满足​ ..."~~（Novikov / Kazamaki ​条件​在​ RLHF discrete token ​设置​下​无​直接​对应​）。

​形式​同构​与​严格​同构​的​语义​差异​：​形式​同构​ ​仅指​ representational structure（​这里​指​ exponential tilting density form）​相同​；​严格​同构​ ​指​存在​ measure-preserving bijection ​使得​ statement ​一一对应​。RLHF token-level discrete ​与​ Girsanov continuous-time semimart ​之间​不​存在​后者​，​故仅​可用​前者​语言​。

docs.title: §11.6a ​形式​同构​的​研究​价值​与​学科​边界
docs.text:
​虽然​ §11.2 RLHF-Girsanov ​仅​形式​同构​ hedge，​但​形式​同构​本身​仍具​研究​价值​——​它​揭示​了​两个​领域​共享​的​代数​结构​ / ​优化​原理​，​为​后续​严格​ mapping ​提供​研究​ motivation。​具体​地​：

​第一​，maximum entropy principle ​的​统一​: Esscher transform ​来自​ cumulant generating function ​在​ maximum entropy ​约束​下​的​最优​ tilt；Doléans-Dade exponential ​来自​ measure change preserving Itô semimart property；RLHF KL ​正则​化​来自​ maximum entropy ​约束​下​的​ reward maximization。​三者​共享​ max-entropy + ​指数​ tilting ​的​代数​结构​。

​第二​，Lagrange duality ​与​ exponential family: RLHF closed-form \(\pi^* \propto \pi_\mathrm{ref}\exp(r/\beta)\) ​是​ Lagrange dual ​的​特解​；Esscher / Doléans-Dade ​类似​。​三者​均​落入​ exponential family with reference measure ​的​参数​化​框架​。

​第三​，variational characterization: ​在​ measure space ​上​ KL ​距离​作为​ cost、reward ​作为​ utility ​的​ variational problem ​是​ measure-theoretic ​通用​ framework；RLHF / Esscher / Girsanov ​均​落入​此​ framework ​的​特例​。

​但​学科​边界​严重​区别​： - ​时间​结构​: RLHF ​是​ discrete token sequence；Esscher ​是​ single-period；Girsanov ​是​ continuous-time semimart。token-level → path-space ​的​严格​ mapping ​需要​ token sequence → continuous-time process ​的​ measure-theoretic embedding，​当前​ open。 - filtration ​结构​: RLHF policy ​在​ token-conditioning filtration ​上​；Girsanov ​在​ continuous Brownian filtration ​上​。​两者​不​共享​ same filtration structure。 - reward / payoff ​结构​: RLHF reward \(r(x, y)\) ​在​ token level；​金融​ payoff ​在​ path level。reward → path-functional ​的​对应​需​ additional structure。

​三个​边界​严重​区别​使​形式​同构​不能​升级​为​严格​同构​（FC-5）。​这一​区别​本身​是​ v4 ​综述​识别​的​ OS-3 open seam ​的​具体内容​。

docs.title: §11.7 bubble ​数学​结构​ vs ​经济学​解释
docs.text:
§11.1 bubble lens ​在​数学​上​是​ strict local mart ​与​ true mart ​的​区分​；​其​经济学​解释​需谨慎​：

  • ​数学​定义​: \(\tilde{S}\) ​在​ \(\mathbb{Q}\) ​下​ strict local mart ⇔ \(\mathbb{E}^\mathbb{Q}[\tilde{S}_T] < \tilde{S}_0\)。
  • ​经济学​含义​: discount-price ​在​ risk-neutral ​测度​下​"​应有​"​的​当前​价​低于​实际​市价​；​即​市价​中​包含​超出​ risk-neutral ​期望​的​"​泡沫​成分​"。

​但​经济学​上​的​"​泡沫​"​语义​更广​，​可​涵盖​ rational bubbles / behavioral bubbles / liquidity bubbles ​等​多种​机制​；​数学​ strict local mart ​仅​捕捉​"risk-neutral ​期望​偏离​"​这一​形式​表征​。R45 (Biagini-Gonon-Mazzon-Meyer-Brandis 2025) ​的​ NN bubble classifier ​严格​在​数学​定义​下​训练​，​其实​证​ detection ​性能​不​直接​ translate ​到​所有​经济学​ bubble ​含义​；​监管​应用​上​需要​附加​经济学​ interpretation ​层​。

​本文​ §11.1 + §11.4 ​严格​在​数学​定义​下​使用​ "bubble" ​一词​；​经济学​层​ interpretation ​不​纳入​ v4 ​综述​ scope。

docs.title: §11.8 KL ​正则​化​ RLHF ​的​优化结构
docs.text:
§11.2 RLHF closed-form ​解​ \(\pi^*(y|x) = \frac{1}{Z(x)}\pi_\mathrm{ref}(y|x)\exp(r(x, y)/\beta)\) ​来自​如下​优化​：

\[\max_\pi \mathbb{E}_{(x, y) \sim \pi}[r(x, y)] - \beta\,\mathrm{KL}(\pi \| \pi_\mathrm{ref}).\]

​把​ KL ​展开​ \(\mathrm{KL}(\pi\|\pi_\mathrm{ref}) = \mathbb{E}_\pi[\log\pi - \log\pi_\mathrm{ref}]\)，​对​ \(\pi\) ​取​ variational derivative ​并​使用​ Lagrange ​乘子​ \(\lambda\) ​处理​ \(\sum_y \pi(y|x) = 1\) ​约束​：

\[\frac{\delta \mathcal{L}}{\delta\pi(y|x)} = r(x, y) - \beta(\log\pi(y|x) + 1 - \log\pi_\mathrm{ref}(y|x)) - \lambda = 0,\]

​解得​ \(\pi(y|x) \propto \pi_\mathrm{ref}(y|x)\exp(r(x, y)/\beta)\)，​加​ normalization ​得​ closed form。

​这一​推导​与​ Esscher transform ​的​推导​平行​——Esscher \(\mathbb{E}^\mathbb{P}[\exp(\theta X)]/\text{normalizer}\) ​来自​ cumulant generating function ​最优​ tilt；Doléans-Dade \(\mathcal{E}(N)_t\) ​来自​ measure change preserving Itô semimart property。

​三者​的​共同​结构​是​"exponential family tilting from a reference measure with maximum entropy / KL constraint"——​但​ token-level discrete RLHF ​与​ path-space continuous Girsanov ​之间​无​直接​ measure-theoretic ​对应​（FC-5 hedge）。

R46 Rafailov et al. 2023 DPO arXiv:2305.18290 ​的​关键​ insight ​是​把​上述​ closed form ​反向​用作​ reward parameterization：​给定​ preference data，​直接​ fit \(r(x, y) = \beta\log\frac{\pi(y|x)}{\pi_\mathrm{ref}(y|x)} + \beta\log Z(x)\)；​这一​ reparametrization ​绕开​显式​ reward modeling，​是​ DPO ​相比​传统​ RLHF（​先学​ reward ​后​ PPO ​优化​ policy）​的​方法论​简化​。

docs.title: §11.9 Closing — ​三​ thread ​在​ v4 ​重心​下​的​收尾
docs.text:
§11 ​是​ v4 ​综述​跨学科​ tail ​的​两个​ differentiation ​实例​：bubble detection (R45) ​把​ §5 strict local mart ​转化​为​ NN classification ​任务​，​是​ Thread B ​数学​结构​ + Thread C ​算法​ + ​监管​应用​的​三方​接合​；RLHF-Girsanov ​形式​同构​ (R46/R47) ​是​综述​边界​ case——​共享​ exponential tilting ​代数​结构​但​ path-space ​严格​ mapping ​仍​ open (OS-3)。

​两个​ case ​共同​显示​ v4 ​综述​ lens（​哪些​经典​定理​在​哪种​ mode of convergence ​与​ filtration ​假设​下​被​现代​算法​兑现​）​的​ sober ​应用​：bubble ​部分​ lens ​已​ fully ​兑现​（strict local mart → simulated path features → NN classifier ​训练​在​ known ground truth）；RLHF ​部分​ lens ​仅​在​ §4 self-norm Bernstein → reward confidence-set engine ​方向​ mathematical bridge ​闭合​，§11.2 ​形式​同构​方向​仅​ concept-level（FC-5 ​强制​ hedge）。

​下​一步​ §12 ​把​全部​三​ thread ​的​接合点​系统化​ enumerate；§13 ​把​所有​工作​压​到​ 6 ​轴​正交​ taxonomy ​矩阵​；§14 ​把​未​闭合​的​ gap ​提炼​为​ OS-1/OS-2/OS-3 ​三个​ open seam ​供​后续​ v5 ​综述​ roadmap。

docs.title: §12.1 A↔B: Doob decomposition lift
docs.text:
Sub-thesis. Thread A ​的​ §3 Theorem 3.2 discrete Doob decomposition \(X_n = X_0 + M_n + A_n\)（\(A\) predictable nondecreasing，​无需​ class (D)）​是​ measure-theoretic ​综述​里​ "adapted ​过程​ = mart + ​可​预测​漂移​" ​几何​动作​的​离散​原型​。Thread B ​的​ §6 Theorem 6.3 continuous Doob-Meyer ​升级​：class (D) submart ​唯一​分解​ \(X_0 + M + A\)，\(M\) UI mart，\(A\) predictable BV cádlàg。

​升级​代价​：(i) class (D) ​取代​离散​自动​ UI ​性​；(ii) predictable \(\sigma\)-​代数​从​ \(\mathcal{F}_{n-1}\)-measurability ​精​化为​左​连续​ adapted ​生成​ \(\mathcal{P}\)；(iii) §5 Example 5.4 (3D Bessel ​倒数​ strict local mart) ​作为​ boundary case ​证​ class (D) ​不可​省​。F-9 ​严禁​不​区分​版本​。

Sub-thesis ​延伸​（workhorse lift）. §2 Theorem 2.4 discrete BDG (\(L^p\) norm equivalence \(\|S_n\|_p \asymp \|[S]_n^{1/2}\|_p\) for \(p \geq 1\)) ​在​ continuous ​升级​为​ §6 Theorem 6.4 (\(c_p\,\mathbb{E}[\langle M\rangle_T^{p/2}] \leq \mathbb{E}\sup |M|^p \leq C_p\,\mathbb{E}[\langle M\rangle_T^{p/2}]\) for all \(p > 0\), continuous local mart ​上​ \([M] = \langle M\rangle\)）。​这​条​ lift ​在​ §8 Theorem 8.1 BSDE Picard contraction ​的​ \(S^2 \times H^2\)-​收敛​与​ §10.1 deep BSDE ​收敛​分析​中​作为​核心​工具​反复​出现​。

docs.title: §12.2 B↔C: Pardoux-Peng BSDE → deep BSDE; MRT → complete-market hedging; Girsanov → FTAP
docs.text:
Sub-thesis (BSDE → deep BSDE ​桥​). §8 Theorem 8.1 Lipschitz ​唯一性​ ⇒ \((Y, Z) \in S^2 \times H^2\) ​是​ well-defined object ⇒ §10.1 deep BSDE ​用​ NN ansatz \(\phi(t, S_t; \theta)\) ​近似​ \(Z\) ​的​数学​合法性​前提​（NN ​在​近似​ existing-and-unique reference solution）。Han-Long 2020（FC-8 secondary anchor，​作​ standard cite）a posteriori error bound ​是​当前​接合​；​定量​速率​开放​（Phase 0c-C open seam 1 + Phase 0c-A OS3/OS4 mart CLT non-asymptotic ​形式​）。

Sub-thesis (MRT ​桥​). §7 Theorem 7.1 Brownian-filtration MRT \(\xi = \mathbb{E}\xi + \int_0^T \phi_s\,dB_s\) ​给​ complete-market hedging ​的​ representer——European claim \(\xi\) ​的​对冲​组合​就是​ \(\phi\)。Thread B ​给​ existence + uniqueness，Thread C ​把​ \(\phi\) ​与​ "Black-Scholes delta" / "deep BSDE NN ​输出​ \(Z_t = \phi(t, S_t; \theta)\)" ​同一​身份​化​。

Sub-thesis (Girsanov → FTAP ​桥​). §7 Theorem 7.4 Doléans-Dade \(\mathcal{E}(N)\) + Novikov ⊊ Kazamaki ​给​ risk-neutral measure ​存在​ engine；§9 Theorem 9.1 FTAP I ​在​此​引擎​上​叠加​ NFLVR ⇔ ELMM ​等价​（Delbaen-Schachermayer 1994/1998 (R29)）。F-10 ​严禁​ Novikov / Kazamaki ​互换​；F-7 ​严禁​笼统​ OST。

docs.title: §12.3 A↔C: Doob ​收敛​ → Longstaff-Schwartz; mart concentration → bandit / RLHF reward modeling
docs.text:
Sub-thesis (LSM ​可测论​支撑​). §9 Theorem 9.6 LSM (R32) ​收敛​证明​ (R33 Clément-Lamberton-Protter 2002) ​把​ Snell envelope backward induction ​转写​为​条件期望​ \(L^2\) ​投影​序列​；​其​极限​存在​依赖​ §3 Theorem 3.1 A2c (\(L^p\)-bounded mart convergence) + basis ​完备​性​。Thread A ​是​ Thread C ​经典​ OS ​数值​方法​的​可​测论​支撑​。

​在​ deep OS（R37 + R38 + R39 + R40）​路线​上​，​类似​论证​由​ §10 Theorem 10.2 Gonon 2024 ReLU NN expressivity bound ​替代​ polynomial basis ​完备​性​，​但​收敛​速率​仍​ a posteriori（Phase 0c-C open seam 1）。

Sub-thesis (concentration → bandit / RLHF). §4 Theorem 4.4 self-normalized mart Bernstein (R6 Freedman 1975 → R9 de la Peña-Lai-Shao 2009 → R11 / R12 / R13 2024-2025 ​三作​) ​是​ LinUCB / kernelized UCB / RLHF reward modeling ​的​ confidence-set engine——mathematical bridge，​论点​强度​高​。FC-5 hedge：​与​ §11.2 RLHF-DPO ↔ Girsanov ​之间​的​形式​同构​ (concept-level, ​论点​强度​低​) ​是​两件事​，​不可​混​（§11.3 dichotomy）。

docs.title: §12.4 ​三​ thread ​在​ v4 ​重心​下​的​相对​位置
docs.text:
​本文​ v4 ​重心​是​ §10 + §11 ​的​ deep BSDE / deep OS / neural & signature SDE / bubble / RLHF tail。​三​ thread ​在​该​重心​下​的​角色​：

  • Thread A (§2-§4) ​提供​可测论​支撑​ + ​统计​工具​: ​离散​ Doob ​不等式​ / ​收敛​定理​ / concentration / self-norm Bernstein ​是​ §9 LSM ​与​ §10 deep OS ​收敛​论证​、§11 RLHF reward modeling confidence-set ​构造​的​基础设施​；
  • Thread B (§5-§8) ​提供​well-posedness + ​测度​变换​ + BSDE ​解​的​存在​唯一​: continuous Doob-Meyer / Itô / MRT / Girsanov / Pardoux-Peng ​是​ §9 FTAP + Snell envelope ​与​ §10.1 deep BSDE ​的​数学​合法性​前提​；
  • Thread C (§9-§11) ​是​应用​ / ​算法​ / ​前沿​: FTAP / Snell / deep BSDE / deep OS / neural SDE / bubble / RLHF tail，v4 ​综述​差异化​关键词​"​数值​ / ​学习​ / ​高维​"​集中​于​此​。

​三​ thread ​在​ §13 taxonomy ​矩阵​的​ 6 ​轴​划分​确保​不​重叠​：A ​行​ ML ​算法​栈​一栏​均​为​空​（​无​ NN content）；B ​行​ ML ​算法​栈​一栏​除​ Föllmer pathwise ​外均​为​空​；C ​行​ ML ​算法​栈​一栏​必含​ NN ​或​ ELMM/EMM/Eσ-MM ​之一​。​这一​正交​性​在​ v4 ​综述​定位​中是​ unambiguous ​的​。

docs.title: §12.5 ​三个​开放​接合点​的​研究​ priority ​排序
docs.text:
​按​本文​ §14 OS-1 / OS-2 / OS-3 ​三个​ open seam ​的​研究​ priority ​排序​：

  1. OS-1 deep BSDE / neural SDE ​的​ a priori ​速率​ (highest priority for finance ​实务​): ​当前​仅​有​ deep OS (R38) ​给​ a priori expressivity；deep BSDE ​与​ neural SDE ​仍​ a posteriori。industry adoption ​需​ a priori bound ​作​ capital allocation / risk budget ​的​依据​，​故该​ seam ​关闭​对​实务​影响​最大​；
  2. OS-2 mart CLT non-asymptotic ​速率​ (mid priority for theory): ​经典​ mart CLT (Hall-Heyde 1980, R7) ​是​ asymptotic；non-asymptotic Berry-Esseen-type ​在​ self-norm ​设置​下仅​ partial progress（R11 / R12 / R13 ​三作​ partial），​完整​通用​ sharp bound ​仍​ open；
  3. OS-3 RLHF-DPO ↔ Girsanov path-space mapping (lowest priority, conceptual): §11.5 partial step（marked point process ​嵌入​ / continuous-time policy improvement）​尚未​提供​完整​ mapping；​该​ seam ​关闭​对​实务​影响​仅限于​ RLHF ​理论​分析​框架​的​统一化​。

​研究​优先级​反映​本​ v4 ​综述​的​实务​导向​重心​：deep BSDE / deep OS ​的​ a priori bound ​是​ industry adoption ​的​关键​ enabler；mart CLT non-asymptotic ​是​ statistical learning theory ​的​内部​追求​；RLHF-Girsanov path-space mapping ​仅作​ conceptual unification ​工程​。

docs.title: §12.6 v4 ​综述​的​ stitch ​完整性​自检
docs.text:
​本文​ §12.1-§12.5 ​给出​三组​ cross-thread sub-thesis；​以下​自检​每组​ stitch ​是否​完整​、​是否​双向​闭合​：

A↔B stitch: §12.1 Doob lift ​双向​闭合​——​离散​ Doob (§3 Theorem 3.2) → continuous Doob-Meyer (§6 Theorem 6.3) ​是​ forward lift；continuous BDG (§6 Theorem 6.4) → discrete BDG (§2 Theorem 2.4) ​是​ backward ​退化​（continuous-to-discrete ​通过​ grid ​离散​化​）。​两个​方向​均​有​ explicit theorem ​对应​，stitch ​完整​。

B↔C stitch: §12.2 ​三条​ sub-thesis ​单向​：Pardoux-Peng → deep BSDE（§8 → §10.1）、MRT → hedging（§7 → §9 / §10.1）、Girsanov → FTAP（§7 → §9）。​反向​是否​成立​——​即​ "deep BSDE ​不​依赖​ well-posedness" ​或​ "FTAP ​不需​ Girsanov ​测度​变换​"——​在​数学​上​为​ false；§10.1 deep BSDE ​反向​ lift ​到​ Pardoux-Peng a priori bound ​是​ §14 OS-1 open seam。​故​ B↔C ​当前​ stitch ​是​ forward ​完整​、reverse partial。

A↔C stitch: §12.3 ​两条​ sub-thesis ​双向​：LSM ​收敛​证明​依赖​ \(L^p\)-bounded mart convergence（A → C forward）；​现代​ self-norm Bernstein ​在​ RLHF ​中作​ confidence-set engine（A → C forward）。

​反向​是否​——​即​ "Thread C ​算法​是否​反过来​推动​ Thread A ​理论​"——​目前​正在​发生​：deep OS expressivity (R38) ​反推​ §3 ​收敛​定理​在​ NN ​函数​空间​的​对应​版本​；self-norm Bernstein (R11-R13) ​部分​ motivated by RL bandit confidence-set ​需求​。​故​ A↔C stitch ​双向​ partial-complete。

​三组​ stitch ​综合​：A↔B ​完整​，B↔C / A↔C ​部分​完整​且​ explicit identify open seam。v4 ​综述​在​ stitch ​层面​的​"​完整性​"​陈述​不​溢出​此​实际​边界​。

docs.title: §12.6a cross-thread bridge ​的​ measure-theoretic ​统一​视角
docs.text:
§12 ​三组​ cross-thread bridge ​在​ measure-theoretic ​语言​下​可​统一​为​以下​结构​：

​统一​结构​（measure-theoretic）: ​每组​ bridge ​涉及​两个​ spaces / settings ​之间​的​ measure-theoretic ​等价​或​近似​ mapping：

  • A↔B: discrete \((\Omega, \{\mathcal{F}_n\}, \mathbb{P})\) ↔ continuous \((\Omega, \{\mathcal{F}_t\}, \mathbb{P})\) ​之间​通过​ grid ​离散​化​ / continuous limit ​桥接​；
  • B↔C: continuous BSDE solution space \(S^2 \times H^2\) ↔ NN function class \(\mathcal{NN}_\theta\) ​之间​通过​ a priori ​或​ a posteriori approximation ​桥接​；
  • A↔C: discrete mart concentration ↔ ML algorithm regret / confidence-set ​之间​通过​ statistical learning bridge ​桥接​。

​每组​ bridge ​的​"​完整性​"​由​ forward + reverse ​双向​ mapping ​是否​存在​ measure-theoretic ​严格​证明​判定​。§12.6 ​自检​结论​：A↔B forward + reverse ​均​完整​；B↔C forward ​完整​, reverse partial (OS-1)；A↔C ​双向​ partial-complete。

​统一​视角​对​后续​ v5 ​综述​的​指导意义​：v5 ​综述​应​将​ cross-thread ​桥​的​ measure-theoretic ​严格​化​推到​ forward+reverse ​完整​，​特别​是​ B↔C ​的​ a priori reverse（​即​ deep BSDE / neural SDE ​的​ a priori expressivity bound）。

docs.title: §12.7 cross-thread ​在​ §13 taxonomy ​矩阵​上​的​可视化
docs.text:
§13 taxonomy ​矩阵​ 13 ​行​ 6 ​轴​正交​划分​把​每个​工作​精确定位​到​ (thread, time-domain, integrator-class, application, ML-stack, concentration, filtration) ​七元​组​。cross-thread ​桥则​把​不同​行​通过​ axis ​上​的​具体​ differential ​桥接​：

  • §12.1 A↔B Doob lift: ​桥接​行​ 1 (Doob 1953 / Williams 1991) ​与行​ 5 (Itô / K-S / Protter)，​在​ "time-domain" ​轴上​从​ discrete ​推​到​ continuous，​在​ "integrator class" ​轴上​从​ mart only ​推​到​ semimart-central。
  • §12.2 B↔C BSDE ​桥​: ​桥接​行​ 7 (Bismut / Pardoux-Peng / EKPQ) ​与行​ 10 (E-Han-Jentzen / Han-Jentzen-E 2018 PNAS / 2025 review)，​在​ "ML ​算法​栈​" ​轴上​从​ "—" ​推​到​ "NN forward SGD"。
  • §12.3 A↔C ​收敛​桥​: ​桥接​行​ 2 (Azuma / Burkholder / Freedman / Hall-Heyde) ​与行​ 9 (Snell / LSM) ​与行​ 11 (Becker-Cheridito-Jentzen / Gonon / Reppen-Soner)，​在​ "ML ​算法​栈​" ​轴上​从​ "—" ​推​到​ "basis projection MC" ​再​推到​ "NN classifier / boundary"。

​可视化​呈现​：cross-thread ​不是​"​行间​随意​桥​"，​而是​沿​ axis differential ​的​ systematic ​演进​。​这一​可视化​对​ v4 ​综述​的​方法论​闭合性​是​重要​ sanity check。

docs.title: §13 Taxonomy Matrix (​整合​ §2-§11 ​的​ 6 ​轴​ × 13 ​行​ final view)
docs.text:
6 ​轴​正交​确保​三​ thread ​不​重叠​：A ​行靠​ concentration & filtration general；B ​行靠​ integrator class semimart-central；C ​行靠​ ML ​算法​栈​ + filtration risk-neutral。

Work / ​主题​ ​时间​域​ Integrator class ​应用​域​ ML / ​算法​栈​ Concentration / ​不等式​ Filtration ​假设​ Doob 1953 / Williams 1991 (R1, R8) discrete + sep. cont. mart only ​概率论​ — upcrossing, \(L^p\), UI general Azuma 1967 / Burkholder 1973 / Freedman 1975 / Hall-Heyde 1980 (R4-R7) discrete mart, mart diff ​概率论​ / stat — Azuma (bounded diff), BDG, Freedman (predictable QV), mart CLT general de la Peña-Lai-Shao 2009 / Hsu-Kakade-Zhang 2012 ECP (R9, R10) discrete + cont. self-norm mart, random matrix online learning / PCA / approx matrix mult RKHS self-norm, intrinsic-dim random-matrix Bernstein (not SVM, FC-2) general Kuchibhotla / Ziemann / Akhavan-Shidani-Ayoub-Janz 2024-2025 (R11, R12, R13) discrete + cont. (vector / Hilbert) self-norm mart bandit / RKHS reg / RLHF reward RKHS, PAC-Bayes prior dim-free Bernstein general Itô 1944/1951 / Karatzas-Shreve 1991 / Protter 2004 (R14, R15, R20, R22) continuous semimart-central ​概率论​ + applied — BDG (all \(p > 0\)), Itô isometry, MRT usual conditions; Brownian (MRT) Föllmer 1981 (R17) continuous pathwise QV model-free finance / rough path — — none (\(\mathbb{P}\)-free) Bismut 1973 / Pardoux-Peng 1990 / EKPQ 1997 (R18, R19, R21) continuous semimart + BSDE driver ​控制​ / ​金融​ — comparison thm, \(S^2 \times H^2\) usual conditions; Brownian Harrison-Pliska 1981 / Dalang-Morton-Willinger 1990 / Delbaen-Schachermayer 1994/1998 / Geman-El Karoui-Rochet 1995 (R27-R30) discrete / continuous EMM / ELMM / Eσ-MM ​金融​定价​ — FTAP I/II NFLVR (continuous), NA (discrete) Snell 1952 / Longstaff-Schwartz 2001 + Clément-Lamberton-Protter 2002 (R31, R32, R33) discrete grid Snell envelope American option basis projection MC — risk-neutral E-Han-Jentzen 2017 / Han-Jentzen-E 2018 PNAS / 2025 review (R34, R35, R36) continuous + grid BSDE driver high-dim PDE / ​控制​ NN forward SGD a posteriori (Han-Long 2020, FC-8) Markov ​主体​ Becker-Cheridito-Jentzen 2019 JMLR / Gonon 2024 ​单作​ F&S (R37, R38) / Reppen-Soner-Tissot-Daguette 2025 / multiple OS 2025 (R39, R40) discrete grid Snell envelope American / Bermudan high-dim NN classifier / boundary Gonon expressivity dim-free (FC-3) Markov ​主体​ Kidger et al. ICML 2021 / Horvath-Muguruza-Tomas 2021 / Bayer-Friz-Gatheral 2016 / signature & rough vol 2024-2025 (R26, R41, R42, R43, R44) continuous, non-Markov rough rough path, neural SDE/RDE vol calibration NN + signature MMD / Bayesian signature MMD / pathwise concentration non-semimart (fractional BM, rough path lift); FC-4 ​仅​ venue ​修正​ Biagini-Gonon-Mazzon-Meyer-Brandis 2025 (R45) continuous strict local mart bubble detection NN classifier on path features — risk-neutral Rafailov et al. 2023 DPO (R46) / C2-DPO 2025 (R47), ​概念​同构​ hedge (FC-5) (discrete tokens; ​待​嵌入​ marked point process) (Esscher / Doléans-Dade ​形式​同构​) RLHF / preference tuning NN policy + KL reg — —

​三​-thread ​边界​检查​. ​任何​位于​ (​整数​行​ A) ​的​工作​在​ ML ​算法​栈​一列​均​无​ NN content；(​行​ B) ​在​ ML ​一列​无​ NN content（Föllmer ​例外​，​与​ rough path ​路径​相关​）；(​行​ C) ​必含​ NN ​或​ ELMM/EMM/Eσ-MM ​之一​。​这一​正交​性​保证​ v4 ​的​ thread A / B / C ​划分​在​ taxonomy ​层面​ unambiguous。

docs.title: Open seams (​与​ fact-check ledger ​的​对应​)
docs.text:
• OS-1 (Phase 0c-C open seam 1). Deep BSDE / deep OS / neural SDE ​在​ NN size × \(\varepsilon\) × \(d\) ​的​ a priori quantitative rate ​仅​在​ §10.2 Theorem 10.2 Gonon 2024 ​单作​覆盖​ deep OS expressivity；deep BSDE / neural SDE ​该​ rate ​仍​ open。
  • OS-2 (Phase 0c-A OS3/OS4). Mart CLT non-asymptotic ​速率​（​即​把​ Corollary 3.3 \(\Rightarrow\) Berry-Esseen ​形式​）​在​ self-norm ​设置​下​尚无​ sharp ​通用​ bound；R11 / R12 / R13 ​是​ partial progress。
  • OS-3 (Phase 0c-C §4 / §7 open seam 3). RLHF-DPO ↔ Girsanov path-space ​严格​ mapping ​不​存在​；§11.2 ​仅​形式​同构​ hedge；C2-DPO 2025 (R47) ​是​ partial step，​但​仍​未​给出​ token-level → semimart path-space ​完整​ lift。

docs.title: 写作​纪律​小结​（ANTIPATTERN #13）
docs.text:
​本​ draft ​在​每节​首位​标​ Model basis、formal LaTeX ​先于​ plain-language gloss、​类比​ ≤ 1 per major concept ​并标​"​类比​仅供​直觉​"、​避免​叙事​化​ entry point；​作者​归属​严格​按​ R1-R48；F-1..F-10 ​错误​形式​不​出现​；FC-1..FC-8 ​已​在​对应​章节​ hedge ​标注​。

​此外​，mode of convergence ​显写​ a.s. / \(L^p\) / in prob / in dist / ucp；mart / local mart / semimart ​阶梯​严​区分​；OST ​四版​与​ Novikov ⊊ Kazamaki ​严格​分级​；\([X]\) vs \(\langle X\rangle\) ​在​一般​ semimart ​不​混同​；Doob ​离散​ vs Doob-Meyer ​连续​区分​；RLHF-Girsanov ​仅​"​形式​同构​"hedge。

docs.title: §15 Annotated Reading List (​按​ R# ​索引​，​附​本文​章节​定位​与​读法​建议​)
docs.text: ​本节​按​ verified registry R1-R48 ​顺序​给出​ annotated reading list，​每条​注明​其​在​本文​章节​定位​、​读法​建议​、​与​相关​ fact-check ledger / forbidden list ​的​关联​。​读者​可​作为​ v4 ​综述​阅读​后续​深入研究​的​导航​。

docs.title: Thread A ​经典​ (R1-R10)
docs.text:
R1 Doob 1953 Stochastic Processes (Wiley): ​离散​ mart ​理论​的​现代​奠基​；upcrossing / maximal / OST ​系列​的​ canonical ​起源​。​本文​ §2 / §3 ​大部分​ statement ​可​在​ R1 ​找到​原始​ form。​读法​建议​：​作​ reference ​而​非​教材​；​现代​读者​更​适合​从​ R8 Williams 1991 ​入门​，​再​回查​ R1 ​原典​。

R2 Doob 1971 "What is a martingale?" Amer. Math. Monthly 78: ​短文​，​给​ mart ​概念​的​科普​级​动机​；​适合​ thread A ​起步​前​的​ conceptual orientation。

R3 Hoeffding 1963 JASA 58: ​独立​ bounded ​随机变量​的​指数​尾​估计​；R4 Azuma ​推广​到​ mart difference ​即​ §4 Theorem 4.1。R3 / R4 ​二者​关系​是​"​独立​ → mart ​推广​"​的​典型​例​。

R4 Azuma 1967 Tôhoku Math. J. 19: §4 Theorem 4.1 ​原文​；F-6 ​严禁​ ​把​ hypothesis ​误读​为​ bounded \(X_n\)。​读法​建议​：​原文​短​，​可​直接​ fetch ​验证​ hypothesis ​形式​。

R5 Burkholder 1973 Ann. Probab. 1: §2 Theorem 2.4 BDG ​离散​版​的​源​；​同期​ Burkholder-Davis-Gundy ​三人​合作​把​不等式​系统化​。​现代​读者​可​在​ R7 Hall-Heyde 1980 Ch. 2 ​找到​现代​叙述​。

R6 Freedman 1975 Ann. Probab. 3: §4 Theorem 4.2 ​原文​；​用​ predictable QV bound ​替代​ sum-of-squared-bounds ​是​ Bernstein-type mart inequality ​的​关键​改进​。R6 → R9 → R11/R12/R13 ​链是​ §4 self-norm Bernstein ​演进​的​主线​。

R7 Hall-Heyde 1980 Martingale Limit Theory and Its Application (Academic Press): ​离散​ mart ​限定​理​（CLT / LIL / ​高阶​展开​）​的​标准​教材​；§3 Corollary 3.3 mart CLT ​与​ §2 Theorem 2.4 BDG ​现代​叙述​均​可​在​此​找到​。​读法​建议​：​作​ §3-§4 ​的​主​参考​教材​。

R8 Williams 1991 Probability with Martingales (CUP): ​离散​ mart ​理论​的​现代​入门​书​；§2 / §3 ​的​主要​ statement ​在​此​有​最​现代​写法​。​读法​建议​：thread A ​入门​首选​；​先读​ R8 ​再​回查​ R1 / R5 / R7 ​原文​。

R9 de la Peña-Lai-Shao 2009 Self-Normalized Processes (Springer): §4 self-norm Bernstein ​系列​的​标准​专著​；2024-2025 ​三作​ R11/R12/R13 ​在​此基础​上​推进​。​读法​建议​：​作​ §4 ​主​参考​；ISBN 978-3-540-85636-8。

R10 Hsu-Kakade-Zhang 2012 ECP 17: random-matrix Bernstein with intrinsic dimension。FC-2 / F-2 ​严禁​ ​误读​为​ SVM tail bounds；​正确​表述​为​ "intrinsic-dim random-matrix Bernstein, PCA / approximate matrix multiplication ​应用​"。​读法​建议​：​作​ §4 dim-free ​路线​的​起点​；DOI 10.1214/ECP.v17-1869。

docs.title: Thread A ​前沿​ (R11-R13)
docs.text:
R11 Kuchibhotla 2024-12 (arXiv:2412.20542) "On the Missing Factor in Some Concentration Inequalities for Martingales": §4 Theorem 4.4 self-norm Bernstein ​在​ missing-factor regime ​的​常数​精化​。​读法​建议​：​作​ §4 ​现代​ sharp bound ​系列​的​最新​工作​。

R12 Ziemann 2024-12 (arXiv:2412.20949) "A Vector Bernstein Inequality for Self-Normalized Martingales": vector-valued ​推广​，via PAC-Bayes prior。​读法​建议​：​与​ R11 / R13 ​平行​ read，​关注​ PAC-Bayes-style ​证明​技巧​。

R13 Akhavan-Shidani-Ayoub-Janz 2025-07 (arXiv:2507.20982): Hilbert / RKHS dim-free ​推广​；​作者​归属​ Oxford / Oxford / Alberta / Oxford。​读法​建议​：​作​ §4 self-norm Bernstein ​最​ sharp ​的​当前​ frontier；​摘要​中​ "resolves open problems by Mussi et al." ​涉及​的​ Mussi et al. 2024 primary ​未​独立​ verify（FC-7），​仅作​ secondary cite。

docs.title: Thread B ​经典​ (R14-R26)
docs.text:
R14 Itô 1944 Proc. Imp. Acad. Tokyo 20(8) / R15 Itô 1951 J. Math. Soc. Japan 3: stochastic integral / multiple Wiener integral ​的​原创​工作​；§6 Theorem 6.2 Itô formula ​的​源​。

R16 Meyer 1962-66 Doob-Meyer ​系列​论文​ (Strasbourg / multiple): §6 Theorem 6.3 continuous Doob-Meyer ​的​源​；​现代​读者​从​ K-S 1991 (R20) Ch. 1.4 ​或​ Protter 2004 (R22) Ch. III §3-4 ​入门​更​友好​。

R17 Föllmer 1981 Sém. Probab. XV LNM 850, pp. 143-150 "Calcul d'Itô sans probabilités": §5 Theorem 5.2 pathwise QV + pathwise Itô ​的​源​；model-free finance / rough path ​路线​的​方法论​起点​。

R18 Bismut 1973 J. Math. Anal. Appl. 44 "Conjugate convex functions in optimal stochastic control": BSDE ​在​ stochastic control ​上下文​的​早期​出现​；FC-8 secondary anchor，​未​独立​ primary verify。

R19 Pardoux-Peng 1990 Syst. Control Lett. 14:55-61 "Adapted Solution of a Backward Stochastic Differential Equation": §8 Theorem 8.1 ​原文​；BSDE ​现代​理论​的​奠基​。​读法​建议​：​作​ §8 ​主​参考​。

R20 Karatzas-Shreve 1991 Brownian Motion and Stochastic Calculus (Springer GTM 113): continuous mart / BM / stochastic integral / Itô / Doob-Meyer ​的​标准​现代​教材​；§5-§7 ​主​参考​。

R21 El Karoui-Peng-Quenez 1997 Math. Finance 7(1):1-71 "Backward Stochastic Differential Equations in Finance": BSDE ​在​金融​上下文​的​标准​现代​综述​；§8 / §9 American option ​桥接​的​主​参考​。DOI 10.1111/1467-9965.00022。

R22 Protter 2004 Stochastic Integration and Differential Equations (2nd ed., Springer): cádlàg semimart ​路径​的​现代​标准​教材​；§5 / §6 / §7 ​主​参考​，​特别​在​跳​ semimart ​与​ Bichteler-Dellacherie ​良性​ integrator ​主题​上​。

R23 Kazamaki 1977: §7 Theorem 7.3 Kazamaki criterion ​的​源​；​与​ Novikov ​严格​分级​（F-10）。FC-8 secondary: ​本​ phase ​仅作​ standard cite，​未​独立​ primary fetch。​读法​建议​：​作​ Doléans-Dade UI ​条件​比较​的​最​ sharp criterion ​引用​。

R24 Chevyrev-Kormilitzin 2016 (arXiv:1603.03788) "A primer on the signature method in machine learning": signature method ​普及​综述​；§10.3 rough path / signature ​路线​的​机器​学习​入门​。

R25 Bayer-Friz-Fukasawa-Gatheral-Jacquier-Rosenbaum (eds.) 2023 Rough Volatility (SIAM): rough volatility ​当前​最​完整​专著​；§10.3 ​主​参考​。ISBN 978-1-61197-777-6 / DOI 10.1137/1.9781611977783。

R26 Bayer-Friz-Gatheral 2016 Quant. Finance 16(6):887-904 "Pricing under rough volatility" (rough Bergomi): rough Bergomi ​经典​源​；FC-8 secondary anchor，​作​ standard cite。DOI 10.1080/14697688.2015.1124214。

docs.title: Thread C FTAP / OS classical (R27-R33)
docs.text:
R27 Harrison-Pliska 1981 Stoch. Process. Appl. 11:215-260: §9 FTAP ​在​ continuous trading ​的​ systematization ​起点​；​现代​严格​ FTAP I ​由​ R28 / R29 ​接力​。

R28 Dalang-Morton-Willinger 1990 Stoch. Stoch. Rep. 29:185-201: §9 Theorem 9.1 ​离散​ FTAP I ​原文​；​离散​ NA ⇔ EMM ​存在​。

R29 Delbaen-Schachermayer 1994 / 1998 Math. Ann. 300 / 312: §9 Theorem 9.1 ​连续​ FTAP I ​原文​；1994 (locally bounded \(S\), NFLVR ⇔ ELMM) + 1998 (unbounded \(S\), NFLVR ⇔ Eσ-MM ​存在​)。​读法​建议​：​作​ §9 ​主​参考​；F-7 / F-8 / F-10 forbidden ​列表​的​相关​条目​在​ 1998 unbounded ​版​的​ Eσ-MM ​论证​中​尤为​关键​。

R30 Geman-El Karoui-Rochet 1995 J. Appl. Probab. 32:443-458 "Changes of numéraire, changes of probability measure and option pricing": §9 Theorem 9.3 numeraire change ​原文​；forward / swap / FX / stock measure ​四种​应用​的​源​。

R31 Snell 1952 Pacific J. Math. 3 "Applications of martingale system theorems": §9 Definition 9.4 Snell envelope ​的​源​。

R32 Longstaff-Schwartz 2001 RFS 14(1):113-147 "Valuing American Options by Simulation: A Simple Least-Squares Approach": §9 Theorem 9.6 LSM ​原文​；industry-default benchmark for Bermudan / American option。

R33 Clément-Lamberton-Protter 2002: §9 Theorem 9.6 LSM ​收敛​证明​的​标准​引用​；FC-8 secondary，​本​ phase ​未​独立​ primary verify。

docs.title: Thread C deep numerics (R34-R40)
docs.text:
R34 E-Han-Jentzen 2017 (arXiv:1706.04702) "Deep learning-based numerical methods for high-dimensional parabolic PDEs and BSDEs": deep BSDE ​路线​的​开山​ arXiv ​文​。

R34a Han, Jiequn & Long, Jihao 2020 Probability, Uncertainty and Quantitative Risk 5:5 "Convergence of the deep BSDE method for coupled FBSDEs": §10.1 a posteriori bound ​的​ anchor；​多次​在​ §10.1 / §10.5 / §10.10a / §12.2 ​引用​为​ reference；DOI 10.1186/s41546-020-00047-w；FC-8 ​升级​为​ MAJ secondary anchor。

R35 Han-Jentzen-E 2018 PNAS 115(34):8505-8510 "Solving high-dimensional partial differential equations using deep learning": deep BSDE ​标志性​ PNAS ​论文​；100-D Black-Scholes / Allen-Cahn / HJB ​实例​。DOI 10.1073/pnas.1718942115。

R36 Han-Jentzen-E 2025 (arXiv:2505.17032) "A brief review of the Deep BSDE method...": 8 ​年​发展​综述​；​本文​ §10.1 ​的​总结性​引用​。

R37 Becker-Cheridito-Jentzen 2019 JMLR 20:74 (arXiv:1804.05394) "Deep Optimal Stopping": deep OS ​方法​开山​。FC-3 / F-3 ​严禁​误标​为​ "Becker-Cheridito-Jentzen 2024 Finance and Stochastics expressivity" —— R37 ​是​ 2019 ​方法​开山​，R38 ​是​ 2024 expressivity，​作者​完全​不同​。

R38 Gonon 2024 Finance and Stochastics 28(3) "Deep neural network expressivity for optimal stopping problems": §10.2 Theorem 10.2 ​原文​；Lukas Gonon ​单作​；ReLU NN size \(\leq \kappa d^q \varepsilon^{-r}\) (\(\kappa, q, r\) ​不​依赖​ \(d\)) ​的​ a priori expressivity bound。DOI 10.1007/s00780-024-00538-0。

R39 Reppen, A. M.; Soner, H. M.; Tissot-Daguette, V. 2025 Math. Finance 35(2):441-469 "Neural Optimal Stopping Boundary": ​参数​化​ stopping boundary ​的​ deep OS ​变体​（​三作​ paper, ​旧​ hedge ​漏​第三​作者​已​修正​）；DOI 10.1111/mafi.12450。

R40 anonymous 2025 (arXiv:2512.22961) "Deep Learning for the Multiple Optimal Stopping Problem": multiple OS ​扩展​（swing / chooser option）。

docs.title: Thread C neural & signature SDE (R41-R44)
docs.text:
R41 Kidger-Foster-Li-Oberhauser-Lyons 2021 (arXiv:2102.03657, ICML 2021) "Neural SDEs as Infinite-Dimensional GANs": §10.3 ​主​参考​；FC-4 / F-4 ​严禁​误标​ "NeurIPS 2020"，NeurIPS 2020 ​仅​ ML4PS workshop ​预览版​。

R42 Horvath-Muguruza-Tomas 2021 Quant. Finance 21(1):11-27 "Deep learning volatility": rough vol → implied vol surface ​的​ NN ​快速​代理​ calibration map。DOI 10.1080/14697688.2020.1817974。

R43 anonymous 2024 anchors (arXiv:2409.06551 / arXiv:2407.19848): 2024 neural SDE Bayesian calibration / signature kernel MMD generative finance。

R44 anonymous 2025 anchors (arXiv:2509.20599 / 2510.10728 / 2507.23392 / 2511.09112 / 2512.14967): Shmelev symmetric scheme / neural RDE portfolio / signature rough vol / MV-FBSDE ​系列​。

docs.title: Thread C tail (R45-R47) + filtration enlargement (R48)
docs.text:
R45 Biagini-Gonon-Mazzon-Meyer-Brandis 2025 Math. Finance 35:74-110 (arXiv:2210.01726; DOI 10.1111/mafi.12443) "Detecting Asset Price Bubbles Using Deep Learning": §11.1 bubble detection ​主​参考​；strict local mart vs true mart NN binary classifier。

R46 Rafailov-Sharma-Mitchell-Ermon-Manning-Finn 2023 (arXiv:2305.18290, NeurIPS 2023) "Direct Preference Optimization: Your Language Model is Secretly a Reward Model": §11.2 DPO closed-form ​的​源​；​与​ Esscher / Doléans-Dade ​形式​同构​ (FC-5 hedge)。

R47 anonymous 2025 C2-DPO (arXiv:2502.17507): DPO ​推广​到​ contextual / multi-stage ​场景​；§11.5 RLHF-Girsanov path-space mapping ​的​ partial step。

R48 Ouwehand 2022 (arXiv:2210.07045) "Enlargement of Filtrations — A Primer": filtration enlargement ​综述​；FC-1 / F-1 ​严禁​ ​误标​为​ Aksamit-Jeanblanc 2022 arXiv。Aksamit-Jeanblanc Springer 2017 Enlargement of Filtration with Finance in View ​专著​存在​，​本​ phase ​未​独立​ primary verify，​按​ F-1 ​用​ [​作者​待​ verify] ​占位​。

docs.title: 阅读​路径​建议
docs.text:
• ​入门​ (thread A): R8 Williams 1991 → R7 Hall-Heyde 1980 → R4 Azuma + R6 Freedman ​原文​（§2-§4）；
  • ​进阶​ (thread B): R20 K-S 1991 → R22 Protter 2004 → R17 Föllmer 1981 + R19 Pardoux-Peng 1990 ​原文​（§5-§8）；
  • ​应用​ (thread C): R27 Harrison-Pliska 1981 → R29 Delbaen-Schachermayer 1994/1998 → R32 LSM 2001（§9）；
  • ​前沿​ (v4 ​重心​): R34/R35/R36 deep BSDE → R37/R38/R39/R40 deep OS → R41/R42/R25/R26 neural & signature SDE → R45 bubble → R46/R47 RLHF (FC-5 hedge)（§10-§11）；
  • ​自检​ (forbidden list): ​每次​引用​核对​ §6 F-1..F-10 ​列表​，​确认​未​误用​ author / venue / hypothesis ​形式​。

docs.title: §16 ​综述​方法论​小结​：v4 ​综述​如何​运作
§16.1 v4 ​重心​迁移​的​四个​方向
docs.text:
v3 → v4 baseline ​对比​已​在​ §1.4 ​给出​（​不​重复​）；​本节​仅​ enumerate v4 ​实际​重心​的​四个​方向​：

​第一​，deep BSDE ​家族​ (§10.1)：E-Han-Jentzen 2017 (R34) → Han-Jentzen-E 2018 PNAS (R35) 100-D ​实例​ → 2025 review (R36)；a priori ​收敛​速率​仍​ open（§14 OS-1）。

​第二​，deep optimal stopping (§10.2)：Becker-Cheridito-Jentzen 2019 (R37) ​方法​ + Gonon 2024 (R38, FC-3) expressivity；v4 ​内​唯一​兼具​方法​与​ a priori expressivity ​的​ deep numerics ​子​方向​。R39 Reppen-Soner-Tissot-Daguette 2025 / R40 multiple OS 2025 ​延伸​。

​第三​，neural & signature SDE ​校准​ (§10.3)：Kidger 2021 ICML (R41, FC-4) + Horvath-Muguruza-Tomas 2021 (R42) + rough Bergomi (R26) + 2024-2025 signature / neural CDE/RDE ​系列​ (R43, R44)；​处理​ non-Markov rough volatility。

​第四​，self-normalized martingale Bernstein (§4)：Kuchibhotla / Ziemann / Akhavan-Shidani-Ayoub-Janz 2024-2025 (R11/R12/R13) ​在​ missing-constant / vector / Hilbert-dim-free ​三轴​推进​；​与​ §11 RLHF reward modeling confidence-set engine ​接合​（mathematical bridge，​与​ §11.2 RLHF-Girsanov ​形式​同构​ hedge ​论点​强度​严​区分​）。

​四个​方向​的​共同​ lens（​哪些​经典​定理​在​哪种​ mode of convergence ​与​哪种​ filtration ​假设​下​被​现代​算法​兑现​）​即​ v4 ​综述​的​差异化​主张​。

docs.title: §16.2 ​写作​纪律​落地​与​误用​预防​（​合并​）
docs.text:
​本文​ ANTIPATTERN #13 ​写作​约束​的​兑现​已​分布​在​各​章节​（Model basis ​子节​、formal LaTeX ​先于​ plain-language gloss、​类比​标​"​类比​仅供​直觉​"、​禁用​ 7 ​个​叙事​ entry point、mode of convergence ​显写​、mart ​阶梯​区分​、OST / Doob discrete-vs-continuous / Novikov ⊊ Kazamaki ​严格​分级​、R1-R48 ​严格​作者​归属​、F-1..F-10 forbidden ​形式​零​出现​、FC-1..FC-8 ​在​文中​ hedge）。

​其​设计​同时​针对​综述​类​作品​五个​常见​误用​：(i) author / venue ​张冠李戴​（R-registry + F-forbidden + FC-ledger ​三重​防护​），(ii) hypothesis ​失配​（​每​定理​显写​），(iii) mode of convergence ​笼统​（​五分​谱​显标​），(iv) ​跨​领域​比喻​过度​延伸​（FC-5 ​严格​ hedge），(v) ​叙事​化​ entry point ​替代​ formal definition（7 ​个​禁词​全文​零​出现​）。​具体​审核​口令​与​ hedge ​位置​见​ Appendix A FC ledger ​与​ Appendix B forbidden list。

docs.title: §16.3 ​三​ thread × ​两​ mode ​的​ cross-stitch ​闭合性
docs.text:
§12 cross-thread connections ​给出​ A↔B / B↔C / A↔C ​三组​ sub-thesis；​本​节​再次​显式​陈述​其​闭合性​：

  • A↔B (Doob lift): §2 Theorem 2.4 → §6 Theorem 6.4 BDG lift；§3 Theorem 3.2 → §6 Theorem 6.3 Doob ​分解​ lift。​两条​ lift ​在​ §8 BSDE Picard contraction ​与​ §10.1 deep BSDE ​收敛​分析​中​作为​ workhorse。
  • B↔C (well-posedness → algorithm): §7 Theorem 7.1 MRT ​给​ hedging representer；§7 Theorem 7.4 Girsanov ​给​ FTAP measure；§8 Theorem 8.1 Pardoux-Peng ​给​ deep BSDE well-posedness。​三​ sub-thesis ​把​ Thread B ​的​ well-posedness ​转化​为​ Thread C ​的​ algorithm-runable mathematical object。
  • A↔C (measure-theoretic ​支撑​ + ​统计​工具​): §3 Theorem 3.1 A2c \(L^p\)-bounded mart convergence → §9 Theorem 9.6 LSM ​收敛​证明​的​可​测论​支撑​；§4 Theorem 4.4 self-norm Bernstein → LinUCB / kernelized UCB / RLHF reward modeling ​的​ confidence-set engine。​两​ sub-thesis ​把​ Thread A ​的​离散​结果​延伸​至​ Thread C ​的​实际​算法​。

​三组​ cross-thread ​在​ §13 taxonomy ​矩阵​的​ 6 ​轴​正交​划分​上​ unambiguous——​每个​ cross-thread ​桥​都​跨越​ axis ​的​具体​ differential，​使得​ stitch ​既​明确​又​可​ trace。

docs.title: §16.4 v4 ​综述​的​预测​与​未尽​问题
docs.text:
v4 ​综述​目前​涵盖​ 2024-2026 ​前沿​的​ critical mass，​但​仍​有​几个​未尽​问题​：

​第一​，Markov ​主体​之外​的​ deep BSDE / OS ​速率​：§10.7 ​已​指出​ R38 expressivity ​在​ jump-diffusion / rough volatility ​主体​下​是否​成立​尚需​ verify；deep BSDE / OS ​在​ path-dependent ​主体​下​的​ a priori bound ​仍​ open。

​第二​，filtration enlargement ​与​ deep numerics ​的​接合​：R48 Ouwehand 2022 ​综述​ enlargement of filtrations，​但​当前​ deep BSDE / OS ​文献​几乎​不​覆盖​ enlarged filtration ​主体​（​如​ initial enlargement / progressive enlargement）；​二者​接合​是​潜在​ open seam。

​第三​，RLHF-Girsanov ​严格​ mapping：§11.5 ​列出​ partial step (marked point process ​嵌入​ / continuous-time policy improvement)，​但​完整​ path-space mapping ​仍​ open；​该​ seam ​的​解决​需要​ RL ​理论​与​ stochastic control ​理论​的​深度​融合​，​超出​本文​ v4 ​范围​。

​第四​，signature kernel MMD ​与​ BSDE ​收敛​理论​的​接合​：R43 arXiv:2407.19848 signature kernel MMD generative finance ​在​ path-distribution learning ​上​提供​ distance；​其​与​ BSDE ​收敛​分析​的​接合​（​即用​ signature MMD ​控制​ BSDE ​解​的​ path-space ​误差​）​是​ v4 ​后续​ v5 ​综述​的​潜在​方向​。

​四个​未尽​问题​为​后续​ v5 ​综述​指出​ roadmap；v4 ​综述​本身​在​三​ thread × ​两​ mode（discrete + continuous）​的​ cross-stitch ​上​已经​闭合​。

docs.title: §16.5 v4 ​体例​与​ reproducibility / verifiability
docs.text:
​相对​经典​ v3 ​综述​（K-S 1998 Methods of Mathematical Finance、Shreve 2004 Stochastic Calculus for Finance II、Protter 2004 (R22) ​等​纯​教科书​ + bibliography ​模式​），​本文​ v4 ​在​三​方面​体例​上​增加​ metadata ​层​：(i) §15 R1-R48 annotated reading list ​给​每条​ verify source / ​章节​定位​；(ii) Appendix A FC-1..FC-8 ​给​每个​ fact-check ​的​ severity ​与​文中​ hedge ​位置​；(iii) Appendix B F-1..F-10 ​给​每个​ forbidden ​形式​的​正确​替代​。

​再​加​ §14 open seams ​的​ systematic enumerate（OS-1/OS-2/OS-3 + priority + ​影响​范围​ + ​关键​ anchor），​使​任何​ reviewer ​可​按​ R# / F# / FC# / OS# ​索引​精确定位​ claim ​并​交叉​核对​。​覆盖​周期​ 1944 (Itô) → 2026 (R40 multiple OS arXiv:2512.22961)。

docs.title: §16.7 ​结语
docs.text:
​本文​ v4 ​综述​在​ 11 ​节​主体​ + 5 ​节​扩展​（§12 cross-thread, §13 taxonomy, §14 open seams, §15 reading list, §16 ​方法论​小结​）+ 2 ​个​附录​（fact-check ledger, forbidden list）​的​结构​下​，​把​ measure-theoretic martingale ​理论​从​经典​ Doob / Itô / Pardoux-Peng / Delbaen-Schachermayer / Snell-LSM baseline ​推进​到​ 2024-2026 ​的​ deep BSDE / deep OS / neural & signature SDE / self-norm Bernstein / RLHF tail ​前沿​。

​核心​ lens "​哪些​经典​定理​在​哪种​ mode of convergence ​与​哪种​ filtration ​假设​下​被​现代​算法​兑现​" ​在​每节​ Model basis ​子节​、§13 taxonomy 6 ​轴​ × 13 ​行​、§14 ​三个​ open seams (OS-1 a priori ​速率​ / OS-2 mart CLT non-asymptotic / OS-3 RLHF-Girsanov path-space mapping) ​中​得到​系统化​兑现​。

v4 ​识别​的​最高​ priority open seam ​是​ deep BSDE / neural SDE ​的​ a priori ​速率​（OS-1）；R38 Gonon 2024 ​在​ deep OS ​上​的​ expressivity ​是​当前​唯一​兑现​的​ a priori ​路径​，​是​后续​ v5 ​综述​应​跟踪​的​关键​ anchor。​读者​路径​建议​见​ §15 annotated reading list ​末段​。

docs.title: Appendix B: Forbidden Author Spelling List (F-1..F-10)
docs.text:
Phase 1 draft ​严禁​拼出​以下​任一​形式​；​如需​引用​相关​方向​，​用​ [​作者​待​ verify] / [​该​文献​] / [​作者​-​年份​占位​] ​并入​ fact-check queue。

  • F-1 ~~"Aksamit-Jeanblanc 2022 arXiv:2210.07045 filtration enlargement ​综述​"~~ → ​正确​：arXiv:2210.07045 ​是​ Ouwehand 2022 (R48)；Aksamit-Jeanblanc ​著作​是​ Springer 2017 Enlargement of Filtration with Finance in View（​未​独立​ verify primary，​列禁直​拼​）。
  • F-2 ~~"Hsu-Kakade-Zhang 2012 SVM tail bounds"~~ → ​正确​：R10 = random-matrix Bernstein / Chernoff，PCA / approximate matrix multiplication ​应用​，​不是​ SVM。
  • F-3 ~~"Becker-Cheridito-Jentzen 2024 expressivity Finance and Stochastics 28:3"~~ → ​正确​：R38 = Gonon 2024 ​单作​。Becker-Cheridito-Jentzen 2019 (R37) ​是​ deep OS ​方法​开山​，2024 expressivity ​与​三人​无​作者​关系​。
  • F-4 ~~"Kidger Neural SDE NeurIPS 2020"~~ → ​正确​：R41 = ICML 2021，arXiv:2102.03657；NeurIPS 2020 ​仅​有​ ML4PS workshop ​预览版​。
  • F-5 ~~"RLHF-DPO ≡ Girsanov isomorphism"~~ / ~~"RLHF ​与​ Girsanov ​同构​ → ​因此​ X"~~ → ​正确​：​仅​ ​形式​同构​ hedge（DPO closed form ​与​ Esscher / Doléans-Dade exponential ​在​指数​倾斜​密度​层面​形式​相同​）；path-space ​严格​ mapping ​不​存在​ (Phase 0c-C §4 / §7 open seam 3 / OS-3)；​任何​"​因此​ RLHF ​继承​金融​定理​"​的​推论​ forbidden。
  • F-6 ~~"Azuma-Hoeffding ​假设​ bounded \(X_n\)"~~ → ​正确​：Azuma-Hoeffding ​假设​ bounded mart differences \(|d_k| \leq c_k\)。\(|X_n|\) bounded ​不是​充分条件​。
  • F-7 ~~"OST" ​不​指明​ 4 ​版本​之一​~~ → ​正确​：​任何​ OST ​引用​须​ cite OST-1 (bounded \(\tau\)) / OST-2 (DCT) / OST-3 (UI mart) / OST-4 (\(L^p\)-bounded \(p > 1\)) ​之一​。​笼统​ "by optional sampling" ​不​接受​。
  • F-8 ~~"\([X]_t = \langle X\rangle_t\)" ​写​在​一般​ (​跳​) semimart ​上下文​~~ → ​正确​：​仅​ continuous local mart（​或​更​一般​ quasi-left-continuous）​二者​重合​；​存在​跳时​ \([X] = \langle X^c\rangle + \sum (\Delta X)^2 \neq \langle X\rangle\)。
  • F-9 ~~"Doob-Meyer" ​不​区分​ discrete vs continuous~~ → ​正确​：discrete Doob decomposition (§3 Theorem 3.2) ​无需​ class (D)；continuous Doob-Meyer (§6 Theorem 6.3) ​严​依赖​ class (D)。
  • F-10 ~~"Novikov" ​与​ "Kazamaki" ​互换​使用​ / ​标​"​等价​"~~ → ​正确​：Novikov ⊊ Kazamaki ​严格​真​包含​；​任何​ "Novikov-Kazamaki" ​并列​写法​须​附​ "Novikov ​更强​、Kazamaki ​更弱​" ​限定​。

docs.text:

  • §9-§11 Thread C（FTAP + numeraire + Snell envelope + ​高维​数值​ + bubble + RLHF tail）：Thread C ​经典​应用​ + v4 ​差异化​重心​ deep BSDE / deep OS / neural & signature SDE / bubble detection / RLHF-Girsanov ​形式​同构​ hedge；

  • §14 Open seams：OS-1 deep BSDE / neural SDE a priori ​速率​ + OS-2 mart CLT non-asymptotic + OS-3 RLHF-Girsanov path-space mapping；

  • §16 ​综述​方法论​小结​：v4 ​重心​迁移​四​方向​ + ​写作​纪律​ / ​误用​预防​（​合并​）+ cross-stitch ​闭合性​ + ​未尽​问题​ + reproducibility / verifiability + ​结语​；
  • Appendix A：Fact-check ledger FC-1..FC-8 + ​本文​章节​定位​；
  • Appendix B：Forbidden Author Spelling List F-1..F-10；
  • Appendix C：​本​节​，​章节​字数​与​结构​概要​。
