docs.title: Further Reading
docs.text: Scope. ​本章​为​ v4 ​综述​的​ annotated reading list（​与​ §15 ​的​ R# ​注释​互补​：​本章​按​"​为什么​读​ + ​与​综述​哪节​呼应​ + ​优先级​"​组织​，§15 ​按​ R# ​编号​顺序​枚举​）。​作者​归属​严格​按​ Phase 0d §5 verified registry (R1-R48)；§6 forbidden list ​上​的​方向​用​ [​作者​待​ verify] ​占位​。​优先级​符号​：★★★ must-read / ★★ extension / ★ context。

docs.title: Core (verified) — ​测度论​与​金融​数学​骨架​（​必读​）
docs.text:
• Doob 1953 Stochastic Processes (R1, Wiley)。★★★。martingale ​概念​与​离散​-​连续​基础​不等式​ (upcrossing inequality, \(L^p\) maximal, UI closure) ​的​原始​系统化​；​首次​将​ mart / submart / supermart ​三分​作为​ \(L^1\) ​上​ \(\sigma\)-​代数​投影​性质​给出​，​与​ §2 / §3 ​直接​呼应​，​是​本​综述​ Thread A ​全部​骨架​的​ first-source。Doob ​同期​发展​的​ optional sampling ​思想​后续​被​ Williams / Karatzas-Shreve ​拆为​ OST-1 ... OST-4 ​四版​严格​条件​（​参见​本​综述​ §15 Appendix B F-7）。
  • Williams 1991 Probability with Martingales (R8, CUP)。★★★。Thread A ​入门​教材​最​现代化​的​写法​；​离散​ OST 4 ​版​条件​ (OST-1 bounded \(\tau\) / OST-2 DCT / OST-3 UI mart / OST-4 \(L^p\)-bounded \(p > 1\)) ​与​ Doob ​收敛​三版​ (A2a \(L^1\)-bounded supermart a.s. / A2b UI mart a.s. \(+ L^1\) / A2c \(L^p\)-bounded a.s. \(+ L^p\)) ​的​分立​陈述​在​此​最​清晰​，​与​ §2-§3 ​全节​呼应​。​特别​推荐​给​被​传统​教材​笼统​"by optional sampling"​误导​过​的​读者​。
  • Karatzas-Shreve 1991 Brownian Motion and Stochastic Calculus (R20, Springer GTM 113)。★★★。Thread B ​标准​ reference；usual conditions (​右​连续​ \(+\) ​完备化​) / mart ⊊ local mart ⊊ semimart ​阶梯​ / Doob-Meyer (continuous) ​严​依赖​ class (D) / MRT ​在​ Brownian filtration ​下​的​存在​唯一性​ (\(\xi \in L^2(\mathcal{F}_T^B)\) ​唯一​表示​为​ \(\mathbb{E}\xi + \int_0^T \phi_s\,dB_s\), \(\phi \in H^2\))，​与​ §5-§7 ​全节​呼应​。Ch. 1.4 ​是​ Doob-Meyer continuous ​版​的​标准​转述​。
  • Protter 2004 Stochastic Integration and Differential Equations (2nd ed., R22, Springer)。★★★。semimart-central ​视角​的​ Itô ​积分​与​ \([X]\) vs \(\langle X\rangle\) ​含​跳​情形​ (\([X] = \langle X^c\rangle + \sum (\Delta X)^2\)) ​的​标准​陈述​源​，​与​ §5-§6 + §15 Appendix B F-8 ​直接​呼应​。Ch. III ​完整​给出​ Doob-Meyer continuous ​证明​；​与​ K-S 1991 ​互补​。
  • Pardoux-Peng 1990 Systems & Control Letters 14:55-61 (R19)。★★★。BSDE Lipschitz ​唯一性​ (\(S^2 \times H^2\)) ​的​开山​之作​；Picard ​迭代​ + driver \(f\) ​对​ \((y, z)\) uniformly Lipschitz + ​终值​ \(\xi \in L^2(\mathcal{F}_T)\) + \(\mathbb{E}\int_0^T |f(s, 0, 0)|^2\,ds < \infty\) ​三条​假设​给​唯一​解​ \((Y, Z)\)。​这是​ deep BSDE ​数学​合法性​的​前提​——NN ​在​近似​一个​存在​唯一​的​ reference solution，​与​ §8 / §10(a) / §12 B↔C sub-thesis ​呼应​。
  • El Karoui-Peng-Quenez 1997 Math. Finance 7(1):1-71 (R21)。★★★。BSDE ​在​金融​定价​ / ​对冲​ / ​美式​期权​ / reflected BSDE ​下​的​系统​应用​；comparison theorem ​的​金融​ financial-intuition ​阐释​ + non-linear pricing ​框架​的​标准​ reference；​从​ Thread B ​抽象​ BSDE ​过桥​到​ Thread C ​金融​ BSDE ​的​关键​文献​，​与​ §8 ​后​半​ / §9-§10 ​呼应​。
  • Harrison-Pliska 1981 SPA 11:215-260 (R27)。★★★。FTAP ​思想​原型​（martingale measure ​与​ stochastic integral ​在​连续​交易​理论​中​的​角色​），admissible strategy / ​自​融资​条件​的​早期​形式化​，​与​ §9.1 / §9.2 ​呼应​；​后续​ Dalang-Morton-Willinger 1990 (R28) ​离散​完整版​与​ Delbaen-Schachermayer 1994/1998 (R29) NFLVR ⇔ ELMM continuous ​严格​版均​在​此基础​上​推进​。
  • Snell 1952 Pacific J. Math. 3 (R31)。★★★。optimal stopping ​与​ Snell envelope ​的​奠基​；\(U_t = \mathrm{ess\,sup}_{\tau \geq t} \mathbb{E}^\mathbb{Q}[\cdots]\) ​作为​ smallest \(\mathbb{Q}\)-supermart \(\geq G\) ​的​ backward ​构造​在​此​首次​系统化​，​与​ §9.3 / §10(b)(d) / §12 A↔C sub-thesis ​呼应​；​本​综述​全部​ OS（​经典​ LSM + deep OS）​数学​合法性​的​源头​。

docs.title: Extending — ​现代​扩展​与​ 2024-2026 ​前沿​（​综述​差异化​重心​）
docs.text:
• E-Han-Jentzen 2017 arXiv:1706.04702 (R34) + Han-Jentzen-E 2018 PNAS 115(34):8505-8510 (R35) + Han-Jentzen-E 2025 review arXiv:2505.17032 (R36)。★★★。deep BSDE ​三件套​：​方法​开山​（NN ​沿​时间​网格​前向​逼近​ \(Z_t = \phi(t, S_t; \theta_t)\)，​终值​ mismatch \(\mathbb{E}[(Y_T - g(S_T))^2]\) ​作​ loss + ​全​网格​ SGD）+ PNAS ​高维​ PDE ​系统化​ + 2025 ​八年​回顾​（​路线​综观​）；​与​ §10(a) / §12 B↔C / §14 OS-1 ​直接​呼应​；v4 ​的​算法​重心​，​全部​高维​ BSDE ​应用​文献​的​ reference baseline。
  • Becker-Cheridito-Jentzen 2019 JMLR 20:74 (R37, arXiv:1804.05394)。★★★。deep OS ​方法​开山​（backward stop classifier ​在​每个​时间​网格​点​训练​一个​停止​-​或​-​继续​的​ NN ​决策​器​）；​与​ LSM (R32) ​的​ polynomial basis projection ​形成​ NN ​与​ polynomial ​两条​ OS ​数值​化​路径​。​注意​ Phase 0d F-3 forbidden：2024 expressivity ​文​ ​不是​此三人续​作​，​是​ Gonon ​单作​。​与​ §10(b) ​呼应​。
  • Gonon 2024 Finance and Stochastics 28(3) (R38, doi:10.1007/s00780-024-00538-0, ​单​作者​)。★★★。ReLU NN size \(\leq \kappa d^q \varepsilon^{-r}\) (\(\kappa, q, r\) ​不​依赖​维度​ \(d\)) ​严格​ dim-free expressivity bound — ​比​ deep BSDE ​的​ a posteriori bound ​强​一个​层级​（a priori ​速率​ vs a posteriori ​检验​）；​本​综述​ §10 deep OS ​严谨​度​差异化​的​核心​论文​，​与​ §10(b) / §12 A↔C ​第二段​ / §14 OS-1 ​呼应​。
  • Reppen-Soner 2025 Math. Finance 35 (R39, doi:10.1111/mafi.12450)。★★★。neural OS boundary parametrization — ​不​学​决策​器​，​而是​直接​ NN ​拟合​ free boundary \(\partial\{U_t > G_t\}\)；​与​ R37 ​不同​ modeling ​路线​但同​ problem class，​与​ §10(b) ​呼应​；2025 deep OS ​应用层​迭代​。
  • "Deep Learning for the Multiple Optimal Stopping Problem" 2025 arXiv:2512.22961 (R40, [​作者​待​ verify] — Phase 0a anchor, primary authors ​未​独立​ verify, FC-8 ​范畴​)。★★。multiple-OS ​扩展​（swing options / ​拼装​ callable / ​多重​行权​权利​），​将​ R37/R38/R39 ​单一​停时​ framework ​推到​多​停时​，​与​ §10(b) ​后​半​呼应​。
  • Kidger-Foster-Li-Oberhauser-Lyons 2021 ICML 2021 (R41, arXiv:2102.03657, ICML 2021 not NeurIPS 2020, F-4)。★★★。neural SDE ​作为​无穷​维​ GAN ​的​训练​理论​ + signature kernel discriminator — ​把​ neural SDE ​校准​放进​ GAN ​训练​框架​，​避免​ likelihood-based ​校准​在​ path measure ​上​的​不​可计算性​；​与​ §10(c) / §14 OS-1 ​呼应​。
  • Bayer-Friz-Gatheral 2016 Quant. Finance 16(6):887-904 (R26, doi:10.1080/14697688.2015.1124214)。★★。rough Bergomi ​模型​奠基​（fractional Brownian motion ​驱动​ spot volatility，Hurst \(H < 1/2\)），rough volatility ​系列​的​ modeling ​锚​，​与​ §10(c) ​呼应​。​注意​ FC-8 MIN：primary ​未​独立​ verify ​时​按​ background reference ​强度​引用​。
  • Horvath-Muguruza-Tomas 2021 Quant. Finance 21(1):11-27 (R42)。★★。NN volatility calibration ​系统​比较​ — ​在​ rough Bergomi / Heston / SABR ​等​多个​ surface ​模型​上​做​ NN ​拟合​ + benchmark，rough vol surface ​的​ ML ​拟合​的​标准​ reference，​与​ §10(c) ​呼应​。
  • Kuchibhotla 2024-12 arXiv:2412.20542 (R11) + Ziemann 2024-12 arXiv:2412.20949 (R12) + Akhavan-Shidani-Ayoub-Janz 2025-07 arXiv:2507.20982 (R13)。★★★。self-normalized martingale Bernstein ​三作​并列​：missing-factor (Kuchibhotla, ​修正​经典​ Freedman 1975 ​的​ hidden \(\log\) ​因子​) / vector self-norm via PAC-Bayes prior (Ziemann) / Hilbert/RKHS dim-free (Akhavan et al., resolves open problems by Mussi et al., FC-7) ；​三种​ hypothesis ​不可​笼统​，​与​ §4 / §12 A↔C ​第三段​ ​呼应​；2024-2025 Thread A ​前沿​密度​最高​的​方向​，LinUCB / kernelized UCB / RLHF reward modeling confidence-set ​的​直接​ engine ​升级​路径​。
  • Han-Long 2020 ([​作者​待​ verify] — Phase 0c-C [9] ​引用​为​ Probab. Uncertain. Quant. Risk 5:5, ​未​独立​ primary verify, FC-8 ​范畴​)。★★。deep BSDE a posteriori error bound（\(L^2\) ​损失​下​的​事后​误差​控制​，​不​给​ a priori ​速率​）；Pardoux-Peng ​经典​解​ R19 ​与​ deep BSDE NN ​近似​ R34-R36 ​的​接合点​，​与​ §10(a) / §12 B↔C ​第一段​ / §14 OS-1 ​呼应​。
  • Biagini-Gonon-Mazzon-Meyer-Brandis 2025 Math. Finance 35 (R45, arXiv:2210.01726)。★★。NN classifier ​在​模拟​路径​特征​上​做​ strict-local-mart bubble detection（​即​ \(\mathbb{E}^\mathbb{Q}[\tilde{S}_T] < \tilde{S}_0\) ​区域​的​二​分类​）；​将​ R29 FTAP NFLVR ​框架​下​"bubble = ELMM ​而​非​ EMM"​的​经典​结果​转化​为​可​数据​驱动​的​判别​问题​，​与​ §11(a) ​唯一​呼应​文献​。

docs.title: Foundations — ​方法学​源头
docs.text:
• Itô 1944 Proc. Imp. Acad. Tokyo 20(8):519-524 (R14) + Itô 1951 J. Math. Soc. Japan 3:157-169 (R15)。★★★。stochastic integral ​与​ multiple Wiener integral ​的​原始​两篇​；​与​ §6 ​呼应​；Thread B ​全部​ stochastic calculus ​的​ first-source。Itô isometry \(\mathbb{E}[(\int H\,dM)^2] = \mathbb{E}\int H^2\,d\langle M\rangle\) ​与​ Itô formula \(df(t, X) = \partial_t f\,dt + \partial_x f\,dX + \tfrac{1}{2}\partial_{xx} f\,d\langle X^c\rangle + \text{jumps}\) ​的​原始​形式​即​在​此​两篇​。
  • Meyer 1962-66 Doob-Meyer decomposition papers (R16, Strasbourg)。★★★。Thread B Doob-Meyer (continuous, class (D) ​严​依赖​) ​的​原始​系列​；class (D) ​集合​定义​（\(\{X_\tau : \tau \text{ stopping time}\}\) UI）​作为​唯一性​条件​首次​出现​；​与​ §6 + §15 Appendix B F-9 ​呼应​；​标准​教材​如​ Protter Ch. III / K-S Ch. 1.4 ​转述​这些​原稿​。
  • Bismut 1973 J. Math. Anal. Appl. 44:384-404 (R18)。★★。​最优​ stochastic control ​中​ conjugate convex function ​的​运用​，​是​ Pardoux-Peng 1990 BSDE ​形式化​的​前驱​（adjoint process ​思想​ → BSDE ​反向​方程​）；​与​ §8 historical note ​呼应​。​注意​ FC-8 MIN ​未​独立​ primary verify。
  • Hsu-Kakade-Zhang 2012 Electron. Commun. Probab. 17 (R10, doi:10.1214/ECP.v17-1869, random-matrix Bernstein / PCA / approximate matrix multiplication, NOT SVM tail bounds, F-2)。★★。intrinsic-dimension Bernstein ​与​ random-matrix concentration ​的​标准​ reference（dim ​由​ trace ratio ​替代​ ambient ​维度​）；​与​ §4 ​后​半​ ​呼应​；​常​被​引用​为​"random-matrix Chernoff/Bernstein"​族​的​ intrinsic-dim refinement。
  • Azuma 1967 Tôhoku Math. J. 19 (R4) + Hoeffding 1963 JASA 58 (R3)。★★★。bounded mart-differences concentration ​的​奠基​两篇​——​给出​ \(P(|S_n| > t) \leq 2\exp(-t^2 / 2\sum c_k^2)\) ​形式​ sub-Gaussian tail bound（​注意​ F-6：Azuma ​假设​的​是​ bounded differences \(|d_k| \leq c_k\)，​不是​ bounded \(X_n\)，​混用​是​常见​误读​）；​与​ §4 / §15 Appendix B F-6 ​呼应​；​现代​ self-norm Bernstein (R11/R12/R13) ​都​把​这​两篇​作为​ baseline ​比较​。

docs.title: Cross-domain conceptual references — ​概念​锚​（​综述​中​已​引入​）
docs.text:
• Bellman 1957 Dynamic Programming（Princeton；[​作者​待​ verify primary] — ​古典​ textbook，Phase 0c-C panel ​中​已作​概念​锚​引入​）。★。Snell envelope backward induction \(U_t = \max\{G_t, \mathbb{E}^\mathbb{Q}[U_{t+1} \mid \mathcal{F}_t]\}\) ​与​ Bellman ​方程​ \(V_t = \max\{r_t, \mathbb{E}[V_{t+1}]\}\) ​是​同一​ backward DP ​思想​在​ optimal stopping ​与​ generic MDP ​上​的​两个​实例​；​区别​仅​在​ action set ​是​二元​ (​停​ / ​继续​) ​还是​任意​控制​集​；​与​ §9.3 / §10(b) ​概念​呼应​。​类比​预算​说明​：​本​综述​全文​仅​此​ 1 ​处​使用​"OS ↔ MDP backward DP" ​这​一类​比锚​。
  • Wasserstein gradient flow (Ambrosio-Gigli-Savaré 2008 Gradient Flows in Metric Spaces and in the Space of Probability Measures, Birkhäuser；[​作者​待​ verify primary] — Phase 0c panel cross-domain anchor)。★。neural SDE ​校准​在​ path-measure ​空间​ (Wasserstein-2 metric) ​上​的​ geometric framework；signature MMD / generative finance ​的​ metric ​理论​侧​ reference，​与​ §10(c) / §14 OS-1 ​概念​呼应​。​读者​可​借此​理解​ Kidger et al. 2021 (R41) ​的​ GAN ​训练​目标​在​ path-measure ​上​对应​的​ geometric ​含义​（​虽然​ R41 ​本身​未​显式​诉诸​ Wasserstein flow）。
  • Information geometry / Esscher tilting ([​作者​待​ verify] — Phase 0c-C panel ​中​作为​ RLHF-Girsanov ​形式​同构​的​ dual interpretation ​角度​引入​)。★。DPO ​的​ closed-form \(\pi^* \propto \pi_\mathrm{ref}\exp(r/\beta)\) ​在​指数​族​测度​变换​ (Esscher transform) ​框架​下​的​ dual ​表达​；Esscher 1932 ​在​保险​数学​中​提出​对​寿险​ risk distribution ​的​指数​倾斜​，​与​ Doléans-Dade exponential ​形式​相同​；​这是​ §11(b) ​形式​同构​ hedge (FC-5 CRIT) ​的​概念​框架​；​不可​ ​由此​推断​ RLHF ​严格​继承​ Girsanov ​定理​（F-5 forbidden）—— token-level discrete ​与​ path-space continuous-time ​之间​无​ strict mapping ​是​ §14 open seam 3。

docs.title: Position / Contrarian — ​立场​与​方法学​批评
docs.text:
• "Industrial reality check on deep BSDE / deep OS"（[​文献​待​ verify] — Phase 0c-C panel ​中​作为​ "d ≤ 10 LSM ​仍​ unbeaten" ​立场​引入​，primary review ​未​独立​ verify, ​入​ FC-8）。★。​立场​要点​：deep BSDE / deep OS ​在​ \(d \geq 50\text{-}100\) ​高维​确有​ LSM (R32) basis-projection ​维度​爆炸​所​无法​覆盖​的​优势​区​，​但​在​ \(d \leq 10\) ​中​低维​，​经典​ LSM + Clément-Lamberton-Protter 2002 (R33) ​给出​严格​收敛​证明​ + ​实务​级​ wall-clock + ​鲁棒性​优势​仍​未​被​ NN ​算法​层​颠覆​；​本​综述​ §10(d) ​在​写​到​"deep ​优于​ LSM"​时​必须​区分​维度​区间​，​避免​一概而论​。​与​ §10(d) / §14 OS-1 ​呼应​。
  • Pardoux 1999 monotone BSDE（[​作者​待​ verify primary] — Phase 0c-B R34 ​已​提及​"non-Lipschitz frontier" ​立场​，primary ​未​独立​ verify, ​入​ FC-8）。★。​立场​要点​：BSDE ​唯一性​的​ Lipschitz ​假设​并非​充​要​——monotone in \(y\) (Pardoux 1999) ​与​ quadratic in \(z\) (Kobylanski 2000) ​是​同一​前沿​的​两条​扩展​，​分别​覆盖​效用​最大化​ / risk-sensitive control / ​二次​型​ quadratic hedging ​等​金融​场景​；Phase 1 §8 ​写作​时应​将​"Lipschitz Picard"​与​这些​扩展​严格​分立​，​避免​将​ deep BSDE ​的​合法性​默认​延拓​到​ non-Lipschitz ​区域​ — ​这是​ §14 open seam ​之一​。​与​ §8 ​后​段​ / §14 OS-1 ​呼应​。

docs.title: 阅读​路径​建议
docs.text:
• ​入门​路径​ (Thread A → B)：R1 (Doob 1953 ​概念​奠基​) → R8 (Williams 1991 ​现代​分立​陈述​) → R20 (K-S 1991 Brownian + ​随机​分析​) → R22 (Protter 2004 semimart-central) → R14/R15 (Itô ​原稿​)。​掌握​ measure-theoretic ​骨架​ + Itô calculus ​后​再​进​ R19/R21 BSDE。
  • ​金融​数学​路径​ (Thread C ​经典​)：R27 (Harrison-Pliska 1981 ​思想​原型​) → R28/R29 (FTAP ​离散​ Dalang-Morton-Willinger vs continuous Delbaen-Schachermayer NFLVR ⇔ ELMM) → R30 (numeraire change ​技巧​) → R31 (Snell 1952 OS ​奠基​) → R32+R33 (LSM + ​收敛​证明​)。
  • 2024-2026 ​数值​前沿​路径​ (Thread C v4 ​重心​)：R34 → R35 → R36 (deep BSDE ​三件套​) → R37 → R38 → R39 → R40 (deep OS ​四件​) → R41 → R42 (neural SDE + vol calibration)。BSDE ​与​ OS ​两支​可​并行​读​；neural SDE ​路径​ R41/R42 ​单独​成线​。
  • 2024-2025 concentration ​前沿​路径​ (Thread A)：R3 (Hoeffding 1963) → R4 (Azuma 1967) → R5 (Burkholder 1973) → R6 (Freedman 1975) → R7 (Hall-Heyde 1980 ​教科书​) → R9 (de la Peña-Lai-Shao 2009 self-norm ​系统化​) → R10 (Hsu-Kakade-Zhang 2012 random-matrix intrinsic-dim) → R11/R12/R13 (2024-2025 ​三作​并列​, ​任选​优先​)。
  • cross-thread ​视角​路径​：​先​读本​综述​ §12 ​三组​ sub-thesis (A↔B Doob lift / B↔C Pardoux-Peng → deep BSDE + MRT → hedging + Girsanov → FTAP / A↔C Doob ​收敛​ → LSM + mart concentration → bandit/RLHF)，​再​回头​按​ R# ​补​具体​ reference。

docs.title: v3 → v4 ​读物​迁移​注释
docs.text:
v3 ​综述​偏​经典​金融​数学​教科书​风​（FTAP / Girsanov / Black-Scholes / Snell envelope / bubbles / martingale optimal transport / rough volatility），​其​ reading list ​重心​在​ R20 K-S 1991 / R22 Protter 2004 / R27-R30 FTAP ​经典​群​ / R31 Snell 1952。v4 ​在​保持​ measure-theoretic ​骨架​不变​前提​下​，​新增​ / ​重组​以下​ reading ​重心​：

  • ​新增​"​数值​合法性​桥​"​组​：R19 Pardoux-Peng 1990 BSDE ​的​角色​从​"​金融​ BSDE ​数学​背景​"​升级​为​"deep BSDE NN ansatz ​的​合法性​前提​"（​参见​ §12 B↔C sub-thesis）。​读者​在​ v3 ​中​可能​仅作​金融​ BSDE ​工具​阅读​，v4 ​中​必须​连读​ R34/R35/R36 ​才能​体会​其​作为​ well-posedness anchor ​的​意义​。
  • ​新增​"​高维​ OS ​算法​"​组​：R37 Becker-Cheridito-Jentzen 2019 / R38 Gonon 2024 / R39 Reppen-Soner 2025 / R40 multiple-OS 2025 — v3 ​在​此处​只有​ R32 LSM + R33 ​收敛​证明​这​条​"​中​低维​ OS ​标准​做法​"​线​；v4 ​必须​将​ NN ​路线​与​ polynomial basis ​路线​并列​阅读​，​并​参考​ Position ​类​的​"d ≤ 10 LSM ​仍​ unbeaten" ​立场​避免​一概而论​。
  • ​新增​"non-Markov rough vol"​组​：R26 Bayer-Friz-Gatheral 2016 / R41 Kidger et al. 2021 / R42 Horvath-Muguruza-Tomas 2021 — v3 ​中​ rough vol ​仅作​ modeling ​子​话题​，v4 ​上升​为​ §10(c) ​独立​子节​，​并​与​ signature kernel / neural SDE ​的​训练​理论​合并​阅读​。
  • ​新增​"2024-2025 concentration ​前沿​"​组​：R11/R12/R13 ​三作​ — v3 ​没有​此组​；v4 §4 ​将​其​与​ R3-R10 ​经典​ concentration ​串成​完整​线​，bandit / RLHF ​的​ confidence-set engine ​升级​路径​在​此​显现​。
  • ​新增​"​概念​同构​ hedge"​组​：R46 Rafailov 2023 DPO + R47 C2-DPO 2025 — v3 ​无此​组​；v4 §11(b) ​引入​但​严格​ hedge (FC-5)，​不可​读作​"RLHF ≡ Girsanov" — ​见​上方​易错​点​ F-5。

docs.title: 易错​点​检查​清单​ (​与​ §15 Appendix B forbidden list ​配对​)
docs.text:
​读​上述​任一​文献​时​若想​引用​进​ v4 ​这种​"​测度论​严格​ + ​算法​层​前沿​"​的​综述​，​建议​对照​ Phase 0d §6 forbidden ​列表​逐项​自查​：

  • F-1 / FC-1 CRIT: arXiv:2210.07045 = Ouwehand 2022 Enlargement of Filtrations — A Primer (R48)，​不是​ Aksamit-Jeanblanc 2022 arXiv ​综述​；Aksamit-Jeanblanc ​的​著作​是​ Springer 2017 Enlargement of Filtration with Finance in View，​本​综述​未​独立​ primary verify，​引用​时​占位​。
  • F-2 / FC-2 MAJ: Hsu-Kakade-Zhang 2012 ECP (R10) ​是​ random-matrix Bernstein / PCA / approximate matrix multiplication，​不是​ SVM tail bounds（​互联网​上​有​此​误传​）。
  • F-3 / FC-3 MAJ: Finance and Stochastics 28(3) 2024 expressivity ​文是​ Lukas Gonon ​单作​ (R38)，​不是​ Becker-Cheridito-Jentzen ​续作​；​连写​"Becker-Cheridito-Jentzen-Gonon"​是​错误​归并​。
  • F-4 / FC-4 MAJ: Kidger et al. Neural SDEs as Infinite-Dimensional GANs (R41) ​是​ ICML 2021 (arXiv:2102.03657)，​不是​ NeurIPS 2020；NeurIPS 2020 ML4PS workshop ​仅​有​预览版​。
  • F-5 / FC-5 CRIT (concept): RLHF-DPO ​与​ Girsanov-Doléans-Dade ​在​指数​倾斜​密度​上仅​有​ ​形式​同构​ (formal analogy)，​不是​ isomorphism；token-level discrete ​与​ path-space continuous-time ​之间​无​ strict mapping (§14 open seam 3)；​任何​"RLHF ​因此​继承​ Girsanov ​定理​ X"​的​推论​ forbidden。
  • F-6 / FC-6 MAJ: Azuma-Hoeffding ​假设​是​ bounded mart differences \(|d_k| \leq c_k\)，​不是​ bounded \(X_n\)；​后者​非​充分条件​。
  • F-7: ​任何​ OST ​引用​必须​明确​ OST-1 / OST-2 / OST-3 / OST-4 ​哪一版​；"by optional sampling" ​笼统​引用​不​接受​。
  • F-8: \([X]_t = \langle X\rangle_t\) ​仅​在​ continuous local mart（​或​更​一般​ quasi-left-continuous）​成立​；​存在​跳时​ \([X] = \langle X^c\rangle + \sum (\Delta X)^2 \neq \langle X\rangle\)。
  • F-9: Doob-Meyer ​必须​区分​ discrete (​无需​ class (D)) vs continuous (​严​依赖​ class (D))。
  • F-10: Novikov ⊊ Kazamaki ​严格​真​包含​（​反向​不​成立​, Kazamaki 1977 R23）；​平列​写法​须​附​ "Novikov ​更强​、Kazamaki ​更弱​" ​限定​。

docs.title: Martingale ​及其​在​金融​理论​中​的​作用
引言
docs.text:
​今天​你​应该​为​一份​合约​支付​多少​钱​——​如果​股票​上涨​就​获得​二十​美元​，​如果​下跌​则​一无所获​——​为什么​答案​与​股票​上涨​的​概率​毫无关系​？

Martingale ​是​一种​ stochastic process，​其​未来​的​条件期望​在​给定​过去​信息​的​条件​下​等于​当前​值​。​它​最初​被​形式化​为​公平​博弈​的​模型​——​没有​系统性​漂移​的​过程​——​而​这​同一​结构​，​当​应用​于​精心​选择​的​概率​测度​下​的​资产​价格​而​非​博弈​时​，​恰好​等价​于​ arbitrage ​的​不​存在​。​这一​联系​是​现代​衍生品​定价​的​基石​，​也​可能​是从​概率论​通往​量化​金融​最​直接​的​路径​。

​这一​联系​的​深度​怎么​强调​都​不为过​。​经典​资产​定价​理论​中​的​每​一个​核心​结果​——Black-Scholes ​公式​、American option ​的​定价​、market completeness ​的​刻画​、insider trading ​的​数学​形式化​、​以及​ price bubbles ​的​严格​定义​——​其本质​都​是​关于​ martingale ​的​定理​。​正如​ Delbaen ​和​ Schachermayer ​在​其​专著​ The Mathematics of Arbitrage (2006) ​中所言​，​资产​定价​理论​在​精确​意义​上​就是​ martingale measure ​的​理论​。

​本文​的​目标​是从​基本原理​出发​建立​这一​联系​。​我们​从​ martingale ​的​定义​开始​，​经过​ Fundamental Theorems of Asset Pricing，​最终​抵达​衍生品​定价​、optimal exercise ​及其​他​具体​应用​。​本文​假设​读者​熟悉​测度论​概率​（filtration、​条件期望​、\(L^p\) ​空间​），​但​不​要求​具备​金融学​方面​的​背景​知识​。

docs.title: 形式化​预备​知识
docs.text:
​设​ \((\Omega, \mathcal{F}, \{\mathcal{F}_t\}_{t \geq 0}, \mathbb{P})\) ​为​满足​ usual conditions ​的​ filtered probability space：filtration ​满足​右​连续性​且​完备​（\(\mathcal{F}\) ​中​每个​ \(\mathbb{P}\)-​零测集​都​属于​ \(\mathcal{F}_0\)）。​右​连续性​确保​ stopping time ​表现​良好​——​过程​首次​进入​某​集合​的​时刻​是​可测​的​。​完备​性​排除​了​条件期望​中​的​测度论​边角​情形​（​例如​，​它​保证​ adapted process ​的​修正​仍然​是​ adapted ​的​）。​与​ \(\{\mathcal{F}_t\}\) adapted ​的​ stochastic process \(\{M_t\}_{t \geq 0}\) ​称为​关于​ \(\mathbb{P}\) ​的​ martingale，​如果​：

\[\mathbb{E}[|M_t|] < \infty \quad \text{for all } t \geq 0, \tag{1}\] \[\mathbb{E}[M_t \mid \mathcal{F}_s] = M_s \quad \text{for all } 0 \leq s \leq t. \tag{2}\]

​将​条件​ (2) ​中​的​等​号​替换​为​ \(\leq\)（​或​ \(\geq\)）​即​得到​ supermartingale（​或​ submartingale）。Filtration \(\{\mathcal{F}_t\}\) ​编码​了​时刻​ \(t\) ​可​获取​的​信息​。​在​金融​应用​中​，​这​通常​代表​截至​时刻​ \(t\) ​可​观测​的​市场​量​的​历史​——​价格​、​成交量​及其​他​信号​。

​每个​ submartingale ​都​是​ semimartingale——​即可​分解​为​一个​ local martingale ​加上​一个​有限​变差​过程​的​过程​。Semimartingale ​是​随机​积分​有​良好​定义​的​最​一般​过程​类​，​也​是​ Fundamental Theorems of Asset Pricing ​的​自然​栖居​地​。

Local martingale。 ​在​连续​时间​框架​下​，martingale ​与​ local martingale ​之间​存在​一个​意义​深远​的​区别​。Local martingale ​是​指​存在​一个​递增​的​ stopping time ​序列​ \(\tau_n \uparrow \infty\)，​使得​每个​ stopped process \(\{X_{t \wedge \tau_n}\}\) ​都​是​ true martingale ​的​过程​ \(\{X_t\}\)。​非正式​地说​，local martingale ​在​"​局部​"​上​是​ martingale，​但​可能​不​满足​全局​可积性​条件​。​具体来说​：​一个​初值​ \(X_0 = 1\) ​的​ local martingale \(X\) ​可以​满足​在​某个​ \(T > 0\) ​下​ \(\mathbb{E}[X_T] < 1\)，​这​意味着​质量​沿​某些​路径​"​泄漏​"​到​无穷​远处​，​导致​条件期望​性质​在​长期​尺度​上​崩溃​。​每个​ true martingale ​都​是​ local martingale，​但​反之​不然​。​这一​区别​在​入门​课程​中​似乎​只是​技术细节​，​但​它​具有​直接​的​金融​含义​：​不是​ true martingale ​的​ local martingale ​正是​ price bubbles ​的​数学​标志​，​这​将​在​后文​展开讨论​。

docs.title: 动机​实例​：Binomial Model
docs.text:
​在​进入​一般性​结果​之前​，​考虑​一个​单期​市场​。​一只​股票​今天​的​价格​为​ \(S_0 = 100\)。​明天​它​要么​涨​到​ \(S_1 = 120\)（​在​ \(\mathbb{P}\) ​下​的​概率​为​ \(p\)），​要么​跌​到​ \(S_1 = 80\)（​概率​为​ \(1-p\)）。​无风险​债券​的​利率​为​ \(r = 5\%\)，​因此​今天​的​一​美元​明天​变为​ \(1.05\) ​美元​。

​假设​ \(p = 0.6\)。​那么​ \(\mathbb{E}^{\mathbb{P}}[S_1] = 0.6 \times 120 + 0.4 \times 80 = 104\)。​由于​ \(104 < 100 \times 1.05 = 105\)，​在​ \(\mathbb{P}\) ​下​股票​的​期望​收益率​低于​无风险​利率​。​关键在于​，​在​物理​测度​ \(\mathbb{P}\) ​下​，​股票价格​通常​不是​ martingale——​投资者​要求​获得​承担风险​的​补偿​，​因此​期望​收益率​反映​了​风险​溢价​。

​现在​问​：​是否​存在​一个​概率​测度​ \(\mathbb{Q}\)，​使得​折现​后​的​股票价格​ \(\tilde{S}_t = S_t / (1+r)^t\) ​是​ martingale？​我们​需要​：

\[\mathbb{E}^{\mathbb{Q}}[\tilde{S}_1] = \tilde{S}_0 \implies q \cdot \frac{120}{1.05} + (1-q) \cdot \frac{80}{1.05} = 100. \tag{3}\]

​求解​得​：\(q = (100 \times 1.05 - 80)/(120 - 80) = 25/40 = 0.625\)。​这个​ \(\mathbb{Q}\)——equivalent martingale measure (EMM)——​存在​且​唯一​。​有​一个​未知数​（\(q\)）​和​一个​方程​，​因此​该​测度​被​精确​确定​。​在​ \(\mathbb{Q}\) ​下​，​折现​价格​按​构造​就是​ martingale。

\(\mathbb{Q}\) ​带来​了​什么​？​考虑​一个​执行​价​ \(K = 100\) ​的​ European call option：​持有者​明天​将​获得​ \((S_1 - 100)^+\)。（Call option ​赋予​持有者​以​价格​ \(K\) ​在​到期日​购买​股票​的​权利​而​非​义务​。​其​收益​为​股票价格​超过​ \(K\) ​的​部分​，​若​股票​最终​低于​ \(K\) ​则​为​零​。）​在​ \(\mathbb{Q}\) ​下​，​期权​价格​就是​折现​后​的​期望​收益​：

\[V_0 = \frac{1}{1.05}\left[0.625 \times 20 + 0.375 \times 0\right] = \frac{12.5}{1.05} \approx 11.90.\]

​这个​价格​与​ \(p\) ​无关​——​它​仅​取决于​ \(r\)、\(S_0\) ​和​ \(S_1\) ​的​可能​取值​。​它​也​等于​通过​交易​股票​和​债券​来​复制​期权​收益​的​成本​。

​测度​ \(\mathbb{Q}\) ​不是​对​未来​的​预测​。 ​它​是​一种​计算​工具​，​编码​了​ no-arbitrage ​定价​关系​。​物理​概率​ \(p = 0.6\) ​决定​了​哪些​结果​可能​发生​；risk-neutral ​概率​ \(q = 0.625\) ​决定​了​为​这些​结果​投保​的​成本​。​将​二者​混淆​——​把​ \(\mathbb{Q}\) ​当作​预测​——​是​量化​金融​中​最​常见​的​误解​之一​。

​为什么​ \(p\) ​消失​了​？​复制​组合​论证​给出​了​最​清晰​的​回答​。​为了​复制​该​ call option，​持有​ \(\Delta\) ​份​股票​和​ \(B\) ​美元​债券​。​我们​需要​ \(120\Delta + 1.05B = 20\)（​上涨​状态​）​和​ \(80\Delta + 1.05B = 0\)（​下跌​状态​）。​求解​得​ \(\Delta = 0.5\)，\(B \approx -36.28\)。​该​组合​的​成本​为​ \(50 - 36.28 \approx 11.90\)——​与​之前​相同​，​完全​由​ no-arbitrage ​条件​决定​，​无需​参考​ \(p\)。​测度​ \(\mathbb{Q}\) ​只是​将​这​一​复制​论证​封装​为​概率​语言​。

Binomial model ​中​的​ completeness。 ​上面​ \(\mathbb{Q}\) ​的​唯一性​并非​偶然​。​两种​可能​状态​加上​两种​金融工具​（​股票​和​债券​），​方程组​恰好​有​唯一​解​。​如果​股票​明天​可以​取​三个​值​——​比如​ 120、100 ​或​ 80——​那么​有​两个​未知数​（\(q_1, q_2\)，​其中​ \(q_3 = 1 - q_1 - q_2\)）​但​仍​只有​一个​ martingale ​方程​。​系统​将​是​欠定​的​：​存在​多个​ EMM，​市场​将​是​incomplete ​的​。​这个​简单​的​计数​论证​——​未知数​个数​与​约束​个数​之​比​——​正是​ Second Fundamental Theorem ​的​离散​原型​。

​这个​单期​例子​在精神上​源于​ Cox, Ross, and Rubinstein (1979)，​它​包含​了​一般​理论​的​所有​核心思想​。​扩展​到​ \(n\) ​期​得到​ binomial tree model；​当​ \(n \to \infty\) ​并​进行​适当​的​尺度​变换​时​，​便​恢复​了​ Black-Scholes model——​这一​收敛​结果​由​ Cox, Ross, and Rubinstein ​本人​形式化​，​后续​作者​进一步​完善​。​本文​余下​部分​将​其​推广​到​连续​时间​。

docs.title: Efficient Markets ​与​ Martingale ​假说
docs.text:
​下​一节​——Fundamental Theorem of Asset Pricing——​的​推导​是​一个​形式化​结果​，​但​其​概念​根源​在于​一个​悠久​的​实证​传统​。​本节​在​回到​形式​论证​之前​勾勒​这一​传统​。

Martingale ​通过​ Samuelson 1965 ​年​的​论文​ "Proof that Properly Anticipated Prices Fluctuate Randomly" ​进入​金融​经济学​。Samuelson ​证明​，​在​信息​上​有效​的​市场​中​，​在​对​贴现率​的​某些​条件​下​，​期货价格​（​而​非​现货​价格​，​尽管​有时​被​误述​）​应当​服从​ martingale。​直觉​很​直接​：​如果​明天​价格​的​条件期望​偏离​了​今天​的​价格​，​交易者​就​能​利用​这种​系统性​偏差​获利​。​在​一个​有效​市场​中​，​这种​机会​会​被​竞争​消除​，​使得​价格​不再​有​可​预测​的​漂移​。

Samuelson ​的​洞见​建立​在​ Bachelier (1900) ​的​早期​工作​之上​，​后者​将​股票价格​建模​为​算术​ Brownian motion——​实质​上​是​ martingale，​尽管​该​概念​当时​尚未​以​现代​形式​存在​。​学术​脉络​从​ Bachelier ​出发​，​经过​ Doob ​在​ 1940 ​和​ 1950 ​年代​对​ martingale ​理论​的​形式化​，​到​ Samuelson ​的​经济学​应用​，​最终​到​ Harrison and Kreps (1979) ​的​综合​工作​，​将​整个​框架​建立​在​严格​的​测度论​基础​之上​。

​这一​推理​支撑​了​ Efficient Market Hypothesis (EMH) ​的​半强​形式​：​所有​公开​可得​的​信息​已​被​反映​在​价格​中​。​然而​，​正如​ binomial ​例子​所示​，​资产​价格​在​物理​测度​ \(\mathbb{P}\) ​下​通常​不是​ martingale。​投资者​要求​获得​承担风险​的​补偿​。​一般而言​，\(\mathbb{P}\) ​下​的​价格​是​具有​漂移​项​的​ semimartingale，​漂移​项​反映​了​无风险​利率​和​风险​溢价​。​历史​上​美国股市​约​ 4–8% ​的​年化​权益​溢价​，​恰恰​反映​了​ \(\mathbb{P}\) ​下​ martingale ​性质​的​这种​偏离​。

​要​解决​这​一张​力​，​需要​改变​的​不是​过程​本身​，​而是​概率​测度​。​这一​解决方案​背后​的​形式​理论​就是​下​一节​的​主题​。

docs.title: The First Fundamental Theorem of Asset Pricing
docs.text:
​核心​问题​是​：​在​什么​条件​下​ equivalent martingale measure ​存在​？​它​的​存在​在​经济学​上​意味着​什么​？

​我们​首先​需要​交易​策略​和​ arbitrage ​的​精确​概念​。Self-financing strategy ​是​一个​投资​组合​ \(\phi = (\phi^0_t, \phi^1_t, \ldots, \phi^d_t)\)，​指定​在​债券​和​ \(d\) ​种​风险​资产​上​的​持仓​，​其​价值​过程​ \(V_t(\phi) = \phi^0_t B_t + \sum_{i=1}^d \phi^i_t S^i_t\) ​满足​：

\[dV_t = \phi^0_t \, dB_t + \sum_{i=1}^d \phi^i_t \, dS^i_t. \tag{4}\]

​条件​ (4) ​表明​投资​组合​价值​的​变化​完全​来自​资产​价格​的​变化​——​没有​外部​现金​注入​或​提取​。​它​是​一个​守恒​律​：​投资​组合​对外部​资金流​封闭​。Admissible strategy ​还​要求​财富​过程​有​下界​：\(V_t \geq -c\)，​其中​ \(c\) ​为​某​常数​。​这一​条件​排除​了​ doubling strategy——​依靠​无限​借贷​来​保证​盈利​的​策略​（​类似​于​每次​亏损​后​加倍​赌注​的​ martingale ​博弈​策略​）。​从​经济学​角度看​，admissibility ​条件​是​一种​信用​约束​：​没有​交易​对手​方会​提供​无限​信用​。

​在​金融市场​中​，arbitrage ​是​一种​ admissible self-financing strategy \(\phi\)，​初始​成本​ \(V_0(\phi) = 0\)，​终端​价值​ \(V_T(\phi) \geq 0\) ​几乎​必然​成立​，​且​ \(\mathbb{P}(V_T(\phi) > 0) > 0\)。​用​语言​来说​：​一种​零​成本​、​永不​亏损​、​且​有时​盈利​的​策略​。

The First Fundamental Theorem of Asset Pricing ​建立​了​如下​等价关系​：

​定理​ (Harrison-Pliska 1981)： ​在​有限​离散​时间​市场​中​，​模型​无​ arbitrage ​当且​仅​当​存在​一个​与​ \(\mathbb{P}\) ​等价​的​概率​测度​ \(\mathbb{Q} \sim \mathbb{P}\)——​与​ \(\mathbb{P}\) ​有​相同​零测集​——​使得​折现​后​的​资产​价格​是​ martingale。

​要求​ \(\mathbb{Q}\) ​与​ \(\mathbb{P}\) ​等价​（​而​非​仅仅​绝对​连续​，\(\mathbb{Q} \ll \mathbb{P}\)）​是​本质性​的​。​等价​意味着​ \(\mathbb{Q}\) ​和​ \(\mathbb{P}\) ​在​哪些​事件​可能​发生​上​意见​一致​：\(\mathbb{Q}(A) = 0\) ​当且​仅​当​ \(\mathbb{P}(A) = 0\)。​我们​需要​两个​方向​都​成立​，​因为​理论​要求​在​两个​测度​之间​来回​切换​。​定价​在​ \(\mathbb{Q}\) ​下​进行​，​但​ hedging ​和​风险​评估​在​ \(\mathbb{P}\) ​下​进行​。​如果​ \(\mathbb{Q}\) ​仅​关于​ \(\mathbb{P}\) ​绝对​连续​，​则​一个​ \(\mathbb{P}\)-​可能​事件​可能​有​零​ \(\mathbb{Q}\)-​概率​，​定价​测度​就​会​遗漏​真实世界​中​的​场景​。

​三个​不同​的​结果​逐步​递进​，​构成​了​完整​的​ FTAP：

Harrison and Kreps (1979) ​建立​了​ no-arbitrage ​与​正​线性​定价​泛函​存在​性​之间​的​联系​，​使用​了​一般​概率​空间​上​的​有序​拓扑​向量​空间​框架​。Harrison and Pliska (1981) ​给出​了​有限​离散​时间​市场​的​精确​ EMM ​表述​，​即​上述​定理​。Dalang, Morton, and Willinger (1990) ​将​其​推广​到​离散​时间​的​一般​（​无限​）​概率​空间​——​这一​证明​出人意料​地​微妙​，​需要​用到​可测​选择​定理​，​尤其​当​资产​数​ \(d \geq 2\) ​时​。

​一般​的​连续​时间​版本​由​ Delbaen and Schachermayer (1994) ​建立​，​将​ "no arbitrage" ​替换​为​更​强​的​条件​ "no free lunch with vanishing risk" (NFLVR)。​这一​强化​是​实质性​的​，​而​非​仅仅​是​技术性​的​。​在​连续​时间​中​，​可以​构造​一系列​ admissible strategy，​其​风险​在​极限​中​趋于​零​但​期望​收益​不​趋于​零​。​给​一个​具体​图景​：​考虑​一系列​卖出​越来越​深度​虚值​ call option ​的​策略​，​每​一个​只​在​越来越​不​可能​的​场景​中​亏损​，​同时​收取​趋向​正​极限​的​权利金​。​每个​单独​的​策略​都​有​一定​风险​，​但​风险​在​序列​上​缩减​为​零​。NFLVR ​排除​了​所有​这种​极限​构型​。Delbaen-Schachermayer ​定理​建立​了​ NFLVR ​等价​于​等价​ local martingale measure ​存在​性​的​结论​。

​值得​指出​的​是​，​分解​ NFLVR = NA + NA1（​其中​ NA1 ​是​ "no arbitrage of the first kind"，​也​称​ "no unbounded profit with bounded risk"）​本身​就是​一个​非​平凡​的​结果​。​这​由​ Takaoka (2013) ​和​ Kardaras (2013) ​建立​，​在​原始​ Delbaen-Schachermayer ​工作​之后​数十年​。

​在​ 1998 ​年​将​结果​推广​到​无界​过程​的​工作​中​，Delbaen and Schachermayer ​进一步​精炼​了​这​一​结果​：NFLVR ​等价​于​等价​ sigma-martingale measure ​的​存在​。Sigma-martingale ​是​一个​可​预测​过程​关于​ local martingale ​的​随机​积分​，​其中​被积​函数​严格​为​正​——​它​是​比​ local martingale ​严格​更广​的​类​。​然而​，​对于​ locally bounded semimartingale（​在​紧​时间​区间​上​跳跃​有界​的​过程​——​这一​条件​被​大多数​连续​路径​模型​和​实践​中​使用​的​许多​ jump-diffusion model ​所​满足​），sigma-martingale measure ​与​ local martingale measure ​一致​。​在​这种​情况​下​区分​消失​，​可以​始终​使用​ local martingale measure。

​为什么​ martingale ​性质​编码​了​ no-arbitrage？ ​正​方向​是​优美​的​，​值得​深入​理解​。​如果​折现​价格​是​ \(\mathbb{Q}\)-martingale，​那么​任何​ self-financing、admissible ​投资​组合​的​折现​价值​也​是​ \(\mathbb{Q}\)-martingale。​这​来自​ martingale transform ​性质​：​在​适当​可积性​条件​下​，​关于​ martingale ​的​随机​积分​本身​也​是​ martingale。​从零开始​的​ martingale ​满足​ \(\mathbb{E}^{\mathbb{Q}}[V_T] = V_0 = 0\)。​如果​另外​ \(V_T \geq 0\) ​几乎​必然​成立​，​那么​一个​非负​、​期望​为​零​的​随机变量​必须​几乎​必然​为​零​。Arbitrage ​无处​容身​。

​反​方向​——no-arbitrage ​蕴含​ \(\mathbb{Q}\) ​的​存在​——​更为​深刻​。​它​依赖于​泛函​分析​中​的​ Hahn-Banach ​分离​定理​。​其​思想​是​分离​两个​凸集​：​零​成本​可​达​收益​的​锥​，​以及​正​象限​（​代表​ arbitrage ​利润​）。​在​有限​维中​，​标准​的​ Hahn-Banach ​定理​就​足够​了​。​在​无限​维​——​连续​时间​设定​中​——​论证​需要​ Kreps-Yan ​推广​，​它​处理​了​ \(L^0\) ​和​ \(L^\infty\) ​空间​的​拓扑​微妙​性​。​分离​超平面​被​辨识​为​一个​正​线性​泛函​，​通过​ Riesz representation theorem ​得到​一个​概率​测度​。​这一​联系​表明​，FTAP ​本质​上​是​一个​对偶​结果​，​结构​上​等同于​锥​线性规划​中​的​强​对偶​。

FTAP ​的​威力​在于​这座​桥梁​：​一个​经济​条件​（no arbitrage）​被​转化​为​一个​测度论​条件​（\(\mathbb{Q}\) ​的​存在​），​而​后者​更​易于​数学分析​。

docs.title: Girsanov ​定理​：​构造​ Risk-Neutral Measure
docs.text:
FTAP ​告诉​我们​ EMM ​存在​；Girsanov ​定理​告诉​我们​如何​构造​它​。​在​连续​时间​中​，​假设​股票价格​在​ \(\mathbb{P}\) ​下​满足​

\[dS_t = \mu_t S_t \, dt + \sigma_t S_t \, dW_t \tag{5}\]

​其中​ \(W_t\) ​是​标准​ Brownian motion。​漂移​项​ \(\mu_t\) ​编码​了​期望​收益率​（​包含​风险​溢价​），\(\sigma_t\) ​是​波动​率​。

​为了​定价​衍生品​，​我们​需要​在​一个​测度​ \(\mathbb{Q}\) ​下​的​动力学​，​使得​折现​价格​无​漂移​——​即​为​ martingale。Girsanov ​定理​提供​了​这​一​机制​。​定义​ market price of risk：

\[\theta_t = \frac{\mu_t - r}{\sigma_t}, \tag{6}\]

​它​度量​了​每​单位​波动​率​的​超额​收益​——​市场​对​承担​一​单位​风险​要求​的​补偿​。​资产​的​ Sharpe ratio ​是​期望​超额​收益​除以​收益​的​标准差​；​在​单​资产​、​单​ Brownian motion ​模型​中​，\(\theta_t\) ​恰好​等于​ Sharpe ratio。​在​多因子​模型​中​，market price of risk ​形成​向量​ \(\boldsymbol{\theta}_t = (\theta^1_t, \ldots, \theta^d_t)\)，​每个​分量​对应​一个​独立​的​随机性​来源​，​而​ Sharpe ratio ​是​其模​ \(\|\boldsymbol{\theta}_t\|\)。

​在​由​ Radon-Nikodym ​导数​（Doleans-Dade stochastic exponential）​定义​的​ \(\mathbb{Q}\) ​下​：

\[\frac{d\mathbb{Q}}{d\mathbb{P}}\bigg|_{\mathcal{F}_T} = \mathcal{E}\!\left(-\int_0^{\cdot} \theta_s \, dW_s\right)_T = \exp\!\left(-\int_0^T \theta_s \, dW_s - \frac{1}{2}\int_0^T \theta_s^2 \, ds\right), \tag{7}\]

​过程​ \(\tilde{W}_t = W_t + \int_0^t \theta_s \, ds\) ​是​标准​ Brownian motion。​在​这​一新​坐标​下​，​股票​动力学​变为​

\[dS_t = r S_t \, dt + \sigma_t S_t \, d\tilde{W}_t. \tag{8}\]

​漂移​项​被​替换​为​无风险​利率​ \(r\)。​风险​溢价​被​吸收​到​测度​变换​中​。​在实践中​，​这​就是​ risk-neutral pricing ​的​核心​：​物理​漂移​ \(\mu\) ​对​衍生品​价格​无关紧要​。​只有​波动​率​ \(\sigma\) ​和​无风险​利率​ \(r\) ​起​作用​。

​波动​率​不变性​。 ​一个​关键​且​在实践中​非常​重要​的​观察​是​，\(\sigma_t\) ​在​方程​ (5) ​和​ (8) ​中以​相同​的​值​出现​。Girsanov ​定理​保持​二次​变差​不变​，​因此​在​任何​等价​测度​变换​下​扩散系数​不变​。​这​意味着​已​实现​波动​率​可以​从​历史​（​物理​测度​）​数据​中​估计​，​并​直接​用于​ risk-neutral pricing——​波动​率​参数​不​需要​测度​校正​。​这种​不变性​在​统计​估计​和​定价​之间​建立​了​桥梁​。

​这​一点​在实践中​尤为重要​还有​更​深层​的​原因​。​漂移​项​从​数据​中​极难​估计​：​可靠​的​估计​需要​很长​的​时间​序列​，​因为​在​短​区间​内​漂移​信号​被​扩散​噪声​淹没​。​相比之下​，​扩散系数​可以​从​短​窗口​的​高频​数据​中​精确​估计​。Girsanov ​框架​恰好​利用​了​这种​不对称性​：​定价​依赖于​ \(\sigma\)（​在​ \(\mathbb{P}\) ​下​容易​估计​）​而​不​依赖于​ \(\mu\)（​在​ \(\mathbb{P}\) ​下​难以估计​）。

​有效性​条件​。 Novikov condition ​和​ Kazamaki condition ​都​是​对​ market price of risk \(\theta_t\) ​增长​的​上界​，​确保​ (7) ​中​的​ stochastic exponential ​是​ true martingale，​从而​ \(\mathbb{Q}\) ​是​有效​的​概率​测度​。Novikov condition——\(\mathbb{E}^{\mathbb{P}}[\exp(\frac{1}{2}\int_0^T \theta_s^2 \, ds)] < \infty\)——​是​充分​但​非必要​的​。Kazamaki condition——\(\mathcal{E}(-\int_0^{\cdot} \theta_s \, dW_s)\) ​是​ uniformly integrable martingale——​严格​更弱​：​满足​ Novikov condition ​的​每个​过程​也​满足​ Kazamaki condition，​但​反之​不然​。​当​两个​条件​都​不​满足​时​，stochastic exponential ​可能​是​ strict local martingale。​在​这种​情况​下​，"​测度​" \(\mathbb{Q}\) ​赋予​的​总​质量​小于​一​，​不是​有效​的​概率​测度​。​这种​失效​与​下文​讨论​的​ bubbles ​理论​相关​。

Exponential martingale ​与​ exponential tilting。 (7) ​中​的​ Radon-Nikodym ​导数​ \(d\mathbb{Q}/d\mathbb{P}\) ​在结构上​与​大偏差​理论​（Cramer ​定理​）​和​ Monte Carlo ​模拟​中​ importance sampling ​使用​的​ exponential tilting ​完全相同​。

​在​所有​三种​情境​——​定价​、​稀有​事件​分析​、​方差​缩减​——​中​，​人们​重新​加权​概率​以​强调​某些​结果​。​密度​函数​降低​了​ \(W\) ​向上​漂移​路径​的​权重​，​提高​了​向下​漂移​路径​的​权重​，​从而​移动​了​平均​轨迹​。​在​定价​情境​中​，​被​强调​的​结果​是​那些​资产​按​无风险​利率​增长​的​路径​。​在​ importance sampling ​中​，​被​强调​的​是​人们​希望​有效​估计​的​稀有​事件​。Glasserman (2003) ​大量​利用​这一​联系​来​实现​高效​的​ Monte Carlo ​衍生品​定价​。

​关于​术语​的​说明​：\(\mathbb{Q}\) ​常​被​称为​ "risk-neutral measure"，​这一​称呼​出于​历史​原因​沿用至今​，​但​可能​产生​误导​。​测度​ \(\mathbb{Q}\) ​并​不​预设​市场​参与者​对​风险​无所谓​。​它​是从​ no-arbitrage ​条件​推导​出​的​数学​构造​。"Equivalent martingale measure" ​是​更​精确​的​术语​。​正如​ Bjork (2009) ​指出​的​，​称​ \(\mathbb{Q}\) ​为​ risk-neutral measure ​容易​让​人​误以为​该​理论​假设​了​风险​中性​的​投资者​，​而​事实上​它​只​假设​了​ arbitrage ​的​不​存在​。

docs.title: Change of Numeraire
docs.text:
Numeraire ​是​用作​计价​单位​的​正值​资产​——​价格​的​"​度量​尺​"。​上述​ Girsanov ​构造​使用​货币​市场​账户​ \(B_t = e^{rt}\) ​作为​ numeraire，​产生​了​ risk-neutral measure \(\mathbb{Q}\)。​但​这​一​原理​更为​一般​：​任何​正值​的​可​交易​资产​都​可以​充当​ numeraire，​每种​选择​都​诱导​出其​自身​的​等价​测度​。

​有​一点​需要​在​逻辑​上​澄清​。\(\mathbb{Q}\) ​的​存在​本身​由​ FTAP（​上​一节​）​保证​。Change-of-numeraire ​技术​以​ \(\mathbb{Q}\) ​的​存在​为​前提​，​从中​构造​新​测度​ \(\mathbb{Q}^N\)。​逻辑​链条​是​：no-arbitrage \(\Rightarrow\) FTAP \(\Rightarrow\) \(\mathbb{Q}\) ​存在​ \(\Rightarrow\) numeraire ​变换​产生​ \(\mathbb{Q}^N\)。

​测度​变换​公式​背后​的​直觉​是​：​从以​债券​为​单位​度量​财富​切换​到​以​其他​资产​ \(N\) ​为​单位​度量​财富​，​相当于​按​因子​ \(N_T / B_T\)（​归一化​后​的​初始值​）​进行​缩放​。​这个​因子​恰好​是​定义新​测度​的​ Radon-Nikodym ​导数​。

Geman, El Karoui, and Rochet (1995) ​系统化​了​这​一​ change of numeraire technique。​核心​结果​是​：

​若​ \(N_t > 0\) ​是​可​交易​资产​，​定义​ \(\mathbb{Q}^N\) ​为​ \(\frac{d\mathbb{Q}^N}{d\mathbb{Q}}\big|_{\mathcal{F}_T} = \frac{N_T / N_0}{B_T / B_0}\)。​那么​对​任何​可​交易​资产​ \(S_t\)，​比率​ \(S_t / N_t\) ​是​ \(\mathbb{Q}^N\)-martingale。

​经典​应用​是​ \(T\)-forward measure。​取零息​债券​ \(P(t,T)\)（​在​时刻​ \(T\) ​支付​ 1）​作为​ numeraire，​对应​的​测度​ \(\mathbb{Q}^T\) ​具有​以下​性质​：​远期​价格​ \(F(t,T) = S_t / P(t,T)\) ​是​ \(\mathbb{Q}^T\)-martingale。​这​大大简化​了​利率​衍生品​的​定价​。Jamshidian (1989) ​首先​将​这​一​技术​应用​于​ Vasicek model ​下​的​债券​期权​定价​。​后来​它​成为​ LIBOR market model（Brace, Gatarek, and Musiela 1997）​的​核心​，​其中​每个​ forward LIBOR rate ​在​其​自身​的​ forward measure ​下​被​建模​为​对数​正态​ martingale——​这种​方法​使得​从业者​可以​直接​校准​到​ cap ​和​ swaption ​市场​。

Numeraire ​变换​不仅仅​是​计算​上​的​便利​——​它​揭示​了​更​深层​的​结构​。​所有​ EMM ​的​集合​与​所有​正值​可​交易​ numeraire ​的​集合​之间​存在​一一对应​关系​。FTAP ​可以​重新​表述​为​：​市场​无​ arbitrage ​当且​仅​当​存在​至少​一个​ numeraire，​其​关联​的​测度​使​所有​资产​比率​成为​ martingale。

docs.title: 衍生品​定价​：Martingale ​方法
docs.text:
​有​了​ EMM，​衍生品​定价​就​简化​为​计算​条件期望​。​衍生品​（​或​ contingent claim）​是​一份​合约​，​其​到期日​ \(T\) ​的​收益​ \(H\) ​取决于​标的​资产​的​路径​。​例如​，​执行​价为​ \(K\) ​的​ European call option ​的​收益​为​ \(H = (S_T - K)^+\)。

​在​ \(\mathbb{Q}\) ​下​，​任何​可​达​ claim ​的​价格​就是​折现​后​的​期望​收益​：

\[V_t = e^{-r(T-t)} \, \mathbb{E}^{\mathbb{Q}}[H \mid \mathcal{F}_t]. \tag{9}\]

​折现​后​的​价格​过程​ \(e^{-rt}V_t\) ​是​ \(\mathbb{Q}\)-martingale——​价格​从​定价​测度​继承​了​ martingale ​性质​。

​对于​ geometric Brownian motion ​模型​（​常数​ \(\sigma\) ​和​ \(r\)），​对​ European call ​求解​期望​ (9) ​即​得到​ Black-Scholes ​公式​：

\[C(S_0, K, T, r, \sigma) = S_0 \Phi(d_1) - K e^{-rT} \Phi(d_2), \tag{10}\]

​其中​ \(d_{1,2} = \frac{\ln(S_0/K) + (r \pm \sigma^2/2)T}{\sigma\sqrt{T}}\)（​取正​号​得​ \(d_1\)，​取​负号​得​ \(d_2\)），\(\Phi\) ​是​标准​正态分布​的​累积​分布​函数​。​这一​公式​由​ Black and Scholes (1973) ​和​ Merton (1973) ​用​ PDE ​方法​推导​，​通过​ martingale ​方法​的​再​推导​是​计算​ \(\mathbb{E}^{\mathbb{Q}}[(S_T - K)^+]\)，​其中​ \(\ln S_T\) ​在​ \(\mathbb{Q}\) ​下​服从​正态分布​。Martingale ​推导​可以​说​更为​透明​：​它​明确​表明​公式​是​在​特定​概率​测度​下​的​期望​，​且​可以​立即​推广​到​ PDE ​方法​较为​繁琐​的​模型​。

Martingale ​定价​公式​远比​ Black-Scholes ​更​一般​。​它​适用​于​任何​无​ arbitrage ​模型​中​的​任何​收益​函数​，​只要​该​ claim ​可以​被​复制​。​对于​路径​依赖​期权​（Asian、barrier、lookback）、​多​资产​期权​（basket、spread、rainbow）​以及​ stochastic volatility ​下​的​期权​，​期望​ \(\mathbb{E}^{\mathbb{Q}}[H]\) ​可能​没有​闭式​解​，​但​可以​通过​ Monte Carlo simulation ​来​评估​——​在​ \(\mathbb{Q}\) ​下​生成​ \(S_t\) ​的​路径​并​对​折现​收益​取​平均​。​效率​可​通过​ variance reduction ​技术​提升​：control variates（​使用​已知​的​ European option ​价格​作为​基准​）、antithetic variates、importance sampling ​和​ stratified sampling。Glasserman ​的​ Monte Carlo Methods in Financial Engineering (2003) ​是​标准​参考文献​。

​定价​与​复制​之间​的​联系​由​ Martingale Representation Theorem (MRT) ​介导​。​当​ filtration \(\{\mathcal{F}_t\}\) ​由​ Brownian motion \(\tilde{W}\) ​生成​时​——​这一​条件​在​标准​ Black-Scholes ​设定​中​成立​——​每个​平方​可积​的​ \(\mathcal{F}_T\)-​可测​随机变量​ \(H\) ​都​允许​如下​表示​

\[H = \mathbb{E}^{\mathbb{Q}}[H] + \int_0^T \phi_s \, d\tilde{W}_s \tag{11}\]

​其中​ \(\phi\) ​是​满足​ \(\mathbb{E}^{\mathbb{Q}}\!\left[\int_0^T \phi_s^2 \, ds\right] < \infty\) ​的​可​预测​过程​。​过程​ \(\phi\) ​指定​了​ hedging ​策略​：​在​每个​时刻​应​持有​多少​份​股票​以​完美​复制​该​ claim。​在​ Black-Scholes model ​中​，\(\phi_t = \partial C / \partial S \big|_{S=S_t}\)——​期权​的​ "delta"——​连续​的​ delta-hedging ​实现​完美​复制​。

MRT ​是​ Brownian-generated filtration ​所​特有​的​。​当​ filtration ​包含​额外​的​随机性​来源​——jump process、stochastic volatility ​因子​——​表示​ (11) ​就​失效​了​。Claim \(H\) ​不再​能​写成​仅​关于​ \(\tilde{W}\) ​的​随机​积分​，​这​意味着​某些​风险​成分​无法​通过​交易​标的​资产​来​ hedge。​这​正是​ market incompleteness ​产生​的​机制​。

MRT ​的​实践​意义​还​延伸​到​风险管理​。Greeks——delta (\(\Delta = \partial V / \partial S\))、gamma (\(\Gamma = \partial^2 V / \partial S^2\))、vega (\(\nu = \partial V / \partial \sigma\))、theta (\(\Theta = \partial V / \partial t\))——​是​期权​价格​对​其​输入量​的​敏感性​。​将​ Ito ​公式​应用​于​ \(V(t, S_t)\) ​得到​：

\[dV = \Theta \, dt + \Delta \, dS + \frac{1}{2}\Gamma \sigma^2 S^2 \, dt,\]

​要求​ hedged portfolio \(V - \Delta S\) ​是​局部​无风险​的​（​其​ \(d\tilde{W}\) ​系数​为​零​）​便​恢复​了​ Black-Scholes PDE。Martingale ​方法​和​ PDE ​方法​是​同​一枚​硬币​的​两面​，​由​ Feynman-Kac ​定理​相连​。

docs.title: The Second Fundamental Theorem: Completeness
docs.text:
First FTAP ​讨论​ EMM ​的​存在​性​。Second FTAP ​讨论​唯一性​：

​市场​是​ complete ​的​——​每个​ contingent claim ​都​可以​通过​ self-financing、admissible strategy ​复制​——​当且​仅​当​ equivalent martingale measure ​唯一​。

​直觉​如下​。​如果​两个​ EMM \(\mathbb{Q}_1\) ​和​ \(\mathbb{Q}_2\) ​同时​存在​，​它们​可能​对​某个​ claim \(H\) ​赋予​不同​的​价格​。​仅凭​ no-arbitrage ​条件​，​两个​价格​都​无法​被​唯一​确定​。​而​一个​复制​策略​若​存在​，​将​唯一​确定​价格​（​它​必须​等于​复制​成本​），​从而​消除​歧义​。​反之​，​如果​每个​ claim ​都​可以​被​复制​，​定价​泛函​就​在​整个​ \(L^2\) ​上​被​确定​，​没有​第二个​ EMM ​的​存在​空间​。

​回忆​ binomial model：​两种​状态​加​两种​工具​，EMM ​唯一​。​三种​状态​加​两种​工具​，​则​存在​多个​ EMM。​同样​的​计数​原则​——​独立​随机性​来源​的​数目​与​可​交易​资产​的​数目​之​比​——​支配​着​一般​模型​中​的​ completeness。

​在实践中​，​大多数​现实​模型​是​ incomplete ​的​。Stochastic volatility、price jumps ​和​交易成本​都​会​打破​ completeness。​在​这些​设定​中​，​存在​多个​ EMM，​给定​ claim ​的​ no-arbitrage ​价格​形成​一个​区间​ \([\inf_{\mathbb{Q}} \mathbb{E}^{\mathbb{Q}}[\tilde{H}], \, \sup_{\mathbb{Q}} \mathbb{E}^{\mathbb{Q}}[\tilde{H}]]\)，​以​ sub- ​和​ superhedging ​价格​为界​。

docs.title: Incomplete Markets ​中​的​测度​选择
docs.text:
​从​ no-arbitrage ​区间​中​选取​单一​价格​需要​额外​的​经济​或​数学​假设​。​四种​标准​准则​源于​对​ EMM ​集合​施加​的​变分​原理​。​多位​作者​注意​到​的​一个​统一​视角​是​，​前​三种​准则​可以​看作​从​ \(\mathbb{Q}\) ​到​ \(\mathbb{P}\) ​的​不同​ f-divergence ​的​极小​化者​：MMM ​极小​化​一种​方差​型​ divergence，MEMM ​极小​化​ Kullback-Leibler divergence，​而​ variance-optimal measure ​极小​化​ \(\chi^2\)-divergence。Utility indifference pricing ​不​直接​适用​于​这​一​框架​——​它​依赖于​代理人​的​效用函数​和​财富​，​引入​了​额外​的​自由度​。

The Minimal Martingale Measure (MMM)，​由​ Follmer and Schweizer (1991) ​引入​，​保持​原始​ martingale ​分量​的​结构​，​仅​改变​漂移​。​它​极小​化​ hedging ​误差​的​方差​，​对应​于​ variance-optimal hedging ​策略​。​当​ mean-variance tradeoff process \(\int_0^{\cdot} \theta_s^2 \, ds\) ​局部​平方​可积​时​，MMM ​存在​。

The Minimal Entropy Martingale Measure (MEMM) ​在​所有​ EMM ​上​极小​化​ relative entropy（Kullback-Leibler divergence）\(H(\mathbb{Q} \| \mathbb{P}) = \mathbb{E}^{\mathbb{Q}}[\ln(d\mathbb{Q}/d\mathbb{P})]\)。Frittelli (2000) ​证明​了​这​一​测度​与​指数​效用​最大化​互为​对偶​：​最大化​ \(\mathbb{E}^{\mathbb{P}}[-e^{-\gamma W_T}]\) ​的​投资者​隐含地​以​ MEMM ​来​定价​。​这一​联系​通过​一个​共同​的​变分​原理​将​信息论​、​统计力学​和​金融​经济学​联系​在​一起​。

The Variance-Optimal Measure ​极小​化​ \(\mathbb{E}^{\mathbb{P}}[(d\mathbb{Q}/d\mathbb{P})^2]\)，​对应​于​ mean-variance hedging。Schweizer (1995, 1996) ​发展​了​这​一​方法​，​其​优点​是​在​许多​ incomplete model ​中​具有​易​处理​性​。

Utility Indifference Pricing ​将​ claim \(H\) ​的​价格​ \(p\) ​定义​为​使​代理人​在​持有​和​不​持有​该​ claim ​之间​无​差异​的​金额​：\(\sup_\phi \mathbb{E}^{\mathbb{P}}[U(W_T + H - p)] = \sup_\phi \mathbb{E}^{\mathbb{P}}[U(W_T)]\)。​这一​方法​将​定价​问题​嵌入​投资​组合​优化​之中​，​自然​地​考虑​了​代理人​的​风险​厌恶​。​与​前​三种​准则​不同​，​所​得到​的​价格​取决于​代理人​的​效用函数​和​初始​财富​。

​这些​准则​之间​的​选择​并非​无关紧要​。​不同​准则​在实践中​可能​产生​明显​不同​的​价格​，​特别​是​对于​深度​虚值​期权​和​长期​ claim，​其中​模型​不确定性​会​不断​累积​。

docs.title: Martingale ​收敛​与​ Optimal Stopping
docs.text:
​除了​定价​之外​，martingale ​理论​还​提供​了​分析​金融​过程​长期​行为​和​不​可逆​决策​时机​的​工具​。

Doob's Martingale Convergence Theorem ​指出​，​每个​ \(L^1\)-​有界​的​ martingale（​或非​负​ supermartingale）​几乎​必然​收敛​到​一个​可积​的​极限​。​在​金融​中​，​这​确保​了​某些​ self-financing strategy ​有​良好​定义​的​长期​行为​。​它​也​支撑​了​各种​投资​组合​规则​下​财富​过程​的​分析​，​并​被​用于​证明​ growth-optimal (Kelly) portfolio ​有​良好​定义​的​长期​增长率​。

Optimal stopping ​理论​处理​一个​不同​的​问题​：​何时​应该​采取​不​可逆​行动​？American option ​与​上文​讨论​的​ European option ​不同​，​可以​在​到期日​ \(T\) ​之前​的​任何时刻​行使​。​持有者​面临​一个​ optimal stopping ​问题​：​过早​行使​会​放弃​剩余​的​期权​价值​；​等待​太久​则​有利条件​可能​消失​。

​数学​框架​是​ Snell envelope——​覆盖​收益​过程​的​最小​ supermartingale。​如果​ \(\{G_t\}\) ​是​在​时刻​ \(t\) ​行使​的​（​折现​后​）​收益​，Snell envelope \(\{U_t\}\) ​满足​对​所有​ \(t\) ​有​ \(U_t \geq G_t\)，​且​是​ American option ​的​价值​过程​：

\[U_t = \operatorname{ess\,sup}_{\tau \geq t} \, \mathbb{E}^{\mathbb{Q}}[G_\tau \mid \mathcal{F}_t], \tag{12}\]

​其中​上​确界​取遍​所有​ \(\tau \geq t\) ​的​ stopping time。Essential supremum（​而​非​逐点​上​确界​）​是​必要​的​，​因为​在​连续​时间​中上​确界​取遍​不可数​多个​ stopping time，​而​不可​数个​可测​函数​的​逐点​上​确界​不​一定​可测​。Essential supremum ​是​产生​良好​定义​的​随机变量​的​测度论​修正​。​最优​行使​时刻​为​ \(\tau^* = \inf\{t : U_t = G_t\}\)——​期权​价值​等于​立即​行使​价值​的​首次​时刻​。

Doob-Meyer decomposition ​指出​，​任何​ class (D) ​的​ supermartingale \(U_t\) ​可以​写成​ \(U_t = M_t - A_t\)，​其中​ \(M_t\) ​是​ uniformly integrable martingale，\(A_t\) ​是​满足​ \(A_0 = 0\) ​的​非​递减​可​预测​过程​。​过程​ \(A_t\) ​是​ compensator：​捕获​ supermartingale ​累积​下降​漂移​的​可​预测​递增​过程​。​在​ American option ​的​语境​中​，\(A_t\) ​度量​了​期权​时间​价值​的​累积​侵蚀​——​即​期权​价值​中随​到期日​临近​而​可​预测​地​衰减​的​部分​，​不同于​ \(M_t\) ​所​捕获​的​随机​波动​。​最优​行使​区域​为​ \(\{U_t = G_t\}\)，​即​ Snell envelope ​触碰​收益​的​集合​。

​在​连续​时间​中​，​价值​函数​ \(V(t, S)\) ​在​继续​区域​ \(\{(t, S) : V > G\}\) ​内​满足​ Black-Scholes PDE，​在​行使​边界​上​有​两个​条件​。Value matching ​要求​边界​处​ \(V = G\)。Smooth pasting ​要求​ \(\partial V / \partial S = \partial G / \partial S\)——​导数​也​匹配​。Smooth pasting ​不是​强加​的​条件​而是​推导​出​的​最优性​性质​；​当​收益​函数​ \(G\) ​光滑​且​价格​过程​是​扩散​过程​时​它​成立​。​当​收益​有​折角​（digital option）​或​价格​过程​可以​跳过​边界​时​，smooth pasting ​失效​。​此时​它​被​ complementarity condition（​在​每个​点上​，​期权​要么​处于​继续​区域​，​要么​行使​价值​被​达到​，​但​不是​两者​的​严格​混合​）​所​替代​——​这是​一个​不​要求​可微性​的​更弱​条件​。

​这一​问题​也​可以​表述​为​ variational inequality：\(\min(\mathcal{L}V - rV, V - G) = 0\)，​其中​ \(\mathcal{L}\) ​是​股票价格​过程​的​无穷小​生成元​。​这​三种​方法​——​概率​方法​（Snell envelope）、​解析​方法​（free-boundary PDE）​和​泛​函​分析方法​（variational inequality）——​从​不同​的​数学​视角​描述​同一​对象​。

Longstaff-Schwartz (2001) ​算法​通过​ Monte Carlo ​对​ American option ​进行​定价​，​使用​基​函数​上​的​回归​来​近似​条件期望​ \(\mathbb{E}^{\mathbb{Q}}[U_{t+1} \mid \mathcal{F}_t]\)。​这​使得​ Snell envelope ​即使​在​ PDE ​方法​不​可行​的​高维​情形​下​也​可​计算​。

docs.title: Filtration ​依赖性​与​ Insider Trading
docs.text:
Filtration ​依赖性​。 Martingale ​性质​是​相对​于​一个​ filtration ​的​：​同一​过程​在​一种​信息结构​下​可以​是​ martingale，​在​更​精细​的​信息结构​下则​可能​失效​。​这一​数学​事实​有​直接​的​经济​含义​。

​考虑​一个​市场​，​折现​价格​在​公开​信息​ filtration \(\{\mathcal{F}_t\}\) ​下​是​ \(\mathbb{Q}\)-martingale。​一个​拥有​额外​信息​的​ insider——​比如​提前​知道​盈利​公告​——​在​一个​更​精细​的​ filtration \(\{\mathcal{G}_t\} \supset \{\mathcal{F}_t\}\) ​下​运作​。

​在​这​一​ enlarged filtration ​下​，​折现​价格​过程​可能​不再​是​ martingale。​直觉​上​，​知道​终端​值​ \(L\)（​如​ \(S_T\)）​允许​ insider ​对​股票​可能​路径​进行​贝叶斯​更新​。​数学​上​，​这​表现​为​在​ \(\mathcal{G}_t\) ​下​可见​但​在​ \(\mathcal{F}_t\) ​下​不​可见​的​确定性​漂移​。Insider ​可以​利用​这一​漂移​系统性​地​获利​。

Initial and progressive enlargement of filtrations ​理论​使​这​一点​精确化​。​在​ initial enlargement ​框架​（Jacod 1985）​中​，insider ​从​一​开始​就​知道​一个​随机变量​ \(L\)。​价格​过程​在​ enlarged filtration \(\mathcal{G}_t = \mathcal{F}_t \vee \sigma(L)\) ​下​的​标准​分解​获得​了​一个​额外​的​漂移​项​，​该​漂移​项​依赖于​ \(L\) ​在​给定​ \(\mathcal{F}_t\) ​下​的​条件​密度​。​这一​额外​漂移​就是​信息​优势​，​在​许多​模型​中​可以​显式​计算​。

Amendinger, Imkeller, and Schweizer (1998) ​量化​了​ insider ​可​获得​的​额外​期望​对数​效用​。​他们​证明​这​等于​ enlarged ​测度​与​公开​信息测度​之间​的​ relative entropy——​一个​信息论​量​。Insider ​的​优势​可以​用​ nats ​来​度量​，​而​内幕​信息​的​货币​价值​有​一个​熵​的​解释​。

​测度​依赖性​。 ​正如​ martingale ​性质​依赖于​ filtration，​它​也​依赖于​概率​测度​：​在​ \(\mathbb{P}\) ​下​不是​ martingale ​的​过程​在​ \(\mathbb{Q}\) ​下​可能​变成​ martingale。​这是​整个​定价​理论​的​种子​。​物理​测度​ \(\mathbb{P}\) ​编码​了​真实世界​的​概率​和​风险​溢价​；EMM \(\mathbb{Q}\) ​正是​为了​使​折现​价格​无​漂移​而​构造​的​。

Imkeller (2003) ​使用​ Malliavin calculus ​技术​证明​了​，​在​某些​条件​下​ enlarged filtration ​允许​ free lunch with vanishing risk。Insider ​可以​构造​近似​ arbitrage ​策略​。​这​意味着​ FTAP ​本身​对​ filtration ​是​敏感​的​：​一个​市场​对​公众​可以​是​无​ arbitrage ​的​，​但​对​ insider ​则​不是​。​对​ insider trading ​的​监管​可以​被​看作​是​对​ filtration ​结构​的​制度性​保障​——​市场​的​ no-arbitrage ​性质​正是​依赖于​这一​结构​。

docs.title: Local Martingale ​与​ Rational Bubbles
docs.text:
​当​折现​价格​过程​在​ \(\mathbb{Q}\) ​下​是​ local martingale ​但​不是​ true martingale——​即​ strict local martingale ​时​，​会​出现​一种​更​微妙​的​边界​情形​。​一个​有​下界​的​ local martingale（​价格​满足​此​条件​，​因为​是非​负​的​）​满足​ \(\mathbb{E}^{\mathbb{Q}}[\tilde{S}_T] \leq \tilde{S}_0\)，​其中​严格​不等式​是​可能​的​。​在​金融​术语​中​，​当前​价格​超过​了​期望​折现​未来​价格​——​市场​相对​于​基本​价值​"​多付​了​"。

​一个​典型​例子​是​三维​ Bessel process ​的​倒数​。​三维​ Bessel process \(X_t\) ​是​三维​ Brownian motion ​的​径向​部分​——​其​扩散系数​随离​原点​距离​增大​而​增长​，​导致​路径​逃逸​到​无穷的​速度​足够​快​，​使得​ \(1/X_t\) ​失去​质量​。​过程​ \(1/X_t\) ​是​ strict local martingale：​它​局部​地是​ martingale（​每个​ stopped ​版本​都​是​ true martingale），​但​对​ \(T > 0\) ​有​ \(\mathbb{E}[1/X_T] < 1/X_0\)。​这​说明​ strict local martingale ​行为​可以​纯粹​由​扩散​的​几何​性质​产生​。

​这一​现象​被​提出​作为​ rational bubbles ​的​数学​刻画​。​主要​贡献​来自​ Loewenstein and Willard (2000)、Cox and Hobson (2005) ​和​ Jarrow, Protter, and Shimbo (2010)，Protter (2013) ​提供​了​出色​的​综述​。Bubble ​分量​为​偏差​：

\[\beta_t = \tilde{S}_t - \mathbb{E}^{\mathbb{Q}}[\tilde{S}_T \mid \mathcal{F}_t]. \tag{13}\]

​当​ \(\tilde{S}\) ​是​ true \(\mathbb{Q}\)-martingale ​时​，\(\beta_t = 0\)——​不​存在​ bubble。​当​ \(\tilde{S}\) ​是​ strict local martingale ​时​，\(\beta_t > 0\)，​其​动力学​描述​了​ bubble ​的​演化​。

​该​理论​产生​了​可​检验​的​推论​。​在​存在​ bubble ​的​市场​中​，put-call parity ​被​违反​。​在​ strict local martingale ​下​，​资产​价格​超过​其​基本​价值​ \(\mathbb{E}^{\mathbb{Q}}[\tilde{S}_T \mid \mathcal{F}_t]\)。Call option ​的​价值​依赖于​资产​价格​，​因此​继承​了​这​一​超额​。​更​精确​地说​，\(\tilde{S}\) ​的​ strict local martingale ​性质​意味着​

\[C - P > S_0 - Ke^{-rT},\]

​因此​通常​的​ put-call parity ​等式​变为​严格​不等式​：​如果​标的​资产​是​ true martingale，call ​的​价格​严格​高于​ put-call parity ​所​预测​的​值​。Heston, Loewenstein, and Willard (2007) ​探讨​了​由此​产生​的​期权​定价​异常​。

​一个​重要​的​提醒​：​在​ incomplete market ​中​，​给定​的​价格​过程​是否是​ strict local martingale ​取决于​ EMM ​的​选择​。​同一​资产​在​一个​ EMM ​下​可能​有​ bubble，​在​另​一个​下则​没有​。​因此​，bubble ​的​识别​本质​上​是​模型​依赖​的​。

​一般​形式​的​ FTAP（Delbaen-Schachermayer）​保证​ local martingale measure ​的​存在​，​但​不​一定​是​ true martingale measure。​因此​ local martingale ​和​ true martingale ​之间​的​区别​获得​了​直接​的​经济​意义​：​它​是​有效​定价​与​ bubble ​动力学​之间​的​边界​。

docs.title: 局限性​与​拓展
docs.text: Martingale ​框架​建立​在实践中​会​被​违反​的​假设​之上​。​理解​它​在​何处​失效​与​理解​它​在​何处​成立​同样​重要​。​这些​局限​可​分为​两大类​：​数学​框架​的​结构性​假设​，​以及​来自​市场​数据​的​实证​挑战​。

docs.title: 结构性​局限
docs.text:
​连续​交易​。 ​该​理论​假设​投资​组合​可以​连续​调仓​。​在​具有​离散​交易​和​非​零​交易成本​的​市场​中​，​这​无法​实现​。​在​比例​交易成本​下​，no-arbitrage ​条件​被​替换​为​ "consistent price system"——​一个​位于​买卖​价差​内​的​ martingale（Jouini and Kallal 1995, Schachermayer 2004）。​单一​定价​测度​让​位于​受​价差​约束​的​测度​集合​。

Model risk。 ​对​ \(S_t\) ​的​随机​模型​选择​——geometric Brownian motion、jump-diffusion、stochastic volatility——​决定​了​ EMM ​从而​决定​了​价格​。Martingale ​框架​告诉​人们​在​给定​模型​下​如何​定价​，​但​不​告诉​哪个​模型​是​正确​的​。​在实践中​，​模型​不确定性​往往​主导​定价​误差​。

Martingale Optimal Transport。 ​对​ model risk ​的​一个​特别​优美​的​回应​将​ robust pricing ​与​ optimal transport ​理论​联系​起来​。Beiglbock, Henry-Labordere, and Penkner (2013) ​证明​了​与​模型​无关​的​价格​界限​可以​表述​为​ martingale optimal transport problem。​思想​是​找到​ \((S_{t_1}, \ldots, S_{t_n})\) ​的​联合​分布​，​使​其​与​两个​约束​相容​：​给定​的​边际​分布​和​ martingale ​性质​。​边际​分布​由​观测​到​的​ vanilla option ​价格​通过​ Breeden-Litzenberger ​公式​确定​，​该​公式​从​ call ​价格​对​ strike ​的​二阶​导数​中​恢复​出​ \(S_T\) ​的​ risk-neutral ​分布​。​在​这些​约束​下​，​最大化​或​最小化​ \(\mathbb{E}[H(S_{t_1}, \ldots, S_{t_n})]\) ​以​获得​与​模型​无关​的​价格​界限​。

Dolinsky and Soner (2014) ​将​其​推广​到​连续​时间​。​所​得到​的​ hedging ​策略​在​所有​模型​上​都​是​ robust ​的​——​它们​不​需要​超出​ no-arbitrage ​和​观测​ vanilla ​价格​之外​的​参数​假设​。Henry-Labordere ​的​专著​ Model-free Hedging (2017) ​提供​了​全面​的​论述​。

docs.title: 实证​挑战
docs.text:
​市场​异象​。 ​关于​动量​效应​、​价值​效应​和​波动​率​之谜​的​文献​挑战​了​在​任何​测度​下​真实​价格​可​由​ martingale ​模型​良好​描述​这一​观点​。​然而​，FTAP ​不​要求​ EMH。​它​只​要求​ arbitrage ​的​不​存在​，​这是​远弱​得​多​的​条件​。\(\mathbb{P}\) ​下​收益率​的​可预测性​与​ no-arbitrage ​完全​兼容​，​只要​这种​可预测性​不能​产生​经​风险​调整​后​具有​正​期望​收益​的​ self-financing strategy。

Rough volatility。 Gatheral, Jaisson, and Rosenbaum (2018) ​的​近期​工作​表明​，log-volatility ​可以​很​好​地用​ Hurst ​参数​ \(H \approx 0.1\) ​的​ fractional Brownian motion ​建模​。​在​ rough volatility ​模型​中​，​价格​本身​仍然​是​ Ito semimartingale，​因此​ FTAP ​适用​，no-arbitrage ​有​良好​定义​。​然而​波动​率​过程​是非​ Markov ​且​非​ semimartingale ​的​（\(H < 1/2\) ​的​ fractional Brownian motion ​不是​ semimartingale）。​这​使得​经典​ PDE ​方法​和​ delta-hedging ​变得​困难​。​将​随机​分析​扩展​到​ rough path ​和​ regularity structure ​框架​——​建立​在​ Hairer ​的​工作​之上​——​是​一个​活跃​的​研究​前沿​。​价格​的​基础​ semimartingale ​框架​仍然​完好​。

​离散​时间​摩擦​与​高频​市场​。 ​在​极短​的​时间尺度​上​，​市场​微观​结构​效应​——​买卖​价差​跳动​、​离散​的​最小​变动​单位​、​延迟​——​意味着​逐笔​价格​不是​ semimartingale。​从​高频​数据​计算​的​已​实现​方差​包含​微观​结构​噪声​分量​，​该​分量​在​采样​频率​增加​时​发散​。Two-scales realized volatility estimator（Zhang, Mykland, and Ait-Sahalia 2005）​通过​将​有效​价格​的​ martingale ​分量​与​微观​结构​噪声​分离​来​解决​这一​问题​。

docs.title: 进一步​方向
docs.text:
​以上​各节​发展​了​ martingale ​框架​的​核心​。​若干​更​深层次​的​联系​值得​进一步​研究​。

​泛函​分析​与​ FTAP。 FTAP ​的​证明​依赖于​ Hahn-Banach ​分离​定理​以及​ Riesz representation theorem。​这​将​ arbitrage ​理论​与​泛​函​分析​的​对偶​机制​——​具体​而言​是​随机变量​空间​上​的​凸​锥​理论​——​联系​起来​。Delbaen and Schachermayer ​的​专著​在​完全​一般​的​情形​下​发展​了​这些​联系​。

Information geometry ​与​定价​。 EMM ​的​ relative entropy \(H(\mathbb{Q} \| \mathbb{P})\) ​可​解释​为​ risk-neutral pricing ​的​"​成本​"。​这​将​ martingale ​理论​与​ information geometry ​联系​起来​。Girsanov ​测度​变换​的​指数​族​结构​将​ EMM ​集合​置于​一个​统计​流形​上​，​其​几何​结构​反映​了​ market incompleteness。

Large deviations ​与​ exponential tilting。 (7) ​中​的​ Radon-Nikodym exponential ​在结构上​与​大偏差​理论​中​的​ exponential tilting ​完全相同​。\(\mathbb{Q}\) ​下​的​定价​与​ tilted measure ​下​的​稀有​事件​分析​是​同​一种​模式​的​实例​——​累积​量​生成​函数​与​率​函数​之间​的​ Legendre-Fenchel ​对偶​。

Growth-optimal portfolio ​与​ numeraire ​联系​。 Growth-optimal (Kelly) portfolio ​具有​以下​性质​：​以其为​单位​的​折现​价格​在​ \(\mathbb{P}\) ​下​是​ supermartingale。Long-Pliska ​定理​ (1990) ​和​ Platen and Heath (2006) ​的​ benchmark approach ​利用​这​一点​即使​在​ NFLVR ​失效​时​也​能​获得​一致​的​定价​，​通过​一个​统一​框架​将​ bubbles ​和​ FTAP ​联系​起来​。

docs.title: 总结
docs.text:
Martingale ​视角​通过​单一​的​概率​结构​统一​了​金融​理论​的​核心​。​主要​结果​按​逻辑​顺序​如下​：

  1. Efficient markets ​与​ martingale ​假说​。 EMH ​成为​关于​ \(\mathbb{P}\) ​下​ martingale ​动力学​的​陈述​，​但​由于​风险​溢价​，\(\mathbb{P}\) ​下​的​价格​通常​不是​ martingale。

  2. The First FTAP。 Arbitrage ​的​不​存在​等价​于​等价​测度​ \(\mathbb{Q}\) ​的​存在​：Harrison-Pliska ​用于​有限​市场​，Dalang-Morton-Willinger ​用于​一般​离散​时间​，Delbaen-Schachermayer ​用于​连续​时间​。

  3. Girsanov ​定理​。 \(\mathbb{Q}\) ​的​构造​将​ market price of risk ​吸收​到​测度​变换​中​，​同时​保持​波动​率​不变​——​将​ \(\mathbb{P}\) ​下​的​统计​估计​与​ \(\mathbb{Q}\) ​下​的​ risk-neutral pricing ​连接起来​。

  4. ​衍生品​定价​。 ​价格​简化​为​ \(\mathbb{Q}\) ​下​的​期望​（​公式​ (9)），​可​通过​解析​方法​（Black-Scholes (10)）、PDE ​方法​（Feynman-Kac）​或​模拟​方法​（Monte Carlo）​计算​。

  5. The Second FTAP。 Market completeness ​由​ \(\mathbb{Q}\) ​的​唯一性​刻画​；incompleteness ​由​ EMM ​的​多重性​及​测度​选择​准则​的​需求​刻画​。

  6. Hedging。 ​复制​是​ martingale representation (11)，​特定​于​ Brownian-generated filtration。

  7. Optimal exercise。 American option ​定价​是​ optimal stopping ​问题​，​由​ Snell envelope (12) ​和​ Doob-Meyer decomposition ​支配​。

  8. Insider trading。 Filtration enlargement ​揭示​了​ insider ​优势​的​数学​机制​，​内幕​信息​的​价值​由​ relative entropy ​度量​。

  9. Bubbles。 Strict local martingale ​刻画​了​ rational bubbles，bubble ​大小​由​偏差​ (13) ​度量​，​但​需注意​在​ incomplete market ​中​识别​是​依赖于​测度​的​。

  10. Numeraire change。 Risk-neutral measure ​推广​为​一族​定价​测度​，​每个​对应​不同​的​ numeraire，​适用​于​特定​的​定价​问题​。

​这些​结果​与其​失效​之间​的​边界​——​通过​摩擦​、incompleteness、rough volatility ​或​模型​不确定性​——​划定​了​当前​研究​的​前沿​。

​对于​有​概率论​基础​的​读者​，​这一​框架​提供​了​进入​量化​金融​最有​结构​的​入口​：​每​一个​主要​结果​都​是​概率​课上​已经​半​熟悉​的​定理​，​应用​于​一个​利害攸关​的​领域​。

docs.title: 延伸​阅读
docs.text:
​以下​十项​内容​构成​了​一条​观点鲜明​的​阅读​路径​，​按​从​基础​到​前沿​排序​。​每条​注释​指定​了​读​什么​、​以​何种​粒度​读​、​以及​为何​它​值得​入选​。​第​ 1–4 ​项​涵盖​不可或缺​的​经典​；​第​ 5–10 ​项​涉及​ 2021 ​年​以来​的​最新进展​。​从​ Shreve ​入手​掌握​机械性​基础​，​经由​ Follmer-Schied ​和​ Delbaen-Schachermayer ​掌握​理论​核心​，​然后​根据​你​的​兴趣​分支​到​ rough volatility、martingale optimal transport ​或​ bubble detection。

​各项​标注​了​其​用途​：primary text、technical reference、survey/orientation、freely accessible online resource ​或​ frontier/recent。

1. Primary text: Shreve, S.E. Stochastic Calculus for Finance II: Continuous-Time Models (Springer, 2004).

​在读​其他​内容​之前​，​先​通读​第​ 1–5 ​章​。​第​ 1 ​章​（​测度论​概率​复习​）​和​第​ 2 ​章​（Ito calculus）​足够​简洁​，​可以​在​一个​周末​完成​。​第​ 5 ​章​（Risk-Neutral Pricing，​第​ 212–275 ​页​）​是​核心​收获​：Girsanov ​定理​、Martingale Representation Theorem、​通过​ Feynman-Kac ​推导​的​ Black-Scholes PDE、​以及​基本​定价​公式​，​都​在​一个​持续​的​论证​中​呈现​。​每​一步​证明​都​被​完整​写出​。​第​ 8 ​章​（American options / Snell envelope，​第​ 371–430 ​页​）​涵盖​ optimal stopping，​包括​ Snell envelope、free-boundary PDE ​和​ smooth pasting ​之间​的​联系​。​第一遍​可以​跳过​第​ 6–7 ​章​；​它们​涉及​与​本文​无​直接​关系​的​利率​模型​。

2. Primary text: Follmer, H. and Schied, A. Stochastic Finance: An Introduction in Discrete Time, 5th ed. (De Gruyter, 2025; 4th ed. 2016 also suffices).

​通过​在​离散​时间​中​工作​，​本书​在​无需​ semimartingale ​积分​的​技术​开销​下​实现​了​完全​的​数学​严格​性​。​第​ 1 ​章​（arbitrage ​理论​、​通过​ separating hyperplane theorem ​证明​ FTAP）​使​ Hahn-Banach ​的​直觉​变得​明晰​。​第​ 6 ​章​（utility maximization ​与​ incomplete markets）​精确​地​发展​了​ utility indifference pricing ​与​ entropy minimization ​之间​的​对偶性​。Incomplete markets ​始终​作为​默认​情形​而​非​例外​贯穿​全书​。​第​ 5 ​版​增加​了​关于​模型​不确定性​和​风险​度量​的​材料​。​在​阅读​ Delbaen-Schachermayer ​之前​先读​第​ 1–2 ​章​。

3. Technical reference: Delbaen, F. and Schachermayer, W. The Mathematics of Arbitrage (Springer, 2006).

​这​不是​教科书​；​这是​证明​本身​。​第​ I ​部分​（​第​ 1–8 ​章​）​是​自含​的​研究生​课程​，​在​ Shreve ​和​ Follmer-Schied ​之后​可​读​。​核心​章节​：​第​ 2 ​章​（​有限​离散​时间​的​ FTAP，​第​ 31–85 ​页​）、​第​ 9 ​章​（NFLVR ​和​通过​ Kreps-Yan ​定理​证明​的​连续​时间​ FTAP，​第​ 149–218 ​页​）、​第​ 14 ​章​（sigma-martingale measure，​第​ 285–337 ​页​）。​所​需​的​泛​函​分析​——Mackey ​拓扑​、​弱​*​紧性​、​局部凸​空间​中​的​ Hahn-Banach——​在​附录​中有​解释​。​收获​是​一个​既​完整​又​概念​上​透明​的​证明​。

4. Technical reference: Peskir, G. and Shiryaev, A. Optimal Stopping and Free-Boundary Problems (Birkhauser, 2006).

Snell envelope、Doob decomposition ​以及​与​ free-boundary PDE ​的​联系​在​第​ I ​部分​（​第​ 1–3 ​章​，​第​ 1–120 ​页​）​中以​罕见​的​细致​程度​处理​。​第​ 7 ​章​（​第​ 243–308 ​页​）​将​其​应用​于​ American put ​和​ call，​并​计算​出​精确​的​自由​边界​。​每个​定理​前​都​有​启发式​讨论​。

5. Frontier, technical reference: Jarrow, R.A. Continuous-Time Asset Pricing Theory: A Martingale-Based Approach, 2nd ed. (Springer Finance, 2021).

​以​ martingale ​为​先导​处理​本文​完整​议程​的​最​完整​单卷​论著​。​第​ 8 ​章​涵盖​ bubbles ​和​ strict local martingale。​第​ 10 ​章以​并行​推导​发展​ incomplete-market ​测度​选择​准则​。​第​ 12 ​章以​定理​为​基础​处理​ EMH、EMM ​和​物理​测度​之间​的​关系​。​数学​要求​高于​ Shreve，​但​对​已经​读过​ Delbaen-Schachermayer ​的​读者​来说​回报​丰厚​。

6. Frontier, freely accessible: Aksamit, A. and Jeanblanc, M. "Enlargement of Filtrations — A Primer." arXiv:2210.07045 (October 2022).

​目前​最​易读​的​关于​ filtration enlargement ​的​自含​入门​文献​。​涵盖​ initial enlargement（Jacod condition、enlarged filtration ​下​的​标准​分解​以及​额外​漂移​）、progressive enlargement（​与​信用风险​相关​）​和​金融​应用​（entropy/insider-information ​联系​）。​关于​额外​漂移​的​章节​（​第​ 12–18 ​页​）​提供​了​使​"insider ​能​看到​漂移​"​成为​精确​公式​的​显式​计算​。​约​ 60 ​页​；​前​四节​可​在​一个​下午​读完​。

7. Frontier: Bayer, C., Friz, P., Fukasawa, M., Gatheral, J., Jacquier, A., and Rosenbaum, M. (eds.) Rough Volatility (SIAM, 2023).

​关于​ rough volatility ​的​首部​书​长度​论著​。​第​ 1 ​章​建立​了​实证​基础​：log-volatility ​的​ Hurst ​参数​ \(H \approx 0.1\)。​第​ 2 ​章​发展​了​ rough Bergomi model。​第​ 6 ​章​处理​经典​ Ito ​公式​不​适用​时​的​ hedging。​第​ 10 ​章​通过​ regularity structure ​给出​最​深层​的​数学​处理​。​本书​明确​阐述​了​经典​理论​中​什么​被​打破​了​以及​学术界​做​了​什么​。

8. Frontier, freely accessible: Gatheral, J. "10 Years of Rough Volatility: A Current Perspective." Slides, XXV Workshop on Quantitative Finance, Bologna, April 2024. Available at https://mfe.baruch.cuny.edu/wp-content/uploads/2024/04/RoughVolatilityBologna2024.pdf.

​一份​ 50 ​页​的​幻灯片​，​涵盖​实证​证据​、rough Bergomi ​和​ rough Heston model、identification debate ​以及​开放​问题​。​在​已​解决​和​仍​有​争议​的​问题​上​态度​异常​坦诚​。​两​小时​可​读完​。

9. Frontier, freely accessible: Huesmann, M. "Model Independent Finance and Martingale Optimal Transport." Lecture notes, University of Bonn. Available at https://wt.iam.uni-bonn.de/huesmann/teaching/model-independent-finance-and-martingale-optimal-transport/.

​从​本文​对​ martingale optimal transport ​的​论述​到​真正​数学​的​最​清晰​路径​。​第​ 1 ​部分​（​离散​时间​）：model-free FTAP、​对偶​定理​、left-monotone transport plan。​第​ 2 ​部分​（​连续​时间​）：Skorokhod embedding problem、Breeden-Litzenberger ​公式​、variance swap ​和​ barrier option ​的​ model-free bounds。​所​需​前提​恰好​是​本文​。

10. Frontier, survey: Biagini, F., Gonon, L., Mazzon, A., and Meyer-Brandis, T. "Detecting Asset Price Bubbles Using Deep Learning." Mathematical Finance 35 (2025); arXiv:2210.01726 (October 2022).

​处于​ strict local martingale ​与​实际​ bubble detection ​的​交汇点​。​提供​了​ local-volatility diffusion ​成为​ strict local martingale ​的​一个​新​的​充要条件​。​在​ call option ​截面​数据​上​训练​神经网络​，​对​标的​资产​是​ true ​还是​ strict local martingale ​进行​分类​。​在​ 2020–2021 ​年间​的​ SPX、AMZN ​和​ TSLA ​数据​上​进行​测试​。​理论​部分​自含​；​已​消化​本文​ bubble ​章节​的​读者​将​发现​前​三节​可​直接​理解​。

docs.title: Multi-Objective Optimization: A Survey Across Five Communities
docs.text: Advanced graduate-level survey. Audience: researchers entering MOO from one community (operations research, evolutionary computation, deep multi-task learning, multi-objective reinforcement learning, or LLM alignment) who need to read across the others without re-deriving vocabulary.

docs.title: How to read this survey
docs.text:
What this is. A cross-community map of multi-objective optimization. Five fields — OR / MCDM, evolutionary MOO, deep multi-task learning, multi-objective reinforcement learning, and LLM alignment — re-derive the same Pareto-optimality concepts under different names. This survey supplies the translation table (§3), the order-theoretic core that grounds it (§2), the per-community apparatus (§4–§7), the lateral threads that connect them (§8), and a critical-reading toolkit (§9). The target reader is an advanced graduate student or researcher in one of the five communities who wants to read the others without re-learning the vocabulary.

Reading paths by community. - OR / MCDM: read §2 (which formalises what you already know), then §5 (deep-MTL re-derivations of scalarisation), §7 (RLHF's social-choice corner). - Deep MTL: read §2 (the order-theoretic core MTL papers usually skip), §5 (the gradient revolution as MOO), §9 (critical reading on \(\Delta m\%\) and the gradient-surgery \(k\ge 3\) gap). - MORL: read §2, §6, then §7 (Safe RLHF as CMDP). - Alignment / RLHF: read §3 (vocabulary), §7 (full RLHF-as-MOO development), §8 (lateral threads: welfare, \(f\)-divergence, Goodhart). - Everyone reads §2 first; §10–§11 are the open-problems list and reading list.

Prerequisites. Single-objective convex optimisation through KKT; linear algebra including cone-induced partial orders; basic neural-network MTL and policy-gradient RL; light familiarity with social-choice theory (Arrow's theorem) and information theory (\(f\)-divergence) is helpful but not assumed. Tropical geometry (§4.7), DRO (§7.12), and Csiszár information geometry (§8.6) are flagged as advanced and can be skipped at first pass.

A note on caveats. Throughout we use the marker [†caveat-X] to flag claims that are surveyor synthesis rather than direct literature citation, or that rest on assumptions worth flagging. Examples: [†caveat-C] for the "common descent cone" framing of §5 (pedagogical synthesis, not a phrase in the literature); [†caveat-T] for the Tchebycheff-tropical analogy (informal, not yet a published theorem); [†caveat-Lucas] for the Goodhart-vs-Lucas distinction. The list is summarised in §9.5.

Loosening lines, not a single thread. A reader familiar with the bilevel optimization literature will recognise the rhetorical move of organising a survey around a single technical assumption whose successive relaxation drives the field forward (e.g., bilevel's lower-level-singleton assumption). MOO does not work this way. The field has three or four parallel loosening lines — the convex-front assumption, the static-weight assumption, the single-solution-output assumption — and they belong to different communities. We use the phrase "loosening thread" to name this structure; §1 develops it.

docs.title: §0 Notation
docs.text:
We adopt the notation of Ehrgott (2005) and Désidéri (2014) throughout; per-symbol justification is given in Table 1. Three conventions are essential to the survey's correctness and depart from common informal usage.

First, the unit simplex with \(m\) vertices is an \((m-1)\)-dimensional affine object — the constraint \(\sum_i w_i = 1\) removes one degree of freedom — so its standard name is \(\Delta^{m-1}\), not \(\Delta^m\). Equation (E1): $\(\Delta^{m-1} = \Big\{\,w \in \mathbb{R}^m_{\ge 0}\ :\ extstyle\sum_{i=1}^m w_i = 1\,\Big\}. ag{E1}\)$ This convention is uniform in Ehrgott (2005) and Miettinen (1999); the variant "\(\Delta^m\)" for the \(m\)-vertex case is off by one [†caveat-M].

Second, we distinguish two simplex-valued objects that are routinely conflated in the MTL literature. We write \( oldsymbol{\alpha} \in \Delta^{k-1}\) for computed task weights — the output of an algorithm such as MGDA's quadratic program, \( oldsymbol{\alpha}^\star = \arg\min_{ oldsymbol{\alpha}\in\Delta^{k-1}}\|\sum_i \alpha_i abla J_i\|^2\). We write \( oldsymbol{\omega} \in \Delta^{k-1}\) for user preference weights — an input to a method such as preference-conditioned hypernetworks (PHN, Navon et al. 2021) or Rewarded Soups (Rame et al. 2023). The two never appear in the same role, and informal MTL writing routinely conflates them; the discipline here is to keep the symbols separate. Where Désidéri's min-norm element would clash with the preference symbol, we use \(\mathbf{d}^\star\) in body prose.

Third, three reference points appear in distinct roles. The utopia (or ideal) point \(z^\star\in\mathbb{R}^k\) is the componentwise minimum \(z_i^\star = \min_{x\in S} f_i(x)\) and serves as the Tchebycheff anchor. The reference point \(z^{\mathrm{ref}}\) in Wierzbicki's achievement scalarization is decision-maker-supplied and need not be feasible. The hypervolume reference \(r\in\mathbb{R}^k\) is the dominator \(r\succeq A\) used to bound the dominated region for HV computation; it is distinct from \(z^\star\) and from \(z^{\mathrm{ref}}\).

Symbol Meaning Note \(\mathbf{x}\in S\subset\mathbb{R}^n\) Decision variable \(n\) = decision-space dim \(f_i(\mathbf{x}),\ i=1,\dots,k\) Objective \(i\) \(k\) = number of objectives \(\preceq,\prec\) Pareto dominance (\(\le\) with \( e\)), strict (\(<\) all coords) \(D\subseteq\mathbb{R}^k\) Domination cone (default \(\mathbb{R}^k_{\ge 0}\)) Sawaragi-Nakayama-Tanino 1985 \(\Delta^{m-1}\) Unit simplex with \(m\) vertices \((m-1)\)-dim \( oldsymbol{\alpha}\in\Delta^{k-1}\) Computed task weights algorithm output \( oldsymbol{\omega}\in\Delta^{k-1}\) User preference weights algorithm input \(\mathbf{g}_i = abla_ heta\mathcal{L}_i\) Task-\(i\) gradient \(\mathbf{g}_0 = frac{1}{k}\sum_i\mathbf{g}_i\) Average gradient (CAGrad reference) \(U = \mathrm{conv}\{ abla J_i\}\) Convex hull of gradients Désidéri 2012 \(\mathbf{d}^\star = \arg\min_{u\in U}\|u\|\) Min-norm element MGDA primitive \(z^\star\) Utopia / ideal point Tchebycheff anchor \(z^{\mathrm{ref}}\) Reference point Wierzbicki achievement \(r\) HV reference point (\(r\succeq A\)) \( eta\) KL temperature in DPO/RLHF \(\pi_{\mathrm{ref}}\) Reference policy KL-regularized RLHF \(R_\phi, C_\psi\) Helpfulness reward / cost model Safe RLHF \(\lambda^{\mathrm{CMDP}}\) CMDP Lagrange multiplier distinct from Rewarded-Soups \(\lambda\) \( heta_\lambda = \sum_i\lambda_i heta_i\) Rewarded Soups interpolation \(\lambda\in\Delta^{k-1}\) \( ho^\pi(s,a)\) Occupancy measure Altman 1999 \(\mathcal{V}^\star(s)\) Set of non-dominated value vectors White 1982

docs.title: §1 The Dilemma and Three Threads
docs.text:
MOO does not have a single loosening thread; it has three or four parallel ones, each driven by a different community. To see why this matters, consider how the field's foundational worry has been phrased across forty years. Ehrgott's textbook opens with the observation that the decision maker faces "conflicting, often incommensurable, objectives to be simultaneously evaluated and optimized" (Ehrgott 2005, blurb). Twenty-three years earlier, Sawaragi, Nakayama, and Tanino had already formalised the same intuition through the partial order induced by a domination cone, and Hwang and Masud (1979) had organised the surrounding methodological landscape by when the decision maker articulates a preference. By 2018 the dilemma reappears, almost word for word, in Sener and Koltun's reframing of multi-task learning: "Multi-task learning is inherently a multi-objective problem because different tasks may conflict, necessitating a trade-off" (Sener and Koltun 2018, abstract). By 2024 the LLM alignment community states the same thing again — Panacea (Zhong et al. 2024) writes that scalar preference labels "oversimplify the multi-dimensional and heterogeneous nature of human preferences, leading to reduced expressivity and even misalignment."

The recurrence is itself remarkable. What is harder to explain is that each community has independently re-derived not only the diagnosis but its standard answers — Pareto sets, scalarisation, decomposition, set-based output — without consistently citing the other communities' priors. A reader who learns MOO through operations research will encounter Tchebycheff scalarisation as a 1986 breakthrough (Steuer 1986); a reader who learns MOO through deep MTL will encounter "preference-conditioned hypernetworks" (Navon et al. 2021) as a 2021 breakthrough; almost no introductory deep-learning text observes that the latter is structurally a population-based decomposition method (MOEA/D, Zhang and Li 2007) lifted to a hypernetwork inference surface.

A natural response is to ask whether MOO admits a single unifying technical loosening thread comparable to the bilevel optimization community's lower-level-singleton (LLS) assumption, which over thirty years was loosened from singleton through strong-convexity to convexity to stationary-point. The answer, on close reading, is not quite — and the reasons are themselves diagnostic of how MOO has actually evolved. Three or four parallel loosening lines exist:

(i) The convex-front assumption. Weighted-sum scalarisation, \(\min_x \sum_i w_i f_i(x)\), recovers only the convex-hull-supported portion of the Pareto front; concave regions are inaccessible for any nonnegative \(w\) (Miettinen 1999, §3.1). This assumption was first loosened by weighted Tchebycheff scalarisation \(\min_x \max_i w_i|f_i(x)-z_i^\star|\), which under mild conditions sweeps the entire properly-Pareto front (Steuer 1986; Miettinen Thm 3.4.5 [†caveat-M]). It was loosened a second time by population-based evolutionary methods (Deb 2001; Zitzler 1999) that do not depend on any scalarisation. It was loosened a third time by gradient-based MOO via MGDA, which finds a Pareto-stationary point on the deep-learning loss surface without committing to any scalarisation (Désidéri 2012; Sener and Koltun 2018). And it was loosened a fourth time by weight-interpolation methods (Rewarded Soups, Rame et al. 2023) that approximate Pareto-optimal generalisation across preference space by linear combination of fine-tuned model checkpoints. The explicit loosening claim is in Sener and Koltun (2018): "this workaround [linear combination] is only valid when the tasks do not compete, which is rarely the case."

(ii) The static-weight assumption. Even within scalarisation, the source of weights has been loosened over time. Hwang and Masud (1979) presented a priori, a posteriori, and interactive variants in their original three-segment classification, which Miettinen (1999) extended to four quadrants by adding the no-preference class. Roijers, Vamplew, Whiteson, and Dazeley (2013) re-derived the same taxonomy fourteen years later for sequential decision problems: "we identify three distinct scenarios in which converting such a problem to a single-objective one is impossible, infeasible, or undesirable." Deep MTL added a fifth modality: weights are learned during training (GradNorm; uncertainty weighting). Preference-conditioned LLM alignment added a sixth: weights are an inference-time input (PHN, Rewarded Soups, Panacea).

(iii) The single-solution-output assumption. Classical OR returned a single compromise point. EMO returned an approximating set in a single run, by virtue of maintaining a population (Deb 2001). Preference-conditioned hypernetworks returned a continuum of points parametrised by a hypernet input. Panacea (Zhong et al. 2024) returns the same continuum from a single model: "Instead of just learning one such solution, we focus on learning the entire set of Pareto-optimal solutions." The output object expanded from a point to a set to a preference-indexed family of model parameters.

Three threads run laterally through these loosening lines and reappear in §2, §5, §7, and §8 — we name them here so a reader does not mistake them for one-off digressions. Thread 1 is welfare economics: utilitarian (weighted sum), Rawlsian (max-min and Tchebycheff), Nash bargaining (Nash-MTL), and the Sen capability framework whose dominance order coincides with Pareto's. Thread 2 is information theory and \(f\)-divergence: the choice of divergence in DPO and KL-regularised RLHF acts as a hidden scalarisation between fidelity and mode-coverage. Thread 3 is Goodhart's Law: reward over-optimisation in RLHF is the extremal variant of Manheim and Garrabrant's (2018) Goodhart taxonomy, not the Lucas critique, because the reward model is frozen while the policy distribution shifts. Two further threads — order theory and the cone framing, and decomposition as a design pattern — receive their own subsections in §8.

The reader's map for what follows. §2 develops the order-theoretic core that the four communities share. §3 exhibits the translation table between their vocabularies. §4-§7 walk each community: evolutionary, gradient MTL, MORL, and RLHF. §8 consolidates the lateral threads. §9 develops critical-reading case studies. §10 lists open problems; §11 is the reading list.

docs.title: §2 Core Theory: What Pareto Optimality Actually Buys You
docs.text: Pareto optimality is best understood not as a property of objectives but of the partial order induced by a domination cone \(D\), with three nested efficiency notions (weak, Pareto, strict, proper) and three nested scalarisation classes (weighted sum on convex-supported only; Tchebycheff on every Pareto point; achievement-function with augmentation).

docs.title: 2.1 Order-theoretic foundation
docs.text:
Sawaragi, Nakayama, and Tanino (1985) formalised the multi-objective problem \(\min_X f\) relative to a partial order \(\preceq\) on \(\mathbb{R}^k\). Given a closed pointed convex cone \(D\subseteq\mathbb{R}^k\), the cone-induced dominance is $\(y \preceq_D y' \iff y' - y \in D\setminus\{0\}. \tag{E2}\)$ Efficiency is then minimality of \(f(x)\) under \(\preceq_D\). Geometrically, the cone \(D\) at a point \(y\) is the set of directions you must move to worsen \(y\). Pareto's \(D = \mathbb{R}^k_{\ge 0}\setminus\{0\}\) says "worsening = larger in every coordinate"; weak Pareto uses the dominance relation \(y\prec_w y'\iff y'-y\in\mathrm{int}(\mathbb{R}^k_{\ge 0}) = \mathbb{R}^k_{>0}\) (strict in every coordinate; the underlying cone is the same, but the dominance is the interior relation, since \(\mathbb{R}^k_{>0}\) itself is not closed and therefore violates the closed-pointed assumption of Sawaragi-Nakayama-Tanino). A tilted cone \(D'\) obtained by rotating \(\mathbb{R}^k_{\ge 0}\) encodes preference-weighted directions (Yu 1985's preference cones), letting the user say "I trade off task 1 for task 2 at no worse than rate 3:1" by tilting \(D\) in the corresponding direction.

Three propositions of the order-theoretic framework recur. Existence: under compactness of \(f(X) + D\) and an external-stability condition, efficient solutions exist (Sawaragi et al. 1985, Thm 3.2.1 [†caveat-M]). Scalarisation characterisation: \(\hat{x}\) is \(D\)-efficient if and only if it solves \(\min_X \varphi(f(x))\) for some strictly \(D\)-monotone \(\varphi\). Duality: the dual cone \(D^\star = \{w:\langle w,d\rangle\ge 0\ \forall d\in D\}\) gives the admissible weight directions; for \(D=\mathbb{R}^k_{\ge 0}\), \(D^\star = \mathbb{R}^k_{\ge 0}\) recovers nonnegative weights.

The pedagogical point is that "is this solution Pareto-optimal?" is incomplete without specifying \(D\). ML papers asking the question of MTL solutions tend to leave \(D\) implicit at \(\mathbb{R}^k_{\ge 0}\) and to confuse Pareto efficiency with weak efficiency on boundary cases. The order-theoretic view dissolves the confusion: the question is decided by the cone the user chose, often implicitly.

docs.title: 2.2 Pareto-stationarity and the non-degenerate interior
docs.text:
Désidéri (2012, 2014) introduced the multiple-gradient descent algorithm (MGDA) whose stationarity certificate has become the standard target for gradient-based MOO. The certificate is

\[ ext{$y_0$ is Pareto-stationary} \iff \exists\ oldsymbol{\alpha}\in\Delta^{k-1}\ ext{s.t.}\ \sum_{i=1}^{k}\alpha_i abla J_i(y_0) = 0. ag{E3} \]

The common descent direction at a non-stationary point is \(-\mathbf{d}^\star\), where \(\mathbf{d}^\star\) is the min-norm element of the gradient convex hull

\[ \mathbf{d}^\star = \arg\min_{u\in U}\|u\|,\qquad U = \mathrm{conv}\{ abla J_i(y_0)\}. ag{E4} \]

We adopt Désidéri's convention: \(\mathbf{d}^\star\) denotes the min-norm element itself; the update direction is \(-\mathbf{d}^\star\), along which \(\langle abla J_i, -\mathbf{d}^\star angle = -\|\mathbf{d}^\star\|^2 < 0\) for every \(i\), i.e., every objective is descended. The convergence guarantee (Désidéri 2012, Thm 1): under \(C^1\) smoothness and Wolfe-condition line search, MGDA iterates have accumulation points, all of which are Pareto-stationary; convexity is not required for this. For nonconvex objectives, Pareto-stationarity is necessary but not sufficient for Pareto-optimality; under (quasi)convexity, stationarity ⇔ Pareto-optimality.

A persistent error in ML expositions of (E3) is to display the certificate with a boundary example — \(\alpha_1 = 1, \alpha_2 = 0\) — as though that were the interesting case. It is not, because \(\alpha_1=1, \alpha_2=0\) collapses (E3) to single-objective stationarity of \(J_1\) and contributes nothing to the multi-objective story. The instructive case is the interior of the simplex, where every \(\alpha_i \in (0,1)\) and all gradients are genuinely contributing. Désidéri's MGDA-II / Gram-Schmidt construction (Désidéri 2014, eqs. 16-17) gives such an example explicitly. For an orthogonalised gradient family \(\{u_i\}\) (the orthogonality precondition is what gives (E5) its closed form; without it the min-norm-element coefficients of \(\mathrm{conv}\{u_i\}\) have no such simple expression), $$ \mathbf{d}^\star = \sum_i \alpha_i u_i,\qquad \alpha_i = rac{1}{1+\sum_{j e i}|u_i|^2/|u_j|^2}\in(0,1). ag{E5} $$ Geometrically, when the orthogonal projection of the origin onto the affine hull of \(\{u_i\}\) lies inside the convex hull, the projection equals \(\mathbf{d}^\star\) and the inner product \(\langle u_i, \mathbf{d}^\star angle = \|\mathbf{d}^\star\|^2\) is equal across all objectives (Désidéri 2014, eq. 12); along the update direction \(-\mathbf{d}^\star\), every directional derivative \(\langle u_i, -\mathbf{d}^\star angle = -\|\mathbf{d}^\star\|^2\) is equal and negative — every objective descends at the same rate. This is the genuine non-degenerate Pareto-stationary configuration, with every coefficient in the open simplex interior. Derivation: orthogonalise the gradient family, project the origin onto its affine hull, and read off the barycentric coordinates; each \(\alpha_i\) is large when \(\|u_i\|\) is small relative to its siblings — small-norm objectives get more weight, which is the precise sense in which MGDA equalises pressure.

docs.title: 2.3 Cone-dominance and proper efficiency
docs.text:
Ehrgott (2005, Ch. 4-5) collects the standard hierarchy of efficiency notions: - Weak Pareto: \(\hat{x}\) is weakly efficient iff there is no \(x\) with \(f_i(x) < f_i(\hat x)\) for every \(i\). Equivalent to the dominance relation \(y\prec_w y' \iff y'-y\in\mathrm{int}(\mathbb{R}^k_{\ge 0})\). - Pareto (efficient): \(\hat x\) admits no \(x\) with \(f(x)\le f(\hat x)\) and \(f(x)\ne f(\hat x)\). Equivalent to \(D=\mathbb{R}^k_{\ge 0}\setminus\{0\}\). - Strict Pareto: \(\hat x\) admits no \(x\ne\hat x\) with \(f(x)\le f(\hat x)\) componentwise. - Proper (Geoffrion 1968): \(\hat x\) is efficient and there exists \(M>0\) such that for every \(i\) and every \(x\) with \(f_i(x) < f_i(\hat x)\), some \(j\) has \(f_j(x) > f_j(\hat x)\) with \(\frac{f_i(\hat x)-f_i(x)}{f_j(x)-f_j(\hat x)} \le M\).

Proper efficiency rules out pathological "infinite-trade-off" Pareto points and is the natural target for weighted-sum and achievement-function scalarisations. The intuition: an improper Pareto point is one where buying an arbitrarily small improvement in \(f_i\) costs an unbounded loss in \(f_j\). These are usually geometric pathologies (cusps, corners), not points a decision-maker would want. Proper efficiency rules them out by capping the worst trade-off ratio at a finite \(M\). The cone view also opens the door to preference-cone MOO (Yu 1985), which appears in some recent RLHF work where the decision maker's preferences induce a non-standard dominance.

docs.title: 2.4 The scalarisation zoo
docs.text:
Six standard scalarisations cover most of practical MOO; their completeness and failure modes are well documented (Miettinen 1999, Chs 3-4 [†caveat-M]).

Method Form Coverage of Pareto front Failure mode Weighted sum \(\min_x \sum_i w_i f_i\) Convex-supported region only Misses non-convex / concave segments Weighted Tchebycheff \(\min_x \max_i w_i\lvert f_i - z_i^\star\rvert\), see (E6) Every properly Pareto point Non-smooth; admits weakly-Pareto solutions \(\varepsilon\)-constraint \(\min_x f_j\) s.t. \(f_i \le \varepsilon_i, i\ne j\) Every Pareto point Need to know the front to pick \(\varepsilon\) Achievement function \(\min_x\{\max_i (f_i - z_i^{\mathrm{ref}})/w_i + \rho\sum_i (f_i - z_i^{\mathrm{ref}})/w_i\}\), see (E7) Every properly Pareto point Sensitive to \(\rho\) (needs \(\rho\in(0,\rho_0)\)); needs reference point Lexicographic sequential \(\min_x f_{\pi(1)}\), fix, \(\min_x f_{\pi(2)}\), … One point per permutation Discontinuous in priorities Goal programming \(\min_x \sum_i\|f_i - g_i\|_p\) Not guaranteed Pareto-optimal unless goals infeasible Dominated solutions if goals inside feasible image

The two equations referenced are $$ g_T(x;w,z^\star) = \max_{i=1,\dots,k} w_i\lvert f_i(x) - z_i^\star\rvert, \tag{E6} $$ $$ g_A(x;w,z^{\mathrm{ref}}) = \max_i (f_i(x) - z_i^{\mathrm{ref}})/w_i + \rho\sum_i (f_i(x) - z_i^{\mathrm{ref}})/w_i, \tag{E7} $$ following Miettinen (1999, Def. 3.4.7), with \(w_i>0\) in the denominator and \(\rho\in(0,\rho_0)\) for problem-dependent \(\rho_0\) tied to the maximum allowable trade-off ratio (Geoffrion's proper-efficiency bound). Under these conditions, minimising \(g_A\) recovers exactly the properly Pareto-efficient solutions regardless of whether \(z^{\mathrm{ref}}\) is feasible.

The completeness gap between weighted-sum and Tchebycheff (E6) is the operational reason weighted-sum loss-balancing fails on non-convex Pareto fronts. Sener and Koltun's (2018) explicit loosening claim — that weighted-sum is valid only when tasks do not compete — is this fifty-year-old observation transposed into deep learning. The achievement function (E7) further generalises Tchebycheff by allowing an infeasible reference \(z^{\mathrm{ref}}\) and adding a \(\rho\)-augmentation that excludes weakly-Pareto solutions, giving the strongest scalarisation guarantee in the table (Wierzbicki 1980; Miettinen 1999, §3.4 [†caveat-M]).

docs.title: 2.5 Convexity, support, and the geometry of unreached points
docs.text:
A point \(\hat x\) is supported (weighted-sum-reachable) iff \(f(\hat x)\) lies on the boundary of \(\mathrm{conv}\,f(X) + \mathbb{R}^k_{\ge 0}\) that admits a separating hyperplane with nonnegative normal. For concave segments of \(f(X)\), no \(w\succeq 0\) yields \(\hat x\) — these are the duality-gap Pareto points that Tchebycheff and \(\varepsilon\)-constraint do recover.
