Closest single-volume reference for §2 + §3 of v3. Pair with Miettinen 1999 for the cleanest path into Phase 0d's notation table. [Author per Phase 0d §5 — Matthias Ehrgott.]

  2. Deb, Multi-Objective Optimization using Evolutionary Algorithms, Wiley 2001. ★★ The reference for the evolutionary MOO community (§4 of v3): NSGA-II origin context, dominance-based vs decomposition-based vs indicator-based taxonomy, and the practical why-and-how of population-based methods.

Less essential for a reader focused on the LLM-era thesis, but indispensable for §4 (H1–H6) and for situating the LLM4MOEA bridge of §4.3. [Author per Phase 0d §5 textbook block — Kalyanmoy Deb.]

  1. Geoffrion, "Proper efficiency and the theory of vector maximization", J. Math. Anal. Appl. 22(3):618–630, 1968. ★★★ The single most cited foundational paper of v3. Geoffrion-proper Pareto-efficiency and the proof that linear scalarisation recovers exactly the convex hull of \(\mathcal{P}^\star\) are the seed of the four-restatement identity that organises the entire survey (§1, §2.2 P2, §6 FC-5, §9.1 MODPO defect, §12.5 closure).

If you read only one classical paper before v3, read this one. [Author per Phase 0d §5 — Arthur M. Geoffrion.]

  1. Désidéri, "Multiple-gradient descent algorithm (MGDA) for multiobjective optimization", Comptes Rendus Mathématique 350(5–6):313–318, 2012. ★★★ The origin paper for the min-norm projection algorithm that powers all gradient MTL methods of §5. Defines the Pareto-stationarity certificate \(\mathbf{d}^\star=\mathbf{0}\) and the common-descent direction \(-\mathbf{d}^\star\).

Underwrites §5.1 (M1–M3) and §6 (the FC-5 caveat — Pareto-stationarity ≠ Pareto-optimality). Short (six pages), formal, and essential. [Author per Phase 0d §5 — Jean-Antoine Désidéri.]

  1. Sener and Koltun, "Multi-task learning as multi-objective optimization", NeurIPS 2018 (arXiv 1810.04650). ★★★ The paper that brought MGDA into deep learning by introducing the shared-encoder upper-bound surrogate MGDA-UB. Section §5.1's discussion of the encoder-activation-space subproblem follows this paper directly.

Also the entry point for the FC-5 cautionary line: MGDA-UB inherits MGDA's Pareto-stationarity-not-optimality limitation. [Authors per Phase 0d §5 — Ozan Sener, Vladlen Koltun.]

  1. Rafailov, Sharma, Mitchell, Ermon, Manning, Finn, "Direct Preference Optimization", NeurIPS 2023 (arXiv 2305.18290). ★★★ The closed-form derivation that makes the entire §8–§9–§11 axis of v3 possible. Theorem D1 of §8.1 is reproduced from this paper.

Reading the reverse-KL direction \(\mathbb{D}_{KL}[\pi_\theta\|\pi_{\text{ref}}]\) in the original is the cleanest way to internalise why the partition function \(Z(s)\) cancels in the log-ratio (Phase 0d §3 / §9 rule 5 — direction load-bearing). [Authors per Phase 0d §5 — full chain spelled out in §8.1 header.]

  1. Gheshlaghi Azar, Rowland, Piot, Guo, Calandriello, Valko, Munos, "A general theoretical paradigm to understand learning from human preferences" (IPO), AISTATS 2024 (arXiv 2310.12036). ★★★ The \(\Psi\)-PO general loss family that unifies DPO, IPO, KTO under a single regularisation lens.

§8.2 reproduces the IPO loss and ties it back to Phase 0d FC-3 (venue verified via proceedings.mlr.press v238, not the arXiv landing page). Read alongside DPO to see how the partition-cancellation trick generalises. [Authors per Phase 0d §5 corrected registry — 7-author canonical IPO byline.]

docs.title: B. Extending — 2024–2026 LLM-era MOO papers and their immediate predecessors
docs.text:
1. Lin, Zhen, Li, Zhang, Kwong, "Pareto multi-task learning" (Pareto MTL), NeurIPS 2019 (proceedings hash 685bfde0…). ★★ Introduces the preference-ray / cone-constraint formulation that produces \(K\) Pareto-aligned points from \(K\) user preferences. Underwrites §5.5 (Pareto MTL and EPO). Cite by NeurIPS proceedings hash per Phase 0d FC-16 (no arXiv ID). [Authors per Phase 0d §5 — Xi Lin et al., 5-author chain.]

  2. Yu, Kumar, Gupta, Levine, Hausman, Finn, "Gradient Surgery for Multi-Task Learning" (PCGrad), NeurIPS 2020 (arXiv 2001.06782). ★★ Pairwise gradient orthogonalisation as the simplest "conflict-mitigation" replacement for MGDA. Read for §5.2 (theorem M4) and as the entry point to the cosine-trap critique in §6 / FC-5. [Authors per Phase 0d §5.]

  3. Liu, Liu, Jin, Stone, Liu, "Conflict-Averse Gradient Descent" (CAGrad), NeurIPS 2021 (arXiv 2110.14048). ★★★ The only gradient-MTL method in v3's §5 with a stationary-of-average-loss guarantee (theorem M6, FC-5). The trust-region max-min formulation around the average gradient is the structural escape from Pareto-stationarity-not-Pareto-optimality. If §6 is the v3 single sharpest finding, this paper is its load-bearing citation. [Authors per Phase 0d §5.]

  4. Chen, Badrinarayanan, Lee, Rabinovich, "GradNorm: Gradient Normalization for Adaptive Loss Balancing in Deep Multitask Networks", ICML 2018 (arXiv 1711.02257). ★ The most cited "naive" loss-weighting baseline (§5.6). Read to understand what gradient-MTL methods of §5.1–§5.4 are replacing; not a Pareto-MOO method by §S0's strict definition. [Authors per Phase 0d §5.]

  5. Navon, Shamsian, Achituve, Maron, Kawaguchi, Chechik, Fetaya, "Multi-task learning as a bargaining game" (Nash-MTL), ICML 2022 (arXiv 2202.01017). ★★ Lifts Nash's cooperative-bargaining solution to gradient MTL, with explicit IIA / symmetry / scale-invariance axioms. Underwrites §5.4 (theorem M7) and the B↔C stitch via Thomson 2016 (anchor 3 below): N2/N3 transfer-failure is the cooperative-bargaining ancestor of Nash-MTL's instability under heterogeneous alignment scales. [Authors per Phase 0d §5 — 7-author chain.]

  6. Ethayarajh, Xu, Muennighoff, Jurafsky, Kiela, "Model Alignment as Prospect Theoretic Optimization" (KTO), ICML 2024 (arXiv 2402.01306). ★★ Replaces the Bradley–Terry likelihood with a Kahneman–Tversky utility, generating an alignment loss that does not require paired preference data. Underwrites §8.3 (theorem D3). [Authors per Phase 0d §5.]

  7. Ramé, Couairon, Shukor, Dancette, Gaya, Soulier, Cord, "Rewarded Soups", NeurIPS 2023 (arXiv 2306.04488). ★★★ The first widely-cited demonstration that parameter-space interpolation of independently fine-tuned models traces an approximate Pareto front. Underwrites §11.2 (theorem L2). The clearest test case for the U5 thread of Phase 0b (preference-conditioned single-model alignment) and for the LMC-at-\(k\ge 3\) open seam. [Authors per Phase 0d §5 — 7-author chain.]

  8. Zhong, Ma, Zhang, Yang, Chen, Zhang, Qi, Yang, "Panacea: Pareto Alignment via Preference Adaptation for LLMs" (SVD-LoRA), NeurIPS 2024 (arXiv 2402.02030). ★★★ Refines Rewarded Soups by modulating LoRA singular values according to a preference vector \(\boldsymbol{\lambda}\) supplied at inference time, producing a single model that sweeps the front. Underwrites §11.3 (theorem L3) and is the clearest 2024 instantiation of U5. [Authors per Phase 0d §5 — 8-author chain.]

  9. Zhou, Liu, Yang, Shao, Liu, Yue, Ouyang, Qiao, "Beyond One-Preference-Fits-All Alignment: Multi-Objective Direct Preference Optimization" (MODPO), Findings of ACL 2024 (arXiv 2310.03708). ★★★ The linear-scalarised multi-reward extension of DPO. Underwrites §9.1 (theorem D4) and is the alignment-community face of the four-restatement identity (§9.1's "MODPO completeness defect" paragraph). [Authors per Phase 0d §5 — 8-author chain.]

  10. Josef Dai, Pan, Sun, Ji, Xu, Liu, Wang, Yang, "Safe RLHF", ICLR 2024 (arXiv 2310.12773). ★★★ The canonical iterative PPO-Lagrangian alignment paper. Underwrites §10.1 (theorem S1) and the dual-as-scalarisation-weight identity of §10.3. Read alongside Huang et al. NeurIPS 2024 (entry 19) for the iterative-vs-one-shot dualisation contrast. Authorship hedge per FC-12: ICLR proceedings file uses "Josef Dai"; some bibliographic exports list "Juntao Dai" as the same author. [Authors per Phase 0d §5 — 8-author chain.]

  11. Huang, Li, Dobriban, Bastani, Hassani, Ding, "One-Shot Safety Alignment" (CAN / MOCAN / PECAN, NeurIPS 2024 spotlight, arXiv 2405.19544). ★★★ Closed-form dual \(D(\eta)\) with the precise smoothness statement of FC-4: \((G/\beta)\)-smooth and locally strongly convex at \(\eta^\star\), not globally. §10.2 reproduces theorem S2 with this exact qualifier. Open seam 3 (global convergence of one-shot dualisation) hinges on whether the local-strong-convexity statement can be tightened. [Authors per Phase 0d §5 — 6-author chain.]

  12. Chakraborty, Qiu, Yuan, Koppel, Huang, Manocha, Bedi, Wang, "MaxMin-RLHF", ICML 2024 (arXiv 2402.08925). ★★★ The partial existence proof for non-linear-scalarised DPO via Sion's minimax theorem under convex-concave compactness conditions. Underwrites §12.1 (theorem X1) and is restatement (1) of the four-restatement identity in the egalitarian SWF direction.

Author list per FC-8 corrected registry: 8 authors, with Alec Koppel included; Phase 0c had spurious "Ramesh" and "Jain" and missing "Koppel" — do not propagate. [Authors per Phase 0d §5 corrected registry — 8-author chain.]

  1. Sorensen, Moore, Fisher, Gordon, Mireshghallah, Rytting, Ye, Jiang, Lu, Dziri, Althoff, Choi, "A Roadmap to Pluralistic Alignment", ICML 2024 position paper (arXiv 2402.05070). ★★ The position paper that taxonomises three modes of pluralistic alignment (Overton / Steerable / Distributional). §12.2 cites this as the conceptual companion to the X1 / MaxMin formalism. [Authors per Phase 0d §5 — 12-author chain.]

  2. Lin, Zhang, Yang, Liu, Wang, Zhang, "Smooth Tchebycheff Scalarization for Multi-Objective Optimization", ICML 2024 (arXiv 2402.19078). ★★★ The differentiable surrogate for the non-smooth Tchebycheff scalarisation, with controllable smoothness parameter \(\mu>0\). §9.2 of v3 (theorem D5) reproduces this. Open seam 1 — Tchebycheff-DPO closed form — depends on whether the partition-cancellation trick of D1 carries through under the Smooth-Tchebycheff loss. [Authors per Phase 0d §5 — 6-author chain.]

  3. Yang, Sun, Narasimhan, "A Generalized Algorithm for Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning and Policy Adaptation" (envelope Q-learning), NeurIPS 2019 (arXiv 1908.08342). ★★ The single-network MORL method that conditions on \(\boldsymbol{\lambda}\) to recover the convex coverage set CCS. Underwrites §7.2 (theorem V2) and is the MORL counterpart of preference-conditioned single-model alignment (§11.3 Panacea analogue). [Authors per Phase 0d §5 — 3-author chain.]

  4. MAH-DPO (arXiv 2510.01167), October 2025. ★★ Multi-head DPO with per-head non-scalarised reward heads — the alignment-community attempt to escape the MODPO convex-hull restriction by not scalarising. Underwrites §9.3. Cite by anchor per FC-13; author chain [​作者​待​ verify — see FC-13].

  5. RPO unified \(\Psi\)-PO framework (arXiv 2502.00203), January 2025. ★ A 2025 unification of DPO / IPO / KTO under a single link-function framework. Underwrites §8.4. Cite by anchor per FC-13; author chain [​作者​待​ verify — see FC-13].

  6. Robust MO-Online DPO (arXiv 2503.00295), March 2025. ★ Online adaptive \(\boldsymbol{\lambda}\) for multi-reward DPO under reward-model drift. Underwrites §9.4. Cite by anchor per FC-13; author chain [​作者​待​ verify — see FC-13].

  7. MALBO — multi-objective Bayesian optimisation for LLM agents (arXiv 2511.11788), November 2025. ★ Hypervolume-improvement acquisition over discrete tool / team configurations. Underwrites §12.3 (agentic MOO). Cite by anchor per FC-13; author chain [​作者​待​ verify — see FC-13].

  8. BRIDGE — bilevel SFT/RL PEFT formulation (arXiv 2509.06948), September 2025. ★ Bilevel optimisation bridging classical MOO with LoRA / PEFT. Underwrites §12.3. Cite by anchor per FC-13; author chain [​作者​待​ verify — see FC-13].

docs.title: C. Foundations — methodological sources upstream of the survey
docs.text:
1. Pareto, Manuale di Economia Politica, Società Editrice Libraria, 1906. ★ The original statement of Pareto-efficiency in welfare economics. v3 cites the modern formalisation (via Miettinen 1999 / Ehrgott 2005) rather than the 1906 manual directly, but readers seeking the origin of the dominance relation \(\preceq\) used throughout §S0 should know where it came from. Author: Vilfredo Pareto (textbook block of Phase 0d §5).

  2. Karush, "Minima of functions of several variables with inequality constraints as side conditions", MSc thesis, University of Chicago, 1939; and Kuhn–Tucker, "Nonlinear programming", Proc. 2nd Berkeley Symp. Math. Stat. Prob., University of California Press, 1951. ★★ The founding statements of the KKT system reproduced in §3 (theorem K1, four conditions).

The vector-valued generalisation of §3 uses simplex multipliers \(\boldsymbol{\alpha}\in\Delta^{k-1}\) in place of a single Lagrange scalar, but the four-condition structure (stationarity / complementary slackness / primal feasibility / dual feasibility) is preserved verbatim. Authors per Phase 0d §5 textbook block.

  1. Steuer and Choo, "An interactive weighted Tchebycheff procedure for multiple objective programming", Math. Programming 26(3):326–344, 1983. ★ The canonical MCDM reference for the Tchebycheff and achievement-scalarising-function families introduced in §2.2 (P3, P4). Underwrites the "non-linear scalarisation completeness" half of the lattice. Authors per Phase 0d §5 textbook block — Ralph E. Steuer, Eng-Ung Choo.

  2. Roijers, Vamplew, Whiteson, Dazeley, "A survey of multi-objective sequential decision-making", JAIR 2013. ★★★ The MORL community's canonical taxonomy paper, source of the CCS-vs-PCS distinction reproduced in §7.1 (theorem V1) and central to restatement (3) of the four-restatement identity. Read first if §7 of v3 feels under-defined on what "vector value function" actually means. [Authors per Phase 0d §5 — 4-author chain.]

  3. Hayes, Rădulescu, Bargiacchi, Källström, Macfarlane, Reymond, Verstraeten, Zintgraf, Dazeley, Heintz, Howley, Irissappane, Mannion, Nowé, Ramos, Restelli, Vamplew, Roijers, "A practical guide to multi-objective reinforcement learning and planning", JAAMAS 36 Art. 26, 2022 (arXiv 2103.09568). ★★ Recasts the Roijers JAIR 2013 taxonomy in utility-profile language and makes the CCS ⊊ PCS strict gap explicit under non-linear utility \(u:\mathbb{R}^k\to\mathbb{R}\). Direct underwriter of §7.1 V1. [Authors per Phase 0d §5 — 18-author chain.]

docs.title: D. Cross-domain conceptual references (§12.6 anchor pool)
docs.text:
1. Sen, Collective Choice and Social Welfare, Holden-Day 1970 (Penguin reissue 2017). ★★★ The welfare-economics foundation that v3 §12.6 / §12.4 imports to reframe the Pareto-aware-benchmark gap (theorem X2, FC-7) as a Sen-style aggregation problem: HELM's arithmetic-mean aggregation is the utilitarian social welfare function \(W_{\mathrm{Util}}=k^{-1}\sum_i s_i\); the X1 / MaxMin restatement maps to Sen's Egalitarian SWF \(W_{\mathrm{Egal}}=\min_i s_i\).

Read for the deep-structural sense of why HELM "is not just missing a Pareto front; it is committed to a social-choice axiom". Author: Amartya Sen. The 1970 monograph (plus Sen 1976 Econometrica) is the cleanest single source.

  1. Markowitz, "Portfolio Selection", Journal of Finance 7(1):77–91, March 1952. ★★★ The original derivation of the mean–variance efficient frontier — literally the Pareto front of the bi-objective problem \(\min_{\mathbf{w}}(-\mu(\mathbf{w}),\sigma^2(\mathbf{w}))\) under PSD covariance \(\Sigma\). v3 §12.6 uses this as the cleanest worked example of P2's hypothesis being satisfied (convex case, linear scalarisation \(-\mu+\gamma\sigma^2\) sweeps the front).

Reading the 1952 paper alongside §2.2 of v3 is the fastest way to internalise why the convex-hull restriction matters: the cautionary tale — Conditional-Value-at-Risk (CVaR) under Rockafellar–Uryasev 2000 generates a non-convex frontier where linear scalarisation fails — is the financial-economics ancestor of v3's helpfulness-vs-worst-tail-toxicity argument. Author: Harry Markowitz.

  1. Thomson, "Bargaining and the theory of cooperative games: John Nash and beyond", survey chapter, Handbook of Game Theory / International Journal of Game Theory, 2016 (cf. Thomson 1994 in Aumann–Hart Handbook). ★★★ The cooperative-bargaining survey that v3 §12.6 imports to explain why Nash-MTL (§5.4) is fragile under heterogeneous-scale alignment objectives.

The N2 (symmetry) and N3 (IIA) axioms both fail in many practical bargaining problems, and these failures are inherited by Nash-MTL when lifted to LLM alignment. Read for the deep-diver P1 derivation in §12.6 anchor 3: the N2/N3 transfer-failure is the non-LLM ancestor of the Nash-MTL instability that CAGrad (entry 11) documents empirically. Author: William Thomson.

docs.title: E. Standards / Policy primary — benchmark and evaluation primary sources
docs.text:
1. HELM — Liang et al., "Holistic Evaluation of Language Models", Stanford CRFM 2022–2023 (arXiv 2211.09110); plus HELM-Safety release note, crfm.stanford.edu/2024/11/08/helm-safety.html, November 2024. ★★★ The single most influential multi-axis LLM benchmark, and the primary source of the Pareto-aware-benchmark gap of §12.4 (theorem X2, FC-7).

The Stanford CRFM release note's explicit aggregation rule — "the mean over all benchmark scores normalised to (0,1)" — is the operational claim of X2: HELM displays seven axes (accuracy, calibration, robustness, fairness, bias, toxicity, efficiency) but aggregates them by utilitarian SWF. Reframe via Sen 1970 (entry 34) to see this as a social-choice commitment rather than a measurement oversight. Cite per Phase 0d §5 — Stanford CRFM as institutional author; Liang et al. for the original HELM paper (12+ author chain not enumerated here).

  1. BIG-Bench Extra Hard (BBEH) — Kazemi et al., "BIG-Bench Extra Hard", arXiv 2502.19187, 2025. ★ The 2025 expansion of BIG-Bench that v3 §12.4 cites alongside HELM-Safety as evidence that the Pareto-front gap is industry-wide, not specific to HELM. Per-task means; no Pareto front. Cite per Phase 0d §5 — "Mehran Kazemi et al." (canonical first author; full chain not enumerated).

docs.title: F. Position / Contrarian — counterpoints to v3's central thesis
docs.text:
1. Boldi et al., "MORL position paper on pluralistic alignment", arXiv 2410.11221, October 2024. ★★ A position paper arguing that MORL — not RLHF — is the appropriate framework for pluralistic alignment. Sits orthogonally to v3's §12 thesis, which is non-committal on the RLHF-vs-MORL framing and uses both. Phase 0d FC-15 hedges this entry: full author chain not verified; cite by anchor "Boldi et al. arXiv 2410.11221" or "MORL pluralistic-alignment position paper". A serious reader of §12 should consult this to see the framing v3 declines to take.

  2. Sorensen et al., Roadmap to Pluralistic Alignment, ICML 2024 (entry 21 above, recapitulated here for the contrarian slot). ★★ The Sorensen et al. roadmap argues implicitly that all three of its modes (Overton / Steerable / Distributional) are achievable via universal one-model alignment with the right preference conditioning — the position closest to Rewarded Soups (entry 15) and Panacea (entry 16).

The contrarian reading: v3 §11 / §12 treats the LMC-at-\(k\ge 3\) hypothesis as open, with a non-trivial probability that Universal One-Model Alignment fails for non-convex preference geometries; the Sorensen / Rewarded Soups / Panacea programme implicitly assumes it succeeds. Reading these together exposes the most consequential open seam of the survey (seam 2 of §13).

  1. The implicit "linear scalarisation suffices in convex MOO" position. ★ Not a single paper but a position widely held in operations-research practice and in early-2020s MTL papers: when the Pareto front is convex, linear scalarisation by sweeping \(\boldsymbol{\lambda}\in\Delta^{k-1}\) recovers all proper Pareto optima (Geoffrion 1968, entry 4).

v3's four-restatement thesis is the rebuttal: in LLM alignment, the assumption of convex front is unwarranted (helpfulness vs worst-tail-toxicity is the Markowitz-CVaR analogue of entry 35), and the linear-scalarisation-suffices position degrades to "MODPO covers only the convex hull of \(\mathcal{P}^\star\)". Read entries 4, 11, 17, 20, 22, and 35 together to see the v3-internal version of this debate; the position itself is the dialectical foil rather than a citeable paper.

docs.title: Reading order recommendations
docs.text:
Two-hour entry. Geoffrion 1968 (entry 4) → DPO (entry 7) → MODPO (entry 17) → §1, §2.2, §9.1 of v3. This covers the four-restatement identity in its sharpest form.

One-week deep dive. Add Miettinen 1999 chapters 2–4 (entry 1) → Désidéri 2012 (entry 5) → Sener–Koltun 2018 (entry 6) → CAGrad (entry 11) → Roijers 2013 (entry 32) → Safe RLHF (entry 18) → Huang et al. 2024 (entry 19) → Panacea (entry 16) → MaxMin-RLHF with the corrected 8-author byline including Koppel (entry 20) → Sorensen Roadmap (entry 21) → §S0, §2–§12 of v3 end-to-end.

Cross-domain bridge (advanced). Sen 1970 (entry 34) → Markowitz 1952 (entry 35) → Thomson 2016 (entry 36) → §12.6 of v3. These three classical works supply the social-choice / financial-economics / cooperative-bargaining vocabulary that v3 imports to reframe HELM-aggregation, the MODPO convex-hull restriction, and Nash-MTL instability respectively — each as a documented failure mode in its source discipline, not a 2024-era novelty.

Citation discipline reminder. When citing v3 entries in subsequent work, prefer the §-prefixed theorem labels of §S0 (P1–P5 for Pareto / scalarisation lattice; K1 for KKT; M1–M7 for gradient MTL; V1–V2 for MORL; D1–D5 for closed-form DPO and MODPO; S1–S2 for constrained RLHF; L1–L3 for LMC / parameter-space MOO; X1–X2 for MaxMin-RLHF and Pareto-benchmark gap) over the raw paper titles.

More precisely, route author-name lookups through Phase 0d §5's verified registry — the FC-1 (IBEA), FC-2 (NSGA-II Agrawal spelling), FC-3 (IPO venue), FC-8 (MaxMin-RLHF 8-author Koppel-included), and FC-13/14/15 (arXiv-only papers without enumerated chains) hedges are not optional.

End of Further Reading. Approximate length ≈ 2,650 EN words; 41 annotated entries across 6 classes; all author names spelled out per Phase 0d §5 verified registry; all FC-2/3/4/5/6/7/8/12/13/14/15 hedges propagated; cross-domain anchors Sen 1970 / Markowitz 1952 / Thomson 2016 grounded in v3 §12.6.

docs.title: Traffic Assignment ​的​魔​改​综述​：​从​ Wardrop ​到​ Beckmann，​从​经典​网络​到​ EV-Coupled ​网络​的​统一​视角
§0 ​摘要
docs.text:
​本文​以​"​链路​-​路径​可加性​的​崩溃​与​重建​"​为主​线​，​对​交通​分配​ (Traffic Assignment, TA) ​自​ Wardrop (1952) ​与​ Beckmann (1956) ​奠基​以来​七十年​间​的​所有​主要​扩展​、​修正​与​推广​（​本文​以​"​魔改​"​作为​伞型​术语​统称​之​）​做​一次​系统性​的​综述​与​统一​。​核心​论点​是​：

​当代​ Wardrop–Beckmann ​框架​的​所有​魔改​——​无论是​网络结构​ (A ​类​)、​行为​公理​ (B ​类​) ​还是​ Beckmann ​函数​ (C ​类​)——​本质​上​都​在​回答​同一个​问题​：​当​链路​成本​不再​ link-separable、Jacobian ​不再​对称​、Beckmann ​势函数​不再​存在​时​，​等价​ NLP ​究竟​该​退化​为​ VI、NCP、Quasi-VI ​还是​ GNEP？

​围绕​这一​问题​，​本文​做​四件​事​。​第一​，​在​ §2 ​重述​经典​ Beckmann ​范式​的​刚性​结构​，​把​其​ 6 ​个​隐藏​假设​抽象​为​可​独立​扳动​的​开关​。​第二​，​在​ §3–§5 ​沿​三条​战线​展开​当代​魔改​的​ 28 ​个​代表性​ item，​从​ He, Yin, Lawphongpanich (2014) ​的​ SoC ​节点​扩展​、Liu, Pantelidis, Tam, Chow (2023) ​的​ M/D/c ​充​电弧​、Graf, Harks, Palkar (2022) ​的​ EV walk-flow Vickrey ​模型​，​到​ Smith (1979)–Dafermos (1980) ​的​非对称​ VI、Fisk (1980) ​的​熵​正则​、Marechal & de Grange (2024) ​的​线​积分​广义​ Beckmann、Wei et al. (2017) ​与​ Bakhshayesh & Kebriaei (2023) ​的​ PDN-TN ​耦合​ GNEP。​第三​，​在​ §6–§8 ​从​ 28 ​个​ item ​横向​蒸馏​出​ 12 ​个​统一​杠杆​点​、7 ​条魔改​原理​、13 ​个​跨类​组合​套路​。​第四​，​在​ §9 ​论证​：​魔改​空间​是​一个​以​ UE ​为​中心​的​星形​邻域​ (UE-rooted star)——CumLog (Li, Wang, Nie 2024) ​桥接​ BR ​与​ Wardrop、Logit-SUE ​极限​退化​为​ UE、DRO ​半径​归零​退化​为​经验​ SAA、Marechal ​线​积分​在​ Jacobian ​对称​下​退化​为​ Beckmann——​典型​魔改​都​通过​某个​连续​参数​回到​经典​ UE ​这一​共同​枢纽​。

​关键词​：​交通​分配​；Wardrop ​均衡​；Beckmann ​变换​；​变分​不等式​；​广义​纳什​均衡​；​电动汽车​耦合​网络​；​线​积分​广义​势函数​；UE-rooted star

​与​经典​分类​教材​的​关系​：Patriksson (1994) ​按​模型​类型​ (UE/SO/SUE) + ​算法​族​分类​；Sheffi (1985) ​按​行为​公理​分类​；Nagurney (1999) ​按​ VI ​结构​分类​。​本文​的​"​杠杆​点​ + ​星形​邻域​"​轴​正交​于​这​三种​分类​（​不是​替代​）；​新意​主要​在​ EV-as-forcing-function ​透镜​ (§9.4) ​与​极限​统一性​ (§9.5)——​这​两个​观察​是​上述​三本​教材​在​写作​时​尚未​出现​的​现象​。

"​魔改​"​一词​的​注解​："​魔改​"​为​伞型​术语​，​统称​对​经典​ Wardrop–Beckmann ​框架​在​网络结构​、​行为​公理​与​数学​形式​上​的​各类​扩展​、​修正​与​推广​；​源于​中文​工程​社群​的​非正式​用法​，​此处​用作​语义​统一​标签​，​并​无​贬义​。​英文版​用​ "non-canonical extensions" ​翻译​。

​读者​地图​：​仅​熟悉​凸​优化​与​ KKT ​者​可读​ §1–§3；​同时​熟悉​ VI / NCP ​者​可读​ §5；​同时​熟悉​ RUM / Logit / ​排队​论​ / DRO ​者​可读​ §4；​熟悉​ OPF / EPEC ​者​可读​ §5.8 ​与​ §10.3；​熟悉​ MFG / ​连续​ Wardrop ​者​可读​ §10.4 ​与​ §10.6。​建议​非​专家​先读​ §1.1 → §0 → §1.2 → §2 → §6 → §11。

docs.title: §1 ​引论​：​为什么​ Wardrop/Beckmann ​需要​被​魔​改​？
1.1 ​经典​范式​的​"​幸运​结构​"
docs.text:
Wardrop (1952) ​的​两大​原理​在​写下​的​那一刻​看起来​是​一个​行为​陈述​："​没有​出​行者​能​通过​单方面​切换​路径​降低​自己​的​成本​"——​这是​用户​均衡​ (User Equilibrium, UE) ​的​口头​版本​。​但​若​停留​在​行为​层​，UE ​只是​一个​ fixed-point ​的​描述​，​没有​任何​计算​上​的​优势​：​路径​之间​的​耦合​是​ \(|\mathcal{P}|\) ​维​的​，​而​ \(|\mathcal{P}|\) ​一般​指数​大于​链路​数​ \(|\mathcal{A}|\)。

Beckmann–McGuire–Winsten (1956) ​的​关键​贡献​并​不​在于​"​提出​了​一个​ NLP"，​而​在于​发现​了​一个​非常​幸运​的​结构​：​当​链路​成本​函数​ \(c_a\) ​仅​依赖于​本​链路​流量​ \(x_a\)（​即​ link-separable）​且​单调​递增​ (monotone) ​时​，Wardrop ​第一​原理​的​解​恰好​等于​以下​凸​ NLP ​的​稳定​点​：

\[ \min_{\mathbf{x} \geq 0} \; Z(\mathbf{x}) = \sum_{a \in \mathcal{A}} \int_{0}^{x_a} c_a(s)\, ds, \quad \text{s.t.} \;\; \sum_{p \in \mathcal{P}_{rs}} f_p^{rs} = q^{rs},\;\; x_a = \sum_{rs}\sum_p \delta_{a,p}^{rs} f_p^{rs}. \]

​这里​ \(f_p^{rs}\) ​是​ OD ​对​ \((r,s)\) ​上​路径​ \(p\) ​的​流量​，\(q^{rs}\) ​是​ OD ​需求​，\(\delta_{a,p}^{rs}\) ​是​链路​-​路径​关联​指示器​。​这个​"​幸运​"​由​两件事​保证​：

  1. ​链路​-​路径​可加性​ (link–path additivity)：​路径​成本​ \(c_p^{rs} = \sum_a \delta_{a,p}^{rs} c_a(x_a)\) ​是​链路​成本​沿​路径​的​简单​求和​。
  2. ​势函数​的​存在​ (existence of a potential)：​当​链路​成本​是​ link-separable ​时​，​矢量​场​ \(\mathbf{c}(\mathbf{x})\) ​自动​满足​对称​条件​ \(\partial c_a / \partial x_b = \partial c_b/\partial x_a = 0\) (\(a\ne b\))，​由​ Poincaré ​引理​保证​存在​标量​势​ \(Z(\mathbf{x})\) ​使得​ \(\nabla Z = \mathbf{c}\)。​链路​成本​向量场​是​某个​标量​函数​的​梯度​——​就​像​保守力​场​对应​势能​、​非​保守力​场​（​如​摩擦力​）​则​不​对应​任何​势能​——​这是​ Jacobian ​对称性​的​几何​含义​。

​本文​涉及​至少​三种​可加性​，​必须​分别​命名​以免​混淆​：(a) ​链路​-​路径​可加性​ \(c_p = \sum_a \delta_{a,p} c_a\)（​成本​沿​路径​的​求和​）；(b) ​方差​可加性​ \(\mathrm{Var}(c_p)=\sum_a \mathrm{Var}(c_a)\)（​在​链路​独立性​假设​下​成立​）；(c) ​积分​可加性​ / ​势函数​可加性​（Beckmann ​形式​ \(\sum_a \int_0^{x_a} c_a\) ​是​诸​链路​独立​积分​之​和​）。​本文​主线​针对​ (a)；​遇到​ (b) (c) ​时会​显式​标注​。

​可加性​ (a) ​与​势函数​ (c) ​是​经典​ Wardrop–Beckmann ​框架​立在​地基​上​的​两块​基石​。

docs.title: 1.2 ​现代​世界​如何​敲碎​这两块​基石
docs.text:
​现实​里​两块​基石​几乎​总是​会破​：

  • ​信号​交叉口​的​左转​流量​影响​对​向​直行​容量​，​导致​ \(\partial c_{\text{​直​}}/\partial x_{\text{​左​}}\ne 0\) ​并且​不​对称​——Jacobian ​失​对称​，​势函数​不​存在​ (C ​类破​)；
  • ​出​行者​按​预期​成本​而​非​实际成本​选路​ (Daganzo–Sheffi 1977)，​路径​成本​须​被​替换​为​感知​成本​ \(\tilde c_p = c_p + \theta^{-1}\xi_p\)——​行为​公理​变​ (B ​类破​)；
  • ​电动车​要​中途​充电​、​充电站​排队​，​路径​成本​不再​是​链路​成本​之​和​而​依赖​路径​上​的​ SoC ​轨迹​——​可加性​破​ (A ​类破​，​但​ He (2014) ​通过​状态​扩展​把​它​"​接​回​"A)；
  • ​拥挤​收费​、​里程​税​、​容量​约束​让​链路​成本​依赖​全网​价格​或​对偶​变量​，​路径​成本​不再​ link-separable (​跨​ A/B/C)；
  • ​充电站​与​配电网​耦合​，​电价​在​ TN ​与​ PDN ​之间​反馈​——​单​ NLP ​升级​为​ GNEP (​跨​ A/C)。

docs.title: 1.3 ​本文​的​统一​论点
docs.text:
​学界​长期​把​这些​魔改​视为​彼此​独立​的​ trick：SUE ​是​一​支线​、SO ​是​一​支线​、EV TAP ​是​一​支线​、DRO TAP ​是​一​支线​。​本文​将​论证​它们​共享​同一个​底层​战役​：

​链路​-​路径​可加性​崩溃​后​怎么办​？

A ​类​魔​改​的​策略​是​"​用​维度​换​可加性​"——​把​ SoC、​时间​窗​、​模式​选择​、​充电​状态​等​扩进​节点​空间​，​使​新​网络​上​重新​可​加​；B ​类​魔​改​的​策略​是​"​动​公理​或动​成本​"——​保留​可加性​但​换掉​ Wardrop ​条件​本身​或​把​成本​变成​感知​/​价格​意义​下​的​虚拟​可​加​；C ​类​魔​改​的​策略​是​"​重写​数学​"——​直接​放弃​ NLP，​转向​ VI、NCP、​熵​正则​势​、​线​积分​势​或​ GNEP。

​后文​的​每​一节​都​将​回到​这​条​主线​。

docs.title: 2.1 Wardrop 1952 ​第一​/​第二​原理
docs.text:
​设​道路​网络​ \(G=(\mathcal{N},\mathcal{A})\)，OD ​集​ \(\mathcal{W}\)，​每个​ \(w=(r,s)\in\mathcal{W}\) ​对应​路径​集​ \(\mathcal{P}_w\)，​路径​ \(p\) ​上​的​流量​ \(f_p\geq 0\)，​链路​流量​ \(x_a=\sum_w\sum_{p\in\mathcal{P}_w}\delta_{a,p}f_p\)，​链路​成本​ \(c_a(x_a)\)，​路径​成本​ \(c_p=\sum_a\delta_{a,p}c_a\)。

​第一​原理​ (UE)：​对​每个​ OD \(w\) ​存在​ \(\pi_w\geq 0\) ​使​ $\(f_p>0 \Rightarrow c_p=\pi_w,\qquad f_p=0 \Rightarrow c_p\geq \pi_w.\)$ ​即​所有​被​使用​路径​成本​相等​且​不​大于​未​被​使用​路径​——​这是​一个​互补​松弛​ (complementarity) ​表达​，​非常​关键​，​因为​它​不​要求​"​势函数​"​存在​，​因此​天然​地能​容纳​ §5 ​的​非对称​ VI ​推广​。

​第二​原理​ (SO)：​流量​分配​最小化​总​系统​成本​ \(\sum_a x_a c_a(x_a)\)。​当​ \(c_a\) ​严格​递增​时​，SO ​等价​于​以​"​边际​社会​成本​" \(\tilde c_a(x_a)=c_a(x_a)+x_a c_a'(x_a)\) ​替换​ \(c_a\) ​后​的​ UE——​这是​ Pigovian ​拥挤​定价​ (B5) ​的​数学​源头​。

docs.title: 2.2 Beckmann 1956 ​等价​ NLP ​的​ KKT ​推导
docs.text:
​考虑​

\[ (\mathrm{P}):\quad \min_\mathbf{f} Z(\mathbf{x}(\mathbf{f}))=\sum_a \int_0^{x_a} c_a(s)\,ds \quad\text{s.t.}\quad \sum_{p\in\mathcal P_w} f_p=q_w,\; f_p\geq 0. \]

Lagrange：\(L=Z-\sum_w \pi_w(\sum_p f_p-q_w)-\sum_p \mu_p f_p\)，​其中​ \(\mu_p\geq 0\)。

KKT ​一阶​条件​（​用​链式法则​ + Leibniz ​规则​）： $\(\frac{\partial L}{\partial f_p}=\sum_a \delta_{a,p}\,\frac{\partial Z}{\partial x_a}-\pi_w-\mu_p=\sum_a \delta_{a,p}\,c_a(x_a)-\pi_w-\mu_p=0,\)$ ​即​ \(c_p-\pi_w=\mu_p\geq 0\)，​互补​：\(f_p\mu_p=0\)。​整理​得​ $\(f_p>0 \Rightarrow c_p=\pi_w,\qquad f_p=0 \Rightarrow c_p\geq\pi_w.\)$ ​这恰​是​ Wardrop ​第一​原理​。​整段​推导​中显式​用到​的​唯一​ nontrivial ​假设​是​ \(c_a\) ​是​ \(x_a\) ​的​单​变量​函数​（​即​ link-separability）——​这​正是​ §1.1 ​列出​的​两块​基石​之一​。Jacobian ​对称性​ \(\partial c_a/\partial x_b = \partial c_b/\partial x_a\) ​不是​独立​假设​，​而是​ link-separability ​的​自动​推论​；​它​在​容许​ \(c_a = c_a(x_1,\dots,x_{|\mathcal A|})\) ​跨​链路​依赖​时才​成为​单独​的​约束​。

Beckmann ​目标​函数​的​非​物理​性​也​值得​指出​：\(\sum_a \int_0^{x_a} c_a(s)\,ds\) ​没有​任何​直接​的​经济​或​物理​意义​——​它​既​不是​总​出行​时间​，​也​不是​消费者​剩余​，​纯粹​是​一个​数学​构造​，​唯一​目的​是​让​ KKT ​重现​ Wardrop ​第一​原理​。​澄清​这​一点​对​避免​ misreading ​后续​ §5.5 ​弹性​需求​（Evans 1976）​的​"​负​消费者​剩余​"​项​至关重要​。

​凸性​：​若​ \(c_a\) ​单调​递增​，​则​ \(Z\) ​是​凸​的​（​非​递减​函数​的​原函数​是​凸​的​，​这一​事实​与​对称性​无关​）；​若​进一步​严格​递增​，\(Z\) ​在​链路​流量​ \(\mathbf{x}\) ​上​严格凸​，​故​ \(\mathbf{x}^*\) ​唯一​——​但路​径流量​ \(\mathbf{f}^*\) ​一般​不​唯一​，​因为​多条​路径​可​携带​等价​的​链路​流量​分配​。​这是​ §5.3 Fisk ​熵​正则​的​动机​之一​：​加熵​项​把​路​径流量​的​非​唯一性​也​罚​掉​，​得到​ path-flow ​唯一性​——​是​为数不多​的​"​正则​化​免费​午餐​"​之一​。

docs.title: 2.3 ​经典​假设​的​ 6 ​个​"​开关​"
docs.text:
​本文​把​ Beckmann ​范式​拆成​ 6 ​个​独立​可​扳动​的​开关​：

  1. ​行为​公理​：UE / SO / ​二者​兼容​ (BR, CPT, RUM)；
  2. ​路径​定义​：​固定​路径​ / hyperpath / ​时空​路径​ / ​多​模式​联合​路径​；
  3. ​不确定性​：​确定​ / ​感知​误差​ (SUE) / ​出行​时间​随机​ (Reliable) / ​分布​鲁棒​ (DRO)；
  4. ​同质性​：​单类​ / ​多​类​ (VOT, VOR, ​车型​)；
  5. ​时间​：​静态​ / ​准​动态​ / DTA / ​时间​扩展​网络​；
  6. Jacobian ​对称性​：​对称​ (Beckmann NLP) / ​非对称​ (Smith VI) / ​不​存在​势​ (Marechal ​线​积分​ / NCP)。

​任意​子集​开关​被​扳动​，​就​生出​一类​魔改​。

docs.title: 2.4 ​现代​魔改​的​总体​地图
docs.text:
​我们​把​所有​当代​魔改​放进​三条​战线​：

  • A ​类​——​网络结构​魔改​：​用​维度​换​可加性​。
  • B ​类​——Wardrop ​公理​变体​：​保留​链路​-​路径​可加性​，​扩​公理​或​扩​成本​。
  • C ​类​——Beckmann ​函数​变体​：​直接​重写​数学​，​从​ NLP ​走向​ VI / NCP / GNEP。

​这三类​不是​互斥​的​，​许多​ item ​跨界​——SoC ​节点​扩展​（A）​也动​了​路径​定义​（B ​的​ walk）；DRO（B）​也​重写​了​数学​（C ​的​ conic dual）。​一个​更​诊断​式​（disjoint）​的​分类​轴​是​按​"​哪条​经典​假设​被​违背​"：Jacobian ​对称性​ vs link-separability vs ​行为​公理​ vs ​确定性​。​本文​保留​ A/B/C ​是​为了​写作​流畅​，​但​ §6 ​的​ 12 ​杠杆​点​是​更​基础​的​（​更​细粒度​的​）​正交​坐标​，§8 ​给出​ 13 ​个​跨类​组合​。

docs.title: §3 ​第一​战场​：A ​类​网络结构​魔改​ ("​用​维度​换​可加性​")
docs.text:
A ​类​的​核心思想​是​：​当原​网络​上​的​成本​不再​可​加时​，​找到​一个​扩展​状态​空间​，​使​路径​成本​在​新​空间​上​重新​可​加​。​这是​ EV ​时代​最大​的​方法论​遗产​。

SoC ​扩展​的​玩具​例子​。​考虑​ 3 ​个​节点​ \(\{A, B, C\}\) ​的​小​网络​，​每条​弧​消耗​ 1 ​单位​电量​，​电池容量​为​ 2，​离散​ SoC ​等级​取​ \(\{0, 1, 2\}\)。​扩展​网络​有​ \(3 \times 3 = 9\) ​个​节点​ \((v, s)\)。​原始​弧​ \(A\to B\) ​在​扩展​网络​上​对应​三条​弧​ \((A,2)\to (B,1)\)、\((A,1)\to (B,0)\)、\((A,0)\to\)（​无​后继​，​电量​耗尽​）。​若​ \(B\) ​是​充电站​，​则​在​ \(B\) ​处加充​电弧​ \((B,0)\to (B,1)\)、\((B,0)\to (B,2)\)、\((B,1)\to (B,2)\)，​弧​成本​为​充电​时间​。

​关键​观察​：​原​网络​上​"​我​有没有​足够​电量​到达​终点​"​是​路径​属性​、​不可​加​；​扩展​网络​上​"​我​现在​的​状态​是​ \((v,s)\)、​走​这条​弧后​变成​ \((v',s')\)"​是​节点​属性​、​可​加​。​这​就是​"​用​维度​换​可加性​"​的​全部​秘密​。

docs.title: 3.1 SoC ​节点​扩展​（He, Yin, Lawphongpanich 2014）
docs.text:
EV ​路径​成本​不仅​依赖​链路​流量​，​还​依赖​到达​每个​充电站​的​ SoC——​典型​的​不可​加​。He ​等​的​解法​：​把​ \((\text{​节点​},\text{SoC ​离散​值​})\) ​作为​新​节点​，​链路​ \(a\) ​在​原​网络​上​对应​一​族​链路​ \(\{(i,e)\to(j,e-\Delta e_a)\}\)，​其中​ \(\Delta e_a\) ​为​通过​ \(a\) ​的​能耗​。​在​扩展​网络​上​，​路径​成本​ \(=\sum\) ​扩展​链路​成本​，​可加性​恢复​，UE ​重新​写成​ Beckmann NLP。

​代价​的​精确​刻画​：​节点​数从​ \(|\mathcal N|\) ​涨​到​ \(|\mathcal N|\cdot|\mathcal E|\)（\(|\mathcal E|\) ​为​ SoC ​离散​网格​大小​，​典型​ \(|\mathcal E|=20\)～\(100\)），​弧数​从​ \(|\mathcal A|\) ​涨​到​ \(|\mathcal A|\cdot|\mathcal E| + |V_{\text{ch}}|\cdot|\mathcal E|^2\)——​其中​第二项​来自​每个​充电站​需要​为​每​对​ \((s_1, s_2)\) (\(s_1 < s_2\)) ​加​一条​充​电弧​。​这个​ \(|\mathcal E|^2\) ​二次​项是​真正​的​限制​：​城市​级​ \(|V|\approx 10^5\)、\(|E|=100\) ​即​ \(10^7\) ​节点​ + \(10^9\) ​弧​，​逼近​现代​求解​器​边界​，​也​是​ §10.1 SoC ​嵌入​压缩​研究​空白​的​根源​。​凸性​预算​被​维度​消耗​。

docs.title: 3.2 ​时间​扩展​网络​（Ford–Fulkerson ​准​动态​）
docs.text: ​把​ \((\text{​节点​},\text{​时刻​})\) ​作为​新​节点​，​路径​ \(\to\) ​时空​路径​。FIFO ​与​ holdback ​约束​在​扩展​节点​的​流量​守恒​中​自然​表达​。​关键​洞见​：DTA ​的​所有​"​路径​成本​不可​加​"​问题​——​例如​基于​队列​的​延迟​、​瓶颈​出​清​——​本质​上​和​ EV ​的​ SoC ​不可​加是​同​一类​技巧​。Beckmann NLP ​在​时空​网络​上​仍然​成立​，​只要​时空​链路​成本​仍​ link-separable——​这是​ §6 ​杠杆​ L8 ​的​位置​。

docs.title: 3.3 ​充电站​集成​网络​（Bae & Kwasinski 2012）
docs.text: ​把​充电站​显式​建模​为​节点​，​进站​/​出站​为​虚拟​链路​，​链路​成本​含​电价​。​在​ EV ​比例​小​、PDN ​价格​外生​时​退化​为​ Beckmann；EV ​比例​大时​电价​内生​ → §5.7 GNEP。

docs.title: 3.4 ​多​模式​网络
docs.text: ​地铁​、​公交​、​私家车​、​自行车​作​不同​子​网络​，​转换​链路​ (transfer arc) ​携带​换乘​成本​与​时间​。​路径​定义​被​"​广义​ OD"​取代​——​这是​ §2.3 ​开关​ 2 ​的​扳动​。​当​转换​成本​对称​时​仍​是​ Beckmann；​当地​铁​拥挤​反馈​到​自行车​（​弹性​需求​）​时​进入​ §5.5 Evans ​模型​。

docs.title: 3.5 P&R (Park-and-Ride)
docs.text: P&R ​站点​为​节点​，"​开车​ + ​停车​ + ​公交​"​是​一条​多​模式​路径​，​停车​容量​为侧​约束​。​当​停车​价格​外生​时​仍​是​ Beckmann ​加​ §4.12 side-constrained UE；​当​停车​价格​内生​为​价格​清场​机制​时​进入​ §5.7 GNEP。

docs.title: 3.6 Hyperpath (Spiess–Florian 1989)
docs.text: ​公交​频率​使出​行者​无法​预先确定​具体​乘​哪​一班​，​故​"​路径​"​被​ hyperpath（​一组​备选​弧​的​概率​混合​）​取代​。​形式化​：hyperpath \(h\) ​上​每个​节点​有​一个​出弧​分布​ \(\alpha_{i\to a}\)，​期望​成本​ \(C_h\) ​为​各弧​期望​延迟​之​和​。​关键​：hyperpath ​把​"​弧​选择​不​确定​"​内化​进​路径​定义​，​从而​在​ hyperpath ​层面​恢复​可加性​。​这​与​ §4.3 SUE ​在​数学​上​是​孪生​关系​：SUE ​把​不确定性​内化​进​效用​，Hyperpath ​把​不确定性​内化​进​路径​。

docs.title: 3.7 ​多层​网络​ (Multi-layer)
docs.text: ​物理层​ (TN) + ​信息​层​ (​路径​推荐​) + ​能源​层​ (PDN)。​每层​有​自身​均衡​条件​，​层间​通过​共享​变量​耦合​。​是​ §5.7 PDN-TN ​的​更​一般​版本​。

docs.title: 3.8 ​充​电弧​ M/D/c ​队列​（Liu, Pantelidis, Tam, Chow 2023）
docs.text: ​充电站​排队​不是​简单​的​ BPR——​它​服从​ M/D/c ​排队​论​，​期望​等待时间​形​如​ Cosmetatos ​近似​，​是​ \(\rho/(1-\rho)\) ​量级​（\(\rho = \lambda / (c \mu)\) ​为​利用率​）。Liu, Pantelidis, Tam, Chow (2023, Int. J. Sust. Transp. 17(3): 228–244, arXiv:2102.05851) ​把​每个​充电站​建为​一条​"​充​电弧​"，​弧​成本​为​ M/D/c ​期望​逗留​时间​，​仍​ link-separable——​这是​网络​扩展​把​队列​论​嵌入​ Beckmann ​的​一个​漂亮​例证​。​注意​：M/D/c ​闭式​仅​是​ Cosmetatos ​近似​（​在​中等​ \(c\) ​与​ \(\rho\) ​不近​ 1 ​时​有效​）；​逼近​ \(\rho \to 1\) ​时弧​成本​不可​微​，​需要​ derivative-free MSA ​替代​标准​ Frank-Wolfe。NYC DCAS ​算例​（1484 EVs / 567 chargers / 512 TAZ）​验证​了​该​框架​的​工业​可行性​。

docs.title: 3.9 EV walk-flow Vickrey ​模型​（Graf, Harks, Palkar 2022）
docs.text:
Graf, Harks, Palkar (2022, arXiv:2207.04454, ATMOS 2022) ​的​ "Dynamic Traffic Assignment for Electric Vehicles" ​引入​了​ walk-based ​动态​流​定义​：​在​ EV ​场景​中​，​由于​司机​可能​为​充电​而​绕回​某个​节点​，​传统​的​ simple-path（​无​重复​节点​的​简单​路径​）​假设​破裂​；​需要​用​ walk（​图论​意义​的​弧​序列​，​允许​重复​节点​ / ​弧​）​取代​ path ​才能​正确​建模​。​原文​：

"We introduce a walk-based definition of dynamic traffic flows which allows for cyclic routing behavior as a result of recharging events en route."

​车流​被​视作​ \(L^p_+([0,T])\) ​上​的​连续流​；​每条​链路​上​ Vickrey ​瓶颈​模型​的​时延​算子​是​流入​率​的​非​局部​泛函​。Graf ​等​证明​在​ Lipschitz ​假设​下​ capacitated dynamic equilibrium walk-flow ​存在​，​并​给出​ fixed-point ​迭代​收敛​算法​。​可行​集是​ walk-flow ​上​的​能量​可行性​约束​ \(0 \le s_W(\theta) \le B\)。​这是​ A ​类​（​网络结构​）​与​ C ​类​（​无穷​维​ VI）​的​交叉​。​需要​强调​：​此处​ walk ​是​图论​意义​的​弧​序列​，​与​"​步行​"​无关​。

A ​类​的​代价​是​维度​膨胀​：SoC ​网格​细则​准确​但​不可​解​，​粗则​可解​但​不​准确​。​下一代​研究​的​关键​是​稀疏​化​ / ​嵌入​学习​的​扩展​网络​压缩​——​见​ §10.1。B ​类​——​下​一节​——​则​选择​不​动​网络结构​而动​ Wardrop ​公理​本身​，​看​代价​是否​更​低​。

docs.title: §4 ​第二​战场​：B ​类​ Wardrop ​条件​变体​ ("​动​公理​或动​成本​")
docs.text: B ​类不动​网络结构​，​而​扳动​开关​ 1（​行为​公理​）​或​开关​ 3（​不确定性​）。​其​共同​模式​是​：​保留​链路​-​路径​可加性​，​但​替换​路径​成本​的​"​语义​"——​从​物理​时间​换成​感知​成本​、​效用​、​风险​测度​等​——​使​ Wardrop ​条件​作用​在​虚拟​成本​上​。

docs.title: 4.1 Classic UE（​基线​）
docs.text: ​即​ §2 ​的​ Wardrop ​第一​原理​。

docs.title: 4.2 SO + Pigovian ​定价
docs.text:
SO ​解恰​是​以​边际​社会​成本​ \(\tilde c_a=c_a+x_a c_a'\) ​为​成本​的​ UE ​解​。​差额​ \(\tau_a^{\rm Pig}=x_a c_a'(x_a)\) ​是​ Pigovian ​税​，​把​外部性​内​化为​对偶​价格​——​这是​ §6 ​杠杆​ L9（​对偶​变量​物理​化​）​的​最早​实例​。

Price of Anarchy (PoA) ​与​ Roughgarden–Tardos 4/3 ​界​：UE ​与​ SO ​的​总成本​之​比​，​即​ \(\mathrm{PoA} = Z_{\rm UE}/Z_{\rm SO}\)，​量化​"​自私​选路​"​相对​于​"​中央​调度​"​的​效率​损失​。Roughgarden & Tardos (2002, J. ACM 49(2): 236–259) ​的​标志性​结果​：​在​非​原子​ (non-atomic) selfish routing ​中​，​若​所有​弧​延迟​函数​为​仿射​ \(\ell_e(x) = a_e x + b_e\) (\(a_e, b_e \ge 0\))，​则​ $\(\mathrm{PoA} \le \frac{4}{3},\)$ ​且​该界紧​（​紧​实例​为​ Pigou's example：​两弧​并联​，​一弧​ \(\ell(x) = 1\)、​一弧​ \(\ell(x) = x\)）。​对​最高​ \(d\) ​阶非​负​系数​多项式​延迟​类​ \(\mathcal C_d\)， $\(\mathrm{PoA}(\mathcal C_d) = \Bigl[1 - d\cdot(d+1)^{-(d+1)/d}\Bigr]^{-1} \xrightarrow{d\to\infty} \Theta\Bigl(\frac{d}{\log d}\Bigr).\)$ ​关键​事实​（Roughgarden 2003, JCSS）：​上述​ PoA ​界​与​网络拓扑​无关​——​最坏例​总能​在​并联​两弧​ Pigou ​网络​上​实现​。​这​给​"​政策​合法性​"​问题​（​拥堵​收费​的​最大​社会​收益​）​一个​干净​的​上界​。

docs.title: 4.3 SUE — Logit / Probit (Daganzo–Sheffi 1977; Fisk 1980)
docs.text: ​感知​成本​ \(\tilde c_p=c_p+\xi_p\)，\(\xi_p\) ​为​随机​项​。Logit-SUE： $\(P_p^{rs}=\frac{\exp(-\theta c_p)}{\sum_{p'\in\mathcal P_{rs}}\exp(-\theta c_{p'})},\qquad f_p^{rs}=q^{rs}P_p^{rs}.\)$ \(\theta\to\infty\) ​时​退化​为​ UE。Logit ​的​"​路径​独立​同​分布​"​假设​导致​重叠​路径​过度​计算​（IIA ​病​），​故有​ C-Logit、Path-Size Logit、Cross-Nested Logit、Probit ​等​修正​。Probit ​用​多元​正态​ \(\xi\)，​无​解析​式​，​需​仿真​。

docs.title: 4.4 ​多​类​ (Multi-class)
docs.text: ​不同​类​ \(k\) ​有​不同​ VOT \(\beta^k\)、​不同​车型​耗能​、​不同​感知​方差​。​链路​成本​通常​对​所有​类​相同​ (​环境效应​)，​但​路径​成本​以​ \(\beta^k c_a+\tau_a\) ​计​ (​不同​的​金钱​-​时间​换算​)。​当​ Jacobian \(\partial(\beta^k c_a)/\partial x^{k'}_a\) ​跨类​对称​时​仍​可​写​ Beckmann；​不​对称​时​进入​ §5.2 Smith VI。

docs.title: 4.5 Bounded Rationality (Mahmassani–Chang 1987) ​与​ CumLog ​桥​（Li, Wang, Nie 2024）
docs.text:
​出​行者​只​在​感知​成本​差​超过​阈值​ \(\eta\) ​时换​路径​： $\(f_p>0\Rightarrow c_p\leq \pi_w+\eta.\)$ ​这是​一个​非​唯一​均衡​集​ (BR-UE ​不再​是​单点​)，​定义​了​一个​"\(\eta\)-​球​"。​当​ \(\eta\to 0\) ​退回​ UE。BR ​与​ SUE ​在​某种​连续​意义​上​是​孪生​：SUE ​用​概率​"​软化​"​互补​松弛​，BR ​用​阈值​"​宽化​"​互补​松弛​。

CumLog（​累积​ Logit，Li, Wang, Nie 2024, Trans. Sci. 58(5): 973–994, arXiv:2304.02500）​把​ BR ​视为​日复一日​的​累积​学习​：​引入​累积​估值​递推​ $\(\mathbf s^t = \mathbf s^{t-1} + \eta^t\,\mathbf c(\mathbf p^{t-1})\)$ ​配合​ logit ​选择​ $\(p_k^t = \frac{\exp(-r\,s_k^t)}{\sum_{k'\in\mathcal K_w}\exp(-r\,s_{k'}^t)}.\)$ ​其​核心​定理​：​在​温和​条件​（\(\eta^t\) ​适当​衰减​、\(r\) ​足够​大​）​下​，CumLog ​这种​ BR ​适应​过程​全局​收敛​到​ Wardrop UE——BR ​不必​导致​偏离​ UE，​反而​可​作为​ UE ​的​学习​基础​。​这​同时​解决​了​ Harsanyi (1973) ​的​不稳定性​问题​：​均衡​下​出​行者​为何​会以​不同​概率​选择​等​好​路径​。CumLog ​是​ §9.5 ​中​ BR ↔ Wardrop ​极限​桥​的​精确​数学​载体​。

docs.title: 4.6 CPT (Cumulative Prospect Theory; Tversky–Kahneman 1992)
docs.text: ​行为​成本​不是​期望​，​而是​按​价值​函数​ \(v(x)=x^\alpha\;(x\geq 0)\)、\(-\lambda(-x)^\beta\;(x<0)\) ​与​决策​权重​ \(w(p)\) ​加权​。CPT-UE ​在​ EV ​不​确定​续航​场景​下​解释​力强​。​代价​：CPT ​成本​一般​非凸​，​等价​ NLP ​不​存在​，​必须​用​ VI ​或​ fixed-point ​求解​。

docs.title: 4.7 Mean-Variance / TTB (Travel Time Budget)
docs.text:
​风险​厌恶​出​行者​最小化​ \(\mathbb E[c_p]+\lambda\sqrt{\text{Var}[c_p]}\) ​或​ \(\mathbb E[c_p]+\Phi^{-1}(\alpha)\sqrt{\text{Var}[c_p]}\)（​此处​ \(\Phi\) ​为​标准​正态​ CDF，​仅​在​高斯​近似​下用​此式​）。

​方差​可加性​ \(\text{Var}[c_p]=\sum_a \text{Var}[c_a]\) ​只​在​链路​成本​独立​假设​下​成立​；​当​链路​相关​时​方差​不再​ link-additive。​这是​ §1.1 ​中可加性​ (b) ​的​失效​，​与​可加性​ (a) ​链路​-​路径​成本​可加​是​独立​的​两件事​。​文献​的​标准​处理​是​ Lo–Luo–Siu (2006) ​直接​假设​链路​成本​独立​；​用​状态​扩展​把​方差​作为​ SoC ​类似​的​状态变量​是​非常规​做法​。

docs.title: 4.8 α-reliable METT (Chen–Zhou 2010)
docs.text: ​最小化​ \(\alpha\) ​分​位数​行驶​时间​ \(\mathrm{VaR}_\alpha[c_p]\)。​与​ 4.7 ​的​ TTB ​形式​类似​，​但​ VaR ​不次​可加​，​引发​ 4.9 ​的​ DRO ​思路​。

docs.title: 4.9 DRO TAP（​从​ 2011 ERM ​到​ Wasserstein ​鲁棒​）
docs.text:
​设​链路​成本​分布​ \(\mathbb P\in\mathcal U\) (\(\mathcal U\) ​为​模糊集​，​常取​ Wasserstein ​球​)，​出​行者​最小化​最坏​期望​成本​： $\(\min_p \sup_{\mathbb P\in\mathcal U}\mathbb E_{\mathbb P}[c_p].\)$

Mohajerin Esfahani–Kuhn (2018) ​的​标准​强​对偶​ (Theorem 4.2) ​给出​：​对​类型​-\(p\) Wasserstein ​球​ \(\mathcal U_\varepsilon(\hat{\mathbb P}) = \{\mathbb P : W_p(\mathbb P,\hat{\mathbb P}) \le \varepsilon\}\) ​与​上半​连续​损失​ \(h\)， $\(\sup_{\mathbb P\in\mathcal U_\varepsilon(\hat{\mathbb P})}\mathbb E_{\mathbb P}[h(\xi)] = \inf_{\eta\ge 0}\Bigl\{\eta\varepsilon^p + \frac{1}{N}\sum_{i=1}^N \sup_\xi\bigl[h(\xi) - \eta\,\|\xi - \hat\xi_i\|^p\bigr]\Bigr\}.\)$ ​此处​对偶​变量​改记​为​ \(\eta\) ​以​避免​与​ §4.7 ​风险​厌恶​系数​ \(\lambda\)、§5.8 GNEP ​节点​电价​ \(\lambda_n\) ​撞​符号​。​在​ Kantorovich–Rubinstein ​特殊​情形​（\(p=1\)，\(h\) ​在​支撑​上​ Lipschitz，​支撑​ \(=\mathbb R^d\)）​下​，inf-form ​化为​闭式​： $\(\sup_{\mathbb P:\;W_1(\mathbb P,\hat{\mathbb P})\le\varepsilon}\mathbb E_{\mathbb P}[h(\xi)] = \mathbb E_{\hat{\mathbb P}}[h(\xi)] + \varepsilon\,\mathrm{Lip}(h).\)$ ​三件​齐备​（\(p=1\)、\(h\) Lipschitz、​支撑​无​界​）​才​退化​为​这个​"​鲁棒​补偿​项​"。BPR ​形式​的​链路​成本​在​ \(x_a/c_a \to \infty\) ​时​ Lipschitz ​常数​发散​，​所以​闭式​只​在​工程​上用​ Lipschitz ​截断​时才​严格​成立​。

​极限​关系​：\(\varepsilon\to 0\) ​时​模糊集​塌缩​到​经验​分布​ \(\hat{\mathbb P}\)，DRO ​退化​为​样本​平均​近似​ (SAA) ​下​的​经验​期望​优化​，​并非​ logit-SUE。Logit-SUE ​来自​熵​正则​（§5.3 Fisk），​与​ DRO ​半径​在​数学​上​是​完全​独立​的​对象​；§9.5 ​的​极限​链​将​这​两者​分开​陈述​。

​早期​ ERM ​风格​（Expected Residual Minimization）​鲁棒​ TAP ​的​开创​工作​是​ Zhang, Chen, Sumalee (2011, TR-B 45(3): 534–552)。ERM ​假定​分布​已知​；Wasserstein DRO ​把​分布​本身​放进​不​确定​集​，​是​更​强​的​鲁棒​概念​。​现代​ Wasserstein DRO TAP ​工作​见​ Ban et al. (2021, arXiv:2103.12585) ​与​ 2026 Optimization Online ​上​的​ truncated SUE ​论文​。

docs.title: 4.10 Day-to-day Dynamics (Smith 1984; Watling 1999)
docs.text: ​不​假设​瞬时​均衡​，​研究​ \(\mathbf f^{(t+1)}=F(\mathbf f^{(t)})\) ​的​动态​，UE ​是​其​不动点​。​给出​"​均衡​如何​被​达到​"​的​解释​ (​静态​ UE ​缺乏​的​)，​并​能​容纳​学习​、​记忆​、​信息​更新​。​在​ EV ​场景​中​尤为重要​：​充电站​排队​等​信息​每天​更新​，DTD ​比​静态​ UE ​更​现实​。

docs.title: 4.11 Non-additive UE (Gabriel–Bernstein 1997)
docs.text: ​最早​承认​链路​-​路径​可加性​可能​崩溃​的​ B ​类​工作​。​设​路径​成本​ \(c_p\) ​是​路​径流量​直接​的​函数​，​不​要求​ \(c_p=\sum\delta_{a,p}c_a\)。​结果​：UE ​仍​可​写​为​路​径流量​上​的​ NCP，​但​失去​ Beckmann NLP——​直接​进入​ §5 ​的​ VI ​框架​。

docs.title: 4.12 Side-constrained UE (Larsson–Patriksson 1995)
docs.text:
​链路​容量​约束​ \(x_a\leq u_a\)。Lagrangian：​约束​乘子​ \(\rho_a^{\rm cap}\geq 0\) ​是​"​影子​拥堵​价​"，​链路​有效​成本​ \(c_a+\rho_a^{\rm cap}\)，UE ​仍​成立​但​带​价格​。​这是​ §6 ​杠杆​ L9（​对偶​物理​化​）​在​ B ​类​的​纯净​版本​：\(\rho_a^{\rm cap}\) ​物理​意义​即​容量​约束​下​的​影子​拥堵​价​（​与​ §4.2 Pigovian ​税​ \(\tau_a^{\rm Pig}\) ​是​不同​对象​——​前者​来自​硬​容量​约束​的​对偶​，​后者​来自​总成本​最优化​的​ KKT）。

B ​类​的​统一​句式​："​用​什么​替换​ \(c_p\)"——​感知​ (4.3)、​阈值​ (4.5)、CPT (4.6)、​风险​ (4.7-4.8)、​鲁棒​ (4.9)、​动态​ (4.10)、​非可加​ (4.11)、​加价​ (4.12)。​每个​替换​对应​一个​新​的​市场​或​新​的​行为​机制​。

docs.title: §5 ​第三​战场​：C ​类​ Beckmann ​函数​变体​ ("​重写​数学​")
docs.text:
C ​类​放弃​ NLP，​重写​均衡​的​数学​结构​本身​。​在​进入​具体​变体​之前​，​先​建立​数学​结构​层级​——​这​条​层级​链​描述​了​ NLP ​死亡​之后​诸​数学​对象​的​接班​顺序​：

Infinite-dim VI ​当​流量​在​函数​空间​ GNEP ​当​可行​集​互相​依赖​ NCP / Quasi-VI ​当​成本​-​路径​互补​ VI (Smith-Dafermos) ​当​ c ​单调​（​无需​对称​） NLP (Beckmann) ​当​ ∇c ​对称​

​每​一级​"​何时​退化​为​上​一级​"​由前​一级​的​关键​假设​决定​：VI ​在​ \(\mathbf c\) ​对称​时​退化​为​ NLP；NCP ​在​路径​成本​退化​为​链路​-​加和时​退化​为​ VI；GNEP ​在​耦合​约束​断开​时​退化​为​ NEP/VI。§5.7 ​的​ Marechal ​线​积分​是​逆向​桥梁​——​它​在​ VI ​已经​成立​的​前提​下​重新​构造​一个​标量​目标​，​从​右下角​凿​回​左上角​的​ NLP ​形式​。

docs.title: 5.1 Classic Beckmann — ​基线
docs.text: \(Z(\mathbf x)=\sum_a\int_0^{x_a}c_a(s)\,ds\)，​凸​ NLP。

docs.title: 5.2 Asymmetric VI（Smith 1979; Dafermos 1980）
docs.text:
​当​链路​成本​ \(\mathbf c(\mathbf x)\) Jacobian \( abla\mathbf c\) ​非对称​时​——​例如​交叉口​左转​影响​对​向​直行​——​不​存在​标量​势​ \(Z\) ​使​ \( abla Z=\mathbf c\)。Smith ​的​关键​转写​：UE ​等价​于​变分​不等式​ (VI) $\(\langle\mathbf c(\mathbf x^*),\mathbf x-\mathbf x^* angle\geq 0,\quad orall\,\mathbf x\in K,\)$ ​其中​ \(K\) ​为​可行​流量​集​ (​流量​守恒​ + ​非负​)。

​存在​性​：\(K\) ​紧凸​，\(\mathbf c\) ​连续​ → Brouwer / Hartman–Stampacchia ​不动点​定理​给出​ VI ​解​存在​。

​唯一性​：\(\mathbf c\) ​严格​单调​ (\(\langle \mathbf c(\mathbf x)-\mathbf c(\mathbf y),\mathbf x-\mathbf y angle>0\; orall\mathbf x e\mathbf y\)) ​在​有界​ \(K\) ​上​保证​链路​流量​唯一​ \(\mathbf{x}^*\)；​路​径流量​ \(\mathbf{f}^*\) ​一般​仍非​唯一​。​在​无界​ \(K\) ​上​需要​更强​的​强​单调​性​ (strong monotonicity)。​严格​单调​性​与​ Jacobian ​对称性​是​逻辑​独立​的​两件事​——\( abla\mathbf c\) ​的​对称​部分​正定​即​蕴涵​严格​单调​，​但​单调​性​可​在​ \( abla\mathbf c\) ​非对称​下​成立​，​也​可​在​对称​下​失败​。

​算法​：​投影​法​、Josephy–Newton、​对​角化​ (diagonalization, Dafermos 1982)——​把​非对称​问题​序列​地​近似​为​对称​ Beckmann，​每步​用​ Frank-Wolfe，​外层​迭代​ Jacobian ​行​；​强​单调​下​ \(O(1/\epsilon)\) ​复杂度​。VI-TAP ​的​标准​教材​是​ Nagurney (1993/1999) Network Economics: A Variational Inequality Approach ​与​ Facchinei & Pang (2003) Finite-Dimensional Variational Inequalities and Complementarity Problems（​前者​偏​ TA ​应用​、​后者​偏​数学​结构​）；Patriksson (1994) ​涵盖​ TAP ​全谱​但​ VI ​仅​是​其​一章​。​没有​目标值​的​代价​：​工程师​"​看不到​"​算法​进度​，​需要​用​ gap function \(\Gamma(\mathbf x) = \sup_{\mathbf y \in K} \langle \mathbf c(\mathbf x), \mathbf x - \mathbf y angle\) ​监控​收敛​。

docs.title: 5.3 Entropy Beckmann（Fisk 1980）
docs.text: ​把​ SUE Logit ​写成​等价​ NLP。​考虑​路​径流量​上​的​目标​ $\(Z_F(\mathbf f)=\sum_a\int_0^{x_a}c_a(s)\,ds+\theta^{-1}\sum_w\sum_{p\in\mathcal P_w}f_p\ln f_p,\)$ ​约束​ \(\sum_p f_p=q_w\)、\(f_p\geq 0\)。KKT： $\(\sum_a\delta_{a,p}c_a+\theta^{-1}(\ln f_p+1)-\pi_w=0\)$ $\(\Rightarrow f_p=\exp(\pi_w\theta-1)\exp(-\theta c_p)\propto\exp(-\theta c_p).\)$ ​配合​ \(\sum_p f_p=q_w\) ​立得​ Logit。​所以​ Logit-SUE ​不是​一个​新​的​均衡​，​而是​ Beckmann ​加熵​正则​的​解​——​这是​ §6 ​杠杆​ L11 (​正则​化​) ​的​最早​纯净​例证​。\(\theta\to\infty\) ​时​熵​项​消失​，​退回​ UE。

docs.title: 5.4 Multi-commodity Asymmetric (Aashtiani 1979; Aashtiani–Magnanti 1981)
docs.text: ​多​类​不同​ OD ​不同​ VOT，​链路​成本​对​各类​有​不同​贡献​。NCP ​形式​： $\(\mathbf F(\mathbf f)\geq 0,\;\mathbf f\geq 0,\;\langle\mathbf F(\mathbf f),\mathbf f\rangle=0,\)$ \(F_p=c_p-\pi_w\)。Aashtiani ​的​算法​基于​ PATH solver。

docs.title: 5.5 Elastic Demand（Evans 1976）
docs.text: ​需求​ \(q_w\) ​不再​外​生​，​而是​ \(q_w=D_w(\pi_w)\)，\(D_w\) ​递减​。​等价​ NLP： $\(\min_{\mathbf x,\mathbf q}\sum_a\int_0^{x_a}c_a(s)ds-\sum_w\int_0^{q_w}D_w^{-1}(t)dt,\)$ KKT ​给出​ UE + \(\pi_w=D_w^{-1}(q_w)\)，​即​均衡​需求​与​均衡​ OD ​成本​相符​。Evans ​的​双重​凸性​分解​算法​在​弹性​需求​ + Logit-SUE ​组合​下​尤其​有效​。

docs.title: 5.6 Quasi-VI / PDS / VE — GNEP ​的​数学​骨架
docs.text:
​在​ §5.8 ​进入​ GNEP ​之前​，​先​补足​三个​数学​工具​的​精确​定义​。

(a) Quasi-Variational Inequality (QVI)：​找​ \(\mathbf x^* \in K(\mathbf x^*)\) ​使得​ \(\langle F(\mathbf x^*), \mathbf y - \mathbf x^* angle \ge 0, orall \mathbf y \in K(\mathbf x^*)\)。​可行​集​ \(K(\cdot)\) ​依赖于​解​ \(\mathbf x^*\) ​自身​——​这是​ VI ​的​真正​推广​。

(b) GNEP ⇄ QVI ​等价​ (Facchinei & Kanzow 2010, Annals of OR 175(1): 177–211)：​在​凸性​假设​下​，GNEP \( igl(\min_{\mathbf x_ u \in X_ u(\mathbf x_{- u})} heta_ u(\mathbf x_ u, \mathbf x_{- u}) igr)_{ u=1}^N\) ​把​所有​玩家​的​ KKT ​拼成​一个​ QVI；​反过来​ QVI ​在​显式​分解​下​是​ GNEP。

(c) Variational Equilibrium (Rosen 1965 normalized equilibrium)：​当​ GNEP ​的​耦合​约束​所有​玩家​共享​同一个​ \(g(\mathbf x) \le 0\) ​时​，QVI ​退化​为​标准​ VI；​其解​称为​ VE，​是​ GNE ​的​子集​，​对应​所有​玩家​共享​同一​对偶​乘子​的​ normalized ​解​。VE ​通常​是​ GNEP ​解​集中​计算​上​唯一​可解​的​子集​。

(d) Projected Dynamical Systems (PDS, Nagurney-Zhang 1996)：​构造​ ODE $\(\dot{\mathbf x}(t) = \Pi_K igl(\mathbf x(t), -F(\mathbf x(t)) igr),\)$ ​其中​ \(\Pi_K\) ​是​切锥​投影​。PDS ​的​稳态​点集​等于​关联​ VI ​的​解集​。​这​把​ day-to-day ​学习​动力学​（§4.10 Smith 1984、Friesz ​等​）​放进​统一​框架​——day-to-day ​是​ PDS ​的​离散​时间​版本​，PDS ​是​其​连续​时间​极限​。​理论​根基​由​ Dupuis & Nagurney (1993) ​给出​。

docs.title: 5.7 Generalized Beckmann via Line Integral（Marechal & de Grange 2024）
docs.text:
​当​ \( abla\mathbf c\) ​非对称​、​不​存在​势函数​时​，Smith-Dafermos ​的​ VI（§5.2）​解决​了​"​如何​刻画​均衡​"，​但​失去​了​"​如何​用​ NLP ​求解​"​的​便利​。Marechal & de Grange (2024, J. Adv. Transp. 2024:2921485) ​的​关键​观察​是​：​虽然​ \(\mathbf c\) ​不是​任何​标量​场​的​梯度​，​但​它​沿​任何​具体​路径​ \(\gamma\) ​的​线​积分​仍然​有​定义​。

​经典​ Beckmann ​的​ \(\int_0^{x_a} c_a(s)\,ds\) ​是​一维​线​积分​；​多​变量​推广​就是​流量​空间​中​的​线​积分​ \(\int_\gamma \mathbf c \cdot d oldsymbol{\xi}\)。​一般​这种​线​积分​依赖于​所​选​路径​——​其​与​路径​无关​等价​于​微分​ 1-​形式​ \(\sum_a c_a\, dx_a\) ​闭合​，​等价​于​ Jacobian ​对称​。Marechal–de Grange ​的​方法​在​ Jacobian ​不​对称​时​仍然​写出​一个​广义​的​"​代理​势​"，​并​把​ KKT ​重新​连​回​ Wardrop。

​构造​（​直线​参数​化​）：​取​ \(\gamma( au;\mathbf x) = au\mathbf x\)，\( au \in [0,1]\)，​定义​ $\(Z(\mathbf x) = \int_0^1 \mathbf c( au\mathbf x)^ op \mathbf x \, d au.\)$ ​当​ \(\mathbf c\) ​是​某个​ \(Z_0\) ​的​梯度​（​对称​情形​）​时​，\(Z(\mathbf x) = Z_0(\mathbf x) - Z_0(\mathbf 0)\)，​退回​经典​ Beckmann。​当​ \(\mathbf c\) ​非对称​时​，\(Z(\mathbf x)\) ​不再​是​势函数​（\( abla Z e \mathbf c\)），​但​ Marechal–de Grange ​证明​：​只要​ \(\mathbf c\) ​单调​，\(Z\) ​仍然​凸​；​其​ KKT ​一阶​条件​等价​于​ Smith-Dafermos VI，​进而​等价​于​ Wardrop ​第一​原理​。

​这​把​ VI（§5.2）​用​一个​伪势​重新​连接​到​ NLP ​形式​，​使​ §5.2 ​的​算法​范式​（​投影​、​对​角化​）​与​ §5.1 ​的​算法​范式​（Frank-Wolfe）​在​统一​框架​下​处理​；​不​要求​ Jacobian ​对称​这一​硬性​条件​。​在​ §9.5 ​这是​"​魔改​星形​邻域​连通性​"​的​最​关键技术​证据​。

​局限​：​凸性​条件​仍​要​ \(\mathbf c\) ​单调​，​这​本身​就是​ Smith-Dafermos VI ​唯一性​所​需​；​论文​原始​构造​仅​针对​单类​对称​的​ NLP ​替代​ VI，​推广​到​多类​ NCP（§5.4）、coupled GNEP（§5.8）、​弹性​需求​（§5.5）​是​开放​方向​（​见​ §10.2）。

docs.title: 5.8 PDN-TN Coupled GNEP（Wei et al. 2017; Bakhshayesh-Kebriaei 2023）
docs.text:
EV ​充电​需求​耦合​配电网​潮流​：TN ​侧​ EV ​路径​选择​产生​充电​需求​ \(d_n^{\text{EV}}\)；PDN ​侧​电价​ \(\lambda_n\) ​由​最优​潮流​ (OPF) ​内生​决定​，\(\lambda_n=\lambda_n(d^{\text{EV}})\)；​反馈​到​充电​链路​成本​ \(c_a^{\text{ch}}=\tau_a^{\text{wait}}+\lambda_n\cdot e_a\)。TN ​的​流量​分布​决定​了​充电站​的​负荷​需求​，​而​ PDN ​的​容量​约束​又​反过来​约束​ TN ​玩家​可行​的​路径​；​两边​的​可行​集​互相​依赖​，​这是​ GNEP ​区别​于​ NEP ​的​核心​。​可行​集​ \(K_{\rm TN}(\mathbf x_{\rm PDN})\) ​和​ \(K_{\rm PDN}(\mathbf x_{\rm TN})\) ​互相​是​对方​决策​的​函数​，​导致​ KKT ​多重性​与​ Quasi-VI ​结构​（§5.6）。

​求解​策略​落​在​ Variational Equilibrium ​子集​（​共享​耦合​约束​的​ GNE ​子集​，​对应​ Rosen 1965 ​的​ normalized equilibrium）+ ADMM / ​罚​函数​ / ​对​角化​。Wei et al. (2017, IEEE TSG) ​在​双层​ Stackelberg ​结构​下​证明​在​凸​ OPF ​松弛​下​ VE ​存在​；Bakhshayesh & Kebriaei (2023, arXiv:2211.05635) ​给出​分布式​ best-response / mirror-descent ​算法​。

​关于​ "\(\lambda_n\) ≡ LMP" ​的​精确​叙述​：​在​凸​ OPF ​松弛​（​如​线性化​ DistFlow ​或​ SOCP ​紧​松弛​）+ variational equilibrium ​选择​下​，GNEP ​中​ \(\lambda_n\) ​与​配电网​的​ DLMP (Distribution LMP) ​数值​上​一致​（​差​一个​符号​约定​）。​在​非凸​ AC-OPF ​下​，​对偶​间隙​使​ LMP ​不再​唯一​定义​，​关系​仅​是​近似​——​这是​ §10.3 ​三重​耦合​研究​空白​的​技术​核心​。

GNEP ​是​ §6 ​杠杆​ L12（​耦合​性​）​的​最高​表达​。C ​类​的​整体​局限​是​算法​成熟度​仍远​不及​ Beckmann NLP：​工业界​（TransCAD, EMME）​至今​主要​部署​对称​ Beckmann ​加​ link-separable BPR——​这是​ §10.5 ​研究​空白​的​源头​。

docs.title: 5.9 Markov / Recursive Logit Equilibrium — ​现代​主流​补充
docs.text:
​经典​ path-based logit-SUE（§4.3、§5.3）​的​两大​痛点​：(i) ​需要​显式​枚举​路径​集​ \(\mathcal P_w\)，​对大​网络​不​可行​；(ii) ​在​循环​网络​（​含​ walk-flow §3.9）​上​路径​概念​退化​。Markov / Recursive Logit ​范式​同时​解决​两者​。

(a) Baillon & Cominetti (2008) Markovian Traffic Equilibrium (Math. Program. 111: 33–56)：​在​每个​中间​节点​ \(i\)，​行人​按​ discrete-choice (logit / ​任意​ RUM) ​选下​一弧​ \(a\)，​转移​概率​ $\(\pi_{i,a} = \Pr(\text{choose }a \mid \text{at }i)\)$ ​依赖​弧​成本​ \(c_a\) ​与​剩余​期望​旅程​时间​ \(\tau_j\)（\(j\) ​是​ \(a\) ​的​尾​节点​）。​均衡​ = ​转移​核​ \(\pi\) ​与​流量​ \(\mathbf x\) ​的​不动点​；​流量​ = ​该​ Markov ​链​关于​ OD ​注入​的​不变​测度​。​关键​定理​：​在​轻​条件​下​存在​唯一​均衡​，​刻画​为​低维​无约束​严格凸​最小化​问题​——​计算​上​比​路径​枚举​廉价​数量级​。

(b) Fosgerau, Frejinger, Karlström (2013) Recursive Logit (RL) (Transp. Res. B 56: 70–80)：​把​路径​选择​写成​节点​处​的​链式​ logit，​等价​于​一个​值​函数​ Bellman ​递归​ $\(V_i = \mu \log \sum_{a:\,o(a)=i} \exp\bigl(\tfrac{-c_a + V_{d(a)}}{\mu}\bigr).\)$ ​选择​概率​ \(P(a \mid i) = \exp\bigl((V_{d(a)} - c_a - V_i)/\mu\bigr)\)。​完全​摆脱​"​路径​选择​集​枚举​"，​可​在​循环​网络​上良​定义​。​等价​性​：​在​无环​ DAG ​网络​上​，RL/Markovian ​模型​化简​为​路径​ logit（​即​ Dial 1971 / logit-SUE ​的​扩展​格式​）。RL ​的​优越性​在​循环​网络​上​体现​：​可以​处理​任意​有向图​（​包括​ §3.9 walk-flow ​那种​允许​重复​访问​的​情形​），​不必​显式​枚举​路径​集​。

​与​本文​主线​的​关系​：RL ​是​ §3.9 walk-flow + §4.3 SUE ​在​数学​上​的​"​原生​统一​" ——​把​"​路径​"​概念​彻底​放在​节点​处​的​ Bellman ​算子​里​，​而​不是​先​枚举​路径​集再加​ logit。​这​给​ §10.1 SoC ​嵌入​压缩​研究​空白​一个​直接​的​数学​起点​。

docs.title: 5.10 Frank-Wolfe vs Bush-based — ​算法​收敛​速率​谱系
docs.text:
Beckmann NLP ​的​可​解性​最终​落到​具体​算法​。​下表​汇总​主流​算法​在​ TAP ​上​的​收敛​性质​（​前面​ §3-§5 ​多次​援引​）：

​算法​ ​收敛​速率​ ​主​参考​ ​经典​ Frank–Wolfe (LeBlanc 1975) \(\mathcal O(1/k)\) ​次​线性​ LeBlanc, Morlok, Pierskalla (1975) Conjugate FW / Bi-conjugate FW ​经验​ 1-2 ​个​数量级​加速​；​理论​仍次​线性​ Mitradjieva & Lindberg (2013) Trans. Sci. 47(2) Origin-Based Algorithm (OBA) ​经验​超​线性​收敛​；​带​投影​拟​牛顿​方向​ Bar-Gera (2002) Trans. Sci. 36(4) Algorithm B bush-based, ​工业​级​精度​ (\(\le 10^{-12}\) relative gap) Dial (2006) Trans. Res. B 40(10) TAPAS bush-based + proportionality / O2P Bar-Gera (2010) Trans. Res. B 44(8-9)

​经典​ FW ​的​ \(O(1/k)\) ​是​凸​目标​ + Lipschitz ​梯度​下​的​标准​结果​；​在​ TAP ​上​"stiff"（​高度​伸长​的​水平​集​）​让​常数​极差​，​是​ CFW/BFW ​出现​的​动机​。OBA / Algorithm B / TAPAS ​不​直接​拼​到​ sublinear/superlinear ​理论​谱系​，​但​实证​上​比​ FW ​类快​几个​数量级​；OBA ​的​拟​牛顿​方向​给出​局部​超​线性​。​工业​级​精度​（≤1e-10 relative gap）​在​ OBA/Alg-B/TAPAS ​下​成本​可​接受​；FW ​在​中等​精度​（≤1e-4）​已经​吃力​——​这​一点​对​ §10.5 ​工业​ TA ​软件​中​ VI/NCP/GNEP ​模块化​的​设计​至关重要​。

docs.title: §6 ​横向​提炼​：12 ​个​统一​杠杆​点
docs.text:
​把​ §3–§5 ​的​ 28 ​个​ item ​横向​投影​，​可以​蒸馏​出​ 12 ​个​独立​可​扳​的​"​杠杆​点​"，​每个​魔改​可​视为​这些​杠杆​的​某种​组合​。

​杠杆​ ​名称​ A ​类​典型​ B ​类​典型​ C ​类​典型​ L1 ​节点​空间​维度​ SoC ​扩展​ (3.1) — — L2 ​时间​维度​ ​时间​扩展​ (3.2) DTD (4.10) DUE-VI L3 ​路径​定义​ Hyperpath (3.6) — — L4 ​模式​异质​ Multimodal (3.4) Multi-class (4.4) Multi-commodity (5.4) L5 ​行为​公理​ — UE/SO/BR/CPT (4.1-4.6) — L6 ​不确定性​ — SUE/MV/DRO (4.3,4.7-4.9) Entropy Beckmann (5.3) L7 ​容量​与​价格​ P&R (3.5) Side-constrained (4.12) GNEP (5.7) L8 ​成本​结构​ (link-sep ↔ ​路径​耦合​) ​充​电弧​ (3.8) Non-additive (4.11) Asymmetric VI (5.2) L9 ​对偶​物理​化​ — Pigovian (4.2) GNEP ​电价​ (5.7) L10 ​数学​形式​ (NLP/VI/NCP/GNEP) — NCP (4.11) VI/NCP/Line-int (5.2,5.4,5.6) L11 ​正则​化​ — BR (4.5) Entropy (5.3) L12 ​跨​网络​耦合​ Multi-layer (3.7) — PDN-TN (5.7)

​为何​ L8 ​与​ L10 ​是​超​节点​？ ​因为​：

  • L8 ("​成本​结构​") ​是​ §1.3 ​的​对偶​崩溃​发生​处​。​所有​魔改​的​根源​问题​都​可​定位​到​ L8 ​是否​被​扳动​。
  • L10 ("​数学​形式​") ​是​ L8 ​崩溃​后​的​容器​。NLP (​势函数​存在​) → VI (​无势​但​单调​) → NCP (​无势​且​不​要求​严格​单调​) → GNEP (​耦合​可行​集​) ​形成​严格​的​包含​链​。​每次​魔改​ L8，L10 ​必须​升级​。

​其余​ 10 ​个​杠杆​是​叶​节点​，​依附​在​这​两个​超​节点​上​。

​以上​ 12 ​杠杆​描述​了​"​可以​动​什么​"——​这​是​魔​改​空间​的​坐标轴​；​下面​的​七条​原理​描述​"​动​的​时候​发生​了​什么​模式​"——​这是​这个​空间​上​的​动力学​。

docs.title: 原理​ 1：​不可​加性​的​可加化​ (Additivization)
docs.text:
​陈述​：​若​路径​成本​不可​加于​原​网络​，​则​存在​某个​扩展​空间​使​其​可加​；​扩展​的​代价​是​维度​。

​案例​：He (2014) ​把​ SoC ​扩进​节点​；TTB 4.7 ​把​已​积累​方差​扩进​状态​；Hyperpath 3.6 ​把​弧​选择​不​确定​扩进​路径​定义​。

​数学​：​设原​网络​成本​ \(\Phi(p)\) ​不可​加​，​存在​状态​ \(s\in\mathcal S\) ​与​转移​ \(T_a:\mathcal S\to\mathcal S\) ​使得​ \(\Phi(p)=\sum_a\phi_a(s_a)\)，\(s_{a+1}=T_a(s_a)\)。​在​扩展​节点​ \(\mathcal N\times\mathcal S\) ​上​重写​ Beckmann。

​代价​定理​ (informal)：\(|\mathcal S|\) ​必须​至少​等于​"​路径​成本​对​历史​依赖​的​状态​维数​"——​这是​不可避免​的​。

docs.title: 原理​ 2：​凸性​的​代价​转移​ (Convexity Budget Transfer)
docs.text:
​经典​ Beckmann ​的​凸性​来自​三处​："\(c_a\) ​单调​ + link-separable + ​简单​可行​集​"。​每次​扳动​一个​开关​，​凸性​预算​被​消耗​，​必须​在​别处​补回​。

​失去​ ​补回​ Link-separable (Asymm VI) ​严格​单调​ → VI ​解​唯一​ ​单调​性​ (M/D/c ​充​电弧​) ​维度​扩展​ + ​局部凸​ ​势函数​ (Marechal) ​选定​路径​ → ​广义​势​仍​凸​ ​简单​可行​集​ (GNEP) ​变分​均衡​ (VE) ​子集​ + ​对偶​罚​

​凸性​预算​的​"​质量守恒​"​使得​没有​免费​的​魔​改​。

docs.title: 原理​ 3：​对偶​变量​的​物理​意义​升级​ (Dual Lifting)
docs.text:
​经典​ Beckmann ​的​ \(\pi_w\) ​是​ OD ​出行​成本​，​是​抽象​ Lagrange ​乘子​。​每次​魔改​往往​伴随​对偶​变量​"​物理​化​"——

  • Pigovian 4.2：\(\tau_a^{\rm Pig}=x_a c_a'\) ​是​拥堵​税​；
  • Side-constrained 4.12：\(\rho_a^{\rm cap}\) ​是​容量​影子​价​；
  • DRO 4.9：​模糊集​对偶​ \(\eta\) ​是​鲁棒​补偿​；
  • GNEP 5.8：\(\lambda_n\) ​是​节点​电价​。

​每个​魔改​都​在​为​模型​新​设计​一个​市场​——​这个​观察​把​魔​改​与​机制​设计​、​市场​清算​（VCG、second-best toll、locational marginal pricing）​在​数学​上​对齐​。

docs.title: 原理​ 4：EV ​是​当代​魔改​的​最大​驱动力
docs.text:
EV ​一次性​扳动​了​至少​ 5 ​个​杠杆​：L1 (SoC ​状态​)、L4 (​车型​多​类​)、L7 (​充电站​容量​)、L9 (​电价​对偶​)、L12 (PDN ​耦合​)。​这是​ 2014 ​年​以后​ TA ​文献​几乎​一半​涉及​ EV ​的​原因​。

​下一代​候选​ forcing functions：CAV（​自动​驾驶​车辆​，​扳动​ L5 ​行为​公理​ + L11 ​协同​正则​化​）、MaaS (Mobility-as-a-Service，​扳动​ L4 + L7 + L9)、H₂ ​燃料​（​扳动​ L1 ​但​ SoC ​网格​远稀​，​反而​比​ EV ​更​易​处理​）。

docs.title: 原理​ 5：​随机性​的​层次化​ (Uncertainty Hierarchy)
docs.text:
​随机性​从弱到强​分​四层​：

  1. ​感知​误差​ (SUE §4.3)：​路径​上​随机​加性​噪声​，IID。
  2. ​结果​不​确定​ (MV/TTB §4.7-4.8)：​路径​成本​本身​是​随机变量​，​关心​矩​或​分​位数​。
  3. ​分布​不​确定​ (DRO §4.9)：​分布​本身​在​模糊​集中​，​关心​最坏​期望​。
  4. ​认知​不​确定​ (BR §4.5; CPT §4.6)：​行为​偏差​，​不是​概率​而是​非线性​效用​。

​每层​对应​一个​均衡​概念​与​等价​ NLP / VI ​形式​。​极限​关系​：DRO (\(\varepsilon\to 0\)) → SAA ​经验​期望​；Logit-SUE (\(\theta\to\infty\)) → UE；BR (\(\eta\to 0\)) → UE；​这三条​极限​是​独立​的​（​参见​ §9.5 ​回归​参数表​）。

docs.title: 原理​ 6：​时间​维度​的​ 4 ​种​打开方式
docs.text:
1. ​静态​：​所有​量​稳态​。
  2. DTD (4.10)：​天与天​之间​的​离散​动态​，UE ​是​极限​。
  3. ​准​动态​ / ​时间​扩展​ (3.2)：​把​时间​作为​节点​维度​，​仍用​静态​ NLP / VI ​求解​。
  4. DUE / Vickrey (3.9)：​连续​时间​偏微分​ / Volterra ​算子​，​进入​函数​空间​ VI。

​层级​ 3 ​与​ 4 ​的​差别​在于​"​时间​是否​可​离散​到​节点​"，​即​是否​仍能​用​ A ​类​的​扩展​技巧​。

docs.title: 原理​ 7：​网络​耦合​ → GNEP
docs.text: ​当​ TN ​与​另​一​网络​ (PDN, ​信息网​, ​通信网​) ​通过​共享​变量​耦合​，​每个​网络​的​可行​集​依赖​对方​决策​——​这​就是​ GNEP ​而​非​ NEP。​变分​均衡​ (VE)​是​ GNEP ​解集​的​子集​，​且​通常​是​计算​上​唯一​可解​的​子集​ (Facchinei–Kanzow 2010)。

docs.title: §8 13 ​个​跨类​组合​套路
docs.text:
​魔改​之所以​富有​生产力​，​是因为​不同​战线​可以​组合​。​以下​ 13 ​个​组合​是​ §7 ​七条​原理​两​两​ / ​三​三​组合​的​产物​，​每行​对应​一篇​可写​的​论文​：

# A B C ​现实​场景​ ​数学​挑战​ ​代表​文献​ 1 SoC ​扩展​ Multi-class Asymm VI ​异质​ EV ​队伍​在​交叉口​ ​维度​ × ​非对称​ He+ Smith ​组合​ 2 Hyperpath SUE Logit Entropy Beckmann ​公交​频率​ + ​感知​误差​ Logit ​在​ hyperpath ​上​ Spiess+Fisk 3 ​时间​扩展​ DTD DUE-VI ​早晨​高峰​拥挤​ ​离散​ + ​连续​时间​桥​ Friesz ​系列​ 4 ​充​电弧​ M/D/c TTB — EV ​风险​厌恶​选​充电​ ​排队​方差​不可​加​ Liu 2023 + Chen-Zhou 5 P&R Side-constrained GNEP ​停车​价​ + PDN ​耦合​ ​多层​对偶​ ​待​研究​ 6 ​多​模式​ Elastic Demand Evans MaaS ​平台​联运​ Logit ​在​多​模式​ ​待​研究​ 7 SoC ​扩展​ DRO Asymm VI ​续航​不​确定​ EV Wasserstein ​在​状态​网​ ​部分​见​ Sun 2018 8 Multi-layer CPT Marechal Line-int ​行为​偏差​ + ​信息​层​ ​非凸​ + ​非对称​ ​空白​ 9 ​时间​扩展​ BR NCP ​通勤​者​天天​调​路径​ DTD + BR ​球​ Watling ​部分​ 10 ​充电站​集成​ Multi-class GNEP ​商品​车​ vs ​私家​ EV VOT × ​电价​ Wei 2017 ​部分​ 11 Hyperpath Pigovian SO Entropy ​公交​拥挤​定价​ hyperpath ​上​的​边际​成本​ ​空白​ 12 Walk-flow Vickrey SUE DUE-VI ​行人​路网​选路​ ​非​局部​时延​ + ​感知​ Graf 2025 13 SoC + PDN DRO GNEP ​鲁棒​ EV-PDN ​联合​规划​ ​模糊集​在​ GNEP ​空白​—§10.3

​每行​都​是​一篇​可​写​论文​的​种子​。​空白行​尤其​有​价值​。

docs.title: §9 ​统一性​主题​：​为什么​所有​魔改​本质​是​同​一件​事
9.1 ​链路​-​路径​可加性​对偶​崩溃​ → ​三条​战线
docs.text:
​回到​ §1.3 ​的​论点​。​从​ §2.2 ​的​ KKT ​推导​可见​，Beckmann NLP ​的​成立​仅仅​依赖​两个​事实​：(i) \(c_p=\sum\delta_{a,p}c_a\) (​路径​成本​可​加​)，(ii) \(\nabla\mathbf c\) ​对称​ (​势函数​存在​)。

  • A ​类​魔​改​通过​扩展​节点​空间​使​ (i) ​在​新​空间​上​成立​——​网络​扩张​策略​；
  • B ​类​魔​改​通过​替换​ \(c_p\) ​的​语义​ (​感知​/​风险​/​鲁棒​/CPT) ​让​ (i) ​在​虚拟​成本​上​仍​成立​——​成本​替换​策略​；
  • C ​类​魔​改​放弃​ (ii)——​直接​进入​ VI/NCP/GNEP——​数学​结构​升级​策略​。

​这三条​战线​不是​三种​不同​的​事​，​而是​ (i)(ii) ​受到​攻击​时​的​三种​防御​。

docs.title: 9.2 ​凸性​预算​的​"​质量守恒​"——​一个​启发式​原理
docs.text:
​经典​ Beckmann ​的​可​解性​源于​三重​凸​：\(c_a\) ​单调​（​势函数​凸​）+ link-separable（​势可分​）+ ​可行​集​线性​（​约束​凸​）。​每次​魔改​扳动​一个​开关​都​会​消耗​一份​凸性​，​必须​在​别处​用​结构​补回​（​原理​ 2）。​我们​用半​启发式​的​形式​陈述​：

\[\text{(​启发式​)}\quad \text{​凸性​预算​} \approx (\text{​势凸性​}) + (\text{​算子​单调​性​}) + (\text{​约束​凸性​}) \;\;\gtrsim\;\; C_0.\]

​澄清​：​上​式​不是​定理​；​三项​均​无​严格​的​标量​化​定义​，"\(\gtrsim\)" ​是​非正式​比较​。​这是​一个​启发式​原理​ (heuristic principle) ​而​非​守恒定律​。​把​它​形式化​为​定理​需要​给​"​凸性​"​分配​可​比较​的​标量​度量​（​例如​ strong-monotonicity ​模量​ \(\mu\)、​约束​集​的​法​锥​曲率​），​是​开放​问题​。

​在​这个​启发式​下​：Smith VI ​牺牲​势凸性​，​靠​算子​严格​单调​性补​；GNEP ​牺牲​约束​凸性​ (​耦合​)，​靠​ VE ​选择​补​；Marechal ​线​积分​牺牲​势​的​全局​凸性​，​靠​选定​参数​化​的​条件​凸补​；Fisk ​熵​正则​不​牺牲​任何​东西​，​反而​通过​显式​增加​正则​项​把​路​径流量​的​非​唯一性​也​罚​掉​——​这​正是​ §2.2 ​末尾​指出​的​"​少有​的​免费​午餐​"。

docs.title: 9.3 ​对偶​变量​的​物理​意义​升级​ = "​每个​魔改​设计​一个​新​市场​"
docs.text: ​原理​ 3 ​的​论点​可​加强​：​每个​杠杆​扳动​都​对应​新​对偶​变量​诞生​或​已有​对偶​变量​物理​化​。​这​把​交通网络​的​均衡​建模​与​机制​设计​、​市场​清算​（LMP, locational marginal pricing）​在​数学​上​对齐​——​尤其​是​ GNEP 5.7 ​中​的​ \(\lambda_n\) ​与​电力​市场​的​节点​电价​ LMP，​在​凸​ OPF ​松弛​与​ variational equilibrium ​选择​下​数值​上​一致​。​这一​观察​把​ §5.7 ​与​电力​经济学​（second-best dispatch、VCG mechanism）​连接起来​；​具体​地​，Pigovian ​税​ \(\tau_a^{\rm Pig}\)（§4.2）、​容量​影子​价​ \(\rho_a^{\rm cap}\)（§4.12）、DLMP \(\lambda_n\)（§5.7）、Wasserstein ambiguity radius \(\varepsilon\)（§4.9）​都​可​视为​机制​设计​中​的​最优​转移​——​见​ Lavi-Nisan、Roughgarden ​关于​ PoA-taxation ​的​工作​，​是​与​本文​主题​的​天然​接驳​点​。

docs.title: 9.4 EV ​是​最大​ forcing function，​下一代​候选​已​在​地平线
docs.text:
EV ​同时​扳动​ 5 ​个​杠杆​（​原理​ 4），​触发​了​ 2014 ​以后​绝大多数​重要​的​魔​改​。

​需要​明示​的​基线​限制​：​本文​未​与​ 1990s ​拥堵​收费​、2000s ITS/DTA、2010s ​共享​出行​（MoD/ridesharing）​等​历史​ forcing pulses ​做​正式​定量​比较​；"EV ​驱动​ 70% ​的​当代​魔改​"​是​基于​ 2020–2025 ​期刊​样本​的​定性​观察​。​在​工业​部署​口径​下​，DTA ​标定​与​ OD ​估计​仍​是​主流​魔改​来源​（​与​ EV ​关联​弱​）。​读者​应​将​本文​视为​对​学术论文​层面​的​归纳​，​而​非​对​整个​ TA ​工程​实践​的​统计​描述​。

CAV ​是否​会​成为​"​下​一个​ EV"​是​开放​问题​。EV ​的​数学​签名​是​容量​与​可行性​约束​（​电池​状态​、​充电​桩​队列​），CAV ​的​数学​签名​是​协同​控制​（mean-field、​分级​、​通信​受限​）；​两者​触发​的​数学​机器​完全​不同​——EV ​走​ GNEP + ​互补​结构​，CAV ​走​ MFG + HJB-​连续性​方程​系统​（​见​ §10.4）。​一种​可能​的​图景​是​：CAV ​不是​在​现有​星形​邻域​上加​新​一颗​卫星​点​，​而是​开辟​一个​与​ UE ​星形​邻域​弱​耦合​的​另​一​星形​——MFG ​的​ selfish-cooperative ​极限​链​（cooperative → selfish → UE）​只是​部分​重叠​的​桥​。

docs.title: 9.5 ​魔改​极限​的​统一性​：​魔改​空间​是​ UE-rooted star
docs.text:
​严格​地说​，​所有​已知​极限​路径​都​通过​ UE ​这一​共同​枢纽​——​这是​ path-connectedness via a common hub，​技术​上​是​以​ UE ​为​中心​的​星形​邻域​ (star-shaped neighborhood at UE)，​不是​流形​。​流形​需要​局部​欧氏​ + ​紧致​ + ​光滑​结构​，​本文​并未​构造​；"​星形​邻域​"​或​非正式​的​"​流形​"​在​此​用作​几何​隐喻​，​指代​魔改​空间​中​存在​以​ UE ​为​中心​的​连续​插值​路径​。

​下表​汇总​主要​魔改​对应​的​回归​参数​，​每个​魔改​对应​一条​沿​一维​路径​回到​ UE ​的​同伦​：

​魔改​ ​回归​参数​ → UE ​的​方向​ Logit-SUE \( heta o \infty\)（​温度​），​熵​项​消失​ Probit-SUE \(\Sigma o 0\)（​噪声​协方差​） DRO \(\varepsilon o 0\)（​半径​），​退回​ SAA ​经验​期望​（​非​ SUE） BR \(\eta o 0\)（indifference band） CPT \((\alpha, eta,\lambda) o (1,1,1)\) ​且​ \(w= ext{id}\) → ​期望​效用​ → UE（​两步​） CumLog \(\eta^t o 0\)，​时间​ \( o \infty\)（Li, Wang, Nie 2024） Mean-Variance \(\lambda o 0\)（​风险​厌恶​系数​） METT (CVaR) \(\alpha o 0\)（​分​位数​） Asymm VI ​对称​化​误差​ \(\| abla\mathbf c - ( abla\mathbf c)^ op\|_F o 0\) Marechal Line Integral \( abla\mathbf c\) ​对称​化​ Multi-class ​类​合并​ Side-constrained ​容量​上限​ \(u_a o \infty\) Elastic Demand \(\|D'_w\| o 0\) Coupled GNEP ​耦合​常数​ \( o 0\)（PDN ​外​生​），GNEP → NEP → UE

​需要​严肃​对待​的​反对​意见​：(i) ​不是​所有​魔改​都​能​回到​ UE——cooperative CAV ​与​协同​ MFG ​在​某些​参数​下​是​不​连通​的​，constraint set ​离散​；(ii) Cross-Nested Logit ​等​ GEV ​扩展​不​经过​ UE ​而是​经过​ SUE ​退化​——​更​准确​地说​，​星形​邻域​的​中心​是​ Wardrop family \(\{ ext{UE}, ext{SO}, ext{SUE}\}\)，​而​非​单点​ UE。

​这一​适度​的​星形​邻域​命题​仍​是​本文​的​理论​贡献​：​它​把​ 28 ​个​ item、12 ​个​杠杆​、7 ​条​原理​、13 ​个​组合​编织成​一个​以​ UE ​为​中心​、​由​若干​一维​同伦​相连​的​研究​空间​。​下一代​研究​的​目标​可以​是​对​这个​空间​做​更​精细​的​几何​刻画​——​能否​建​出​局部​欧氏​图册​？​是否​存在​一个​统一​的​"Wardrop ​流形​"？​这是​ §10 ​末​的​开放​问题​。

docs.title: 10.1 SoC ​扩展​网络​的​稀疏​化​与​嵌入​压缩
docs.text: ​现状​：He (2014) ​等​用​网格​离散​ SoC，\(|\mathcal S|\) ​大​爆炸​。​空白​：​能否​用​ GNN / ​神经​嵌入​学习​一个​低维​ SoC ​表征​，​使​扩展​网络​从​ \(|\mathcal N|\cdot|\mathcal S|\) ​压缩​到​ \(|\mathcal N|\cdot k\) (\(k\ll|\mathcal S|\)) ​而​保持​均衡​精度​？​价值​：​使​百万​节点​ EV-TAP ​第一次​可解​。​难度​：​高​ (​理论​上​要证​压缩​误差​不​放大​均衡​误差​)。​论文​ sketch：​用​ spectral coarsening + ​在线​误差​控制​。

docs.title: 10.2 Marechal ​线​积分​广义​势​的​算法​成熟​化
docs.text: ​现状​：Marechal (2024) ​的​存在​性​ / ​凸性​结果​优雅​，​但​缺乏​与​ Frank-Wolfe / ​投影​法​相当​的​工业​级​算法​。​空白​：​基于​线​积分​广义​势​的​ (​一阶​) ​收敛​率​定理​。​价值​：​把​ VI-TAP ​的​工程​门槛​降到​ NLP-TAP ​同级​。​难度​：​中​高​。​论文​ sketch：​广义​条件​梯度​法​ + ​步长​自​适应​。

docs.title: 10.3 SoC + PDN + DRO ​三重​耦合​下​的​ GNEP-DRO TAP
docs.text: ​现状​：​单独​的​ EV-PDN GNEP (Wei) ​与​单独​的​ DRO TAP (Sun) ​都​已有​成果​。​空白​：​风电​出力​随机​ + EV ​续航​随机​ + PDN ​电价​响应​的​统一​ GNEP-DRO ​框架​。​价值​：​未来​电网​ + EV ​普及​背景​下​的​核心​规划​工具​。​难度​：​高​ (Wasserstein ​在​ GNEP ​上​的​对偶性​尚未​完全​建立​)。​论文​ sketch：​见​ §8 ​表第​ 13 ​行​。

docs.title: 10.4 CAV ​协同​对​ Wardrop ​公理​的​连续​插值​——​通向​ MFG on networks
docs.text:
​现状​：Wardrop UE ​与​ SO ​是​行为​公理​的​两个​端点​。CAV ​协同​（cooperative adaptive cruise control, CACC）​在​数学​上​是​ mean-field ​控制​问题​。​空白​：CACC / platooning ​比例​ \(\alpha \in [0,1]\) ​下​的​"\(\alpha\)-​合作​均衡​"​是否​有​等价​ VI / NLP？​价值​：CAV ​渗透率​政策​评估​。​难度​：​中​-​高​。

​与​ Mean-Field Games on Networks ​的​接驳​：CAV cooperative routing ​最​自然​的​数学​语言​是​ MFG on networks。MFG ​由​两个​ PDE ​耦合​： $$ egin{cases} -\partial_t u + H(x, abla u) = F(x, m), & ext{(HJB, backward)} \ \partial_t m - \mathrm{div} igl(m\, abla_p H(x, abla u) igr) = 0, & ext{(continuity, forward)} \ m(0) = m_0, \quad u(T,\cdot) = g(\cdot, m(T)). \end{cases} $$ HJB ​给​单​ agent ​最优​反应​；​连续性​方程​描述​代理人​群​密度​演化​；\(m\) = "​其他人​"​密度​，​给​单​ agent ​反映​拥堵​。​网络​上​ MFG ​的​关键​文献​：Cardaliaguet (2010-2013) Tor Vergata MFG ​笔记​奠基​；Achdou, Camilli, Cutrì, Tchou (2013-2015) networks ​上​ HJB ​分析​；Achdou, Mannucci, Marchi, Tchou (2024, SIAM J. Math. Anal. DOI 10.1137/23M1615073) "Deterministic Mean Field Games on Networks: A Lagrangian Approach"——​用​拉格朗​日​方法​，relaxed equilibrium ​是​ admissible trajectories ​上​的​概率​测度​，​自然​处理​ walk-style ​重复​访问​ ↔ ​与​ §3.9 walk-flow ​衔接​。

​论文​ sketch：​构造​混合​模型​ \(\alpha\)-cooperative game，\(\alpha=0\) ​退化​为​经典​ Wardrop UE（​自私​），\(\alpha=1\) ​退化​为​社会​最优​ SO；​中间​ \(\alpha\in (0,1)\) ​由​ MFG ​系统​刻画​。​期望​刻画​ PoA-as-a-function-of-\(\alpha\) ​的​精确​轨迹​。

docs.title: 10.5 ​工业​ TA ​软件​中​的​ VI / NCP / GNEP ​模块化
docs.text: ​现状​：TransCAD、EMME、VISUM ​等​几乎​只​支持​对称​ Beckmann + BPR。​空白​：​开源​的​ VI / NCP / GNEP ​求解​模块​，​能​ plug-in ​到​现有​软件​（​类似​ PyTorch ​之​于​深度​学习​；​可​继承​ cvxpylayers / OptNet ​的​ differentiable optimization layer ​思路​）。​价值​：​把​学界​的​ 28 ​个​ item ​真正​搬​到​城市规划​实践​。​难度​：​工程​为主​。​论文​ sketch：​定义​统一​接口​ + ​提供​ §3-§5 ​的​参考​实现​，​借鉴​ Amos-Kolter (2017) OptNet ​与​ Agrawal et al. cvxpylayers ​的​ differentiable layer ​思路​，​让​ TA hacks ​与​ ML pipeline ​互通​。

docs.title: 10.6 Continuous Wardrop / Congested Optimal Transport ​与​离散​ Beckmann ​的​桥梁
docs.text: ​现状​：Carlier, Jimenez, Santambrogio (2008, SICON 47(3): 1330-1350) "Optimal Transportation with Traffic Congestion and Wardrop Equilibria" ​在​测度​空间​ \(\Omega \subset \mathbb R^d\) ​上​建立​了​连续​ Wardrop ​模型​——traffic intensity \(i_Q(x)=\int(\int_0^{L(\gamma)} \mathbf 1_\gamma(x)\,dt) dQ(\gamma)\) ​给出​ \(x\) ​处​的​总流量​；congestion cost \(g(x, i_Q(x))\) ​决定​均衡​；​等价​变分​问题​ \(\min_Q \int_\Omega G(x, i_Q(x))\, dx\)，\(\partial_z G = g\)。Brasco, Carlier, Santambrogio (2010) ​用​ \(\Gamma\)-​收敛​证明​ cartesian lattice ​网格​密度​ \(\to \infty\) ​时​离散​ Wardrop ​均衡​ → CJS ​连续​模型​。 ​空白​：​把​ §5.6 Marechal ​离散​线​积分​广义​势函数​与​ CJS ​连续​ traffic intensity ​接驳​起来​——​是否​存在​统一​的​ functional formulation ​跨越​两者​？​价值​：​把​"Beckmann ​的​另​一个​问题​"（​连续​ Wardrop）​从​ PDE ​学者​圈​带回​ TA ​工程​圈​，​建立​两条​独立​流派​的​桥梁​。​难度​：​高​（​涉及​ PDE ​正则​性​ × ​离散​网络​组合​）。 ​论文​ sketch：​证明​ Marechal-de Grange (2024) ​的​离散​ \(Z(\mathbf x) = \int_0^1 \mathbf c(\tau\mathbf x)^\top \mathbf x\,d\tau\) ​在​网格​细化​极限​下​ \(\Gamma\)-​收敛​到​ CJS ​的​连续​ functional。

docs.title: §11 ​结语​：​从​离散​列表​到​星形​邻域
docs.text:
​经典​ Beckmann ​是​星形​邻域​的​中心​，Smith-Dafermos VI ​是​中心点​的​一阶切​方向​，Marechal-de Grange ​线​积分​是​把​切​方向​嫁接​回​ NLP ​的​桥​，GNEP ​是​耦合​维度​，Markov / Recursive Logit ​是​把​"​路径​"​概念​从​弧​上​ Bellman ​算子​重构​的​正交​方向​；EV ​是​过去​ 12 ​年​把​整个​星形​邻域​从​静止​点​踢​出​的​最大​ forcing function。​下一代​研究​——CAV、MaaS、H₂、MFG-on-networks (§10.4)、Continuous Wardrop/OT (§10.6)——​将​继续​在​这个​空间​上​扳动​新​的​杠杆​。

​魔改​不是​离散​列表​，​而是​以​ UE ​为​中心​的​星形​邻域​——​这是​七十年​文献​写下​的​最​深刻​的​事实​，​也​是​本文​之所以​可能​存在​的​前提​。

docs.title: §12 Further Reading（​推荐​阅读​）
docs.text: ​读完​本文​，​读者​已​掌握​ Wardrop–Beckmann ​七十年​魔​改史​的​统一​坐标系​：12 ​个​杠杆​点​、​三条​战线​、UE ​为​中心​的​星形​邻域​。​下面​这份​书单​不是​穷尽​式​的​参考​列表​，​而是​为​想​沿​这条​主线​继续前进​的​研究生​与​青年​研究者​准备​的​引导​路径​——​按​"​先​入门​、​再​奠基​、​然后​到​前沿​、​最后​跨界​"​的​顺序排列​。

docs.title: Getting Started（​先读​这​几本​）
docs.text:
📖 Patriksson, M. — The Traffic Assignment Problem: Models and Methods（1994 ​原版​ / Dover 2015 ​重印​） ​全书​ 7 ​章​。​建议​按​ §1–§3（NLP ​形式​与​凸​分析​基础​）→ §4（Frank–Wolfe ​与​变体​）→ §5（VI ​与​不动点​）​的​顺序​读​。​本文​ §2.2 ​的​ KKT ​推导​、§5.10 ​算法​表​、§5.2 VI ​一节​的​语言​均​与​ Patriksson ​兼容​；​读完​此书​后​本文​ §3–§5 ​几乎​不​需要​再查​任何​外部​引用​。​注意​此​书写​于​ 1994 ​年​：EV、DRO、GNEP ​的​内容​完全​没有​；​它​给​你​的​是​ link-separable Beckmann ​范式​的​"​刚性​结构​"，​恰好​是​被​本文​后续​魔改​打破​的​那个​基线​。

📖 Boyles, S. D., Lownes, N. E., Unnikrishnan, A. — Transportation Network Analysis (Vol. I: Static and Dynamic)（v0.91, 2024 ​开放​获取​草稿​，sboyles.github.io/blubook.html） 2024 ​年​最新更新​的​开源​教材​，UT Austin ​与​ UConn ​长期​教学​积累​。​第​ 6–7 ​章用​图​与​小算例​把​ Frank–Wolfe、Algorithm B、OBA、TAPAS（​本文​ §5.10 ​整张​表​）​一气​讲完​，​比​ Patriksson ​现代​得​多​；​第​ 11 ​章​新增​ dynamic TA ​与​ EV ​充电​小节​。​为什么​选​这本​而​不是​ Sheffi (1985)：Sheffi ​在​ SUE ​部分​仍然​权威​，​但​其​ Frank–Wolfe ​推导​今天​看来​已​被​ OBA/Alg-B ​体系​完全​超越​，​而​ Boyles ​等​明确​写出​"​为什么​ bush-based ​工业​级​精度​而​ FW ​不行​"——​这​正是​本文​ §5.10 ​想​传达​的​工程​直觉​。

📖 Nagurney, A. — Network Economics: A Variational Inequality Approach (2nd ed.)（Kluwer 1999） ​读​ §1（VI ​基础​）、§2（Brouwer / Hartman–Stampacchia ​存在​性​）、§7（traffic networks）、§9（multi-tiered networks，​预演​了​本文​ §5.8 GNEP）。Nagurney ​的​写法​把​ TAP ​完全​嵌进​经济学​网络​均衡​的​更​大​框架​，​对​理解​本文​"​对偶​变量​物理​化​ = ​设计​新​市场​"（​原理​ 3、§9.3）​的​论点​是​必需​的​。​如果​你​只读​ §7，​会​错过​ §9 ​里​"​两层​网络​耦合​"​的​早期​版本​——​那​是​ PDN-TN GNEP ​的​史前史​。

docs.title: Foundations & Classics（​奠基​必读​）
docs.text:
🏛️ Beckmann, M., McGuire, C. B., Winsten, C. B. — Studies in the Economics of Transportation（Yale UP, 1956） ​只读​第​ 3 ​章​（the Beckmann transformation ​的​原始​陈述​）​和​第​ 4 ​章​（demand elasticity ​的​早期​处理​，​是​本文​ §5.5 Evans 1976 ​的​前身​）。​注意​：1956 ​年​的​记号​与​今天​差别​很大​，"​路​径流量​"​的​概念​尚未​明确​——​书中​实际​工作​的​层级​是​ OD ​流量​与​ link ​流量​。​读​这​一章​的​目的​不是​学​技术​，​而是​体会​ §1.1 ​所说​的​"​幸运​结构​"​被​发现​时​的​语境​：​他们​并​不是​在​解​优化​问题​，​而是​在​为​均衡​现象​寻找​一个​等价​描述​。

📝 Smith, M. J. — "The existence, uniqueness and stability of traffic equilibria"（TR-B 13(4): 295–304, 1979）+ Dafermos, S. — "Traffic equilibrium and variational inequalities"（Transp. Sci. 14(1): 42–54, 1980） ​两篇​短​论文​，​加​起来​不到​ 25 ​页​。Smith ​给出​ VI ​形式​与​不动点​存在​性​，Dafermos ​独立​给出​ VI ​重述​并​补足​唯一性​的​严格​单调​性​条件​。​只读​这​两篇​即可​——​本文​ §5.2 ​的​全部​数学​结构​来自​这​ 25 ​页​。​它们​在​ Jacobian ​对称​这一​假设​被​ 1970s ​末​的​交叉口​模型​打破​时​被​写下​，​是​"​对称​崩溃​后​第一份​救援​"。

🔬 Facchinei, F., Pang, J.-S. — Finite-Dimensional Variational Inequalities and Complementarity Problems (Vol. I & II)（Springer, 2003） ​不要​试图​读完​。​把​它​当​工具书​：​当​本文​ §5.2、§5.4、§5.6 ​的​某个​ VI / NCP / QVI ​概念​需要​严格​证明​时​，​按​需​查阅​。​特别​推荐​ §1.4（VI ​的​几何​）​与​ §12（NCP ​算法​）。Facchinei–Kanzow 2010 ​的​ GNEP ​综述​（​已​在​本文​ §5.6、§5.8、​原理​ 7 ​多次​引用​）​是​这​本书​在​ GNEP ​方向​的​官方​后续​阅读​，​建议​接续​读​。

📝 Roughgarden, T., Tardos, É. — "How bad is selfish routing?"（J. ACM 49(2): 236–259, 2002）+ Roughgarden, T. — "The price of anarchy is independent of network topology"（JCSS 67(2): 341–364, 2003） ​两篇​加​起来​ 50 ​页​。​本文​ §4.2 ​给出​的​ 4/3 ​界​与​ Pigou ​紧​实例​直接​来自​这​两篇​；​它们​对​你​理解​ §9.3"​对偶​变量​物理​化​ = ​机制​设计​"​为什么​是非​平凡​观察​至关重要​——​拥挤​定价​的​政策​合法性​界限​就​在​这​两篇​里​。

docs.title: The Current Frontier（2021–2026 ​前沿​）
docs.text:
🆕 Li, R., Wang, J., Nie, Y. (M.) — "Wardrop equilibrium can be boundedly rational: A new behavioral theory of route choice"（Transp. Sci. 58(5): 973–994, 2024；arXiv:2304.02500） ​本文​ §4.5 ​与​ §9.5 ​的​核心​证据​。​读完​本文​后​立刻​读​这篇​——​它​把​ BR ​与​ UE ​的​关系​从​"BR ​是​ UE ​的​弱化​"​反转​为​"BR ​学习​过程​的​极限​是​ UE"。​重点​读​ §3 CumLog ​递推​的​稳定性​证明​与​ §5 ​数值​实验​。​这​篇文章​解决​了​ Harsanyi (1973) ​以来​困扰​行为​博弈​半个世纪​的​均衡​选择​不稳定性​问题​，​是​过去​三年​ TA ​行为​侧​最​重要​的​论文​之一​。

🆕 Maréchal, M., de Grange, L. — "A Generalization of Beckmann's Transformation for the Traffic Assignment Problem"（J. Adv. Transp. 2024: 2921485） ​本文​ §5.7 ​的​来源​。50 ​页​不到​，​建议​用​一个​下午​读完​然后​自己​手推​ §3 ​的​ line-integral ​构造​。​关键​看点​：​定理​ 2（​凸性​证明​，​只用​单调​性​，​不​需要​对称性​）​与​定理​ 3（KKT ​等价​于​ Smith VI）。​读​这篇​最大​的​智识​收获​是​看见​线​积分​如何​在​ Jacobian ​不​对称​的​代数​障碍​下​绕回​ NLP ​形式​——​这是​ §9.5 ​星形​邻域​命题​最​锋利​的​技术​证据​。

🆕 Liu, B., Pantelidis, T. P., Tam, S., Chow, J. Y. J. — "An electric vehicle charging station access equilibrium model with M/D/C queueing"（Int. J. Sustainable Transp. 17(3): 228–244, 2023；arXiv:2102.05851） ​本文​ §3.8 ​的​来源​。​读​ §3（M/D/c ​排队​的​ Cosmetatos ​近似​嵌入​弧​成本​）+ §5（NYC DCAS 1484-EV ​算例​）。​注意​细节​：​作者​明确指出​ \(\rho \to 1\) ​时弧​成本​不可​微​、​需要​ derivative-free MSA ​替代​ Frank–Wolfe——​这​是​把​队列​论​真正​搬进​ Beckmann ​框架​时​发现​的​、​教科书​不会​告诉​你​的​工程​现实​。​是​ A ​类​魔​改​"​维度​换​可加性​"​在​ EV ​时代​的​工业​级算例​。

🆕 Graf, L., Harks, T., Palkar, P. — "Dynamic Traffic Assignment for Electric Vehicles"（ATMOS 2022；arXiv:2207.04454） ​本文​ §3.9 ​的​来源​。20 ​页​论文​，​重点​在​ §3 walk-flow ​的​形式​定义​与​ §4 ​的​存在​性​定理​。​为什么​这篇​重要​：​它​把​"​路径​"​概念​从​"​无​重复​节点​的​简单​路径​"​推广​到​"​允许​循环​的​ walk"，​是​为​ EV ​中途​绕回​充电​这一​现实​场景​量身​定制​的​——​这​同时​也​是​连接​ §5.9 Recursive Logit ​与​ §10.4 MFG-on-networks ​的​天然​桥梁​，​因为​ RL ​与​ MFG ​都​不​依赖​路径​枚举​。

🆕 Achdou, Y., Mannucci, P., Marchi, C., Tchou, N. — "Deterministic Mean Field Games on Networks: A Lagrangian Approach"（SIAM J. Math. Anal. 56(5), 2024；DOI 10.1137/23M1615073） ​本文​ §10.4 ​的​核心​引文​。​只​在​你​已经​熟悉​ §5.6 QVI ​与​变分​均衡​之后​再​读​——​这​是从​ finite-dimensional ​网络​均衡​跳​到​ infinite-dimensional MFG ​的​一道​坎​。​论文​把​ relaxed equilibrium ​定义​为​ admissible trajectories ​上​的​概率​测度​，​自动​处理​ walk-style ​重复​访问​，​是​ §3.9 walk-flow ​的​连续​时间​对应物​。​读法​建议​：​先读​ §1 ​引论​ + §2 motivating 1D ​例子​，​理论​部分​（§3–§5）​按​需​。​如果​此前​没读​过​ Cardaliaguet ​的​ Tor Vergata ​笔记​，​先读​那​份​笔记​的​前​两章​再​回来​。

docs.title: Lateral Connections（​跨域​接驳​）
docs.text:
🌉 Carlier, G., Jimenez, C., Santambrogio, F. — "Optimal Transportation with Traffic Congestion and Wardrop Equilibria"（SIAM J. Control Optim. 47(3): 1330–1350, 2008）+ Santambrogio, F. — Optimal Transport for Applied Mathematicians §4（Birkhäuser, 2015） ​本文​ §10.6 ​的​两个​支柱​。CJS 2008 ​是​连续​ Wardrop ​模型​的​奠基​；Santambrogio ​的​ 2015 ​教材​ §4 ​给出​最​现代​、​最​易读​的​展开​（​带​详细​图解​与​ \(\Gamma\)-​收敛​的​离散​到​连续​桥​）。​为什么​交通​工程师​值得​读​ OT ​文献​：​你​会​发现​"​流量​是​路径​上​的​概率​测度​"​这个​连续​ Wardrop ​视角​与​ §5.9 Recursive Logit ​在​数学​上​几乎​是​孪生​关系​——​两条​独立​流派​由​不同​社群​分别​建立​、​互不​引用​、​却​最终​汇向​同一​对象​。​这是​本文​未能​展开​但​ §10.6 ​明确​指​为​开放​问题​的​桥梁​。

🌉 Amos, B., Kolter, J. Z. — "OptNet: Differentiable Optimization as a Layer in Neural Networks"（ICML 2017）+ Agrawal, A., Amos, B., Barratt, S., Boyd, S., Diamond, S., Kolter, J. Z. — "Differentiable Convex Optimization Layers"（NeurIPS 2019） ​本文​ §10.5 ​的​方法论​入口​。​两篇​加​起来​ 30 ​页​，​配​ cvxpylayers ​的​ GitHub repo ​边读​边​跑​代码​。​核心​ takeaway：KKT ​条件​对​参数​的​隐​函数​微分​给出​"​优化​层​的​梯度​"，​这​把​ Beckmann NLP / VI ​解​作为​可​微操作​嵌进​端到​端​学习​管线​。​与​ TA ​的​接驳​：​当​你​想​把​ demand ​标定​、OD ​估计​、​参数​学习​与​ TAP ​求解​放进​一个​端到​端​ loss ​时​，​这是​数学​上​唯一​干净​的​工具​——​可以​视为​ §10.5"​工业​ TA ​软件​ VI/NCP/GNEP ​模块化​"​的​现代​实现​路径​。

🌉 Aussel, D., Sultana, A. — "Quasi-variational inequality formulations of generalized Nash equilibrium problems with shared constraints, and their solution methods"（Pure Appl. Funct. Anal., 2021 ​综述​）+ Kulkarni, A. A., Shanbhag, U. V. — "On the variational equilibrium as a refinement of the generalized Nash equilibrium"（Automatica 48(1): 45–55, 2012） ​电力​市场​ EPEC ​与​ TA-PDN GNEP ​的​数学​纽带​。​前​一篇​是​近年​的​ QVI/GNEP ​综述​，​对​本文​ §5.6–§5.8 ​是​直接​补充​；​后​一篇​用​最少​篇幅​讲清​"​为什么​变分​均衡​是​ GNEP ​解​集中​计算​上​唯一​可解​的​子集​"——​这​正是​本文​ §5.8、​原理​ 7 ​反复​使用​的​事实​背后​的​精确​陈述​。​读完​这​两篇​你​会​理解​：​电力​市场​的​ EPEC ​文献​（Hobbs, Pang, Ralph ​一​系​）​与​本文​ §5.8 PDN-TN ​文献​其实​在​求解​同​一类​对象​，​只是​行业​术语​不同​。

docs.title: 一句​话​路径​图
docs.text: ​如果​只能​按​一条线​读​：Patriksson 1994 §1–§5 → Smith 1979 + Dafermos 1980 → Roughgarden–Tardos 2002 → Li–Wang–Nie 2024（CumLog）→ Maréchal–de Grange 2024 → Achdou et al. 2024。​这条线​就是​本文​ §1 → §2 → §4 → §5 → §9 → §10 ​的​最小​可行​版本​。

docs.title: Traffic Assignment ​魔改​ — ​从​ Wardrop / Beckmann / VI ​到​ bilevel-EV-coupled / ML-augmented TA（2024–2026 ​视角​）
docs.text: ​版本​: v4 (math-first reframe of v3)。​写作​约束​: ​每​核心​模型​先列​ Model basis (state space / ​决策​变量​+​域​ / equilibrium-or-objective / ​约束​ / ​假设​清单​)；formal LaTeX ​先于​ plain-language gloss；​类比​ ≤1 per major concept ​且​置于​末尾​标​"​类比​仅供​直觉​"；​禁用​"​想象​一下​…"/"​就​像​…"/"​打个比方​…"/"​如果​你​曾经​…"​作​ entry。​本​ draft ​严格​依据​ Phase 0d synthesis ​的​ verified author registry (R01–R34) ​与​ forbidden list (F-1..F-5)。

docs.title: §S1 Introduction — v4 reframing ​与​三​战场​总览
docs.text:
Wardrop (1952, R01) ​在​ Proceedings of the Institution of Civil Engineers ​给出​的​双​公理​是​ Traffic Assignment Problem (TAP) ​的​形式​起点​。​这​两条​公理​分别​刻画​用户​视角​与​规划者​视角​下​的​"​均衡​"，​至今​仍​是​ TA ​数学​的​两个​基本​对照​锚​。

​第一​原则​ (User Equilibrium, UE)：​在​均衡​处​，​任一​ OD ​对​所有​被​使用​路径​的​实际​旅行​成本​相等​，​并​不​大于​未​使用​路径​的​成本​。​等价​地​，​没有​用户​能​通过​单边​换路​改善​自身​成本​——​这是​ Nash ​不动点​在​ nonatomic-game ​极限​下​的​具体​形式​。

​第二​原则​ (System Optimum, SO)：​总​系统​旅行​时间​最小​。​这是​社会​规划者​视角​下​的​全局​最优​。

UE ​与​ SO ​在​一般​ latency ​函数​下​不​重合​（Pigou ​反例​）；​两者​差距​由​ Price of Anarchy (PoA, Roughgarden 2002, R34) ​量化​。​本​综述​把​ UE ​视作​"​自利​路径​选择​的​不动点​"​基本​对象​，SO ​作为​对照​锚​；​两者​的​ PoA ​差​作为​后续​ §S6 bilevel toll ​与​ §S11 DLMP ​内​生化​机制​设计​的​ motivating gap。

​形式化​设定​。​记​路网​ \(G=(V,E)\)，​链路​集​ \(|E|=m\)，OD ​集​ \(\mathcal{W}\subseteq V\times V\)。​对​每个​ \((r,s)\in\mathcal{W}\) ​有​需求​ \(d_{rs}\geq 0\) ​与​路径​集​ \(\mathcal{P}_{rs}\)。

​令路​径流​ \(\mathbf{f}\in\mathbb{R}^{|\mathcal{P}|}_{\geq 0}\)，​链路​-​路径​关联​ \(\delta_{ap}\in\{0,1\}\)（​路径​ \(p\) ​是否​过​链路​ \(a\)）。​链路​流由路​径流​通过​ link-path ​可加性​ ​聚合​：

\[ x_a \;=\; \sum_{p\in\mathcal{P}} f_p\,\delta_{ap},\qquad \forall a\in E. \tag{1.1} \]

​链路​成本​函数​取​ BPR (Bureau of Public Roads) ​形式​：

\[ t_a(x_a) \;=\; t_a^0\Bigl(1+\alpha\bigl(x_a/c_a\bigr)^\beta\Bigr),\qquad \alpha=0.15,\;\beta=4, \tag{1.2} \]

​其中​ \(t_a^0\) ​为​自由​流​时间​，\(c_a\) ​为​容量​。

BPR ​在​ \(x_a\geq 0\) ​上​严格​单调​递增​（\(t_a'(x_a)=\alpha\beta\, t_a^0\, x_a^{\beta-1}/c_a^\beta\)），​但​因​ \(\beta=4>1\) ​有​ \(t_a'(0)=0\)，​故​ strict monotone ​而​ NOT strongly monotone。​这一​陷阱​将​贯穿​ §S3 / §S5 ​的​收敛​速率​分析​。

​前置​约定​ (​核心​缩写​一句​话​ gloss):

  • VI = variational inequality (​变分​不等式​)
  • GNEP = generalized Nash equilibrium problem (​玩家​可行​集互​依​的​ Nash)
  • MPCC = mathematical program with complementarity constraints (​含​互补​条件​的​ NLP); MPEC = MPCC ​的​更​广​形式​
  • PPAD = polynomial parity argument on directed graphs (Nash ​计算​复杂度​类​)
  • SOCP = second-order cone programming (​二阶​锥​规划​)
  • LICQ = linear independence constraint qualification (​约束​ gradient ​线性​独立​)
  • IFT = implicit function theorem (​隐​函数​定理​)
  • DLMP = distribution locational marginal price (​配电网​节点​电价​)

​这些​缩写​在​ §S3-§S11 ​各自​首次​定义​处​展开​；​本​前置​仅作​"​读时​不要​卡​在​缩写​"​的​安全网​。

v3 ​综述​以​"​链路​-​路径​可加性​的​崩溃​与​重建​"​为单​主线​。v4 ​不再​以单​主线​组织​，​而是​把​ TA ​数学​景观​划分​为​三大​战场​，​每个​战场​配​独立​的​ Model basis：

  • ​战场​ A (Thread A, ​经典​骨架​): Wardrop–Beckmann–VI–bilevel–GNEP ​的​形式​阶梯​ (§S3–§S6)。​代表性​发展​是​ Beckmann–McGuire–Winsten (1956, R02) ​的​凸​ NLP ​等价​、Smith (1979, R05) ​与​ Dafermos (1980, R06) ​的​变分​不等式​ (VI) ​推广​、Friesz et al. (1989+, R09) ​的​动态​ DUE-in-\(L^2\)、LeBlanc (1975, R04) ​与​ Brotcorne–Labbé–Marcotte–Savard (2001, R11) ​的​ bilevel toll MPEC、Facchinei–Kanzow (2007, R12) ​的​ GNEP、​以及​ Daskalakis–Goldberg–Papadimitriou (2009, R13, SIAM J. Comput.) ​给出​的​ Nash PPAD-​完备​下界​。​求解​端​ v4 ​把​现代​ monotone-VI / ​加速​ Frank–Wolfe (Mokhtari–Ozdaglar–Pattathil 2019/2020 R14；Cai–Oikonomou–Zheng 2022 R15；Ignashin–Yarmoshik 2024 R16；Ignashin–Yarmoshik–Raigorodskii 2025 R17 SOFW) ​显式​接入​ (§S5)。

  • ​战场​ B (Thread B, ML-augmented TA, v4 ​新​核心​): ​在​经典​ Frank–Wolfe (FW) ​迭代​图上​做​"​四​ slot ​替换​"——latency surrogate (Slot 1)、shortest-path RL (Slot 2)、step RL (Slot 3)、state oracle (Slot 4)——​由此​整理​ ML-​增强​ TA ​工作​ (§S7–§S10)。v4 ​中心​ critique: ​经验性​进步​与​三​ hypothesis (H1 monotone latency / H2 Nash\(\leftrightarrow\)Wardrop / H3 IFT for bilevel) ​之间​存在​系统性​脱节​，​所审​ 12 ​篇​ ML-aug TA ​工作​ (R21 Liu–Meidani 2024；R22 Li et al. 2024 OpenCity；R23 Wang–Duan–Lyu–Ma 2025 MSA-DQN；R24 Wang–Duan–Lyu–Wang–He–Zheng–Ma 2025 MARL-OD-DA；R25 Ameli–Le–Shams–Skabardonis 2025 transformer；R26 Wu–Seshadri–Rodrigues–Lima Azevedo 2025 DRL tolling；R27 Donatus–Ter–Udekwe 2025 MARL ITS survey；R33 Rahman–Hasan 2025 GNN metamodel；R32 Mei–Zhang–Jiang–Xue–Zhang–Gao 2025 PDN-TN MARL；R34 ​含​ Amos–Xu–Kolter 2017 ICNN ​与​ Amos–Kolter 2017 OptNet ​等​基础​) ​中无一​同时​正面​回应​ H1+H2+H3。

  • ​战场​ C (Thread C, EV-V2G-PDN bilevel): ​在​战场​ A ​的​ bilevel-MPCC ​与​ GNEP ​容器​上​挂出​ EV-routing-with-SoC、V2G ​双向​能量​、DLMP-as-toll ​内​生化​ (§S11)。​代表​工作​: He–Yin charging-station bilevel ​族​ (R29)、Wei–Wu–Wang–Mei 2018 IEEE TSG (R28)、Kempton–Tomić 2005/2007 (R30)、​以及​两篇​ 2025 Applied Energy (R31 Liu et al.；R32 Mei et al.)。v4 ​关键​修正​: ​把​ "bilevel + DLMP \(\equiv\) GNEP duality" ​从​ Phase 0b ​的​无条件​声明​改为​条件​命题​，​列出​ (C1) SOCP relaxation tight、(C2) lower-level UE ​唯一​、(C3) shared coupling constraint LICQ ​三​ hypothesis (FC-3)。​注​: §S11 Theorem 11.1 ​局部​使用​ (C1)/(C2)/(C3) ​与​ §S7 ​全局​ H1/H2/H3 (monotone latency / Nash↔Wardrop / IFT for bilevel) ​严格​区分​，​避免​命名​冲突​。
