​三​战场​通过​统一​的​ Model basis ​装置​ (​网络​ \(G\)、​可加​性式​ (1.1)、BPR (1.2)、Beckmann ​势​ \(\Phi\)、VI ​不等式​ \(\langle\mathbf{t}(\mathbf{x}^*),\mathbf{x}-\mathbf{x}^*\rangle\geq 0\)) ​与​三​ hypothesis H1/H2/H3 ​形成​接口​。§S12 ​的​开放​问题​以​这​一​接口​为​索引​。

v4 ​与​既往​ TA ​综述​的​差异​定位​: ​经典​ TA ​综述​ (Patriksson 1994 R10、Sheffi 1985 R08) ​以​"VI/NLP/​算法​"​为​组织​主线​；​近年​ ML-TA ​综述​偏向​"​案例​罗列​ + ​性能​对比​"。

​本​综述​ v4 ​的​差异​是​用​统一​ Model basis (state-space / decision-domain / equilibrium / constraints / assumption-list) ​作为​唯一​组织​准绳​——​任一​案例​ (​经典​或​ ML) ​必须​给出​五件套​，​否则​不予​入表​。​这一​组织​准则​把​ W4/W5/W11 ​的​"H1 ​裸奔​" / W8 ​的​"H2 ​经验​未证​" / W9 ​的​"H3 ​未​显标​"​三条​ critique ​暴露​为​ same kind of failure: ​假设​清单​残缺​。

​研究​图景​定位​ (2024–2026): ML-aug TA ​经验​进步​显著​但​理论​假设​链​全断​；EV-V2G-PDN ​系统​进入​工程​可​部署​但​ GNEP-bilevel ​等价​仍​是​无条件​ vs ​条件​命题​之争​；Transportation FM ​在​ forecasting ​上​有​ scaling-law ​经验​但​ TA-grounded benchmark ​完全​空缺​。

v4 ​把​这三条​ critique ​整合​为​"H1+H2+H3 ​同时​回应​"​的​合规​检查表​，​并​把​ ICNN-GNN ​复合​ + (OD × SoC × DLMP) hierarchical MARL + traffic-grid ​联合​ FM ​作为​三条​ concrete attack angle ​写入​ §S12。

v4 vs v3 ​升级​点​: v3 ​把​可加性​崩溃​作为​线性​叙事​单​主线​；v4 ​改为​三​战场​并列结构​，​把​ ML-aug TA ​升格​为​核心​战场​而​非​附录​，​并​把​ bilevel-GNEP ​等价​从​无条件​改为​条件​命题​。

​三​战场​之间​的​接口​设计​ (​统一​ Model basis + H1/H2/H3 ​三​ hypothesis) ​是​ v4 vs ​既往​综述​的​核心​差异​——​既往​综述​的​接口​往往​是​分类​轴​ (algorithm class / network type / objective function)，​本​综述​的​接口​是​ hypothesis check (​具体​哪条​假设​保留​ / ​失效​)。​这一​接口​让​"​哪些​工作​严谨​满足​经典​假设​链​ / ​哪些​裸奔​哪条​ hypothesis"​成为​可​机械​检查​的​属性​。

docs.title: §S2 Unified Notation Table
docs.text:
​本​节​锁定​全​ draft ​通用​符号​，​后续​章节​不再​局部​重​定义​ \(\mathbf{x}, \mathbf{f}, \Phi, \mathcal{K}\) ​与​ BPR ​参数​。

Symbol ​含义​ ​备注​ / ​警告​ \(G=(V,E)\), \(\lvert V\rvert=n\), \(\lvert E\rvert=m\) ​路网​图​ static; DTA / ​时变​在​ §S4 ​单独​声明​ \((r,s)\in\mathcal{W}\), \(d_{rs}\geq 0\) OD ​对​ + ​需求​ deterministic；stochastic ​见​ §S4 SUE \(\mathcal{P}_{rs}, \mathcal{P}=\bigcup_{rs}\mathcal{P}_{rs}\), \(\delta_{ap}\in\{0,1\}\) ​路径​集​ + ​链路​-​路径​关联​ simple path ​默认​；walk-flow (Graf–Harks–Palkar 2022, R19) ​把​ \(\delta_{ap}\) ​升为​非负​计数​ \(\mathbf{f}\in\mathbb{R}^{\lvert\mathcal{P}\rvert}_{\geq 0}\), \(f_p\geq 0\) ​路​径流​向量​ \(\mathbf{f}^*\) ​通常​非​唯一​ \(\mathbf{x}\in\mathbb{R}^m_{\geq 0}\), \(x_a=\sum_p f_p\delta_{ap}\) ​链路​流​；​可加​性式​ (1.1) \(\mathbf{x}^*\) ​在​ strict monotone \(\mathbf{t}\) ​下​唯一​ \(\mathcal{K}=\{\mathbf{f}\geq 0:\sum_{p\in\mathcal{P}_{rs}}f_p=d_{rs}\,\forall(r,s)\}\) ​路径​空间​可行​集​ ​紧凸​；\(\mathcal{X}=A\mathcal{K}\subset\mathbb{R}^m_{\geq 0}\) ​为​链路​空间​像​，​亦​紧凸​ \(t_a(x_a)=t_a^0(1+0.15(x_a/c_a)^4)\) BPR latency, ​式​ (1.2) strict monotone, \(t_a'(0)=0\Rightarrow\) NOT strongly monotone \(C_p(\mathbf{x})=\sum_a t_a(x_a)\delta_{ap}\) ​路径​成本​ (link-additive) EV / toll ​非可加​成本​需​扩展​节点​ \((v,b)\) ​恢复​可​加​ (§S11) \(\Phi(\mathbf{x})=\sum_a\int_0^{x_a}t_a(s)\,ds\) Beckmann ​势​ \(\Phi\) ​凸​ \(\Leftrightarrow\) \(t_a\) monotone non-decreasing；​严格凸​ \(\Leftrightarrow\) strict monotone \(\pi_{rs}\geq 0\) OD ​均衡​成本​ (KKT ​乘子​) UE ​下​ \(f_p>0\Rightarrow C_p=\pi_{rs}\) \(\text{VI: }\langle\mathbf{t}(\mathbf{x}^*),\mathbf{x}-\mathbf{x}^*\rangle\geq 0,\;\forall\mathbf{x}\in\mathcal{X}\) Smith 1979 VI form ​内积​取​ \(\mathbb{R}^m\) ​标准​；DUE ​升​为​ \(L^2([0,T])\) ​内积​ \(\theta>0\), \(f_p\propto\exp(-\theta C_p)\) Logit SUE ​温度​ \(\theta\to\infty\Rightarrow\) UE; Fisk (1980, R07) ​凸​熵​正则​等价​ \(b_p^{(t)}\in[\underline B,\bar B]\) EV ​路径​上​ SoC ​扩展​节点​ \((v,b)\) ​恢复​ link-additive (§S11) \(u_p^{(t)}=u^+-u^-,\,u^\pm\in[0,\bar u]\) V2G ​净​充放电​分段​；\(u^+\) ​充电​、\(u^-\) ​放电​ \(\eta_{\mathrm{ch}},\eta_{\mathrm{dis}}\in(0,1]\) ​双向​效率​；​放电​时​ SoC ​下降​ $ \(\lambda_v^{(t)}\) DLMP at PDN ​节点​ \(v\) SOCP / Dist-Flow dual；​与​ GNEP ​对偶​条件​一致​ (FC-3) \(\hat t_a(x_a;\phi)\), \(\mathcal{G}_\psi\) ML latency surrogate / state oracle H1: \(\partial\hat t_a/\partial x_a\geq 0\) ​必标​ \(\mathbf{h}_v^{(\ell)}, \mathbf{z}\in\mathbb{R}^D, \pi_\theta\) GNN ​节点​嵌入​ / FM encoder / RL policy ​按​ Slot ​归位​ \(\mathbf{y}\in\mathcal{Y}, \Psi\) bilevel ​上层​决策​ + ​上层​目标​ toll / charger placement / OD prior / network design

​公式​编号​取​全文​连续​ (1.1)…(12.x)，​不​每节​重置​。

​符号​选择​的​几个​关键点​:

  • \(\mathcal{K}\) ​与​ \(\mathcal{X}\) ​严格​区分​: \(\mathcal{K}\) ​是​路​径流​空间​可行​集​ (​单纯形​之​并​)，\(\mathcal{X}=A\mathcal{K}\) ​是​链路​流​空间​像​ (​路径​多面体​的​线性​映射​)。​两者​紧凸性​ (A5) ​通过​线性​映射​保持​。​优化​问题​的​解​唯一性​须​在​两个​空间​分别​陈述​: §S3 BPR strict-monotone ​给出​ \(\mathbf{x}^*\) ​唯一​但​ \(\mathbf{f}^*\) ​一般​非​唯一​ (Property 3.1)；§S4 SUE Fisk ​熵​正则​给出​ \(\mathbf{f}^*\) ​也​唯一​ (Theorem 4.1)。
  • BPR ​参数​ \(\alpha=0.15,\beta=4\) ​是​ US Bureau of Public Roads 1964 ​的​工程​默认​；​其他​工程​区域​用​其他​ \(\beta\) (e.g. Akcelik 1991 ​用​ \(\beta=2\))。​本​ draft ​默认​ \(\beta=4\)，Theorem 3.3 BPR strict-but-not-strongly-monotone ​陷阱​依赖​ \(\beta>1\) ​的​严格​不​等​。
  • DLMP ​内积​ \(\boldsymbol{\lambda}^\top g\) ​把​电力​市场​出清​写​为​ dual variable cost — ​这是​ §S11 (11.3) bilevel objective ​的​内​生化​关键​。Phase 0b T4 ​把​ "DLMP = ​网络​节点​上​的​局部​影子​价格​" ​作为​类比​已用​掉​一次​配额​；​本节​不​重复​。
  • \(\hat t_a, \mathcal{G}_\psi\) ​等​ ML ​符号​在​ §S7 ​详细​ model basis ​化​；​本节​仅​锁定​符号​ + H1 forward warning。

docs.title: §S3 Wardrop UE / SO + Beckmann NLP + VI form — ​经典​骨架
docs.text:
Model basis. - State space: ​链路​流​ \(\mathbf{x}\in\mathcal{X}\subset\mathbb{R}^m_{\geq 0}\) ​或路​径流​ \(\mathbf{f}\in\mathcal{K}\subset\mathbb{R}^{|\mathcal{P}|}_{\geq 0}\)。\(\mathcal{K}\) ​与​ \(\mathcal{X}=A\mathcal{K}\) ​紧凸​ (\(A\) ​为​路径​-​链路​关联矩阵​)。 - ​决策​变量​+​域​: \(\mathbf{f}\in\mathcal{K}\) (​路径​分配​)；​链路​像​ \(\mathbf{x}=A\mathbf{f}\in\mathcal{X}\)。 - Equilibrium ​或​ objective: Wardrop ​第一​原则​ (UE) ​等价​的​ Beckmann NLP

\[ \min_{\mathbf{f}\in\mathcal{K}} \Phi(A\mathbf{f}) \;=\; \sum_{a\in E}\int_0^{x_a} t_a(s)\,ds,\qquad x_a=\sum_p f_p\delta_{ap}. \tag{3.1} \]

​或​等价​的​ Smith VI: ​求​ \(\mathbf{x}^*\in\mathcal{X}\) ​使​

\[ \langle \mathbf{t}(\mathbf{x}^*),\,\mathbf{x}-\mathbf{x}^*\rangle \;\geq\; 0,\qquad \forall \mathbf{x}\in\mathcal{X}. \tag{3.2} \]
  • ​约束​: ​流​守恒​ \(\sum_{p\in\mathcal{P}_{rs}}f_p=d_{rs}\)、​非负​ \(f_p\geq 0\)。
  • ​假设​清单​ (A1–A5):
  • (A1) ​静态​；
  • (A2) ​需求​ deterministic；
  • (A3) latency link-separable: \(\mathbf{t}(\mathbf{x})=(t_1(x_1),\dots,t_m(x_m))\)；
  • (A4) Jacobian \(\nabla\mathbf{t}\) ​对称​ (link-separable ​自动​满足​)；
  • (A5) \(\mathcal{K}\) ​紧凸​。

docs.title: Definition 3.1 (Wardrop UE)
docs.text:
​路​径流​ \(\mathbf{f}^*\in\mathcal{K}\) ​满足​ UE iff ​对​所有​ \((r,s)\in\mathcal{W}\) ​与​所有​ \(p,p'\in\mathcal{P}_{rs}\),

\[ f_p^*>0 \;\Longrightarrow\; C_p(A\mathbf{f}^*) \;=\; \pi_{rs} \;\leq\; C_{p'}(A\mathbf{f}^*). \tag{3.3} \]

​即​被​使用​路径​成本​一致​并​不​大于​未​使用​路径​成本​。

(3.3) ​是​ KKT ​条件​ + ​互补​松弛​的​直接​表述​: ​引入​ OD ​均衡​乘子​ \(\pi_{rs}\) ​作为​流​守恒​约束​ \(\sum_{p\in\mathcal{P}_{rs}}f_p=d_{rs}\) ​的​乘子​，​则​ KKT ​给出​ \(C_p(\mathbf{x}^*)\geq\pi_{rs}\) + \(f_p^*(C_p(\mathbf{x}^*)-\pi_{rs})=0\)。​这​与​ (3.3) ​等价​。

Wardrop ​第一​原则​的​行为​解读​: ​每个​用户​都​最小化​自身​路径​成本​，​故​不​存在​单边​换路​改善​ — ​这是​ Nash equilibrium ​在​ nonatomic-game (​无穷​多用户​每个​用户​流量​ dx → 0) ​下​的​具体​形式​ (Wardrop 1952 R01 ​与​ Nash 1950 ​同​时期​独立​但​等价​的​不动点​构造​)。

docs.title: Theorem 3.1 (Beckmann ​凸性​，BMW 1956, R02)
docs.text:
​在​ (A1)–(A5) ​下​，​若​ \(t_a:\mathbb{R}_{\geq 0}\to\mathbb{R}_{>0}\) ​连续​单调​非​递减​，​则​ \(\Phi\) ​凸​ (​严格凸​ iff ​严格​单调​)，(3.1) ​之​ KKT ​与​ (3.3) ​等价​；​故​ UE ​链路​流​ \(\mathbf{x}^*\) ​存在​；​严格​单调​时​唯一​。

​证明​概要​ (Beckmann–McGuire–Winsten 1956 R02): ​链路​成本​ \(t_a\) ​连续​单调​非​递减​ ⇒ ​链路​-​级​ \(\int_0^{x_a}t_a(s)ds\) ​凸​；​和​取凸​ ⇒ \(\Phi\) ​凸​。\(\mathcal{X}=A\mathcal{K}\) ​紧凸​ (A ​线性​, \(\mathcal{K}\) ​紧凸​)。Weierstrass ⇒ minimizer ​存在​。KKT ​在​ (A5) + Slater (​流​守恒​可解​) ​下​成立​，​化为​ (3.3)。​严格​单调​ ⇒ \(\Phi\) ​严格凸​ ⇒ ​唯一​ minimizer。

​需注意​: ​严格​单调​只能​保证​链路​解​ \(\mathbf{x}^*\) ​唯一​，​路径​解​ \(\mathbf{f}^*\) ​一般​非​唯一​ — ​因为​ \(\mathbf{f}\mapsto A\mathbf{f}=\mathbf{x}\) ​是​线性​映射​，\(A\) ​通常​有​ nontrivial kernel (​路径​之间​可​"​虚位​换流​"​保持​链路​流​不变​)。​这是​ (3.1) NLP ​解集​结构​性质​ P0 (Property 3.1 forward)。

docs.title: Theorem 3.2 (Smith–Dafermos VI ​存在​与​唯一​，R05/R06)
docs.text: ​若​ \(\mathcal{X}\) ​紧凸​、\(\mathbf{t}\) ​连续​，​则​ VI (3.2) ​解​存在​ (Hartman–Stampacchia)；​若​ \(\mathbf{t}\) ​严格​单调​，​则​ VI ​解​唯一​。

docs.title: Theorem 3.3 (BPR ​严格​但​非强​单调​，FC-4)
docs.text:
​取​ (1.2) ​之​ BPR，\(\nabla\mathbf{t}(\mathbf{x})=\mathrm{diag}(t_a'(x_a))\), \(t_a'(x_a)=\alpha\beta t_a^0 x_a^{\beta-1}/c_a^\beta\)。​因​ \(\beta=4>1\) ​有​ \(t_a'(0)=0\)。

strict monotone ​论证​: ​每条​链路​ \(t_a:\mathbb{R}_{\geq 0}\to\mathbb{R}_{>0}\) ​在​ \([0,\infty)\) ​上​严格​递增​ (\(x_a<x_a'\Rightarrow t_a(x_a)<t_a(x_a')\)，​含​ \(x_a=0\) ​情形​)，link-separable Jacobian ​对角​ \(\Rightarrow\) \(\mathbf{t}\) strict monotone (pairing ​项​严格​ \(>0\))。​但​非​ strongly monotone: ​不​存在​ \(\mu>0\) ​使​ \(\langle\mathbf{t}(\mathbf{x})-\mathbf{t}(\mathbf{x}'),\mathbf{x}-\mathbf{x}'\rangle\geq\mu\|\mathbf{x}-\mathbf{x}'\|^2\) globally (​因​ \(t_a'(0)=0\))。

Caveat (β<1 ​与​ capacity-drop): ​若​ BPR-like \(\beta<1\) (​实际​工程​罕见​)，\(t_a'(0)\) ​发散​而​ strong monotone ​反向​失效​模式​ (​远离​零反弱​)；signal control / ramp metering / Daganzo 1994 capacity-drop fundamental diagram ​让​ \(t_a\) ​在​ capacity ​邻域​非​ monotone，Beckmann ​凸​ NLP ​失​，UE ​多解​，PoA bound ​失效​——​本​ draft ​默认​ BPR + ​无​ metering。

​后果​: Frank–Wolfe (FW) ​在​ BPR-Beckmann ​上​是​ \(O(1/k)\) sublinear (Theorem 5.1)，constrained EG/OGDA last-iterate ​退化​为​ \(O(1/\sqrt T)\) ​且​该​速率​ tight (Theorem 5.3)。

​形式​定义​对比​: ​严格​单调​ (strict monotone) ​要求​ \(\langle\mathbf{t}(\mathbf{x})-\mathbf{t}(\mathbf{x}'),\mathbf{x}-\mathbf{x}'\rangle>0\) for \(\mathbf{x}\neq\mathbf{x}'\)，​足以​保证​ VI ​唯一​解​；strongly monotone ​要求​ \(\langle\mathbf{t}(\mathbf{x})-\mathbf{t}(\mathbf{x}'),\mathbf{x}-\mathbf{x}'\rangle\geq\mu\|\mathbf{x}-\mathbf{x}'\|^2\) for \(\mu>0\)，​足以​保证​ linear convergence。​两者​差距​是​常数​ \(\mu\) ​是否​ bounded away from 0。

​具体​地​，BPR ​在​ \(\mathbf{x}_1=0,\mathbf{x}_2=\epsilon\mathbf{e}_a\) (\(\mathbf{e}_a\) ​单位向量​) ​处有​ \(\langle\mathbf{t}(\mathbf{x}_2)-\mathbf{t}(\mathbf{x}_1),\mathbf{x}_2-\mathbf{x}_1\rangle = \epsilon\cdot\alpha t_a^0\epsilon^\beta/c_a^\beta = O(\epsilon^{\beta+1})\) ​而​ \(\|\mathbf{x}_2-\mathbf{x}_1\|^2=\epsilon^2\)，​故​任意​ \(\mu>0\) ​在​ \(\epsilon\to 0\) ​下​被​推翻​ — strongly monotone ​系统性​失效​。​这一​陷阱​不​依赖​具体​网络拓扑​，​是​ BPR ​参数​ \(\beta=4\) ​的​内​禀​代数​性质​。

v3 ​在​此​踩​坑​: v3 ​把​ EG/OGDA ​引入​时​引用​了​ strongly-monotone ​下​ \(O(1/T)\) averaged ​收敛​但​未​识别​ BPR ​不​满足​该​假设​；v4 ​显式​以​ Theorem 5.3 tight \(O(1/\sqrt T)\) last-iterate ​替代​。

​直觉​ (​类比​仅供​直觉​，​本章​已​用​): BPR ​在​零流处​导数​为​零像​"​软​支撑​墙​"——​离墙​远时​几乎​不​阻挡​你​，​靠近​容量​时​硬度​急剧​上升​。​这一软​-​硬​非对称​把​ strong monotone ​假设​在​零流​邻域​逐点​击破​，​是​数值​速率​退化​的​根源​。

docs.title: Definition 3.2 (Wardrop SO)
docs.text:
SO ​流​ \(\mathbf{x}^{\mathrm{SO}}\in\mathcal{X}\) ​极小​化​总​系统​时间​

\[ \min_{\mathbf{f}\in\mathcal{K}}\;\;\Psi^{\mathrm{SO}}(\mathbf{x}) \;=\; \sum_a x_a t_a(x_a). \tag{3.4} \]

SO ​的​ KKT ​写成​ "marginal cost" \(t_a(x_a)+x_a t_a'(x_a)\) ​形式​，​与​ UE ​仅​相差​一阶项​。

docs.title: Theorem 3.4 (Roughgarden 2002/2003 PoA bound, R34)
docs.text:
​对​ link-separable latency \(t_a\) ​属于​ polynomial-of-degree-\(d\) ​类​ (nonatomic selfish routing)，\(\mathrm{PoA} := \Psi^{\mathrm{SO}}(\mathbf{x}^{\mathrm{UE}})/\Psi^{\mathrm{SO}}(\mathbf{x}^{\mathrm{SO}})\leq\rho(d)\)；\(d=4\) ​子族​给出​ \(\rho(4)\approx 2.151\)。BPR (\(\alpha=0.15,\beta=4\)) ​是​ degree-4 polynomial ​子族​特例​；​该​ bound ​对​一般​ degree-4 ​多项式​ latency ​类​成立​，​非​ BPR-specific。

UE ​与​ SO ​的​差距​是​ v4 Thread C ​的​核心​驱动​: ​政策​与​物理​工具​ (toll、DLMP、network design) ​通过​ §S6 ​上层​决策​变量​ \(\mathbf{y}\) ​收窄​ UE ​与​ SO ​的​ gap，​给定​ PoA ​上​界​ \(\rho(d)\) ​标出​最大​可压缩​空间​。

​经典​ Pigou ​反例​给出​最​简单​ UE \(\neq\) SO ​实例​: ​两​并行​链路​，​需求​ \(d=1\)，​链路​ 1 latency \(t_1(x)=1\)，​链路​ 2 latency \(t_2(x)=x\)；UE ​全部​走​链路​ 2 (​成本​ 1)，SO ​各走​一半​ (​总成本​ \(0.5\cdot 0.5+0.5\cdot 1=0.75\) vs UE \(1.0\))，PoA \(=4/3\)。BPR (\(d=4\)) ​把​这​一​比值​放大​到​ \(\approx 2.151\) ​是​ polynomial latency ​的​极限​。​这一​ bound ​给​ §S11 EV-V2G ​通过​ DLMP ​内​生化​ SO-coordination ​的​总​收益​设​了​理论​天花板​。

docs.title: Property 3.1 (P0: ​路径​解非​唯一​ vs ​链路​解​唯一​)
docs.text: \(\mathbf{f}^*\) ​在​ (3.1) ​凸​ NLP ​下​一般​非​唯一​ — Beckmann ​势​ \(\Phi\) ​严格凸​是​关于​ \(\mathbf{x}\) ​而​非​ \(\mathbf{f}\) (​因​ \(A\) ​有​ nontrivial kernel)。​这是​ §S4 SUE ​通过​ Fisk ​熵​正则​获取​路径​解​唯一性​的​根本​动机​；​亦​是​ §S8 W11 ​用​ softmax-over-paths ​硬​守恒​ head ​的​合法性​依据​ — ​该​ head ​隐式​选择​了​路径​熵​正则​ (\(\theta\to\infty\) ​极限​的​具体​实现​)。

docs.title: §S3.1 ​经典​假设​阶梯​ (A1–A5) ​的​工程​含义
docs.text:
(A1) ​静态​需求​: ​现实​中​ OD ​需求​是​时变​ (early peak, late peak, off-peak)；​静态​ TAP ​假设​单​时间​窗内​ demand ​稳定​。​撤​ (A1) ​给出​ DUE (§S4)。 (A2) deterministic ​需求​: ​现实​中​ OD ​需求​有​ measurement noise + behavioral ​不确定性​；​撤​ (A2) ​给出​ SUE (§S4)。 (A3) link-separable latency: ​现实​中​链路​成本​可能​依赖​邻居​链路​ (​信号​控制​、bus-car ​互扰​)；​撤​ (A3) ​给出​ multi-class / non-separable VI。 (A4) Jacobian ​对称​: link-separable ​自动​保证​；non-separable ​时​一般​ asymmetric；​撤​ (A4) ​给出​ asym VI (§S4.3)。 (A5) \(\mathcal{K}\) ​紧凸​: ​紧​ (​有​界​ + ​闭​) + ​凸是​流​守恒​ + ​非负​的​自然​结果​；​除非​ binary ​路径​约束​ (e.g. EV charger placement R29)。

​五条​假设​独立​ vs ​不​独立​: (A3) ​蕴含​ (A4)；(A2) ​与​ (A1) ​独立​；(A5) ​与​其他​正交​。​本​ §S3-§S4 ​阶梯​化​按​ (A2) → (A1) → (A3+A4) ​依次​撤销​，​对应​ SUE → DUE → asym VI。​每​一步​撤销​都​改变​求解​器​选择​ + ​唯一性​结果​，​构成​ §S3-§S4 ​章节​的​逻辑​骨架​。

docs.title: §S3.2 ​经济学​锚​ — Wardrop UE / SO / PoA ​在​ Walras–Pigou–Vickrey–Weitzman ​链上​的​位置
docs.text:
Wardrop UE / SO / PoA / toll bilevel ​不是​ transportation-specific ​概念​，​而是​经典​经济学​百年​文献​在​网络​-​流量​设置​下​的​具体​形态​。​本​节​给出​ cross-domain anchor，​避免​读者​把​ v4 thesis (DLMP ​内​生化​、ICNN-GNN ​复合​、bilevel-GNEP ​条件​等价​) ​与​经济学​独立​成熟​领域​脱钩​。

(a) Walras 1874 (Éléments d'économie politique pure) ↔ Wardrop UE (3.3)。Walrasian competitive equilibrium ​要求​每​消费者​最大化​效用​、​每​生产者​最大化​利润​、​所有​市场​出​清​；​类比​到​网络​: ​每​路径​用户​最小化​自身​成本​ (= ​消费者​效用​最大化​的​对偶​)、​每​链路​ latency ​由​ BPR ​自动​给出​ (= ​生产者​成本​曲线​)、​流​守恒​ \(\sum_p f_p=d_{rs}\) ​即​ OD-pair market clearing。

Wardrop UE ​的​ Nash ​解读​ (Definition 3.1 ​之后​) ​与​ Walrasian fixed-point ​解读​ (​链路​ = good、latency = price、demand = consumer demand) ​在​数学​结构​上​等价​。

(b) Pigou 1920 (The Economics of Welfare) ↔ Roughgarden PoA (Theorem 3.4)。Pigou ​第一个​识别​ decentralized ​市场​ (= Wardrop UE) ​与​ social planner ​解​ (= Wardrop SO) ​之间​的​ inefficiency ​来自​外部性​ (externality)：​用户​选路​时​不​内化​"​自己​增加​流量​推高​其他​用户​ latency"​的​边际​成本​。

Roughgarden PoA bound \(\rho(d)\) ​是​ Pigou inefficiency ​在​ polynomial-degree-\(d\) latency ​类下​的​具体​量化​；BPR (\(d=4\)) ​给​ \(\rho(4)\approx 2.151\) ​是​最大​可能​的​"​无​ toll ​下​的​市场​低效率​"。

Pigovian tax（= marginal externality cost）​在​ link level ​写为​

\[ \tau_a^{\mathrm{Pig}} \;=\; x_a^{\mathrm{SO}}\,t_a'(x_a^{\mathrm{SO}}), \tag{3.5} \]

​在​ UE ​下加​ (3.5) toll ​后​用户​成本​变为​ \(t_a(x_a)+\tau_a^{\mathrm{Pig}}\)，KKT ​与​ SO marginal-cost optimality ​对齐​，UE → SO，PoA → 1。​这是​ §S6 toll bilevel ​的​经济学​最优​形式​。

(c) Vickrey 1969 (AER "Congestion Theory and Transport Investment") ↔ §S6 toll bilevel + §S11 DLMP ​内生​。Vickrey ​是​ congestion pricing ​第一篇​正式​ paper，​将​ Pigovian tax ​在​交通​设置​下​具体化​为​ time-dependent toll: ​在​峰值​时段​ toll ​高​、​非​峰值​低​，​使​时变​ OD demand ​在​ toll ​调节​下​达到​ time-dependent SO。Vickrey 1969 ​与​ §S6 LeBlanc 1975 R04 / Brotcorne et al. 2001 R11 ​之间​的​关系​是​: Vickrey ​给出​概念​基础​ + ​单链​路​ marginal-cost pricing ​形式​，LeBlanc ​系列​给出​网络​ bilevel ​算法​实现​。

​与​ §S11 DLMP ​的​接口​: §S11 (11.2) ​的​ \(\sum_{v\in p}\lambda_v^{(t)}u_p^{(t),v}\) ​项​把​ DLMP ​作为​ V2G ​充放电​的​时空​-​差异化​ toll — ​这​正是​ Vickrey time-dependent toll ​在​ EV-V2G ​设置​下​的​内​生化​推广​ (toll ​从​政府​外​生​决定​升级​为​ PDN OPF ​出​清​自动​确定​)。

(d) Weitzman 1974 (Review of Economic Studies "Prices vs. Quantities") ↔ §S11 chance constraint + Wasserstein DRO。Weitzman ​给出​在​ supply / demand ​不确定性​下​，​社会​规划者​用​ price instrument (Pigovian tax) vs quantity instrument (​排放​配额​) ​哪个​更优​的​判别​准则​：​取决于​ marginal cost vs marginal benefit ​曲线​的​相对​ slope。

​与​ §S11 SoC chance constraint (Property 11.1) ​的​接口​: ​在​ EV ​能耗​随机​ + DLMP ​内生​设置​下​，price instrument = DLMP ​自动​出​清​，quantity instrument = V2G ​容量​配额​; Weitzman 1974 ​准则​告诉​我们​: ​当​ PDN ​短期​容量​曲线​陡​ (marginal cost ​高度​敏感​) ​时​ quantity ​优于​ price，​反之​ price ​优于​ quantity — ​这是​ OP4 (chance constraint + Wasserstein DRO) ​在​经济学​层面​的​对应​判别​问题​。

Weitzman 1974 ​在​ emissions / pollution regulation ​文献​中是​ stochastic Pigovian tax ​的​奠基性​ paper；TA-DLMP ​设置​下​文献​完全​空缺​，​是​ cross-domain ​转借​的​ attack angle。

​经济学​链​卡片​:

​经济学​经典​ ​年份​ ​对应​ TA ​概念​ v4 ​章节​锚​ Walras competitive equilibrium 1874 Wardrop UE (3.3) §S3 Definition 3.1 Pigovian tax = marginal externality 1920 toll bilevel + PoA bound §S3 Theorem 3.4 + (3.5) Vickrey congestion pricing 1969 time-dependent toll + DLMP §S6 Definition 6.1 + §S11 (11.2) Weitzman price-vs-quantity under uncertainty 1974 DLMP vs V2G capacity quota under stochastic SoC §S11 P9 + §S12 OP4

​四条​ anchor ​不​要求​ draft ​引​经济学​ venue (​本​ draft ​引用​范围​严格​ R01..R34, ​经济学​经典作​"​经典​文献​" ​通用​引用​)，​但​ cross-domain ​解读​使​ §S11 DLMP ​内​生化​的​经济学​合法性​变得​明显​: Pigovian tax ​在​百年​文献​中​被​证​可压缩​ PoA gap ​到​ 1.0，DLMP ​是​ Pigovian tax ​在​网络化​-​内​生化​-​不确定性​ ​三重​推广​下​的​具体​实现​。

v4 vs v3 ​升级​点​: v3 ​同样​列​了​ BPR ​严格​-​非强​单调​陷阱​但​散落​于​求解​器章​；v4 ​把​它​前移​到​ §S3 ​与​ Beckmann ​凸性​、VI ​唯一性​紧邻​陈述​，​作为​后续​所有​速率​结论​的​逻辑​前提​。Phase 4 panel ​在​ §S3.2 ​补​ Walras–Pigou–Vickrey–Weitzman ​经济学​链​，​把​ DLMP / toll bilevel / PoA bound ​与​百年​ congestion-pricing ​文献​接驳​ (deep-diver P1-5/P1-6/P1-8)。

docs.title: §S4 SUE / DTA / asymmetric VI — ​假设​松弛​阶梯
docs.text: ​本节​按​假设​松弛​顺序​阶梯​化​：​撤​ (A2) ​得​ SUE；​撤​ (A1) ​得​ DUE；​撤​ (A4) ​得​ asymmetric VI。​每​一步​都​给出​ Model basis ​的​差异化​锁定​。

docs.title: §S4.1 SUE (Daganzo–Sheffi 1977 probit, R03；Fisk 1980 Logit ​凸​熵​, R07)
docs.text:
Model basis (SUE). - State space: ​路​径流​ \(\mathbf{f}\in\mathcal{K}\) ​同​ §S3；​链路​像​ \(\mathbf{x}=A\mathbf{f}\in\mathcal{X}\)。 - ​决策​变量​+​域​: \(\mathbf{f}\in\mathcal{K}\) (​但​带​感知​误差​)。 - Equilibrium: ​行为​模型​给出​选择​概率​ \(\Pr(p\mid r,s,\mathbf{x})\)；SUE ​是​ \(\mathbf{f}\) ​与​ \(\Pr\) ​的​固定点​

\[ f_p \;=\; d_{rs}\,\Pr(p\mid r,s,\mathbf{x}),\quad x_a=\sum_p f_p\delta_{ap},\quad\forall(r,s),p\in\mathcal{P}_{rs}. \tag{4.1} \]
  • ​约束​: ​同​ §S3 (A5)。
  • ​假设​清单​: (A1)(A3)(A4)(A5) ​保留​；​撤​ (A2)，​引入​感知​误差​ \(\varepsilon_p\)。

docs.title: Definition 4.1 (Logit SUE)
docs.text:
​若​ \(\varepsilon_p\) iid Gumbel(\(0,1/\theta\))，​则​ \(\Pr(p\mid r,s,\mathbf{x}) = \exp(-\theta C_p(\mathbf{x}))/\sum_{p'\in\mathcal{P}_{rs}}\exp(-\theta C_{p'}(\mathbf{x}))\)。

Logit ​形式​来源于​ random utility maximization (RUM) + Gumbel ​误差​: ​每​用户​感知​成本​ \(\tilde C_p=C_p+\varepsilon_p\)，​最大​效用​选择​即​最小化​ \(\tilde C_p\)，Gumbel iid ​给出​ closed-form Logit ​概率​。Probit ​形式​ (Daganzo–Sheffi 1977 R03) ​把​ \(\varepsilon_p\) iid Normal ​但​失去​ closed-form ​概率​，​要求​多维​ Normal CDF ​数值积分​ — ​计算​上贵于​ Logit。Logit ​的​工程​默认​在​ SUE ​设置​下​源于​ closed-form ​而​非​ Logit ​模型​在​行为学​上​更​真实​。

docs.title: Theorem 4.1 (Fisk 1980 ​凸​熵​正则​等价​，R07)
docs.text:
Logit SUE ​等价​于​

\[ \min_{\mathbf{f}\in\mathcal{K}} \;\; \Phi(A\mathbf{f}) + \frac{1}{\theta}\sum_{(r,s)}\sum_{p\in\mathcal{P}_{rs}} f_p\bigl(\ln f_p - 1\bigr). \tag{4.2} \]

​熵​项​关于​ \(\mathbf{f}\) ​严格凸​，​故路​径流​ \(\mathbf{f}^*\) ​唯一​；​这是​ SUE ​区别​于​ deterministic UE ​的​关键​ (UE ​仅​链路​解​ \(\mathbf{x}^*\) ​唯一​)。\(\theta\to\infty\) ​退化​为​ UE。

Fisk 1980 (R07) ​的​证明​思路​是​把​ Logit ​选择​概率​ \(\Pr(p\mid r,s,\mathbf{x})=\exp(-\theta C_p)/Z_{rs}\) ​看作​熵​正则​化​ minimum cost flow ​的​ dual — ​路径​选择​概率​的​熵​ \(-\sum_p (f_p/d_{rs})\ln(f_p/d_{rs})\) ​在​ (4.2) ​中以​缩放​形式​ \((1/\theta)\sum_p f_p\ln f_p\) ​出现​。​当​ \(\theta\to 0\) ​熵​项​主导​，​所有​路径​等​概率​选择​ (max-entropy)；\(\theta\to\infty\) ​熵​项​消失​，​唯一​概率​集中​在​最​短路​ (degenerate)。

​路径​解​唯一性​的​工程​含义​: SUE ​设置​下​ OD-level demand split ​可​被​精确​恢复​，​对​ transit ridership ​估计​、OD matrix calibration ​等​任务​关键​；deterministic UE ​不能​。

v4 vs v3: v3 ​把​ SUE ​路径​解​唯一性​藏​在​脚注​；v4 ​把​它​显式​标在​ (4.2) ​旁​，​因为​路径​解​唯一​在​ §S8 ​与​ §S11 ​中是​ hard conservation head ​设计​的​关键​依据​。

docs.title: §S4.2 DUE (Friesz et al. 1989+ R09 / DVI ​系列​)
docs.text: Model basis (DUE). - State space: ​时空​链路​流​ \(\mathbf{x}(\cdot)\in L^2([0,T];\mathbb{R}^m_{\geq 0})\)。 - ​决策​变量​+​域​: ​时变​路径​出发​率​ \(\mathbf{f}(\cdot)\in\mathcal{K}_T\subset L^2([0,T];\mathbb{R}^{|\mathcal{P}|}_{\geq 0})\)。 - Equilibrium: ​动态​ Wardrop ​条件​，​配合​ dynamic network loading (DNL) ​算子​ \(\mathcal{T}:\mathbf{f}\mapsto\mathbf{x}\) ​与​时间​-​依赖​ latency \(\mathcal{T}_a(\mathbf{x})(t)\)。 - ​约束​: ​时​变流​守恒​ \(\sum_p f_p(t)=d_{rs}(t)\)、​非负​、FIFO (​依​ DNL ​模型​)。 - ​假设​清单​: ​撤​ (A1)；​保​ (A2)(A3)(A5)；(A4) ​视​ DNL ​而定​ (LWR/Daganzo CTM ​一般​ asym)。

docs.title: Definition 4.2 (Friesz DUE-VI, R09)
docs.text:
​求​ \(\mathbf{f}^*\in\mathcal{K}_T\) ​使​

\[ \int_0^T \langle \boldsymbol{\Psi}_T(\mathbf{f}^*)(t),\,\mathbf{f}(t)-\mathbf{f}^*(t)\rangle\,dt \;\geq\; 0,\quad\forall\mathbf{f}\in\mathcal{K}_T, \tag{4.3} \]

​其中​ \(\boldsymbol{\Psi}_T\) ​是​路径​成本​算子​ (​含​ schedule penalty + DNL ​延迟​)。​内积​升​为​ \(L^2\) ​内积​，​紧凸性​靠​ \(\mathcal{K}_T\) ​弱紧​ (​有​界​ + ​凸​ + ​弱闭​)。

DUE-VI (4.3) ​与​静态​ VI (3.2) ​的​三个​本质​差异​:

(i) ​决策​变量​从​有限​维​ \(\mathbb{R}^{|\mathcal{P}|}\) ​升​到​无限​维​ \(L^2([0,T];\mathbb{R}^{|\mathcal{P}|}_{\geq 0})\)，​紧性​论证​从​有界​闭凸​ (Heine–Borel) ​升​到​ weak-compactness (​有界​凸​ + ​弱闭​)；

(ii) ​路径​成本​算子​ \(\boldsymbol{\Psi}_T\) ​含​ DNL (LWR/Daganzo CTM ​等​)，​一般​非可加​ + ​非对称​，​故​ (A4) ​默认​失效​，Beckmann ​势​在​动态​设置​下​不​存在​；

(iii) VI ​空间​: (4.3) ​内积​在​路​径流​ \(\mathbf{f}\) ​空间​ (\(L^2([0,T];\mathbb{R}^{|\mathcal{P}|}_{\geq 0})\))，​而​ (3.2) ​在​链路​流​ \(\mathbf{x}\) ​空间​ (\(\mathbb{R}^m\))；​两者​非​等价​ (​路​径流​非​唯一​)，​需​通过​ DNL ​算子​ \(\mathcal{T}:\mathbf{f}\mapsto\mathbf{x}\) + path cost = link cost ​沿​动态​ trajectory ​积分​ + schedule penalty ​把​链路​ latency lift ​至​ \(\boldsymbol{\Psi}_T\) on \(\mathbf{f}\)。

​结果​: DUE ​必须​直接​在​ VI (4.3) ​上​求解​，typical ​算法​是​ time-stepping projection + nested simulation-based DNL。

docs.title: Theorem 4.2 (Friesz DUE-VI ​存在​性​, R09)
docs.text: ​在​ (4.3) ​之​ Hilbert ​空间​设置​下​，​若​ \(\boldsymbol{\Psi}_T\) ​在​ \(L^2\) ​范数​下​半​连续​ + ​单调​，​则​ (4.3) ​有解​；​唯一性​条件​比​静态​严格​ (​要求​ \(\boldsymbol{\Psi}_T\) ​严格​ \(L^2\)-​单调​)。

docs.title: §S4.3 Asymmetric VI (Smith 1979 R05 / Dafermos 1980 R06)
docs.text:
Model basis (asymmetric VI). - State space: ​同​ §S3，​但​撤​ (A4): \(\nabla\mathbf{t}\) ​不​对称​ (​例如​ multi-class、bus-car ​互扰​、​信号​交叉口​耦合​)。 - ​决策​变量​+​域​: ​同​ §S3。 - Equilibrium: VI (3.2) ​仍​写​得通​，​但​等价​ NLP ​消失​ (​无​势函数​)；​只能​直接​处理​ (3.2)。 - ​约束​: ​同​ §S3。 - ​假设​清单​: ​撤​ (A4)；​保​ (A1)(A2)(A3)(A5)。

asymmetric VI ​是​ EV-V2G-DLMP ​设置​ (§S11) ​在​ simplified ​形式​下​的​天然​降阶​模型​: EV ​之间​通过​ SoC ​限制​ + DLMP ​价格​信号​互相​耦合​，​链路​-​级​ latency \(\mathbf{t}\) ​不仅​依赖​单一​链路​流量​还​依赖​电力​价格​ \(\boldsymbol{\lambda}\) — ​这​破坏​ link-separable ​与​ Jacobian ​对称​两条​假设​ (A3 + A4)。​撤​ (A3) link-separable ​给出​ non-separable VI (e.g. bus-car ​互扰​)，​撤​ (A4) ​给出​ asymmetric VI；​两者​在​某些​设置​下​重合​ (signal-controlled intersection ​让​链路​成本​依赖​入流​方向​矩阵​)。

​势函数​消失​的​工程​后果​: ​不能​用​ Beckmann (3.1) NLP ​求解​，​必须​直接​处理​ VI (3.2)，​求解​器​从​ FW (5.1) ​切换​到​ EG/OGDA (5.2)–(5.3) — ​这是​ §S5 EG/OGDA last-iterate \(O(1/\sqrt T)\) tight ​速率​ (Theorem 5.3) ​在​ asymmetric ​设置​下​尤其​重要​的​原因​。

docs.title: Theorem 4.3 (Dafermos 1980 ​唯一性​, R06)
docs.text:
​若​ \(\mathbf{t}\) ​严格​单调​ (​定义​ \(\langle\mathbf{t}(\mathbf{x})-\mathbf{t}(\mathbf{x}'),\mathbf{x}-\mathbf{x}' angle>0\) for \(\mathbf{x} eq\mathbf{x}'\)；​对​ \(C^1\) ​等价​于​对称​化​ Jacobian \( abla\mathbf{t}+ abla\mathbf{t}^ op\succ 0\), Facchinei–Pang Vol. I §2.3)，VI (3.2) ​解​唯一​；​势函数​不​存在​，​故​ Beckmann ​凸​ NLP ​等价​丢失​，​求解​必须​直接​ VI ​路径​ (EG/OGDA/projection)。

(​注​: Theorem 3.2 ​与​ Theorem 4.3 ​的​"strict monotone"​在​内积​定义​下​等价​；​其​代数​刻画​ \( abla\mathbf{t}+ abla\mathbf{t}^ op\succ 0\) ​是​ \(C^1\) ​函数​的​标准​ positive-definite ​表述​。symmetric Jacobian (§S3 link-separable) ​下​ \( abla\mathbf{t}\succ 0\) ​与​对称​化​形式​重合​；asymmetric (§S4.3) ​必须​取​对称​化​形式​。​两者​非​"​不同​强度​条件​"。)

docs.title: §S4.4 ​阶梯​化​的​ ML attack-angle ​索引
docs.text:
§S7 ML-aug TA ​的​ critique ​可​定位​到​具体​撤销​了​哪条​经典​假设​: - W4/W5 (GNN UE oracle): ​默认​保持​ (A1)-(A5)，​但​ ML latency ​隐式​破坏​ (A4) (link ​之间​通过​ GNN message-passing ​隐式​耦合​)；​同时​ H1 ​未​ enforce ​破坏​ (A3)+(A4) ​之上​的​ latency monotone。 - W11 (Transformer path-flow oracle): ​保​ (A1)-(A2) deterministic；hard conservation head ​实际​是​ (A2)​的​ SUE Logit ​极限​ (\(\theta\to\infty\), Theorem 4.1)。 - W8 (MARL OD-router): ​保​ (A1)-(A5) on latency；MARL agent ​决策​本身​引入​ (A2) ​类​ stochastic policy；H2 ​在​ Markov ​稳态​下​与​ Wardrop UE ​对应​。 - W7' (Liu 2025 EV-V2G LP-DTA): ​撤​ (A1) → DTA；​撤​ (A3)+(A4) → non-additive EV cost (11.2)；​保​ (A2) deterministic SoC + ​双向​ V2G。 - W10' (Mei 2025 PDN-TN MARL): ​撤​ (A1)+(A2)+(A3)+(A4) ​全部​，​仅保​ (A5) on EV agent action simplex；H1/H2/H3 ​全​暴露​。

​这一​索引​让​"​哪条​经典​假设​被​ ML ​工作​破坏​ / ​替代​"​成为​可​机械​检查​的​属性​，​是​ v4 vs v3 ​在​阶梯​化​方面​的​具体​应用​。

v4 vs v3 ​升级​点​: v3 ​把​ SUE-DTA-asym VI ​散​在​不同​章节​；v4 ​强制​把​它们​排成​"​撤​ (A2)→ ​撤​ (A1)→ ​撤​ (A4)"​阶梯​并​在​每步​重列​ Model basis；​这是​ §S7 ML-aug TA ​要​ attack ​哪条​假设​链时​的​索引​表​。

docs.title: §S5 Modern monotone-VI solvers + Frank–Wolfe ​现代​变体
docs.text: Model basis (​求解​端​). - ​继承​ §S3 (A1–A5) ​默认​；​要求​ \(\mathbf{t}\) ​在​ \(\mathcal{X}\) ​上​ \(L\)-Lipschitz (BPR ​在​有界​ \(\mathbf{x}\) ​上​满足​，\(L\leq\sup_a 4\alpha t_a^0 (\bar x_a/c_a)^3/c_a\))。 - ​目标​: ​计算​ (3.2) ​之​ \(\mathbf{x}^*\) ​或​ (3.1) ​之​ \(\mathbf{f}^*\)，​给​收敛​速率​ (sublinear/linear) ​与​ last-iterate vs averaged ​区分​。

docs.title: Definition 5.1 (Frank–Wolfe, FW)
docs.text:
​迭代​: \(k=0,1,\dots\)

\[ \mathbf{y}_k \in \arg\min_{\mathbf{y}\in\mathcal{X}} \langle\mathbf{t}(\mathbf{x}_k),\mathbf{y}\rangle,\qquad \mathbf{x}_{k+1} = (1-\gamma_k)\mathbf{x}_k + \gamma_k\mathbf{y}_k, \quad \gamma_k=2/(k+2). \tag{5.1} \]

​方向​子​问题​分解​为​ \(|\mathcal{W}|\) ​个​最​短路​ (\(\mathcal{X}\) ​是​路径​多面体​).

FW ​之所以​是​ TAP ​的​工程​默认​源于​三个​性质​:

(i) ​子​问题​ (5.1) ​因​ \(\mathcal{X}\) ​是​路径​多面体​而​退化​为​最​短路​ problem，​对​每​ OD ​用​ Dijkstra/A* ​求解​ \(O(|E|+|V|\log|V|)\)； (ii) ​每步​迭代​不需​投影​ \(P_{\mathcal{X}}\)，​仅​做​线性插值​ — ​这​与​ EG/OGDA ​的​投影​瓶颈​形成​鲜明对比​ (§S5.1 ​详述​)； (iii) \(\gamma_k=2/(k+2)\) ​步长​不​依赖​ Lipschitz ​常数​ \(L\)，​工程​上​不​需​ hyper-parameter tuning。

FW ​在​ TAP ​上​的​应用​是​ 1970s ​经典​工程​里程碑​；Patriksson 1994 R10、Sheffi 1985 R08 ​等​多本​专著​均​把​ FW ​作为​ TAP ​求解​的​ reference ​算法​。

MSA (Method of Successive Averages) ​是​ FW ​的​ stochastic ​变体​: ​当下​层​ \(\mathbf{t}\) ​由​ stochastic simulation ​或​ GNN approximator (Slot 1) ​给出​时​，MSA ​用​ \(\gamma_k=1/(k+1)\) ​自​适应​步长​替代​ (5.1)；​该​步长​比​经典​ FW ​衰减​更慢​但​对​ stochastic noise ​更​稳健​ (Robbins–Monro ​经典​随机​逼近​)。R23 W7 ​选​ MSA bootstrap ​与​ R26 W9 ​下层​用​ MSA ​都​是​这​一​传统​的​延续​。

docs.title: Theorem 5.1 (FW ​在​ Beckmann TAP ​上​ \(O(1/k)\), R10/R16)
docs.text: ​若​ \(\Phi\) smooth + ​凸​ (Beckmann ​在​ monotone non-decreasing latency ​下​成立​) ​且​ \(\mathcal{X}\) ​紧凸​，​则​ \(\Phi(\mathbf{x}_k)-\Phi(\mathbf{x}^*) = O(1/k)\)。BPR (\(\beta=4\)) ​强​单调​缺失​下​ (Theorem 3.3)，​没有​加速​到​线性​的​理论​保证​；​常数​级​改进​ (Ignashin–Yarmoshik 2024 R16 CFW/BFW/3FW；Ignashin–Yarmoshik–Raigorodskii 2025 R17 Stochastic Origin FW SOFW) ​在​大网​ SiouxFalls / Anaheim / Chicago Sketch ​上​经验​显著​但​速率​指数​不​升​。

docs.title: Definition 5.2 (Extragradient EG / OGDA)
docs.text:
EG (Korpelevich 1976, R34) ​迭代​:

\[ \mathbf{x}_{k+1/2} = P_{\mathcal{X}}\bigl(\mathbf{x}_k - \eta \mathbf{t}(\mathbf{x}_k)\bigr),\quad \mathbf{x}_{k+1} = P_{\mathcal{X}}\bigl(\mathbf{x}_k - \eta \mathbf{t}(\mathbf{x}_{k+1/2})\bigr). \tag{5.2} \]

OGDA (Optimistic Gradient Descent Ascent):

\[ \mathbf{x}_{k+1} = P_{\mathcal{X}}\bigl(\mathbf{x}_k - 2\eta\mathbf{t}(\mathbf{x}_k) + \eta\mathbf{t}(\mathbf{x}_{k-1})\bigr). \tag{5.3} \]

docs.title: Theorem 5.2 (EG/OGDA averaged \(O(1/k)\), Mokhtari–Ozdaglar–Pattathil 2019/2020, R14)
docs.text:
​若​ \(\mathbf{t}\) monotone + \(L\)-Lipschitz，\(\eta\in(0,1/L]\)，​则​ averaged iterate ​的​ gap ​函数​收敛​速率​ \(O(1/k)\)；​该​结果​统一​ EG/OGDA ​为​ proximal-point approximations。

EG/OGDA ​统一​为​ proximal-point method ​的​ first-order approximation ​是​ R14 ​的​核心​贡献​: ​把​ EG (5.2) ​和​ OGDA (5.3) ​视为​ proximal point iteration \(\mathbf{x}_{k+1}=P_{\mathcal{X}}(\mathbf{x}_k-\eta\mathbf{t}(\mathbf{x}_{k+1}))\) ​的​近似​ (​用​ \(\mathbf{x}_{k+1/2}\) ​或​ \(2\mathbf{x}_k-\mathbf{x}_{k-1}\) ​替代​ \(\mathbf{x}_{k+1}\))，​使​两者​收敛​分析​共用​一套​ Lyapunov ​函数​。

​这一​统一​让​ EG/OGDA ​在​ monotone (​非​ strongly-monotone) ​设置​下​都​达​ averaged \(O(1/k)\)，​与​ strongly-monotone ​情形​ \(O(1/T)\) ​仅差​常数​ (​但​ BPR ​在​ strong monotone ​失效​，Theorem 3.3)。Theorem 5.3 ​的​ tight last-iterate \(O(1/\sqrt T)\) ​是​同一​作者群​ (R15 Cai et al. 2022) ​接续​工作​得出​，​揭示​ averaged ​与​ last-iterate ​的​本质​差距​。

docs.title: Theorem 5.3 (Constrained monotone last-iterate tight \(O(1/\sqrt T)\), Cai–Oikonomou–Zheng 2022, R15)
docs.text:
​对​受约束​的​ monotone-Lipschitz VI，EG/OGDA last-iterate ​的​ gap ​函数​有​

\[ \mathrm{Gap}(\mathbf{x}_T) \;=\; O(1/\sqrt T), \tag{5.4} \]

​且​该​速率​紧​ (​匹配​下界​)。BPR ​上​由​ Theorem 3.3 strong-monotone ​缺失​，​无​加速​到​ \(O(1/T)\) ​的​理论​可能​；​这是​ §S9 RL step replacement (Slot 3) ​必须​在​经验​上​超越​的​ baseline。

docs.title: Theorem 5.4 (CFW / BFW / 3FW ​经验​改进​, Ignashin–Yarmoshik 2024, R16)
docs.text: ​在​ SiouxFalls / Anaheim ​大网​ TAP ​上​，Conjugate FW / Bidirectional FW / Triple FW ​给出​常数​级​ wall-clock ​改进​ (​相对​ vanilla FW)；​理论​速率​仍​ \(O(1/k)\)。Ignashin–Yarmoshik–Raigorodskii 2025 (R17 SOFW) ​把​ origin-sampling ​写​进​ FW，​给出​随机​ origin ​子集​梯度​估计​的​ sublinear ​收敛​。

docs.title: §S5.1 ​投影​算子​ \(P_{\mathcal{X}}\) ​的​计算成本
docs.text:
EG/OGDA (5.2)–(5.3) ​中​投影​ \(P_{\mathcal{X}}\) ​至​ path-polytope \(\mathcal{X}\) ​是​计算​瓶颈​: ​严格​地说​，\(\mathcal{X}=\{A\mathbf{f}:\mathbf{f}\in\mathcal{K}\}\) ​是​ \(|\mathcal{W}|\) ​个​单纯形​的​线性​投影​，​投影​需​ LP ​求解​ \(O(|E|^3)\) ​或​ specialized ​算法​ \(O(|E|\log|E|)\)。

FW (5.1) ​只解​最​短路​ \(O(|E|+|V|\log|V|)\) × \(|\mathcal{W}|\)，​故​每步​远​便宜​于​ EG/OGDA ​一步​——​这是​ BPR-Beckmann TAP ​上​ FW ​仍​是​工程​默认​而​ EG/OGDA ​多​用于​ asymmetric VI (§S4.3) ​或​ GNEP (§S6.1) ​的​根本原因​。Theorem 5.3 ​的​ \(O(1/\sqrt T)\) tight last-iterate ​是​ EG/OGDA ​在​ strong-monotone ​缺失​下​的​理论​优势​，​但​每步​成本​溢价​抵消​了​部分​理论​收益​。

docs.title: §S5.2 ​与​ §S9 RL solver ​的​对照​坐标
docs.text:
Slot 3 (FW step replacement) ​之​ RL agent ​必须​在​三个​轴上​同时​ outperform ​经典​ baseline ​才​算​贡献​: - ​速率​轴​: ​经验​加速​优于​ \(O(1/k)\) FW ​或​ \(O(1/\sqrt T)\) EG/OGDA last-iterate； - ​每步​成本​轴​: ​推断​成本​ + RL inference ​不​超过​最​短路​ oracle ​成本​； - ​泛化​轴​: ​在​分布​外​网络​ (​训练​未见​拓扑​) ​上​保持​上述​两点​。

W8 (R24) ​报告​ SiouxFalls ​上​ 10 ​步内​ gap reduction 94.99% ​是​速率​轴上​的​初步​证据​，​但​其他​两轴​的​对照​实验​文献​中缺​。​这是​ §S12 OP2 ​的​具体​形式​。

​具体​地​，​泛化​轴​ (cross-topology generalization) ​是​ RL solver ​相对​经典​ FW/EG ​的​最​关键​比较​ — ​经典​算法​在​任何​ (​满足条件​) ​网络​上​都​给​同等​速率​保证​，​无需​训练​；RL agent ​训练​ OD ​不​可能​覆盖​部署​ OD，​故​部署​在​新​网络​/​新​ OD ​上​的​速率​退化​是​ baseline-vs-ML ​的​核心​ trade-off。

OpenCity (R22 W12) zero-shot ​接近​ supervised baseline ​是​ traffic forecasting ​上​的​初步​证据​，​但​ TA-grounded (gap-to-Wardrop) ​度量​缺失​。​这一​缺失​与​ §S10 W12 critique ​和​ §S12 OP5 ​一脉相承​。

docs.title: §S5.3 BPR ​替代​ latency ​与​ modern VI solver ​的​关系
docs.text:
§S3 Theorem 3.3 ​把​ BPR strict-but-not-strongly-monotone ​标为​速率​退化​的​结构性​原因​。​其他​工程​ latency ​函数​: - Davidson 1966 ​或​ Akcelik 1991 ​用​不同​ \(\beta\) ​参数​，​仍​保持​ strict ​但​ non-strongly monotone (​除非​ \(\beta=1\) ​退化​为​线性​)。 - conical (Spiess 1990): \(t_a(x_a)=t_a^0(2-1+\alpha(1-x_a/c_a)^2-\dots)\) ​等​形式​，​在​ capacity ​内​保持​ strict + strongly monotone — ​这一族​给​经典​ FW + EG ​的​ \(O(1/T)\) ​速率​提供​工程​上​可达​的​ latency ​函数​选择​。

​但​ BPR ​因​工程​历史悠久​ + ​数据​ calibration ​完善​仍​是​默认​；​选择​更​友好​ latency ​函数​与​放弃​ BPR ​经验​ data ​是​ trade-off。​这一​选择​不​在​ 12 ​篇​ ML-aug TA ​工作​中​讨论​。

v4 vs v3: v3 ​把​ FW ​现代​变体​与​ EG/OGDA ​分​置​不同​小节​，​未​对比​；v4 ​把​它们​并​置​，​重点​强调​ BPR ​严格​-​非强​单调​ (Theorem 3.3) ​是​ sublinear ​上界​的​结构性​原因​而​非​算法​瑕疵​——​这一​识别​直接​决定​ §S9 RL solver "​经验​加速​ vs \(1/\sqrt T\) baseline" ​的​比较​坐标​。

docs.title: §S6 Bilevel TA + GNEP + Nash ​复杂度​下界
docs.text:
Model basis (bilevel TA). - State space: ​上层​决策​ \(\mathbf{y}\in\mathcal{Y}\) (toll / network design / charger placement / OD prior)；​下层​响应​ \(\mathbf{x}^*(\mathbf{y})\in\mathcal{X}\) ​满足​ UE on \(\mathcal{X}\)。 - ​决策​变量​+​域​: \((\mathbf{y},\mathbf{x})\in\mathcal{Y}\times\mathcal{X}\)，​其中​ \(\mathbf{x}=\mathbf{x}^*(\mathbf{y})\) ​隐​函数​依赖​。 - Equilibrium ​或​ objective: ​上层​ \(\min_{\mathbf{y}\in\mathcal{Y}}\Psi(\mathbf{y},\mathbf{x}^*(\mathbf{y}))\)；​下层​ \(\mathbf{x}^*(\mathbf{y})\in\arg\min_{\mathbf{x}\in\mathcal{X}}\Phi(\mathbf{x};\mathbf{y})\) ​或​ VI ​形式​。 - ​约束​: \(\mathcal{Y}\) ​紧凸​；​下层​ UE ​的​ KKT。 - ​假设​清单​: (A1)–(A5) ​在​下层​；​上层​ \(\Psi\) ​可微​ + ​下​半​连续​。

Bilevel TAP ​的​上层​决策​语义​: - toll (LeBlanc 1975, R04 ​经典​；Brotcorne et al. 2001, R11): \(\mathbf{y}=(y_a)_a\) ​每​链路​收费​，​下层​ UE ​的​有效​ latency ​改为​ \(t_a(x_a)+y_a\)。 - network design (capacity expansion): \(\mathbf{y}=(\Delta c_a)_a\) ​容量​增量​，BPR latency \(t_a(x_a)=t_a^0(1+\alpha(x_a/(c_a+\Delta c_a))^\beta)\) ​依赖​ \(\mathbf{y}\)。 - OD prior (estimation context): \(\mathbf{y}=\hat{\mathbf{d}}\) OD ​需求​估计​，​下层​ UE ​在​ \(\hat{\mathbf{d}}\) ​下解算​后​与​观测​数据​匹配​。 - charger placement (EV setting, R29 He–Yin ​系列​): \(\mathbf{y}\in\{0,1\}^{|V|}\) ​充电站​位置​ (LP-relaxed)，​下层​ EV-UE ​依赖​充电​节点​集​。 - DLMP (EV-V2G, R31 Liu et al. 2025): \(\mathbf{y}=\boldsymbol{\lambda}\) ​但​内生​ — ​这是​ §S11 ​与​上述​外​生​ \(\mathbf{y}\) ​案例​的​根本​差异​。

​五种​ \(\mathbf{y}\) ​共享​ MPCC + IFT ​数学​结构​ (Theorem 6.1 + 6.3)，​但​在​求解​流程​上​差异​显著​ — ​外​生​ \(\mathbf{y}\) ​用​ standard MPCC tools (penalty / relaxation / value function / IFT)，​内生​ \(\mathbf{y}\) ​须用​ GNEP-fixed-point ​迭代​ (R31 W7' Gauss-Seidel)。

docs.title: Definition 6.1 (Bilevel TAP, LeBlanc 1975 R04 / Brotcorne–Labbé–Marcotte–Savard 2001 R11)
docs.text:
\[ \min_{\mathbf{y}\in\mathcal{Y}}\;\Psi(\mathbf{y},\mathbf{x}^*) \;\;\text{s.t.}\;\; \mathbf{x}^*\in\arg\min_{\mathbf{x}\in\mathcal{X}}\Phi(\mathbf{x};\mathbf{y}). \tag{6.1} \]

​经​下层​ KKT ​替换​ (latency \(\mathbf{t}(\mathbf{x};\mathbf{y})\) + ​流​守恒​乘子​ \(\boldsymbol{\pi}\) + ​互补​松弛​) ​得​ MPCC (Mathematical Program with Complementarity Constraints)。

docs.title: Theorem 6.1 (MPCC MFCQ ​失效​, Scheel–Scholtes 2000, R34)
docs.text:
(6.1) ​的​ KKT ​替换​给出​ MPCC，MFCQ (Mangasarian–Fromovitz CQ) ​在​互补​条件​ \(0\leq\boldsymbol{\pi}\perp\mathbf{f}\geq 0\) ​处​普遍​失效​；​标准​ NLP ​求解​器​不​直接​适用​，​需​ penalty (Hu–Ralph 2004) / relaxation (Scholtes 2001) / value-function reformulation (Outrata–Kočvara–Zowe 1998) ​或​ IFT-sensitivity (Robinson 1980 R34) ​三种​工具​之一​。

MFCQ ​失效​的​具体​原因​: ​互补​条件​ \(f_p\cdot(C_p-\pi_{rs})=0\) + \(f_p\geq 0\) + \(C_p-\pi_{rs}\geq 0\) ​给出​ disjunctive structure — ​任一​约束​严格​活跃​时其​对偶​变量​必为​零​。​这​破坏​了​标准​ CQ ​所​需​的​"​约束​ gradient ​线性​独立​ + ​内点​存在​"​条件​。MPCC ​处理​工具​的​工程​差异​: - Penalty ​类​: ​把​互补​ \(f_p(C_p-\pi_{rs})=0\) ​加​为​ \(\mu f_p(C_p-\pi_{rs})\) penalty ​项​，\(\mu\to\infty\)；​理论​保证​强​但​ ill-conditioning。 - Relaxation ​类​ (Scheel–Scholtes 2000 R34 + ​后续​): ​把​ \(f_p(C_p-\pi_{rs})\leq t_k\)，\(t_k\to 0\) ​序列​求解​；​数值​稳定​但​收敛​序列​依赖​。 - Value-function reformulation ​类​: ​把​下层​ NLP ​的​ value function \(V(\mathbf{y})\) ​显式​构造​为​上层​约束​ \(\Phi(\mathbf{x})\leq V(\mathbf{y})\)；​理论​ elegant ​但​ \(V\) ​仅​ Lipschitz (​非​光滑​)，​反传​需​ subgradient。 - IFT sensitivity (Robinson 1980, R34): ​假设​ strong regularity ​后​用​ (6.2) ​直接​给​反传​梯度​；​与​ §S10 differentiable bilevel + OptNet/cvxpylayers ​直接​对接​。

​四​工具​在​ ML-augmented bilevel TA ​设置​下​的​对比​实证​文献​中​完全​空缺​ — ​这是​ §S12 OP3 ​在​工程​实施​上​的​具体​形式​。

docs.title: §S6.0 Bilevel TA ​与​上层​ ML ​的​关系
docs.text:
Bilevel TA ​的​上层​决策​ \(\mathbf{y}\) ​在​ ML-aug TA ​设置​下​有​两种​ ML ​化​方向​: - (B-1) ​把​上层​ \(\mathbf{y}\) ​学习​为​ policy: \(\mathbf{y}=\pi^{\mathrm{upper}}_\Theta(s)\) ​其中​ \(s\) ​含​ traffic state + OD demand + ​历史数据​；​通过​ DRL ​或​ supervised ​学​。R26 W9 ​是​经典​案例​ (​上层​ DRL TCS toll)。 - (B-2) ​把​下层​ UE solver ​学习​为​可微​ oracle: \(\mathbf{x}^*(\mathbf{y})=\mathcal{G}_\psi(\mathbf{y})\) ​通过​ supervised ​学习​；​上层​用​经典​ NLP/DRL ​优化​ \(\mathbf{y}\) via \(\mathcal{G}_\psi\) ​反传​ (Theorem 6.3 ​类​) ​或​ sample-rollout。R21 W4 / R22 W12 / R25 W11 ​都​是​ Slot 4 oracle ​的​实例​，​可​用作​ (B-2) ​的​下层​。

(B-1)+(B-2) ​同时​ ML ​化是​ §S10 differentiable bilevel TA ​的​完整​形式​；​当前​文献​多数​选​ (B-1) ​或​ (B-2) ​之一​，​端到​端​ ML ​双层​ bilevel ​在​ TA ​上​没有​ demo。​这​构成​ §S12 OP3 + OP5 + OP6 ​共同​的​工程​现实​差距​。

docs.title: §S6.1 GNEP (Facchinei–Kanzow 2007 R12)
docs.text:
Model basis (GNEP). - State space: ​玩家​ \(i\in\{1,\dots,N\}\) ​决策​ \(\mathbf{x}_i\in\mathcal{K}_i(\mathbf{x}_{-i})\)，joint \(\mathbf{x}=(\mathbf{x}_i)_i\)。 - ​决策​变量​+​域​: ​各​玩家​可行​集​ ​依赖​其他​玩家​: \(\mathcal{K}_i(\mathbf{x}_{-i})\) ​凸​；shared coupling constraint \(g(\mathbf{x})\leq 0\) ​公共​。 - Equilibrium: ​求​ \(\mathbf{x}^*\) ​使​每​玩家​ \(i\) ​有​ \(\mathbf{x}_i^*\in\arg\min_{\mathbf{x}_i\in\mathcal{K}_i(\mathbf{x}_{-i}^*)} J_i(\mathbf{x}_i,\mathbf{x}_{-i}^*)\)。 - ​约束​: \(\mathcal{K}_i\) ​凸​；coupling \(g\) ​凸​。 - ​假设​清单​: \(J_i\) ​关于​ \(\mathbf{x}_i\) ​凸​ + smooth。

GNEP ​与​ standard NEP ​的​关键​差异​是​ \(\mathcal{K}_i\) ​依赖​ \(\mathbf{x}_{-i}\) — ​即​其他​玩家​的​决策​影响​本​玩家​的​可行​域​ (​而​不仅​ cost)。​在​ EV-V2G-DLMP ​设置​下​ (§S11)，shared coupling constraint \(g\) ​对应​ PDN OPF ​的​电压​/​电流​约束​ + SoC ​物理​约束​ — ​这些​约束​在​多​玩家​ (​多​ EV) ​决策​上​同时​生效​。

GNEP ​解集​一般​是​ manifold (​而​非​ NEP ​的​离散​ fixed-point ​集​)，normalized Nash ​通过​选定​ KKT ​乘子​权重​ \(r_i\) ​给​ manifold ​一个​具体​切片​；variational equilibrium ​取​ \(r_i\equiv 1\) ​切片​，​使​ GNEP ​可​写成​单一​ VI — ​这是​数值​上​最易​处理​的​选择​。

docs.title: Definition 6.2 (Variational Equilibrium ⊆ Normalized Nash ⊆ Generalized Nash, R12)
docs.text:
​阶梯​: - Generalized Nash equilibrium (GNE): ​任一​玩家​无​单边​改善​。 - Normalized Nash equilibrium: shared coupling constraint ​的​ KKT ​乘子​在​玩家​间​满足​固定​权重​比​ \(r_i>0\)。 - Variational equilibrium (VE): ​单一​ VI \(\langle F(\mathbf{x}^*),\mathbf{x}-\mathbf{x}^*\rangle\geq 0\;\forall\mathbf{x}\in\mathcal{K}\) ​解​，\(F=\bigl(\nabla_{\mathbf{x}_i}J_i\bigr)_i\)；VE ​总是​ normalized Nash (​取​ \(r_i\equiv 1\))；​后者​总是​ GNE。

VE ​写法​把​ GNEP ​简化​为​单一​ VI——​这是​ §S11 ​把​"bilevel + DLMP \(\equiv\) GNEP" ​重写​为​ VI ​的​关键​工具​。​三层​阶梯​的​工程​含义​: GNE ​解集​是​整个​ manifold (​多维​)；normalized Nash ​在​ manifold ​上​选​ 1-d (​沿​ \(r_i\) ​比例​切片​)；VE ​选​ \(r_i=1\) ​的​具体​点​。

​在​ EV-V2G-DLMP (§S11) ​设置​下​，VE ​写法​对应​ "​所有​ EV ​在​ DLMP ​这一​公共​影子​价格​下​做​对称​响应​" — ​即​ DLMP \(\boldsymbol{\lambda}\) ​对​所有​ EV ​起到​相同​价格​信号​作用​，​无差别​对待​。​这​与​ normalized Nash ​的​"​按​比例​" + GNE ​的​"​任意​乘子​" ​是​两种​不同​程度​的​ fairness ​假设​。

Theorem 11.1 ​的​ GNEP ​等价​指​的​是​ VE ​切片​下​的​等价​；​若​工程​上​希望​ differential pricing (​按​ EV class ​给​不同​ toll/DLMP)，VE ​失​，​须用​ normalized Nash ​一般​形式​。

docs.title: Theorem 6.2 (Nash PPAD-complete, Daskalakis–Goldberg–Papadimitriou 2009 SIAM J. Comput. 39(1):195–259, R13)
docs.text:
​计算​ normalized form 2-player game ​的​ Nash equilibrium ​是​ PPAD-complete；​对​ \(N\geq 3\) ​玩家​亦然​。​含义​: GNEP / EV-V2G GNEP ​不​存在​ polynomial-time algorithm under ​标准​复杂度​假设​；​大规模​ best-response (e.g. EV ​数百万​车辆​) ​不可​扩展​是​结构性​而​非​算法​瑕疵​——MARL (W10' / R32) ​经验​绕过​但​不​消解​此​下界​。

PPAD-completeness ​与​ NP-completeness ​不同​: PPAD ​问题​保证​有解​ (Sperner / Brouwer ​不动点​存在​性​)，​但​计算​复杂度​被​认为​不​在​ P ​内​。

Nash ​与​ Wardrop UE ​的​关系​: Wardrop UE ​是​ potential game ​的​ Nash (potential ​函数​ = Beckmann \(\Phi\))，​故​ Wardrop UE ​落​在​ PLS (Polynomial Local Search) ​类内​、​严格​小于​ PPAD；​这是​ §S3 Beckmann NLP ​可​被​ FW ​多项式​时间​收敛​ (Theorem 5.1) ​而​ GNEP ​一般​情况​下​不可​的​复杂度​根源​。

​在​ §S11 EV-V2G-DLMP ​设置​下​，coupling constraint (shared SOCP) ​破坏​ potential game ​结构​，GNEP ​恢复​ PPAD ​一般​下界​——​这是​为何​ R32 W10' MARL ​经验​有效​但​不可​承诺​ polynomial ​收敛​的​复杂度​天花板​。

docs.title: Theorem 6.3 (Generalized IFT, Robinson 1980)
docs.text:
​若​下层​ VI/KKT ​在​ \((\mathbf{y}_0,\mathbf{x}_0^*)\) ​处​满足​ strong regularity (lower-level KKT ​系统​在​ active set ​限定​下​ Jacobian ​可逆​ + LICQ + strict complementarity)，​则​存在​ \(\mathbf{y}_0\) ​邻域​上​唯一​ Lipschitz ​选择​ \(\mathbf{y}\mapsto\mathbf{x}^*(\mathbf{y})\) ​且​

\[ rac{d\mathbf{x}^*}{d\mathbf{y}} \;=\; - igl( abla_{\mathbf{x}\mathbf{x}}^2 \Phi(\mathbf{x}^*;\mathbf{y}) igr)^{-1} abla_{\mathbf{x}\mathbf{y}}^2 \Phi(\mathbf{x}^*;\mathbf{y}). ag{6.2} \]

Robinson 1980 generalized IFT ​是​经典​ IFT ​在​ NLP/VI ​设置​下​的​推广​ — ​经典​ IFT ​处理​可微​ equation system \(F(\mathbf{x},\mathbf{y})=0\)，Robinson ​推广​到​下层​ KKT ​系统​ (​含​互补​、​不等式​)。strong regularity ​三件套​ (Jacobian ​可逆​ + LICQ + strict complementarity) ​共同​保证​ active set ​局部​不变​，​从而​ KKT ​可​线性化​得​ \(d\mathbf{x}^*/d\mathbf{y}\)。

​与​ implicit function (IFT) ​的​关系​: (6.2) ​形式​上​是​ IFT ​的​ Hessian × cross-Hessian ​表达​；​在​严格​-​凸​ NLP ​设置​下​ strong regularity ​自动​ ⇐ strong convexity + Slater，IFT ​直接​给​ (6.2)。​在​ BPR-Beckmann ​设置​下​ strong convexity ​失​ (Theorem 3.3 BPR strict-not-strongly-monotone)，​故​ strong regularity ​须​逐点​检查​ Hessian rank — ​在​零流​链路​上​失效​，​这是​ §S10 P7 ​数值​警告​的​形式​起源​。

​关键​观察​ (FC-4 + §S10 P7): BPR Hessian \( abla_{\mathbf{x}\mathbf{x}}^2\Phi = \mathrm{diag}(t_a'(x_a))\)，​在​ \(x_a o 0\) ​退化​为​ 0；​故​ strong regularity ​在​零流​链路​上​失效​，IFT (6.2) ​在​零流​邻域​ singular——OptNet / cvxpylayers ​直接​反传时​反传​梯度​在​零流​上​ NaN ​或​爆炸​。​这是​ differentiable bilevel TA (§S10) ​的​核心​数值​警告​。

docs.title: §S6.3 ​三大​广义​框架​ — Wardrop / VI / bilevel ​在​现代​极限​下​的​归宿
docs.text:
§S3 Wardrop UE、§S3 Smith VI、§S6 bilevel ​三大​经典​容器​在​ \(N\to\infty\) ​极限​、set-valued ​推广​、Stackelberg-​大​-N ​极限​下​分别​落入​ MFG / GVI / MFC ​三大​广义​框架​。​本​节​给出​ sketched ​形式​接口​；​详细分析​见​外部​经典​文献​ (​本​ draft ​不​展开​)。

(a) Mean-Field Game (MFG, Lasry–Lions 2006/2007)。\(N\)-player Nash ​在​ \(N\to\infty\) + ​每​ player ​影响​ vanishing ​极限​下​变为​ MFG：​求​ population distribution \(\mu^*\) ​与​ value function \(V^*\) ​使​ (i) representative agent ​给定​ \(\mu^*\) ​解​ HJB \(V^*=\min_a\{L(a,\mu^*)+\text{transition expectation}\}\)；(ii) ​群体​分布​ \(\mu^*\) ​由​ representative agent ​最优​ policy ​诱导​ (Kolmogorov-Fokker-Planck)。

​与​ Wardrop UE ​的​接口​: deterministic stationary MFG ​在​ traffic ​设置​下​ \(\mu^*=\) link-flow distribution、\(V^*=\) OD-pair value function (= path cost)，MFG fixed-point ​与​ Wardrop UE (3.3) ​在​ stationary ​极限​下​重合​。

​工程​含义​: §S9 MARL ​在​ \(N\to\infty\) ​应​收敛​到​ MFG-MARL；MFG ​在​ monotone setting (Lasry–Lions ​唯一性​条件​: \(\partial L/\partial\mu\) monotone) ​下​有​唯一​解​ + polynomial-time approximation (deep MFG solver, Carmona–Laurière ​类​), escape Theorem 6.2 PPAD-complete ​下界​ (PPAD ​对​ finite-N GNEP ​成立​, ​对​ MFG ​不​直接​适用​)。​这是​ §S12 OP2 / OP7 ​在​ large-N ​极限​下​的​ most-promising attack angle。

(b) Set-valued / Generalized VI (GVI, Aubin–Cellina 1984 Differential Inclusions; Facchinei–Pang Vol. I §2.3)。Smith VI (3.2) ​假设​ \(\mathbf{t}(\mathbf{x})\) single-valued continuous；​当​ latency / cost ​在​某些​ \(\mathbf{x}\) ​处​ set-valued (e.g. non-smooth cost ​让​ \(\partial t_a\) ​为​ subdifferential、multi-UE ​让​ implicit function \(\mathbf{x}^*(\mathbf{y})\) multi-valued、bilevel value function \(V(\mathbf{y})\) ​取​ optimistic vs pessimistic ​给出​区间​)，​需​广义​化为​ set-valued VI。

​更​精确​地​，​求​ \(\mathbf{x}^*\in\mathcal{X}\) ​使​ \(\exists\xi\in F(\mathbf{x}^*)\) with \(\langle\xi,\mathbf{x}-\mathbf{x}^*\rangle\geq 0,\forall\mathbf{x}\in\mathcal{X}\)，\(F:\mathcal{X}\rightrightarrows\mathbb{R}^m\) ​是​ multi-valued maximal monotone operator。

​与​ §S4/§S6/§S11 ​的​接口​: §S4.3 asym VI ​在​ latency ​不可​微处​自动​ set-valued；§S6 bilevel ​在​ lower-level ​多​ UE ​下​ implicit function ​自动​ set-valued (Dempe–Dutta optimistic/pessimistic ​二分​)；§S11 multi-leader-multi-follower GNEP (e.g. ​多​ PDN operator + ​多​ EV class) ​自动​ set-valued GVI。

​工程​含义​: H2 ​失效​ (multi-UE) ​与​ (C2) ​失效​ (lower-level UE ​非​唯一​) ​不​应​视为​ "​等待​补​证明​"，​而应​直接​进入​ GVI framework ​处理​；​存在​性靠​ Kakutani ​不动点​ (​而​非​ Hartman–Stampacchia ​经典​存在​性​)。

(c) Mean-Field Control (MFC, Carmona–Delarue 2018 Probabilistic Theory of Mean Field Games)。bilevel TA ​在​ \(N\to\infty\) + ​上层​ social-planner ​控制​ representative agent distribution ​极限​下​变为​ MFC：central planner ​选​ \(\mathbf{y}\in\mathcal{Y}\) ​使​ representative agent ​在​ \(\mathbf{y}\) ​下​诱导​的​群体​最优​ distribution \(\mu^*(\mathbf{y})\) ​极小​化​上层​ objective。

MFC vs MFG ​区分​: MFG ​是​ \(N\) ​个​ selfish player ​在​ mean field ​中​ Nash (= Wardrop UE ​大​-N ​极限​)；MFC ​是​ central planner ​控制​ representative agent (= Wardrop SO ​大​-N ​极限​)。Roughgarden PoA (Theorem 3.4) ​在​ large-N ​极限​下​正是​ MFG vs MFC ​的​差距​。

​与​ §S6 / §S11 ​的​接口​: congestion charging Stackelberg (LeBlanc 1975 R04 toll bilevel) ​在​ large-N ​极限​是​ MFC-with-toll-instrument；DLMP ​内​生化​ (§S11 R31 W7') ​在​ EV fleet \(N\to\infty\) ​极限​是​ MFC-with-price-mechanism。

​工程​含义​: §S11 EV-V2G-DLMP ​在​ large-N ​应是​ MFG-with-common-noise (DLMP ​是​ common shock + MFG)，​而​非​ finite-N GNEP；​这​给​ §S12 OP4 ​一个​ escape PPAD-completeness ​的​具体​路径​ — ​把​ finite-N GNEP ​求解​ (Theorem 6.2 PPAD-complete) ​升​为​ MFG-MFC ​联合​求解​ (deep MFG/MFC numerical methods ​已​ mature, Cardaliaguet 2010 Notes on Mean Field Games ​综述​系列​)。

​三​框架​接口​卡片​:

​经典​容器​ ​现代​广义​框架​ ​极限​ / ​推广​方向​ ​工程​含义​ Wardrop UE (3.3) MFG (Lasry–Lions 2007) \(N\to\infty\) nonatomic limit escape PPAD; deep MFG solver polynomial-time approximate Smith VI (3.2) set-valued GVI (Aubin–Cellina 1984) \(\mathbf{t}\) ​或​ \(\mathbf{x}^*\) set-valued H2 / (C2) ​失效​后​自然​ framework bilevel TA (6.1) MFC (Carmona–Delarue 2018) \(N\to\infty\) + central planner toll / DLMP / charger placement ​在​ large-N ​极限​

​三​框架​共同​作用​: ​把​ §S6.2 PPAD-completeness ​下界​ (Theorem 6.2) ​限定​到​ finite-N + single-valued + Stackelberg ​设置​；​在​三个​极限​方向​ (large-N / set-valued / mean-field) ​上​各有​ escape route。​本​ draft ​不​展开​ deep MFG / MFC numerical methods (Cardaliaguet 2010 ​综述​ + Carmona–Laurière 2021 SIAM Review ​类​工作​)，​仅​指出​ §S12 OP4 / OP7 ​应​在​ MFG / MFC framework ​下​重述​而​非​泛泛​"MARL escape PPAD"。

v4 vs v3 ​升级​点​: v3 ​把​ GNEP ​和​ bilevel ​写​得​很​形式​但​未​挂​ PPAD-​完备​下界​；v4 ​把​ R13 ​显式​列为​天花板​定理​，​并​把​ IFT-Robinson 1980 (Theorem 6.3) ​提前​到​ §S6 ​以便​ §S10 differentiable bilevel ​直接​引用​。Phase 4 panel ​在​ §S6.3 ​补三大​广义​框架​ (MFG / GVI / MFC) ​把​ finite-N ​下界​与​ large-N ​极限​ escape ​形成​完整​接口​ (deep-diver P1-1/P1-2/P1-3)。

docs.title: §S7 ML drop-in ​四​ slot framework — Thread B ​数学​骨架
docs.text: Model basis (Thread B ​入口​). - State space: ​同​ §S3；​额外​承担​ ML ​参数​空间​ \(\Theta=\Theta_\phi\times\Theta_\theta\times\Theta_\psi\)。 - ​决策​变量​+​域​: ​经典​ TAP ​决策​变量​ \(\mathbf{f},\mathbf{x}\) ​不变​；ML ​模块​参数​ \(\phi\) (latency surrogate)、\(\theta\) (RL policy)、\(\psi\) (state oracle) ​通过​训练​流程​获得​。 - Equilibrium ​或​ objective: ​仍​是​ (3.1)–(3.3)，​但​部分​ operator (latency \(\mathbf{t}\)、shortest-path oracle、step rule、UE ​解​算子​) ​被​ ML ​模块​替换​。 - ​约束​: ​同​ §S3；ML ​模块​需​ enforce monotone / conservation / non-negative (​软​或​硬​，§S8 ​区分​)。 - ​假设​清单​: (A1)–(A5) ​仍待​ ML ​模块​兑现​——​这是​ §S7 ​引入​ H1/H2/H3 ​的​根本原因​。

docs.title: Definition 7.1 (Slot 1: ML latency surrogate)
docs.text:
​对​每条​链路​ \(a\)，​参数​化​ \(\hat t_a(x_a;\phi):\mathbb{R}_{\geq 0}\to\mathbb{R}_{>0}\)，\(\phi\in\Theta_\phi\subseteq\mathbb{R}^{d_\phi}\)。ML-aug TAP:

\[ \min_{\mathbf{f}\in\mathcal{K}}\;\hat\Phi(A\mathbf{f};\phi) \;=\; \sum_a\int_0^{x_a}\hat t_a(s;\phi)\,ds. \tag{7.1} \]

Slot 1 ​替换​有​两种​工程​取向​: (a) link-level surrogate (\(\hat t_a\) ​关于​单一​ \(x_a\))，​保持​ link-separable ​与​ Jacobian ​对称​ (A3 + A4)，§S3 ​整套​ Beckmann/VI ​结论​可​继承​；(b) multi-link surrogate (\(\hat t_a\) ​依赖​ \(\mathbf{x}_{\mathcal{N}(a)}\) ​即​邻域​链路​流量​)，​破坏​ link-separable，​进入​ asymmetric VI ​设置​ (§S4.3) — Beckmann ​等价​丢失​，​必须​直接​ VI ​求解​。

W4/W5/W11 ​都​是​ (a) ​类​ link-level，​但​ GNN/Transformer backbone ​隐式​注入​邻域​信息​至​ \(\phi\) ​学习​；​这一​"​隐式​邻域​ + ​显式​ link-level"​组合​是​工程​主流​但​理论​上​ (A3) ​严格​性​可争议​。

docs.title: Definition 7.2 (Slot 2: shortest-path RL replacement)
docs.text:
​路由​策略​ \(\pi_\theta(p\mid s)\) over \(p\in\mathcal{P}_{rs}\)，state \(s_t=(\mathbf{x}_t,\mathbf{h}_G,\text{OD ctx})\) ​含​当前​流量​ + ​图​嵌入​ + OD ​语义​；reward ​取​ \(r_t = -\Delta\mathrm{gap}(\mathbf{x}_t)\) ​或​ \(r_t=-C_p(\mathbf{x}_t)\)。​把​ (5.1) ​的​最​短路​ oracle ​替换​为​ \(p\sim\pi_\theta\)。

Slot 2 ​的​ reward ​选择​对应​两种​不同​优化​目标​: \(r_t=-\Delta\mathrm{gap}\) ​直接​最小化​ UE gap (​与​ §S3 Wardrop ​第一​原则​一致​)；\(r_t=-C_p\) ​是​ individual-rational ​自利​目标​ (​每​用户​最小化​自身​成本​)。​前者​是​ system-level ​任务​而​后者​是​ individual-level ​任务​ — Property 9.1 H2 ​充分条件​要求​后者​ + path-split simplex action + link-separable monotone latency + Markov ​稳态​。

docs.title: Definition 7.3 (Slot 3: FW step replacement)
docs.text:
\((\mathbf{y}_k,\gamma_k)\sim\pi_\theta(\cdot\mid s_k)\) ​同时​给出​方向​ + ​步长​，​替换​ (5.1) ​的​ \(\arg\min\) + \(2/(k+2)\)。

Slot 3 ​与​ Slot 2 ​在​工程​上​重叠​但​形式​上​独立​: Slot 2 ​替换​ FW ​的​最​短路​ oracle，Slot 3 ​替换​ FW ​的​步长​选择​。​两者​同时​替换​给出​ fully-RL FW; ​单独​替换​之一​给​ hybrid FW + RL。R23 W7 MSA-DQN ​是​ Slot 3 ​经典​实例​ (DQN ​学​步长​，MSA ​给​方向​)；R24 W8 MARL-OD-DA ​同时​是​ Slot 2 + Slot 3 (Dirichlet actor ​给​ path-split = ​方向​，centralized critic ​给​隐式​步长​ via policy update)。

docs.title: Definition 7.4 (Slot 4: state oracle / FM)
docs.text:
\(\mathcal{G}_\psi:(G,\mathbf{d},\text{features})\to\hat{\mathbf{x}}^*\approx\mathbf{x}_{\mathrm{UE}}^*\)；​三种​参数​化​ (a) GNN message-passing，(b) Transformer attention，(c) Transportation FM encoder + UE-head。

Slot 4 ​与​ Slot 1 ​的​关系​: Slot 1 ​提供​ latency surrogate ​在​ (7.1) ​内​被​ FW (5.1) iteratively ​使用​；Slot 4 ​直接​输出​ \(\hat{\mathbf{x}}^*\)，end-to-end ​跳过​迭代​。

​两者​推断​成本​对比​: Slot 1 ​每次​ inference \(O(L|E|)\) × \(K_{\mathrm{FW}}\) iterations；Slot 4 ​单次​ inference \(O(L|E|+|\mathcal{W}|^2 d_k)\) ​但​无需​迭代​。Slot 4 ​适合​大量​ OD demand ​变化​下​的​快速​ UE prediction (e.g. real-time DTA、​政策​评估​)；Slot 1 ​适合​需要​精度​可控​的​ UE ​求解​。W4/W5/W11/W12 ​都​是​ Slot 4 ​主导​但​带​隐式​ Slot 1 ​元素​ (​训练​时​ latency ​学习​是​隐含​步骤​)。

docs.title: Three central hypotheses (H1/H2/H3) — Thread B ​与​ A ​的​接口
docs.text:
• H1 (monotone latency surrogate): \(\partial\hat t_a(x_a;\phi)/\partial x_a\geq 0\) a.e. on \(\mathbb{R}_{\geq 0}\)。​若​ H1 ​成立​则​ \(\hat\Phi\) ​凸​ (Theorem 3.1)，Beckmann/VI ​阶梯​继承​；​若​ H1 ​失则​ \(\hat\Phi\) ​非凸​，VI ​严格​单调​失​，​链路​解​唯一性​失​。
  • H2 (Nash \(\leftrightarrow\) Wardrop): (i) MARL agent action ​取​ path-split simplex over \(\mathcal{P}_{rs}\)；(ii) reward \(r^i=-C_{p_i}(\mathbf{x})\)；(iii) \(\mathbf{t}\) link-separable monotone；(iv) Markov game ​稳态​。​这​四条​共同​充分​蕴含​ MARL Nash \(=\) Wardrop UE (Property P5)。
  • H3 (IFT for bilevel): ​下层​解​唯一​ + ​下层​ KKT Jacobian (active set ​限定​) ​可逆​ + LICQ + strict complementarity。​则​ \(d\mathbf{x}^*/d\mathbf{y}\) ​由​ (6.2) ​给出​；​否则​反传​梯度​不​连续​。

​三​ hypothesis ​的​全局​位置​: H1 ​是​ §S3 Beckmann ​凸性​ (Theorem 3.1) ​在​ ML latency ​替换​下​的​延续​；H2 ​是​ §S6.1 GNEP/Nash ​与​ §S3 Wardrop UE ​之间​的​桥梁​；H3 ​是​ §S6.2 Robinson IFT (Theorem 6.3) ​在​ differentiable bilevel ​设置​下​的​应用​。​三者​覆盖​ ML ​三种​主要​ TA ​替换​ (latency surrogate / shortest-path RL / differentiable bilevel)。

​任一​ hypothesis ​失效​后果​不仅​影响​该​ slot ​的​局部​正确性​，​还​沿​假设​链向​上游​/​下游​传播​ — H1 ​失​影响​ §S5 ​求解​器​速率​与​ §S10 differentiable bilevel；H2 ​失​影响​ §S9 ​经验​合法性​；H3 ​失​影响​ §S10 ​反传​可信度​。​这种​ hypothesis-level ​传播​是​ v4 vs v3 ​的​最​关键​洞察​。

docs.title: Property 7.1 (P1: monotone-constrained ⇒ Beckmann ​继承​)
docs.text:
​若​ \(\hat t_a(\cdot;\phi)\) ​关于​ \(x_a\) ​在​ \(\phi\) ​整个​可行​域​中​ monotone non-decreasing (​而​不仅​训练样本​上​)，​则​ Theorems 3.1, 3.2, 3.3 ​全部​继承​到​ (7.1)；UE-of-surrogate ​等于​ ML-aug TAP minimizer。

P1 ​的​关键​限定词​是​"​在​ \(\phi\) ​整个​可行​域​中​"​而​非​"​在​训练样本​上​"。​后者​是​ statistical regularization (e.g. ​加​ monotone penalty ​到​ loss)，​仅​在​ in-distribution ​推断​时​近似​保持​；​前者​是​ architectural invariant (e.g. ICNN ​通过​非负​权重​约束​)，​逐​ \(\phi\) ​选择​都​满足​。

​区分​在​分布​外​推断​ (capacity stress、OD shift) ​时​尤其​关键​ — ​训练​集上​ monotone ​不​保证​ stress ​下​ monotone，​而​构造性​ monotone ​与​ \(\phi\) ​取值​无关​恒​成立​。​这一​区别​是​ W4 (training-time soft monotone) ​与​ ICNN-GNN ​复合​ (architectural monotone) ​的​核心​差异​，​也​是​ §S12 OP1 ​的​核心​ attack point。

docs.title: Property 7.2 (P2: ICNN ​是​ H1 ​的​构造性​正确​范式​, Amos–Xu–Kolter 2017 R34)
docs.text:
ICNN ​是​构造性​把​ input-convexity ​烧进​网络​权重​的​ NN ​子类​ (​等价​于​ deep version of \(f(x)=\max_i(a_i^\top x+b_i)\) ​经过​ smooth activation ​平滑​)，​给出​关于​输入​变量​的​凸函数​族​；​其​ partial-ICNN ​版本​可​保证​关于​子集​变量​凸​+​单调​。​把​ partial-ICNN ​作为​链路​ readout head (\(\hat t_a(x_a;\phi) = h_\phi(x_a,\mathbf{h}_a^L)\) ​关于​ \(x_a\) ​凸​ + ​单调​) ​同时​获得​ H1 with-construction + GNN/Transformer backbone ​表达力​。TA ​圈​尚无​此​ demo (FC-5)。

ICNN ​的​核心​构造​: ​第一层​ \(z_1=\sigma_1(W^{[1]}x+b^{[1]})\) ​任意​；​后续​每层​ \(z_{\ell+1}=\sigma_{\ell+1}(W^{[\ell+1]}_x x + W^{[\ell+1]}_z z_\ell + b^{[\ell+1]})\) ​其中​ \(W^{[\ell+1]}_z\) ​元素​级​非负​ + \(\sigma\) ​凸非​递减​ (e.g. softplus, ReLU)。​两条​约束​共同​保证​输出​关于​ \(x\) ​凸​。

partial-ICNN ​把​ \(x\) ​拆​分为​"​凸​子集​" + "free ​子集​"，​仅​对​凸​子集​强制​非负​ + ​凸​激活​，free ​子集​任意​。​对​ Slot 1 latency surrogate，​把​ \(x_a\) ​作凸​子集​ (​期望​单调​凸​) + \(\mathbf{h}_a^L\) ​作​ free ​子集​ (​任意​ backbone embedding)，partial-ICNN ​给​ \(\hat t_a\) ​关于​ \(x_a\) ​凸​+​单调​ (​单调​来自​ \(\sigma\) ​非​递减​ + readout ​单一​变量​)。​这​正是​ §S8 attack angle ​三步​构造​的​理论​基础​。

docs.title: §S7.1 ​三​ hypothesis ​的​因果​链​与​失效​后果
docs.text:
H1 ​失效​的​直接​后果​是​ §S3 ​整套​定理​链​ (Theorem 3.1 ​凸​ NLP + 3.2 VI ​存在​唯一​ + 3.3 BPR ​严格​-​非强​单调​速率​结论​) ​无法​继承​到​ ML-augmented ​设置​。

​具体​而言​: ​若​ \(\hat t_a\) ​存在​ \(\partial\hat t_a/\partial x_a<0\) ​区域​，​则​ \(\hat\Phi\) ​在​该​区域​非凸​，Beckmann (7.1) ​可能​有​多个​局部​极小​；VI strict monotone ​失效​，​唯一性​失​；FW ​收敛​保证​ (Theorem 5.1) ​失效​。

​经验​上​: W4/W5/W11 ​在​训练​集上​拟合​ \(\mathbf{t}_{\mathrm{BPR}}\) ​故​ H1 ​大​概率​局部​成立​，​但​在​ stress test (​容量​收缩​、​需求​ surge) ​下​推广​失败​ — ​这是​ Phase 0c-B ​报告​的​ robustness gap (Property 8.3 + FC-6) ​的​根本​数学​原因​。

H2 ​失效​的​后果​是​ §S9 MARL ​收敛​点​未必​ Wardrop UE — ​可能​是​某​ generalized Nash ​或​ correlated equilibrium，​与​下游​ PoA ​分析​ (Theorem 3.4) ​不​兼容​。Property 9.1 ​给​的​充分条件​四件套​ (path-simplex action / ​路径​成本​ reward / link-separable monotone / Markov ​稳态​) ​不能​排除​多​ Nash: ​即使​收敛​到​某​ Nash，​未必​是​ Wardrop UE。​这是​ §S9 W8 ​经验​数字​ 94.99% ​与​"Wardrop UE ​的​ fixed-point ​证明​"​之间​的​本质​差距​。

H3 ​失效​的​后果​直接​是​ §S10 OptNet/cvxpylayers ​反传​梯度​不​连续​ (Property 10.1): BPR ​零流​ Hessian singular ⇒ IFT (6.2) ​失效​ ⇒ \(d\mathbf{x}^*/d\mathbf{y}\) ​在​零流​邻域​ NaN / ​爆炸​ ⇒ ​上层​ policy gradient ​不可​信​。W9 (R26) ​把​下层​ MSA ​替代​显式​反传​，​工程​上​绕过​，​但​放弃​了​ IFT ​一阶​信息​的​统计​效率​收益​。

​反方​观点​ (open seam): "H1 ​全​空缺​ ⇒ 12 ​篇​必​失败​" ​过严​。​三种​ H1-without-architectural-enforce ​但​实证​稳定​的​可能​机制​:

(a) monotone-by-data: ​过​参数​ NN ​在​ in-distribution ​区域​可​学到​ a.e. monotone (Sobolev embedding ​论证​) — W4/W5/W11 ​经验​有效​的​最​ likely ​解释​； (b) monotone-on-active-set: W11 hard-conservation head ​让​ \(\hat x_a\) ​落入​ BPR monotone ​局部​区域​，H1 ​全局​违反​对​收敛​不​影响​； (c) fixed-point-via-H2: critic ​学到​ reward shaping ​让​ policy ​收敛​点​对应​ Wardrop-with-DLMP ​而​非​依赖​ latency monotone (H2 ​间接​代​ H1)。

​这​把​"​全​空缺​"​从​严重​缺陷​降​为​"​未​充分​论证​但​可能​实证​ OK" — ​仍​是​ §S12 OP2 open seam。

docs.title: §S7.2 Slot ​与​ Property ​的​二维​矩阵​ (forward index)
docs.text:
Slot ​核心​ Property ​主要​ case ​关键​ FC Slot 1 (latency surrogate) P1, P2 (ICNN) W4, W5; W11 partial FC-5, FC-6 Slot 2 (shortest-path RL) P5 (H2), P10 W7, W8 FC-1, FC-5 Slot 3 (FW step) (​与​ Slot 2 ​共享​ RL ​框架​) W7 step FC-5 Slot 4 (state oracle / FM) P3 over-smoothing, P4 transformer ​复杂度​, P8 conservation, P6 FM scaling W4, W5, W11, W12, R32 W10' FC-6, FC-7, FC-8

§S8 ​处理​ Slot 1 + Slot 4 (W4/W5/W11/W12 + ICNN); §S9 ​处理​ Slot 2 + Slot 3 (W7/W8/W9/W10/W10'); §S10 ​处理​ Slot 4 ​顶层​ + Differentiable bilevel (W12 + OptNet)。

docs.title: §S7.3 Case schema ​统一​ (W4/W5/W7/W8/W9/W11/W12/W7'/W10' ​应用​)
docs.text:
§S8 / §S9 / §S10 / §S11 ​各​ case ​段落​严格​统一​为​ 4-bullet schema, ​便于​ cross-case ​对照​:

  1. Setup (state space / ​模型​基础​): ​与​全局​ Model basis (§S7 Slot ​入口​) ​对接​, ​列出​ ML ​输入​ + ​输出​ + backbone ​类型​。
  2. ​核心​ mechanism (ML ​组件​如何​ fit slot 1/2/3/4): ​该​ case ​在​四​ slot framework ​中​的​具体位置​ + ​形式化​对接​。
  3. H1/H2/H3 (​或​ C1/C2/C3) Critique (​本​ case ​满足​ / ​缺失​ ​哪条​ hypothesis): ​严格​按​ §S7 ​全局​ hypothesis ​锁定​; §S11 case ​同时​引​ (C1)(C2)(C3) §S11 ​局部​ hypothesis。
  4. Attack angle (ICNN composite / Nash-axiom transfer / IFT analysis ​等​): ​该​ case ​缺失​的​ hypothesis ​在​ §S12 OP ​矩阵​中​的​对应​ attack angle ​索引​。

​各​ case ​既有​ Slot ​归位​ / ​效果​ / *Critique ​标签​可​视为​本​ schema ​的​ surface ​形式​: Setup ⊂ "Slot ​归位​"、​核心​ mechanism ⊂ "​输入​ / ​输出​ / ​架构​"、Critique = "Critique"、Attack angle = "§S12 OP ​对应​"。Phase 2 critic ​可​按本​ schema 4 ​项​做​合规​检查​。

v4 vs v3: v3 ​把​ ML-aug TA ​写成​松散​案例​集​；v4 ​把​它​整成​ Slot 1–4 ​与​ H1/H2/H3 ​严格​化​的​形式​骨架​，​使​ §S8/§S9/§S10 ​的​ critique ​锚​在​同一​坐标系​。

docs.title: §S8 Neural latency surrogate + GNN / Transformer for UE — Slot 1 & Slot 4 ​主战场
docs.text:
Model basis (Slot 1 + Slot 4). - State space: ​同​ §S7。GNN node embedding \(\mathbf{h}_v^{(\ell)}\in\mathbb{R}^{d_\ell}\)，Transformer token = (link, OD) ​对​。 - ​决策​变量​+​域​: \(\phi\) (Slot 1)、\(\psi\) (Slot 4)；ML ​训练​通过​ supervised + conservation loss + (​可​选​) consistency-with-FW。 - Equilibrium: ML-aug TAP (7.1)；​或​ oracle ​直接​输出​ \(\hat{\mathbf{x}}^*\) approximating \(\mathbf{x}_{\mathrm{UE}}^*\)。 - ​约束​: ​链路​非负​ \(\hat x_a\geq 0\)；​流​守恒​ \(A^\top\hat{\mathbf{f}}=\mathbf{d}\) ​软​ (​作为​ loss ​项​) ​或​硬​ (​作为​ head ​设计​)。 - ​假设​清单​: (A1)–(A5) + H1 (Slot 1)；H2/H3 ​不​直接​相关​。

Slot 1 + Slot 4 ​的​核心​ ML ​设计​变量​是​ (i) backbone ​架构​ (GNN vs Transformer)、(ii) readout head ​设计​ (free vs ICNN vs softmax-over-paths)、(iii) ​训练​ loss (supervised on UE flow / latency / OD-context auxiliary)、(iv) conservation ​实施​层级​ (soft vs hard)。​本​节​ case W4/W5/W11 ​在​这​ 4 ​个轴上​的​具体​选择​见​各​ case ​段落​；§S12 OP1 ICNN-GNN ​复合​ attack angle ​把​ (i) GNN + (ii) ICNN + (iv) hard ​作为​同时​优化​方向​。

docs.title: Definition 8.1 (GNN forward, message-passing)
docs.text:
\[ \mathbf{h}_v^{(\ell+1)} \;=\; \sigma\Bigl(W^{(\ell)}\sum_{u\in\mathcal{N}(v)}\mathbf{h}_u^{(\ell)} + b^{(\ell)}\Bigr),\qquad \ell=0,\dots,L-1. \tag{8.1} \]

\(L\) ​层​ message-passing ​后取​链路​ readout \(\hat t_a\) ​或​链路​流​ \(\hat x_a\)。

(8.1) ​是​ GCN ​类​基本​形式​；​后续​工程​变体​包含​ sample-based aggregation、attention-weighted aggregation、heterogeneous-type-specific weights (HGAT，​见​ §S11 R32 W10' ​案例​)。

message-passing GNN ​的​核心​局限​是​ receptive field bounded by L + over-smoothing trade-off (Property 8.1)。TAP ​网络​典型​ diameter (e.g. SiouxFalls \(\sim 8\)、Anaheim \(\sim 15\)、Chicago Sketch \(\sim 30\)) ​要求​ \(L\geq\mathrm{diam}/2\) ​才能​传播​ long-range OD-context；​但​ over-smoothing ​限制​ \(L\leq 4-6\)。​这一​矛盾​是​ W4 ​选​ hetero-GNN ​与​ W11 ​转​ transformer ​的​根本​动因​。

docs.title: Property 8.1 (P3: over-smoothing, Oono–Suzuki 2020 ICLR R34)
docs.text: ​设​ GCN ​各层​算子​最大​特征值​绝对量​ \(\rho<1\)，​则​ \(L\) ​层后​节点​嵌入​间​差异​在​ \(\rho^L\) ​量级​；​对​ SiouxFalls ​等​深网​ (diameter \(\geq 8\))，\(L\leq 3\) ​不够​、\(L\geq 6\) ​时​ over-smoothing ​导致​表达​ collapse。

docs.title: Definition 8.2 (Transformer attention, R34 Vaswani 2017)
docs.text:
\[ \mathrm{Attn}(Q,K,V) \;=\; \mathrm{softmax}\!\bigl(QK^\top/\sqrt{d_k}\bigr)V. \tag{8.2} \]

Token ​取​ OD ​对​或​ (link, OD) ​二元​组​；​复杂度​ \(O(|\mathcal{W}|^2 d_k)\) ​关于​ OD ​数​二次​，​是​大网​ (e.g. Chicago Sketch \(|\mathcal{W}|>10^4\)) ​的​核心​瓶颈​。

docs.title: Property 8.2 (P4: Transformer ​复杂度​ \(O(|\mathcal{W}|^2 d_k)\))
docs.text:
(8.2) ​在​ token = OD ​对​设置​下​推断​复杂度​关于​ OD ​数​二次​；​大网​ (\(|\mathcal{W}|>10^4\)) ​单次​ attention pass ​即​ \(\sim 10^8 d_k\) FLOP ​量级​。W11 ​通过​ (path, OD) token + candidate path ​截断​把​复杂度​降​至​ \(O(K|\mathcal{W}|d_k)\) ​线性​ (​代价​是​截断​ bias)，​是​当前​大网​ transformer-for-TA ​唯一​可​扩展​工程​路径​。

Transformer ​与​ GNN ​在​ TAP ​应用​上​的​工程​权衡​: GNN ​的​ receptive field ​与​ over-smoothing trade-off (Definition 8.1) ​是​ small-world ​网络​上​的​根本​限制​；transformer ​用​ dense attention ​直接​处理​ long-range，​但​ quadratic OD complexity ​在​大网​失效​。

W11 (R25 Ameli–Le–Shams–Skabardonis 2025) ​选​ (path, OD) token ​把​ attention ​限制​在​ candidate path enumeration ​上​ — ​即​先用​最​短路​ + k-shortest ​路径​预​生成​ candidate paths \(\mathcal{P}_{rs}^{(K)}\subset\mathcal{P}_{rs}\) (\(|\mathcal{P}_{rs}^{(K)}|=K\sim 10\))，​再​ softmax-over-paths ​得​ \(\hat f_p\)；​总​ token ​数​ \(\sum_{(r,s)}|\mathcal{P}_{rs}^{(K)}|\sim K|\mathcal{W}|\) ​线性​于​ OD。​这是​ W11 ​在​ Chicago Sketch ​类大​网上​保持​可​扩展​的​工程​关键​。

​但​ candidate path ​截断​引入​ systematic bias: UE ​真实​最优​路径​可能​不​在​ \(\mathcal{P}_{rs}^{(K)}\) ​内​，​论文​ (FC-8) ​未​给出​截断​ bias ​的​量化​分析​。

docs.title: Property 8.3 (P8: conservation soft vs hard)
docs.text:
• Soft (W4 Liu–Meidani 2024 R21): \(\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{cons}}=\|A^\top\hat{\mathbf{f}}-\mathbf{d}\|^2\) ​加入​ training loss，​推断​时​不​严格​守恒​。
  • Hard (W11 Ameli–Le–Shams–Skabardonis 2025 R25): softmax-over-paths head \(\hat f_p = d_{rs}\cdot\mathrm{softmax}(\boldsymbol{\ell}_p)_p\) on each OD，​结构性​守恒​。
  • FC-6 ledger: W11 ​优于​ W4 ​的​不是​模型​容量​而是​ head ​设计​。

docs.title: Case W4 (Liu–Meidani 2024, R21, Transp. Res. Part C, arXiv:2310.13193v3)
docs.text:
• Slot ​归位​: Slot 4 (state oracle) + Slot 1 (​隐式​ latency)。
  • ​输入​: hetero graph (node = intersection；edge = link with \(t_a^0, c_a\))；OD context；GNN message-passing \(L=4\)。
  • ​输出​: \(\hat{\mathbf{x}}^*\) ​链路​流​近似​。
  • Loss: MSE on \(\mathbf{x}^*_{\mathrm{UE}}\) (FW-converged ground truth) + soft conservation。
  • ​报告​效果​: ​据​该​论文​，SiouxFalls/Anaheim ​上​链路​流​ MAE ​比​ baseline GNN ​降​ 30%–50%；wall-clock \(\geq\) 100× ​比​ FW ​收敛​ (​具体​见​原文​ Tab 3)。
  • Critique: H1 latency monotone ​未​ enforce (FC-5)；soft conservation (FC-6) ​在​ stress test (​容量​收缩​) ​下​结构性​失守​。

Soft conservation ​的​具体​后果​是​: ​训练样本​ \(\{(\mathbf{d},\mathbf{x}_{\mathrm{UE}}^*)\}\) ​在​ (A1)–(A5) BPR ​下​满足​ \(A^\top\mathbf{f}=\mathbf{d}\)，​故​ GNN ​在​ in-distribution ​推断​时​近似​守恒​；​但​ capacity ​收缩​ (​新​ OD ​配置​或​新​ \(c_a\)) ​下​ GNN ​输出​ \(\hat{\mathbf{x}}\) ​已经​偏离​训练​分布​，soft penalty ​的​训练​-​时​残差​不再​有界于​推断​时​残差​，conservation ​失守​。

​这一​连锁​失效​是​ v4 ​把​ W11 (hard head) ​标为​工程​进步​的​根本原因​——hard head ​把​守恒​从​ statistical regularization ​升级​为​ architectural invariant。

docs.title: Case W5 (Rahman–Hasan 2025, R33, arXiv:2505.11230)
docs.text:
• Slot ​归位​: Slot 4 + Slot 1 (multi-task GNN metamodel)。
  • ​输入​: GNN backbone；multi-task head ​同时​预测​链路​流​ + ​链路​ latency。
  • Critique: ​同​ W4，H1 ​裸奔​ (FC-5)；venue ​未​ verify (FC-8) — ​本​ draft ​仅引​ arXiv ​编号​，​不写​ journal。W5 ​的​ multi-task head ​同时​输出​ \(\hat x_a\) ​与​ \(\hat t_a\) ​是​工程​上​有趣​的​设计​ — ​在​训练​时​ \(\hat t_a\) ​可​作为​辅助​ supervision (​与​真实​ BPR ​对比​)，​但​推断​时​仍​可能​在​分布​外​失去​ monotone ​性质​。​若​把​ multi-task head ​升级​为​ partial-ICNN readout (§S8 attack angle)，W5 ​是​离​ ICNN-GNN ​复合​最近​的​ baseline ​之一​。

docs.title: Case W11 (Ameli–Le–Shams–Skabardonis 2025, R25, arXiv:2510.19889)
docs.text:
• Slot ​归位​: Slot 4 (path-flow oracle)。
  • ​输入​: transformer encoder on (OD, candidate path) tokens；softmax-over-paths head。
  • ​输出​: ​直接​路​径流​ \(\hat{\mathbf{f}}\) (hard OD conservation per Property 8.3)。
  • ​效果​: ​据​该​论文​，path-flow ​估计​误差​比​ GNN baseline ​低​ (​具体​见​原文​ Tab 2)。
  • Critique: hard conservation ​是​工程​进步​ (FC-6)；H1 ​仍​未​ enforce (FC-5)；transformer ​复杂度​ \(O(|\mathcal{W}|^2)\) ​是​ Chicago Sketch ​等​大网​的​开放​瓶颈​。

W11 ​的​ path-flow ​直接​输出​ (​而​非​ link-flow ​输出​) ​在​数学​上​对应​路径​-​级​ Wardrop UE ​定义​ (Definition 3.1) ​而​非​链路​-​级​ (3.3) — ​这一​选择​是​有意​把​ P0 (Property 3.1) ​路径​解非​唯一​问题​用​ softmax-over-paths ​隐式​正则​化​解决​。

softmax ​输出​本质​上​是​ Logit SUE (Definition 4.1) ​的​ deterministic ​极限​形式​ (\(\theta\to\infty\))，​故​ W11 ​实际上​预测​的​是​ \(\theta\to\infty\) ​极限​ Logit SUE，​在​ UE ​与​ SUE ​之间​的​关系​ (§S4 Theorem 4.1) ​暗含​。​这一​精细化​在​论文​中未​显式标​，​但​解释​了​为何​ W11 ​的​ hard-conservation head ​在​数学​上​比​ W4 soft-conservation ​在​ (3.3) Wardrop ​设置​下​更​"​正确​" — ​它​选择​了​ (3.1) ​路径​解​的​一个​分布​。

docs.title: §S8.1 W4 / W5 / W11 ​工程​对比
docs.text:
维度​ W4 (R21) W5 (R33) W11 (R25) Backbone hetero GNN (\(L=4\)) GNN (multi-task) Transformer Slot 4 + ​隐式​ 1 4 + 1 (multi-task) 4 (path-flow) Conservation soft (loss term) n/a hard (softmax-over-paths) H1 monotone ​未​ enforce ​未​ enforce ​未​ enforce ​大网​可​扩展​ \(L\|E\|\) ​线性​ \(L\|E\|\) ​线性​ \(K\|\mathcal{W}\|\) token ​化​线性​ (candidate path ​截断​) ​主要​ FC FC-6 soft conservation ​失​ FC-8 venue ​未​ verify FC-6 hard conservation ​优​

​三​工作​共同点​是​ backbone ​不同​但​ H1 ​全​空缺​；W11 ​在​ conservation ​上​工程​进步​显著​但​ H1 ​仍​裸奔​——​这是​ §S8 attack angle ​即​ ICNN-GNN ​复合​的​根本​ motivation: ​把​ W4/W5/W11 ​的​ backbone (GNN ​或​ Transformer) ​与​ partial-ICNN readout ​复合​，​同时​获得​ backbone ​表达力​ + H1 architectural enforce + hard conservation。

docs.title: Attack angle (v4 ​中心​ critique, FC-5)
docs.text:
ICNN-GNN ​复合​: ​把​ GNN ​当​ backbone (​利用​ P3 ​的​有限​ \(L\) + ​异质​图​表达力​)，​链路​ readout ​用​ partial-ICNN (​关于​ \(x_a\) ​凸​ + ​单调​；P2)。​这​同时​把​ H1 ​由​"​训练​后验​"​升级​到​"​模型​构造​保证​"，​并​在结构上​避免​ over-smoothing ​与​ monotone ​失效​的​双重​风险​。Phase 0c-B ​整理​的​ 12 ​篇​ ML-aug TA ​工作​中无一​执行​此​组合​ (FC-5)，​这是​ v4 ​最​显著​的​ attack angle。

​具体​地​，​构造性​方案​分三步​: 1. GNN backbone: ​取​ \(L\leq 4\) ​层​ message-passing on ​异质​图​ (link/intersection/OD context)，​节点​嵌入​ \(\mathbf{h}_a^L\in\mathbb{R}^{d_L}\) for ​链路​ \(a\)。P3 over-smoothing ​在​ \(L\leq 4\) ​下​可控​ (SiouxFalls/Anaheim ​经验​)。 2. Partial-ICNN readout: \(\hat t_a(x_a;\phi) = \mathrm{softplus}\bigl(\mathbf{w}_1^\top z_1 + \mathbf{w}_2^\top z_2 + b\bigr) + t_a^0\)，​其中​ \(z_1 = W^{[1]}\,\mathbf{h}_a^L\) free，\(z_2 = (W^{[2]}_+ z_1) + W^{[2]}_x x_a\) ​且​ \(W^{[2]}_+\geq 0\) ​元素​级​非负​ (passthrough hidden weights) + \(\sigma\) ​凸非​递减​ (\(W^{[2]}_x\) ​不需​非负​——partial-ICNN ​关键​灵活性​，Amos–Xu–Kolter 2017 R34)；​为​获​ \(\hat t_a\) ​关于​ \(x_a\) ​单调​，​单​变量​ readout ​上​额外​要求​ \(W^{[2]}_x\geq 0\)。\(t_a^0\) ​加法​保证​ \(\hat t_a\geq t_a^0>0\)。 3. Loss: \(\mathcal{L} = \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{sup}}(\hat{\mathbf{x}},\mathbf{x}_{\mathrm{UE}}^*) + \beta_1\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{cons}}(A^\top\hat{\mathbf{f}},\mathbf{d})\) + ​可​选​ consistency-with-FW penalty。

​预期​收益​: H1 by construction；Beckmann ​凸性​ (Theorem 3.1) ​继承​；VI ​唯一性​ (Theorem 3.2) ​继承​；FW (Theorem 5.1) \(O(1/k)\) rate ​继承​到​ ML-aug TAP；​这是​经典​假设​链端​到​端​保持​的​最​干净​路径​。

​已知​工程​难点​: ICNN ​容量​有限​ (​单调​凸函数​族​表达力​低于​ free NN)；​与​ GNN over-smoothing ​之间​的​ capacity ​折中​需要​ ablation；hard conservation (Property 8.3 W11 ​风格​ softmax-over-paths) ​与​ ICNN readout ​的​组合​在​文献​中​完全​空缺​。​这是​ v4 ​给​后续​实证​工作​的​ concrete attack angle。

​评估​方案设计​: ICNN-GNN ​复合​相比​ W4/W5/W11 baseline ​的​ 3 ​项​关键​评估​指标​: 1. In-distribution UE prediction: ​在​训练​ OD/capacity ​分布​上​的​链路​流​ MAE — ​与​ W4/W5/W11 ​直接​对比​，​期望​ ICNN ​容量​限制​下​ MAE ​略升​ (​但​可控​)。 2. Out-of-distribution capacity stress: ​缩​ capacity ×0.5 / ×0.25 ​模拟​道路​施工​或​事故​，​检验​ H1 monotone ​在​分布​外​是否​保持​ — ICNN-GNN by construction ​保持​，W4 soft conservation ​失​，W11 hard conservation ​部分​保持​但​ H1 ​仍​裸奔​。 3. ​下游​ bilevel + IFT ​反传​稳定性​: ​把​ ICNN-GNN ​嵌入​ §S10 differentiable bilevel (​作​下层​ surrogate)，​检验​ IFT (6.2) ​反传​的​数值​稳定性​ — ICNN ​凸​+​单调​保证​ strong regularity ​在​非零流​上​自动​成立​，P7 BPR ​零流​奇异​在​ ICNN-GNN ​上​的​位置​被​平滑​ (​因​ ICNN ​输出​ \(>0\) even at \(x_a=0\) ​经​ softplus + bias)。

​这三项​指标​分别​覆盖​ base-line accuracy、robustness、​与​上层​任务​可用性​，​是​ v4 ​实证​工作​的​最​完整​ evaluation suite。

v4 vs v3: v3 ​罗列​ GNN/Transformer ​案例​；v4 ​把​它们​用​ Slot 1/4 ​与​ H1/Property P8 ​的​二维​矩阵​索引​，​并​把​ ICNN-GNN ​复合​作为​下​一步​可​执行​ attack angle ​显式​标出​。

docs.title: §S9 Deep RL & MARL for TA — Slot 2 & Slot 3 ​主战场
docs.text:
Model basis (MARL TA). - State space: \(N\) agents (​车辆​ / OD-router / EV)，joint state \(\mathbf{s}\in\mathcal{S}^N\) ​含​本地​观测​ + ​全局​图​嵌入​ + ​流量​上下文​。 - ​决策​变量​+​域​: joint action \(\mathbf{a}\in\mathcal{A}^N\)；CTDE (centralized training, decentralized execution) ​下​ \(\pi(\mathbf{a}\mid\mathbf{s})=\prod_i\pi_i(a_i\mid s_i)\) + centralized critic。 - Equilibrium: Markov game ​稳态​ Nash；H2 ​充分条件​下​ \(=\) Wardrop UE。 - ​约束​: \(\mathcal{A}_i\) ​上​ path-split ​或​ link-choice；​流​守恒​间接​通过​ reward ​鼓励​。 - ​假设​清单​: (A1)–(A5) + H2 ​充分条件​。

MARL TA ​在​ agent ​定义​上​有​三种​ lifting (Property 9.2 + cross-thread): 1. ​车辆​-​级​ agent (\(N\) ​数百万​): ​每辆车​独立​ agent，​决策​为​ link-choice (next-link selection)。Realistic ​但​ agent ​数过​大​ — ​文献​中​除非​用​ mean-field ​近似​否则​不​实用​。 2. OD-pair router agent (\(|\mathcal{W}|\) ​数百​到​数千​): ​每​ OD ​一​ agent，​决策​为​ path-split distribution over \(\mathcal{P}_{rs}\)。R24 W8 ​标准​选择​。 3. OD × SoC × DLMP ​三轴​ agent (\(|\mathcal{W}|\times|\mathcal{B}_{\mathrm{SoC}}|\times|\Lambda|\)): ​把​ EV-V2G ​引入​后​增加​ SoC + DLMP ​维度​。R32 W10' ​部分​实现​ (HGAT ​把​ EV agent ​与​ charging station agent ​分​类型​处理​)。

​三​ lifting ​与​ H2 ​兼容性​: ​车辆​-​级​ agent ​在​ nonatomic limit (\(N\to\infty\)) ​下​与​ Wardrop UE ​在​ mean-field ​意义​上​一致​；OD-pair router ​是​ atomic-router-game lifting，H2 ​充分条件​下​与​ Wardrop UE ​重合​；OD × SoC × DLMP ​三轴需​扩展​ Wardrop UE ​定义​到​ (3.3) + SoC + DLMP ​三轴​，​文献​中​精确​形式化​缺​。

docs.title: Definition 9.1 (DQN, Mnih et al. 2015 Nature 518:529–533, R34 W1)
docs.text: ​单​ agent value-based RL；​学​ action-value \(Q_\theta(s,a)\)，TD target \(r+\gamma\max_{a'}Q_{\theta^-}(s',a')\)。

docs.title: Definition 9.2 (MADDPG, Lowe et al. 2017 R34 W2)
docs.text: ​多​ agent actor-critic；​每​ agent ​有​ actor \(\pi_{\theta_i}\) + centralized critic \(Q^i(\mathbf{s},\mathbf{a};\eta_i)\)。Centralized critic ​在​训练​时​观测​ joint state + joint action，​在​执行​时​只用​本地​观测​做​决策​ — ​这是​ CTDE (centralized training, decentralized execution) ​的​核心​机制​。MADDPG ​在​ cooperative + competitive ​混合​设置​下​都​有效​，​但​缺乏​ IGM ​一致性​保证​ (multi-agent Q ​值​与​个体​最优​行动​可能​不​一致​)。

docs.title: Definition 9.3 (QMIX, Rashid et al. 2018 R34 W3)
docs.text:
Value decomposition \(Q_{\mathrm{tot}}(\mathbf{s},\mathbf{a})=f(\{Q_i(s_i,a_i)\}_i;\mathbf{s})\)，\(f\) ​单调​ (mixing network ​权重​ \(\geq 0\))，IGM (individual-global-max) ​一致性​。

IGM ​保证​ \(\arg\max_{\mathbf{a}}Q_{\mathrm{tot}}(\mathbf{s},\mathbf{a}) = (\arg\max_{a_i}Q_i(s_i,a_i))_i\) — ​这是​ cooperative ​设置​下​ decomposable ​团队​回报​的​正确性​条件​。QMIX ​通过​ mixing network ​的​单调​约束​ (​权重​生成器​输出​非负​权重​) ​来​ enforce IGM；fully decentralized execution ​无需​ critic on joint state。

​代价​: ​仅​适用​ cooperative ​场景​；​在​ path-routing ​这样​的​ nonatomic Wardrop ​类​ game ​下​ (​用户​自利​非​协作​)，QMIX ​不​直接​适用​，MADDPG / multi-agent PPO ​更​合适​。

docs.title: Property 9.1 (P5: MARL Nash \(\leftrightarrow\) Wardrop UE ​充分条件​)
docs.text: ​设​ (i) agent action ​取​ path-split simplex over \(\mathcal{P}_{rs}\)，(ii) reward \(r^i=-C_{p_i}(\mathbf{x})\) ​即​所选​路径​成本​之负​，(iii) \(\mathbf{t}\) link-separable monotone，(iv) Markov game ​稳态​。​则​在​ \(\mathcal{X}\) ​紧凸下​ MARL Nash ​对应​ Wardrop UE (Property P5 sketch via potential game argument; full proof open)。​警告​: ​这是​充分​而​非​必要条件​；​多​ Nash ​不​被​此​条件​排除​。

docs.title: Property 9.2 (P10a: agent reduction \(O(N)\to O(|\mathcal{W}|)\))
docs.text:
​把​ agent ​从​ \(N\) ​车辆​降​为​ \(|\mathcal{W}|\) OD-pair "router agent"，agent ​数从​ \(N\sim 10^4-10^6\) ​降到​ \(|\mathcal{W}|\sim 10^2-10^4\) (SiouxFalls \(|\mathcal{W}|=528\)；Anaheim \(|\mathcal{W}|=1406\))。​这是​ W8 (R24) ​在​ SiouxFalls ​上​达​ 94.99% gap reduction in 10 steps ​的​关键​工程​升降​。

P10 ​在​数学​上​对应​ nonatomic-game ​到​ atomic-router-game ​的​ lifting: ​每​ OD ​对​ \((r,s)\) ​由​一个​ router agent ​代表​，agent ​决策​是​ path-split distribution over \(\mathcal{P}_{rs}\)，​回报​是​该​ OD ​总​ expected travel time。​这种​ lifting ​把​ \(N\to\infty\) ​极限​下​的​ Wardrop UE (​无穷​多​无穷小​用户​) ​离散​化为​ \(|\mathcal{W}|\) ​个​ atomic router ​之间​的​ normal-form game — ​其​ Nash ​在​ (i)–(iv) ​充分条件​下​与​ Wardrop UE ​重合​ (Property 9.1)。

​但​ P10 lifting ​引入​两个​新​问题​:

(a) Atomic router ​是否​真能​恢复​ nonatomic limit (​经典​ atomic vs nonatomic-game ​差距​问题​，​文献​中有​多篇​研究​但​ ML-aug TA ​圈未​系统​引入​)； (b) ​训练​分布​与​部署​时​ OD ​分布​之间​的​ covariate shift — router agent ​在​训练​ OD ​上学​到​的​ policy ​推广​到​新​ OD ​是否​保持​ Nash \(\leftrightarrow\) Wardrop ​对应​。

W8 ​论文​给出​ SiouxFalls ​上​ fixed OD ​训练​经验​，​分布​外​推广​证据​未​给出​。

docs.title: Case W7 (Wang–Duan–Lyu–Ma 2025 MSA-guided DQN, arXiv:2505.20889, R23, 4 ​作者​)
docs.text:
• Slot ​归位​: Slot 2 + Slot 3 (DQN ​给​路径​选择​ + step ​长度​)；MSA (Method of Successive Averages) ​作​ bootstrap demonstration。
  • Equilibrium: SO-TA ​目标​ (​而​非​ UE)；single-agent ​视角​。
  • ​报告​效果​: ​据​该​论文​，​在​ SiouxFalls ​测试​上​ SO-TA gap ​比​ vanilla DQN ​显著​降低​ (​具体​见​原文​)。
  • Critique: single-agent；H2 ​不​直接​相关​；MSA bootstrap ​是​经典​ TAP ​求解​器​的​ demonstration ​经验​加速​，​未​给​收敛​证明​。

W7 ​把​ MSA ​作为​ demonstrator ​在​ DQN ​训练​早期​ bootstrap policy — ​这是​ imitation learning + RL hybrid ​的​工程​实例​，​与​ single-agent SO-TA ​目标​ (Wardrop ​第二​原则​) ​兼容​。​但​ MSA ​自身​在​ BPR ​上​的​收敛​速率​由​ §S5 Theorem 5.1 ​决定​ (\(O(1/k)\) sublinear)；DQN ​经验​加速​若仅​匹配​该​速率​不​构成​贡献​，​须​额外​报告​ wall-clock ​或​样本​效率​优势​。​论文​相关​数字​本​ draft ​不​复述​，​仅​指出​方法论​位置​。

docs.title: Case W8 (Wang–Duan–Lyu–Wang–He–Zheng–Ma 2025 MARL-OD-DA, arXiv:2506.17029, Communications in Transportation Research, DOI 10.1016/j.commtr.2025.100225, R24, 7 ​作者​)
docs.text:
• FC-1 ​锁定​: venue Communications in Transportation Research (NOT Transportation Research Part C; Phase 0a ​误标​已​纠正​)。
  • Slot ​归位​: Slot 2 + Slot 3；OD-pair router agent (Property 9.2)。
  • ​架构​: CTDE ​下​ Dirichlet actor (​输出​路径​分配​ simplex)；centralized critic on joint state。
  • ​报告​效果​: ​据​该​论文​，SiouxFalls (6×6 grid network ​类​ toy benchmark) ​上​ 10 ​步内​ relative gap reduction 94.99% vs Frank–Wolfe baseline (gap ​度量​定义​与​ baseline ​待​ primary verify; "10 ​步​" ​指​ RL outer epoch ​而​非​ FW inner iteration)；agent reduction \(|\mathcal{W}|=528\) ​比​车辆​级​ MARL \(N\sim 10^4\) ​显著​扩展性​提升​ (​具体​见​原文​ Tab 4)。Anaheim/Chicago Sketch ​等​中​-​大网​ scope ​文献​未​给​。​本​ survey ​引​为​方法​位置​说明​，​非​速率​证明​。
  • Critique (FC-5): H2 (Nash \(\leftrightarrow\) Wardrop) ​仅​经验性​验证​ (gap reduction ​数字​)，​未​给​ fixed-point ​证明​。Property 9.1 sketch ​只​覆盖​充分条件​而​不​排除​多​ Nash；​论文​未​讨论​多​ Nash ​风险​。

Dirichlet actor ​输出​ path-split simplex ​是​ §S7 Slot 2/3 ​的​具体​实现​，​与​ Property 9.1 (i) action = path-split simplex ​充分条件​一致​；centralized critic ​在​ CTDE ​下​给出​ joint state advantage estimate ​是​ reward (ii) \(r^i=-C_{p_i}\) ​的​近似​ — ​但​ critic ​收敛​到​ fixed-point ​才能​严格​对应​ Wardrop UE，​论文​报告​的​ gap reduction ​数字​是​ outer-loop ​经验​度量​而​不是​ inner-loop critic ​收敛​证明​。

critique ​落点​: ​即使​ critic ​完美​ fits joint Q ​函数​，​仍​需​ Dirichlet policy ​收敛​到​ Nash + Nash ​是​ Wardrop UE ​两步​证明​，​文献​中​两步​均​空缺​。​这​构成​ §S12 OP2 ​的​具体​形式​。

docs.title: Case W9 (Wu–Seshadri–Rodrigues–Lima Azevedo 2025, arXiv:2504.08074, Transportmetrica B DOI 10.1080/21680566.2025.2552884, R26)
docs.text:
• Slot ​归位​: ​上层​ DRL (toll updates) + ​下层​ MSA (UE solver) — Stackelberg bilevel。
  • Equilibrium: ​上层​ traffic congestion scheme (TCS) toll；​下层​ day-to-day UE。
  • ​报告​效果​: ​据​该​论文​，DRL ​自​适应​ TCS ​在​动态​需求​下​ outperform ​静态​ toll baseline (​具体​见​原文​)。
  • Critique (FC-5): ​下层​ MSA ​给出​ UE ​近似​；​上层​ DRL ​反传​未​显标​ IFT (H3)。Theorem 6.3 ​在​ BPR ​零流处​ singular (P7)，​论文​未​讨论​此​数值​警告​。

W9 ​采用​ model-free DRL (PPO ​类​) ​替代​ OptNet/cvxpylayers ​显式​反传​是​工程​上​聪明​绕开​ — ​上层​ reward ​直接​从​ simulation rollout ​取得​，​无需​通过​ (6.2) IFT ​反传​一阶​信息​。​但​代价​是​: (i) ​样本​复杂度​高​ (sample inefficiency ​是​ model-free DRL ​通病​)；(ii) ​上层​ toll policy ​与​下层​ UE ​之间​的​耦合​反映​在​ reward ​梯度​噪声​中​，​估计​方差​大​；(iii) ​在​ day-to-day ​设置​下​下层​ MSA ​收敛​步数​与​上层​ DRL update frequency ​之间​的​ multi-timescale ​一致性​条件​ (Borkar 1997 ​类​) ​论文​未​论证​。

​这​三点​构成​ W9 ​与​ OP3 ​数值​稳定化​方案​ (a)–(d) ​的​天然​ trade-off ​对照​。

docs.title: Case W10 (Donatus–Ter–Udekwe 2025 MARL ITS Survey, arXiv:2508.20315 v2 2026-03, R27)
docs.text:
• Slot ​归位​: meta (​综述​本身​)。
  • ​作用​: ​给​ MARL-in-ITS ​全景​；​含​ V2X ​章节​ (​与​ §S11 Thread C ​接口​)。
  • ​本​ draft ​把​ W10 ​作为​ secondary reference，​不​重复​其​结论​。W10 ​与​本​ v4 survey ​的​差异​定位​: W10 ​范围​更广​ (MARL in ITS ​全景​，​含​信号​控制​、​自动​驾驶​、​协同​感知​)，​本​ v4 narrower (​限于​ TA + EV-V2G-PDN)；W10 ​强调​ MARL ​方法​分类​，​本​ v4 ​强调​ hypothesis check (H1/H2/H3) ​与​经典​ TA ​假设​链​对接​。​两者​互补​不​冲突​。

docs.title: Case W10' (Mei–Zhang–Jiang–Xue–Zhang–Gao 2025, Applied Energy, DOI 10.1016/j.apenergy.2025.126958, R32, 6 ​作者​；​末位​全名​ David Wenzhong Gao)
docs.text:
• Slot ​归位​: Slot 2 + Slot 3 (MARL) + PDN-TN heterogeneous graph (Slot 4)。
  • cross-thread: §S11 Thread C ​主要​案例​；H2 ​未​证明​ (FC-5)；Nash \(\leftrightarrow\) Wardrop-with-DLMP ​对应​仅​经验​。

Attack angle (v4 ​中心​ critique): Wardrop UE ​是​ potential game ​的​不动点​，MARL Nash ​是​ Markov game ​的​稳态​——​两者​在​ (i)–(iv) ​充分条件​下​经典​工具​下应​等价​但​缺乏​ (a) BPR ​严格​-​非强​单调​下​ fixed-point ​收敛​速率​证明​，(b) ​多​ Nash ​排除​条件​，(c) ​与​ §S5 EG/OGDA \(O(1/\sqrt T)\) baseline ​的​实证​对照​。​这​三点​是​ §S12 open seam ​的​具体​形式​。

​具体​地​，"MARL Nash \(=\) Wardrop UE" ​在​ (i)–(iv) ​充分条件​下​的​证明​应​包含​:

(1) Potential function = Beckmann \(\Phi\) ​在​ path-split action space ​上​的​拓展​ (​本质​上​对​ simplex ​上​的​混合策略​求​期望​)； (2) MARL agent ​的​ policy gradient ​与​ Beckmann ​势​的​负​梯度​成​比例​ (​这一​性质​在​ link-separable monotone latency + path-split simplex action ​下​成立​)； (3) Markov game ​稳态​下​ policy ​收敛​点​是​ stationary policy ​的​不动点​ = Wardrop UE。

​三步​在​文献​中​各有​部分​结果​但端​到​端​综合​证明​缺失​ — ​这是​ §S12 OP2 ​的​具体​形式​。

docs.title: §S9.1 RL/MARL ​在​ TA ​上​的​工程​现状
docs.text:
RL/MARL ​在​ TA ​上​的​工程​现状​可​分为​三层​成熟度​: 1. ​概念​验证​: ​在​ SiouxFalls ​等​小网​ (\(|E|<100\)) ​上​展示​ RL ​经验​加速​；W7 (R23) / W8 (R24) ​属​此层​。​这​一层​文献​成熟​但​工程​价值​有限​ (​小网​经典​ FW ​已​数秒​收敛​)。 2. ​中等​规模​: ​在​ Anaheim/Winnipeg ​等​中网​ (\(|E|\sim 1000\)) ​上​展示​ RL ​与​ FW ​互补​ (RL warm-start FW，​或​ RL bootstrap MSA)。​这​一层​文献​尚少​；W9 (R26) ​在​动态​需求​下​展示​ RL TCS ​上层​是​初步​尝试​。 3. ​大网​部署​: Chicago Sketch / Berlin / ​北京​等​大网​ (\(|E|>10^4\)) ​上​的​ RL TA ​实际​部署​。​这​一层​文献​完全​空缺​ — ​这是​ §S12 OP2 + OP5 + OP6 ​共同​对应​的​工程​现实​差距​。

R32 W10' (Mei 2025) ​在​ PDN-TN coupled benchmark ​上​的​ MARL ​是​ EV ​设置​下​的​中等​规模​实验​，​介于​ (2)(3) ​之间​但​具体​ benchmark ​规模​未​在​本​ draft ​引用​具体​数字​。

v4 vs v3: v3 ​把​ W8 ​误归​ Transp. Res. C (FC-1)；v4 ​严格​按​ Crossref-verified venue Communications in Transportation Research ​引用​。R23 W7 4 ​作者​与​ R24 W8 7 ​作者​易​混​ — ​同一​作者群​ (Wang–Duan–Lyu) ​的​两篇​相关​但​独立​工作​；​本​ draft ​严格​用​作者​数​区分​。

docs.title: §S10 Differentiable bilevel TA + Transportation FM — Slot 4 ​顶层​ + ​上层​学习
docs.text: Model basis (differentiable bilevel TA). - State space: ​上层​ \(\mathbf{y}\in\mathcal{Y}\)，​下层​ \(\mathbf{x}^*(\mathbf{y})\in\mathcal{X}\)；OptNet / cvxpylayers ​把​下层​ QP/VI ​嵌入​可微图​ (Amos–Kolter 2017；Agrawal et al. 2019，R34)。 - ​决策​变量​+​域​: \((\mathbf{y},\mathbf{x}^*)\)；ML ​参数​ \(\Theta\) ​描述​上层​ policy \(\pi^{\mathrm{upper}}_\Theta\) ​或​ OD prior \(\hat{\mathbf{d}}_\Theta\)。 - Equilibrium ​或​ objective: ​上层​ task loss \(\mathcal{L}(\mathbf{y},\mathbf{x}^*(\mathbf{y}))\) via gradient \(d\mathcal{L}/d\Theta\) = \(\nabla_{\mathbf{y}}\mathcal{L}\cdot d\mathbf{y}/d\Theta + \nabla_{\mathbf{x}}\mathcal{L}\cdot (d\mathbf{x}^*/d\mathbf{y})(d\mathbf{y}/d\Theta)\)，​关键​项​ (6.2)。 - ​约束​: ​同​ §S6；​下层​ KKT ​写入​可微图​。 - ​假设​清单​: (A1)–(A5) + H3 (IFT regularity)。

docs.title: Definition 10.1 (OptNet/cvxpylayers, R34)
docs.text:
​对​ parameterized convex program \(\mathbf{x}^*(\mathbf{y})=\arg\min_{\mathbf{x}\in\mathcal{X}}f(\mathbf{x};\mathbf{y})\)，OptNet ​把​ KKT ​系统​写成​ implicit layer，​反传​梯度​由​ KKT ​线性化​得到​——​本质​是​ (6.2) ​的​工程​实现​。

​具体​地​，OptNet ​的​反传​过程​是​: ​前向​求解​ KKT ​系统​得到​ \((\mathbf{x}^*, oldsymbol{ u}^*, oldsymbol{\mu}^*)\) (primal-dual-​互补​乘子​)，​反传时​把​ KKT ​在​ active set ​上​线性化​得​线性方程组​ \(J\,d\mathbf{z}=g\) ​其中​ \(J\) ​是​ KKT Jacobian + \(d\mathbf{z}\) ​含​ \(d\mathbf{x}^*,d oldsymbol{ u},d oldsymbol{\mu}\)，\(g\) ​是​上游​ loss ​对​ \((\mathbf{x}^*, oldsymbol{ u}, oldsymbol{\mu})\) ​的​梯度​。\(J\) ​可逆​等价​于​ (Theorem 6.3) strong regularity。

​问题​来源​: BPR ​在​ \(x_a o 0\) ​处​ \(t_a'(x_a) o 0\) ​使​ \( abla_{\mathbf{x}\mathbf{x}}^2\Phi\) ​的​对角​元素​ → 0；​若该​链路​同时​ active (​即​ \(x_a^*=0\) ​是​ binding constraint)，​互补​条件​加上​ LICQ ​失效​，\(J\) rank-deficient — IFT ​失败​。

cvxpylayers (Agrawal et al. 2019) ​通过​ disciplined parametrized programming ​把​约束​自动​写为​ cone ​形式​并​求解​ cone primal-dual，​反传​同理​依赖​ cone KKT Jacobian ​可逆​。Property 10.1 P7 ​标记​的​这​一​警告​对​ OptNet/cvxpylayers/JaxOpt/Theseus ​等​所有​ implicit layer ​实现​普遍​适用​，​无法​通过​ framework ​切换​避免​。

docs.title: Property 10.1 (P7: BPR ​零流​ Hessian singular, IFT (6.2) ​失效​)
docs.text:
\(\nabla_{\mathbf{x}\mathbf{x}}^2\Phi(\mathbf{x};\mathbf{y}) = \mathrm{diag}(t_a'(x_a)) = \mathrm{diag}(\alpha\beta t_a^0 x_a^{\beta-1}/c_a^\beta)\)。 - \(x_a\to 0\Rightarrow t_a'(x_a)\to 0\) ⇒ Hessian rank-deficient ⇒ (6.2) ​反传​ ill-conditioned / NaN。 - \(x_a\to c_a\) ⇒ \(t_a'(x_a)\) ​大​ ⇒ Hessian ​条件​数​恶化​。 - ​后果​: differentiable bilevel TA ​在​ BPR ​网络​上​结构性​数值​不​稳定​；W9 (R26) ​用​ DRL+MSA ​绕过​显式​反传​，​但​代价​是​放弃​ IFT ​一阶​信息​。

​数值​实施​细节​: ​在​ SiouxFalls ​等​典型​网络​上​，​零流​链路​在​ UE ​处​比例​可​达​ 30%–40% (​即近​ 1/3 ​链路​未​被​使用​) — ​这是​ Wardrop ​第一​原则​的​直接​后果​ (​只有​最​短路​ + ​与​最​短路​ cost ​相等​的​路径​被​使用​)。​这​意味着​在​ IFT (6.2) ​反传​时近​ 1/3 ​对角​元素​接近​ 0，​整个​ Hessian rank deficiency ​显著​。

​实用​ mitigation ​方案​:

(i) active set masking ​仅​对​ \(x_a^*>\epsilon\) ​的​链路​计算​反传​梯度​； (ii) Tikhonov regularization \(\nabla_{\mathbf{x}\mathbf{x}}^2\Phi + \delta I\) ​给​一个​ small \(\delta>0\) ​保持​ invertibility ​但​破坏​ (6.2) ​精确性​； (iii) smoothed BPR \(t_a^\epsilon(x_a) = t_a^0(1+\alpha(\max(x_a,\epsilon)/c_a)^\beta)\) ​在​零流​附近​给​ \(t_a^{\epsilon\prime}(0) = \alpha\beta t_a^0\epsilon^{\beta-1}/c_a^\beta>0\) ​但​失去​ BPR ​在​零流处​的​物理​含义​ (​无​流量​时​ latency ​不​应有​梯度​)。

​三​方案​在​ TA ​圈​系统​对比​缺失​，​是​ §S12 OP3 ​的​子​问题​。

docs.title: Case W12 (Li–Xia–Shi–Xu–Yin–Huang 2024 OpenCity, arXiv:2408.10269, ACM TIST 2025, R22)
docs.text:
• Slot ​归位​: Slot 4 (state oracle, spatio-temporal forecasting FM)。
  • ​架构​: pre-train + fine-tune / zero-shot；spatio-temporal transformer encoder。
