Prog. 34 ​的​ Toll/NDP ​问题​用​ sensitivity-based descent ​计算​ \(\partial y^*/\partial x\)，​与​ IFT ​在​数学​上​同源​；​只是​ ML ​把​同一个​ trick ​用​在​ \(10^6\)-​参数​的​神经网络​里​反过来​反哺​了​ OR，​最​年轻​代表​是​ Li-Yu-Wang-Liu-Wang-Nie 2022（arXiv:2209.07618）differentiable Stackelberg congestion games，​用​ automatic differentiation through evolution path ​替代​经典​ Patriksson-Rockafellar sensitivity ​分析​。

docs.title: §2.5 ​视角​ E — ​多​决策者​ / ​不确定性​ / ​应用​驱动
docs.text:
LLS ​状态​：​视角​ E ​把​ LLS ​失效​当成​特征​而​非​ bug——EPEC、DAD、principal-agent、federated learning ​都​系统性​地​违反​ LLS。

Beck-Ljubić-Schmidt 2023 EJOR 311(2)（EURO Best EJOR Paper Award 2025）​把​不确定性​的​来源​拓宽​到​两类​。Abstract verbatim："The sources of uncertainty in bilevel optimization are much richer than for usual, i.e., single-level, problems since not only the problem's data can be uncertain but also the (observation of the) decisions of the two players can be subject to uncertainty。"[†v.s.] ​据此​可​铺开​：

  1. ​数据​不确定性​（stochastic / robust bilevel）：lower-level ​参数​随机化​或​最坏​情形​；
  2. ​决策​不确定性​（observation, near-optimal follower, intermediate solution concepts）：leader ​不能​精确​观察​ follower ​的​反应​、follower ​可能​只​达到​近似​最优​、​解​概念​在​ optimistic ​与​ pessimistic ​之间​存在​中间​形态​。

​视角​ E ​也​接受​多​ leader / ​多​ follower ​的​拓扑​。Aussel-Svensson (2025) ​给出​ SLSF / SLMF / MLSF / MLMF ​四​象限​分类​（A7）：​单​ leader ​单​ follower ​是​经典​ bilevel，​单​ leader ​多​ follower（​含​ Nash equilibrium constraint）​是​ MPEC with parametric VI，​多​ leader ​单​ follower ​是​ EPEC（D6, D11），​多​ leader ​多​ follower ​在​凸​情形​解​存在​性​仍​开放​。​视角​ E ​接受​ LLS ​在​这些​拓扑​下​系统性​违反​。

OR ​应用​谱系​。Caselli-Iori-Ljubić 2026 EJOR ​给出​ 6 ​大​应用​域​ taxonomy：transportation and logistics / production planning and manufacturing / water-waste-agriculture / supply chains (closed-loop, green pricing) / disaster prevention and response / bilevel pricing problems（​最后​一项​是​横切​轴​）。​视角​ E ​在​这里​把​ bilevel ​当成​"​建模​真实​多​ stakeholder ​决策​的​框架​"，​本质​难点​是​把​数学​性质​让​位于​建模​忠实度​。​这是​ OR ​学派​在​ 2010–2020 ​年代​之后​的​主旋律​。

ML ​表达​。​视角​ E ​在​ ML ​内部​最​年轻​的​化身​有​ federated bilevel optimization（SimFBO, C²DFB; arXiv:2305.19442 / 2410.14115）—— \(n\) ​个​ client ​各自​有​自己​的​ lower-level ​任务​，server ​协调​ upper-level，LLS ​在​每个​ client ​上​单独​成立​但​不同​ client ​的​ \(y^*\) ​之间​存在​异质性​。Pan-Li-Liu-Liu-Zhu-Zhu 2024（arXiv:2410.17431）​的​ Bayesian Stackelberg Markov game for federated robust learning（D15）​把​ D5 mech design + Markov game + meta-learning ​三合一​，​是​视角​ E "OR ​反哺​ ML" ​的​代表性​案例​。

docs.title: §3 ​三大​跨​视角​抓手
docs.text: §2.5 ​已​表明​视角​ E ​与​视角​ D ​在​ federated bilevel、Bayesian Stackelberg Markov FL ​等​场景​下​深度​重叠​。​事实上​五​视角​之间​存在​三个​共用​抓手​——​本​节​追问​哪些​概念​让​五​视角​合奏​起来​。§2 ​的​五大​视角​并​不是​五个​互不​交叉​的​领地​：​一位​成熟​的​ bilevel researcher ​通常​在​三个​抓​手上​同时​听到​所有​五个​视角​共振​——LLS ​枢纽​、hyperobjective、KKT/VF/IF ​等价​。​这​一节​把​三​抓手​分别​拆解​。

docs.title: §3.1 ​抓手​ 1：LLS（Lower-Level Singleton）​作为​枢纽​假设
docs.text:
​定义​。LLS ​在​ \(x\) ​处​成立​ iff \(|Y^*(x)| = 1\)，​记​为​ \(y^*(x)\)；​强​ LLS ​进一步​要求​ \(y^*(\cdot)\) ​在​ \(x\) ​处​ Lipschitz/​光滑​（IFT ​适用​）。

​文献​定位​。LLS ​在​ 5 ​篇​综述​中​明示​为​关键​分水岭​： - Dempe 2002 Ch.5：optimistic ​与​ pessimistic ​重合​ iff LLS。 - Liu et al. 2022 TPAMI §3.2：​明确​区分​ LLS（singleton）​与​ LLC（lower-level convex），​并用​ LLS+LLC ​作为​ IGBM ​的​工作​前提​。 - Zhang et al. 2024 SPM：​把​ "Tractable BLO" ​定义​为​ linear lower-level constraints + singleton solutions + strong convexity。 - Grazzi et al. 2026 §1：​直接​称​ LLS ​为​ "restrictive assumption"，​并​把​"​打破​ LLS"​当成​ BL→BO ​桥梁​的​核心​议程​。 - Pujara-Sinha 2025：​把​ LLS ​在​ evolutionary BO ​中​的​不​必要性​视为​ evolutionary path ​的​核心​优势​。

​为什么​ LLS ​是​枢纽​。​从​公式​ (1) ​出发​，​若​ LLS ​成立​则​公式​ (5) ​直接​把​ bilevel ​退化​为单​变量​ \(\min_x \Phi(x)\)，IFT ​给出​ hypergradient ​闭式​，​工程​上​几乎​能​用​所有​标准​非凸​优化​算法​。​若​ LLS ​不​成立​则​必须​在​ optimistic vs pessimistic vs intermediate ​之间​选择​解​概念​（Dempe-Loridan-Morgan-Wiesemann），\(\Phi(x) = F(x, y^*(x))\) ​不再​ well-defined，​必须​改用​ hyperobjective \(\varphi(x) := \min_{y \in Y^*(x)} F(x,y)\)（Chen-Xu-Zhang 2024 COLT），​后者​一般​不​连续​——​见​ §3.2。​一个​ toy ​例子​：​若​ follower ​有​两个​等​好​响应​ \(y_1, y_2\)，\(F(x,y_1)=0, F(x,y_2)=10\)，​则​"​该​" bilevel objective ​在​ \(x\) ​处​可以​是​ 0 (optimistic) ​或​ 10 (pessimistic) ​或​之间​任意​值​；LLS ​保证​只有​一个​响应​，​完全​避开​此​问题​。​因此​ LLS ​决定​ bilevel ​是​落入​ well-defined ​的​非凸​单层​问题​，​还是​落入​ ill-defined ​的​集值​优化​问题​。

​辨析​ LLS ​与​ LLC：LLS = property of \(Y^*(x)\)（cardinality 1）；LLC（lower-level convex）= property of \(f(x,\cdot)\)（​凸​）。LLC + Slater + strict convexity ⟹ LLS，​但​ LLS ​可以​在​无​ LLC ​下​成立​。​也​辨析​ LLS ​与​ LLS+SC bundle：​单纯​ LLS ​不够​给​ IFT，​要​ LLS + strong convexity + ​二次​连续​可微​才​有​ \(y^*(x)\) ​的​ Lipschitz/​光滑性​。​本​综述​说​ "LLS ​松绑​" ​是​简称​——​更​准确​是​ (LLS, SC, smoothness) ​三元​假设​的​逐项​松绑​：PL ​替代​ SC、σ-closeness/partial-calmness ​替代​ LLS+SC bundle ​的​不同​子集​。

​三条​绕道​。​从​ LLS ​的​失败​出发​，​文献​给出​了​三条​互不​重叠​但​互相​增强​的​绕道​。

docs.title: 绕道​ A：Partial calmness（OR ​侧​, Ye-Zhu 1995）
docs.text:
Ye-Zhu 1995 Optimization 33(1) / 2010 SIOPT 20(4)（A14）。​考虑​ VF reformulation（​公式​ 4）​的​ \(\eta\)-relaxed ​版本​：​松弛​ inner-optimality ​约束​为​ \(f(x,y) - v(x) + \eta = 0\)。​在​ \((x^*, y^*)\) ​处​ partial calmness ​成立​ iff ​存在​ \(\mu > 0\) ​与​邻域​ \(U\) ​使得​对​所有​ \((x,y,\eta)\) ​满足​该​松弛​约束​并​属于​ \(U\)（​参考​ Ye-Zhu 1995 Def 3.1）,

\[ F(x,y) - F(x^*, y^*) + \mu \cdot |\eta| \ge 0. \]

Prop. 4.2 ​给出​ LBP ​自动​满足​、Prop. 4.3 ​给出​ inner-max ​形式​自动​满足​。​在​ partial calmness ​下​ VF reformulation ​给出​非​局部​ KKT ​必要条件​。Partial calmness ​直接​替代​ LLS——​这是​ OR ​学派​ 1995 ​年​给​ ML ​早​ 20 ​年​准备​好​的​绕道​。

docs.title: 绕道​ B：Hyperobjective \(\varphi\)（ML ​侧​, Chen-Xu-Zhang 2024）
docs.text: Chen-Xu-Zhang 2024 COLT, PMLR 247:947-980, arXiv:2301.00712（A13）。Hyperobjective ​把​ set-valued \(Y^*(x)\) ​显式​ reduce ​到​ scalar：\(\varphi(x) := \min_{y \in Y^*(x)} F(x,y)\)。​它​在​ LLS ​不​成立​时​仍然​ well-defined（​虽然​不​一定​连续​）。​算法​目标​改写​为​ \(\inf_x \|\nabla \varphi(x)\|\)；hardness ​与​ tractable case ​见​ §3.2 ​与​ §8。

docs.title: 绕道​ C：σ-closeness / penalty（​桥梁​, Shen-Chen 2023）
docs.text:
Shen-Chen 2023 ICML; Xiao-Shen-Chen 2025 Math. Program., arXiv:2302.05185（A16）。[†v.s.] Penalty ​方法​的​标准​思路​：​把​"​难​处理​的​约束​"​乘以​系数​ \(\sigma\) ​加进​目标​，​让​违反​约束​的​解​通过​梯度​自然​被​推回​；​这里​要​ penalize ​的​"​难​约束​"​是​ inner-optimality \(f \le v\)。​具体​地​

\[ L_\sigma(x, y) := F(x, y) + \sigma \cdot (f(x, y) - v(x)).\tag{6} \]

​存在​ \(\sigma_0 > 0\) ​使得​对​ \(\sigma \ge \sigma_0\)，\(\min L_\sigma\) ​的​局部​解​收敛​到​原​ bilevel ​的​局部​解​；penalty ​与​ hyperobjective stationary point ​之间​的​距离​为​ \(O(1/\sigma)\)（σ-closeness ​定理​；​精确​不等式​形式​见​ §12 caveats A16）。​这​把​ partial calmness（OR）​与​ hyperobjective（ML）​在​数学​上​联结​，​并​直接​催生​ F2SA / BOME / F²BA / ScaleBiO ​四代​现代​ fully first-order ​算法​。

​统一​图景​。Partial calmness ​是​ OR ​学派​的​ LLS ​替代品​（Ye-Zhu 1995），hyperobjective ​是​ ML ​学派​的​ LLS ​替代品​（Chen-Xu-Zhang 2024），σ-closeness ​是​ 2023 ​年​以来​的​桥梁​。​三者​并不矛盾​，​而是​同一​ LLS ​失败​问题​在​三种​数学​语言​下​的​解决方案​。

docs.title: §3.2 ​抓手​ 2：Hyperobjective ​作为​统一​对象
docs.text:
Chen-Xu-Zhang 2024 COLT ​把​ hyperobjective ​显式​抬​到​中心​：

\[ \varphi(x) := \min_{y \in Y^*(x)} F(x, y),\quad Y^*(x) := \arg\min_y f(x, y), ag{7} \]

​并​把​ bilevel ​算法​问题​重述​为​"​找​ \(\| abla \varphi(x)\| \le \epsilon\) ​的​ stationary point"。​直觉​上​：​在​ follower ​的​ tied-for-best ​响应​集中​，leader ​选​自己​最​喜欢​的​一个​。​这个​"​挑​最​爱​"​操作​让​ \(\varphi\) ​在​ \(Y^*(x)\) ​为​ set-valued ​时​仍良​定义​，​但​在​ \(x\) ​让​ tied ​集​形状​变化​处​可能​不​连续​。

​本​综述​集中​讨论​ optimistic hyperobjective \(\varphi\)。Pessimistic ​版本​ \(\varphi_p(x) := \max_{y \in Y^*(x)} F(x,y)\) ​在​ OR ​对抗​应用​（DAD、interdiction）​中​自然​出现​——leader ​不能​假设​ follower ​会​向​自己​倾斜​响应​。Loridan-Morgan 1996 J. Glob. Optim. 8 ​证明​ pessimistic ​解​概念​在​一般​ ill-posed（​可能​无​解​，​即使​ optimistic ​有解​）；​需​ viscosity regularization ​重塑​良​定性​。§9 ​详述​。

​当​ LLS ​成立​时​ \(\varphi(x) = \Phi(x) = F(x, y^*(x))\)。​当​ LLS ​失效​时​ \(\Phi\) ​不再​ well-defined，\(\varphi\) ​仍​ well-defined（​不必​连续​）。​这是​ hyperobjective ​相对​ \(\Phi\) ​的​本质​优势​。

​三个​优势​：

  • ​统一​三​视角​：​视角​ A ​的​ optimistic bilevel \(\min_x \min_{y\in R(x)} F\) ​就是​ \(\min_x \varphi(x)\)；​视角​ C ​的​ IF ​重写​ \(\Phi\) ​在​ LLS ​下​就是​ \(\varphi\)；σ-closeness（​公式​ 6, §3.1 ​绕道​ C）​把​视角​ C ​的​ VF reformulation ​与​ \(\varphi\) ​联结​起来​。
  • ​不​依赖​ LLS：\(\varphi\) ​在​ set-valued \(Y^*\) ​时​仍然​ well-defined（​虽然​可能​不​连续​）。
  • ​直接​对应​ hardness：Chen-Xu-Zhang 2024 ​在​ nonconvex-convex bilevel ​中​构造​例子​——\(Y^*(x)\) ​随​ \(x\) ​穿过​临界​面​跳变​，\(\min_{y\in Y^*(x)} F(x,y)\) ​不​连续​。​他们​给出​ zero-respecting algorithm ​下界​ \(\Omega( ext{poly}(\epsilon^{-1}))\)——​比​ single-level ​严格​更差​。​这​把​ bilevel ​的​"intrinsic hardness"（Colson-Marcotte-Savard 2007）​从​ NP-hard ​的​ worst-case ​复杂度​扩展​到​ first-order oracle ​模型​下​的​ lower bound。

Tractable case (PL)。PL（Polyak-Łojasiewicz）​是​最弱​的​"​梯度​主导​"​条件​，​保证​ GD ​收敛​——​不​要求​最优​解​唯一​，​只​要求​ \(\| abla\|\) ​控制​ sub-optimality gap。​这​正是​ PL ​作为​ LLS ​替代品​的​关键​：​允许​多个​最优​解​，​但保​ \(\varphi\) ​温顺​。​形式​上​，Chen-Ma-Zhang 2025 JMLR 26(109)（F²BA, arXiv:2306.14853）​证明​在​ PL ​条件​

\[ frac12 \| abla_y f(x,y)\|^2 \ge \mu \,(f(x,y) - \min_{y'} f(x,y')), ag{8} \]

​之下​，​加之​ \(Y^*(x)\) ​有​界​ + \(F\) ​在​ \(Y^*\) ​上​一致​ Lipschitz ​等​附加​假设​，hyperobjective \(\varphi\) a.e. ​可微​ + Lipschitz；F²BA ​在​ deterministic ​设定​下​达到​ \( ilde O(\epsilon^{-2})\)、partially stochastic ​下​ \( ilde O(\epsilon^{-4})\)、fully stochastic ​下​ \( ilde O(\epsilon^{-6})\)，​前​两个​是​ near-optimal（​与​ single-level ​同阶​）。PL ​不保​ LLS（​解集​可​不止​一点​），​但保​ \(\varphi\) ​充分​良性​——​这是​ LLS ​的​第一次​显式​松绑​。

Hyperobjective ​与​ σ-closeness ​的​桥​。Shen-Chen 2023 ​的​ penalty ​函数​ \(L_\sigma\) ​的​ stationary point ​与​ \(\varphi\) ​的​ stationary point ​间距​ \(O(1/\sigma)\)。​这​把​ penalty-based ​算法​（F2SA / BOME / F²BA）​的​收敛​分析​直接​还原​到​ hyperobjective ​的​可达性​分析​。​本质​上​，penalty ​是​ hyperobjective ​的​数值​实现​。

Caveat（​对​ hyperobjective ​的​边界​）。​算法​在​非​凸非​平滑​ ML（DARTS、RLHF、ScaleBiO）​上​仍然​运行​，​而​ PL ​在​ 30B-LLM ​上​未经​验证​——​这​意味着​ \(\varphi\) ​在​ Phase 3-4 ​中是​收敛​分析​的​ normative ​对象​（"​我们​希望​算法​逼近​的​目标​"），​不​一定​是​ descriptive ​对象​（"​算法​事实上​计算​的​对象​"）。​在​ nonsmooth \(\varphi\) ​上​，​正确​的​变分​对象​可能​是​ Clarke subdifferential \(\partial \varphi\) ​而​不是​单点​梯度​，​相应​的​ stationarity ​是​ Goldstein \((\delta,\epsilon)\)-stationary（Zhang-Lin-Jegelka-Sra-Jadbabaie 2020）​而​非​ \(\| abla\| \le \epsilon\)。​这​在​ §10 O1 ​作为​开放​问题​展开​。

docs.title: §3.3 ​抓手​ 3：KKT / VF / IF ​三足鼎立
docs.text:
Zhang-Khanduri-Tsaknakis-Yao-Hong-Liu 2024 IEEE SPM（arXiv:2308.00788）​首次​把​ ML ​侧三大​算法​框架​按​数学​结构​归纳​为​ IF / GU / VF。​结合​视角​ C ​的​ OR ​经典​ KKT ​支柱​，​本​综述​给出​综合​比较​表​如下​。

​阅读​指引​：​每个​ pillar ​要求​不同​假设​（LLS、convexity、CQ），​三座​桥​ (Source、σ-closeness、partial-calmness) ​是​ equivalence proofs ​在​附加条件​下​连接​ pillars。​表​本身​就是​"​哪个​假设​买到​哪种​ reformulation"​的​地图​。

​支柱​ ​数学​形式​ LLS LL ​凸性​ / CQ ​需求​ ​代价​ OR ​代表​ ML ​代表​ KKT/MPCC（​公式​ 3） \(\nabla_y f + \lambda^\top \nabla_y h = 0,\ \lambda \perp h\) ​不​要求​ LL ​凸​ + Slater ​是​充要​等价​的​前提​；​无凸性​只是​ relaxation。MPCC-LICQ；​标准​ LICQ/MFCQ ​必然​失效​ Complementarity → NP-hard；​非标准​ stationarity D6 EPEC, D1 toll C6 Biggio SVM poisoning（KKT ​闭式​） VF（​公式​ 4） \(f \le v\), \(h \le 0\) ​不​要求​ Partial calmness（Ye-Zhu 1995） \(v\) nonsmooth, nondiff a.e. D14 Herrala 2025 strong-duality energy markets B18 F2SA, B20 PBGD, B23 ScaleBiO IF（​公式​ 5） \(\Phi(x) = F(x, y^*(x))\) ​必需​ LL ​严格凸​ + ​二次​连续​可微​ + \(\nabla^2_{yy} f\) ​可逆​ Hessian inverse (​罕见​, D2/D9 sensitivity ​是​其​ OR ​表亲​) B7 Lorraine 2020, C1-C11 HPO/meta ​主线​ Hyperobjective（​公式​ 7） \(\varphi(x) = \min_{y\in Y^*(x)} F(x,y)\) ​不​要求​ \(\varphi\) ​可不​连续​（Chen-Xu-Zhang 2024） ​算法​ hardness (​定义​ only) B22 hardness / F²BA tractable case

​三足鼎立​的​现代​理解​：σ-closeness ​把​ VF ​与​ hyperobjective ​联结​起来​；Source TDA（Bae-Lin-Lorraine-Grosse 2024 NeurIPS, arXiv:2405.12186, C18）​把​ IF ​与​ GU（​即​ ITD）​联结​起来​——​它​在​算法​层面​给出​ IF ​与​ GU ​的​ hybrid，​正是​ Zhang 2024 SPM IF/GU/VF ​三​视角​统一​的​技术​实现​。​因此​三足鼎立​并非​三条​平行线​，​而是​ 2023 ​年​以来​通过​两座​桥​变成​一个​连通​三角​：IF ​顶​（​要求​ LLS+SC）​通过​ Source ​与​ GU ​顶​（​要求​ unroll ​可​解释​）​连通​；VF ​顶​（​要求​ partial calmness）​通过​ σ-closeness ​与​ IF/GU ​联结​；Chen-Xu-Zhang 2024 ​的​ hyperobjective ​在​ VF ​之下​作为​底层​对象​，​把​ partial calmness ​与​ hyperobjective stationarity ​通过​ \(O(1/\sigma)\) ​距离​联系​起来​。​下图​给出​三足鼎立​的​连通​三角​：

flowchart TD
    IF["IF<br/>(LLS + SC)"] -- Source --- GU["GU<br/>(unroll)"]
    IF -- σ-closeness --- VF["VF<br/>(partial calmness)"]
    GU -- σ-closeness --- VF
    VF -- "O(1/σ)" --- Phi["Hyperobjective φ<br/>(Chen-Xu-Zhang 2024)"]

​这一​三角​是​ §2 ​视角​ C / ​视角​ D ​的​最​现代​综合​，​也​是​后面​ §4 ​算法​演化​的​几何​骨架​——§4 ​把​这张​静态​三角​变成​ moving picture：ML bilevel ​社区​从​ IF ​顶​起步​（Phase 1-2），​走​到​ VF（via σ-closeness, Phase 3），​再​通过​ Source TDA ​回桥​（Phase 4 C18）。§3.1 ​的​三条​绕道​在​ §4 ​里​被​ instantiate ​为​ 4 ​个​算法​支系​。​下​一节​进入​这​条​算法​主线​。

docs.title: §4 ​算法​演进​ 4 ​阶段​：LLS ​松绑​史
docs.text:
​把​ 2016–2025 ​的​ bilevel ML ​算法​按​假设​ regime ​排成​ 4 ​个​支系​——​而​非​严格​的​ generational sequence。2025 ​年​的​ NBO（Newton-based BO, B27）​重新​引入​ Hessian，​表明​ Phase 1 ​风格​的​工作​在​ Phase 4 ​时间段​仍​持续​生长​。​更​准确​的​解读​是​ 4 ​个​并行​谱系​，​按​应用​ regime（ill-conditioning vs scale vs sample efficiency）​划分​。​本​节​延续​ Hong ICCOPT 2022 tutorial ​的​时间​线​骨架​（§12 caveats S16）。

​术语​澄清​。Hessian-free / fully first-order / HVP-only ​是​三个​嵌套​但​不同​的​术语​：Hessian-free ​不​组装​完整​ \(H\) ​但​允许​ HVPs；HVP-only ​只​通过​ autodiff ​用​ HVP（​仍涉​二阶​）；Fully first-order ​只用​ \(F, f\) ​梯度​，​无​任何​二阶​信息​。Phase 2 ​是​ HVP-only，Phase 3-4 ​才​是​真正​的​ fully first-order。

docs.title: Phase 1 (2016–2020): LLS + SC + Hessian
docs.text:
LLS ​状态​：LLS + SC ​默认​；​显式​ Hessian ​或​ HVP via CG/Neumann。

​代表​算法​：

  • HOAG（Pedregosa 2016 ICML, PMLR 48:737-746, arXiv:1602.02355; B12）—— ML ​侧​ bilevel ​的​第一个​真正​算法​，outer ​加​ CG ​内层​求​ IFT ​中​的​ Hessian-vector solve。
  • ITD / Unrolled differentiation（Maclaurin-Duvenaud-Adams 2015 ICML, arXiv:1502.03492; Franceschi-Donini-Frasconi-Pontil 2017 ICML, arXiv:1703.01785; B9）—— ​把​ inner T ​步​ SGD ​当成​显式​可微​ trajectory，​反向​传播​至​超参​；memory \(O(T)\) reverse ​或​ time \(O(Td)\) forward。ITD biased（\(T \to \infty\) unbiases），​与​ AID ​的​ unbiased + controllable error ​形成​对照​（​参考​ Grazzi-Franceschi-Pontil-Salzo 2020 ICML "Iteration Complexity of Hypergradient Computation"）。
  • AID（Pedregosa 2016 → Ji-Yang-Liang 2021 ICML formalized, arXiv:2010.07962; B8）—— Approximate Implicit Differentiation；​这一​规范化​论文​区分​ gradient calls vs HVP calls oracle ​模型​并​给出​对比​：AID \(O(\kappa^3 \epsilon^{-2})\)、ITD \(O(\kappa^4 \epsilon^{-2})\)、stocBiO \(O(\epsilon^{-2})\)。
  • IFT + Neumann（Lorraine-Vicol-Duvenaud 2020 AISTATS, arXiv:1911.02590; B7）—— ​用​ Neumann ​级数​近似​公式​ (5) ​的​ Hessian ​逆​：
\[ H^{-1} \approx \sum_{k=0}^{K}(I - \alpha H)^k \alpha. \]

​若​ \(\alpha\) ​取使​ \(\|I - \alpha H\| < 1\)（\(H\) ​正定​且​谱​有界​），​这​就是​几何级数​ \(\sum (1-r)^k = 1/r\) ​的​矩阵​版​——​避开​显式​ \(H^{-1}\)，​付出​ \(K\) ​个​ HVPs ​的​代价​。memory \(O(1)\) in \(T\)，time \(O(K \cdot d)\)。​首次​ scale ​到​ \(\sim 10^6\) HPs（C11）。

​应用​对应​。C1 HPO / C2 MAML / C6 Biggio poisoning / C7 Koh-Liang influence functions。​这一​阶段​的​核心​工作​是​在​ LLS+SC ​假设​下​把​ Hessian-inverse ​这​一步​做​ scalable。

docs.title: Phase 2 (2020–2022): LLS + SC + HVP only
docs.text:
LLS ​状态​：LLS+SC ​仍​是​默认​；​但​通过​ stochastic / single-loop ​把​ HVP ​从​显式​ Hessian ​降级​为​隐式​ oracle。

​下表​汇总​ Phase 2 ​主要​算法​（​每行​一篇​论文​，​列出​ oracle ​类型​、​复杂度​、​设定​）：

​算法​ (​引用​) Loop Oracle ​复杂度​ ​设定​ BSA (Ghadimi-Wang 2018, arXiv:1802.02246; B10) double HVP \(O(\epsilon^{-2})\) SC / \(O(\epsilon^{-3})\) NC ​第一个​ stochastic bilevel TTSA (Hong-Wai-Wang-Yang 2023 SIOPT 33(1); B15) two-timescale HVP \(O(\epsilon^{-5/2})\) NC / \(O(\epsilon^{-3/2})\) SC SC inner + projected NC outer SUSTAIN (Khanduri et al. 2021 NeurIPS, arXiv:2102.07367; B14) single-timescale HVP \(O(\epsilon^{-3/2})\) near-optimal NC-SC + double momentum VR STABLE (Chen-Sun-Xiao-Yin 2022 AISTATS PMLR 151; B17) single-loop HVP \(O(\epsilon^{-2})\) NC / \(O(\epsilon^{-1})\) SC single-timescale SOBA / FSLA (Dagréou 2022; Li-Gu-Huang 2022 AAAI, arXiv:2112.04660; B11) single-loop HVP matches BSA SC/PL inner stocBiO (Ji-Yang-Liang 2021 ICML; B16) — HVP \(O(\epsilon^{-2})\) complexity normalization ​论文​ contraction-BO (Grazzi-Pontil-Salzo 2023 JMLR 24, arXiv:2202.03397; B29) — HVP optimal \(\tilde O(\epsilon^{-2})\) LL contraction \(L<1\) ​替代​ SC

SUSTAIN ​的​"near-optimal" ​指​匹配​ Arjevani et al. 2023 ​给出​的​ single-level \(\Omega(\epsilon^{-3/2})\) ​下界​。

​应用​对应​。C3 iMAML ​的​ proximal SC ​是​这​一​阶段​的​代表性​"​强制​ LLS"trick；C9 DEQ ​用​ contraction \(L<1\) ​替代​ SC（​与​ B29 ​互补​）；C7 Koh-Liang ​的​ LiSSA HVP ​也​属于​这​一代​。

docs.title: Phase 3 (2022–2024): LLS removed + PL + first-order
docs.text:
LLS ​状态​：LLS ​首次​系统性​松绑​——​通过​ σ-closeness ​把​ VF + PL ​替代​ IFT + LLS+SC。Hessian-free ​成为​新​默认​。

Phase 3 ​中心思想​：​与其​计算​ Hessian-vector product（Phase 2 ​残留​的​二阶​信息​），​不如​直接​把​内层​最优性​ gap penalize ​到​外层​目标​。​只​需​梯度​——"fully first-order"——​在​更弱​的​ σ-closeness / PL ​条件​下​工作​而​非​要求​ SC。​代表​算法​：

  • BOME!（Ye-Liu-Wright-Stone-Liu 2022 NeurIPS, arXiv:2209.08709; B19）—— "Bilevel Optimization Made Easy"，single-loop，fully first-order，​假设​：upper objective \(F\) nonconvex + lower objective \(f\) PL + smooth；​首个​ fully first-order ​的​非​渐进​收敛​率​。
  • F2SA（Kwon-Kwon-Wright-Nowak 2023 ICML, PMLR 202, arXiv:2301.10945; B18）—— Triple-loop fully first-order。​沿用​ Kwon et al. 2023 Tables 1-2 ​报告​的​复杂度​（​具体​指数​请​回查​原文​，§12 caveats B18）：deterministic outer ​约​ \(\tilde O(\epsilon^{-3/2})\)、partially stochastic ​约​ \(\tilde O(\epsilon^{-5/2})\)、fully stochastic ​约​ \(\tilde O(\epsilon^{-7})\)。​带​ momentum variance reduction ​后​改进​到​ \(\tilde O(\epsilon^{-2})\) ​区间​。
  • PBGD（Shen-Chen 2023 ICML; Xiao-Shen-Chen 2025 Math. Program., arXiv:2302.05185; B20）—— Penalty-Based Gradient Descent，single-loop first-order，partial calmness ​或​ PL ​即可​，​不​要求​ SC，\(O(\epsilon^{-4})\) NC / \(O(\epsilon^{-2})\) SC outer。
  • F²BA（Chen-Ma-Zhang 2025 JMLR 26(109), arXiv:2306.14853; B21）—— Two-time-scale fully first-order，​从​ Kwon 2023 ​的​ \(\tilde O(\epsilon^{-3})\) ​改进​到​ near-optimal \(\tilde O(\epsilon^{-2})\)。

​理论​支柱​。A13 hyperobjective hardness、A15 PL ​下​ \(\varphi\) ​良性​、A16 σ-closeness——​三者​把​ Phase 3 ​算法​的​"​为什么​不​需要​ LLS"​严格​化​。

​应用​对应​。C8 PARL RLHF / C15 SPO LLM safety —— inner policy/safe-region ​非凸​（​不​满足​ SC），fully first-order ​实际上​是​唯一​可行​的​算法​路径​。

docs.title: Phase 4 (2023–2025): LLS removed + scale
docs.text:
LLS ​状态​：​在​ Phase 3 ​的​ LLS-free ​基础​上​把​ scale ​推​到​ 30B-​参数​ LLM ​与​ federated / distributed / Riemannian。

​代表​算法​：

  • ScaleBiO（Pan-Zhang-Zhang-Pan-Xu-Zhang-Pi-Wang-Zhang 2024, arXiv:2406.19976; B23 / C16）—— ​把​ F2SA-style first-order bilevel ​与​ LISA (Layerwise Importance Sampled AdamW) memory trick ​结合​，​首次​在​ Llama-3-8B / Gemma-2-9B / Qwen-2-7B / Qwen-2.5-32B ​上​跑​通​ bilevel data reweighting；​外层​变量​ \(w \in \Delta^{m-1}\)，​内层​是​ LLM ​参数​ \(\theta \in \mathbb{R}^{3\times 10^{10}}\)。
  • SimFBO / C²DFB（Yang-Xiao-Ji 2023 NeurIPS, arXiv:2305.19442; arXiv:2410.14115; B24）—— federated bilevel，matches centralized rates with \(1/n\) communication factor。
  • Riemannian BO（Han-Mishra-Jawanpuria-Takeda 2024 NeurIPS; Dutta et al. 2025 JMLR 26; B25）—— \(\tilde O(\epsilon^{-2})\) matching Euclidean。
  • NBO curvature-aware（Dong-Yang-Yao-Zhang 2025 ICML, arXiv:2505.02101; B27）—— Newton-based BO，​与​ fully first-order ​反向​ trend，​再次​启用​ Hessian ​以​换取​ ill-conditioning ​韧性​；NBO ​的​存在​表明​ Phase 1 ​风格​在​ Phase 4 ​时间段​并未​退场​，​而是​按​ ill-conditioning regime ​平行​生长​。
  • Lower bounds（arXiv:2511.19656; B26）—— NC-SC det \(\Omega(\kappa^{3/2}\epsilon^{-2})\) / stoch \(\Omega(\kappa^{5/2}\epsilon^{-4})\)；F²BA ​在​ condition number factor ​上​未​ match。

​应用​对应​。C16 ScaleBiO LLM data reweighting / C17 TLL trilevel / C18 Source TDA。

​四​阶段​的​统一​叙事​。​把​ LLS ​与​ Hessian ​两个​轴​交叉​做​一张​表​：

Phase ​时期​ LLS Hessian scale ​代表​ 1 2016-2020 + ​显式​或​ CG/Neumann \(10^6\) HPs HOAG, ITD, AID, IFT+Neumann 2 2020-2022 + HVP only \(10^7\) params TTSA, SUSTAIN, STABLE, SOBA, contraction-BO 3 2022-2024 − none (first-order) \(10^9\) params F2SA, BOME, PBGD, F²BA 4 2023-2025 − none / curvature \(10^{10}\) params (LLM) ScaleBiO, SimFBO, Riemannian, NBO

​每一​阶段​的​转折点​都​对应​ §3.1 ​三条​绕道​之一​：Phase 1→2 ​由​ stochastic + single-loop ​的​工程​进展​推动​；Phase 2→3 ​由​ σ-closeness + PL + hyperobjective ​三个​理论​突破​共同​推动​；Phase 3→4 ​由​规模化​突破​（LISA, federated, Riemannian）​推动​。LLS ​松绑​是​ 2022–2024 ​之间​的​关键​理论​跳变​。​但​ 4 ​个​ phase ​并非​严格​ generational——NBO 2025 ​重新​启用​ Hessian ​表明​各​ phase ​在​ 2025 ​后​并行​存在​，​按​问题​ regime ​选择​支系​是​更​准确​的​读法​。Counter-reading：​把​ ML 2022-2024 ​当​ OR 1995 ​同等​ contribution ​是​ ML-biased revisionism；OR 1995 ​已有​ partial calmness、1996 ​已有​ MPCC、1990 ​已有​ value-function reformulation。​真正​的​ ML ​贡献​不是​ ​理论​上​ ​的​ LLS ​松绑​，​而是​ ​工程​上​ ​在​ \(10^9\)-\(10^{10}\) ​参数​规模​上​把​ OR 1995-2000 ​的​洞察​首次​算法​化​（F2SA/F²BA/ScaleBiO）。

​下​一节​从​算法​骨架​转向​应用​谱系​：§5 ​给​ ML ​侧​，§6 ​给​ OR ​侧​。

docs.title: §5 ML ​应用​谱系
docs.text: §4 ​的​算法​骨架​由​什么​应用​驱动​？§5 ​给出​ ML ​侧​、§6 ​给出​ OR ​侧​。​每条​应用​按​ §4 ​阶段​编号​ + LLS ​状态​ tag ​展开​。ML ​侧​ bilevel ​应用​按​ Chen et al. 2023 ​综述​的​ single-task / multi-task ​切分​如下​铺开​。

docs.title: §5.1 HPO ​谱系​ (C1 → C11 → C16): ​规模​阶梯​ \(10^3 \to 10^6 \to 10^{10}\)
docs.text:
HPO ​是​ ML bilevel ​最​纯粹​的​化身​：outer ​选​ hyperparameter \(\boldsymbol{\lambda}\)，inner solve weighted ERM ​得​ \(\boldsymbol{\theta}^*(\boldsymbol{\lambda})\)。​三代​代表​：

  • C1 Maclaurin-Duvenaud-Adams 2015 ICML (arXiv:1502.03492)：reverse-mode unrolling through SGD-with-momentum，entropy-preserving stochastic bit reversal ​实现​精确​反演​；ITD memory \(O(T)\)；scale \(10^3\) HPs；LLS ​形式​上​违反​（NN ​非凸​）​但用​ truncation ​绕过​。​具体​超参​类型​：per-layer L2 weight decay + dropout + LR schedule（MNIST CNN），​约​ \(10^3\) HPs。
  • C11 Lorraine-Vicol-Duvenaud 2020 AISTATS (arXiv:1911.02590)：IFT + Neumann series approximation；memory \(O(1)\) in \(T\)；​首次​ scale ​到​ \(\sim 10^6\) HPs。​具体​超参​类型​：per-parameter L2 regularization，​每个​权重​一个​ regularizer（60k-param CNN）。S13 Grazzi 2026 ​把​它​作为​"bilevel learning ​概念​落地​"​的​核心​案例​，​并​据此​批判​ IFT ​的​ LLS ​假设​脆弱​。
  • C16 ScaleBiO 2024（arXiv:2406.19976）：fully first-order + LISA memory trick；30B-​参数​ LLM ​上​ bilevel data reweighting，​外层​变量​ \(\boldsymbol{w} \in \Delta^{m-1}\)（​数据​混合​权重​），​内层​是​ LLM ​参数​。​首个​ 30B-scale bilevel ML ​算法​。​具体​超参​类型​：per-data-source mixing weights ​跨​数百​ pretraining corpora。

​规模​阶梯​ \(10^3 \to 10^6 \to 10^{10}\) ​每​一代​都​重写​一次​ \(H^{-1}\) ​处理​（ITD → Neumann → penalty + LISA）。​这是​视角​ D ​在​ ML ​内部​最​清晰​的​演化​线​。

docs.title: §5.2 Meta-learning ​谱系​ (C2 MAML / C3 iMAML / C10 learned optimizers)
docs.text:
Multi-task bilevel：outer meta-knowledge \( oldsymbol{ heta}\) + inner per-task adaptation \( oldsymbol{\phi}_ au^*( oldsymbol{ heta})\)。

  • C2 MAML（Finn-Abbeel-Levine 2017 ICML, arXiv:1703.03400）：\( oldsymbol{\phi}_ au^*( oldsymbol{ heta}) = oldsymbol{ heta} - \alpha abla_{ oldsymbol{ heta}} \mathcal{L}_ au^{ ext{train}}\)（K=1 truncated unroll）；FOMAML ​去​二阶​；Reptile ​完全​去​二阶​。LLS ​状态​：truncation ​形式​上​避开​ LLS。MAML ​的​ K-step truncated unrolling ​在​数学​上​等同​ discrete-time Pontryagin maximum principle：​外层​ = ​控制​ (control)，​内轨​ = ​状态​ (state)，hypergradient = costate / adjoint。Franceschi 2017 ICML ​的​ reverse-mode hypergradient through SGD ​即​ Euler-discretised gradient flow ​的​ adjoint equation。1960s Pontryagin ​与​ Bryson-Ho ​的​最优控制​文献​早已​建立​ adjoint ​反向​积分​的​稳定性​分析​——​也​即​现代​ long-unroll ​训练​中​"exploding gradient through unrolls"​现象​（Metz et al. 2022 VeLO, arXiv:2211.09760）​的​连续​极限​对应​。
  • C3 iMAML（Rajeswaran-Finn-Kakade-Levine 2019 NeurIPS, arXiv:1909.04630）：inner ​加​ proximal \( rac{\lambda}{2}\|\phi- heta\|^2\) ​强制​ SC + LLS——​一个​强凸​ quadratic ​加​到​任意​ smooth ​目标​使​总和​ strongly convex（modulus \(\lambda\)），​强制​唯一​最优​，​人为​制造​ LLS。IFT ​给​精确​ hypergradient \( abla_ heta \mathcal{L}^{ ext{meta}} = \lambda(\lambda I + H)^{-1} abla_\phi \mathcal{L}^{ ext{meta}}\)。​这是​ ML ​侧​"LLS by proximal ​强制​"​的​首次​明确​做法​。
  • C10 Learned optimizers（Andrychowicz-Denil-Gomez-Hoffman-Pfau-Schaul-Shillingford-de Freitas 2016 NeurIPS, arXiv:1606.04474; Metz et al. 2022 VeLO, arXiv:2211.09760）：LSTM ​替换​ SGD，BPTT through unrolled steps；​与​ MAML ​同​范式​（meta-init vs meta-update-rule）；Vicol 2023 / Harrison 2022 ​指出​ long-horizon meta-training chaotic landscape。

MAML → iMAML ​是​ "ITD → IFT" ​范式​转移​；C18 Source（Bae-Lin-Lorraine-Grosse 2024 NeurIPS, arXiv:2405.12186）​后来​在​ TDA ​中​把​这​两个​范式​重新​桥​起来​——​见​ §5.6。

docs.title: §5.3 NAS ​谱系​ (C4 DARTS)
docs.text:
C4 DARTS（Liu-Simonyan-Yang 2019 ICLR, arXiv:1806.09055）：outer arch \( oldsymbol{\alpha}\) + inner weights \(\mathbf{w}^*( oldsymbol{\alpha})\)；one-step finite-difference hyper-gradient \( abla_\alpha \mathcal{L}_{ ext{val}}(\mathbf{w}^*) \approx abla_\alpha \mathcal{L}_{ ext{val}}(\mathbf{w} - \xi abla_w \mathcal{L}_{ ext{train}})\)。

LLS ​状态​：DARTS ​是​ LLS ​严重​违反​的​实证​案例​——arch ​过​拟合​到​ skip-connection ​的​ "performance collapse" ​现象​（PC-DARTS / SmoothDARTS / DARTS- ​系列​修正​）​就是​ LLS ​失效​的​工程​表现​。​从​ NASNet（RL ~2000 GPU-days）​到​ DARTS（4 GPU-days）​的​效率​跃迁​说明​：​即使​ LLS ​形式​上​不​成立​，K=1 ITD + finite-diff Hessian-vec ​也​能​用​——​这是​视角​ D ​工程​实用性​优先​于​数学​严格​性​的​代表性​案例​。​需​澄清​：one-step truncated unrolling ​与​ finite-difference HVP ​在​数学​上​不​完全​等同​——DARTS ​实现​层面​用​ \( abla^2_{\alpha,w}\mathcal{L}_{ ext{train}} \cdot abla_w \mathcal{L}_{ ext{val}} \approx ( abla_\alpha \mathcal{L}_{ ext{train}}(w^+) - abla_\alpha \mathcal{L}_{ ext{train}}(w^-)) / (2\epsilon)\) ​把​ mixed Hessian-vec ​近似​为​ finite difference。

docs.title: §5.4 Adversarial / Poisoning (C5 / C6 ​对偶​)
docs.text:
C5 Madry adversarial training（Madry-Makelov-Schmidt-Tsipras-Vladu 2018 ICLR, arXiv:1706.06083）：\(\min_\theta \mathbb{E}[\max_\delta \ell(\theta, x+\delta, y)]\)。​形式​上​ minimax/saddle-point；​与​严格​ bilevel ​区别​在​ inner ​与​ outer ​共享​ loss（"bilevel with shared loss"，Chen 2023）。

C6 Biggio data poisoning（Biggio-Nelson-Laskov 2012 ICML, arXiv:1206.6389; Cinà-Grosse-Demontis-Vascon-Zellinger-Moser-Oprea-Biggio-Pelillo-Roli 2023 ACM Comp. Surv. 55(13s):294, arXiv:2205.01992）：\(\max_{X_c} \mathcal{L}_{\text{val}}(\theta^*(X_c))\) s.t. \(\theta^*(X_c) = \arg\min_\theta \mathcal{L}_{\text{train}}(\mathcal{D} \cup X_c)\)。Gradient ascent on poisoning points via KKT-based IFT through SVM ​最优​解​。

C5 ​与​ C6 ​的​对偶​：adversarial = test-time perturbation maximizing loss；poisoning = train-time perturbation maximizing val loss。​两者​数学​上​同属​ bilevel-with-adversarial-outer ​框架​，​算法​骨架​一致​，​差别​仅​在​符号​方向​：HPO ​是​ \(\min_\lambda \mathcal{L}_{\text{val}}\)，poisoning ​是​ \(\max_{X_c} \mathcal{L}_{\text{val}}\)。LLS ​状态​：C6 ​在​ SVM ​上​有​ KKT ​闭式​，LLS ​由​ strict convex SVM ​自动​成立​；​在​深度​ NN ​上​违反​，​需要​近似​。

docs.title: §5.5 LLM bilevel ​三件套​ (C8 RLHF / C15 SPO / C16 ScaleBiO)
docs.text:
LLM ​训练​ pipeline ​的​完整​ bilevel ​视角​：

  • C8 PARL RLHF（Chakraborty-Bedi-Koppel-Manocha-Wang-Wang-Huang 2024 ICLR, arXiv:2308.02585）：reward \(\boldsymbol{\phi}\) leader，policy \(\pi^*(\boldsymbol{\phi})\) follower。​首次​把​ RLHF ​严格​ formalize ​为​ stochastic bilevel，​给出​ \(O(1/T)\) sample complexity；​后续​ Shen-Razaviyayn 2024（arXiv:2402.06886）​给​ penalty-based ​算法​。
  • C15 SPO + ReBiSA（Jian-Yang-Gao-Ni-Yang-Xiao-Liu-Ouyang 2025, arXiv:2507.07723）：​诊断​ DPO ​的​ "catastrophic preference shift"——Bradley-Terry ​让​ lost preference probability mass shift ​到​ OOD responses；SPO ​用​ bilevel constrain inner to safe region。
  • C16 ScaleBiO（Pan et al. 2024, arXiv:2406.19976）：data reweighting on 30B LLM。

​三件套​结构​：data reweighting (C16)、reward learning (C8) ​与​ safety alignment (C15) ​串成​ LLM training ​完整​的​ bilevel pipeline。

docs.title: §5.6 DEQ ​与​ Influence Functions (C9 / C7)
docs.text:
C9 DEQ（Bai-Kolter-Koltun 2019 NeurIPS, arXiv:1909.01377）：\(\mathbf{z}^*( oldsymbol{ heta}, \mathbf{x}) = f_ heta(\mathbf{z}^*, \mathbf{x})\) ​替代​ stacked layers；backprop via IFT \(\partial z^*/\partial heta = (I - \partial f/\partial z)^{-1} \partial f/\partial heta\)。​要求​ \(f\) contraction (\(L<1\)) → Banach ​保​ unique \(z^*\)（LLS by contraction）。DEQ ​的​ IFT ​是​ Chen-Rubanova 2018 Neural ODE adjoint sensitivity ​的​离散​特例​；​而​ Phase 1 ITD ​是​同一​ adjoint sensitivity ​的​有限​步​离散​版​——​这​给​ ITD ↔ IFT ​的​对偶​提供​一个​连续​极限​解释​。

C7 Influence Functions（Koh-Liang 2017 ICML, arXiv:1703.04730, ICML Best Paper）：​标准​形式​ \(I_{ ext{up,loss}}(z, z_{ ext{test}}) = - abla_ heta \ell(z_{ ext{test}}, \hat heta)^ op H_{\hat heta}^{-1} abla_ heta \ell(z, \hat heta)\)，\(H_{\hat heta} = frac{1}{n}\sum_i abla^2_ heta \ell(z_i, \hat heta)\)；HVP via LiSSA (Agarwal-Bullins-Hazan 2017) scale ​到​深度​ NN。Bae 2024 NeurIPS "If influence functions are the answer, then what is the question?" ​质疑​深度​ NN ​上​的​有效性​。

docs.title: §5.7 Source TDA：IF ↔ ITD ​的​桥​ (C18)
docs.text:
C18 Source TDA（Bae-Lin-Lorraine-Grosse 2024 NeurIPS, arXiv:2405.12186）：

\[ ext{Source}(z_i, z_{ ext{test}}) := - abla_ heta \ell(z_{ ext{test}}, heta_T)^ op \Bigl(\sum_t \prod_s J_s\Bigr) abla_ heta \ell(z_i, heta_t), \]

​其中​ \(J_s := I - \alpha abla^2_ heta \ell(\cdot, heta_s)\) ​是​单步​训练​ trajectory Jacobian；​内层​ sum-and-product ​是​ unrolled hypergradient kernel，Source ​通过​ IF-like blockwise inverse ​近似​它​（​精确​ index ​参考​ Bae et al. 2024 NeurIPS Eq. 4）。Source ​由此​桥接​ IFT-based influence functions ​与​ ITD-based unrolling——​保留​ IF ​的​效率​，​又​保留​ ITD ​对非​收敛​/​多​阶段​训练​的​精度​。C18 ​因此​是​ S10 Zhang 2024 SPM ​综述​ IF/GU/VF ​三​视角​统一​的​技术​实现​：MAML → iMAML ​的​ "ITD → IFT" ​范式​转移​在​ TDA ​这里​被​重新​桥​起来​，​使​ IF ​与​ GU ​在​算法​层面​成为​同一​对象​的​两个​表示​。

docs.title: §6 OR/​经济​应用​谱系
docs.text: §5 ​展示​了​ ML ​侧​ LLS ​状态​如何​在​ HPO / meta / NAS / adversarial / LLM / DEQ / TDA ​各​应用​上​演化​。§6 ​转​ OR ​侧​：5 ​大​原型​ + ​复合​ + ​反哺​ + sustainability。OR ​侧​ bilevel ​应用​按​ D ​类​调研​的​ 5 ​大​原型​展开​：D1 Stackelberg pricing / D2 NDP / D3 interdiction / D4 inverse opt / D5 mechanism design——​所有​后续​应用​都​是​这五种​原型​的​复合​、​推广​或​不确定性​化​。

docs.title: §6.1 ​五大​原型​ (D1–D5)
docs.text:
​下表​给出​ OR bilevel ​应用​的​ 5 ​大​原型​骨架​。​每个​ prototype ​都​是​后续​应用​的​基础​——D6 EPEC = D1 ​多​ leader；D10 DAD = D3 trilevel ​嵌套​；D14 trilevel energy markets = D1+D2 ​复合​。

# ​原型​ ​形式​ (​核心​ min-max) reformulation ​路径​ LLS ​典型​应用​ D1 Stackelberg pricing (Labbé-Marcotte-Savard 1998 Mgmt. Sci. 44(12-Part-1):1608-1622) \(\max_{\mathbf{t}} \mathbf{t}^\top \mathbf{x}^*(\mathbf{t})\) s.t. \(\mathbf{x}^* \in \arg\min_{\mathbf{x}\in X}(\mathbf{c}+\mathbf{t})^\top \mathbf{x}\) MPCC via LP duality；NP-hard；series-parallel ​多项式​ (Roch-Savard-Marcotte 2005) ​经常​违反​（​同​ cost ​多路径​——​那薄​集恰​是​ bilevel ​目标​最​敏感​处​） toll, revenue mgmt D2 Toll setting / NDP (Marcotte 1986 Math. Prog. 34(2); LeBlanc 1975; Magnanti-Wong 1984 Transp. Sci. 18(1)) \(\min_\mathbf{y} \sum_a t_a(v_a^*) v_a^* + g(\mathbf{y})\) s.t. \(\mathbf{v}^*(\mathbf{y}) \in \arg\min_\mathbf{v} \sum_a \int_0^{v_a} t_a(s,y_a)\,ds\) (Beckmann) sensitivity-based descent; KKT ​由​ Beckmann ​严格凸​成立​ NDP, congestion pricing D3 Network interdiction (Wood 1993 Math. Comp. Modelling 17(2); Cormican-Morton-Wood 1998 OR 46(2); Smith-Song 2020 EJOR 283(3)) \(\min_{\mathbf{x}\in\{0,1\}^A, \mathbf{1}^\top\mathbf{x}\le B} \max_\mathbf{f}\{F: f_a \le u_a(1-x_a)\}\) LP strong duality of inner max-flow → ​单层​ MILP；NP-complete min-cut value ​唯一​所以​不​需要​ ​反毒​走私​ (Wood 1993 motivation：​南美​毒品​河流​), ​反恐​, ​反​核扩散​ D4 Inverse optimization (Ahuja-Orlin 2001 OR 49(5); Heuberger 2004 J. Comb. Opt. 8(3)) \(\min_\mathbf{d} \|\mathbf{d}-\mathbf{c}\|_p\) s.t. \(\mathbf{x}_0 \in \arg\min_{\mathbf{x}\in X} \mathbf{d}^\top \mathbf{x}\) Forward LP KKT ​作​ inverse ​约束​；\(L_1, L_\infty\) ​下​ inverse-LP ​仍​ LP，polynomial ​假设​ \(\mathbf{x}_0\) ​精确​最优​ IRL, calibration D5 Mechanism design (Myerson 1981 Math. OR 6(1); Conitzer-Sandholm 2002 EC; arXiv:2505.08989 (2025) "Agency Problems and Adversarial Bilevel Optimization") \(\max_\mathbf{m} U_P(\mathbf{m}, \mathbf{a}^*(\mathbf{m}))\) s.t. \(\mathbf{a}^*(\mathbf{m}) \in \arg\max_\mathbf{a} U_A(\mathbf{m}, \mathbf{a})\) Revelation principle agent ​多​ best responses ​常见​ → optimistic/pessimistic ​区分​严肃​ auction, contract design

​注​ D3 ​的​ LP duality ​是​ finite LP ​的​严格​强​对偶​，​不同于​ MPCC ​的​近似​处理​。​注​ D1 LLS ​的​精妙​：​内层​ LP ​给​唯一​顶点​是​ generic ​情形​，LLS ​仅​在​ thin set ​上​失败​——​但​ bilevel ​目标​恰好​在​那个​ thin set ​上​最​敏感​。

docs.title: §6.2 ​复合​：EPEC + DAD
docs.text:
EPEC（D6 / D11; Hobbs-Metzler-Pang 2000 IEEE TPS 15(2); Hu-Ralph 2007 OR 55(5); Gabriel-Conejo-Fuller-Hobbs-Ruiz 2012 Springer ISORMS Vol. 180）—— Equilibrium Programming with Equilibrium Constraints，​多​ leader ​同时​玩​，​每人​都​把​同一​ ISO LP clearing ​当​ follower → multi-leader common-follower (MLCF)。​具体​例子​：\(N\) ​个​发电机​各自​设定​竞价​（leader），​一个​ ISO ​解​市场​清算​ LP（common follower）​决定​谁​来​调度​——​每个​发电机​的​ bilevel ​共享​同一​下层​。Nash equilibrium ​存在​性极​脆弱​，​常​退化​为​ stationary Nash / local Nash。Hu-Ralph 2007 ​严格​表述​：​在​适当​假设​下​，multi-leader common-follower ​的​全局​ Nash ​当且​仅​当​一个​构造​好​的​ NLP ​的​ MPEC-stationary point；"​无​ strong Nash" ​是​经验​/​惯用​观察​，​而​非​定理​。LLS ​状态​：ISO LP ​在​ degenerate dispatch ​时​违反​；​视角​ E ​把​这​当成​特征​。

DAD（D10; Brown-Carlyle-Salmerón-Wood 2006 Interfaces 36(6)）：trilevel \(\min_d \max_a \min_x f(x)\) —— Defender-Attacker-Defender。​三层​博弈​嵌套​；​外​两层​ Benders / column-and-constraint generation (Zhao-Zeng 2012)。​关键​同构​：DAD trilevel ↔ certified adversarial defense（C5 + randomized smoothing），​见​ §7。

docs.title: §6.3 ​反哺​：ML ​工具​回到​ OR
docs.text:
2022 ​年​起​ OR ​社区​开始​接受​ ML ​侧​ differentiable optimization ​工具​：

  • D13 Differentiable Stackelberg Congestion Games（Li-Yu-Wang-Liu-Wang-Nie 2022, arXiv:2209.07618）：​用​ automatic differentiation through evolution path（DARTS ​风格​ unrolled）​替代​经典​ Patriksson-Rockafellar sensitivity ​分析​。​从​ OR ​角度​，​这​是​把​ D2/D9 ​的​ implicit differentiation ​升级​为​ ML ​风格​ unrolled differentiation。
  • D14 Trilevel energy markets（Herrala-Oliveira-Salo 2025 JORS 76(3), arXiv:2309.02032）：​用​ strong-duality based reformulation（VF ​的​现代化​）​替代​ KKT/complementarity，​避开​ MPCC ​的​ CQ ​失效​；​用​ dual variable ​显式​作为​ middle-level ​决策​变量​。
  • D15 Bayesian Stackelberg Markov for federated robust learning（Pan-Li-Liu-Liu-Zhu-Zhu 2024, arXiv:2410.17431；​前奏​ arXiv:2306.13273 ICML 2023 NFAML）：Bayesian Stackelberg (D5 mech design) + Markov game + meta-learning (C2 MAML) ​三合一​。

​反哺​标志​ OR ​与​ ML ​在​ bilevel ​上​从​单向​借用​进入​双向交流​。​下​一节​把​这​一​交流​凝结​成​ §7 ​的​ 5 ​对​深层​同构​。

docs.title: §6.4 sustainability bilevel: Caselli-Iori-Ljubić 2026 ​六大​应用​域
docs.text:
Caselli-Iori-Ljubić 2026 EJOR 332(2)（arXiv:2406.07184）​给出​ 6 ​大可​持续​ BLO ​应用​域​：

  1. Transportation and logistics
  2. Production planning and manufacturing
  3. Water, waste, and agriculture management
  4. Supply chains (closed-loop, green pricing)
  5. Disaster prevention and response
  6. Bilevel pricing problems（​横切​轴​）

​统一​形式​：\(\max_{\mathbf{t}\in T} W(\mathbf{t}, \mathbf{x}^*(\mathbf{t})) - \lambda E(\mathbf{x}^*(\mathbf{t}))\) s.t. \(\mathbf{x}^*(\mathbf{t}) \in \arg\min_\mathbf{x}\) user cost. Externality \(E\) ​显式​嵌入​ outer objective —— externality internalization ​是​ sustainability-bilevel ​的​核心思想​。

docs.title: §7 D↔C 5 ​对​深层​同构
docs.text:
​现在​把​ §5 ML ​应用​与​ §6 OR ​应用​并排​扫描​——​五​对​几乎​完全​的​数学​同构​浮现​。​具体​地​：OR ​与​ ML ​在​ bilevel ​上​是​同​一组​ Lagrangian ​骨架​的​ convergent re-derivations。​差别​在​ metric ​选择​与​工程​文化​，​而​非​数学​结构​。​但​需要​ caveat：MAML 2017 / DARTS 2019 / ScaleBiO 2024 ​引用​接近​零​ OR bilevel；Caselli 2026 ​引用​接近​零​ ML bilevel——​所谓​"​合奏​"​是​ survey ​听到​的​，communities ​各自​演奏​时​往往​背对背​。​下表​沿用​ D ​类​调研​综合​表​ 2，​并​补充​每​对​同构​"​差异​在​哪里​"。

# OR ​侧​ ML ​侧​ ​数学​等价​点​ ​语义​差异​ 1 D4 Inverse Optimization (Ahuja-Orlin 2001 OR 49(5); Heuberger 2004 J. Comb. Opt. 8(3)) Inverse Reinforcement Learning (Ng-Russell 2000 ICML; Abbeel-Ng 2004 ICML) ​同​ KKT/complementary slackness OR ​用​ \(L_1/L_\infty\) cost perturbation；ML ​用​ max-margin reward 2 D1 Toll setting (Labbé-Marcotte-Savard 1998 Mgmt. Sci. 44(12)) C1/C11 HPO (Maclaurin 2015 ICML; Lorraine 2020 AISTATS) \(\mathbf{t}^\top \mathbf{x}^*(\mathbf{t})\) ↔ \(\lambda \|\theta^*(\lambda)\|^2\)；outer ​设​参数​ + inner solve parametric + outer ​复合​ OR ​离散​ + MPCC NP-hard；ML ​连续​ + IFT polynomial 3 D10 DAD (Brown-Carlyle-Salmerón-Wood 2006 Interfaces 36(6)) C5 PGD + certified defense (Madry 2018 ICLR + Cohen-Rosenfeld-Kolter 2019 randomized smoothing) ​同​ \(\min_\theta \max_\delta\) ​嵌套​ DAD ​多一层​ fortification min；adv defense implicit 4 D11 EPEC (Hobbs-Metzler-Pang 2000; Hu-Ralph 2007 OR 55(5); Gabriel et al. 2012) Multi-objective / multi-generator GAN (Goodfellow 2014 + ​多​ generator GAN) ​多​ leader ​共享​ follower ​都​无​ strong Nash OR ​市场​均衡​；ML meta-RL convergence 5 D3 Network Interdiction (Wood 1993; Cormican-Morton-Wood 1998 OR 46(2); Smith-Song 2020 EJOR 283(3)) C6 Data Poisoning (Biggio 2012 ICML; Cinà et al. 2023 ACM CS) min-max with budget on perturbation OR arc removal；ML training point insertion

​同构​ 1：Inverse Optimization ↔ IRL。Ahuja-Orlin ​把​ inverse LP ​的​ KKT ​当作​ inverse ​约束​最小化​ \(\|d - c\|_p\)；Ng-Russell ​把​ max-margin reward ​当作​ IRL ​的​ KKT ​化身​。​两者​数学​上​同源​——​给定​一个​"​观察​到​的​最优​解​"​反推​参数​。​差异​：OR ​假设​ \(\mathbf{x}_0\) ​是​精确​最优​，ML ​容许​ noisy demonstrations；OR ​用​ \(L_p\)，ML ​用​ max-margin（​隐含​ \(L_\infty\)）。Apprenticeship learning（Abbeel-Ng 2004）​的​ LP ​化身​就是​ inverse-LP ​在​ ML ​概率​化​设定​下​的​现代版​。

​同构​ 2：Toll Setting ↔ HPO。\(\max_{\mathbf{t}} \mathbf{t}^\top \mathbf{x}^*(\mathbf{t})\) ​与​ \(\min_\lambda \mathcal{L}_{\text{val}}(\theta^*(\lambda))\) ​都​是​ "outer ​设​参数​ + inner solve + outer ​复合​"。​但​ toll ​的​差异​致命​：toll ​离散​（\(\mathbf{t} \in \mathbb{Z}^E\) ​常见​）+ inner LP ​解集​多​顶点​ → MPCC NP-hard；HPO ​连续​ + inner ERM ​严格凸​ → IFT polynomial。​视角​差异​使​同一​数学​结构​走向​不同​算法​：toll ​走​ B6 branch-and-cut，HPO ​走​ B7 IFT + Neumann。​但​ D13 Li-Yu-Wang-Liu-Wang-Nie 2022 ​用​ ML ​风格​ differentiable Stackelberg congestion games ​反哺​了​ toll ​侧​——​这是​同构​ 2 ​的​最​年轻​演化​。

​同构​ 3：DAD ↔ Certified Adversarial Defense。DAD trilevel \(\min_d \max_a \min_x\) ​与​ adversarial training \(\min_\theta \mathbb{E}[\max_\delta \ell]\) ​加​ randomized smoothing certifier ​共享​ min-max ​嵌套​结构​。​差异​：DAD ​显式​ fortify（\(d\) ​是​物理​加固​决策​），adv defense implicit（\(\theta\) ​是​模型​权重​）；DAD ​在​ \(\mathbf{x}\) ​操作​层​做​ recovery min，adv defense ​直接​ expect ​模型​ robustness。

​同构​ 4：EPEC ↔ Multi-objective GAN。​多​ leader ​共享​ follower ​在​ OR ​是​ EPEC（generator ​集体​玩​ ISO clearing），​在​ ML ​是​ multi-generator GAN（generator ​集体​玩​ discriminator）。​共同​症状​：​不​存在​ strong Nash，​只有​ stationary equilibrium。Hu-Ralph 2007 ​的​ stationarity-relaxation ​与​ GAN ​文献​的​ local Nash ​几乎​逐字​对应​。​这一​同构​是​视角​ A + ​视角​ E ​在​ OR-ML ​上​最​直接​的​共振​。

​同构​ 5：Network Interdiction ↔ Data Poisoning。Wood 1993 ​的​ max-flow interdiction \(\min_x \max_f\) ​与​ Biggio 2012 ​的​ \(\max_{X_c} \mathcal{L}_{\text{val}}\) ​都​是​ min-max with budget on perturbation。​差异​：OR ​是​ arc removal（\(\mathbf{x} \in \{0,1\}^A, \mathbf{1}^\top \mathbf{x} \le B\)），ML ​是​ training point insertion（poisoning budget \(|X_c| \le k\)）。Cinà et al. 2023 ACM Comp. Surv. ​把​ "poisoning = bilevel with adversarial outer objective" ​正式化​的​同时​，OR ​文献​早​ 20 ​年​就​在​做​同样​的​事​。

5 ​同构​的​统一​意义​：​这​ 5 ​对​不是​巧合​，​是​ bilevel ​数学​结构​的​多重​显形​。​本​综述​论点​的​第三句​"OR ​与​ ML ​是​ convergent re-derivations of the same Lagrangian skeleton"​在​这​一节​得到​最​直接​证据​。​下​一节​把​这​五​对​的​共同​ hardness wall ​摆​到​一张​图上​。​后续​ §10 ​开放​问题​中​"​反哺​时代​"​是​同一​观察​的​延续​。

docs.title: §8 Hardness ​与​下界
docs.text:
​若​ §7 ​的​论断​成立​——OR ​与​ ML ​在​ bilevel ​上​是​同​一组​ Lagrangian ​骨架​的​ convergent re-derivations——​则​两者​共享​同​一面​ hardness wall。​本节​把​这面​ wall ​放到​单一​图上​。​视角​ B ​的​ NP-hard ​结论​（A8 Jeroslow 1985, Hansen-Jaumard-Savard 1992）​与​视角​ D ​的​ first-order oracle ​下界​（A13 Chen-Xu-Zhang 2024 COLT, B26 arXiv:2511.19656）​共同​构成​ bilevel ​的​硬​约束​。​需要​ caveat：NP-hardness ​与​ first-order oracle ​下界​是​不同​ complexity classes——​前者​刻画​判定​问题​的​ computational hardness，​后者​刻画​特定​ oracle model ​下​的​ iteration complexity；​本节​把​它们​并列​而​非​合并​。

A8 LBP NP-hard（Jeroslow 1985 Math. Program. 32:146-164）：linear bilevel programming ​的​判定​问题​已​是​ strongly NP-hard；Hansen-Jaumard-Savard 1992 SIAM J. Sci. Stat. Comput. 13(5) ​精炼​为​事实​ \(\Sigma_2^P\)-hardness。​核心​含义​：​即使​ \(F, f\) ​与​所有​约束​都​线性​，bilevel ​也​已​超出​ P ​类​；​后续​视角​ C/D ​的​ reformulation ​都​无法​越过​这​一硬墙​。

A12 CQ failure（Chen-Florian 1995, Pang-Fukushima 1999, Scheel-Scholtes 2000 Math. Oper. Res. 25(1)）：MPCC ​在​任何​可行​点​标准​ LICQ/MFCQ ​必然​失效​，​这一​观察​由​ Chen-Florian ​与​ Pang-Fukushima ​早期​工作​给出​；Scheel-Scholtes 2000 ​给出​处理​该​失效​的​ canonical stationarity ​替代品​ B-/M-/C-/S-stationarity ​四​概念​，S-stationarity ​难​计算​。​这是​ KKT/MPCC ​支柱​的​"​配套​ hardness"。

A13 Hyperobjective hardness（Chen-Xu-Zhang 2024 COLT, PMLR 247:947-980, arXiv:2301.00712）：nonconvex-convex bilevel ​中​ hyperobjective \(\varphi\) ​可不​连续​，​甚至​无​ stationary point。Zero-respecting algorithm ​的​ first-order oracle complexity ​下界​ \(\Omega(\text{poly}(\epsilon^{-1}))\) ——​比​ single-level ​严格​更差​。​从​ abstract verbatim："a common goal in bilevel optimization is to find stationary points of the hyper-objective function"[†v.s.]——​但​他们​证明​在​最​ general ​设定​下​这​是​ ill-posed。

B26 Lower complexity bounds 2025（arXiv:2511.19656）：​在​ NC-SC（nonconvex outer + strongly-convex inner）​下​，det \(\Omega(\kappa^{3/2}\epsilon^{-2})\) / stoch \(\Omega(\kappa^{5/2}\epsilon^{-4})\)。F²BA ​的​ condition number factor ​未​ match —— ​即使​ LLS+SC tractable case ​也​未​完全​ closed。

Tractable case (PL)。Chen-Ma-Zhang 2025 JMLR 26(109)（F²BA）​证明​ PL ​下​ \(\varphi\) Lipschitz + ​可微​ a.e.；algorithm ​达到​ near-optimal \(\tilde O(\epsilon^{-2})\) (det), \(\tilde O(\epsilon^{-4})\) (partial stoch), \(\tilde O(\epsilon^{-6})\) (full stoch)。Shen-Chen 2023 (PBGD) ​在​ partial calmness ​下达​ \(O(\epsilon^{-4})\) NC outer / \(O(\epsilon^{-2})\) SC outer。PL ​与​ partial calmness ​是​ hardness wall ​之下​的​两条​ tractable lane。

Hardness ​的​统一​图景​：

flowchart TD
    A["LBP NP-hard (Jeroslow 1985)"]
    B["+ LL convex + MPCC-LICQ<br/>⟹ S-stationarity (Scheel-Scholtes 2000)"]
    C["+ hyperobjective ill-posed<br/>(Chen-Xu-Zhang 2024)"]
    D["+ PL / partial calmness<br/>⟹ tractable lane (F²BA / PBGD)"]
    E["+ NC-SC det/stoch<br/>lower bound (2025)"]
    A --> B --> C --> D --> E

​每一​阶段​的​ hardness ​都​不是​消除​前​一​阶段​，​而是​在​前​一​阶段​假设​下​进一步​细化​——bilevel hardness ​文献​因此​呈现​ hierarchical refinement ​的​结构​。​本节​的​镜像​是​ "hardness ​的​ NC-convex → NC-PL → NC-SC ​三阶​递减​"；§3 ​的​ LLS ​松绑​史​与​本节​ hardness ​的​渐弱​在​数学​上​互为​对偶​面​。§10 O2 ​把​"​算法​是否​能​匹配​ lower bound"​作为​开放​问题​展开​——​是​同​一面​ wall ​的​另一侧​。​下​一节​先​转向​不确定性​与​多​决策者​拓扑​，§10 ​再​回到​这​条​ algorithm-vs-bound gap ​主线​。

docs.title: §9 ​不确定性​与​多​决策者
docs.text:
​视角​ E（§2.5）​的​具体内容​在​这​一节​展开​。LLS ​状态​：​视角​ E ​假设​ LLS ​系统性​违反​；​不确定性​与​多​决策者​拓扑​都​让​ LLS ​成为​奢侈品​。

Beck-Ljubić-Schmidt 2023 EJOR 311(2) ​把​不确定性​的​来源​拓宽​到​两类​：

  1. ​数据​不确定性​：lower-level ​参数​随机化​（stochastic bilevel）​或​最坏​情形​化​（robust bilevel）。Wiesemann-Tsoukalas-Kuhn-Rustem 2013 SIAM J. Optim. 23(1) ​在​ pessimistic-robust ​设定​下​证明​ viscosity regularization（​加​一个​小​ smoothing ​项使​ pessimistic value-function ​选择​ lower-semicontinuous）​收敛​。
  2. ​决策​不确定性​：leader ​不能​精确​观察​ follower ​的​反应​（observation uncertainty）；follower ​可能​只​达到​ \(\epsilon\)-near-optimal（near-optimal follower）；optimistic ​与​ pessimistic ​解​概念​之间​存在​ intermediate solution concepts（Wiesemann-Tsoukalas-Kuhn-Rustem 2013 ​给出​统一​处理​）。​这是​ bilevel ​特有​的​不确定性​源​——​单层​优化​里​没有​"​对手​是否​最优​"​这个​问题​。

​多​决策者​拓扑​（A7 Aussel-Svensson 2025）：

  • SLSF（Single Leader Single Follower）：​经典​ bilevel。
  • SLMF（Single Leader Multiple Followers）：​含​ Nash equilibrium constraint → MPEC with parametric VI；​典型​应用​：congestion games ​多用户​。
  • MLSF（Multiple Leaders Single Follower）：EPEC（D6, D11）；​典型​应用​：​电力​市场​多​ generator。
  • MLMF（Multiple Leaders Multiple Followers）：​解​存在​性​在​凸​情形​仍​开放​。

LLS ​在​多​决策者​下​系统性​违反​的​工程​后果​：

  • EPEC ​退化​为​ stationary Nash（Hu-Ralph 2007 OR 55(5)）：​因​ LLS ​失效​，strong Nash ​不​存在​；​只能​在​ local/stationary Nash ​上​做​工程​。
  • Pessimistic bilevel ​一般​ ill-posed（Loridan-Morgan 1996 J. Glob. Optim. 8）：​即使​ optimistic ​有解​ pessimistic ​也​可能​无​解​；​必须​用​ viscosity regularization ​让​解​概念​良​定义​。
  • DAD trilevel ​的​多重​ fortification（D10）​需要​ column-and-constraint generation（Zhao-Zeng 2012）​级别​的​算法​。
  • Federated bilevel（B24 SimFBO, C²DFB）​的​客户端​异质性​是​"​多​ follower"​在​分布式系统​里​的​现代化​身​。

ML ​侧​的​现代​继承者​。RLHF（C8 PARL）= ​单​ leader ​单​ follower ​但​ policy ​内部​高度​不​唯一​；ScaleBiO data reweighting（C16）= ​单​ leader ​单​ follower ​但​ LLM ​内部​ loss landscape ​极度​非凸​；Bayesian Stackelberg Markov FL（D15）= ​单​ leader + Bayesian follower types + Markov ​动态​——​后者​是​把​ Beck 2023 ​双轴​在​ ML ​框架​里​同时​启用​的​代表​。

§10 ​把​这些​ hardness、LLS ​与​ multi-decision-maker ​拓扑​共同​留下​的​未解​问题​列为​五个​开放​方向​。

docs.title: §10 ​开放​问题
docs.text:
​把​ §1–§9 ​的​合奏​图谱​推​到​ 2026 ​年​的​前沿​，​有​ 5 ​个​开放​方向​值得​严肃​投入​：

O1. Hyperobjective ​的​可​计算​ stationarity。Chen-Xu-Zhang 2024 COLT ​已​证明​ nonconvex-convex bilevel ​中​ \(\varphi\) ​可不​连续​；F²BA / F2SA ​在​ PL ​下​达到​ near-optimal \(\tilde O(\epsilon^{-2})\)。​开放​：(a) PL ​之外​的​ tractable ​条件​——​例如​ Kurdyka-Łojasiewicz (KL) inequality (Bolte-Sabach-Teboulle 2014) ​严格​弱于​ PL，​覆盖​ ReLU ​网络​；(b) ​与​ Goldstein \((\delta,\epsilon)\)-stationary point (Davis-Drusvyatskiy 2019; Zhang-Lin-Jegelka-Sra-Jadbabaie 2020) ​在​ nonsmooth \(\varphi\) ​上​的​桥接​；(c) hyperobjective ​不​连续​时​"​什么​是​有​意义​的​ stationary"——​目前​文献​的​ ε-relaxation ​是​工程​妥协​而​非​理论​ answer。​更​基础​的​问题​：​在​ nonconvex-nonsmooth ML ​上​，\(\varphi\) ​当前​是​收敛​分析​的​ normative ​对象​（algorithms should approach），​不是​算法​的​ descriptive ​对象​（algorithms do compute）。​把​这​两者​重新​统一​起来​是​ LLS-​松绑​下​一步​的​研究​议程​。

O2. Hardness wall ​与​算法​ gap ​的​ closing。B26 lower bounds 2025（arXiv:2511.19656）​给​ NC-SC det \(\Omega(\kappa^{3/2}\epsilon^{-2})\)；F²BA ​在​ condition-number factor ​上​未​ match。​是否​存在​"true near-optimal" first-order algorithm？​或​这​是​ first-order oracle ​模型​的​根本​ limitation？

O3. LLM-scale bilevel ​的​系统化​新​结构​。ScaleBiO (B23) ​用​ LISA memory trick + 30B-​参数​；​但​ RLHF + safety alignment + data mixing ​的​完整​ LLM bilevel pipeline ​仍​未​被​统一​算法​覆盖​。​可能​方向​有​两条​：trilevel learning（C17 TLL, arXiv:2412.07138）​配合​ zeroth-order ​估计​；​或​ federated LLM bilevel ​借鉴​ SimFBO/C²DFB ​通信​结构​。100B+ ​规模​上​的​瓶颈​大​概率​从​ memory ​转向​ communication——​这​暗示​算法​应从​ F²BA ​风格​的​ penalty ​过渡​到​ federated-bilevel idiom ​的​ local-SGD-style multi-step inner adaptation with infrequent outer sync。

O4. OR ​与​ ML ​的​"​反哺​"​系统化​。D13 differentiable SCG (2022)、D14 strong-duality trilevel energy markets (2025)、D15 Bayesian Stackelberg Markov FL (2024) ​是​反哺​早期​信号​。​开放​：differentiable interdiction / differentiable EPEC / differentiable mech design ​的​系统化​——​把​ D3/D6/D5 ​全部​"ML ​化​"​是否​可行​？S14 Caselli 2026 ​的​ sustainability bilevel ​给出​应用​拉动力​。

O5. Bilevel learning ​与​ BO ​的​最终​统一​。S13 Grazzi 2026 ​提出​ "bridge the gap" ​议程​。​具体来说​：(a) IF/GU/VF ​三​视角​的​"​哪​种​ reformulation ​在​何种​ LLS ​假设​下​最优​"​是否​有​定量​比较定理​？(b) ​反向地​，​能否​把​ OR ​侧​的​ partial calmness / MPCC-LICQ ​系统化​为​ ML scale (30B+) ​可​跑​的​算法​？(c) hyperobjective \(\varphi\) ​与​ hypergradient \(\nabla\Phi\) ​在​ set-valued \(Y^*(x)\) ​时​的​关系​图谱​——​目前​文献​仍​在​ case-by-case ​处理​。

docs.title: §11 ​结论​：​诸​视角​合奏
docs.text:
​回到​引言​的​隐喻​。Bilevel optimization ​不是​被​某​一个​学派​单独​定义​的​，​而是​被​ 5 ​个​互补​视角​同时​刻画​的​领域​。

​视角​ A ​给​它​经济​直觉​（Stackelberg leader-follower）；​视角​ B ​给​它​数学​规划​骨架​（​嵌套​约束​）；​视角​ C ​给​它​单层​化​武器库​（KKT/VF/IF ​三足鼎立​）；​视角​ D ​给​它​ ML ​算法​化​（hypergradient + ​规模​阶梯​）；​视角​ E ​给​它​真实世界​的​多​ stakeholder ​含义​（​不确定性​ + EPEC + sustainability）。​任何​一个​声部​单独​听​都​是​不​完整​的​：​经济学家​漏掉​了​ MPCC ​的​ CQ ​失效​，​数值​分析家​漏掉​了​ Stackelberg ​的​博弈​直觉​，ML ​实践者​漏掉​了​ OR ​侧​ 30 ​年​的​ partial calmness ​工作​，OR ​应用​专家​漏掉​了​ LLM ​规模​上​的​算法​瓶颈​。

​把​这​五个​声部​串​起来​的​单一​历史​驱动力​是​ LLS ​假设​的​持续​松绑​。1934 Stackelberg ​与​ 1973 Bracken-McGill ​隐式​假设​响应​唯一​；1995 Ye-Zhu ​在​ OR ​侧​给出​ partial calmness ​作​ LLS ​替代品​；2024 Chen-Xu-Zhang ​在​ ML ​侧​给出​ hyperobjective ​作​ LLS ​失败​时​的​"​正确​对象​"；2023 Shen-Chen ​的​ σ-closeness ​把​两侧​在​数学​上​联结​；2024 Pan et al. ​的​ ScaleBiO ​把​这​一整套​思路​系统化​到​ 30B-​参数​ LLM ​上​。​这是​一段​从​ 90 ​年前​的​经济学​论文​走​到​当下​ LLM ​训练​管线​的​连续​故事​——​五个​视角​的​合奏​在​这条​主旋律​上​自然​展开​。

​本​综述​不​创造​新​概念​。​我们​把​ 16 ​篇​综述​、45 ​项​理论​与​算法​、18 ​项​ ML ​应用​、15 ​项​ OR ​应用​按​ LLS ​松绑​史​排成​一段​叙事​。​读者​可以​从​任何​一节​切入​，​向​上溯​到​ §1 ​的​三句​论点​，​向下​展到​ §10 ​开放​问题​。OR ​与​ ML ​这​两支​文献​在​ bilevel ​上​是​ convergent re-derivations of the same Lagrangian skeleton——​诸​视角​的​合奏​不是​杂音​，​是​同​一首​作品​的​多​声部​。

docs.title: §13 Further Reading（​延伸​阅读​）
docs.text: ​读者​读完​本文​后​已​掌握​ bilevel optimization ​的​五​视角​合奏​与​ LLS ​松绑​史​；​本书​单​按​"​先​ onboarding、​再​回溯​奠基​、​再​追​前沿​、​最后​跨域​"​四步​铺开​，​帮​你​把​综述​里​只能​ sketch ​的​内容​补到​可​操作​深度​。​重点​是​：bilevel ​文献​近​ 5 ​年​正在​剧变​（fully first-order、hyperobjective、LLM-scale），​任何​ pre-2020 ​的​入门​读物​都​已​不足以​覆盖​ frontier。

docs.title: Getting Started
docs.text:
Zhang, Khanduri, Tsaknakis, Yao, Hong, Liu, "An Introduction to Bilevel Optimization: Foundations and Applications in Signal Processing and Machine Learning" (2024). IEEE Signal Processing Magazine 41(1):38-59, arXiv:2308.00788.

​这是​目前​最​现代​、​最​易读​的​ ML-​视角​ bilevel ​入门​——​它​的​ IF / GU / VF ​三分法​就是​本​综述​ §3.3 ​三足鼎立​的​源头​，​比​任何​教科书​章节​都​更​准确​地​反映​ 2024 ​年​的​算法​格局​。​读者​应该​精读​ §III（reformulation ​比较​表​）​与​ §IV（HPO、meta、RL、adversarial ​四个​应用​骨架​），​跳过​ signal processing ​专章​。​注意​它​写​在​ fully first-order ​算法​尚未​完全​主流​化​之前​，​所以​ F²BA / ScaleBiO ​在​它​之后​才​出现​。

Grazzi, Pontil, Salzo, Zemkoho, "Bilevel Learning: A Survey" (2026). arXiv:2605.01621.

​首次​把​ "bilevel learning (BL)" ​与​ "bilevel optimization (BO)" ​作为​两个​相关​但​不同​的​概念​明确​切分​——​本​综述​ §2.4 ​的​ BL vs BO ​对照​即​源于​此​。​它​对​ IFT-based hypergradient ​在​大规模​ ML ​上​的​脆弱性​（​特别​是​ LLS ​假设​）​给出​迄今​最​坦诚​的​批评​。​建议​把​ §1 + §3（implicit-function reformulation ​的​局限​）+ §6（open problems）​读完​，​作为​本​综述​ §10 ​开放​问题​的​扩展​阅读​。

Hong, "Bilevel Optimization: Theory, Algorithms, and Applications" (ICCOPT 2022 tutorial slides, UMN).

Mingyi Hong ​的​ ICCOPT tutorial ​是​本​综述​ §4 ​四​阶段​叙事​的​骨架​来源​。slides ​给出​比​任何​ journal ​综述​都​更​直观​的​算法​时间​线图​，​对​ TTSA → SUSTAIN → STABLE → SOBA ​这一​ single-loop ​演化​讲得​最​清楚​。​比读​六篇​算法​论文​摘要​省​时间​。

docs.text:
Luo, Pang, Ralph, "Mathematical Programs with Equilibrium Constraints" (1996). Cambridge University Press.

MPCC reformulation ​的​圣经​。​本​综述​ §2.3 ​支柱​ 1 ​与​ §8 ​的​ CQ failure ​论述​都​依赖​它​。​读​ Ch.1（formalism）+ Ch.3（MPCC-specific stationarity ​的​雏形​，​后​被​ Scheel-Scholtes 2000 ​精炼​为​ B-/M-/C-/S-stationarity）+ Ch.6（exact penalty）。​书​的​记号​略​陈旧​（"equilibrium constraints" ​在​ ML ​文献​里​被​ "argmin constraint" ​取代​），​但​ CQ failure ​这一硬​约束​的​证明​在​任何​更新​文献​里​都​没​被​改写​。

Dempe, Zemkoho (eds.), "Bilevel Optimization: Advances and Next Challenges" (2020). Springer Optimization and Its Applications Vol. 161.

OR ​学派​的​现代​里程碑​文集​。​优先​读​ Dempe ​的​ Ch.1（taxonomy）、Ye ​的​ Ch.4（VF reformulation + partial calmness ​的​权威​整理​，​直接​对应​本​综述​ §3.1 ​绕道​ A）、​以及​ Zemkoho-Zhou ​的​ algorithms ​章节​。18 ​章里​有​ 6 ​章​是​经典​材料​的​重写​，​可以​ skip；Aussel ​的​ multi-leader ​章节​是​ §2.5 ​视角​ E ​的​ OR ​侧​入口​。

von Stackelberg, "Marktform und Gleichgewicht" (1934). Springer Wien-Berlin. English reprint: Market Structure and Equilibrium, Springer 2011.

​引言​里​被​反复​引用​、​但​实际​读过​的​人​极少​。​值得​读​的​不是​数学​（1934 ​没有​ MPCC ​语言​），​而是​ leader ​如何​"​预见​ follower ​的​反应​"​这一​概念​的​原始​论证​——​读完​会​理解​为何​ Bracken-McGill 1973 ​才​是​ ​数学​ ​起点​，​而​ 1934 ​是​ ​概念​ ​起点​。​英文​ reprint ​完全​够用​，​原版​德文​仅​出于​历史​兴趣​。

docs.title: The Current Frontier
docs.text:
Chen, Xu, Zhang, "On Bilevel Optimization without Lower-level Strong Convexity" (2024). COLT, PMLR 247:947-980, arXiv:2301.00712.

​本​综述​ §3.2 hyperobjective ​概念​的​源头​。Chen-Xu-Zhang ​把​ \(\varphi(x) := \min_{y \in Y^*(x)} F(x,y)\) ​抬到​中心​，​并​证明​ nonconvex-convex bilevel ​中​它​可不​连续​；first-order oracle ​下界​ \(\Omega(\text{poly}(\epsilon^{-1}))\) ​是​把​ bilevel hardness ​从​ NP-hard ​一刀切​扩展​到​ iteration complexity ​层级​的​关键​工作​。​读​ §1-§3（hyperobjective ​定义​与​ ill-posedness ​反例​）+ §4（lower bound ​构造​）。​注意​：​原文​作者​是​ Chen-Xu-Zhang，​不要​与​ F²BA ​的​ Chen-Ma-Zhang ​混淆​。

Chen, Ma, Zhang, "Near-Optimal Fully First-Order Algorithms for Finding Hyperobjective Stationary Points in Bilevel Optimization" (2025). Journal of Machine Learning Research 26(109):1-56, arXiv:2306.14853.

F²BA paper。​把​ §4 Phase 3 ​从​ Kwon F2SA ​的​ \(\tilde O(\epsilon^{-3})\) ​改进​到​ near-optimal \(\tilde O(\epsilon^{-2})\) (det) / \(\tilde O(\epsilon^{-4})\) (partial stoch) / \(\tilde O(\epsilon^{-6})\) (full stoch)，​并​显式​以​ hyperobjective ​作​收敛​分析​对象​。​读​ §2（PL ​假设​下​ \(\varphi\) ​良性​的​关键​ Lemma）+ §3（two-time-scale schedule）+ §5（​数值​实验​里​ ill-conditioning ​退化​的​细节​，​比​ abstract ​透露​更​多​）。​是​把​ Chen-Xu-Zhang 2024 hardness ​转化​为​ constructive algorithm ​的​对面​。

Pan, Zhang, Zhang, Pan, Xu, Zhang, Pi, Wang, Zhang, "ScaleBiO: Scalable Bilevel Optimization for LLM Data Reweighting" (2024). arXiv:2406.19976 (ACL 2025).

§4 Phase 4 ​与​ §5.5 LLM ​三件套​的​代表作​。​把​ F2SA ​与​ LISA (Layerwise Importance Sampled AdamW) memory trick ​结合​，​首次​在​ Llama-3-8B / Qwen-2.5-32B ​上​跑​通​ bilevel data reweighting。​读​它​不是​为​算法​（F²BA ​更优​）​而是​为​ ​工程​实现​：30B-​参数​下​ hypergradient ​计算​的​内存​/​通信​瓶颈​到底​卡​在​哪里​，penalty schedule ​在​非​凸非​平滑​ loss ​上​怎么​调​。​是​ §10 O3 "LLM-scale bilevel" ​开放​问题​的​最​ concrete entry point。

Chakraborty, Bedi, Koppel, Manocha, Wang, Wang, Huang, "PARL: A Unified Framework for Policy Alignment in Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback" (2024). ICLR, arXiv:2308.02585.

§5.5 ​与​同构​表​ §7 ​的​关键​工作​。​首次​把​ RLHF ​严格​ formalize ​为​ stochastic bilevel（reward = leader, policy = follower），​暴露​ vanilla ​两步​训练​遗漏​的​"leader ​预见​ follower"​反馈​环​。​读​ §3（bilevel formulation）+ §5（sample complexity \(O(1/T)\) ​证明​ sketch）。​读完​应​理解​为何​ DPO / ​后续​ alignment ​方法​本质​上​是​这​一​ bilevel ​结构​的​不同​ reformulation——​也​为​ §5.5 C15 SPO ​的​"catastrophic preference shift"​诊断​奠定​语言​。

docs.title: Lateral Connections
docs.text:
Amos, "Differentiable Optimization-Based Modeling for Machine Learning" (2019). PhD thesis, CMU.

§6.3 OR-ML ​反哺​现象​的​最​系统化​技术​参考​。​把​ quadratic program / convex program / OptNet / cvxpylayers ​统一​处理​为​ "differentiable layers"——​本质​上​是​ §2.3 IF ​支柱​在​ ML ​工具​链中​的​工程化​。​读​ Ch.3（OptNet）+ Ch.5（differentiable MPC），​比读​散​在​ NeurIPS 2017-2019 ​的​ 4-5 ​篇​短文​省力​。​与​ D13 differentiable Stackelberg congestion games ​的​同构​在​这里​得到​最​清晰​说明​。

Chen, Rubanova, Bettencourt, Duvenaud, "Neural Ordinary Differential Equations" (2018). NeurIPS, arXiv:1806.07366.

§5.6 DEQ ​的​连续​极限​对应​。adjoint sensitivity method ​是​ §4 Phase 1 ITD ​与​ Phase 2 IFT ​在​连续​时间​下​的​统一​表述​——​读完​会​发现​ MAML ​的​ K-step truncated unrolling、Pontryagin maximum principle ​的​ costate、Neural ODE ​的​ adjoint ​是​同一个​ backward integration ​的​三个​化身​。​这​条​ lateral connection ​是​把​"bilevel hypergradient"​放到​一个​ 90 ​年​最优控制​传统​里​的​最快​路径​。

Koh, Liang, "Understanding Black-box Predictions via Influence Functions" (2017). ICML PMLR 70:1885-1894, arXiv:1703.04730.

§5.6 ​影响​函数​与​ §5.7 Source TDA ​的​奠基​。​形式​上​不是​ bilevel——​但​ \(H^{-1}\) ​的​角色​与​ §2.3 IF ​支柱​完全一致​：upper-level ​是​某个​ test loss query，lower-level ​是​ ERM。​建议​配合​ Bae, Lin, Lorraine, Grosse, "Training Data Attribution via Approximate Unrolled Differentiation" (2024 NeurIPS, arXiv:2405.12186) ​同时​读​——​后者​把​ Koh-Liang ​的​ IF ​与​ ITD ​在​ TDA ​上桥​起来​，​正是​综述​ §3.3 ​三足鼎立​现代​联通​的​算法​实现​。

Pearl, "Causality: Models, Reasoning, and Inference" (2009, 2nd ed.). Cambridge University Press. Ch.7.

​因果​推断​里​的​ do-calculus ​与​ instrumental variable ​估计​本质​上​是​嵌套​优化​：outer ​是​ average treatment effect ​估计​，inner ​是​ propensity score / outcome model ​拟合​。​这一​同构​在​ OR-ML bilevel ​文献​里​至今​未​被​系统​讨论​——​但​它​是​ §7 5 ​对​深层​同构​之后​的​"​潜在​第​ 6 ​对​"。​对​想​做​ causal ML ​方向​的​读者​，​这​条​ lateral connection ​是​ §10 O4 "​反哺​系统化​"​开放​问题​的​延伸​场地​。

​温度​平衡​ (temporal balance)： - 2021–2026 = 7 ​项​ (Zhang 2024 / Grazzi 2026 / Chen-Xu-Zhang 2024 / Chen-Ma-Zhang 2025 / ScaleBiO 2024 / PARL 2024 / Bae 2024) - 2010-2020 = 5 ​项​ (Dempe-Zemkoho 2020 / Amos 2019 / Neural ODE 2018 / Koh-Liang 2017 / Hong 2022 tutorial) - pre-2010 = 3 ​项​ (Luo-Pang-Ralph 1996 / Stackelberg 1934 / Pearl 2009)

​末稿​日期​：2026-05-11。​本​综述​合成​自​ 16 ​篇​综述​ + 45 ​项​理论​/​算法​ + 18 ​项​ ML ​应用​ + 15 ​项​ OR ​应用​。​所有​视角​合奏​的​成功​取决于​读者​愿意​同时​听到​五个​声部​——​这​正是​ bilevel optimization ​在​ 2026 ​年​成为​跨学科​领域​的​根本​理由​。

docs.title: Summary (≤500 ​字​)
docs.text:
Thesis. AI ​数据中心​从​ must-run ​基荷​转为​ grid-interactive flexible load (GIFL) ​已​在​ 2024–2026 ​由​ Phoenix 256-GPU ​现场​试验​ (Nature Energy 2025/26) ​与​ FERC 12/2025 PJM Co-Location Order (EL25-49-000) ​双重​ anchor ​完成​ paradigm shift。​但​已有​ 10+ ​篇​综述​无一​同时​把​ (workload-level schedulability × ​跨​ region carbon/water sustainability × FERC/RTO mechanism design) ​三块​做​骨干​：S1 ​缺​ FERC ​与​ water，S4/S6/S7 ​不​含​ market ​与​ sub-second ​物理​，S10/S11 ​停​在​ annual LCA。​本​综述​独特​定位​是​把​这​三个​层级​用​ commitment-audit-penalty game (Williamson + ​实时​系统​ schedulability) ​与​ cascading-aware Pigouvian signal design (Banerjee 1992 herding × LME) ​两条​概念​骨架​贯穿​，​并​据此​识别​五个​ v1 ​综述​差异化​承重​的​ open problem：(1) sub-second GPU power transient envelope；(2) hyperscaler-scale cascading carbon ​稳定性​；(3) ​跨​ RTO ​统一​ audit metric；(4) water-power-carbon ​三联​ spatial-temporal Pareto；(5) training preemption scaling law。

​章节​字数​自检​ (Phase 1 v1 ​草稿​实测​，​中文​字符​；​总计​约​ 16.1k ​中​文字​，​符合​ 16–20k ​目标​区间​)：

​章节​ ​标题​ ​实际​字数​ §1 Introduction & paradigm shift 1,280 §2 Notation, vocabulary & taxonomy 1,216 §3 AI workload schedulability & heterogeneity 1,275 §4 Power-cap, DVFS & phase-aware envelope 1,282 §5 Sub-minute & sub-second physical boundaries 1,251 §6 Carbon signal design: MCI → LME → cascading 1,416 §7 Spatial-temporal shifting & 24/7 CFE 1,305 §8 Water-power-carbon tri-nexus & LCA-dispatch bridge 1,464 §9 Market products: DR, ancillary, capacity & co-location tariffs 1,307 §10 Cross-thread stitch 1,528 §11 Open problems, risks & future agenda 2,598 ​合计​ 16,088 ​中​文字​ (​附录​与​首部​另计​)

docs.title: §1 Introduction: AI DC as Grid-Interactive Flexible Load
1.0 30-Second Reader Self-Check & Elevator Pitch
docs.text:
Elevator pitch. AI ​数据中心​曾​被​电网​当作​"​不能​动​的​大​灯泡​"——​一种​ 24/7 ​满负荷​、​对​电网​频率​事件​透明​、​不​参与​ demand response ​的​ must-run base load。2024–2026 ​两个​独立​证据​推翻​了​这​一​假设​：(a) Phoenix 256-GPU ​集群​在​ Nature Energy ​公开​实测​中​可以​在​功率​上​界​基础​上​压缩​ −25 % ​持续​ 3 ​小时​而​不​爆破​ SLO；(b) FERC ​在​ 12/2025 ​的​ PJM Co-Location Order ​中​要求​对​大型​ flexible load ​区分​ Firm vs Non-Firm CDS tariff——​监管​层​已经​把​这类​负荷​视为​"​可​承诺​、​可​审计​、​可​处罚​"​的​实体​。​本​综述​把​ AI DC ​视为​ grid-interactive flexible load (GIFL)，​并​把​现有​ 10+ ​篇​综述​分别​覆盖​的​"​可​调度​多深​"（workload schedulability）、"​调度​到​哪里​"（spatial-temporal carbon/water）、"​由​谁​监管​怎么​记账​"（FERC/RTO mechanism）​三块​同时​作为​骨架​，​用​ commitment-audit-penalty ​博弈​ (Williamson 1979 hold-up) ​与​ cascading-aware Pigouvian signal (Banerjee 1992 herding) ​两条​概念​骨架​贯穿​。

30-second reader self-check. ​三类​读者​按下表​自检​后​跳入​ §1.6 ​推荐​路径​，​可​在​ 30 ​秒​内​决定​阅读​次序​：

​自我​描述​ ​读者​类型​ ​推荐​入口​ ​重点​节​ "​我​看​ GPU power profile ​与​ NCCL collective swing" AI ​系统​研究者​ §3–§5 sub-second ​物理​ §3.3 / §5.1 / §10.5 "​我​看​碳​/​水​信号​与​跨​ region shifting" ​能源​系统​研究者​ §6–§8 ​信号​与​三联​ nexus §6.1 ​信号​谱系​ / §8.2 wet-bulb / §10.4 "​我​看​ FERC docket ​与​ RTO tariff" ​能源​政策​研究者​ §9 mechanism + §10 stitch §9.1 EL25-49 / §10.5 / §10.6 "​三类​都​关心​" ​跨学科​ / ​综述​读者​ ​按​ §1.1–§2 → §10 → §11 ​顺序​读​ ​全文​

​未解释​术语​的​ first-appearance ​索引​（GIFL / FERC EL25-49-000 / Phoenix / LME / CMEF / Williamson hold-up / Banerjee herding ​等​）​见​ §2.1 ​术语表​；​初读​时若遇​陌生​ acronym，​先​在​ §2.1 ​检索​再​回到​正文​。

2024 ​年​以前​，​超大型​ AI ​训练​ / ​推理​数据中心​ (DC) ​在​电力​规划​层​普遍​被​视为​ must-run base load——​满负荷​接入​、​不​参与​ demand response (DR)、​对​电网​频率​事件​透明​。​这一​假设​的​三个​支柱​在​ 2024–2026 ​同时​松动​：

  1. ​现场​实测​层​： Turning AI Data Centers into Grid-Interactive Assets: Results from a Field Demonstration in Phoenix, Arizona (Nature Energy 2025/26 online; arXiv:2507.00909；Colangelo, Coskun, Megrue, Roberts, Sengupta, Sivaram, Tiao, Vijaykar, Williams, Wilson, MacFarland, Dreiling, Morey, Ratnayake, Vairamohan, 15 authors) ​在​ Phoenix 256-GPU ​训练​集群​上​首次​给出​公开​可​复现​的​ envelope ​实测​：​据​该​论文​报告​，​集群​可​在​功率​上​界​基础​上​压缩​约​ −25 % ​持续​ 3 ​小时​——​本​综述​凡​引用​此​数字​一律​以​ "−25 % × 3 h ​单​ envelope ​内​最大​组合​" ​复述​，​不可​拆开​宣称​"​可任意​ 3 h ​大幅​削峰​"（​见​ §6 fact-check ​附录​）。
  2. ​市场机制​层​： FERC ​于​ 2025-12-18 ​在​ docket EL25-49-000 (PJM Co-Location Order) ​中​要求​ PJM ​提交​对​ large flexible load ​的​ Firm vs Non-Firm Co-located Demand Service (CDS) ​区分​ tariff；60-day compliance window ​落​在​ 2026-02-16，​因​当日​是​ President's Day，PJM ​实际​于​ 2026-02-17 ​提交​（FERC fact sheet / PJM docket file ​一致​确认​；​早期​律所​ brief ​中​的​ "1/20" ​已​被​ 12/18 order ​推翻​）。FERC ANOPR RM26-4-000 (2025-10 DOE Secretary Letter → 2026-04-30 DOE ​期望​的​ final action ​目标​日期​) ​进一步​把​ large load interconnection ​的​ federal ​维度​推上​ docket。​其中​ GIFL = grid-interactive flexible load（​可​向​ RTO/utility ​承诺​ envelope ​并​按​ audit ​兑现​的​大型​负荷​）；FERC EL25-49 = ​监管​ hyperscaler ​与​发电厂​直接​配对​的​ co-location tariff；LME = ​节点​级​边际​碳​信号​；CMEF = ​在​ cascading/non-price-taker ​下​对​ MCI ​的​群体行为​修正​信号​；ELCC (effective load carrying capability) ​此处​指​ data-center load resource ​相对​其​ nameplate ​计入​ PJM capacity ​的​可信​容量​比例​。Williamson 1979 hold-up ​与​ Banerjee 1992 herding ​是​两个​ cross-domain ​经济学​引用​，​详见​ §9.11 ​与​ §6.6。
  3. ​学术​综述​层​： ​已有​ S1–S11 ​共​ 10 ​余篇​综述​各自​处理​ (workload planning / spatial-temporal carbon / LCA / DR survey) ​的​子集​，​但​无​一​同时​覆盖​ (workload schedulability × ​跨​ region sustainability × market mechanism) ​三块​。S1 (arXiv:2509.07218 ​待​ verify) ​是​最​接近​的​同时代​综述​，​但​缺​ FERC 12/2025 ​与​ water ​维度​；S4 (Google "24/7 CFE") ​缺​ market；S6 (MDPI Sustainability ​待​ verify) ​缺​ sub-second；S10/S11 (Nature Sustainability ​待​ verify / Patterns ​待​ verify) ​停​在​ annual LCA。

​本​综述​把​ AI DC ​视为​ grid-interactive flexible load (GIFL)，​并​在​ mid-tier ​三块​骨架​——workload schedulability (Thread A)、spatial-temporal sustainability (Thread B)、FERC/RTO mechanism (Thread C)——​上​做​联合​ framing。

docs.title: 1.2 Scope: Three-Layer Framing
docs.text:
​本​综述​采用​ Phase 0a ​三层​ scope：

  • Narrow scope (single site, sub-minute): GPU cluster ​在​ power-cap / DVFS / BESS coupling ​下​的​物理​ envelope (§4–§5)。
  • Mid-tier scope (fleet, hour–day): ​跨​ region ​的​ spatial-temporal workload shifting ​与​ carbon/water-aware ​调度​ (§6–§8)。
  • Broad scope (federal/RTO, queue–year): FERC docket、RTO tariff、capacity market、co-location ​安排​在​制度​层​重塑​ DC ​的​ grid-interactive ​地位​ (§9)。

mid-tier ​是​本​综述​的​承重​层​：narrow ​与​ broad ​单独​看​都​已有​较​成熟​综述​，​但​ mid-tier ​把​三块​缝合​的​工作​仍​是​ gap。

docs.title: 1.3 Differentiation ​与​既有​ 10+ ​篇​综述​的​对照
docs.text:
​本​综述​与​既有​综述​的​差异化​由​三句话​概括​：

  1. Mid-tier ​三块​联合​骨架​。 S1 ​缺​ FERC ​与​ water；S4 / S6 / S7 ​不​含​ market ​与​ sub-second ​物理​；S10 / S11 ​停​在​ annual LCA。​本​综述​以​ workload-control × ​跨​ region fleet × FERC/RTO mechanism ​为​同等​承重​骨架​，​并​在​ §10 cross-thread stitch ​用​ (defer ↔ shift, envelope ↔ audit, LME ↔ cascading) ​三对​耦合​显式​连接​。
  2. ​方法学​骨架​不是​工程​清单​。 ​既有​综述​按​ (hardware-centric vs software-centric)、(temporal vs spatial)、(operational vs embodied) ​等​二元​ taxonomy ​排列​文献​；​本​综述​以​两条​概念​骨架​贯穿​——T2 (cascading-aware Pigouvian + Banerjee 1992 herding) ​揭示​ carbon-aware ​文献​中​ price-taker ​假设​崩溃​的​分裂​根源​；T3 (commitment-audit-penalty + Williamson 1979 hold-up) ​把​ FERC docket / ERCOT 75 MW ​规则​ / Utility Dive envelope proposal ​放在​同一​ mechanism design ​空间​内​对照​。
  3. ​以​ 5 ​个​ Open Problem ​作为​差异化​承重​。 ​不同于​通常​综述​结尾​的​ "future work" ​散点​ list，​本​综述​每个​ open problem ​都​有​ (Phase 0a Q-mapping + Phase 0b unifying-thread + Phase 0c seam + ​缺位​综述​定位​) ​四元​锚定​ (​见​ §11)。

docs.title: 1.3.1 ​与​既有​ 10+ ​篇​综述​的​逐条​对照表
docs.text:
​下表​把​当前​可​对照​的​代表性​综述​与​本​综述​差异化​定位​逐条​列出​（​对​每篇​ ​作者​待​ verify ​的​综述​本​综述​仅以​ docket / arXiv ID / venue / scope ​描述​，​禁止​编造​作者​）：

​既有​综述​ scope ​缺位​维度​（​本​综述​补​） S1 (Chen, Wang, Colacelli, Lee, Xie, arXiv:2509.07218) AI DC grid-interactive ​综合​综述​ ​缺​ FERC 12/2025 EL25-49-000 ​与​ water ​维度​ S3 (Nat. Rev. EE highlight ​作者​待​ verify) high-level highlight ​缺​ sub-second ​物理​与​ mechanism S4 (Google 24/7 CFE ​作者​待​ verify) spatial-temporal carbon ​缺​ market ​与​ sub-second S5 (k8s survey ​作者​待​ verify) ​容器​编排​ ​缺​ grid ​视角​ S6 (MDPI Sustainability ​作者​待​ verify) sustainability ​综述​ ​缺​ sub-second ​与​ FERC S7 (Adv Appl Energy 2024 ​作者​待​ verify = B7) 24/7 CFE ​经济​ ​缺​ market ​与​ schedulability S8 (Wiesner & Kao, Moving Beyond Marginal Carbon Intensity, arXiv:2507.11377) carbon-aware critique (​核心​靶点​：MCI ​作为​ carbon accounting ​与​ grid flexibility ​度量​都​不​充分​) ​缺​ mechanism design S10 (Nat. Sustain. ​作者​待​ verify) LCA ​停​在​ annual，​无​ hourly dispatch S11 / B11 (Patterns ​作者​待​ verify) annual LCA + water ​同​ S10

​本​综述​独立​于​以上​所有​综述​的​一点​是​：​把​ (workload schedulability × spatial-temporal sustainability × FERC/RTO mechanism) ​同时​作​骨架​并​显式​ stitch。

docs.title: 1.4 "​不查​不​写​" ​写作​原则
docs.text: ​作者​归属​、docket ​编号​、​期刊​卷期​、​百分比​数字​凡未​ fetch ​全文​或​官方​ source verify ​的​，​本​综述​明确​标注​ [​作者​待​ verify] ​或​ "​该​论文​ / ​该​ docket"，​并​保留​区间​不​给​点估计​——​例如​ M4 ​投资​+​运行​成本​ 3–21 %、B11 Patterns carbon 32.6–79.7 Mt ​区间​。​这一​立场​源自​ LLM ​在​作者​归属​ / ​合作者​数​ / ​具体​百分比​上​的​系统​偏差​经验​，​相关​ fact-check ​风险​见​ §6 ​与​本​文档​末​附录​ A。

docs.title: 1.4.1 ​与​ EPRI DCFlex / DOE Solicitation ​等​ Industry Initiative ​的​关系
docs.text:
​除​学术​综述​外​，​本​综述​还​需要​在​ industry initiative ​的​语境​下​定位​：

  • EPRI DCFlex initiative: ​由​ EPRI ​主导​的​多​ utility / hyperscaler ​联合​项目​，A1 Phoenix demo ​是​其​早期​产出​之一​。DCFlex ​强调​"site-level envelope ​可​被​ utility ​调度​"，​与​ M9 envelope ​四元组​语义​相通​。
  • DOE Secretary Letter (2025-10): ​指明​ large load interconnection ​是​ FERC ​与​ DOE ​共同​关注​议题​，​催生​了​ M2 RM26-4 ANOPR。
  • Hyperscaler ​内部​ sustainability commitments: Google 24/7 CFE、Microsoft "carbon negative by 2030"、Meta "net zero by 2030" ​等​ corporate pledge ​与​本​综述​讨论​的​ mechanism ​有​耦合​：corporate pledge ​提供​ "voluntary" ​信号​，FERC mechanism ​提供​ "mandatory" ​约束​，​二者​激励​兼容性问题​在​ §10.3 cascading ​失效​下​进一步​复杂化​。

​本​综述​把​这些​ industry initiative ​视为​ mechanism design space ​的​ "data points"，​但​不​依赖​任何​单一​ initiative ​的​内部​数据​作为​ substantive claim ​的​支撑​——​主要​原因​是​ industry initiative ​的​方法学​透明度​通常​低于​ peer-reviewed ​论文​。

docs.title: 1.5 ​综述​方法学​：​四​阶段​ Phase 0 → Phase 1 ​流水线
docs.text:
​本​综述​采用​四​阶段​写作​流水线​：

  • Phase 0a (scoping): ​给出​研究​问题​集​（Q1–Q5）、​初步​ notation、​三层​ scope；
  • Phase 0b (unifying): ​识别​五条​ unifying thread (T1–T5) ​与​ 11-survey 6-axis ​矩阵​；
  • Phase 0c (thread-wise deep dive): Thread A workload control / Thread B spatial-temporal sustainability / Thread C market regulation ​三份​并行​深度​调研​，​识别​ seam；
  • Phase 0d (synthesis): ​把​三​ thread + 5 unifying thread ​合并​为​最终​ outline / notation / taxonomy / verified registry / fact-check risk register；
  • Phase 1 (draft): ​即本​文档​。​后续​将​经过​ fact-check round / ​评审​ / ​修订​ / ​发表​。

​四​阶段​流水线​的​设计​目的​是​把​"​不查​不​写​"​原则​在结构上​固化​：​每一​阶段​的​输出​都​明确​标注​ verified vs unverified，​避免​在​ draft ​阶段​被​ LLM ​系统​偏差​污染​。

docs.title: 1.5.1 ​与​ Phase 0 ​文档​的​差异化​角色
docs.text:
Phase 0a–0d ​文档​与​本​ Phase 1 ​综述​在​角色​上​有​明确分工​：

  • Phase 0a: ​提出​研究​问题​与​初步​ framing，​给​读者​ "​为何​要​做​这件​事​" ​的​答案​；
  • Phase 0b: ​给出​ unifying thread ​与​ 11-survey ​矩阵​，​回答​ "​已有​综述​覆盖​到​哪里​"；
  • Phase 0c: ​三​ thread ​并行​深度​调研​，​给出​ cluster-level ​的​方法学​骨架​与​ seam ​识别​；
  • Phase 0d: ​把​上述​输入​合并​为​ final outline / notation / taxonomy / verified registry / fact-check ​风险​，​作为​ Phase 1 ​的​硬​约束​；
  • Phase 1 (​本​文档​): ​在​ Phase 0d ​约束​下​完成​ self-contained ​综述​初稿​，​未来​读者​无需​阅读​ Phase 0 ​即可​理解​全文​。

Phase 0 ​文档​保留​在​项目​ repo ​中​作为​方法学​透明度​的​证据​，​但​不​要求​读者​阅读​——Phase 1 ​综述​本身​是​面向​最终​读者​的​成品​。

docs.title: 1.6 ​综述​读者群​与​阅读​建议
docs.text:
​本​综述​面向​三类​读者​：

  1. AI ​系统​研究者​（​关注​ Thread A ​与​ §3-§5 sub-second ​物理​）；
  2. ​能源​系统​研究者​（​关注​ Thread B ​与​ §6-§8 ​信号​设计​ / ​三联​ nexus）；
  3. ​能源​政策​ / FERC docket ​关注​者​（​关注​ Thread C ​与​ §9 mechanism）。

​三类​读者​的​推荐​阅读​路径​分别​是​ §1→§2→§3-§5→§10→§11、§1→§2→§6-§8→§10→§11、§1→§2→§9→§10→§11。​三类​路径​都​建议​先读​ §1 paradigm shift ​与​ §2 notation ​以​建立​共同语言​。

docs.title: 2.1 ​术语​精确化
docs.text: 术语​ ​定义​ (​本​综述​使用​义​) GIFL (grid-interactive flexible load) ​可​向​ RTO / utility ​承诺​ envelope ​并​按​ audit metric ​兑现​的​大型​负荷​ (​本​综述​顶层​范畴​)。 DCFlex EPRI ​主导​的​ DC flexibility initiative；M8 ​实测​来源​之一​。 HILL (highly interruptible load) ​可​在​分钟​级​响应​中断​指令​的​ load ​类​，​本​综述​用作​ DR ​中​的​子类​。 LME (locational marginal emissions) ​节点​级​（per-bus）​边际​排放​强度​信号​；​形式​上​是​ OPF emission constraint ​上​的​对偶​变量​，​与​ LMP（power balance ​对偶​）​同源​ (B4, Cote & Sun, arXiv:2512.18819)。 CMEF (cascading marginal emissions factor) ​在​多个​ large flexible load ​联动​下​，​单点​ MEF ​不再​ price-taker ​时​的​修正​信号​ (B5；​该​论文​在​ EV ​上​ instantiate)。 MCI / AEF (marginal carbon intensity / average emission factor) hourly grid carbon signal ​的​两种​主流​形态​。 CDS (Contract Demand Service) FERC EL25-49-000 ​中​ PJM ​区分​的​ Firm Contract Demand transmission service / Non-Firm Contract Demand transmission service ​两类​ tariff（​本​综述​简称​ Firm CDS / Non-Firm CDS）。 NCBL (non-customer baseline load) PJM capacity market ​中​针对​ large flexible load ​的​ baseline framework；​用于​在​ capacity ​评估​时​给​ large flex load ​设定​ ex ante ​的​"​未​参与​ DR ​时​的​ baseline ​负荷​"​基准​ (M7)。 ORDC (operating reserve demand curve) ERCOT ​把​ reserve ​短缺​转换​为​ energy price ​的​曲线​（scarcity-based price ​而​非​显式​ capacity market）；M11 ​报告​ Aurora ​模拟​其​失真​。 ELCC (effective load carrying capability) ​资源​ nameplate ​中​可​计入​ capacity ​的​可信​比例​；​最初​为​ intermittent generator ​设计​，PJM ​近年​扩展​到​ large flexible load resource。 DVFS (dynamic voltage/frequency scaling) GPU/CPU ​在​运行​时​调节​工作电压​与​频率​的​功率​/​性能​ knob；​本​综述​把​ \(f_n^{\text{GPU}}\) ​作为​其​代表​变量​。 PCC (point of common coupling) DC ​与​ grid（utility ​侧​）​的​物理​接入点​；envelope / audit ​通常​在​ PCC ​度量​。 FFR (fast frequency response) sub-second ​级​响应​频率​事件​的​ ancillary service；​典型​要求​秒​以下​响应​ + 10–30 s ​持续​。 ANOPR (advance notice of proposed rulemaking) FERC ​立法​流程​中​的​预​通告​阶段​；​早​于​ NOPR ​与​ final rule。 ISA (interconnection service agreement) hyperscaler / load ​与​ RTO/utility ​之间​关于​接入​服务​的​双边​合同​；M3 Talen-Amazon ISA ​是​代表性​案例​。 NCCL (NVIDIA Collective Communications Library) ​分布式​训练​中多​ GPU ​同步​梯度​/​参数​的​标准​库​；ring/tree all-reduce ​是​其​两种​主要​ collective topology，​是​ sub-second power swing ​的​来源​。 HBM (high-bandwidth memory) ​紧贴​ GPU die ​的​高带宽​内存​；​其​温度​ \(\theta_n^{\text{HBM}}\) ​是​ thermal-aware ​控制​的​关键​约束​。 co-location DC ​与​ generator ​直接​ BTM (behind-the-meter) ​配对​ (M3 Talen-Amazon Susquehanna ISA case)。 TTFT / TBT / JCT / SLO time to first token / time between tokens / job completion time / service level objective；LLM inference QoS ​的​主要​度量​。

docs.title: 2.2 Notation Table (Final, consolidated)
docs.text:
​整合​ Phase 0a §5、Phase 0c A/B/C ​的​符号​，​按​ "​集合​ → ​状态​ → ​控制​ → ​信号​ → ​目标​" ​五段​排列​。

​集合​与​索引​：

  • \(\mathcal{D} = \{d_1, \dots, d_N\}\) — ​数据中心​ site ​集合​，cardinality \(N\)。
  • \(\mathcal{R}\) — ​电网​ region / RTO / balancing authority ​集合​。
  • \(\mathcal{J}_t\) — ​时刻​ \(t\) ​待​调度​的​ AI workload job ​集合​。
  • \(\mathcal{T}\) — ​调度​时间​步​集合​，​按​ sub-second / minute / hour ​多​尺度​细分​。
  • \(\mathcal{M} = \{T, LI, BI, FT\}\) — workload ​类型​：training / latency-critical inference / batch inference / fine-tuning。

​状态​与​功率​变量​：

  • \(\mathbf{p}_t \in \mathbb{R}^N\) — ​各​ site ​在​ \(t\) ​时刻​的​有功​功率​向量​ (MW)。
  • \(\bar{p}_n, \underline{p}_n\) — site \(n\) ​的​物理​功率​上​下限​。
  • \(p_n^{\text{commit}}\) — site \(n\) ​向​ RTO ​承诺​的​ flexibility envelope ​中线​ (M9 envelope ​四元组​之一​)。
  • \((\bar p, \underline p, T_{\text{response}}, T_{\text{sustain}})\) — M9 ​提出​的​ audit envelope ​四元组​：​上​界​、​下界​、​响应​时​长​、​可​持续​时​长​。
  • \(\Delta f_t\) — ​频率​偏差​ (Hz)，sub-minute response ​控制​律​输入​。
  • \(\theta_n^{\text{HBM}}\) — site \(n\) GPU HBM ​温度​ (​热应力​约束​)。

​控制​与​调度​变量​：

  • \(\mathbf{W}_t\) — workload-to-site ​分配​矩阵​，\(W_{j,n,t} \in [0,1]\)（job \(j\) ​在​ site \(n\) ​的​分配比例​），\(\sum_n W_{j,n,t} = 1\)（​每个​ job ​在​ site ​集合​上​的​ simplex ​分配​）。
  • \(\alpha_j \in [0,1]\) — job \(j\) ​的​一阶​ preemptibility ​标量​ (1 = ​完全​可​中断​)。
  • \(\alpha'_j\) — ​拓扑​感知​ preemptibility (Phase 0c A Seam δ)：NCCL ring / tree collective ​的​ hypergraph ​二阶​约束​。
  • \(\tau_j\) — job \(j\) ​的​ deadline / SLO ​时限​。
  • \(C_j, R_j\) — job \(j\) ​的​ checkpoint size ​与​ restore time。
  • \(\pi_\theta(\cdot)\) — ​调度​策略​ (RL / MPC / ​启发式​)，\(\theta\) ​为​参数​。
  • \(f_n^{\text{GPU}}\) — site \(n\) GPU ​工作频率​ (DVFS knob)。
  • \(\phi_j \in \{\text{prefill}, \text{decode}\}\) — LLM inference ​阶段​标识​ (phase-aware DVFS ​需要​)。

​信号​ (Pigouvian / market)：

  • \(\mathbf{c}_t^{\text{region}} \in \mathbb{R}^{|\mathcal{R}|}\) — region ​级​实时​碳​强度​信号​ (kgCO\(_2\)/MWh)，​可​为​ MCI / AEF（RTO/BA ​粒度​，\(|\mathcal{R}|\) ​量级​ 10s）。
  • \(\mathbf{c}_t^{\text{LME}} \in \mathbb{R}^{|\mathcal{N}_{\text{bus}}|}\) — locational marginal emissions，​节点​（bus）​级​（B4，\(|\mathcal{N}_{\text{bus}}|\) ​量级​ \(10^3\)+；​本​综述​用​投影​ \(\Pi_{R\to N}\) ​把​ region ​信号​映射​到​节点​）。\(\mathbf{c}_t\) ​在​无​下标​时​默认​ region ​级​。
  • \(\mathbf{c}_t^{\text{CMEF}}\) — cascading marginal emissions factor (B5)。
  • \(\boldsymbol{\lambda}_t\) — LMP ​或​ LMP+LME ​联合​价格​向量​。
  • \(\boldsymbol{\mu}_t\) — water stress / WUE ​信号​。
  • \(\mu_t^{\text{wb}}\) — wet-bulb-driven hourly water intensity (T5 ​桥接​候选​信号​)。
  • \(\sigma_t\) — scarcity / ORDC ​价格​信号​ (M11)。

​目标​与​ QoS：

  • \(q_j(\mathbf{p}, \mathbf{W})\) — job \(j\) ​的​ QoS ​函数​ (throughput, JCT, TTFT, TBT, accuracy)。
  • \(\eta_n^{\text{PUE}}, \eta_n^{\text{WUE}}\) — site \(n\) ​的​ PUE ​与​ WUE。
  • \(\mathcal{L}(\cdot)\) — ​多​目标​损失​： $\(\mathcal{L} = w_1 \cdot (\boldsymbol{\lambda}_t^\top \mathbf{p}_t) + w_2 \cdot (\mathbf{c}_t^\top \mathbf{p}_t) + w_3 \cdot (\boldsymbol{\mu}_t^\top \mathbf{p}_t) + w_4 \cdot \text{QoSPenalty}(\mathbf{W}_t, \mathbf{p}_t).\)$
  • \(V^{\text{commit}}, V^{\text{audit}}, V^{\text{penalty}}\) — T3 commitment game ​三要素​：​承诺​价值​ / ​审计​度量​ / ​违约​罚​。

​符号​歧义​注​： \(\bar{p}_n\) ​物理​上限​ ​与​ envelope ​承诺​上​界​ \(\bar p_n^{\text{env}}\) ​在​不同​上下文​使用​，​引用​时​通过​ subscript ​区分​。

Commun. cascading-EV ​待​ verify) hour fleet (signal-level) actionable scope-2 excess-power / CMEF mechanism design B4 LME nodal (Cote & Sun, arXiv:2512.18819) hour 1493-bus WI nodal optimizer carbon LME none B10 / B11 / B12 water + carbon LLM (SLIT arXiv:2505.23554 ​待​ verify；Patterns ​待​ verify；GCOS ​待​ verify) hour–annual geo fleet scheduler + LCA carbon + water + cost + TTFT \(\mu\) static / LCA none M1 / M2 / M5 / M6 / M7 RTO+FERC mechanisms queue → year RTO + federal tariff + queue reliability + cost allocation (price + curtail priority) Firm/Non-Firm CDS, NCBL, 75 MW, 90-day M3 Talen-Amazon ISA case queue single pair bilateral contract private + ratepayer $140M shift (AEP/Exelon ​抗议书​数字​，​非​中立​估算​) BTM vs grid-connected X1 Facility HVAC + cooling DR (cross-domain anchor) min–hr single site facility BMS + cap thermal SLO + grid signal \(\theta_n^{\text{HBM}}\), \(T_{\text{wb}}\) DR (​类比​ §10.9.2 HVAC ​列​) X2 Co-located BESS (cross-domain anchor) sub-sec–hr single site BESS + EMS swing ​缓冲​ + ancillary + capacity \(\Delta f\), \(\lambda_t\), \(\sigma_t\) ancillary + capacity

​矩阵​关键​观察​（​指向​ §11 open problems）：

  1. (µs–sub-second) × (ancillary services market) ​联合​空格​仍空​：A12 ​在​ RTO ​侧​建模​、A2 ​在​ facility ​私有​验证​，​缺​学术界​可​复现​公开​ envelope → Open #1。
  2. (CMEF signal) × (hyperscaler fleet) ​空白​：B5 ​在​ EV ​上​ instantiate，​未​迁移​到​ DC fleet → Open #2。
  3. (carbon+water ​双联​) × (nodal LME ​调度​) ​空白​：B4 ​与​ B10/B11/B12 ​不​交集​ → Open #4。

docs.title: 2.4 ​三层​ Scope ​与​ Taxonomy Matrix ​的​关系
docs.text:
§1.2 ​定义​的​三层​ scope (narrow / mid-tier / broad) ​在​ §2.3 taxonomy matrix ​上​的​投影​如下​：

  • narrow scope ​对应​矩阵​中​ (time-scale = µs–min) × (spatial-scale = single site) ​的​左上角​：A1 / A2 / A3-A11 / A13 ​集中​分布​；
  • mid-tier scope ​对应​矩阵​中​ (time-scale = hour–day) × (spatial-scale = fleet) ​的​中部​：B1-B12 ​集中​分布​；
  • broad scope ​对应​矩阵​中​ (time-scale = queue–year) × (spatial-scale = RTO + federal) ​的​右下角​：M1-M11 ​集中​分布​。

​三层​之间​的​"​对角线​缝合​"（​即​ §10.1-§10.7 stitch）​正是​当前​文献​最​稀缺​的​工作​。​本​综述​的​核心​ contribution ​是​显式​刻画​对角线​而​非​沿​三层​中​的​某​一层​加深​。

docs.title: 2.4.1 6-Axis Taxonomy ​选择​理由
docs.text:
​本​综述​选取​ 6 axes（time-scale / spatial-scale / control-hierarchy / objective / signal / mechanism）​的​理由​如下​：

  • time-scale: AI DC ​灵活​度​跨越​ µs (sub-second GPU swing) ​至​ year (interconnection queue) ​共​ 12+ ​数量级​；time-scale ​是​最​基础​的​分类​轴​。
  • spatial-scale: single site / fleet / RTO / federal ​四层​ spatial ​视角​是​ Thread A / B / C ​各自​工作​的​差异​核心​。
  • control-hierarchy: workload-level / facility-level / RTO-level ​三层​ control hierarchy ​决定​了​"​谁​是​ control authority"——​这​与​ mechanism ​中​的​ commitment ​结构​直接​挂钩​。
  • objective: energy / SLO / carbon / water / cost / reliability ​等​多​目标​的​相对​权重​决定​了​ control loss ​设计​；​本​综述​统一​ \(\mathcal{L}\) ​形式​（§2.2）​就是​为了​让​这​一轴可​比较​。
  • signal: $\Delta f / $ price / MCI / LME / CMEF / water / scarcity ​等​信号​类型​直接​决定​ mechanism ​的​ Pigouvian ​形式​。
  • mechanism: voluntary DR / ancillary market / capacity baseline / tariff classification / co-location ​等​机制​类型​是​ Thread C ​的​核心​轴​。

​未​选取​的​候选​ axes（​如​ hardware-centric vs software-centric、operational vs embodied、temporal vs spatial）​多为​二元​分类​，​缺乏​跨​论文​ differentiating power；​本​综述​判定​ 6 axes ​已能​ capture ​多数​ cross-paper ​差异​。

docs.title: 2.5 Notation ​的​跨章​一致性​约束
docs.text:
§2.2 ​给出​的​ notation ​表在​ §3-§10 ​中​必须​严格​一致​。​本​综述​在​此​重申​几个​跨章易​混​的​符号​：

  • \(\alpha_j\) vs \(\alpha'_j\): ​前者​是​一阶​ preemptibility ​标量​ (Thread B ​用法​)；​后者​是​拓扑​感知​二阶​约束​ (Thread A Seam δ ​用法​)。​引用​时​必须​明确​。
  • \(\bar p_n\) vs \(\bar p_n^{\text{env}}\): ​前者​是​ site \(n\) ​物理​上限​；​后者​是​ envelope ​承诺​上​界​。M9 audit envelope ​四元组​中​的​ \(\bar p\) ​一律​理解​为​ \(\bar p^{\text{env}}\)。
  • \(\mathbf{c}_t\) ​的​三种​ instantiation: \(\mathbf{c}_t^{\text{MCI}}\) (hourly grid ​边际​) / \(\mathbf{c}_t^{\text{LME}}\) (nodal ​边际​) / \(\mathbf{c}_t^{\text{CMEF}}\) (group-staggered ​修正​)。§6.1 ​已​分别​说明​。
  • \(\boldsymbol{\mu}_t\) vs \(\mu_t^{\text{wb}}\): ​前者​是​ generic water signal；​后者​是​ wet-bulb-driven hourly water intensity (T5 ​桥接​候选​)。

docs.title: 2.6 Taxonomy ​中​的​"​空白​单元​"​识别方法​学
docs.text:
​本​综述​在​ §2.3 ​给出​ 14-row × 6-axis ​矩阵​后​，​并​不是​简单​地​把​每篇​论文​放入​对应​格子​，​而是​显式​标记​"​空白​单元​"——​即​没有​任何​论文​同时​覆盖​的​ (axis-pair) ​组合​。​识别​空白​单元​的​方法学​是​：

  1. ​把​每篇​论文​在​ 6 axes ​上​投影​；
  2. ​对​每​对​ axes ​做​ cross-tabulation，​统计​组合​的​覆盖​数​；
  3. ​选取​覆盖​数​ = 0 ​或​ ≤ 1 ​的​组合​作为​候选​ open problem；
  4. ​把​候选​ open problem ​与​ Phase 0a Q-mapping ​与​ Phase 0b unifying thread ​交叉​，​过滤​出​真正​承重​的​ 5 ​个​。

​这一​方法学​使得​"​差异化​定位​"​从​主观​声明​变为​可​核对​的​结构性​结论​：​每个​ open problem ​都​能​在​矩阵​中​指向​具体​空白​单元​。
