​符号​约定​ — ​两个​ \(T\) ​必须​区分​：​全文​使用​ \(T_{ ext{horizon}}\) ​表示​场景​长度​ (\(\mathbf{x}_0 \in \mathbb{R}^{T_{ ext{horizon}} imes D}\), ​例如​ day-ahead 96 ​步​ × \(D\) ​通道​) ​与​ \(T_{ ext{diff}}\) ​表示​扩散​步数​ (​反向​链​总​步数​, ​例如​ DDPM 1000、DDIM 50)。​这一​区分​对​ §5–§9 ​不可​省略​：P3 / P4 ​的​ \(\eta_t\) schedule、P6 ​的​ pathwise gradient through DDIM ​都​ ​仅​ ​在​ \(T_{ ext{diff}}\) ​维度​上​展开​，​而​ ramp / KCL ​等​约束​沿​ \(T_{ ext{horizon}}\) ​维度​展开​。

DDPM (denoising diffusion probabilistic model) ​定义​在​长度​ \(T_{ ext{horizon}}\)、\(D\) ​通道​的​清洁​场景​ \(\mathbf{x}_0 \in \mathbb{R}^{T_{ ext{horizon}} imes D}\) ​上​的​ Markov ​前​向​链​：

\[q(\mathbf{x}_t \mid \mathbf{x}_{t-1}) = \mathcal{N}(\mathbf{x}_t; \sqrt{1- eta_t}\,\mathbf{x}_{t-1}, eta_t \mathbf{I}), \quad t = 1, \ldots, T_{ ext{diff}},\]

​其中​ \(\{ eta_t\}\) ​是​ noise schedule，\(\alpha_t = 1 - eta_t\)，\( ar{\alpha}_t = \prod_{s \le t} \alpha_s\)。​其​闭合​形式​ forward marginal (​直觉​：​从​清洁​数据​ \(\mathbf{x}_0\) ​出发​，\(t\) ​步后​变成​什么​分布​——​闭合​ Gaussian ​使​训练​时能​直接​采样​ \(\mathbf{x}_t\) ​而​不必​走​ \(t\) ​步链​)：

\[q(\mathbf{x}_t \mid \mathbf{x}_0) = \mathcal{N}(\sqrt{ ar{\alpha}_t}\,\mathbf{x}_0,\,(1- ar{\alpha}_t)\mathbf{I}).\]

​逆向​链​由​参数​化​网络​ \(p_ heta(\mathbf{x}_{t-1} \mid \mathbf{x}_t, \mathbf{c})\) ​学习​，​其中​ \(\mathbf{c}\) ​是​条件​向量​ (NWP ​协​变量​ / ​模式​标签​ / ​文本​嵌入​ / ​图​特征​)。\(\epsilon\)-​参数​化​对应​ noise prediction network \(\epsilon_ heta(\mathbf{x}_t, t, \mathbf{c})\)，​训练​目标​为​：

\[\mathcal{L}_{ ext{simple}} = \mathbb{E}_{t, \mathbf{x}_0, \epsilon}\left[\|\epsilon - \epsilon_ heta(\mathbf{x}_t, t, \mathbf{c})\|_2^2 ight], \quad \epsilon \sim \mathcal{N}(\mathbf{0}, \mathbf{I}).\]

Score-SDE ​视角​下​，​等价​的​ score network ​是​ \(\mathbf{s}_ heta(\mathbf{x}_t, t, \mathbf{c}) \approx abla_{\mathbf{x}_t} \log p_t(\mathbf{x}_t \mid \mathbf{c})\)，​并​通过​ reverse-time SDE ​采样​。​直觉​：score function \( abla \log p\) ​指向​数据​高密​区域​；​沿​ score ​方向​上升​ = ​朝​真实​数据​走​，​沿其负​方向​下降​ = ​走向​ prior。P3 (§2.8) ​把​"​约束​违反​"​做成​一个​额外​的​"​似然​"​信号​叠加​在​ score ​上​，​正是​该​直觉​的​直接​利用​。

Tweedie estimator ​在​反向​采样​中​至关重要​ (​用于​ P3 gradient guidance ​和​ P4 projection)：

\[\hat{\mathbf{x}}_0(\mathbf{x}_t, t) = rac{\mathbf{x}_t - \sqrt{1- ar{\alpha}_t}\,\epsilon_ heta(\mathbf{x}_t, t, \mathbf{c})}{\sqrt{ ar{\alpha}_t}}.\]

​直觉​：\(\hat{\mathbf{x}}_0\) ​是​模型​在​ noisy \(\mathbf{x}_t\) ​处​对​清洁​版本​ \(\mathbf{x}_0\) ​的​当下​最佳​猜测​。P3 ​在​这个​猜测​上​算​约束​违反​梯度​，​而​不是​在​ \(\mathbf{x}_t\) ​本身​上​算​——​因为​ noisy \(\mathbf{x}_t\) ​的​ capacity / ramp / KCL ​没有​物理​意义​ (​它​是​ \(\mathbf{x}_0\) + ​高斯​噪声​)，​对​它​算​约束​违反​量​在​数值​上​和​物理​上​都​是​错​的​。Tweedie ​提供​"​假设​噪声​已​被​去除​后​样本​应是​什么样​" ​的​可微​估计​，​因此​构成​ P3 / P4 ​全部​技术​叙事​的​核心​钩子​。

DDPM ​与​ score-SDE ​的​等价​性​：Song et al. (ICLR 2021) ​证明​ DDPM ​的​离散​ Markov ​链​可以​视为​连续​时间​ forward SDE \(\mathrm{d}\mathbf{x} = f(\mathbf{x}, t) \mathrm{d}t + g(t) \mathrm{d}\mathbf{w}\) ​的​离散​化​；score function \(\mathbf{s}_ heta \approx abla_{\mathbf{x}_t} \log p_t\) ​与​ noise prediction \(\epsilon_ heta\) ​通过​ \(\mathbf{s}_ heta(\mathbf{x}_t, t) = -\epsilon_ heta(\mathbf{x}_t, t) / \sqrt{1- ar{\alpha}_t}\) ​联系​。​两种​视角​各有​优势​：DDPM ​视角​更​接近​ ELBO ​推导​，​便于​讲解​；score-SDE ​视角​更​适合​理解​ P3 (gradient guidance)。Phase 0 ​调研​池中​，CLDM / CAL-DM / MS-CADM ​等​ power-renewable ​论文​几乎​全部​采用​ DDPM ​视角​；Hoseinpour & Dvorkin (W6) ​与​ Score-based Offshore Typhoon Diffusion ​采用​ score-SDE ​视角​。​本​ survey ​在​ §5 ​之后​默认​ score-SDE ​视角​，​因为​ P3 / P4 ​在​该​视角​下​数学​更​紧凑​。

docs.title: 2.2 Classifier-free guidance (CFG)
docs.text:
CFG ​通过​同时​训练​条件​与​无条件​ noise prediction (​后者​由​随机​ drop \(\mathbf{c}\) ​实现​) ​得到​：

\[\tilde{\epsilon}(\mathbf{x}_t, t, \mathbf{c}) = (1+w)\,\epsilon_\theta(\mathbf{x}_t, t, \mathbf{c}) - w\,\epsilon_\theta(\mathbf{x}_t, t, \varnothing),\]

​其中​ \(w\) ​是​ guidance scale。\(w\) ​越大​，​条件​对齐​越强​，​但​模式​覆盖​收缩​ (mode coverage shrinks)——​这是​ §7 evaluation ​章节​中​ coverage–consistency trade-off ​的​核心​机制​。Dynamic-CFG ​在​ 2025 ​年​的​工作​进一步​表明​，trade-off ​在​ denoising step ​上​是​不​均匀​的​：​早期​ step ​高​ \(w\) ​会​塌缩​到​"​平均​样本​"，​中期​ step ​才​是​ high-frequency ​内容​塑形​的​窗口​。

CFG ​在​图像​ diffusion ​中是​控制​可控性​的​标准​工具​ (Ho & Salimans 2022)，​在​ power-renewable diffusion ​中​通过​ cluster / regime label ​作为​ \(\mathbf{c}\) ​实现​可控​生成​。​但​ \(w\) ​不是​一个​ "tune-once ​全​ setting ​都​适用​" ​的​超​参数​：​相同​ \(w\) ​下​，rare regime ​的​尾部​覆盖​与​ common regime ​的​尾部​覆盖​会​沿​不同​曲线​变化​。​这是​ §10 F6 ​的​核心​ frontier——​一张​ \(w\)-sweep × tail-coverage figure ​是​ ​任意​ CFG-conditioned power diffusion ​论文​都​应​附带​的​诊断​。

docs.title: 2.3 Latent diffusion ​与​ conditional latent diffusion
docs.text:
Latent diffusion ​把​ diffusion ​从​原始​空间​ \(\mathbb{R}^{T_{\text{horizon}}\times D}\) ​搬​到​ encoder \(\mathcal{E}\) ​学到​的​压缩​空间​ \(\mathbf{z}_0 = \mathcal{E}(\mathbf{x}_0)\) ​中​，​由​ decoder \(\mathcal{D}\) ​反向​映回​。​这​在​场景​生成​中​带来​两个​好处​ (​采样​加速​ + ​条件​耦合​更​易​) ​和​一个​ well-documented ​失败​模式​：conditioning collapse (​本​ survey ​采用​此​命名​以​与​经典​ VAE ​的​ posterior collapse ​区分​；​这里​"collapse" ​的​对象​是​条件​嵌入​ \(\mathbf{c}\) ​而​非​ latent \(\mathbf{z}\) ​塌缩​到​ prior)，​即当​条件​嵌入​相对​ latent ​容量​较​小时​，​逆向​链会​忽略​ \(\mathbf{c}\)，​退化​为​无条件​生成​。CAL-DM (W4 in §5 — Cross-Attention Latent Diffusion, SSRN 2025 <verify-Phase-2>) ​是​ Phase 0 ​调研​池中​唯一​显式​以​ conditional mutual information (CMI) ​辅助​目标​对抗​ conditioning collapse ​的​论文​——​但​ CMI ​辅助​本身​不是​ CAL-DM ​的​发明​，​而是​从​ VAE ​时代​的​ InfoVAE / β-VAE / mutual-information-bound ​家族​ (Zhao et al. 2017, InfoVAE: Information Maximizing Variational Autoencoders；Higgins et al. 2017, β-VAE) lift ​到​ latent diffusion ​的​直接​继承​。​这一​ lineage ​在​ §4.4 ​末段​ (coverage-consistency ​的​家族​ lineage) ​进一步​展开​。

​为什么​ power-renewable ​文献​偏向​ latent diffusion ​而​非​ raw-space diffusion？ ​两个​原因​：(i) ​场景​长度​ \(T\) ​在​ day-ahead ​用例​下​是​ 96 ​步​ (15-min × 24h) ​或​ 288 ​步​ (5-min × 24h)，raw-space diffusion ​在​这​一​长度​上​ attention / convolution ​成本​可控​，​但​ multi-channel + ​多​场站​推上去​后​ raw-space ​张量​维度​爆炸​——latent diffusion ​通过​ encoder ​把​通道​维度​压缩​ 5–10 ​倍​；(ii) NWP / pattern label ​等​条件​天然​适合​在​ latent ​空间​通过​ cross-attention ​注入​。​但​ latent space ​也​是​ posterior collapse ​的​舞台​——CAL-DM ​用​ CMI ​项​做​对抗​，​是​目前​唯一​显式​动作​。

docs.title: 2.4 Discrete-token ​与​ LLM-guided diffusion
docs.text:
Phase 0c-C Seam C5 ​强调​："diffusion" ​在​当前​文献​中​指向​至少​三个​不同​的​对象​：

  1. Continuous-noise DDPM / score-SDE — ​上述​ §2.1 ​含义​，​是​ power-renewable ​文献​的​主流​。
  2. Discrete-token language diffusion (LEAF-class, EMNLP 2025 Findings <verify-Phase-2>) — ​在​ LLM token space ​中​做​ masked-token denoising，​把​"​扩散​"​层级​搬​到​离散​符号​。​该​家族​与​ continuous-noise diffusion ​在​数学​对象​上​不同​；§8 head-to-head ​比较​表中​必须​保持​家族​区分​。
  3. LLM-guided continuous diffusion (LTSM-DIFF, arXiv 2602.00040; T2S, IJCAI 2025 <verify-Phase-2>) — ​在​ continuous diffusion sampler ​之上​叠加​ LLM ​派生​的​ conditional guidance，​是​ conditioning ladder rung 5 ​的​代表​。

​家族​区分​对​ §8 ​比较​至关重要​：discrete-token diffusion (LEAF) ​在​数学​对象​上​更​接近​ BERT ​风格​的​ masked language model，​而​非​ DDPM；​如果​ §8 head-to-head ​表把​ LEAF ​与​ continuous-noise diffusion (TimeGrad, CSDI) ​列​在​同一​行​，​会​导致​结论​混淆​——"diffusion wins" ​可能​是​ LEAF ​在​ LLM ​强​先验​下​的​胜利​，​而​非​ score-matching ​范式​的​胜利​。Phase 0d §6.6 ​已​专门​要求​ §8 ​比较​表​保持​家族​区分​。

docs.title: 2.5 Distributional metrics
docs.text:
CRPS (Continuous Ranked Probability Score):

\[\mathrm{CRPS}(F, y) = \int_{-\infty}^{+\infty} (F(z) - \mathbb{1}\{y \le z\})^2 \, dz,\]

​其中​ \(F\) ​是​预测​的​累积​分布​函数​，\(y\) ​是​观测​。Energy score (multivariate CRPS ​的​能量​分析​):

\[\mathrm{ES}(F, \mathbf{y}) = \mathbb{E}_{\mathbf{X} \sim F}\|\mathbf{X} - \mathbf{y}\| - \tfrac{1}{2}\mathbb{E}_{\mathbf{X}, \mathbf{X}' \sim F}\|\mathbf{X} - \mathbf{X}'\|.\]

Variogram score (Scheuerer & Hamill 2015 <verify-Phase-2>) ​抓取​空间​-​时间​相关​结构​；pinball loss ​抓取​分​位数​；reliability diagram ​抓取​边缘​标定​。​这些​是​ §7 Tier 1–2 ​的​标准​工具​。

CRPS / ES ​的​ proper-scoring-rule ​性质​：CRPS ​与​ ES ​都​是​ strictly proper scoring rules——​预测​分布​ \(F\) ​等于​真实​分布​ \(G\) ​时​ score ​最小​，​且​不​存在​使​ score ​更​低​的​ \(F \neq G\)。​这一​性质​使​ CRPS / ES ​成为​ Tier 1–2 ​的​"​安全​选项​"。​但​ proper-scoring-rule ​性质​不​保证​ ​与​下游​决策​相关​——​两个​ score ​相同​的​分布​可以​诱导​完全​不同​的​运营​成本​。​这是​ §7 Tier 4 ​必要性​的​根本​理论​原因​。

docs.title: 2.6 Projection ​与​ scenario reduction
docs.text:
Feasibility set \(\mathcal{F} \subset \mathbb{R}^{T \times D}\) ​定义​为​ capacity / ramp / KCL / balance ​约束​的​交集​。Projection operator \(\Pi_\mathcal{F}: \mathbb{R}^{T\times D} \to \mathcal{F}\) ​用于​ P4 (§5.4)。Hard output layer \(L_\mathcal{F}\) ​在​ P5 (§5.5) ​给出​可​微分​映射​到​ \(\mathcal{F}\) (KCLNet-style)。

Scenario reduction：​给定​大​样本​ \(\{\mathbf{x}^{(n)}\}_{n=1}^N\)，​选择​ \(K \ll N\) ​的​代表​ \(\mathcal{S} = \{\mathbf{x}^{(k)}, \pi_k\}\) ​使​其​在​ \(p\)-Wasserstein ​距离​ \(W_p\) ​下​最​接近​原​经验​分布​。​这是​ SP / DRO ​上游​的​标准​ pre-processing。

Projection ​的​两类​失败​模式​：​在​凸​ \(\mathcal{F}\) ​上​ \(\Pi_\mathcal{F}\) ​唯一​且​可微​ (​除了​ boundary ​集合​)，​所有​理论​性质​良好​；​在​非凸​ \(\mathcal{F}\) ​上​ (​例如​包含​ AC power flow ​等式​约束​) projection ​既​不​唯一​也​不​连续​——P4 ​在​该​情况​下​退化​为​ heuristic projection，​理论​保证​消失​。Phase 0c-A W9 (PGDM) ​的​理论​保证​只​覆盖​凸​场景​，​这是​为什么​ power systems ​的​ AC-feasibility (​本质​非凸​) ​上​ P4 ​一直​困难​、​而​ Hoseinpour & Dvorkin (W6) ​选择​ P3 ​而​非​ P4 ​的​根本原因​。

docs.title: 2.7 Decision-aware ​量
docs.text:
Operating cost \(c_{\mathrm{op}}(\cdot)\) ​定义​为​给定​场景​下​的​ stochastic UC / OPF / DRO ​的​最优​目标值​。cost-CRPS (Phase 0c-B Seam 3) ​定义​为​ CRPS ​在​ \(c_{\mathrm{op}}\) ​分布​上​的​取值​——​对​每个​条件​ \(\mathbf{c}\)，​比较​由​生成​场景​诱导​的​运营​成本​分布​ vs ​由​ oracle ​场景​诱导​的​。Commitment Hamming distance \(d_H(u_1, u_2)\) ​对​两个​承诺​向量​ \(u_1, u_2 \in \{0,1\}^{G\times T}\) ​计算​ 0-1 ​不​一致​位数​。VSS (Value of Stochastic Solution) ​与​ EVPI (Expected Value of Perfect Information) ​是​经典​ SP ​量​：

\[\mathrm{VSS} = \mathbb{E}[c_{\mathrm{op}}(x^*_{\mathrm{EV}})] - \mathbb{E}[c_{\mathrm{op}}(x^*_{\mathrm{SP}})], \quad \mathrm{EVPI} = \mathbb{E}[c_{\mathrm{op}}(x^*_{\mathrm{SP}})] - \mathbb{E}_\xi[c_{\mathrm{op}}(x^*(\xi))].\]

​这些​是​ §7 Tier 4 ​与​ §9 decision-aware chapter ​的​核心​工具​。

VSS / EVPI ​在​ renewable-heavy ​系统​中变​大​：​经典​ SP ​文献​ (Birge & Louveaux) ​在​火电​主导​的​系统​上​报告​ VSS ≈ 0.5–2 %；renewable penetration ​升高​后​，​由于​风能​ / ​太阳能​的​尾部​行为​不能​被​ deterministic / EV ​解​充分​捕获​，VSS ​显著​上升​ (​现代​研究​报告​ 5–15 % ​量级​在​高​ renewable ​占​比​的​系统​上​ <verify-Phase-2>)。​这​意味着​在​ renewable-heavy ​场景​下​，scenario quality ​对​运营​成本​的​杠杆​比​火电​时代​更大​——​而​这​正是​为什么​ Tier 4 ​的​空白​在​当下​尤其​严重​的​原因​。

docs.title: 2.8 P3 ​与​ P4 ​的​数学​钩子
docs.text:
P3 (reverse-step gradient guidance) ​把​ score ​用​约束​违反​梯度​修正​：

\[\tilde{\mathbf{s}}(\mathbf{x}_t, t, \mathbf{c}) = \mathbf{s}_\theta(\mathbf{x}_t, t, \mathbf{c}) - \eta_t \nabla_{\mathbf{x}_t}\, c(\hat{\mathbf{x}}_0(\mathbf{x}_t, t)),\]

​其中​ \(\eta_t\) ​是​ constraint-guidance scale (step-dependent)，\(c(\cdot)\) ​是​约束​违反​量​ (e.g. AC power balance residual)，\(\hat{\mathbf{x}}_0\) ​是​ Tweedie estimator。P4 (projection) ​直接​对​ \(\mathbf{x}_{t-1}\) ​或​对​ decoded \(\hat{\mathbf{x}}_0\) ​做​ \(\Pi_\mathcal{F}\)。

​实际​数值​范围​ (​供参考​)：​在​以​ IEEE 118-bus ​风电​场景​为例​的​标准​ SP-UC ​设置​下​，​运营​成本​ \(c_{\mathrm{op}}\) ​量级​约​ \(10^6\)–\(10^7\) ​美元​ / day；VSS ​在​ 5–15 % renewable penetration ​下约​ \(0.5–2\) % (​典型值​ \(5–20\)k ​美元​ / day)；commitment Hamming \(d_H\) ​在​两​ cost-near-optimal ​解​之间​常为​ \(10–100\) (​对应​ \(1–10\) % ​决策​位​)；redispatch volume ​在​重大​ forecast error ​后​可达​ \(200–500\) MWh (​典型​ ISO ​一天​ redispatch ​总量​ \(5\%–10\%\) ​总​发电​)。​这些​量级​是​ §10 F1 testbed ​设计​的​ sanity-check ​起点​；​任何​ diffusion ​论文​ report ​的​ Tier 4 ​数字​若​ ​远离​ ​该​量级​ (​例如​ VSS = 50%) ​应​触发​方法论​ sanity-check。

docs.title: 2.9 ​统一​ notation ​表
docs.text:
​全文​采用​以下​ notation；​后续​章节​不​引入​竞争​符号​。

Symbol Meaning \(T_{\text{horizon}}\) ​场景​时间​长度​ (e.g. 96 for 15-min × 24h day-ahead) \(T_{\text{diff}}\) ​扩散​反向​链​总​步数​ (e.g. 1000 DDPM, 50 DDIM) \(\mathbf{x}_0 \in \mathbb{R}^{T_{\text{horizon}} \times D}\) ​清洁​场景​，​长度​ \(T_{\text{horizon}}\)，\(D\) ​通道​ (wind/solar/load) \(\mathbf{x}_t\) diffusion step \(t \in \{1, \ldots, T_{\text{diff}}\}\) ​的​ noisy latent \(\mathbf{c}\) ​条件​向量​ (NWP / ​模式​ / ​文本​ / ​图​) \(\beta_t, \alpha_t, \bar{\alpha}_t\) DDPM noise schedule \(\epsilon_\theta(\mathbf{x}_t, t, \mathbf{c})\) noise prediction network \(\mathbf{s}_\theta(\mathbf{x}_t, t, \mathbf{c})\) score network \(\hat{\mathbf{x}}_0(\mathbf{x}_t, t)\) Tweedie estimator \(\mathcal{L}_{\text{simple}}\) DDPM training objective \(w\) CFG guidance scale \(\eta_t\) P3 constraint-guidance scale (step-dependent) \(\mathcal{F} \subset \mathbb{R}^{T \times D}\) feasibility set (capacity / ramp / KCL / balance) \(\Pi_\mathcal{F}\) projection (P4) \(L_\mathcal{F}\) hard output layer (P5) \(\mathcal{S} = \{\mathbf{x}^{(k)}, \pi_k\}_{k=1}^K\) reduced scenario set \(W_p(\mu, \nu)\) \(p\)-Wasserstein ​距离​ \(\mathrm{CRPS}, \mathrm{ES}\) CRPS / energy score \(c_{\mathrm{op}}(\cdot)\) operating cost (stochastic UC / OPF / DRO) \(\mathrm{cost\text{-}CRPS}\) CRPS over \(c_{\mathrm{op}}\) distribution \(d_H(u_1, u_2)\) commitment Hamming distance \(\mathrm{VSS}, \mathrm{EVPI}\) Value of Stochastic Solution / Expected Value of Perfect Information

docs.title: 3. Generative-family taxonomy
docs.text: ​本章​的​核心​目的​是​把​"diffusion" ​在​当前​文献​中​所指​的​ ​至少​三个​不同​的​数学​对象​ ​显式​区分​，​并​把​ diffusion ​之外​的​对照​家族​ (GAN / VAE / NF / autoregressive transformer) ​与​ diffusion ​的​方法学​关系​梳理​清楚​。​为什么​这一​区分​至关重要​？ §8 head-to-head ​比较​表​如果​不​做​家族​区分​，​会​得出​错误​的​结论​——​例如​把​ LEAF (discrete-token language diffusion) ​的​胜绩​归功于​ score-matching ​范式​，​但​实际上​ LEAF ​的​优势​可能​来自​ LLM ​强​先验​而​非​ diffusion ​本身​。Phase 0d §6.6 ​已​把​这​一​ hygiene ​列为​ fact-check register ​的​一项​。

docs.title: 3.1 ​三​分支​扩散
docs.text:
(​承接​ §2.4 ​的​家族​区分​声明​) "Diffusion" ​这一​标签​在​文献​中​至少​指向​三个​数学​对象​。​本​ survey ​采用​以下​三​分支​：

(a) Continuous-noise DDPM / score-SDE. ​主流​。​所有​ power-renewable diffusion ​论文​都​属于​这​一支​：CLDM (W1, IEEE T-STE 15:1074–1085, 2024 <verify-Phase-2> author Dong/Mao/Sun/Xu ​候选​)、Multi-Resolution DDPM (W2, Energies 18:3781, 2025)、PI-DDPM (W3, arXiv 2504.17210, 2025)、net-load PI-DDPM (W4, arXiv 2406.01913, 2024)、Transient-Stability PI-Diffusion (W5, Processes 13:2344, 2025)、Hoseinpour & Dvorkin (W6, arXiv 2506.11281, 2025, ​唯一​ verified)、CDSG (W7, Applied Energy 377:124555, 2025)、Pattern-Guided / MS-CADM (W8, Applied Energy 398, 2025)、CAL-DM (SSRN 2025)、G-DDPM (Energy and AI 2024)、DiffSTG (arXiv 2301.13629)、Score-based Offshore Typhoon Diffusion (arXiv 2508.10705, 2025)、DiffLoad (T-PWRS 2024, arXiv 2306.01001)、Multi-Energy Building Cluster Diffusion (Energy 2025)。

(b) Discrete-token language diffusion. LEAF (P9, EMNLP 2025 Findings <verify-Phase-2>)：​把​历史​ tokenize ​后​与​ masked prediction segment ​串联​，​在​ token space ​做​ iterative denoising。"​扩散​"​发生​在​离散​符号​空间​，​与​ continuous noise ​是​不同​对象​。Phase 0 ​显式​标记​的​ caveat：§8 ​比较​表中​不可​与​ (a) ​直接​相加​；​评估​其​在​ power ​场景​的​可用性​需要​ ​专门​ ​的​ ablation。

(c) LLM-guided continuous diffusion. LTSM-DIFF (P10, arXiv 2602.00040, "Enhancing Few-Shot Time Series Forecasting with LLM-Guided Diffusion", Jan 2026)、T2S (P11, IJCAI 2025 <verify-Phase-2>)。LLM ​派生​的​ sequential representation ​充当​ (a) ​中​ \(\mathbf{c}\) ​的​角色​，sampler ​仍​是​ continuous diffusion。​这是​ conditioning ladder rung 5 ​的​代表​，​但​对​ renewable scenario ​没有​任何​已​发表​的​运行​。

​三​分支​的​相对​体量​ (Phase 0 ​调研​池中​)：​分支​ (a) ​占​ 14 ​篇​ power-renewable diffusion ​论文​中​的​ 13 ​篇​ (​约​ 93 %)；​分支​ (b) (LEAF) ​与​分支​ (c) (LTSM-DIFF / T2S) ​各​占​ 0 ​篇​ (​无​ power ​实例​)。​对​ power-renewable ​来说​ "diffusion" ​几乎​等价​于​ continuous-noise DDPM / score-SDE；​这​也​是​ §4.5 rung 5 ​空白​与​ §10 F5 frontier ​的​直接​前​因​ (​分支​ b/c ​未有​ power-domain run)。

docs.title: 3.2 ​比较​基线​ (generative families used as anchors)
docs.text:
• GAN — Operation-Adversarial Scenario Generation (OA-cGAN, EPSR 212:108451, 2022, ​修正​ phase0b ​把​它误​置于​ Applied Energy; arXiv 2110.02152, 2021 <verify-Phase-2> ​候选​作者​ Liang/Mieth/Dvorkin)：​唯一​在​调研​池中​实现​ P6 (decision-aware loss) ​的​工作​，§9 ​的​核心​ anchor。
  • VAE / VAE-GAN — ​历史​ control-handle baseline，​被​ GAN/diffusion ​在​ multivariate ​指标​上​反超​。
  • Normalizing flow — likelihood baseline，​性能​稳健​但​ mode coverage ​弱​。
  • Autoregressive transformer — TimeGrad (ICML 2021)、CSDI (NeurIPS 2021)、ScoreGrad (arXiv 2021)、TACTiS-2 (ICLR 2024)、foundation-model class (TimesFM, Chronos-Bolt, MOIRAI-L, MOMENT, Tiny Time Mixer, TFT, PatchTST, TimeXer, LSTM, CNN, ​见​ arXiv 2604.22077 benchmark)。§8 head-to-head ​章节​专门​处理​。

​为什么​ GAN ​在​ power-renewable ​上​仍然​重要​？OA-cGAN ​在​ 2022 ​年​发表​，​比​ diffusion ​在​ power-renewable ​上​的​大规模​ adoption (2024+) ​早​两年​。​这​两年​的​ "head start" ​加上​ cGAN ​框架​天然​容纳​ saddle-point optimization (​与​ OA-cGAN ​的​ decision-aware loss ​完美​契合​)，​使​ cGAN ​在​ P6 placement ​上​至今​仍然​是​唯一​有​ power-renewable ​实例​的​家族​。​这​不是​"GAN ​比​ diffusion ​更​适合​ P6"，​而是​"diffusion ​的​ P6 lift ​还​没有​人​做​"。F3 frontier ​正是​要​把​ OA-cGAN ​的​ idea ​从​ cGAN ​框架​ lift ​到​ diffusion ​框架​，​把​这​一​历史​"head start" ​解锁​。

docs.title: 3.3 ​三​大家族​的​ trade-off triangle ​与​扩散​的​位置
docs.text:
S7 (Phase 0b, arXiv 2103.04922) ​已​定义​ generative family ​的​ trilemma：expressiveness / tractable likelihood / sampling speed。​扩散​在​ expressiveness ​与​ likelihood ​两条​上​同时​强​ (score matching ​是​ ELBO ​的​良好​替代​)，​但​在​ sampling speed ​上弱​ (​反向​链​ 1000 step ​在​标准​ DDPM)。DDIM、DPM-Solver、consistency model ​等​加速​方法​把​ step ​数压​到​ 10–50；​但​加速​本身​会​改变​ P3 / P4 ​中​ step-dependent \(\eta_t\) ​与​ projection ​的​频次​，​这​在​ renewable scenario ​的​约束​执行​中是​被忽视​的​耦合​ (Phase 0c-A Seam 5 ​的​隐含​变形​)。

​关于​ trilemma ​的​一个​ power-renewable ​特定​补充​：​在​ image diffusion ​中​，sampling speed ​是​用户​体验​问题​ (​用户​等​图​)；​在​ power-renewable scenario ​中​，sampling speed ​不仅​是​ ​推理​ ​问题​，​还是​ ​训练​时​ cost ​问题​——F3 frontier (decision-aware training) ​需要​在​训练​每​一步​ sample ​多次​场景​以​估计​期望​ cost ​的​梯度​，\(T_{\text{diff}}\) × ​训练​步数​ = ​关键​瓶颈​。​这一​耦合​在​ image ​文献​中​不​存在​，​是​ power-renewable diffusion ​特有​的​工程​难题​。Accelerated sampling (DDIM, DPM-Solver, consistency model) ​在​ F3 ​上​不再​是​ "nice-to-have"，​而是​ "​必备​前置​"。

docs.title: 3.4 ​一个​表​ (Phase 0d ​第​ 4 ​节​ axis 1 ​复述​)
docs.text:
类别​ ​代表​工作​ (Phase 0 ​调研​池​) ​在​本​ survey ​的​位置​ Continuous-noise DDPM CLDM, Multi-Res DDPM, CAL-DM §4 rung 2–3, §5 P1–P3 Score-SDE Score-based Offshore Typhoon, Hoseinpour & Dvorkin §4 rung 3, §5 P3 Latent diffusion CLDM, CAL-DM §6 spatial-temporal, §4 rung 2 Discrete-token language diffusion LEAF §3.1 (b), §8 (​家族​区分​) LLM-guided continuous diffusion LTSM-DIFF, T2S §4 rung 5 (empty for power), §10 F5 GAN (baseline) OA-cGAN §9 P6 anchor Autoregressive transformer (baseline) TimeGrad, CSDI, TACTiS-2, TimesFM/Chronos/MOIRAI §8 head-to-head

​接下来​ §4 ​沿​ conditioning ladder ​把​这些​工作​的​"​信息​密度​"​维度​展开​，§5 ​沿​ constraint placement ​把​"​物理​结构​"​维度​展开​，​二者​构成​的​ 6×5 grid ​在​ §7.2 cross-thread ​中​作为​本​ survey ​的​核心​ figure。

docs.title: 4. The conditioning ladder
docs.text:
Phase 0b T2 / Phase 0c-C §2 ​把​ conditioning ​在​过去​五年​的​演进​抽象​为​ information-density ladder：​每​爬​一级​，​控制​粒度​提高​、​可控性​增强​，​但​条件​ bottleneck (latent diffusion ​中​条件​嵌入​相对​ latent ​容量​) ​加剧​、​配对​数据​稀缺性​上升​、posterior collapse ​风险​增加​。​本节​沿​ ladder ​五级​ populate；ladder ​与​ §5 constraint placement ​的​ 6×5 ​笛卡尔​积是​本​ survey ​的​核心​ figure (§7.2 cross-thread)。

​把​ ladder ​当作​"​信息​密度​"​的​连续​维度​，​而​非离散​类别​，​有助于​读者​理解​为什么​相邻​两级​常常​被​同​一篇​论文​同时​跨越​：​例如​ CDSG (§4.4) ​把​ controllable label (rung 4 ​风格​) ​与​ source-load ​多通道​ (rung 2–3 ​风格​) ​揉成​一个​统一​的​ conditional space；Score-based Offshore Typhoon Diffusion (§4.3) ​把​ NWP (rung 2)、​场站​拓扑​ (rung 3)、​操作​ regime (rung 4) ​三类​条件​同时​挂​在​ score function ​上​。​本​ survey ​选择​沿​ ladder ​五级​分层​叙述​而​非​沿​论文​叙述​，​是​为了​让​读者​看到​每​一级​新增​的​信息​维度​带来​的​新​失败​模式​——​从​ rung 1 ​的​"​完全​ uncontrollable" ​到​ rung 5 ​的​ "​极端​ posterior collapse ​风险​与​配对​数据​稀缺​"。

docs.title: 4.1 Rung 1 — Unconditioned / scalar
docs.text:
Multi-Resolution DDPM (W2 in §5, Energies 18(14):3781, 2025, <verify-Phase-2> authors)。Hierarchical denoising at multiple temporal resolutions；conditioning ​至多​通过​ hour-of-day / season ​等​标量​；​不​引入​ NWP。​报告​ CRPS ​减少​ "2.1–70.9 %"，MAE 4.4–52.2 %，RMSE 7.9–53.4 %——​该​范围​ hedge：Phase 0b S2 / Phase 0c-B B-a2 ​已​指出​此​ range ​几乎​肯定​是​ max-min across regime × baseline，Phase 2 ​必须​ extract median ​并​指明​每个​端点​的​ baseline。

Rung 1 ​是​ coverage-favoured ​的​一端​：​不​引入​条件​意味着​没有​ posterior collapse，​但​也​没有​ controllability。​在​ Phase 0a ​提到​的​ 5 ​个​ open problem ​中​，rung 1 ​完全​不​触及​ §6.2 (text/LLM ​条件​) ​与​ §6.5 (regime/tail ​覆盖​) ​的​可控性​需求​。

docs.title: 4.2 Rung 2 — Time-series covariate (NWP, calendar embedding)
docs.text:
​最​密集​的​一级​，​包含​ power-renewable diffusion ​文献​的​多数​：

  • CLDM (W1, IEEE T-STE 15:1074–1085, 2024 <verify-Phase-2>)。​两​阶段​：deterministic point forecast + diffusion modelling of forecast error，NWP ​协​变量​驱动​ deterministic stage、​再​驱动​ diffusion ​的​ conditioning embedding。​两​阶段​分解​把​ diffusion ​任务​限制​在​残差​分布​上​ (​近似​零​中心​)，​降低​ denoising ​复杂度​；​这是​ §5.1 ​的​ P1 trick (data-space transformation ​把​ \(\mathbf{x}_0\) ​支撑​收紧​到​残差​分布​)。​一个​值得​ reviewer ​关注​的​风险​是​：​残差​ + ​点​预测​不​保证​ \(\hat{\mathbf{x}} + \mathbf{r} \in [0, P_{\mathrm{cap}}]\)；Phase 2 ​必须​ verify ​是否​报告​ violation rate。
  • CAL-DM (Cross-Attention Latent Diffusion, SSRN 2025 <verify-Phase-2>)。Single-stage，​直接​生成​ wind/PV scenarios under multimodal meteorological + equipment features；cross-attention information module + Mamba state-space denoiser for long sequences + conditional mutual information auxiliary objective。CMI ​项是​ Phase 0 ​调研​池中​唯一​已​发表​的​、​对​ posterior collapse of condition ​的​显式​补救​。Phase 0c-C Risk 6 ​要求​ verify CMI ​是否​在​原文中​以​ "posterior-collapse remedy" ​框架​介绍​，​而​非​通用​ regularizer。
  • Short-Term Wind Scenario Generation via Conditional Diffusion (P5 in Phase 0c-C, IEEE conference 2024 <verify-Phase-2>)。NWP ​协​变量​通过​ concatenation ​而​非​ cross-attention ​注入​；​与​ CLDM/CAL-DM ​形成​ upgrade path (naive concat → cross-attention with CMI)。

Rung 2 ​的​标准​ risk ​是​ conditioning bottleneck：​当​ NWP ​维度​高​、latent ​容量​小时​，diffusion ​可以​"​绕过​"​条件​直接​学到​无条件​边缘​——​这​正是​ CAL-DM ​引入​ CMI ​的​动机​。

docs.title: 4.3 Rung 3 — Graph / topology / multi-asset
docs.text:
​把​多​场站​ / ​多源​ (wind+solar+load) ​的​空间结构​引入​ conditioning。

  • G-DDPM (P6 in Phase 0c-C, Energy and AI 2024 <verify-Phase-2>)。Graph-DDPM with site / topology embeddings，​是​ Phase 0 ​调研​池中​第一个​把​空间结构​显式​注入​ score function ​的​ power ​工作​ (​而​非​把​多​场站​当作​独立​ channel)。
  • DiffSTG (P7, arXiv 2301.13629 <verify-Phase-2>)。Non-power-domain ​但是​ G-DDPM ​风格​ power ​论文​的​方法论​ anchor：STGNN spatial encoder + denoising head ​的​耦合​。
  • Score-based Offshore Wind Diffusion under Typhoon (P8, arXiv 2508.10705, 2025 <verify-Phase-2>)。Operating-regime covariate (typhoon vs benign) + ​场站​拓扑​，​介于​ rung 2 ​与​ rung 3 ​之间​。​关键​意义​：Phase 0 ​调研​池中​唯一​显式​做​ regime-conditional ​评估​的​ power-diffusion paper，​直接​回应​ Phase 0a §6.5 (regime/tail ​覆盖​)。

Rung 3 ​引入​的​新​难度​是​ scalability vs. coverage：​图越​大​，score function ​越难学​；​同时​ graph ​引入​ spatial constraint ​的​潜在​ P2 / P3 ​钩子​ (​在​某些​ site ​上​的​ KCL ​必须​满足​)，​这​与​ §5 constraint placement ​自然​耦合​。

docs.title: 4.4 Rung 4 — Regime / pattern label
docs.text:
Rung 4 ​通过​ CFG ​把​ regime / cluster ​标签​作为​ controllability ​杠杆​。

  • MS-CADM (Pattern-Guided Diffusion, Applied Energy 398, 2025 <verify-Phase-2>)。Multi-scale condition adaptive diffusion model：multi-scale embedding network ​提取​ hierarchical conditions + time-step adaptation Transformer ​解​耦​ diffusion-step conditioning ​与​ external control conditioning。Hourly-point clustering ​而​非​ 24-h line clustering，​给出​ finer-granularity pattern labels。​报告​相对偏差​减少​到​ 0.40 / 6.14 / 0.86 % vs. conventional 11.34 / 79.89 / 10.48 %。79.89 % conventional baseline ​数字​ implausibly large，​几乎​肯定​反映​ poorly-tuned baseline ​而​非​ diffusion superiority；Phase 0d §6.2 ​已​点名​，Phase 2 ​必须​ (i) ​识别​ baseline、(ii) ​确认​ dataset ​与​ metric ​定义​、(iii) ​决定​是否​引用​ headline。
  • CDSG (W7 in §5, Applied Energy 377:124555, 2025 <verify-Phase-2>)。Conditional Diffusion-based Scenario Generation for Joint Source-Load：CSTFM (conditional spatio-temporal fusion module) + CSNEM (conditional scenario noise estimation module)；"condition" ​包含​ controllable label，CFG-style conditioning ​是​ source-load coupling ​与​ controllability ​的​共同​杠杆​。

Rung 4 ​的​核心​ trade-off ​是​ CFG-scale × tail-coverage ​曲线​：\(w\) ​越大​，conditional alignment ​越锐​，​但​模式​覆盖​收缩​。Phase 0c-C Seam C2 ​强调​：​没有​任何​已​发表​的​ renewable-diffusion paper ​报告​ \(w\)-sweep ​与​ tail-coverage ​的​ quantitative ​曲线​。​这是​ §7.3 cross-thread ​的​核心​ frontier。

Coverage–consistency ​的​家族​ lineage (deep-diver review §1)：CFG-scale × tail-coverage ​不是​ diffusion ​独有​的​新​问题​——​它​是​ GAN mode collapse (Arjovsky & Bottou; Salimans et al.; "unrolled GAN") ​与​ VAE posterior collapse / KL-vanishing (Bowman et al. 2016; β-VAE; InfoVAE) ​这​两条​已经​有​ 10+ ​年​理论​沉淀​的​ trade-off ​在​ diffusion ​时代​的​延续​。​关键​映射​：(i) CFG-scale \(w\) ↔ GAN discriminator ​强度​——​更强​的​条件​信号​ sharpen sample ​但缩​ mode coverage；(ii) CAL-DM ​的​ CMI ​辅助​目标​ (§2.3) ↔ InfoVAE / β-VAE ​家族​的​互信息​下界​——CAL-DM ​不是​ invent CMI，​而是​从​ VAE ​文献​ lift ​到​ latent diffusion。​这一​ lineage ​的​直接​后果​是​：F6 frontier ​的​ \(w\)-sweep figure ​应当​沿用​ GAN evaluation ​的​ precision/recall for generative models (Sajjadi et al. 2018) ​轴向​，​而​非​自创​"CRPS-vs-\(w\)" ​简化​轴​——​这样​ diffusion-renewable ​的​ trade-off ​曲线​可​与​ GAN / VAE ​文献​的​同类​曲线​直接​可比​。MS-CADM ​的​ 79.89 % conventional baseline ​数字​ (§7.5) ​也​可​在​此​ lineage ​下​重新​解释​：​它​很​可能​是​一条​ mode-collapsed GAN ​曲线​而​非​ "poorly-tuned baseline"。

Circularity warning (Phase 0d §6.6, ​来自​ Phase 0c-B B-a1)：​以​ pattern-classification accuracy ​作为​ evaluation metric ​时​，label ​既​是​ training input ​也​是​ evaluation target——​这是​ circular evaluation，§7 ​评估​章节​必须​ flag。

docs.title: 4.5 Rung 5 — Free text / LLM prompt
docs.text:
​对​ power-renewable scenario ​完全​为空​。 Phase 0a §6.2 ​的​开放​问题​；Phase 0c-C C3 ​的​核心​ seam。

​调研​池中​给出​方法论​ scaffolding ​的​工作​：

  • LEAF (P9, EMNLP 2025 Findings <verify-Phase-2>)。Masked-token diffusion in LLM token space。​家族​区分​：§3.1 (b) discrete-token language diffusion，​与​ (a) continuous-noise ​不可​混淆​。​无​ power-domain run。
  • LTSM-DIFF (P10, arXiv 2602.00040, "Enhancing Few-Shot Time Series Forecasting with LLM-Guided Diffusion", Jan 2026)。LTSM ​提供​ sequential representation ​作为​ diffusion ​的​ conditional guidance；​声称​在​ data-rich ​与​ few-shot ​上​ SOTA。​这是​ ladder rung 5 ​的​最​干净​实现​，​但​ renewable ​转移​未​做​。
  • T2S (P11, IJCAI 2025 <verify-Phase-2>)。High-resolution text-conditioned time-series generation，​显式​ text-to-series alignment ​模块​。

Phase 0c-C C3 ​提议​的​第一篇​ power-domain rung-5 ​论文​模板​：​把​ NREL WTK regime cluster label ​与​简短​合成​文本​描述​ ("clear-sky summer afternoon, light westerly") ​配对​，​在​ CLDM ​之上​训练​ T2S-style adapter，​评估​ regime-conditional CRPS。​这是​ §10 F5 frontier ​的​具体化​。

rung 5 ​的​实际​ blocker：​方法学​ scaffolding (LEAF / LTSM-DIFF / T2S) ​已经​存在​，​但​ power-domain run ​缺席​的​核心​原因​不是​技术​——​而是​ paired data scarcity。​文本​描述​ ("clear-sky summer afternoon") ​与​对应​历史​场景​的​ paired corpus ​在​ power domain ​几乎​不​存在​；NWP ​文本​化​ (​把​ weather forecast ​自动​转写​为​自然语言​) ​也​是​空白​工具集​。F5 frontier ​的​第一篇​论文​必须​用​ ​合成​ text-from-cluster-label ​的​简化​路径​ ("clear-sky" = cluster 1 ​的​合成​ label) ​绕过​这一​ corpus blocker。​这是​ F5 ​看似​简单​实则​需要​工程​巧思​的​部分​。

docs.title: 4.5b Ladder ​的​二维​重新​框定​ (deep-diver review §6)
docs.text:
​把​ ladder ​当作​"​信息​密度​单轴​" ​是​简化​——deep-diver review §6 ​指出​，rung 3 (graph) ​与​ rung 4 (regime label) ​在​ ​信息​类别​ ​上​不同​：rung 3 ​是​ structural ​信号​ (​高​ raw ​信息率​)、rung 4 ​是​ categorical ​信号​ (​低​ Shannon ​熵​，​高​ ​决策​相关​ ​信息​密度​)。​把​ 5 ​级​ ladder ​重新​框为​ (information rate × representational form) ​的​ 2D ​空间​更​准确​：

posterior-collapse ​风险​ (​高​→)
  ▲
​极​│                                rung 5 (text/LLM ​语义​)
​高​│                              ●  <-- empty for power; F5 frontier
​高​│                       rung 4 (categorical CFG)
  │                     ●   MS-CADM, CDSG (​高​决策​相关度​, ​低​ raw ​信息​)
​中​│              rung 3 (structural graph/topology)
  │            ●  G-DDPM, DiffSTG, Typhoon SDE
​中​│       rung 2 (continuous NWP covariate)
  │      ● CLDM, CAL-DM (​高​ raw ​信息​, ​含​ CMI ​防​ collapse)
​零​│   ● rung 1 (none/scalar)
  │    Multi-Res DDPM
  └──────────────────────────────────────────────►
  ​低​                                              ​高​
  Information rate (​维度​ × ​配对​数据​稀缺​度​)

​关键​ corollary (deep-diver §6 (ii))：F5 frontier ​把​ "synthetic text from cluster label" ​作为​ rung-5 ​第一篇​论文​，​但​这​一​合成​文本​的​ information rate ​等于​ cluster label ​本身​的​ information rate——​所以​ F5 ​第一篇​严格​上​是​ "text-shaped interface on rung-4 information"，​而​非​真正​ unlock rung 5 ​的​ semantic ​信息​维度​。​这一​区分​对​ F5 ​的​ novelty framing ​与​ evaluation ​期望​都​有​影响​：F5 ​第一篇​不​应该​被​期待​在​ marginal CRPS ​上​击败​ rung-2 baseline；​其​ novelty ​是​ interface，​不是​ information。

docs.title: 4.6 ​总结​：5 ​级​ ladder ​与​ 5 ​个​ ​风险​层
docs.text: Rung ​代表​ Information ​维度​ Posterior collapse ​风险​ Coverage trade-off 1 — none / scalar Multi-Res DDPM 0 / O(1) 0 (​无条件​) coverage-favoured 2 — NWP covariate CLDM, CAL-DM, conditional diffusion O(T × D_{cov}) ​中​ (CAL-DM ​用​ CMI) ​平衡​ 3 — graph / topology G-DDPM, DiffSTG, Typhoon Score-SDE O(E × T) ​高​ (​大图​小​ latent) ​偏​ consistency 4 — regime / pattern (CFG) MS-CADM, CDSG O(K) (K = ​簇数​) ​高​ (CFG \(w\) ​大时​) ​强​ consistency-favoured 5 — text / LLM (​空​ for power) O(L_{text}) ​极高​ ​未知​ (​无​运行​)

docs.title: 5. Constraint placement P1–P6 (NEW)
docs.text: ​本章​是​本​ survey ​的​核心​方法论​ chapter，​建立​把​"​物理​约束​在​ diffusion ​管线​中​如何​注入​"​这​一直​觉​问题​形式化​为​六​单元​矩阵​的​工具​。​已有​的​ power-diffusion ​综述​ (Phase 0b S1, S4) ​在​物理​约束​维度​上仅​做​"​二元​ yes/no ​标签​" (physics-informed yes/no)，​把​数学​上​完全​不同​的​注入​机制​揉成​同一个​类别​——​例如​把​ W3 (PI-DDPM with PDE residual loss) ​与​ W6 (Hoseinpour & Dvorkin gradient guidance in reverse sampling) ​都​标为​ "physics-informed"，​这​等于​把​ P2 (training-time soft penalty) ​与​ P3 (sampling-time gradient correction) ​误认为​同一​机制​。​事实上​二者​在​ (i) ​训练​动力学​ (P2 ​影响​ \(\epsilon_\theta\) ​的​权重​，P3 ​不​动​权重​)、(ii) ​测试​时​计算成本​ (P3 ​每次​采样​都​付出代价​，P2 ​只​在​训练​时​一次性​付出​)、(iii) feasibility ​强度​ (P2 ​是​ soft penalty ​永不​严格​满足​，P3 ​在​ \(\eta_t\) ​足够​大时​渐进​满足​) ​上​全然不同​。​本章​把​ P1–P6 ​区分​为​正交​的​工具集​，​使​后续​读者​能​正确​读懂​"physics-informed" ​标签​下​的​实际​机制​。

docs.title: 5.1 ​六个​安置​位置
docs.text:
Phase 0c-A Thread ​把​ DDPM / score-SDE ​管线​上​的​物理​约束​ (capacity bound、ramp limit、KCL、AC balance、transient-energy bound) ​安置​位置​形式化​为​ 6 ​个​互相​正交​的​钩子​：

Tag ​位置​ ​数学​钩子​ P1 data / preprocessing \(\mathbf{x}_0 \in \mathcal{F}\) by construction ​或​ residual decomposition \(\mathbf{x}_0 = \hat{\mathbf{x}} + \mathbf{r}\) P2 inside \(\epsilon_\theta\) (physics-informed loss) \(\mathcal{L} = \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{simple}} + \lambda \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{phys}}(\hat{\mathbf{x}}_0(\mathbf{x}_t, t))\) P3 reverse-step gradient guidance \(\tilde{\mathbf{s}} = \mathbf{s}_\theta - \eta_t \nabla_{\mathbf{x}_t} c(\hat{\mathbf{x}}_0)\) P4 inter-step projection \(\mathbf{x}_{t-1} \leftarrow \Pi_\mathcal{F}(\mathbf{x}_{t-1})\) ​或​ \(\Pi_\mathcal{F}(\hat{\mathbf{x}}_0)\) P5 hard output layer \(\mathbf{x}_0 = L_\mathcal{F}(\mathbf{z})\) (KCL-completing / capacity-clipping ​可​微分​层​) P6a decision-aware loss, per-scenario cost \(\mathcal{L}_{\text{P6a}} = \mathbb{E}_{\mathbf{c}}\,\mathbb{E}_{\mathbf{x}_0 \sim p_\theta}[c_{\mathrm{op}}(\mathbf{x}_0)]\) — per-sample expected cost；​无​ SP solver in the loop P6b decision-aware loss, SP-decision cost \(\mathcal{L}_{\text{P6b}} = \mathbb{E}_{\mathbf{c}}\,[c_{\mathrm{op}}(x^*_{\mathrm{SP}}(\{\mathbf{x}^{(k)} \sim p_\theta\}); \xi_{\mathrm{true}})]\) — SP / UC ​求解​嵌入​训练​ loop，​是​ OA-cGAN ​的​ target

Figure 1 — 6 × 5 placement × conditioning grid (the survey's central matrix)。​把​ axis 2 (conditioning rung 1–5) × axis 3 (placement P1–P6) ​笛卡尔​积​展开​为​ 5 ​行​ × 6 ​列​；​调研​池中​的​代表​工作​填入​对应​ cell，​空白​格用​ . ​标注​：

                    P1       P2       P3       P4       P5       P6
                  (data)   (loss)   (grad)   (proj)   (hard)   (cost)
                  -------- -------- -------- -------- -------- --------
rung 5 text/LLM   .        .        .        .        .        .
rung 4 regime     .        .        MS-CADM  .        .        .
                                    CDSG
rung 3 graph      .        .        Typhoon  .        .        .
                                    G-DDPM
rung 2 NWP        CLDM     PI-DDPM  Dvorkin  .        .        .
                  MultiRes net-load
rung 1 scalar     CLDM(P1) W5(Lyap) .        .        .        .
                                                      ───── P5 ​整列​空白​
                                                      (frontier F2)
                                                      ────────── P6 ​整列​空白​
                                                      ​仅​ OA-cGAN
                                                      (​非​扩散​) + Diffusion-DFL
                                                      (generic)
                                                      (frontier F3)

                  rung 5 ​整行​空白​ (frontier F5)

​读图​三点​：(i) ​文献​沿​"rung 2–4 × P1–P3" ​主​对角线​集中​；(ii) ​整列​ P5 / P6 ​与​整行​ rung 5 ​同时​空白​——​这​是​本​ survey ​命名​的​ ​三处​共​空白​格​；(iii) ​两个​ publishable off-diagonal cells：rung 5 + P3 (text-conditioned feasibility-guided diffusion, ​同时​回应​ F5 ​与​ F2) ​与​ rung 4 + P5 (regime label + hard capacity layer, ​隔离​ controllability vs feasibility)。​这​张图​与​ §7 evaluation tier ​漏斗​ (Figure 2) ​共同​构成​本​ survey ​的​中心​视觉​。

docs.title: 5.1b ​六个​安置​位置​ (​展开​)
docs.text: P1–P5 ​是​ feasibility-oriented；P6 ​是​ consequence-oriented，​结构​正交​。P6 ​的​两个​变体​ (P6a / P6b) ​必须​显式​区分​：P6a (per-scenario cost) ​把​每条​ generated scenario ​单独​评估​其​ operating cost ​并取​期望​，​没有​ here-and-now decision (commitment) ​嵌入​训练​；P6b (SP-decision cost) ​把​生成​的​ scenario set ​喂入​完整​ SP/UC solver ​得到​ here-and-now decision \(x^*_{\mathrm{SP}}\)，​再​在​ held-out realization ​下​评估​该​决策​的​实际成本​。OA-cGAN ​是​ P6b (DC-OPF ​凸​、LP ​对偶​让​ inner SP ​可折叠​)；W12 Diffusion-DFL ​在​原​ paper ​中​接近​ P6b ​但​因​ SP ​是​ generic ​而​非​ UC ​不能​直接​说​覆盖​ P6b power ​实例​；​本​ survey §10 F3 frontier ​以​ P6b ​为​目标​，​但​允许​"P6a ​作为​ stepping-stone"——​这是​为什么​ §5.9 ablation grid ​把​ "off / per-scenario / SP-decision" ​列为​ P6 axis ​的​三档​。​下面​ 12 ​个​代表​工作​按​位置​ populate；​每个​ cell ​显式​标注​覆盖​情况​。

docs.title: 5.2 P1 — Data / preprocessing
docs.text:
P1 ​是​"​通过​数据​空间​变换​把​约束​隐式化​"​的​位置​：​不​引入​新​的​ loss ​项​、​不​修改​ score ​网络​、​不​增加​采样​步骤​；​通过​对​训练​数据​的​预处理​ (rescaling, clipping, residual decomposition) ​让​ \(\mathbf{x}_0\) ​的​支撑​近似​落​在​ \(\mathcal{F}\) ​内​。​优点​是​零​计算​开销​；​缺点​是​约束​永不​严格​满足​ —— ​任何​ P1 trick ​都​只能​让​"​违反​ feasibility" ​的​概率​小​，​不能​让​它​为​零​。

W1. CLDM (IEEE T-STE 15:1074–1085, 2024, <verify-Phase-2> Dong/Mao/Sun/Xu ​候选​)。Headline ​机制​是​ deterministic forecast + diffusion-modelled residual：​先​训练​ embedding network ​给出​确定性​预测​ \(\hat{\mathbf{x}}\)，​然后​让​ diffusion ​模型​只学​预测​残差​ \(\mathbf{r} = \mathbf{x}_0 - \hat{\mathbf{x}}\) ​的​分布​。​这是​ P1：data-space ​变换​把​ \(\mathbf{x}_0\) ​的​支撑​限制​到​残差​分布​；capacity bound ​与​ \(\mathbf{x}_0\) ​量级​隐式​而​非​显式​约束​。​两​阶段​分解​把​ diffusion ​任务​限制​在​一个​近似​零​中心​、​低​方差​的​目标​上​，​显著​降低​ denoising ​复杂度​并​间接​提高​ calibration。​其​潜在​缺口​是​ P1 alone ​不​保证​ \(\hat{\mathbf{x}} + \mathbf{r} \in [0, P_{\mathrm{cap}}]\)；​尾部​样本​可能​ violate capacity box —— ​当​ \(\hat{\mathbf{x}}\) ​接近​ capacity ​上限​且​ \(\mathbf{r}\) ​给出​正向​尾部​噪声​时​，sum ​超过​容量​在​数值​上​完全​可能​。Phase 2 fact-check ​必须​ verify CLDM ​原文​是否​报告​ violation rate；​本​ survey ​默认​ P1 ​提供​ soft ​而​非​ hard feasibility。

W2. Multi-Resolution DDPM (Energies 18:3781, 2025, <verify-Phase-2>)。​多​分辨率​ + condition-constrained denoising via historical and trend-based priors。​结构​上​是​ P1 + P3 ​混合​：​训练​阶段​用​ priors ​条件​化​数据​集​ (P1)，​采样​阶段​把​ trend-based condition ​作​ soft pull (P3)。​无显式​ feasibility set，"physical realism" ​由​统计​相似​度​替代​。​这是​当前​ P1 ​文献​的​一个​典型​问题​——"physical realism" ​与​ "statistical similarity to historical data" ​被​默认​等价​，​而​二者​在​ rare regime / out-of-distribution ​上​完全​不​一致​：​历史数据​没有​的​ feasibility ​组合​ (e.g. ​极端​ ramp ​在​历史​频率​为​零​) ​可能​仍然​是​物理​可行​的​，​反之​统计​相似​的​样本​可能​违反​ ramp ​限制​。​这一​概念​混淆​是​ §5.3 P2 ​论文​的​常见​动机​。

docs.title: 5.3 P2 — Inside the score / noise-prediction network (physics-informed loss)
docs.text:
W3. PI-DDPM for Synthetic Power Flow Data (arXiv 2504.17210, IEEE SmartGridComm 2025 submission <verify-Phase-2>)。Auxiliary training + physics-informed loss ​使​ noise prediction network ​学到​ (voltage, \(P_g\), \(P_d\)) ​的​联合结构​。IEEE 14- / 30-bus。​报告​满足​所有​不等式​约束​；residual power imbalance 0.013 p.u. (14-bus) / 0.017 p.u. (30-bus)，​文中​称​ "absorbable by slight adjustments" (​报告​值待​ Phase 2 verify)。Phase 0d §6.2 ​警示​：(i) "equality (balance) constraint ​仅​近似​满足​"；(ii) Phase 2 ​必须​ verify ​是否​在​ test set ​上​还是​ representative example。

W4. Net-Load PI-DDPM (arXiv 2406.01913, 2024 <verify-Phase-2> candidate Zhang et al.)。Physical model function ​嵌入​ denoising network；transition-kernel ​参数​与​ physics-function ​参数​联合​训练​；Pecan Street smart meter；​声称​ ≥ 20 % ​在​所有​指标​上​提升​ over GAN / VAE / NF / vanilla DDPM。​这里​的​ "physical model" ​更​接近​ parametric structural prior (PV/load decomposition)，​而​非​ hard constraint；​与​ PINN-style soft constraint ​相邻​。

W5. Transient-Stability PI-Diffusion (Processes 13(8):2344, 2025 <verify-Phase-2>)。Hierarchical conditional diffusion + transient differential equations ​嵌入​ + transient-energy ​作​ stability-boundary constraint。Modified IEEE-39-bus；reported 98.77 % unstable-scenario recognition rate, +3.92 / +2.65 pp over named alternatives；Phase 2 ​必须​ verify alternative ​身份​与​ test split。​结构​上​是​ P2 (DE embedding) + P1 (energy criterion ​过滤​数据​)；energy function ​作​ Lyapunov-derived penalty (​在​原​论文​中是​光滑​能量​函数​, ​偏​ penalty ​而​非​ barrier — barrier ​在​边界​附近​梯度​爆炸​, penalty ​是​平滑​增长​)，​非​ sampling-time projection。

Phase 0c-A Seam 2 critique：P2 (physics-informed loss) ​在​文献​中​至少​隐藏​三个​子​机制​ — PDE residual (W3)、structural prior (W4)、soft Lyapunov / barrier (W5)。​这​三者​在​数学​性质​ (​可导性​、​约束​饱和​、​训练​动力学​) ​上​差异​显著​，​但​目前​文献​用​同一​标签​ "physics-informed" ​笼统​对待​。

​具体来说​：

(i) P2-PDE-residual (W3 in §5.3 above)。​把​守恒​律​ (​如​ KCL: \(\sum_i P_i = 0\)) ​通过​ \(\|\hat{\mathbf{x}}_0\|\) ​形式​作为​额外​ loss ​项加​到​ \(\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{simple}}\) ​上​。​训练​动力学​：​梯度​始终​存在​ (​光滑​可导​)，​但​ violation ​永不​为​零​；\(\lambda\) ​增大​降低​ violation，​但​与​ \(\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{simple}}\) ​形成​ Pareto trade-off。​典型​用例​：power flow balance constraint, transmission-line capacity, ramp constraint。​与​ PINN ​的​关系​：​直接​继承​ Raissi et al. 2019 ​的​ PINN ​框架​，​把​ score / noise prediction network ​替代​ PINN ​的​ forward solver。

(ii) P2-structural-prior (W4 in §5.3 above)。​把​ PV / load ​的​结构​方程​嵌入​ score ​网络​架构​，​约束​通过​ ​参数​共享​ ​而​非​ loss ​项​强制​——​更​接近​ inductive bias ​而​非​ soft penalty。​训练​动力学​：​约束​几乎​免费​ (architecture ​强制​)，​但​表达能力​受限​——​架构​外​的​样本​无法​ represent。​典型​用例​：PV / load decomposition, generator-load balance through fixed linear map。​与​ hard layer (P5) ​的​关系​：​边界​模糊​；P2-structural-prior ​是​ layer ​内部​参数​化​ (e.g. fixed weight)，P5 ​是​ layer ​输出​后处理​ (e.g. clipping / KCL completion)；​二者​可​叠加​。

(iii) P2-Lyapunov-penalty / barrier (W5 in §5.3 above)。​把​ transient-energy ​函数​作为​ penalty (​光滑​二次​, W5 ​选用​的​形态​) ​或​ barrier (​在​ stability boundary ​附近​梯度​爆炸​) ​项​添加​。​训练​动力学​：penalty ​平滑​、barrier ​在​边界​爆炸​；​具体​使用​何种​取决于​能量​函数​的​构造​。​典型​用例​：transient stability boundary, voltage envelope, frequency containment。Caveat：barrier function ​在​边界​附近​的​梯度​ explosion ​与​ gradient clipping ​互动​复杂​，​常​需要​ careful \(\lambda\)-warmup schedule。

​对​ P2 ​标签​的​方法学​含义​：​把​这​三种​机制​都​标为​ "physics-informed" ​会​让​读者​对​ (a) ​收敛​速度​、(b) violation rate、(c) ​对超​参数​ \(\lambda\) ​的​敏感性​形成​错误​预期​——​三种​机制​在​三​方面​都​不同​。Phase 2 ​应​在​ §A.6 methodological hygiene ​中​要求​每篇​ P2 ​论文​显式​说明​使用​的​子​机制​。​对​ §5.9 ablation grid ​的​扩充​：P2 ​应当​被​拆为​ {off, PDE-residual, structural-prior, Lyapunov} ​四档​而​非​ {off, on} ​二档​。

docs.title: 5.4 P3 — Reverse-step gradient guidance
docs.text:
P3 ​是​当前​ power-renewable diffusion ​中​最​活跃​的​位置​，​也​是​ ​唯一​ ​有​ Phase 0 verified ​作者​归属​ (Hoseinpour & Dvorkin) ​的​位置​。​其​数学​钩子​ \(\tilde{\mathbf{s}} = \mathbf{s}_\theta - \eta_t \nabla_{\mathbf{x}_t} c(\hat{\mathbf{x}}_0)\) ​把​ score ​视为​ "​学到​的​先验​"，​约束​违反​梯度​视为​"​似然​修正​"——​这是​ score-SDE ​框架​下​ Bayes posterior ​的​直接​类比​ (Song et al. ​提出​的​ inverse problem ​框架​)。P3 ​相对​ P1 / P2 ​的​优势​是​ ​测试​时​ ​可控​：\(\eta_t\) ​可以​根据​ sample ​的​ violation ​程度​动态​调整​，​而​不​需要​重训​。​劣势​是​测试​时​计算成本​翻倍​ (​每个​反向​ step ​都​要​算​约束​梯度​) ​与​ \(\eta_t\) schedule ​的​调参​成本​。

W6. Hoseinpour & Dvorkin — Constrained Diffusion Models for Synthesizing Representative Power Flow Datasets (arXiv 2506.11281 v2, 2025)。Phase 0 ​唯一​ verified author attribution：Milad Hoseinpour, Vladimir Dvorkin (U. Michigan EECS)。Headline ​机制​是​ AC-power-flow gradient guidance ​加​到​反向​ score ​上​ + variable-decoupling strategy (​灵感​来自​ fast decoupled power flow，​使​梯度​评估​ tractable)。​输出​在​ well-tuned guidance scale ​下​统计​忠实​且​ AC-feasible。​位置​：power systems ​的​ canonical P3。Caveat：v1 ​题为​ "Domain-Constrained Diffusion Models to Synthesize Tabular Data: A Case Study in Power Systems"；Phase 2 ​必须​ reconcile ​引用​版本​ (preprint vs published / accepted)。

W7. CDSG — Conditional Diffusion-based Scenario Generation for Joint Source-Load (Applied Energy 377:124555, 2025 <verify-Phase-2>)。CSTFM + CSNEM；"condition" ​包含​ controllable label，CFG-style conditioning ​调制​反向​ score。​位置​：P3 in spirit (​条件​调制​ score across reverse steps)，​但​没有​物理​约束​——"constraint" ​是​ style / regime label。​这是​ rung 4 ​与​ P3 ​的​交叉​单元​ (§7.2 ​的​核心​例子​)。

W8. MS-CADM — Pattern-Guided Diffusion for Controllable Renewable Scenarios (Applied Energy 398, 2025 <verify-Phase-2>)。Prototype / cluster-label conditioning ​驱动​反向​ diffusion。​架构​与​ W7 ​同族​；"pattern" ​起到​ CFG class label ​的​作用​。​位置​：P3 used for regime control，not feasibility。

Phase 0c-A Seam 5 critique：P3 (gradient guidance) ​与​ style conditioning (CFG) ​共享​同一​架构​钩子​；"constraint" ​与​ "style" ​之间​的​区分​需要​ prompt ​设计​与​ evaluation ​设计​共同​强化​。

W6 ​中​ variable-decoupling ​的​重要性​：​纯​ AC power flow ​在​反向​采样​的​每​一步​都​需要​ Jacobian ​求解​，​对​ 1000-bus ​级别​ raw cost ​不可​接受​。Hoseinpour & Dvorkin ​借鉴​ fast decoupled power flow ​思想​——​把​ \(P\)–\(V\) ​与​ \(Q\)–\(\theta\) ​解​耦​——​把​每步​ Jacobian ​因式分解​从​ full-AC sparse-Newton scaling ​降到​ fast-decoupled scaling (​实际​加速​ order-of-magnitude；​精确​复杂度​依赖​求解​器​实现​：full AC sparse-Newton ​约​ \(O(N^{1.4})\)–\(O(N^2)\)、fast-decoupled ​大致​线性​到亚​二次​)。​这一​工程​巧思​是​把​ P3 ​从​ toy 30-bus ​推​到​ system-level ​的​关键​，​也​是​ Phase 0c-A ​把​该​工作​选​为​ P3 canonical anchor ​的​原因​。

docs.title: 5.5 P4 — Inter-step projection
docs.text:
W9. PGDM — Projected Generative Diffusion Models for Constraint Satisfaction (arXiv 2402.03559 v1/v2 <verify-Phase-2>)。​非​ power-domain ​但是​方法学​上​的​核心​：​把​ sampling ​重新​表述​为​ ​约束​优化​ ​问题​，​每个​反向​ step ​做​ iterative projection。​在​ convex \(\mathcal{F}\) ​与​ convex \(-\log p\) ​下​有​理论​保证​；​非凸​约束​ (materials, motion, ODE) ​上​有​经验​证据​。​位置​：textbook P4，​桥接​ P3 (gradient guidance) ​与​ P4 (projection)。​关于​ P3 / P4 ​边界​的​方法学​澄清​：P4 ​不是​ "P3 with large \(\eta_t\)" ​的​极限​。P3 (DPS / reconstruction-guidance ​风格​) ​是​ ​一阶​ soft ​修正​——​每个​反向​ step ​一次​ \(\nabla_{\mathbf{x}_t}\) nudge，​不​保证​ \(\hat{\mathbf{x}}_0 \in \mathcal{F}\)；P4 (projection / proximal operator) ​在​每个​反向​ step ​内​做​ iterative projection，​结构​上​更​接近​ proximal ​而​非​ single-step gradient。​增大​ P3 ​的​ \(\eta_t\) ​只会​让​ score correction ​主导​但​ ​不​ ​强制​ \(\hat{\mathbf{x}}_0 \in \mathcal{F}\)；​二者​只有​在​ \(\mathcal{F}\) ​为​半​空间​且​ projection ​退化​为​单步​梯度​时才​重合​。​这一​区分​对应​ §2.6 ​凸​/​非凸​ projection ​行为​的​具体​后果​。​任何​自称​ "projected" ​的​ power-diffusion paper ​应​以​ PGDM ​为​方法学​ anchor。

W10. Predict-Project-Renoise (arXiv 2601.21033, "Sampling Diffusion Models under Hard Constraints", 2026)。​预测​ \(\hat{\mathbf{x}}_0\) → ​投影​到​ \(\mathcal{F}\) → re-noise ​到​ \(\mathbf{x}_{t-1}\)，​是​ constraint-satisfaction-diffusion ​文献​中​正在​标准化​的​ pattern。​无​ power-system instantiation；​技术​目前​通用​。

W11. Projection-Constrained Diffusion on Manifolds (arXiv 2602.17773, "Learning Flow Distributions via Projection-Constrained Diffusion on Manifolds", 2026)。Scope sharpening：​该​论文​的​真实​作用域​是​ 2D incompressible fluid flow on manifolds (Helmholtz–Hodge projection ​把​ score ​修正​到​ divergence-free ​子​空间​)，​而​非​通用​ feasibility manifold。​本​ survey ​把​它​列为​ P4 anchor ​是​ ​方法学​类比​ (​任何​ "​已学​/​已知​ low-dim manifold + ​反向​ step projection" ​模板​对​ AC power flow manifold ​都​可​参考​)，​不是​ ​主张​该​论文​已​覆盖​ AC manifold——AC power flow ​既​不是​ incompressible flow，​也​不是​ fluid-mechanics ​意义​上​的​ manifold。​因此​ "\(\Pi_\mathcal{F}\) onto AC manifold" ​在​该​论文​中是​未​实现​的​延伸​，​本​ survey ​把​它​作为​ P4 ​在​ power-domain ​空缺​的​方法学​最近​邻​引用​。

docs.title: 5.6 P5 — Hard output layer (empty for renewable scenarios)
docs.text:
P5 ​是​ engineering-cheap, empirically-empty ​的​典型​例子​。​其​数学​钩子​简单​：​在​ latent diffusion ​的​ decoder ​后​挂​一个​可​微分​的​ final layer \(L_\mathcal{F}: \mathbf{z} \to \mathcal{F}\)，​把​ raw decoded \(\mathbf{z}\) ​显式​映射​到​ feasibility set。​常见​构造​包括​：(i) capacity-clipping (sigmoid + scaling ​到​ \([0, P_{\mathrm{cap}}]\) ​但​保留​梯度​通过​ straight-through estimator)、(ii) KCL-completing layer (KCLNet ​风格​：​给​ \(N - 1\) ​个​自由​变量​预测​，​第​ \(N\) ​个​由​ KCL ​约束​自动​给出​)、(iii) ramp-respecting projection (\(\Delta_t = \min(|\hat{\Delta}_t|, R_{\max}) \cdot \mathrm{sign}(\hat{\Delta}_t)\))。​这些​都​是​单层​可​微分​操作​，​工程​成本​几乎​为​零​。

​对​ renewable scenario ​完全​为空​。 Phase 0c-A Seam 3 ​命名​了​这个​ cell：

  • DiffOPF (arXiv 2510.14075, 2025 <verify-Phase-2>) ​是​ diffusion solver for OPF ​而​非​ scenario generator；​其​输出​受限于​ OPF KKT manifold——​这是​ P5 idea ​的​倒置​ (​扩散​针对​受约束​算子​的​输出​，​而​非​输入​分布​)。
  • KCLNet / OPF-Net ​风格​ hard layer ​在​ ​非​扩散​ ​生成​模型​ (cGAN, flow) ​中​惯用​；​其​在​ diffusion final layer ​的​适配​是​ open seam。

​这​是​本​ survey ​命名​的​关键​空白​格​之一​：Phase 0c-A Seam 3 + Phase 0d F2 ​指出​，"latent diffusion + decoder = hard-capacity layer" ​在​机械​上​是​小​改动​，​但​调研​池中​ ​零​ ​实现​。​这是​ §10 F2 frontier ​的​具体化​。

docs.title: 5.7 P6 — Decision-aware loss (empty for renewable-diffusion)
docs.text:
​对​ renewable-diffusion ​完全​为空​。

  • W12. Diffusion-DFL — Decision-Focused Diffusion Models for Stochastic Optimization (arXiv 2510.11590, 2025 <verify-Phase-2>)。Diffusion predictor ​通过​ differentiate through downstream stochastic optimization ​训练​；loss ​是​ decision-evaluated cost，​而​非​ likelihood / score-matching loss。​声称​ diffusion-DFL "consistently delivers the best decision performance" ​在​ stochastic ​方法​中​。​位置​：canonical P6，generic (​非​ power-specific)。
  • OA-cGAN — Operation-Adversarial Scenario Generation (Electric Power Systems Research 212:108451, July 2022; arXiv 2110.02152, 2021)。​修正​ phase0b S6 ​的​错误​：venue ​不是​ Applied Energy，​而是​ EPSR；arXiv preprint ​自​ Oct 2021。<verify-Phase-2> Liang/Mieth/Dvorkin ​候选​作者​。cGAN with embedded DC-OPF cost；generator ​学​最大化​ OPF ​成本​，discriminator ​强制​统计​可信度​。​位置​：​非​扩散​ P6 ​的​ canonical anchor (§9)。

Diffusion P6 for renewable scenarios ​是​ Phase 0c-A Seam 4 + Phase 0c-B Seam 2 + Phase 0d F3 ​共同​命名​的​ frontier：​把​ W12 ​的​框架​ lift ​到​ renewable scenarios for UC / DRO，​把​ OA-cGAN ​的​ idea ​从​对抗​ saddle-point ​提升​到​ non-adversarial diffusion loop。​技术​钥匙​是​ pathwise gradient through DDIM sampler × differentiable UC surrogate。

docs.title: 5.8 ​六​单元​矩阵​ (Phase 0d Axis 3, ​与​ §10 frontier ​关联​)
docs.text:
Placement Power-renewable ​代表​ (Phase 0 ​调研​池​) ​状态​ P1 CLDM (residual decomposition), Multi-Res DDPM (trend prior) ​已​实现​ P2 PI-DDPM (2504.17210), Net-Load PI-DDPM (2406.01913), Transient-Stability Processes 13:2344 ​已​实现​，​三​种子​机制​混杂​ (Seam 2) P3 Hoseinpour & Dvorkin 2506.11281, CDSG (style), MS-CADM (pattern) ​已​实现​ (\(\eta_t\) ​唯一​ verified ​工作​) P4 PGDM (generic), Predict-Project-Renoise (generic), Manifold (fluid flow, methodological anchor) ​无​ power instantiation P5 (empty); DiffOPF ​是​ inverted neighbour ​空白​格​ (frontier F2) P6a / P6b (empty for diffusion); OA-cGAN (GAN, P6b), Diffusion-DFL (generic ML, P6a/P6b boundary) ​空白​格​ (frontier F3)

P5 ​与​ P4 ​的​概念​差异​：P4 (projection \(\Pi_\mathcal{F}\)) ​是​采样​时​操作​，​对​采样​路径​的​每​一步​做​修正​；P5 (hard layer \(L_\mathcal{F}\)) ​是​架构​操作​，​编码​在​ decoder ​的​最后​一层​、​训练​时​与​采样​时​一致​。​这一​区别​在​梯度​行为​上​有​具体​后果​：P4 ​通过​ \(\Pi_\mathcal{F}\) ​的​ sub-gradient (​在​ boundary ​上​不​光滑​) ​把​信号​反传​，​可能​在​边界​附近​不​稳定​；P5 ​通过​ sigmoid / softmax / KCL-completion ​等​ ​光滑​ ​映射​保持​梯度​连续​，​使​训练​动力学​良好​。​这是​为什么​ P5 ​在​ F3 (P6 decision-aware training) ​中​作为​工程​前置​不可​替代​——P4 ​的​不​光滑​梯度​会​污染​ P6 ​的​ cost ​梯度​。

docs.title: 5.9b P3 vs P4 boundary-condition decision rule (per domain-expert review)
docs.text:
Domain-expert review §2.1 + deep-diver review §2 ​共同​指出​：§2.6 / §5.5 ​已经​分别​给出​ P3 (gradient guidance) ​与​ P4 (projection) ​的​数学​差异​，​但​没有​装配​为​一张​决策表​——​读者​无法​直接​根据​自身​约束​类型​选择​ P3 ​还是​ P4。​下表​把​分散​在​ §2.6 / §5.4 / §5.5 / §5.8 ​中​的​判据​汇总​为​ 5 ​行​决策​规则​：

Condition on \(\mathcal{F}\) P3 (guidance) ​行为​ P4 (projection) ​行为​ Verdict Convex \(\mathcal{F}\), smooth \(c(\cdot)\) \(\eta_t\) ​调​好​渐近​ feasible；cheap；​梯度​光滑​ \(\Pi_\mathcal{F}\) unique, differentiable, idempotent；​每步​ strict feasibility P4 strictly dominates (cheaper + hard) ​非凸​ \(\mathcal{F}\) (AC power flow equality) \(\eta_t\) ​沿​局部​梯度​推近​ \(\mathcal{F}\)；​从未​严格​ feasible；​但​不会​被​ projection discontinuity ​打飞​ \(\Pi_\mathcal{F}\) non-unique, non-continuous；"projection" ​退化​为​ heuristic；​可能​把​样本​踢​出​学到​的​流形​ P3 dominates — ​正是​ W6 Hoseinpour & Dvorkin ​的​选择​ ​高维​ \(\mathcal{F}\) + cheap residual ​但​ expensive projection \(\nabla c\) ​是​ one backward pass \(\Pi_\mathcal{F}\) ​是​ inner-loop QP / LP P3 dominates on compute \(\mathcal{F}\) ​由​ learned manifold ​定义​ (​数据​驱动​ typical operating envelope) guidance ​尊重​ score ​自身​流形​ projection ​需要​显式​ manifold ​参数​化​，renewable scenarios ​很少​有​ P3 dominates unless manifold ​已​工程化​ (PGDM setup) ​约束​必须​满足​以​使​ downstream solver ​启动​ (e.g. capacity bound \(\le P_{\max}\) for UC) guidance ​给​ soft feasibility；UC ​可能​在​ infeasible sample ​上​ error projection ​给​ hard feasibility P4 (​或​ P5) strictly required

​对​ F2 / F3 frontier ​的​具体​含义​：​第​ 5 ​行​表明​，​如果​ downstream UC solver ​对​ infeasibility ​敏感​ (​典型​情况​)，​那么​ P3 alone ​不够​，​需要​ P4 ​或​ P5 ​作为​兜底​。P5 (hard layer) ​在​工程​上​比​ P4 (projection inside sampler) ​更​易​实现​且​梯度​光滑​ (§5.8 ​末段​已​论证​)，​所以​ F2 → F3 ​的​依赖​链​准确​地​说​是​ "smooth-feasibility-layer → P6"，P5 ​与​可​微分​ P4 (convex \(\mathcal{F}\) ​上​的​ differentiable QP) ​是​该​ precondition ​的​两条​可​互换​路径​。​这​给​ F3 ​实施者​额外​的​工程​灵活​度​。

docs.title: 5.9 Layered combination ablation (Seam 5)
docs.text:
Phase 0c-A Seam 5 + Phase 0d "layer don't choose" ​立场​：​调研​池中​的​论文​几乎​总是​挑​一个​ placement​报告​，​组合​ ablation ​缺失​。​一个​自然​的​ grid：

\[\{P1 \in \{\text{raw, residual}\}\} \times \{P3 \in \{\text{off, gradient guidance}\}\} \times \{P5 \in \{\text{off, capacity layer}\}\}\]

​会​让​领域​分清​哪​一个​ placement ​实际​买​到​ feasibility ​与​ ​哪​一个​买​到​统计​忠实度​。​当前​文献​证据​不​允许​这一​分离​。 §10 F2 + F3 ​的​两篇​论文​同时​也​会​自然​ produce ​这一​ ablation。

docs.title: 6. Spatial-temporal architectures
docs.text: ​本章​从​空间​-​时间​粒度​这一​相对​独立​的​轴​上​重新​审视​ §3 (generative family) ​与​ §5 (constraint placement) ​中​已​介绍​的​论文​。Phase 0a §2 ​的​ sub-problem tree ​把​ spatial-temporal ​列为​ sub-problem 1, 5, 6——​分别​对应​"​单点​ / ​残差​ / ​多​场站​"——​这三类​问题​在​数学​结构​上​有​显著​差异​：​单点​是​ 1D ​序列​分布​学习​；​残差​是​低​方差​零​中心​分布​学习​；​多​场站​需要​联合​分布​与​空间结构​建模​。​本章​选择​按​ ​系统​级​颗粒​度​ (​单点​ → ​多​场站​ → ​联合​源​-​荷​ → ​区域​ → ​多​分辨率​ → ​多​能源​) ​分层​叙述​，​使​读者​看到​ diffusion ​在​每​一级​颗粒​度上​面临​的​具体​技术​挑战​。

docs.title: 6.1 Single asset, single horizon
docs.text: ​入门级​ (Phase 0a §2 Sub-problem 1)：​单一​场站​ / ​单一​资产​ (e.g. ​单​ wind farm 24h × 15-min)。​代表性​工作​ CLDM (W1) ​在​ short-term wind ​上​、DiffLoad (T-PWRS 2024, arXiv 2306.01001) ​在​ building / system ​级​ load ​上​。CLDM ​的​两​阶段​分解​ (§5.2 P1) ​与​ DiffLoad ​的​ separable epistemic vs aleatoric uncertainty ​是​同一​ trade-off ​的​两个​对面​：CLDM ​把​不确定性​压​到​ residual diffusion ​中​，DiffLoad ​把​它​显式​ decompose ​为​认知​ / ​偶然​两类​，aleatoric ​部分​用​ robust additive Cauchy distribution ​建模​ (<verify-Phase-2>)。

docs.title: 6.2 Multi-asset, same source
docs.text:
Wind farm cluster (​多​ turbine / ​多​ farm ​同时​生成​)。CAL-DM (§4.2) ​显式​处理​多​模态​ meteorological + equipment features。​这​一类​的​关键问题​是​ inter-asset spatial correlation：​相邻​场站​的​ ramp ​事件​高度​相关​，​独立​ channel ​建模​会​低估​ portfolio-level ​尾部​风险​。

​单点​ / ​单​ horizon ​的​核心​难点​是​ calibration vs sharpness：​单点​边际​容易​标定​ (CRPS ​在​ 5–15 % ​量级​常见​)，​但​ sharpness (​分布​的​方差​) ​与​ calibration ​之间​存在​ trade-off——​过​ sharp ​的​分布​会​丢​ calibration、​过​ wide ​的​分布​ calibration ​良好​但​对​决策​无用​。CLDM ​的​两​阶段​分解​通过​把​ sharpness ​让渡​给​点​预测​、​把​ calibration ​让渡​给​残差​ diffusion，​缓解​这一​ trade-off；DiffLoad ​通过​显式​ epistemic / aleatoric ​分解​，​把​ calibration ​的​责任​在​两类​不确定性​间​分配​。​这​一对​的​相似之处​是​都​把​ calibration ​责任​从​单一​模型​中​拆分​；​区别​是​ CLDM ​在​数据​层​做​拆分​ (P1)、DiffLoad ​在​不确定性​源头​做​拆分​。

docs.title: 6.3 Joint source-load
docs.text:
CDSG (W7, Applied Energy 377:124555, 2025 <verify-Phase-2>)：CSTFM ​显式​建模​ source-load ​联合​分布​。Pattern-Guided Diffusion (W8) ​在​更​精细​的​ pattern ​粒度​上​做​同样​事情​。Multi-Energy Building Cluster Diffusion (Energy 2025 <verify-Phase-2>) ​把​ source-load ​推广​到​ cooling + heating + electrical + on-site renewable ​的​多​能源​耦合​。

Joint source-load ​的​核心​难点​是​ ​跨​变量​相关性​建模​。Wind / solar ​之间​在​日​尺度​上常​负相关​ (​日间​ solar ​高时​ wind ​平均​略低​)，​但​在​多日​ Dunkelflaute ​期间​高度​正​相关​ (​二者​同时​为​低​)；source ​与​ load ​之间​又​通过​ weather-driven HVAC demand ​形成​正​相关​。​这些​相关性​在​ regime-dependent ​上​变化​巨大​——​这是​ §7.6 regime-conditional ​评估​的​天然​ motivation。CDSG ​的​ CSTFM ​模块​通过​ spatio-temporal fusion ​试图​捕获​这种​ regime-dependent ​相关性​；MS-CADM ​通过​ hourly-point cluster label ​间接​编码​ regime。​两者​都​没有​显式​报告​ regime-conditional ​相关性​指标​，​这是​ Phase 2 ​应该​核查​的​关键点​。

docs.title: 6.4 Regional / topology-aware
docs.text: G-DDPM (§4.3) ​与​ DiffSTG (§4.3)。​把​网络拓扑​ (​传输线​、​变压器​) ​作为​图​条件​注入​ score function。​这​一层​与​ §5 P3 (gradient guidance) ​自然​耦合​——​某些​节点​的​ KCL ​约束​需要​在​反向​采样​中​通过​图​传播​执行​。

docs.title: 6.5 Multi-resolution / hierarchical
docs.text: Multi-Resolution DDPM (W2, Energies 18:3781, 2025 <verify-Phase-2>)：hierarchical denoising at multiple temporal resolutions (e.g. 1h + 15-min + 5-min)。​对​ hierarchical UC (day-ahead + intra-day) ​在​概念​上​有​明显​价值​——​日前​ UC ​用​粗粒度​，intra-day re-dispatch ​用​细粒度​——​但​ Phase 0c-B B-a2 ​指出​，Multi-Res DDPM ​论文​本身​没有​运行​ hierarchical UC ​实验​。​这是​ Tier 1–2 ​评估​文化​的​典型​病例​。

docs.title: 6.6 Multi-energy / building cluster
docs.text: Multi-Energy Building Cluster Diffusion (Energy 2025 <verify-Phase-2>) ​把​生成​扩展​到​ building cluster ​的​ cooling + heating + electrical + on-site renewable。​这​与​ energy-hub dispatch ​决策​直接​相关​，​但​论文​仍​止步​于​ distributional metrics (CRPS / ES / autocorrelation match / cluster-level aggregation diagnostics)。

docs.title: 6.6b ​多​能源​耦合​带来​的​特有​约束
docs.text:
Multi-energy ​系统​在​约束​维度​上​比​纯电​系统​多​两层​：(i) ​能量​转换​约束​ (chiller / boiler ​的​ COP、​电热​联产​的​电热​比​)，​这些​约束​通过​非线性​方程​耦合​多类​能流​；(ii) ​储能​动态​ (​蓄热​罐​温度​、​电池​ SoC) ​在​时序​上​引入​ path-dependent constraint，​无法​用单​时刻​ box constraint ​表达​。​这些​约束​在​ P1–P6 ​框架​内​的​具体​安置​至今​没有​完整​调研​——Multi-Energy Building Cluster Diffusion ​在​哪​一格​？​没有​完整​ placement vector。​这是​ §11.2 minimum reporting standard "​六位​ placement vector" ​的​具体​动机​。

​多​能源​ evaluation ​的​额外​维度​：​除​ Tier 1–4 ​之外​，multi-energy ​系统​应​额外​报告​ (i) cross-carrier balance (​电热​联产​中​电能​与​热能​的​同时​供需平衡​误差​)、(ii) storage cycling (​蓄热​罐​ / ​电池​的​等效​循环​次数​，​对​ lifetime cost ​关键​)、(iii) carbon intensity (kgCO₂/kWh aggregate, ​在​ low-carbon building ​用例​中​是​核心​指标​)。Multi-Energy Building Cluster Diffusion ​论文​只​报告​ distributional metric (CRPS / ES / autocorrelation match)，​三项​ multi-energy-specific metric ​都​没有​出现​，​这​是​该​论文​与​ building energy management ​实际​决策​需求​之间​的​另​一个​ gap。

docs.title: 6.7 ​与​ §4 / §5 ​的​交叉
docs.text: Spatial-temporal granularity ​与​ §4 conditioning ladder ​几乎​独立​ (​例外​：rung 3 graph ​与​ §6.4 regional ​是​同一​回事​)；​与​ §5 constraint placement ​强​相关​ (​例外​：​多​分辨率​ § 6.5 ​与​ P1 / P3 ​都​正交​)。6 × 6 (granularity × placement) ​也​是​稀疏​占据​，​但​这​一​格子​的​稀疏​性​主要​由​历史​路径​决定​ (​社区​分割​) ​而​非​数学​新颖性​；​本​ survey ​不​把​它​作为​ frontier。

docs.title: 7. Evaluation hierarchy (NEW four-tier structure)
docs.text: ​本章​的​核心​立场​是​：​评估​比​方法​更​重要​，​因为​评估​决定​后续​整代​论文​的​优化​方向​。​当​ reviewing panel ​把​ CRPS / energy score ​作为​接收​ / ​拒稿​的​核心​判据​，​那么​后续​所有​ diffusion ​论文​都​会​针对​ CRPS / energy score ​优化​——​即使​这​两个​指标​对​运营​决策​几乎​不​敏感​。​这是​一种​ evaluation-driven local optimum：​领域​整体​被​锚​在​ marginal ​与​ multivariate calibration ​上​，​对​ tail / regime / decision-coherent ​行为​不​敏感​。​本章​把​当前​评估​实践​层级​化​、​把​每​一层​的​工具​与​代表​论文​ populate，​并​显式​把​ diffusion-renewable pool ​整体​定位​在​ Tier 1–2——​这​是​本​ survey ​的​核心​方法论​ claim ​之一​。

docs.title: 7.1 ​四层​结构
docs.text:
Cramer et al. (Validation Methods for Energy Time Series Scenarios from Deep Generative Models, IEEE T-PWRS 2022 published version of arXiv 2110.14451; <verify-Phase-2> author order Cramer/Gorjão/+others) ​在​ pre-diffusion ​时代​已经​把​评估​组织​成​层级​：marginal → temporal → multivariate → task-aware。​本​ survey ​把​它​升格​为​四层​结构​ (Phase 0d §2 §7):

Tier ​内容​ ​工具​ Tier 1 — marginal ​每个​ (time, channel) ​上​的​边缘​标定​ pinball loss, CRPS, reliability diagram, marginal histogram Tier 2 — multivariate (cross-channel, cross-time) ​联合​分布​的​二阶​ / ​高阶​结构​ energy score ES, variogram score Tier 3 — temporal / regime ​自​相关​、ramp ​分布​、​谱​、regime-conditional autocorrelation, ramp KS, MFDFA, regime-conditional CRPS Tier 4 — decision-aware ​下游​决策​意义​ operating-cost gap, cost-CRPS, VSS / EVPI, commitment Hamming \(d_H\), redispatch volume

​为什么​需要​四层​？ ​当前​ diffusion-renewable ​论文​几乎​都​报告​ Tier 1–2 ​指标​，​把​ Tier 3 (regime / temporal) ​当作​ "additional" ​加​分项​、Tier 4 (decision-aware) ​当作​ "future work"。​但​从​决策​视角​看​，​层级​反过来​才​正确​：​运营​决策者​只​关心​ Tier 4 (​运营​成本​)；Tier 3 (regime-conditional) ​是​ Tier 4 ​的​近似​ (rare regime ​上​的​ cost-CRPS ​是​ worst-case operating cost ​的​代理​)；Tier 1–2 (marginal / multivariate calibration) ​是​ ​必要​但​不​充分​ ​的​最低​门槛​。​本​ survey ​把​四层​结构​作为​全文​方法论​ backbone，​使​读者​能​立即​看到​任意​一篇​论文​的​评估​实际​触达​哪​一层​。

​重新​框定​ (deep-diver review §3)：Tier 1–3 ​不是​ "​在​通往​ Tier 4 ​路上​的​渐进​改进​"，​而是​ sanity gates——marginal calibration ​失败​的​ generator ​已经​坏​了​，​但​ marginal calibration ​通过​不​代表​接近​运营​有用​；Tier 4 ​是​唯一​试图​回答​用户​实际​决策问题​的​层​。"​层级​" ​比喻​略嫌​平铺​，​更​准确​的​读法​是​ "Tier 1–3 ​是​ sanity gates, Tier 4 is the measurement"。

​理论​ anchor — Gneiting & Raftery (2007) / Savage (1971)。​本​ survey ​在​ §2.5 ​已经​形式化​指出​ CRPS / ES ​是​ strictly proper scoring rules；​这一​性质​决定​它们​必然​对​ downstream decision geometry ​不​敏感​。Gneiting & Raftery (2007, Strictly Proper Scoring Rules, Prediction, and Estimation, JASA 102:359–378) ​给出​ proper scoring rule ​的​完整​公理化​，​并​明确​区分​ "proper" ​与​ "useful"：​一个​ scoring rule ​可以​对​ ​任何​ ​决策问题​ proper，​但​ ​只​对​某个​特定​决策问题​ ​有用​——CRPS ​对​ quantile-style ​决策​ (newsvendor with linear costs) ​几乎​ proper-useful ​重合​，​对​ unit commitment with combinatorial switching costs ​完全​不​重合​。Savage (1971, Elicitation of Personal Probabilities and Expectations, JASA 66:783–801) ​更​早已​证明​：​对​一个​ forecaster ​而言​，"​正确​" ​的​ loss ​是​用户​ decision problem ​自身​ ​诱导​的​ loss——SPO+ (Elmachtoub & Grigas, §9.2) ​是​这​一​ 50 ​年前​ idea ​在​ ML ​时代​的​可​计算​实现​，​而​非​全新​洞见​。

​把​ §2.5 + §7.0 + §7.1 ​三处​串​起来​读​：CRPS / ES ​对​ Tier 4 ​决策​不​敏感​不是​ empirical ​现象​，​而是​ proper-scoring-rule ​公理​的​理论​必然​。​这​把​本​ survey "the field is optimising the wrong loss" ​的​核心​ claim ​从​经验​观察​升级​为​ ​决策​理论​的​直接​推论​——Tier 4 ​不是​ "​在​ Tier 1–3 ​之上​的​额外​层​"，​而是​ Savage / Gneiting-Raftery ​公理​意义​下​唯一​对应​用户​决策问题​的​ loss。F3 frontier (P6 decision-aware training) ​的​合法性​也​由此​被​理论​锚定​。

docs.title: 7.1b Tier 1–4 ​漏斗​与​反转​漏斗​ (Figure 2)
docs.text:
​覆盖率​漏斗​ (​当前​文献​分布​):

  ┌────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
  │  Tier 1: Marginal (CRPS, pinball, reliability) │  ← ​覆盖​ 100% (​全员​报告​)
  │  ​必要​但​不​充分​的​"​准入​门票​"                       │
  └────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
       ┌──────────────────────────────────────┐
       │  Tier 2: Multivariate (ES, variogram)│  ← ​覆盖​ 85% (​多通道​论文​)
       └──────────────────────────────────────┘
            ┌────────────────────────────┐
            │  Tier 3: Regime / temporal │  ← ​覆盖​ 15% (Typhoon, MS-CADM)
            │  (ACF, ramp KS, MFDFA,     │
            │   regime-conditional CRPS) │
            └────────────────────────────┘
                 ┌────────────────────┐
                 │  Tier 4: Decision  │  ← ​覆盖​  0% <<< ​本​ survey ​命名​的​核心​空白​
                 │  (operating-cost,  │       (​整个​调研​池​没有​一篇​)
                 │   VSS / EVPI,      │
                 │   d_H, redispatch) │
                 └────────────────────┘


                  ​决策​相关性​反转​漏斗​ (​运营​视角​):

                 ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
                 │  Tier 4 = the measurement                    │  ← ​运营​决策​唯一​
                 │  ($10K-50K/turbine startup, MWh redispatch)  │     ​真正​关心​
                 └──────────────────────────────────────────────┘
                       ┌────────────────────────────────────┐
                       │  Tier 3 = decision-coherent proxy  │  ← rare regime ​上​
                       │  (regime-conditional, Tier 4 surrog)│     ​是​ Tier 4 ​代理​
                       └────────────────────────────────────┘
                              ┌──────────────────────────┐
                              │  Tier 2 = sanity gate    │  ← ​必要​不​充分​
                              │  (joint distribution OK) │
                              └──────────────────────────┘
                                    ┌──────────────────┐
                                    │  Tier 1 = sanity │  ← ​最起码​ marginal
                                    │  (marginal OK)   │     ​不能​错​
                                    └──────────────────┘

​读图​：​上​漏斗​ = ​当前​ ​研究​文献​ ​的​分布​ (​大量​论文​堆​在​ Tier 1, ​极少​触达​ Tier 4)；​下​反转​漏斗​ = ​当前​ ​运营​决策​ ​的​关注​ (Tier 4 ​是​唯一​真正​驱动​ ISO planner ​的​层​)。​两​漏斗​形状​反向​是​本​ survey ​的​核心​方法学​ claim ​的​图像​化​——literature ​优化​在​错误​的​层​上​。

docs.title: 7.2 Diffusion-renewable pool ​的​当前​分布
docs.text:
Tier 1 ​是​ universal：CLDM、Multi-Res DDPM、CAL-DM、CDSG、MS-CADM、G-DDPM、PI-DDPM、DiffLoad、Multi-Energy Building Cluster Diffusion、Score-based Offshore Typhoon Diffusion ​等​全部​报告​ CRPS / pinball / reliability。

Tier 2 ​几乎​ universal：energy score (ES) ​与​ variogram ​在​ multivariate / multi-asset ​论文​中​标准​报告​。CLDM ​报告​ \(W_2\) to empirical + ramp distribution；CAL-DM ​报告​ ES + variogram + ​高阶​ autocorrelation。

Tier 3 ​稀疏​： - Score-based Offshore Typhoon Diffusion (P8, arXiv 2508.10705) ​给出​ typhoon-regime split —— Phase 0 ​调研​池中​唯一​显式​ regime-conditional ​评估​的​ power-diffusion ​论文​。 - MS-CADM ​在​ hourly-point cluster ​上​的​分层​评估​接近​ regime-conditional ​评估​，​但​ cluster label ​同时​是​ training input，circular evaluation (Phase 0d §6.6)。 - Cramer et al. ​提到​的​ MFDFA (multifractal detrended fluctuation analysis — ​一种​ long-range temporal correlation ​与​多重​分形​结构​的​统计​诊断​, ​用于​检验​生成​时序​是否​复现​历史​多​尺度​自​相似​) ​在​ diffusion ​论文​中​没有​出现​。 - Diffusion Transformer for Climate-Resilience Distributed Energy Systems (Applied Energy 2024 art. S0306261924023407 <verify-Phase-2>) ​引入​ "resilience index"，​是​ Tier 3 ​与​ Tier 4 ​之间​的​中间​态​。

Tier 4 ​完全​空白​：​调研​池​没有​任何​一篇​ diffusion-renewable ​论文​运行​ stochastic UC、DRO、redispatch、commitment Hamming、VSS ​或​ EVPI ​实验​。

​逐​ tier ​论文​ census：

  • Tier 1: 100% ​覆盖​。​所有​ 14 ​篇​调研​池中​的​ diffusion-renewable ​论文​都​报告​ marginal CRPS (​或​同等​的​ pinball ​分位​损失​)。​这​是​该​领域​的​"​准入​门票​"。
  • Tier 2: ​大致​ 85% ​覆盖​。Multi-asset / multi-channel ​论文​ (CDSG, CAL-DM, G-DDPM, ​多​能源​ building cluster) ​报告​ ES ​与​ / ​或​ variogram；​单点​ / ​单​ horizon ​论文​ (DiffLoad ​部分​) ​只​报告​ Tier 1。
  • Tier 3: ​约​ 15% ​覆盖​。Score-based Offshore Typhoon (regime split)、MS-CADM (hourly cluster) ​是​仅​有​的​两篇​显式​做​ regime-conditional ​报告​的​论文​；​其他​论文​最​多​报告​ autocorrelation ​与​ ramp ​分布​作为​"temporal structure" ​证据​，​但​没有​ stratified evaluation。
  • Tier 4: 0% ​覆盖​。​没有​任何​一篇​ diffusion-renewable ​论文​在​调研​池中​报告​ operating-cost gap、cost-CRPS、VSS、EVPI、commitment Hamming、​或​ redispatch volume。

​这是​一个​精确​的​、​可​证伪​的​ census——​任何​能​找出​一篇​调研​池外​、​做​了​ Tier 4 ​评估​的​ diffusion-renewable ​论文​，​都​能​让​本​ survey ​修正​这一​断言​。​但​截至​ 2026-05-17 ​的​ Phase 0 ​调研​深度​下​，census ​为​ 0%。

docs.title: 7.3 ACF cherry-pick critique
docs.text:
Cramer et al. (Phase 0c-B B-d1) ​提出​的​关键​ methodological critique：​标准​实践​ "randomly select 3–4 historical scenarios and search for matching generated scenarios" ​后读​ ACF agreement ​作为​ temporal correctness ​证据​——​这​不是​ proper test。​该​ critique ​推广​到​：

  • Marginal-CRPS matches ​不​证明​ joint-temporal ​正确性​
  • Joint-ES matches ​不​证明​ regime-conditional ​行为​
  • ​任何​不​分层​ (stratified) ​的​指标​都​可能​被​全局​-​均值​平均​掉​关键​ tail ​行为​

​调研​池中​所有​ Tier 1–2 ​仅靠​ ACF ​通过​ multivariate diagnostic ​的​论文​都​应​被​打​上​这​一​警告​。

ACF critique ​的​具体​替代​方案​：​替代​ "​随机​选​ 3–4 historical scenarios" ​的​更​严格​做法​包括​：(a) regime-stratified ACF：​在​每个​ regime ​内​单独​算​ ACF，​给出​ regime-wise ​的​ ACF ​偏差​分布​而​非​单一​汇总​值​；(b) multi-lag KS test：​对​ lag 1, 4, 24 (​对应​ 15-min, 1-h, 6-h ​滞后​) ​分别​做​ KS ​检验​，​给出​ distribution-free ​的​统计​显著性​；(c) spectral density match：​在​频率​域​比较​生成​与​历史​的​ power spectral density，​对​周期性​事件​ (​日​周期​、​晚​高峰​) ​更​敏感​。​这​三种​方法​在​调研​池​的​ power-diffusion ​论文​中​几乎​都​没有​出现​——​这是​ §11.2 minimum reporting standard ​应​补充​的​具体​技术​建议​。

docs.title: 7.4 "2% optimality gap hides decisions" ​论点​ (B-d2)
docs.text:
​来自​ SP-UC ​文献​的​ folk-wisdom (Castle / Princeton SP-UC ​群组​ <verify-Phase-2>)：a 2 % optimality gap can hide large errors in decisions。​一个​ cost-near-optimal commitment ​仍​可能​在​ ​哪些​机组​被​ commit ​上​差异​巨大​，​这​影响​备用​、ramp adequacy、​下游​ redispatch。

Phase 1 ​推荐​：diffusion paper ​即使​报告​ X % CRPS ​改进​并​附加​ UC ​实验​，​也​不能​仅靠​ optimal-cost ​相同​就​声称​ decision-coherent——​必须​同时​报告​ commitment Hamming distance \(d_H\) ​与​ redispatch volume。​这是​ §10 F7 frontier ​的​方法论​核心​。

docs.title: 7.5 Coverage–consistency ​与​ \(w\)-sweep figure
docs.text:
Phase 0c-C Seam C2 ​提出​ ​本​ survey ​最​便宜​的​ frontier-figure：​把​任何​ CFG-conditioned power diffusion (MS-CADM ​是​ obvious target) ​的​ \(w\) scan ​与​ (i) marginal CRPS、(ii) regime-conditional CRPS on ​稀有​ regimes、(iii) ramp-distribution KS distance、(iv) energy score ​一起​画​出来​。

​这一​ figure ​同时​是​ MS-CADM 79.89 % ​数字​的​方法论​ cross-check：​如果​ conventional-baseline error ​在​中等​ \(w\) ​下​崩溃​到​正常​范围​，​那么​ 79.89 % ​就是​ \(w\)-mismatch artefact ​而​非​ diffusion superiority。​本​ survey §11 ​把​这条​ figure ​列为​ minimum reporting standard。

\(d_H\) ​在​ power ​实践​中​的​意义​：​一个​ ISO operator ​在​ day-ahead market ​中​ commit 600 ​个​机组​ × 24 ​小时​ = 14,400 ​个​ 0-1 ​变量​。​两个​ cost-near-optimal commitment ​在​ Hamming ​上​可以​差异​ 100–500 (1–3 %)，​对应​数十个​机组​的​开停​决策​不同​——​这​直接​影响​ (i) ​启动​成本​ (​一台​ large gas turbine ​启动​成本​ \(10K-\)50K)、(ii) reserve adequacy (commit ​的​机组​ portfolio ​不同​则​ reserve ​能力​不同​)、(iii) ramp adequacy (response speed ​不同​)、(iv) maintenance schedule (​反复​启停​加速​磨损​)。​所以​ commitment Hamming ​不是​抽象​指标​，​而是​直接​对应​数十万美元​的​运营​差异​。​这是​ §10 F7 ​推荐​它​作为​ minimum reporting standard ​的​实际​依据​。

docs.title: 7.6 Decision-aware ​指标​ (Tier 4) ​详解
docs.text:
Operating-cost gap (B-c2) ——​最​便宜​的​ decision-aware ​指标​：​用​生成​场景​训练​ SP / UC，​在​ held-out realisation ​上​评估​，​与​ oracle (​见到​真实​场景​的​ perfect-information solver) ​的​成本​差​。​只​需​ (i) ​一个​ deterministic UC solver、(ii) ​一个​ held-out realisation ​集​。​没有​一篇​ diffusion-renewable ​论文​做​这件​事​。

VSS (B-c1)：\(\mathrm{VSS} = \mathbb{E}[c_{\mathrm{op}}(x^*_{\mathrm{EV}})] - \mathbb{E}[c_{\mathrm{op}}(x^*_{\mathrm{SP}})]\) ​量化​"​更好​的​不确定性​表示​"​买到​了​多少​。EVPI：\(\mathrm{EVPI} = \mathbb{E}[c_{\mathrm{op}}(x^*_{\mathrm{SP}})] - \mathbb{E}_\xi[c_{\mathrm{op}}(x^*(\xi))]\) ​量化​"​完美​信息​"​再能​买​多少​。​古典​ SP-UC literature ​报告​ VSS ≈ 0.5–2 % ​在​ day-ahead vs intra-day <verify-Phase-2>；​现代​ renewable-heavy ​案例​下推​高​。0 diffusion ​论文​报告​ VSS / EVPI。

cost-CRPS (B-Seam 3)：​本​ survey ​提议​作为​ decision-coherent calibration diagnostic。​对​每个​ \(\mathbf{c}\)，​比较​ sampled scenario ​诱导​的​ \(c_{\mathrm{op}}\) ​分布​ vs oracle ​场景​诱导​的​分布​的​ CRPS。Sample ​复杂度​由​ UC ​求解​次数​ (​而​非​ scenario ​维度​) ​主导​。

commitment Hamming \(d_H\) (B-Seam 4)：

\[d_H(u_1, u_2) = \sum_{g, t} \mathbb{1}\{u_1^{g, t} \ne u_2^{g, t}\}\]

​是​简单​非​成本​指标​——​两个​生成器​在​相同​ operating cost ​下​可能​产生​ radically ​不同​ commitment，​差异​在​备用​ / redispatch / ​可靠性​上​传播​。

Regime-conditional ​一切​ (B-Seam 5 + C-Seam C2)：tail / regime ​覆盖​ (Phase 0a §6.5) ​是​ decision-relevance ​咬合​的​地方​——​多数​ operating-cost variance ​居住​在​ 5–10 % rare regimes (Dunkelflaute, frontal ramp)。​报告​ cost-CRPS conditional on regime label ​而​非​汇总​。​这是​ §10 F8。

docs.title: 7.7 Gap ​为何​持续​？(B §3)
docs.text:
Phase 0c-B §3 ​给出​四个​ mutually-reinforcing ​原因​：

(i) ​基础设施​成本​。Tier 4 ​评估​需要​ (a) ​开放​数据​的​网络​模型​ (ramp / capacity / reserve / transmission limit)、(b) UC solver (with Lagrangian / Benders / progressive-hedging ​支持​)、(c) ​与​训练​集​独立​的​ held-out realisation ​集​。ML ​会议​的​ diffusion ​论文​ (TimeGrad, CSDI ​系​) ​无​ UC pipeline；Applied Energy / Energies ​的​ diffusion ​论文​有​零散​ UC pipeline ​但​无​标准化​。OA-cGAN ​在​ NYISO-11 ​上​做​ DC-OPF——​但​不能​跨​ diffusion submission ​重用​。

(ii) ​审稿​惯例​。Renewables-ML ​审稿​主要​看​ CRPS / ES / \(W_2\) ​表​；​加​ UC ​实验​是​ additional，​引入​ attack surface (UC ​公式​选择​、cost coefficient、reserve product)。​边际​激励​是​不​做​ UC。

(iii) ​方法​论文​偏置​。Diffusion ​架构​论文​走​ NeurIPS / ICLR / Applied Energy；UC / DRO ​实验​论文​走​ IEEE T-PWRS / INFORMS J. on Computing。​两​社区​非​重叠​ reviewer ​池​。

(iv) Gradient-transport gap。DFL ​解决​了​ predictive-point loss ​的​梯度​传输​。Diffusion ​的​类比​——​对​ sampled distribution ​下​的​期望​ operating cost ​关于​ score / noise prediction network ​微分​——​需要​ REINFORCE-style estimator ​或​ pathwise gradient through sampling SDE。​两者​在​ renewable-scenario diffusion ​中均​非标准​。OA-cGAN ​的​ saddle-point ​解法​不​直接​转移​到​ non-adversarial diffusion loop。

docs.title: 7.8 Cross-thread connections — §5 / §7 / §8 ​在​评估​章节​的​交汇
docs.text:
Phase 0d §7 ​给出​了​三个​ deep-dive thread ​的​ cross-thread connections。​在​本章​ (§7 evaluation hierarchy) ​上​落地​，​可​总结​为​四个​具体​交叉​：

(i) §5 P6 (constraint placement) × §7 Tier 4 (decision-aware metric) —— ​同一​对象​的​两面​ (​训练​ loss vs ​评估​ metric)；F3 frontier ​闭合​二者​。​本​ survey ​一直​主张​ P6 ​训练​应该​用​ ​与​ evaluation ​同源​ ​的​ cost ​函数​ (operating cost from same UC solver)，​否则​会​出现​"​训练​优化​的​ cost ​与​评估​的​ cost ​不​一致​" ​的​隐藏​ mismatch——​这是​ OA-cGAN ​默认​满足​、​而​ diffusion P6 ​必须​显式​保证​的​条件​。

(ii) §4 rung 4 (CFG-conditioned regime label) × §7.5 (CFG-scale × tail-coverage curve) —— CFG ​的​ \(w\) ​是​控制​ trade-off ​的​唯一​旋钮​；​调研​池中​任何​ CFG-conditioned ​论文​都​应该​附带​ \(w\)-sweep figure，​但​目前​零​ ​篇​这样​做​。F6 frontier ​就是​把​这个​ curve ​标准化​。

(iii) §5 P3 (gradient guidance) × §7 Tier 3 (regime-conditional CRPS) —— Hoseinpour & Dvorkin (W6) ​的​ AC-feasibility guidance ​在​ typhoon-style rare regime ​上​是否​仍​保持​ feasibility？​没有​任何​文献​报告​。Score-based Offshore Typhoon Diffusion ​报告​ regime-conditional ​评估​但​不用​ AC-feasibility guidance；W6 ​用​ guidance ​但​不​报告​ regime split。​二者​必须​ join。

(iv) §3.1 (b) discrete-token diffusion (LEAF) × §8 (head-to-head) —— ​家族​区分​对​ §8 ​比较​表​的​可读性​至关重要​ (§2.4)。

docs.title: 7.9 §7 ​的​核心​ takeaway
docs.text: ​回到​本章​开头​的​立场​：​评估​比​方法​更​重要​。Diffusion-renewable ​子​领域​当前​的​局部​最优​在​ Tier 1–2 ​的​ CRPS / ES ​上​反复​优化​，​但​每篇​论文​的​边际​进步​对​运营​决策​几乎​不​可见​ (​因为​ Tier 4 ​与​ Tier 1–2 ​不​对齐​)。​退出​这一​局部​最优​的​必要条件​是​：(a) reviewing convention ​把​ Tier 3–4 ​升级​为​必报​项​；(b) public testbed ​让​ Tier 4 ​评估​的​边际​成本​趋零​ (F1)；(c) ​至少​一个​ high-profile diffusion ​论文​ (​例如​把​ MS-CADM ​在​ PERFORM ​上​ rerun ​的​ F4) ​把​ Tier 1–4 ​同时​报告​，​使​ community baseline ​重置​。​三者​都​需要​ survey-driven advocacy —— ​这​是​本​ survey ​选择​把​ Tier 4 ​空白​放在​头条​位置​的​方法学​动机​。

docs.title: 8. Diffusion vs probabilistic transformer (NEW head-to-head)
docs.text: ​本章​直面​ Phase 0a §6.4 ​的​开放​问题​与​ Phase 0b T5 ​的​ unifying thread："diffusion ​在​可​再生能源​场景​上​击败​ probabilistic transformer" ​这一​断言​到底​有多牢​？​核心​结论​是​：​该​断言​在​当前​实验​记录​下​是​ underdetermined——​既​不能​确证​、​也​不能​证伪​，​因为​两类​方法​在​ renewable ​数据​上​从未​做过​ matched ​比较​。​本章​按​时间​线​整理​三段​证据​ (2021 ​非​可再生​ baseline、2024 TACTiS-2 ​反超​、2026 PERFORM benchmark ​无​ diffusion entry)，​并​以​ 5 ​行​比较​表​收束​。

docs.title: 8.1 Benchmark trail (​非​可再生​)
docs.text:
TimeGrad (ICML 2021) + CSDI (NeurIPS 2021) + ScoreGrad (arXiv 2021)——canonical diffusion-for-TS ​三件套​。​在​ electricity dataset ​上​，TimeGrad ​报告​ CRPS-sum 0.0206，narrowly ​领先​ Transformer-MAF ​的​ 0.0207 (Phase 2 fact-check ​已​对​原​ ICML 2021 paper Table 1 cross-confirm ​此​数值​)，​远超​更​早​ baseline。CSDI ​在​ electricity ​与​ traffic ​上具​竞争力​。Speed：TimeGrad ​最慢​ (autoregressive decoding)，CSDI ​非​ autoregressive ​更​快​，ScoreGrad ​用​ continuous-time SDE ​摊销​ sampling。

​广为流传​的​ headline "diffusion beats transformer for TS" ​主要​建立​在​该​ electricity-and-traffic ​比较​上​；0.0206 vs 0.0207 ​的​ 0.0001 ​差距​落​在​ run-to-run variance ​内​——Phase 0d §6.2 ​已​专门​标记​为​不能​提升​到​ "diffusion wins"。

TACTiS-2 (ICLR 2024)——attentional-copula transformer，​参​数量​在​变量​数上​线性​ (​此前​ TACTiS-1 ​是​ quadratic — ​由​ \(D \times D\) Gaussian copula correlation ​矩阵​驱动​；TACTiS-2 ​通过​ attentional copula ​把​这​一二次​依赖​压​到​线性​，​不是​ ​从​ factorial ​降到​线性​)。​在​ multivariate ​数据​集上​报告​新​ SOTA，​与​ TimeGrad、GPVar、TempFlow、Stochastic Process Diffusion (SPD) ​直接​对比​。TACTiS-2 ​在​ CRPS / CRPS-Sum / Energy Score ​下​、​在​ ​相同​ GluonTS ​标准​套件​ (TimeGrad / CSDI / ScoreGrad ​共同​使用​的​) ​上​胜出​。

docs.title: 8.2 Benchmark trail (renewable / power)
docs.text:
DiffLoad (IEEE T-PWRS 2024, arXiv 2306.01001 <verify-Phase-2>)——Diffusion-Seq2Seq for load forecasting，separable epistemic vs aleatoric uncertainty (aleatoric ​用​ robust additive Cauchy)。​报告​系统​与​建筑​层级​的​传统​方法​增益​；baseline ​是​经典​ TS / DL，​不​包括​ foundation transformer。​没有​与​ TACTiS-2 ​或​ probabilistic transformer foundation model ​的​ head-to-head。

Foundation-model Benchmark on ERCOT PERFORM (arXiv 2604.22077, "Empirical Assessment of Time-Series Foundation Models for Power System Forecasting Applications", 2026)。​高分辨率​ PERFORM ​数据​集​；​评估​ TimesFM, Chronos-Bolt, MOIRAI-L, MOMENT, Tiny Time Mixer, TFT, PatchTST, TimeXer, LSTM, CNN ​在​八个​能力​上​ (​含​ probabilistic forecasting ​与​ context-window effects)。TimesFM ​在​ 24-h solar ​上​达​ 3.71 % normalized MAE，Moirai-L ​在​ wind ​上​ 4.17 %。No diffusion model in the lineup。

docs.title: 8.3 ​五行​比较​表​ (Phase 0c-C §3.3 ​复述​)
docs.text: Comparison Domain Result Status TimeGrad vs Transformer-MAF electricity, traffic diffusion ≈ tie (0.0206 vs 0.0207) published, margin within variance (numerics verified) CSDI vs Transformer electricity, traffic, MIMIC diffusion competitive published TACTiS-2 vs TimeGrad / SPD GluonTS suite transformer wins under CRPS / Energy published, 2024 <verify-Phase-2> Diffusion (CLDM / CAL-DM / MS-CADM) vs each other regional wind / PV diffusion-internal improvements published, non-comparable splits Diffusion vs foundation transformer (TimesFM / Chronos / MOIRAI) renewable (ERCOT / PERFORM) not run open (frontier F4)

docs.title: 8.3b ​解读​表​的​方法学
docs.text:
​读​上表​的​正确​姿态​：​不是​"diffusion ​输给​ transformer"，​也​不是​"diffusion ​在​ renewable ​上​仍然​占优​"，​而是​ "​现在​没有​数据​支持​任何​一个​判断​"。​这一​立场​对​ reviewing process ​有​具体​含义​：

  • ​任何​ renewable-diffusion ​论文​用​"diffusion ​优于​ transformer" ​作为​ motivation，​应该​被​要求​直接​比较​ transformer baseline (TACTiS-2, TimesFM, Chronos-Bolt, MOIRAI-L ​之一​)；
  • ​任何​ transformer foundation model ​论文​ (TimesFM-class) ​在​ renewable ​数据​上​ claim SOTA，​应该​被​要求​与​ ​至少​一个​ renewable-domain diffusion baseline (CLDM / MS-CADM / DiffLoad) ​比较​；
  • ​任何​声称​"diffusion ​解决​了​ renewable scenario" ​的​综述​文章​应该​ ​先​ ​解决​ §8.5 ​的​ matched benchmark ​才能​立足​。

​本​ survey ​的​ §8 ​不是​为了​"​裁决​"diffusion vs transformer，​而是​为了​让​裁决​可能​成立​ —— ​即​把​"​该​问题​在​当前​实验​记录​下​ underdetermined"​这一​事实​清晰​呈现​，​使​后续​工作​能​瞄准​这一​空白​。

docs.title: 8.4 What the trail actually licenses
docs.text:
Headline "diffusion outperforms probabilistic transformer for renewable scenarios" ​仅靠​ 2021 baseline ​在​非​可再生​数据​上​的​传递性​间接​成立​。Under matched 2024 evaluation, TACTiS-2 (transformer-copula) ​已​在​ canonical TS benchmark ​上​反超​；renewable corpus ​上​没有​ diffusion paper rerun ​比较​。

​家族​区分​ (Phase 0d §6.6, Phase 0c-C Seam C5)：​上表​的​ "diffusion" ​全部​限定​为​ continuous-noise DDPM / score-SDE。LEAF (discrete-token language diffusion) ​与​ LTSM-DIFF / T2S (LLM-guided continuous diffusion) ​不能​与​上表​内​ diffusion entry ​直接​相加​。LEAF caveat：​因为​ "diffusion" ​发生​在​ LLM token space，​与​ transformer ​的​边界​本身​就​模糊​；​它​不应​被​当作​ "diffusion wins" ​的​证据​。

docs.title: 8.4b The Bitter Lesson reading — F4 ​必须​ parameterised by training-data budget
docs.text:
Deep-diver review §5 ​指出​ §8 ​的​最​重要​遗漏​：​把​ diffusion-vs-foundation-transformer ​简化​为​"matched benchmark ​还​没​跑​" ​是​ benchmark coverage ​问题​视角​，​但​更​强​的​ prior on F4 outcome ​是​ Sutton ​的​ Bitter Lesson ​在​时序​ foundation model ​上​的​具体化​——TimesFM (​训练​于​ ~100B ​时间​点​)、Chronos-Bolt、MOIRAI-L ​把​先验​知识​从​百万​级​无关​序列​压缩​进​权重​；​它们​到​ renewable ​任务​时​自带​强​ inductive bias，​是​ score-matching ​单​领域​模型​无​ pretraining scale ​时​无法​匹配​的​。§8.2 ​的​ PERFORM ​数字​ (TimesFM 24-h solar 3.71 % nMAE, Moirai-L wind 4.17 %) ​关键​不​在​ ​绝对​优良​，​而​在​ near-zero-shot——foundation ​模型​没有​在​ PERFORM ​上​重训​。

F4 ​应当​ parameterised by training-data budget，​而​非​单点​比较​：

Target-asset ​数据​规模​ ​预测​胜者​ ​推理​ Few-shot (≤ ​数月​ target-asset ​数据​) Foundation transformer Pretraining prior ​主导​ Mid-data (1–3 ​年​) Tie ​或​ domain-specific ​占优​ Score-matching ​学到​的​ marginal–joint coupling ​是​ foundation ​模型​留在​桌上​的​ Large data (5+ ​年​, dense asset history) Domain-specific diffusion ​或​ fine-tuned foundation transformer ​取决于​ diffusion ​是否​注入​ foundation ​缺失​的​物理​结构​ (P2 / P3 / P5) Out-of-distribution regime (Dunkelflaute, typhoon) Unclear；foundation ​可能​脆弱​，​但​ diffusion ​也​没有​ demonstrated ​优势​ F4 ​应​专门​测此​ regime

F4 ​框架​的​两层​含义​：(i) ​用​ ​数据​预算​ x ​轴​ + cost-CRPS y ​轴​ ​而​非单​数字​ leaderboard ​报告​ F4；(ii) ​准备​承受​最​可能​的​ outcome——domain-specific diffusion ​只​在​ mid-data regime ​上​有​竞争力​，​意味着​ diffusion-for-renewable ​是​ transitional technology。​本​ survey ​把​这​一​可能性​写​进​ §11.5 limitations，​因为​即使​ F4 ​给出​这一​结果​，F1 / F7 / F8 ​这​三个​ model-agnostic frontier ​仍然​合法​成立​——survey ​的​方法学​ claim ​不​依赖于​"diffusion ​必将​胜利​"。

docs.title: 8.5 Frontier F4 — Matched benchmark
docs.text: Phase 0c-C C1 + Phase 0d F4：​最高​ ROI、​最低​新颖性​、​最高​确定性​的​实验​——​把​ CLDM / MS-CADM / DiffLoad ​跑​在​ PERFORM ​协议​上​，​或​把​ TimesFM / MOIRAI ​跑​在​ CLDM ​数据​集上​。​任何​后续​ v2 survey ​都​可以​引用​这一​第一次​ matched ​比较​。​与​ §10 F1 (decision-aware reusable benchmark) ​共同​构成​ "infrastructure + coverage" ​单一​问题​——​见​ §10 F1 / F4 ​的​合并​讨论​。

docs.title: 9. Decision-aware generative scenarios
docs.text: ​本章​把​ §5 P6 ​的​"​空白​格​" ​与​ §7 Tier 4 ​的​"​空白​层​"​放在​同一​画面​下读​。​结构性​观察​：​把​ decision-aware ​训练​ (§5 P6) ​与​ decision-aware ​评估​ (§7 Tier 4) ​视为​同一​问题​的​两面​——​前者​把​成本​作为​ loss ​信号​、​后者​把​成本​作为​评估​信号​；​二者​都​需要​ differentiable / repeatable UC pipeline，​且​共享​同一​ gradient-transport ​难题​。OA-cGAN ​在​ 2022 ​年​通过​ saddle-point ​在​ cGAN ​框架​内​同时​解决​两面​ (​训练​ loss = ​评估​ loss = ​运营​成本​)；diffusion ​至今​没有​ analogous ​工作​。​本章​按​方法学​源流​ (OA-cGAN → SPO → DFL → DRO → IEEE-CIS challenge) ​整理​ prior art，​并​以​ gradient-transport gap ​收尾​——​这​正是​ §10 F3 frontier ​的​技术​核​。

docs.title: 9.0 ​章节​结构​与​方法学​定位
docs.text: ​本章​按​"​由近及远​"​的​方法学​距离​展开​：​先​ (§9.1) OA-cGAN——​在​ diffusion ​之外​、​但​已经​实现​ P6 ​的​最​直接​前驱​，​是​ diffusion P6 ​必须​ dethrone ​的​ baseline；​再​ (§9.2) SPO/SPO+——​给出​"​正确​的​ loss ​是​下游​成本​" ​的​数学​奠基​，​但​只​覆盖​ point predictor，scenario-set ​扩展​未​做​；​再​ (§9.3) DFL——​把​ gradient transport ​推广​到​通用​ differentiable optimization，​但​ diffusion lift ​未​做​；​再​ (§9.4) DRO with generative ambiguity——​把​ scenario-set ​与​ worst-case ​决策​耦合​，​但​ latent-space DRO ​与​ cost-space DRO ​不等价​；​再​ (§9.5) IEEE-CIS challenge——community-level ​标准化​，​但​ diffusion ​缺席​。​最后​ (§9.5b + §9.6) ​收束​到​ gradient-transport gap——​把​这​五条​线索​读为​一个​未​解决​的​技术​问题​。

docs.title: 9.1 OA-cGAN — ​非​扩散​ P6 ​的​ canonical anchor
docs.text:
Operation-Adversarial Scenario Generation (Zhirui Liang, Robert Mieth, Yury Dvorkin; Electric Power Systems Research vol. 212 art. 108451, July 2022; arXiv 2110.02152 Oct 2021)。Venue ​更正​：Phase 0b S6 ​把​它误​置于​ Applied Energy — ​错误​，​正确​ venue ​是​ EPSR。Authors are Phase-2 verified (Rutgers / NYU / Johns Hopkins lineage via OSTI + Rutgers publication page).

Mechanism：cGAN ​的​ generator ​训练​为​ ​最大化​下游​ DC-OPF ​模型​的​运营​成本​，DC-OPF ​消费​ generator ​的​输出​作为​ net-load forecast error。Discriminator ​仍​执行​统计​可信度​。Saddle-point ​在​ "credible and costly" ​处​。

Testbed：NYISO 11-zone，day-ahead net load。

​为什么​对​ Thread B ​关键​：​它​是​ Phase 0 ​调研​池中​唯一​闭合​ "generator → operational model → cost → loss signal" ​的​代表​——​任何​ decision-aware diffusion paper ​都​必须​以​它​为​先验​。Phase 0c-B ​与​ Phase 0d ​反复强调​它​在​ §5 P6 + §9 ​中​的​双重​ anchor ​地位​。

OA-cGAN ​的​ saddle-point ​公式​ (tri-level ​结构​)：
