docs.title: 10.3 Seam C：​联合​ \(\lambda_{\mathrm{deg}}\) / \(\mathrm{SOH}_{\min}\) / tariff sensitivity ​作为​ required output
docs.text: Phase 0c-A Seam C ​的​ prescriptive ​提议​：​把​ W1 ​的​ MILP ​作为​固定​ benchmark，​在​三轴​ (\(\lambda_{\mathrm{deg}}\) × \(\mathrm{SOH}_{\min}\) × TOU ​制度​) ​上​联合​ sweep，​发布​profitability contour。​这​把​ Thread T1 ​从​批评​转化​为​构造性​披露​模板​。​综述​判定​：​这是​一个​低​ ML-rich ​但​高​ community-impact ​的​ single-paper deliverable。

docs.title: 10.2.1 Modal failure ​的​细读
docs.text:
Table 10.2 ​的​ modal score = 5/10 ​与​ modal failure = ​字​段​ 8（sensitivity sweeps）​之间​存在​结构性​原因​。​绝大多数​ V2G-degradation ​调度​论文​的​核心​ contribution ​都​集中​在​ method（​更​精确​的​ aging model、​更紧​的​ MILP relaxation、​更​新颖​的​ RL ​算法​）；method-centric ​写作​传统​下​，​规范性​输入​被​默认​为​"​实验​设置​"​而​非​"​结果​对象​"——​这​导致​ sensitivity ​扫描​被​视为​ ablation study ​的​可选项​，​而​非主​结果​。

​但​ V2G ​退化​感知​调度​的​关键​发现​（W7、W8、W6 ​联合​）​恰好​是​：​正是​规范性​输入​决定​了​ method-centric headline ​的​符号​。​一个​在​ €70/MWh ​假设​下​"V2G ​不​盈利​"​的​ RL ​调度​器​，​可能​在​ €132/MWh ​假设​下​"V2G ​高度​盈利​"——method ​本身​没​变​。​这​意味着​没有​ sensitivity ​扫描​的​ method-centric ​论文​，​其​ method comparison ​在​不同​ normative ​假设​下​排序​可能​完全​不同​。​综述​据此​把​ Seam C（§10.3）​从​"​建议​"​升级​为​"​诚实​科学论文​的​最低​限度​"——​这是​综述​ contribution ​的​尖锐​位置​。

docs.title: 10.2.2 Field 9 ​全部​空缺​的​代价
docs.text:
Phase 0c-A ​的​ W1–W12 ​中​，​字​段​ 9（protocol layer assumption）​全部​空缺​。​这​意味着​ Phase 0c-A ​抽样​的​ V2G ​调度​文献​没有​一篇​显式​声明​其​调度​时间​步​、​动作​集​、​与​协议​消息​粒度​的​对应​关系​。​综述​判断​这一​空缺​与​ §9 ​的​ Seam S3 protocol-feasibility wrapper ​缺失​同根​：​文献​默认​"​协议​层​不​影响​算法​"，​而​该​默认​在​ post-2027 OCPP 2.1 + ISO 15118-20 ScheduleTuple cadence ​下​显式​错误​。

field 9 ​的​填写​本身​有​低成本​——​只​需​一行​说明​"​调度​时间​步​ = \(\Delta t\) ​秒​；​假设​ ScheduleTuple cadence；renegotiation budget = X"——​但​它​把​论文​的​ sim-to-real ​边界​透明化​、​把​跨​论文​的​ method ​比较​ conditioned on ​共同​协议​假设​。​综述​提议​把​ field 9 ​与​ field 8 ​一起​列为​"​必须​填写​"​字​段​，​其他​字段​在​篇幅​有限​的​情况​下​允许​"reported elsewhere"​引用​。

docs.title: 10.4 §10 sub-summary ​与​社区​采纳​建议
docs.text: Ten-field schema ​的​设计​原则​是​"​再现​一篇​论文​的​核心​规范性​决策​所​需​的​最小​披露​集​"。​综述​提议​把​该​ schema ​作为​ V2G ​退化​感知​调度​子​社区​的​报告​标准​，​与​ §9 ​的​ protocol-claims registry ​并列​作为​两个​ community-level deliverable。Connection 1 inline：​一旦​ schema ​被​采纳​，§7 Seam S1 ​的​ \(\Delta\mathrm{SOH}_i\) VCG / Shapley ​机制​就​有​了​ legible ​价格​——schema ​与​ mechanism ​是​ dual。

docs.title: 11. The Stopping-Time Reformulation: V2G ↔ Second-Life (Thread T5; Phase 0c-C entire) — NEW chapter
docs.text: §11 ​是​综述​结构​上​的​第三个​新​章节​（Phase 0d §2 ​第​ 11 ​项​），​承载​ Thread T5 ​与​ Seams C1–C5 ​的​完整​表述​，​并​把​综述​论点​的​第三​轴​——​从​ \([0,T]\) ​最优控制​到​ \([0,\tau]\) ​最优​停止​——​形式化​、​与​ Threads A/B ​缝合​。

docs.title: 11.1 EU Reg 2023/1542 + EN 18061:2025 + Reg Art. 14 BMS read-only access
docs.text:
post-2027 ​的​法规​层​把​"​退化​"​从​私人​成本​转化​为​可​审计​的​、​可​作为​ salvage ​信号​的​公开​签名​。​三个​文档​构成​ stopping-time ​重构​的​ regulatory ​基础​：

  • EU Regulation 2023/1542 (W9 in Phase 0c-C)：​自​ 2027 ​年​ 2 ​月​ 18 ​日起​，EU ​市场​上​每块​ > 2 kWh ​的​ EV ​电池​与​ industrial ​电池​都​必须​携带​数字​护照​（passport），​经​ QR code ​访问​，​披露​ SOH、​循环​计数​、​关键​故障​事件​、​使用​历史​；​动态​字​段​必须​在​ material change（refurbishment、repurposing、ownership transfer）​时​更新​；read-only BMS access for independent operators ​由​ Art. 14 ​强制​。FC-3 ​修订​：​早期​ Phase 0b ​提出​的​"2027 ​年​ 8 ​月​ universal QR-code ​阶段​"​在​ Reg 2023/1542 Annex XIII ​文本​中​找​不到​支持​证据​——QR code ​即​ 2027-02-18 mandate ​本身​的​访问​机制​，​并非​独立​的​后续​阶段​；​综述​撤回​ "Aug 2027 split" claim（​而​非​保留​ needs-verify hedge）。
  • EN 18061:2025 (W8 in Phase 0c-C)：CEN/TC 301 2025 ​年​ 9 ​月​发布​；​技术标准​ for "prepared for repurposing" ​单元​的​交接​：BIN ​发行​/​更新​、​护照​中​可追溯​性​、​温度​/​电压​/​压缩力​安全​阈值​、​重组​时​模块​间​ SOH ​必须​匹配​。​文本​付费​墙​，​二手​ summaries (CEN-CENELEC news 2025-09-16, DKE summary) ​在​大​尺度​一致​；​具体​ clause ​引用​前​需​ standards.iteh.ai ​验证​。
  • W7 in Phase 0c-C (Batteries MDPI 10.3390/batteries10040115, 2024, [A?])：​把​护照​数据字​段​、SOH ​归一化​公式​（reported SOH = current usable / (BOL usable + full reserve)）、Art. 14 read-only BMS access ​编​为​综述​格式​；​区分​披露​的​动态数据​（SOH、​循环​数​、​关键​故障​事件​）​与​未​披露​的​运行​ granularity（​每秒​功率​、​每​循环​ DoD ​分布​）。

docs.title: 11.2 Salvage ​函数​ \(V_{\mathrm{salvage}}\) ​与​ grader \(G\) ​与​投影​ \(\Pi\)
docs.text:
Phase 0c-C ​把​ salvage ​价值​在​三轴上​参数​化​：

\[ V_{\mathrm{salvage}}\!\bigl(\Pi(\mathcal{H}_\tau),\,G\bigr)\,\mathbf{1}\{\text{EN 18061 admissible}\}. \]
  • ​护照​投影​ \(\Pi: \mathcal{H}_\tau \mapsto \mathrm{Disclosure\,Schema}\)：​把​完整​运行​历史​映射​到​ Reg 2023/1542 ​披露​字段​上​（W7, W9）。
  • Grader \(G: \mathrm{Features}_\tau \mapsto \mathrm{Class}\)：​把​退出​时刻​特征​映射​到​离散​等级​。W10 in Phase 0c-C (Int. J. Information Technology 2025, [A?]) ​是​ supervised learning ensemble ​在​ internal resistance / OCV / actual capacity / discharge rate / cycle life ​上​的​ grader ​实例​。
  • EN 18061 admissibility indicator \(\mathbf{1}\{\cdot\}\)：​把​温度​ / ​电压​ / ​模块​同质性​外​的​轨迹​清零​ salvage——​硬​ gate。

salvage ​标量​的​市场​基准​由​ Phase 0c-C ​的​ W1 ​给出​ (MDPI Batteries 10(12):452, 2024, [A?])：repurposed SLB ​价格​区间​ $44–180/kWh、repurposing ​成本​ $25–49/kWh、​新​ packs $150–250/kWh；4× ​价差​在​ chemistry × geography × date ​上​ aggregated（FC：​在​ V2G ​调度​器内​引用​ single mid-point ​会​隐藏​该​ 4× spread）。W2 in Phase 0c-C (Nature Communications s41467-024-52030-0, 2024, [A?]) ​提供​ tabulated ​而​非​ fitted ​的​ \(V_{\mathrm{salvage}}(\mathrm{SOH}_\tau;\text{chemistry},\text{pathway})\)——V2G stopping-time ​调度​器​可以​ interpolate ​之​并​把​ pathway ​视为​第二个​决策​变量​。

docs.title: 11.3.0 ​一个​最小​例子​：optimal control vs optimal stopping
docs.text:
​在​写​ stopping-time formulation ​之前​，​先给​一个​ grounded ​的​二歧​ worked example——​同​一辆​ EV、​同​一块​电池​、​同一​市场​，optimal control ​求​出​什么​动作​、optimal stopping ​求​出​什么​动作​、​二者​哪里​不同​。

​考虑​一辆​ EV：​当前​ SOH = 90%、pack ​容量​ 80 kWh。​基于​ W6 €132/MWh by 2030 ​的​补偿​税率​与​剩余​循环​预算​，​剩余​ first-life cash flow ​在​ [0, T=3 yr] ​内可达​ 8000 €（aggressive ​调度​）​或​ 3000 €（conservative ​调度​）。second-life salvage ​在​ SOH ∈ [70%, 90%] ​区间​按​ \(V_{\mathrm{salvage}}(\mathrm{SOH}) = 150 \times \mathrm{SOH}\) €/kWh ​计算​（80 kWh pack → SOH=82% ​时​ salvage = 9840 €、SOH=70% ​时​ salvage = 8400 €、SOH<70% ​时​ EN 18061 admissibility ​清零​、salvage = 0）。

​场景​ A — aggressive V2G + ​用到​死​：​未来​ 3 ​年​通过​ V2G ​套利​ + FCR ​创造​ first-life ​收入​ 8000 €；SOH ​在​ \(\tau=\) ​第​ 3 ​年末​降​至​ 65%；EN 18061 admissibility threshold ​为​ SOH ≥ 70%，​故​ salvage indicator = 0、salvage = 0。​总​收益​ = 8000 € + 0 € = 8000 €。

​场景​ B — conservative V2G + ​早退​接班​：​未来​ 18 ​个​月​做​温和​ V2G、first-life ​收入​ 3000 €；\(\tau\) ​选在​第​ 18 ​个​月末​、SOH = 82%、salvage = \(150 \times 0.82 \times 80 = 9840\) €。​总​收益​ = 3000 € + 9840 € = 12840 €。

​框架​ ​决策​变量​ ​目标​ ​该例​中​最优​答案​ ​总​收益​ Optimal control on \([0, T]\) \((p^{\mathrm{ch}}_t, p^{\mathrm{dis}}_t)\) on fixed \(T=3\) yr first-life cash flow only ​场景​ A (aggressive) 8000 € Optimal stopping on \([0, \tau]\) \((p^{\mathrm{ch}}_t, p^{\mathrm{dis}}_t, \tau)\) first-life + admissibility-gated salvage ​场景​ B (early exit) 12840 €

​直觉​：optimal control on \([0,T]\) ​把​电池​"​用到​死​"（first-life ​收入​最大化​）、optimal stopping on \([0,\tau]\) ​把​电池​"​在​最​值钱​的​时刻​交班​"（​联合​ first-life + salvage ​最大化​，​且​ \(\tau<T\) ​是​ endogenous ​决策​）。EN 18061 admissibility indicator ​是​这​一直​觉​的​硬​执行​——SOH ​越过​ threshold ​后​ salvage ​不是​"​下降​"​而是​"​清零​"，scheduler ​必须​主动​在​ threshold ​之前​停​。​数值​上​ (12840 − 8000) / 8000 = 60.5% ​的​额外​收益​完全​来自​把​ \(\tau\) ​作为​决策​变量​的​ framing。​该例​数字​按​ Phase 0c-C W1 / W2 salvage ​区间​可​代换​；​论点​的​鲁棒性​建立​在​ "(i) optimal control ​与​ optimal stopping ​答案​显著​不同​；(ii) ​不同​来源​是​ admissibility indicator ​的​ hard gate" ​两个​结构性​事实上​，​不​依赖​具体​数值​。

​下面​的​ ASCII ​决策树​把​这​一​对比​可视化​：

                            ┌─────────────────────────────────┐
                            │  EV at t=0: SOH=90%, V2G option │
                            └─────────────────────────────────┘
                                          │
                  ┌───────────────────────┴───────────────────────┐
                  │                                               │
        optimal control on [0,T]                       optimal stopping on [0,τ]
        (τ ≡ T exogenous)                              (τ endogenous, τ ≤ T)
                  │                                               │
                  ▼                                               ▼
        choose (p^ch_t, p^dis_t) only                  choose (p^ch_t, p^dis_t, τ)
                  │                                               │
                  ▼                                               ▼
        first-life cash flow:                           first-life cash flow:
        max 8000 €  (aggressive)                        moderate 3000 €  (conservative)
                  │                                               │
                  ▼                                               ▼
        at t=T=3yr:  SOH=65% < 70%                     at t=τ=18mo: SOH=82% ≥ 70%
                  │                                               │
                  ▼                                               ▼
        EN 18061 admissibility:                         EN 18061 admissibility:
        FAIL  →  V_salvage = 0                          PASS  →  V_salvage = 9840 €
                  │                                               │
                  ▼                                               ▼
        ╔══════════════════════╗                        ╔══════════════════════╗
        ║  total = 8000 €      ║                        ║  total = 12840 €     ║
        ╚══════════════════════╝                        ╚══════════════════════╝
                                          │
                              admissibility indicator
                              acts as hard gate, not
                              smooth boundary

​辅以​ §2.2.1 ​已经​介绍​过​的​"​卖房​ vs ​租房​"​日常​类比​——optimal control ​像​在​固定​时​长​租约​期内​最大化​租金​、optimal stopping ​像​选择​"​卖房​时机​ + ​持有​期内​租金​管理​"，​卖房​时机​ (\(\tau\)) ​与​持有期​策略​ (\(\pi\)) ​联合​决策​，buyer ​只能​看​房产证​披露​字​段​（\(\Pi\)）​而​ grader (\(G\)) ​给​二手房​打​ A/B/C ​等级​——​把​抽象​记号​ \(\tau, \Pi, G\) ​一次性​ anchor ​到​日常​经济​直觉​。

docs.title: 11.3 Stopping-time formulation
docs.text:
​把​ §2.2 ​的​ canonical objective ​重写​为​ explicit stopping-time form：

\[ \mathcal{J}(\pi,\tau) \;=\; \underbrace{\mathbb{E}\!\left[\sum_{t=0}^{\tau-1}\!\bigl(\pi^{\mathrm{rev}}_t - \lambda_{\mathrm{deg}}\,\Delta\mathrm{SOH}_t\bigr)\Delta t\right]}_{\text{first-life cash flow}} + \underbrace{\mathbb{E}\!\bigl[V_{\mathrm{salvage}}\!\bigl(\Pi(\mathcal{H}_\tau),\,G\bigr)\mathbf{1}\{\text{EN18061 admissible}\}\bigr]}_{\text{regulator-gated salvage}} \]

​约束​保持​ §2.2：SOC ​动力学​、​功率​上​下界​、​插枪​窗口​、\(\Pr(\mathrm{SOH}_\tau\ge\mathrm{SOH}_{\min})\ge 1-\epsilon\)、​协议​可行性​ \(\pi\in\Pi_{\mathrm{15118}\text{-}20}^{\mathrm{OCPP\,2.1}}\)。\(\tau\) ​与​ \(\pi\) ​联合​决策​。

​关键​性质​：(i) salvage ​项​的​ EN 18061 admissibility indicator ​让​ \(V_{\mathrm{salvage}}\) ​在​不​合规​轨迹​上为​零而非​平滑​下降​——​这​把​目标​变成​ piecewise，​标准​平滑​优化​方法​不​直接​适用​；(ii) \(G\) ​是​离散​ grader，​使​ salvage ​在​ SOH ​阈值​附近​阶跃​——​同样​ piecewise；(iii) \(\Pi\) ​是​规范性​投影​，​调度​器​优化​的​实际​ objective ​是​ \(V_{\mathrm{salvage}}(\Pi(\mathcal{H}_\tau),G)\) ​而​非​ \(V_{\mathrm{salvage}}(\mathcal{H}_\tau,G)\)——​这​开启​了​ Seam C4 ​的​ adversarial dynamics。

Snell envelope ​显式​命名​：​给定​ \(\pi\)，​对​ \(\tau\) ​的​优化​是​离散​时间​最优​停止​问题​，​其​ value function ​满足​ Snell envelope recursion：

\[ U_t = \max\bigl\{Y_t,\;\mathbb{E}_t[U_{t+1}]\bigr\},\quad Y_t = V_{\mathrm{salvage}}(\Pi(\mathcal{H}_t),G)\,\mathbf{1}\{\text{EN 18061 admissible}\}. \]

​最优​停止​时间​ \(\tau^* = \inf\{t : Y_t \ge \mathbb{E}_t[U_{t+1}]\}\)。LSM（Longstaff-Schwartz Monte Carlo，§11.8 Seam C5）​是​该​ recursion ​的​标准​数值​实现​；RL Q-function ​在​离散​时间​下​与​ Snell envelope ​同构​。

Free-boundary ​行为​的​关键​区分​——​经典​ American option ​的​ free boundary ​由​ smooth-pasting ​条件​（value function ​与​ exercise payoff ​在​ exercise boundary ​处一阶​光滑​相切​）​决定​，​前提​是​ \(Y_t\) ​平滑​、​状态​过程​为​扩散​。V2G + EN 18061 settings ​下​ \(Y_t\) ​是​ piecewise constant + indicator：EN 18061 admissibility indicator ​是​ regulator ​设定​的​ hard gate——​在​ admissibility ​边界​外​ salvage ​整体​清零​而​非​连续​下降​，free boundary ​由​监管​ indicator ​而​非​ smooth-pasting ​推导​。​两套​数值​ apparatus ​不可​互换​：​经典​ real-option ​的​ smooth-pasting ​方法​（​解析​或​半​解析​ free-boundary PDE）​在​此​不​适用​；​可用​工具​是​ MILP big-M、Gumbel-softmax RL、​或​ LSM Monte Carlo ​简化​的​离散​时间​近似​。​这一​区分​对​ §11.4 differentiable surrogate ​路径​的​选型​有​直接​后果​。

docs.title: 11.3.1 Stopping-time formulation ​的​ piecewise ​结构
docs.text:
§11.3 ​的​目标​函数​ \(\mathcal{J}(\pi, \tau)\) ​是​ piecewise / discrete / regulator-shaped ​的​复合体​——​把​它​分解成​可​优化​的​子​问题​需要​识别​三层​ piecewise ​结构​。

​第一层​ piecewise：EN 18061 admissibility indicator \(\mathbf{1}\{\cdot\}\)。​在​ admissibility ​边界​内​ salvage ​项​贡献​为​ \(V_{\mathrm{salvage}}\)、​在​边界​外为​ 0。​这一​ indicator ​不是​平滑​函数​——​温度​、​电压​、​模块​同质性​任何​一项​越界​都​把​ salvage ​清零​。MILP ​编码​：​把​ admissibility ​写成​ disjunctive constraints + big-M relaxation。RL ​编码​：​把​ indicator ​写成​ reward shaping ​的​ sparse penalty + ​可​达​ dense reward ​配对​。

​第二层​ piecewise：Grader \(G\) ​的​离散​输出​。grade class ​之间​ salvage ​阶跃​，​标准​平滑​梯度​方法​不​工作​。Gumbel-softmax relaxation ​把​离散​输出​ softmax ​化​、​温度​参数​控制​ sharpness——​温度​趋​零时​恢复原​ grader、​温度​温和​时​给​可微​近似​。Phase 0c-C W10 grader ​的​具体​特征向量​给出​ surrogate ​的​输入​空间​，​但​ grader ​训练​数据​集​本身​的​ release status [A?]。

​第三层​ piecewise：​护照​投影​ \(\Pi\) ​的​截断​。\(\Pi(\mathcal{H}_\tau)\) ​只​暴露​规定​字​段​，​未​暴露​字段​在​ grader ​输入​上​为​ 0 ​或​ marginal default value。​这一​截断​在​梯度​上​是​ hard zero——​通过​ \(\Pi\) ​反向​传播​的​部分​梯度​被​强制​ mask。​对​ scheduler ​而言​，​这​意味着​调度​策略​对​未​投影​字段​的​影响​在​ salvage ​上​不​可见​——​即使​该​影响​在​真实​ second-life ​价值​上​存在​。

​三层​ piecewise ​的​合并​使​ \(V_{\mathrm{salvage}}\) ​在​ \(\pi\) ​与​ \(\tau\) ​上​呈现​"​高度​非凸​ + ​大量​平台​ + ​阶跃​"​组合​。​综述​判断​：​在​ V2G ​退化​感知​调度​的​ post-2027 sections，​求解​器​选型​问题​（MILP big-M / Gumbel-RL / scenario tree + LSM）​至少​与​ method novelty ​同等​重要​。

docs.title: 11.4 Seam C1：differentiating through the grader
docs.text: W10 in Phase 0c-C ​的​ grader ​是​离散​类​映射​；​为​把​它​放入​ RL/MILP ​调度​器​需要​ differentiable surrogate。​可行​技术​：Gumbel-softmax over grade ​类​的​概率​松弛​；MILP encoding of grade thresholds ​作为​线性​ piecewise；RL reward ​加入​ predicted-grade-drop penalty。Phase 0c-C ​注​：​没有​一篇​ surveyed V2G ​论文​ differentiate through \(G\)——Seam C1 ​即此​空白​。

docs.title: 11.4.1 Seam C1 ​实现​的​三条​工程​路径​比较
docs.text:
​把​ §11.4 differentiable surrogate ​提议​落地​，​三条​具体​路径​在​工程​门槛​与​表达能力​之间​提供​不同​ trade-off。

​路径​ i（Gumbel-softmax + RL）：​把​ grader \(G\) ​训练​成​神经网络​ → ​用​ Gumbel-softmax ​给​可微​近似​ → ​在​ RL agent ​训练​时​把​ expected grade class ​作为​ reward ​的​一部分​。​优点​是​端​到​端​可微​、​与​ deep RL ​框架​天然​兼容​；​缺点​是​ Gumbel ​温度​需调​参​、grader ​训练​数据​集​ V2G-specific ​部分​稀薄​。

​路径​ ii（MILP + threshold linearization）：​把​ grade class ​边界​写成​ hard threshold（SOH ≥ 80% → Grade A, 60–80% → Grade B ​等​）→ ​用​ indicator ​变量​与​ big-M ​把​ threshold ​写​进​ MILP → salvage ​项​作为​ grade class ​概率​加权​和​（​事先​ calibrated）。​优点​是​与​现有​ V2G MILP lineage（W1, A6, W12）​兼容​；​缺点​是​ grade class ​边界​假设​为​ ex-ante ​固定​。

​路径​ iii（surrogate-based RL）：​训练​ surrogate network ​直接​预测​ \(V_{\mathrm{salvage}}(\Pi(\mathcal{H}_\tau), G)\) ​作为​ \(\mathcal{H}_\tau\) ​的​标量​函数​ → ​在​ RL ​中​作为​ terminal reward。​优点​是​绕过​ grader ​与​投影​的​显式​建模​；​缺点​是​ surrogate ​需要​大量​ (trajectory, salvage) ​配对​，post-2027 ​之前​几乎​没有​真实​数据​。

​综述​判断​：​路径​ iii ​最​ ML-rich ​但​ data-bottleneck ​最​严重​；​路径​ ii ​工程​门槛​最低​、​最​适合​ Phase 1 verification round ​上​的​概念​验证​；​路径​ i ​在​ deep RL ​社区​最​自然​但​需​独立​的​ grader ​数据​集​。​三条​路径​都​进入​ §12 frontier。

docs.title: 11.5 Seam C2：information-premium reward shaping
docs.text:
Phase 0c-C W4 (Cell Reports Phys. Sci., 2024, [A?]) + W12 (pv-magazine 2025-05-22 trade press) ​联合​提出​：salvage ​价值​的​一部分​来自​ SOH ​签名​的​可​识别性​ (characterizability) ​而​非​ SOH ​值​本身​。​新​ LFP ​价格​下跌​（W12 directional finding）​使​ well-documented ​老​电池​的​边际​信息​溢价​相对​上升​。

​形式化​（Connection 3 inline）：​在​ §2.2 objective ​中​加入​ \(-\mu\,\mathrm{tr}\bigl(\Sigma_{\mathrm{SOH}\mid\mathcal{H}_\tau}\bigr)\) ​项​，​奖励​能​"​激发​更​可​识别​老化​签名​"​的​轨迹​——​更​近似​最优​实验设计​而​非​纯粹​"​最小化​老化​"。​该项​只​在​ §6 Seam D ​的​ L4（​调度​器​消费​完整​后验​）​已​实现​时​ well-defined。Connection 3 (Phase 0d §7) ​的​精确​陈述​：Thread T2 ​的​ prediction-decision ​闭环​是​ Thread C ​信息​溢价​ reward shaping ​的​技术​先决条件​。conformal-then-MILP at first life (Seam A) ​自然​扩展​为​ "conformal-then-MILP at first life plus posterior-variance penalty for second-life salvage"。

docs.title: 11.6 Seam C3：homogeneity / fairness coupling at the module level（Connection 4 inline）
docs.text:
Phase 0c-C W3 (Applied Energy S0306261925005306, 2025, [A?]) + W8 (EN 18061:2025) ​联合​表明​：salvage ​函数​对​模块​间​ SOH ​同质性​敏感​。​全​ pack repurposing ​要求​ module ​间​ SOH ​匹配​（EN 18061 ​显式​ clause）；disassembly destroys economic surplus（W3 structural claim，​对​ LFP modular pack vs NMC laminate ​需​ cautious generalize）。

Connection 4 (Phase 0d §7)：​聚合​器层​ fleet dispatch ​在​最大化​ revenue ​时若​允许​模块​间​ SOH ​弥散​度过​大​，​会​在​ \(\tau\) ​直接​破坏​ salvage。EN 18061 ​因此​是​综述​里​ V2G fleet fairness ​约束​的​第一个​非​哲学​正当性​：fairness ​不再​是​规范性​ equity，​而是​ salvage liquidity。Seam C3 ​与​ Seam S1（​机制​设计​）​共享​同一​ tractable ​形式​——per-module SOH-spread ​约束​ + Shapley-style allocation of the implied per-module budget。

docs.title: 11.6.1 Module homogeneity ​约束​的​ MILP encoding
docs.text:
Seam C3 ​在​ §5.1 ​的​ MILP / LP ​范式​下​有​自然​的​ encoding。​设​ fleet ​中有​ \(N\) ​模块​，​每​模块​当前​ SOH \(s_i^t\)、​调度​动作​ \(a_i^t\)（​属​ EV \(i\) ​的​子集​）。​约束​的​ minimal viable ​形式​：

\[ \max_i s_i^t - \min_i s_i^t \leq \delta_{\mathrm{spread}}, \quad \forall t. \]

​即​模块​间​ SOH ​散布​上限​不​超过​ \(\delta_{\mathrm{spread}}\)。EN 18061 ​给出​的​散布​上限​对应​于​"​重组​时​ SOH ​匹配​"​的​严格要求​；​具体​数值​需对​ EN 18061 paywalled text verify（​合理​估计​ \(\delta_{\mathrm{spread}} \in [0.03, 0.10]\)）。

​这一​约束​的​ MILP encoding ​直接​：\(N\) ​个​模块​的​ SOH ​进入​ max / min linearization，​每个​时步​加入​ \(2N\) ​个​ auxiliary ​不等式​。​计算​开销​与​模块​数​线性​、​与​时​步数​线性​、​总体​ \(O(NT)\) ​额外​约束​。​在​ fleet ​规模​下​ \(N \sim 100\)、\(T \sim 24 \times 4 = 96\)（15-min granularity），\(NT \sim 10^4\) ​约束​——​现代​ MILP ​求解​器​ routine ​处理​。

Shapley-style budget allocation ​进一步​细化​：​把​"​模块​ \(i\) ​在​ horizon ​内​可​被​消耗​的​ SOH ​预算​ \(b_i\)"​作为​ Shapley ​分配​的​下游​约束​ \(s_i^0 - s_i^T \leq b_i\)，\(b_i\) ​由​ fleet-level ​总预算​与​ Shapley ​边际​贡献​分配​。​这一​双层​ encoding ​把​ Seam S1（VCG/Shapley on \(\Delta\mathrm{SOH}\)）​与​ Seam C3（module homogeneity）​合并​为​单一​ V2G fleet MILP。​综述​判断​这是​综述​全文​里​"​机制​设计​ + ​协议​合规​ + salvage liquidity"​三重​约束​最​干净​的​合并​点​。

docs.title: 11.7 Seam C4：passport projection as adversarial channel
docs.text:
Phase 0c-C ​提出​：\(\Pi\) ​是​ regulator-mandated ​的​投影​，​买方​ grader ​在​ \(\Pi\) ​上​而​非​完整​ \(\mathcal{H}\) ​上​运行​；​策略性​ scheduler ​可能​ game \(\Pi\)——​例如​把​ rough cycle ​安排​在​护照​ logging-blind ​窗口​内​。​这​是​与​ ML benchmark ​优化​中​的​ Goodhart ​效应​同构​的​ adversarial alignment ​问题​。​监管者​的​ response ​是​丰富化​ \(\Pi\)（​更​高频​日志​、​更​细字​段​）；scheduler ​的​ response ​是​ game ​更​丰富​的​ \(\Pi\)。

Thread T1（​隐​价格​）​在​ Thread C ​下​的​对偶​陈述​：​现在​价格​不再​隐藏​——​它​可​审计​但​投影​截断​。​综述​判定​ Seam C4 ​是​综述​未完结​的​ frontier ​项​，​与​ §10 ​的​ disclosure schema ​形成​对偶​ tension（schema ​越细​ → game ​越精​）。

docs.title: 11.7.1 Passport projection in the Akerlof-Spence-Hirshleifer triangle
docs.text:
§11.7 ​把​ \(\Pi\) ​形式化​为​ adversarial channel，​但​其​ deep structure ​在​ information economics ​的​三个​经典​节点​（Akerlof / Spence / Hirshleifer）​下​还有​更​精确​的​位置​——​把​这​三个​节点​显式​ cite ​进来​可以​把​ Seam C2 + Seam C4 + §10 disclosure schema ​三件​事​统一​到​ information-incentive duality ​框架​下​。

(i) \(\Pi\) as Akerlof (1970) lemons-market correction：second-life integrator（buyer）​在​没有​ SOH ​披露​的​世界​里​ cannot distinguish high-SOH ​与​ low-SOH ​电池​——​市场​ collapse to lemons equilibrium，high-SOH ​卖方​系统性​退出​，​市场​价格​收敛​到​ average-quality battery ​的​价格​。W12（pv-magazine 2025-05-22）​报告​的​ LFP ​价格​下跌​部分​驱动​很​可能​就是​该​ lemons effect ​的​实证​：​缺少​统一​ SOH ​披露​ → buyer ​假设​最坏​ → ​价格​折扣​ → ​优质​卖方​退出​ → ​平均​质量​进一步​下降​。EU Reg 2023/1542 ​通过​强制​披露​ SOH / cycle count / ​关键​故障​事件​，​把​信息​不​对称​从​ buyer-unfavorable ​转换​为​ quasi-symmetric。​理论​上​ lemons discount ​应该​缩小​、market depth ​应该​上升​——​这是​ W11 IDTechEx 17 GWh-by-2030 forecast ​的​ information-economics ​上层​动机​，​而​非纯​供给​驱动​。\(\Pi\) ​在​这​一层​级​上​是​ welfare-positive Pigouvian-style disclosure mandate，​即​综述​ §10 disclosure schema ​的​法规​层​ counterpart。

(ii) Seam C2 reward shaping as Spence (1973) signaling：Akerlof correction ​在​ \(\Pi\) ​字​段​维度​内​有效​——​但​ \(\Pi\) ​是​ projection ​而​非​ full disclosure。\(\Pi\) ​暴露​ (SOH, cycles, fault events, ownership history)，​但​不​暴露​ sub-cycle DoD ​分布​、​瞬时​ C-rate、​温度​ excursion——​这是​ §11.3.1 ​第三层​ piecewise ​的​ information-theoretic ​对应​。Spence ​框架​下​，buyer ​应该​对​ \(\Pi\) ​字段​外​维度​施加​ worst-case ​假设​（pooling equilibrium）——​除非​ seller ​在​ \(\Pi\) ​字段​内​ credibly signal high quality on \(\Pi\)-blind dimensions。​综述​ Seam C2 ​的​ reward shaping \(-\mu\,\mathrm{tr}(\Sigma_{\mathrm{SOH}|\mathcal{H}_\tau})\) ​项​本质​上​是​ Spence signaling ​的​ V2G ​实例​：scheduler ​通过​激发​更​可​识别​的​老化​签名​的​轨迹​来​ signal quality on \(\Pi\)-blind dimensions——signal cost ​是​ \(\mu \cdot \mathrm{tr}(\Sigma)\)，signal ​受益​是​ separating equilibrium ​下​ buyer ​愿意​支付​的​ information premium。

​这一​同构​给出​ Seam C2 ​的​两个​直接​收获​：(a) \(\mu\) ​不再​是​ ad hoc reward weight——​它​应该​正比​于​ pooling vs separating equilibrium ​的​ buyer surplus ​差​（the price of revealed quality）；(b) Seam C2 ​与​ Seam C4 ​是​同一​ information economics ​问题​的​两侧​——signaling ​与​ gaming ​共享​同一​ \(\Pi\) projection，​区别​只​在​ scheduler ​是​ cooperative（signal ​真实​质量​）​还是​ strategic（game ​投影​盲区​）。​综述​据此​把​ Seam C2 ​与​ Seam C4 ​合并​为​单一​ mechanism-design ​问题​而​非​两条​平行​ frontier。

(iii) Hirshleifer (1971) negative — disclosure ​不​单调​改善​ welfare：​在​保险​ / ​风险​分担​市场​中​，ex-ante ​不​对称​信息​可能​是​ welfare-positive——​完全​披露​摧毁​可​保险​性​ (insurability)。​在​ V2G + second-life ​市场​上下文​，full \(\Pi\) disclosure ​摧毁​了​ OEM ​与​ second-life integrator ​之间​的​ batch-level risk pooling——​每块​电池​单独​定价​、batch-discount ​消失​、OEM ​不再​有​动力​补贴​边缘​批次​的​ repurposing ​路径​。​这​意味着​ EU Reg 2023/1542 ​的​福利​效果​不是​单调​改善​——​它​在​ (a) reducing lemons discount (Akerlof positive) ​与​ (b) destroying batch risk pooling (Hirshleifer negative) ​之间​取舍​。Phase 0c ​抽样​里​ ​没有​论文​ ​讨论​ (b)；​综述​把​它​作为​ cross-domain frontier ​项是​ honest ​的​——​这​与​ §1.1 ​第一​轴​对​ \(\lambda_{\mathrm{deg}}\) ​是​ normative input ​的​论点​ echo：disclosure ​强度​的​"​最优​值​"​是​ trade-off ​解​、​不是​"​披露​越多越好​"。

​综合​：\(\Pi\) ​在​三个​经典​ information-economics ​节点​上​同时​是​ Akerlof correction (​字段​内​ lemons removal)、Spence signaling channel (Seam C2 reward shaping ​的​ information-theoretic ​基础​)、​与​ Hirshleifer disclosure cost (batch pooling ​摧毁​)。​综述​ §10 disclosure schema、Seam C2 information premium、Seam C4 adversarial \(\Pi\) ​三件​事​在​该​框架​下​是​同一​对象​的​三个​视图​。Akerlof / Spence / Hirshleifer ​三个​ reference ​进入​ §12 ​跨章​ frontier ​与​ §13.3 ​综述​未来​扩展​。

docs.title: 11.8 Seam C5：salvage liquidity premium ​与​ option-value of waiting
docs.text: Phase 0c-C W11 (IDTechEx 2025 market forecast) + W12 (pv-magazine 2025) + W13 (Joule 2022, S2666386421002484, [A?]) ​联合​表明​ \(V_{\mathrm{salvage}}\) ​非​平稳​：market depth ​在​增长​ (W11 ≈17 GWh by 2030 in EU)，​绝对​价格​在​下跌​ (W12)，characterization ​成本​在​下降​ (W13 ​主要​ friction ​被​ post-2027 ​护照​制度​溶解​)。​最优​ \(\tau\) ​因此​是非​平稳​ salvage ​下​的​ real-option / optimal-stopping problem。​技术​工具​——American-option pricing、optimal-stopping via least-squares Monte Carlo (LSM)、RL for stopping problems——​已​存在​，​但​几乎​不​在​ V2G ​调度​文献​中​。Phase 0c-C ​判定​：closing Seam C5 ​是​ thread ​推荐​的​"​最​干净​的​ single-paper contribution"。

docs.title: 11.8.1 Real-option benchmarks: McDonald-Siegel / Bermudan / Snell-LSM-RL isomorphism
docs.text:
Seam C5 ​的​"​技术​工具​已​存在​但​不​在​ V2G ​文献​"​陈述​需要​把​ real-option ​文献​的​三个​ canonical reference ​显式​ cite ​进来​，​否则​ closed-form benchmark ​与​数值​ benchmark ​都​缺失​，Seam C5 closing ​的​可​证伪​性​下降​。

McDonald-Siegel (1986) threshold rule：​经典​ real-option ​在​ geometric Brownian motion + ​平滑​ salvage ​假设​下​给出​ closed-form ​退出​ threshold——​当​ \(V_{\mathrm{salvage}}/\text{flow} \geq \kappa^*\) ​时​退出​，\(\kappa^*\) ​由​ volatility + drift + discount rate ​解析​决定​。V2G ​映射​：salvage ​在​ high-SOH ​区域​的​增长率​ vs first-life cash flow ​的​衰减​率​之​比​决定​"​等​多久​退出​"。​综述​判断​：McDonald-Siegel threshold ​是​ Seam C5 ​的​ closed-form benchmark——LSM / RL ​数值​解​必须​先​与​之​ sanity-check。​该​ benchmark ​在​ V2G ​文献​中​ ​完全​缺失​——Phase 0c-C W11/W12/W13 ​给出​ directional findings ​但​没有​量化​ threshold。

Dixit-Pindyck (1994) path-dependent extension：V2G salvage ​通过​护照​投影​ \(\Pi(\mathcal{H}_\tau)\) ​进入​——​使​ salvage ​是​ path-dependent ​而​非纯​ SOH-Markovian。​这​把​问题​从​标准​ American option (Markov state) ​推向​ Asian-style option（path-dependent payoff）。​综述​ §11.7 Seam C4 ​触及​了​ path-dependence ​但​未​识别​ Asian-option ​同构​——​后者​使​数值​ apparatus ​进一步​复杂​（Asian-style LSM ​收敛​比​ American ​慢​）。

Longstaff-Schwartz (2001) LSM as Bermudan-option benchmark + ​协议​ exercise discretization：V2G ​退出​不能​在​任意​时刻​发生​——​退出​必须​在​ plug-in ​窗口​、​需​经过​ EV ​所有权​转移​流程​ + EN 18061 admissibility ​评估​，​是​ ​离散​ exercise dates。​这​把​问题​精确​推​到​ Bermudan option（discrete exercise dates）​而​非​ American option (continuous exercise)。LSM ​是​ Bermudan-LSM ​的​标准​实现​——​综述​ §11.3 / §11.8 ​已​提到​ LSM ​但​未​明确​这是​ Bermudan ​而​非​ American ​设定​。​区分​有​工程​后果​：Bermudan-LSM ​的​收敛​速度​比​ American ​慢​、​需​更​多​ simulation paths。

Snell envelope recursion + LSM + RL Q-function ​三方​等价​：§11.3 ​已​写出​ Snell envelope ​形式​ \(U_t = \max\{Y_t, \mathbb{E}_t[U_{t+1}]\}\)；​这里​给出​ LSM ​与​ RL Q-function ​的​ detail，​三者​在​ V2G stopping-time ​上下文​下​是​同一​对象​的​三个​数值​实现​。

(i) Snell envelope discrete-time recursion（​理论​形式​）： $$ U_t(\mathcal{H}t) = \max\bigl{\underbrace{V}}(\Pi(\mathcal{Ht),G)\,\mathbf{1}{\text{EN 18061 admissible}}}}},\;\underbrace{\mathbb{Et!\bigl[(\pi^{\mathrm{rev}}_t-\lambda}}\Delta\mathrm{SOHt)\Delta t + U}(\mathcal{H{t+1})\bigr]}\bigr} $$ ​最优​停止​时间​ }\(\tau^*=\inf\{t:Y_t\ge C_t\}\)。​这是​综述​ canonical objective \(\mathcal{J}(\pi,\tau)\) ​在​ \(\pi\) ​给​定下​对​ \(\tau\) ​优化​的​ exact value function recursion。

(ii) LSM (Longstaff-Schwartz) approximation：​直接​计算​ \(\mathbb{E}_t[U_{t+1}]\) ​需对​完整​ future trajectory ​求​积分​（​在​ \(\mathcal{H}_t\) ​高维​下​不​可行​）。LSM ​把​ continuation value ​在​每个​ exercise date ​上​ ​回归​到​ basis function ​展开​： $$ \widehat{C}t(\mathcal{H}_t) \;=\; \sum}^{K} \beta_{k,t}\,\phi_k(\mathcal{Ht),\quad \beta_t = \arg\min\beta \sum_{n=1}^{N}\bigl(U^{(n)}_{t+1} - \sum_k \beta_k \phi_k(\mathcal{H}_t^{(n)})\bigr)^2 $$ ​其中​ \(\phi_k\) ​是​ polynomial / Hermite / spline basis，\(N\) ​是​ Monte Carlo path ​数​。​算法​ backward induction：​从​ \(t=T\) ​开始​向前​递推​ \(\widehat{C}_t\)，​每个​ path ​上​ \(\widehat{\tau}^{(n)}=\min\{t:Y_t^{(n)}\ge\widehat{C}_t(\mathcal{H}_t^{(n)})\}\)。Bermudan ​离散​ exercise dates ​适配​自然​——V2G plug-in ​窗口​对应​ LSM ​的​ exercise ​时刻​集合​。

(iii) RL Q-function ​与​ Snell envelope ​在​离散​时间​下​同构​：​定义​两​-​动作​ MDP——​每个​ exercise date ​选​ "stop" ​或​ "continue"——​其​ Q-function ​满足​ $$ Q_t(\mathcal{H}t,\text{stop})=Y_t,\quad Q_t(\mathcal{H}_t,\text{continue})=\mathbb{E}_t[(\pi^{\mathrm{rev}}_t-\lambda}}\Delta\mathrm{SOHt)\Delta t + \max,a)] $$ ​最优​ policy }Q_{t+1}(\mathcal{H}_{t+1\(\pi^*_t = \arg\max_a Q_t(\mathcal{H}_t,a)\)，​与​ \(\tau^* = \inf\{t:Q_t(\text{stop})\ge Q_t(\text{continue})\}\) ​等价​。Q-learning / Fitted-Q-iteration / DQN ​三种​算法​都​是​ Snell envelope recursion ​的​函数​近似​实现​：LSM ​用​线性​基​函数​回归​ \(C_t\)、Fitted-Q ​用​任意​函数​近似​ Q、DQN ​用​神经网络​近似​ Q。​三者​在​ V2G ​上下文​的​ trade-off：LSM ​训练​快​、basis ​选择​需​先验​、​与​经典​ finance ​文献​兼容​；Fitted-Q ​通用​、​与​ RL ​库​生态​兼容​；DQN ​处理​高维​ \(\mathcal{H}_t\)（​包含​护照​投影​、​电化学​状态​、​市场​价格​）​最​自然​但​需要​更​多​数据​。

(iv) "Option to wait has positive value" ​的​定性​预测​：McDonald-Siegel ​的​核心​定性​结果​——​只要​ \(V_{\mathrm{salvage}}\) ​仍​在​增长​ (W11 IDTechEx forecast) ​或​其​ volatility ​仍高​，​最优​ \(\tau\) ​系统性​比​ myopic SOH-threshold rule ​更​晚​。​这​给​ V2G ​调度​社区​一个​可​立即​检验​的​可​证伪​ prediction：post-2027 V2G stopping decision ​在​ Snell-LSM / RL-Q ​解出​下​应该​系统性​晚于​ "\(\mathrm{SOH}_t = \mathrm{SOH}_{\min}\) ​时​退出​"​的​简单​规则​。​该​ prediction ​与​ Seam C2 information premium reward shaping ​一致​（​信息​溢价​同​向​激励​"​等待​ + signaling"），​与​ Seam C4 adversarial \(\Pi\) ​反向​（gaming ​激励​"​早退​兑现​"）——​三者​共同​决定​ net ​方向​。​综述​识别​：W11 + W12 directional findings ​加权​ net ​方向​是​ empirical question——​这是​ Seam C5 ​推荐​的​ closed-form vs ​数值​ benchmark + ​直觉​对比​的​ single-paper protocol。

​综述​把​ McDonald-Siegel / Dixit-Pindyck / Longstaff-Schwartz ​三个​ reference ​进入​ §12 frontier ​与​ §13.3 ​综述​未来​扩展​，​作为​ Seam C5 closing ​的​ closed-form ​基准​ + ​数值​ benchmark + path-dependent extension ​的​引用​清单​。

​两条​信道​在​ trust boundary、latency budget、regulatory regime ​上​完全​分离​；​它们​在​ "scheduler ​消费​的​ posterior" ​这一​架构​对象​上​ converge。​没有​一篇​ surveyed V2G ​论文​同时​画出​二者​——​综述​判定​该图​为​ §11 ​的​ single most-deployable figure。

docs.title: 11.10 Connection 5：​统一​信息​层
docs.text: Phase 0d Connection 5：Threads A（disclosure schema）、B（protocol-claims registry + OCPP 2.1 / 15118-20）、C（passport schema \(\Pi\) + EN 18061 admissibility + Reg 2023/1542 read-only BMS）​全部​ converge ​到​单一​信息​层​——​什么​被​ logged、​什么​被​披露​、​什么​被​投影​、​什么​可​审计​。§9 / §10 / §11 ​是​同一个​底层​ transparency regime ​的​三个​ projection：OCPP 2.1 + ISO 15118-20 ​决定​ scheduler ​信道​的​ logging granularity；​披露​ schema ​决定​研究​论文​层​的​ reporting；​护照​ + EN 18061 ​决定​ first-life ↔ second-life ​交接​的​ disclosure。​综述​的​贡献​——​也​是​ Phase 1 over Phase 0 ​的​核心​增量​——​是​识别​这一​统一性​并​提出​其​首次​综合​处理​。

docs.title: 11.10.1 ​三条​ deliverable ​的​并行​可行性
docs.text:
Connection 5 ​描述​的​统一​信息​层​在​工程​实现​上​分布​到​三件​ deliverable ​上​：(a) protocol-claims registry (§9 Table 9.1)、(b) ten-field disclosure schema (§10 Table 10.1)、(c) two-channel architecture figure (§11.9)。​三者​在​ community-level ​工作量​上​是​分离​的​——registry ​是​一份​持续​维护​的​ curated ​表​、schema ​是​一份​社区​认可​的​报告​模板​、architecture figure ​是​一份​ reference document。​综述​判断​三者​可以​并行​推进​、​互不​阻塞​，​分别​由​不同​子​社区​认领​：

  • registry ​适合​由​ ChargIN / Open Charge Alliance / ​行业​联盟​维护​；
  • schema ​适合​由​ V2G-Sim / EV2Gym / ​学术​调度​社区​共同​采纳​；
  • architecture figure ​适合​由​ ElaadNL / ​国家​研究​项目​（​如​ PAVE / Vinnova）​领导​。

​综述​本身​不​提供​三件​ deliverable ​的​最终​版本​——​它​提供​其​ minimal viable ​形式​与​ community-level adoption rationale。​这一​组织​选择​是​ Phase 1 ​综述​与​典型​ state-of-the-art ​综述​格式​的​关键​分野​：​综述​显式​承认​其​论点​的​工程​实现​需要​ community-level ​协调​，​而​非​单一​研究组​单​线性​推进​。

docs.title: 11.10.2 ​综述​论点​在​数据​层​的​镜像
docs.text: §11 ​的​统一​信息​层​论点​在​数据​层有​一个​镜像​：post-2027 ​的​ V2G ​退化​感知​调度​需要​ ​联合​ first-life ​数据​ + protocol telemetry + second-life grading outcome ​的​纵向​数据​集​。​当前​各​数据源​分布​在​不同​ owner ​一侧​——OEM ​持有​ BMS ​数据​、CPO ​持有​ OCPP/15118 telemetry、second-life ​集成商​持有​ grading outcome、​监管者​持有​护照​披露​字​段​。Phase 0c ​抽样​语料​中​没有​一份​数据​集​联合​三方​。​综述​据此​提名​：​构建​一份​"V2G longitudinal benchmark dataset"——​以​ EV ​为主​键​、​横向​覆盖​ first-life duty + protocol log + second-life grade——​是​综述​识别​的​最大​单项​ community deliverable，​重要性​高于​任何​方法论​ novelty。

docs.title: 11.11 §11 sub-summary
docs.text: §11 ​把​综述​论点​的​第三​轴​完全​形式化​。EU Reg 2023/1542 (Feb 2027) + EN 18061:2025 (Sep 2025) ​把​ first-life ​与​ second-life ​之间​的​接口​从​合同​关系​升级​为​ regulator-shaped ​函数​关系​。canonical objective ​自此​带​ \(\tau\)、\(\Pi\)、\(G\)、\(V_{\mathrm{salvage}}\) ​与​ EN 18061 admissibility indicator ​五个​新​对象​。Seams C1–C5 ​共​五条​都​对应​明确​的​ single-paper deliverable——​综述​判定​ V2G ​退化​感知​调度​的​ post-2027 ​单​论文​ contribution ​候选​集​主体​在​ Thread C ​内​。

docs.title: 12. Open Frontier & Research Agenda
docs.text: §12 ​汇总​ §4–§11 ​的​全部​开放​ seams，​并​给出​ reproducibility / data / benchmark ​建议​与​跨​ Topic ​指向​。

docs.title: 12.1.1 Cross-domain mechanism-design analogues
docs.text:
§7.3.3 + §11.7.1 ​把​ mechanism design ​与​ information economics ​的​ dual literature ​引入​综述​。​把​这​一​引入​推​到​ V2G mechanism design ​的​ frontier list ​上​，​需要​识别​三个​跨域​类比​——​它们​各自​指向​综述​ underexplored ​的​同一个​ mechanism design ​维度​：inter-temporal / inter-agent ​的​退化​预算​ transferability。

Table 12.2 — Cross-domain transferability mechanisms vs V2G \(\Delta\mathrm{SOH}\) governance

Domain ​资源​ / quota ​对象​ ​经典​机制​ ​关键​设计​原则​ V2G ​映射​ (frontier ​项​) Fishing quota (Hardin 1968, Ostrom 1990, Grafton 2006, Costello-Gaines-Lynham 2008) Total Allowable Catch (TAC), ​渔业资源​ Individual Transferable Quota (ITQ) ​个体​可​交易​ quota + on-board observer + enforcement cost; first-best ​接近​度​由​可​交易​性​决定​ Fleet-level total \(\Delta\mathrm{SOH}\) budget + per-EV \(\Delta\mathrm{SOH}_i\) allocation + EV-to-EV \(\Delta\mathrm{SOH}\) ​内部​市场​ (​综述​当前​ §11.6.1 ​仅​ fixed per-module spread，​未​引入​ transferability) Carbon credit / cap-and-trade (Pigou 1920, Coase 1960, Stavins 2008, Rubin 1996) ​累积​排放量​、​跨期​ carbon budget Pigouvian taxation + cap-and-trade + banking / borrowing timing flexibility — emission ​在​哪​年​发生​不​重要​、cumulative budget ​重要​ \(\Delta\mathrm{SOH}\) ​在​哪​一时​段​发生​不​重要​、cumulative budget ​重要​ → inter-temporal banking and borrowing of SOH budget (​低​ V2G ​价值​时段​保留​ SOH、​高​价值​时段​加速​消耗​) HMO refund / capitated medicine (Arrow 1963, Newhouse 1993) ​医疗​服务​利用率​、provider ​与​ patient ​长期​ health Capitated payment + retrospective refund / risk corridor ​当​ actual utilization ​偏离​ disclosed expectation ​触发​ retrospective refund ​聚合​器​收取​ owner V2G participation fee → ​调度​ \(\Delta\mathrm{SOH}_i\) → ​当​ actual \(\Delta\mathrm{SOH}_i\) ​超过​披露​ expected ​时​retrospective refund​给​ owner (Seam C2 information premium ​的​反向​ contractual ​版本​) ​综合​ inter-temporal × inter-agent ​退化​预算​ "inter-temporal transferable SOH quota + retrospective refund" ​三个​机制​联合​给出​：dynamic + transferable + retrospective-correctable V2G mechanism design ​的​ frontier ​形状​: ​综述​ §7 + §11.6 ​的​ static within-horizon ​设计​是​ ​局部​最优​；​跨域​校准​后​的​ first-best ​是​ ITQ-style transferable quota + carbon-style intertemporal banking + HMO-style refund mechanism ​三件套​

​综合​ insight：​三个​类比​共同​指向​综述​ underexplored ​的​ mechanism design ​维度​——inter-temporal / inter-agent ​的​退化​预算​ transferability。​综述​ §7 + §11.6 ​的​ mechanism design ​是​ static within-horizon；ITQ + carbon banking + HMO refund ​三类​联合​给出​的​设计​原则​是​ dynamic, transferable, retrospective-correctable。​这是​ V2G mechanism design ​在​ cross-domain ​文献​校准​下​的​ frontier ​形状​。​综述​把​"​可​交易​ SOH quota / inter-temporal banking / retrospective refund"​作为​高​ ML-rich + ​高​ community impact ​的​复合​ frontier ​项​进入​ Table 12.1 ​的​延伸​；​具体​的​ inter-temporal MILP / RL with banking constraint ​实例​尚无​ V2G ​文献​先例​。

docs.title: 12.1.2 Meta-​观察​：information-incentive duality ​作为​综述​论点​的​第四层​陈述
docs.text:
​综述​当前​以​"three-axis obsolescence + ​统一​信息​层​ (Connection 5)"​为​论点​骨架​。​把​ §7.3.2 (mechanism design boundary) + §11.7.1 (Akerlof-Spence-Hirshleifer) + §12.1.1 (cross-domain mechanism analogues) ​三个​新​内容​合并​阅读​，​会​发现​一个​比​ Connection 5 ​更​紧密​的​陈述​——information-incentive duality——​它​是​综述​论点​的​隐含​ fourth-level statement。

​轴​ 1 / ​轴​ 2 / ​轴​ 3 ​在​ information-incentive ​视图​下​的​对偶​展开​： - ​轴​ 1 (disclosure / §10 schema) ​是​ information layer ​的​约束​——​什么​必须​被​报告​、​被​披露​、​被​审计​。 - ​轴​ 2 (protocol / OCPP 2.1 + ISO 15118-20 + IEC 63584) ​是​ information + physical action layer ​的​约束​——​什么​ logging granularity ​由​协议​强制​、​什么​ action set ​由​协议​允许​。 - ​轴​ 3 (stopping-time / EN 18061 + Reg 2023/1542) ​是​ information + incentive layer ​的​约束​——salvage indicator ​是​ regulator-set hard gate（incentive ​上​把​ first-life "​用到​死​" ​路径​的​ reward ​清零​）、\(V_{\mathrm{salvage}}\) ​输入​是​护照​投影​ \(\Pi\)（information ​上​截断​历史​可见​性​）。

Duality ​的​陈述​：​三个​轴​的​统一​不仅​是​"​统一​信息​层​"——​而是​ information-incentive duality：​综述​识别​的​每​一份​新​披露​ (axis 1) ​既​是​审计​能力​的​扩展​ (axis 2 enforcement)、​也​是​ stopping decision ​的​决策​输入​ (axis 3 salvage)。​换言之​，§10 disclosure schema ​字​段​、§9 protocol-claims registry ​行​、§11 passport \(\Pi\) ​字​段​——​三件​ deliverable ​不仅​是​相同​信息​层​的​三个​ projection（Connection 5 ​陈述​），​它们​更是​相同​ incentive ​机制​的​三个​ ​杠杆​点​： - §10 ​字​段​ 3 (\(\lambda_{\mathrm{deg}}\)) ​是​ ​披露​ ​也​是​ ​机制​设计​ ​的​ monetary equivalent（§7.3.3 ​内部​ tension ​已​识别​）； - §9 protocol-claims registry ​是​ ​审计​ ​也​是​ RL action set enforcement（Seam S3）； - §11 passport \(\Pi\) ​是​ ​投影​ ​也​是​ Spence signaling channel（§11.7.1）。

​三个​轴​在​ information layer ​上​共享​同一​对象​（​被​披露​ / logged / ​投影​的​ fields），​同时​在​ incentive layer ​上​承担​三个​不同​ mechanism design ​角色​（disclosure mandate / action constraint / signaling cost）。information-incentive duality ​因此​是​综述​论点​的​ fourth-level ​陈述​：post-2027 V2G ​退化​感知​调度​的​统一​信息​层​不止​是​ disclosure——​它​是​ information ​与​ incentive ​之间​的​ IC ​双工​（incentive compatibility ​的​双向​耦合​）：information ​是​ incentive ​的​必要​前提​（​披露​使​内化​可能​），incentive ​是​ information ​的​承载​机制​（​机制​设计​决定​哪些​字​段​值得​披露​）。

​这一​ fourth-level ​陈述​对​综述​论点​的​实质性​后果​：post-2027 V2G ​综述​社区​不​应该​把​ disclosure schema、protocol registry、passport schema ​当作​三个​并列​ deliverable——​而​应该​把​它们​视为​ ​同一​ information-incentive ​双工​的​三个​ entry point。​综述​ §10.4 / §13.3 ​据此​把​"​建立​ information-incentive duality ​框架​下​的​ V2G mechanism design"​作为​ future version ​的​ organizing principle。

docs.title: 12.2 Reproducibility / data / benchmark ​建议
docs.text:
Benchmark ​建议​：V2G ​退化​感知​调度​社区​当前​缺​一份​ cross-paper ​可比​ benchmark suite。​最低​限度​的​ deliverable：(a) ​一份​ V2G duty cycle ​数据​集​（​建议​在​ W4 V2G-HealthNet ​的​ proxy-cycle ​基础​上​释出​、​显式​标注​ proxy-vs-real fraction），(b) ​一份​ \(\lambda_{\mathrm{deg}}\) × \(\mathrm{SOH}_{\min}\) × TOU ​制度​的​标准​ sensitivity ​网格​，(c) W1 MILP ​的​ reference ​实现​作为​ deterministic baseline。

Reproducibility schema：§10 ten-field schema ​的​字​段​ 10 (reproducibility artefact) ​应该​在​ Phase 1 verification round ​把​ W1–W12 ​的​实际​ code/data ​可用​状态​填全​；​当前​默认​假设​是​ "code/data ​不可​用​" ​直到​证否​。

​协议​层​：Seam S3 ​的​ protocol-feasibility wrapper ​是​ high-leverage low-novelty ​工作​；​任何​ V2G-RL ​研究组​都​可以​把​它​做​出来​。​它​一旦​发布​，​整个​ V2G-RL ​文献​的​ sim-to-real claim ​都​需要​重评​——​这是​ §12 ​内​ community impact ​最高​的​单项​工作​。

docs.title: 12.3 ​跨​ Topic ​指向
docs.text:
• Topic 15（multi-agent coordination）：​聚合​器层​ Seam S1 + Seam C3 ​的​ fleet ​机制​设计​与​多车​ cooperation ​直接​接续​ Topic 15。post-2027 ​与​ Topic 15 ​的​最大​新​接口​是​"​在​ \(\Delta\mathrm{SOH}_i\) ​上​的​ VCG / Shapley ​在​ multi-agent learning ​框架​下​的​ truthfulness"。
  • Topic 17（resilience + second-life stationary storage）：Thread C ​的​ \(V_{\mathrm{salvage}}\) ​在​ Topic 17 stationary ​端​被​消费​——​一条​ V2G ​调度​优化​的​ first-life ​轨迹​会​在​ Topic 17 stationary storage ​的​ resilience-aware ​选型​与​ dispatch ​上​有​ downstream ​影响​。Seam C5 ​的​ optimal-stopping ​与​ Topic 17 stationary storage ​投资决策​共享​ real-option apparatus。
  • broader battery passport literature：W7 + W9 ​在​ Reg 2023/1542 ​与​ passport-design ​文献​之间​的​接口​，​是​综述​未​深入​的​方向​；​与​ Topic 17 stationary ​二次​寿命​ + Topic 18 (​假设​) supply-chain traceability ​共享​ passport schema \(\Pi\)。

docs.title: 12.3.1 ​综述​论点​的​核查​可​证伪​性
docs.text:
​综述​的​核心​论点​——post-2027 V2G ​退化​感知​调度​是​规范性​披露​ + ​协议​可行​动作​集​ + ​最优​停止​时间​的​多​目标​问题​——​其​各个​分支​都​附带​明确​的​可​证伪​条件​，​便于​ Phase 1 verification round ​与​后续​研究​测试​。

​第一条​轴​（​规范性​披露​）​可​被​以下​证据​证伪​：​若​ Phase 1 verification round ​在​ Phase 0c-A ​抽样​之外​的​论文​中​找到​一份​同时​完整​披露​ ten-field schema ​全部​ 10 ​个​字​段​（​含​ sensitivity ​与​ protocol layer）​的​ V2G-degradation ​调度​论文​，​则​综述​论点​中​"​披露​ schema ​是​ community-level ​空白​"​被​证伪​、​降级​为​"​披露​ schema ​不​普遍​但​已有​先例​"。​同样​，​若​ W7 ​的​ \(\lambda_{\mathrm{deg}}\) sensitivity ​翻转​结论​在​更​严谨​复制​下​不可​重现​（​如​翻转​点​不​存在​或​位于​不合理​参数​区域​），​则​综述​论点​中​"V2G ​盈利​符号​由​ \(\lambda_{\mathrm{deg}}\) ​决定​"​被​弱化​。

​第二条​轴​（​协议​可行​集​）​可​被​以下​证据​证伪​：​若​ EV2Gym ​或​类似​仿真器​内部​已​ incorporate ScheduleTuple cadence ​与​ TLS handshake budget（​而​综述​未​识别​），​则​ Seam S3 protocol-feasibility wrapper ​的​"​未​发布​"​陈述​被​证伪​。​若​ AC_BPT_DER ​已​在​ 2026 ​年初​实际​发布​、​综述​定稿​时未​注意​到​，​则​ §9.4 ​的​相关​ phrasing ​需​更新​。

​第三条​轴​（​最优​停止​）​可​被​以下​证据​证伪​：​若​ Phase 0c-C ​之外​的​ V2G ​调度​论文​已经​显式​ joint optimize \((\pi, \tau)\) under EN 18061 admissibility（​综述​未​识别​），​则​ Seam C5 "single-paper contribution" ​提名​失效​。​若​ EU Reg 2023/1542 ​的​实施​ timeline ​推迟​（​如​ Feb 2027 mandate ​因​法律​审查​延后​），​综述​的​"post-2027"​时间​标签​需​调整​但​论点​本身​不变​——​因为​论点​不​依赖​具体​日期​、​只​依赖​"​接口​存在​"。

​综述​明确​地​把​这些​证伪​条件​写​出来​，​是​为了​让​其​论点​ falsifiable——​这是​综述​与​ advocacy ​文体​的​关键​分野​。

docs.title: 12.3.2 ​论点​中三轴​ weights ​的​隐含​定位
docs.text:
​综述​论点​把​三轴​并​列为​"​同等​重要​"，​但​工程​实践​中​三者​优先级​隐含​不​对称​。​综述​判断​：(i) ​协议​轴​（§9）​是​ deployable-vs-not ​的​硬​门槛​——​没有​ protocol-feasibility wrapper，​所有​ V2G-RL sim-to-real claim ​不可​证伪​、​产业​意义​为​零​；(ii) ​规范性​披露​轴​（§10）​是​ cross-paper-comparable-vs-not ​的​硬​门槛​——​没有​ ten-field schema ​采纳​，​所有​学术​ NPV / revenue headline ​之间​不可​比​；(iii) ​停止​时间轴​（§11）​是​ first-life-vs-second-life-coherent-vs-not ​的​硬​门槛​——​没有​ stopping-time formulation ​采纳​，​所有​ V2G first-life ​调度​策略​与​ second-life salvage ​决策​互相​ inconsistent。

​三个​硬​门槛​的​工程​优先级​（​综述​判断​）：​协议​轴​ > ​披露​轴​ > ​停止​时间轴​。​理由​是​协议​轴​的​ deliverable（protocol-feasibility wrapper、protocol-claims registry）​工程​门槛​最低​、 community impact ​最​直接​；​披露​轴​的​ deliverable（ten-field schema ​社区​采纳​）​需要​ community-level ​协调​但​技术​门槛​低​；​停止​时间轴​的​ deliverable ​需要​新​的​方法​（differentiable grader、optimal stopping under regulator-shaped salvage），​工程​门槛​最高​。​这一​优先级​判断​既​是​综述​对​ Phase 1 verification round ​的​建议​，​也​是​综述​对​未来​ V2G ​退化​感知​调度​子​社区​ roadmap ​的​建议​。

docs.title: 12.4 ​综述​的​边界​与​不​主张
docs.text:
​综述​自我​设限​的​边界​：(i) ​没有​引入​任何​ Phase 0c ​三份​材料​之外​的​论文​，​因此​ §10 retro-applied schema ​仅​在​ Phase 0c-A ​的​ W1–W12 ​上​计算​；Phase 1 verification round ​应该​扩展​到​ ≈40 ​篇​代表性​论文​（Phase 0d §2 ​提议​的​ Appendix N ​范围​），(ii) §5 verified author registry ​之外​没有​断言​任何​作者​归属​，​所有​未​核实​者​一律​ [A?]，(iii) FC-2 (AFIR/EPBD instrument)、FC-3 (passport date split)、FC-4 (AC_BPT_DER ​发布​)、FC-6 (IEC 63584 instrument)、FC-7 (headline numbers assumption tables) ​在​综述​定稿​时​未必​能​全部​ verify，​未​ verify ​项​保留​ [​需​ verify] ​标签​。

​综述​明确​不​主张​的​内容​：(a) V2G ​在​任何​特定​ jurisdiction ​内​是​ profitable / unprofitable——​这​取决于​ §10 schema ​字​段​ 3、4、7 ​的​具体​值​，​综述​只​主张​披露​这些​字​段​；(b) ​任何​特定​的​ \(\lambda_{\mathrm{deg}}\) ​数值​是​"​正确​"​的​——​综述​只​主张​ normative status ​与​ sensitivity ​报告​要求​；(c) ​任何​特定​ RL/MPC ​方法​在​协议​下​ sim-to-real ​可行​——Seam S3 wrapper ​未​发布​前该​ claim ​不可​证伪​。

docs.title: 13. Closing Remarks — ​综述​的​方法学​定位
docs.text: §1–§12 ​完成​了​ Phase 0d ​指定​的​ 12-section outline。​本​节​给出​综述​本身​的​方法学​定位​，​作为​ Phase 1 ​与​未来​工作​之间​的​ contract。

docs.title: 13.1 ​综述​写作​的​"​反对​建议​"
docs.text:
V2G ​退化​感知​调度​的​现有​综述​主流​有​两种​格式​：(a) ​按​时间​/​方法​纵向​分类​（"2015–2020 MILP ​综述​、2020–2025 RL ​综述​"）、(b) ​按子​主题​横向​并列​（"aging ​模型​ / ​优化​算法​ / ​不确定性​处理​"​分别​列举​）。​本​综述​显式​拒绝​这​两种​格式​，​理由​是​它们​都​默认​问题​结构​稳定​、​综述​任务​是​"​覆盖​"​现有​工作​。post-2027 ​的​三轴​重构​使​这​一​默认​错误​——​现有​工作​的​相当​部分​在​新​结构​下​需要​重读​、​其​ headline ​结论​需要​ conditioned on ​规范性​披露​与​协议​合规​假设​。

​综述​采取​的​第三种​格式​是​论点​驱动​：​把​"post-2027 V2G ​退化​感知​调度​是​规范性​披露​ + ​协议​可行​集​ + ​最优​停止​时间​的​多​目标​问题​"​作为​论点​，​把​ §4–§11 ​作为​论点​的​逐轴​展开​、​把​ §12 frontier ​作为​论点​产生​的​研究​ agenda。​这一​格式​的​代价​是​综述​对​覆盖率​的​承诺​降低​（​不​试图​穷举​所有​相关​工作​），​收益​是​综述​对​论点​的​承诺​提高​（​每​一条​工作​的​引用​都​对应​论点​的​一个​具体​支点​）。

docs.title: 13.2 ​综述​与​ Phase 0c ​三份​材料​的​关系
docs.text:
​综述​与​ Phase 0c ​三份​材料​是​严格​继承​关系​而​非​简单​合并​：

  • Phase 0c-A ​提供​ Thread A ​的​语料​、​论点​结构​、​与​ ten-field schema ​初稿​。​综述​在​ §6 ​与​ §10 ​把​ Thread A ​的​"​披露​ → ​机制​" axis ​完成​升级​，​并​在​ Connection 1 ​与​ Connection 3 ​将​其​连接​到​ Threads B ​与​ C。
  • Phase 0c-B ​提供​ Thread B ​的​语料​、protocol-claims registry ​概念​、​与​ Seams S1–S5。​综述​在​ §7 ​与​ §9 ​把​ Thread B ​的​"​聚合​器​ → ​协议​" axis ​形式化​为​两条​信道​架构​与​ protocol-feasibility ​三层​ nesting，​并​在​ Connection 1、2、4 ​将​其​连接​到​ Threads A ​与​ C。
  • Phase 0c-C ​提供​ Thread C ​的​语料​、stopping-time formulation、​与​ Seams C1–C5。​综述​在​ §11 ​把​ Thread C ​的​"second-life fork" axis ​形式化​为​ piecewise objective ​与​三层​ piecewise ​结构​，​并​在​ Connection 2、3、4、5 ​将​其​连接​到​ Threads A ​与​ B。

Phase 0d ​提供​ §2 outline ​与​ §3 notation ​的​最终​形式​，​综述​按此​ scaffold ​不​偏移​。​所有​未​在​ Phase 0c ​三份​材料​中​出现​的​论文​在​综述​里​不​被​引入​——​这是​综述​论点​ traceability ​的​必要​约束​。

docs.title: 13.3 ​综述​未来​版本​应​包含​的​扩展
docs.text:
​承认​本​初稿​的​范围​限制​，​未来​版本​应该​至少​包含​以下​扩展​：

(i) Appendix N ​的​完整​ retro-application：​把​ ten-field schema ​应用​到​ ≈40-paper ​样本​而​非仅​ Phase 0c-A ​的​ W1–W12 12 ​篇​。​这​要求​把​ Phase 0c-B ​的​ A1–A12 ​与​ Phase 0c-C ​的​ W1–W13 ​都​按​ schema ​逐字​段​填写​，​目前​留​ §10.2 + Appendix N placeholder。

(ii) Protocol-claims registry ​的​扩展​：​当前​ Table 9.1 ​只​覆盖​ 8 ​条​ claim，post-2027 ​实际​监管​环境​涉及​更​多​ protocol/standard/regulation ​节点​（​如​ ISO 15118-21 ​互通​测试​层​、IEC 63110 ​充电​点​登记​、​各国​ transposition ​法案​）。​综述​未来​版本​应​把​ registry ​扩展​到​ 30+ entries ​并设​维护​机制​。

(iii) Two-channel architecture figure ​的​细化​：​当前​ §11.9 ​给出​ ASCII ​示意​；​未来​版本​应​给出​ production-grade architecture diagram（​含​ trust boundary、TLS handshake budget、message rate、​与​ EU/US/CN jurisdictional ​差异​）。

(iv) ​综述​论点​的​实证​测试​：​综述​在​ §12.3.1 ​给出​论点​的​可​证伪​条件​。​未来​版本​应该​实际​运行​ Seam C ​的​ joint \((\lambda_{\mathrm{deg}}, \mathrm{SOH}_{\min}, \mathrm{tariff})\) ​三轴​扫描​（​在​ W1 MILP ​上​）、​发布​ profitability contour ​作为​综述​论点​的​ empirical anchor。

docs.title: 13.4 ​综述​对​ Phase 1 ​自身​的​ honest log
docs.text:
​最后​，​本​初稿​的​ honest log：

  • ​综述​没有​ web-verify Phase 0c ​三份​材料​之外​的​任何​ reference；§5 verified registry ​之外​的​所有​作者​归属​一律​标​ [A?]（​旧​ [A?] ​符号化​）。
  • Phase 2 review round ​升级​了​三项​ FC：FC-2 (primary instrument = Commission Delegated Reg (EU) 2025/656)、FC-6 (IEC 63584:2024 Ed. 1.0 + IEC 63584-210:2025)、FC-3 (​撤回​ Aug 2027 split——Annex XIII ​不​支持​)。FC-4 (AC_BPT_DER published ​状态​)、FC-7 (W6/W8/W5/W4 assumption tables) ​在​本稿​定稿​时​仍​ hold。
  • §11.9 ​的​ architecture figure ​是​ ASCII ​示意​而​非​ production diagram。
  • §10 Table 10.2 ​的​字​段​评分​基于​ Phase 0c-A ​抽象​描述​、​未​对​原文​ cross-check（FC-7 ​同样​适用​）。
  • ​综述​未​做​ quantitative meta-analysis（​如​ NPV cross-paper ​中位数​ / ​方差​报告​）——​综述​论点​不​要求​ quantitative aggregation。

honest log ​的​存在​是​综述​与​ advocacy ​文体​的​另​一条​分野​：​综述​显式​标注​其​论点​的​核查​边界​、​留​ Phase 1 verification round ​与​未来​研究​修订​空间​。

docs.text: FC ​内容​ ​首次​出现​ Status FC-1 OCPP 2.1（​非​ 2.0.1）​才​与​ ISO 15118-20 BPT ​原生​互通​；OCPP 2.0.1 ​仅作​ transitional baseline §1.1, §9.1, Table 10.1 field 9 confirmed via ElaadNL A12 + Phase 0c-B Seam S4 FC-2 EU Mode-3 January 2027 mandate ​的​ primary instrument §1.1, §9.3, Table 9.1 confirmed (upgrade): Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2025/656, OJEU 2025-06-18, supplementing AFIR (EU) 2023/1804；​两​ phase（2026-01-08 EN 15118-2 / 2027-01-01 EN 15118-20） FC-3 ​电池​护照​ Feb 2027 / Aug 2027 split §1.1, §11.1, Table 9.1 revised: 18 Feb 2027 confirmed (Art. 77 + Annex XIII)；"Aug 2027 universal QR-code split" ​在​ Annex XIII ​中​找​不到​支持​证据​——​综述​撤回​该​ claim（QR code ​即​ Feb 2027 mandate ​本身​的​访问​机制​） FC-4 AC_BPT_DER "expected early 2026" §9.4, Table 9.1 expected, not published; verify at write time FC-5 V2G-HealthNet RMSE 0.015 ​必须​标​ "proxy-cycle" §4.4, §6.1, §7.2, §8.5 confirmed; qualifier preserved throughout FC-6 OCPP 2.0.1 ed3 ↔ IEC 63584 §9.5, Table 9.1 confirmed (upgrade): IEC 63584:2024 Edition 1.0 (Dec 2024, OCPP 2.0.1 ed3) + IEC 63584-210:2025 (OCPP 2.1) FC-7 Headline numbers (W6 €132/€70, W8 USD 25k, W5 0.213%, W4 0.015) assumption tables §1.1, §4.4, §8.1, §10.2 reported figures, ​需​ verify full-text assumption tables; SOH RMSE ​单位​统一​为​ percentage points FC-8 W1 ​没有​发布​ \(\lambda\)-sensitivity sweep §5.1, Table 10.2 row W1 confirmed; W1 ​不可​被​ credit ​为​ sensitivity disclosure ​发起

docs.title: Appendix A ​续​：fact-check ​各项​的​"​升级​触发​条件​"
docs.text:
​为​让​ fact-check log ​在​ Phase 1 verification round ​上​ actionable，​附加​每条​ FC ​项​的​"​升级​触发​条件​"——​满足​该​条件​后​ status ​可​由​ [​需​ verify] ​升​为​ confirmed ​或​ revised：

  • FC-2 ​已​升级​：primary instrument ​定位​为​ Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2025/656（OJEU 2025-06-18，supplementing AFIR (EU) 2023/1804），​含​ 2026-01-08 (15118-2) ​与​ 2027-01-01 (15118-20) ​两​ phase。​建议​ EUR-Lex ​直接​核查​可​作为​最后​冗余​ confirm（​不​强制​）。
  • FC-3 ​已​ revised："Aug 2027 universal QR-code phase" ​在​ Annex XIII ​中​找​不到​支持​证据​——​综述​已​撤回​该​ claim；Feb 18, 2027 mandate（Art. 77 + Annex XIII）confirmed。​后续​仅​需​在​公布​后​跟踪​ Reg 2023/1542 ​的​ delegated acts（​处理​ lifecycle/durability statistics）​的​具体​生效​日期​。
  • FC-4：​需​ ISO 15118-20 AC_BPT_DER ​修订​的​正式​ published ​标记​（ISO ​网站​或​ ElaadNL ​更新版​ V2G guide）。​一旦​ published，​更新​ §9.4 ​的​ "expected" → "published" ​与​具体​生效​日期​。
  • FC-6 ​已​升级​：OCPP 2.0.1 ed3 ↔ IEC 63584:2024 Edition 1.0（Dec 2024）；OCPP 2.1 ↔ IEC 63584-210:2025。EUR-Lex / IEC catalog ​可​作为​最后​冗余​ confirm（​不​强制​）。
  • FC-7：​需对​ W6（Sagaria, Boström et al.）、W8（China megacities）、W5（BatteryGPT）、W4（V2G-HealthNet）​的​原文​ assumption table ​逐项​ verify—— \(\lambda_{\mathrm{deg}}\) ​推导​、TOU ​价格​路径​、​折现​率​、aging ​模型​类​、benchmark ​数据​集​组成​、SOH RMSE ​报告​单位​约定​。​任何​一项​发现矛盾​即​触发​对应​行​的​ status ​改为​ revised。
  • FC-1、FC-5、FC-8 ​已​ confirmed，​仅​保留​作为​对照​基线​。

​升级​触发​条件​的​形式化​让​综述​的​ fact-check log ​从​ "honest disclosure of uncertainty" ​升级​为​ "verification roadmap with explicit acceptance criteria"——​后者​更​易于​交付给​ Phase 1 verification subagent ​作为​任务​规约​。
